summary_zh: 本研究针对发展中国家和偏远地区缺乏集中污水处理设施的现状，评估了一种小型化、可持续的好氧-反硝化下流式悬挂海绵生物反应器在处理生活污水中的性能。该系统对化学需氧量和氨氮的去除率分别超过79%和84%，通过将部分原污水绕过反应器顶层引入，可促进反硝化作用，使总氮去除率最高达到71%。然而，这种旁路策略对处理后出水中抗微生物药物耐药性基因和可移动遗传元件水平的影响尚不明确。为此，研究采用高通量定量PCR技术，分析了不同旁路比例（0%、10%、20%和30%）条件下反应器出水中耐药基因和可移动遗传元件的丰度变化。结果显示，所有系统均实现了90%以上的耐药基因削减，但不同旁路设置下出水中的耐药基因和总氮水平存在差异，约20%的旁路比例可实现两者的协同最优削减。耐药基因的去除与细菌去除率呈平行关系，但出水中残留细菌因可移动遗传元件相对丰度更高，表现出更强的遗传可塑性。总体而言，增加旁路比例可提高总氮去除率，但会降低耐药基因削减效果，因此在实际应用中需根据当地对总氮和耐药基因排放的具体要求进行协同优化。该研究为分散式污水处理系统中营养物去除与耐药性风险控制的平衡提供了科学依据。
title: Co-optimization of sponge-core bioreactors for removing total nitrogen and antibiotic resistance genes from domestic wastewater
venue: The Science of The Total Environment

abstract: <jats:title>Abstract</jats:title> <jats:p>The electromagnetic method is one of the important approaches to hydrocarbon prospecting. In an approach to invert resistivity and induced polarization (IP) using the constraints of seismic and electric logging data, the accuracy of reservoir-distribution prediction on the formation's electrical properties is improved. An example illustrates that a joint interpretation workflow of electromagnetic properties (resistivity and polarization), for seismic traps as well as seismic attributes, can significantly reduce drilling risks for oil and gas exploration. The number of practical projects also supports the conclusion. Joint interpretation works at different stages of oil and gas exploration and production with positive results.</jats:p>
summary_zh: 电磁法是油气勘探的重要手段之一。本文提出一种在地震和电测井数据约束下反演电阻率与激发极化参数的方法，从而提升基于地层电性特征的储层分布预测精度。实例表明，将电磁属性（电阻率和极化率）与地震圈闭及地震属性进行联合解释的工作流程，能够显著降低油气勘探的钻井风险，这一结论已得到多个实际项目的验证。联合解释方法在油气勘探与开发的不同阶段均取得了良好应用效果。
title: Drilling-risk assessment with joint electromagnetic and seismic data

abstract: Understanding physics is crucial for intelligent robots and embodied agents to sense the world, move and manipulate objects, interact safely with their environment, and optimize motions and processes. In this paper, we propose GraphSlot , a slot-based object-centric learning framework that leverages graph neural networks to model object interactions. GraphSlot dynamically constructs graphs based on the spatial proximity of objects and external influence from gravity. Embedding information from neighbors is propagated between connected nodes. Through comprehensive experiments on simulation datasets, we demonstrate that GraphSlot achieves state-of-the-art performance with a remarkable enhancement of 8.5% in foreground Adjusted Rand Index (fg-ARI) comparing to the baseline SAVi-L model. As part of our evaluation, we design a real-world ball-catching game environment to test the physical intuition of our proposed model. GraphSlot shows promise for slot-based methods with physical understanding common sense.
summary_zh: 本文提出GraphSlot框架，将基于槽的对象中心学习与图神经网络相结合，通过根据对象空间邻近性和重力影响动态构建图来建模对象交互，实现对物理规律的理解。在模拟数据集上的实验表明，GraphSlot相比基线模型SAVi-L在前景调整兰德指数上提升了8.5%，达到最优性能。通过设计真实球类捕捉游戏环境的评估，验证了该模型具有物理直观理解的能力，为具有物理常识的基于槽的方法提供了新的思路。
title: Towards physics aware embodied control with graph based object-centric learning

abstract: <jats:p>Federated Learning (FL) offers a decentralized approach to model training, where data remains local and only model parameters are shared between the clients and the central server. Traditional methods, such as Federated Averaging (FedAvg), linearly aggregate these parameters which are usually trained on heterogeneous data distributions, potentially overlooking the complex, high-dimensional nature of the parameter space. This can result in degraded performance of the aggregated model. While personalized FL approaches can mitigate the heterogeneous data issue to some extent, the limitation of linear aggregation remains unresolved. To alleviate this issue, we investigate the generative approach of diffusion model and propose a novel generative parameter aggregation framework for personalized FL, pFedGPA. In this framework, we deploy a diffusion model on the server to integrate the diverse parameter distributions and propose a parameter inversion method to efficiently generate a set of personalized parameters for each client. This inversion method transforms the uploaded parameters into a latent code, which is then aggregated through denoising sampling to produce the final personalized parameters. By encoding the dependence of a client's model parameters on the specific data distribution using the high-capacity diffusion model, pFedGPA can effectively decouple the complexity of the overall distribution of all clients' model parameters from the complexity of each individual client's parameter distribution. Our experimental results consistently demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed method across multiple datasets, surpassing baseline approaches.</jats:p>
title: pFedGPA: Diffusion-based Generative Parameter Aggregation for Personalized Federated Learning

abstract: Hypergraphs provide a versatile framework for modeling complex relationships beyond pairwise interactions, finding applications in various domains. k -core decomposition is a fundamental task in hypergraph analysis that decomposes hypergraphs into cohesive substructures. Existing studies capture the cohesion in hypergraphs based on the vertex neighborhood size. However, such decomposition poses unique challenges, including the efficiency of core value updates, redundant computation, and high memory consumption. We observe that the state-of-the-art algorithms do not fully address the above challenges and are unable to scale to large hypergraphs. In this paper, we propose an efficient approach for hypergraph k -core decomposition. Novel concepts and strategies are developed to compute the core value of each vertex and reduce redundant computation of vertices. Experimental results on real-world and synthetic hypergraphs demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art algorithm by 7 times on average while reducing the average memory usage by 36 times. Moreover, while existing algorithms fail on tens of millions hyperedges, our approach efficiently handles billion-scale hypergraphs in only a single thread.
title: Accelerating Core Decomposition in Billion-Scale Hypergraphs
venue: Proceedings of the ACM on Management of Data

abstract: We propose a new nonthermal mechanism of dark matter production based on vacuum misalignment. A global X-charge asymmetry is generated at high temperatures, under which both the will-be Higgs boson and the dark matter are charged. At lower energies, the vacuum changes alignment and breaks the U(1)_{X}, leading to the emergence of the Higgs bosonand of a fraction of charge asymmetry stored in the stable dark matter relic. This mechanism can be present in a wide variety of models based on vacuum misalignment, and we demonstrate it in a composite Higgs template model, where all the necessary ingredients are naturally present. A light pseudo-scalar η is always predicted, with interesting implications for cosmology, future supernova observations and exotic Z→γη decays.
summary_zh: 我们提出一种基于真空错位的暗物质非热产生新机制。在高温下，系统产生一个整体的 X 电荷不对称性，即将成为希格斯玻色子的场和暗物质粒子均携带该荷。随着能量降低，真空取向发生改变并破缺 U(1)X 对称性，从而涌现出希格斯玻色子，同时部分电荷不对称性被储存于稳定的暗物质遗迹中。该机制可广泛存在于各类基于真空错位的模型中，我们以一个复合希格斯模板模型加以展示，其中所有必要要素均自然具备。该机制总是预言存在一个轻赝标量粒子 η，这对宇宙学、未来超新星观测以及奇异的 Z→γη 衰变过程具有重要启示。
title: Higgs Boson Emerging from the Dark

summary_zh: 自动指纹识别系统在门禁控制、银行卡验证及刑事侦查等领域的应用日益广泛。当前主流算法基于空间细节点检测与匹配，其匹配阶段需耗费大量时间进行修正。本文提出一种基于频域的指纹识别算法，利用傅里叶变换将增强后的指纹图像编码为一组浮点数构成的特征扇区，在指纹增强阶段即融合细节点与脊线信息。匹配过程仅需计算两个特征扇区间的绝对距离。由于采用快速傅里叶变换与同心圆采样方法，该算法具备几何畸变不变性，且匹配速度显著提升。实验结果验证了算法的可行性，文末展望了后续改进方向。
title: Fingerprint Identification Based on Frequency Texture Analysis
venue: First International Conference on Innovative Computing, Information and Control - Volume I (ICICIC'06)

summary_zh: 在纳米医学领域，全身给药的纳米颗粒通常被认为会大量富集于肝、脾和肾脏。本研究利用第二近红外（NIR-II）荧光成像技术发现，骨骼也是小尺寸聚合物纳米颗粒的重要蓄积器官。研究人员制备了具有可见光及近红外二区荧光特性的不同尺寸聚合物纳米颗粒，并观察到其在骨骼中的分布行为具有显著的尺寸依赖性。实验结果表明，直径约为15纳米的小尺寸聚合物纳米颗粒能够在骨骼中实现快速积累与长期滞留；相比之下，直径大于25纳米的纳米颗粒则主要分布于肝脏。通过对骨切片的共聚焦显微镜观察发现，这些纳米颗粒主要分布在骨髓内窦状血管的内皮细胞中。该研究为骨骼成像及骨相关疾病的治疗提供了新的思路与潜在的应用机会。
title: NIR-II Fluorescence Imaging Reveals Bone Marrow Retention of Small Polymer Nanoparticles

abstract: This work deals with the analysis and protocol design problems of the prescribed-time interval bipartite consensus of multi-agent systems on signed and directed graphs. A new distributed protocol with hybrid constant and time-varying feedbacks of local signed error is proposed, whose consensus time period is independent of the specific topology among agents and initial states of all agents. By introducing a series of well-structured Lyapunov functions, the technical difficulties arising from the asymmetrical Laplacian matrices of directed graphs are circumvented. The effectiveness of this prescribed-time protocol for multi-agent systems on signed digraphs with a spanning tree is proven both on structurally balanced digraphs and structurally unbalanced ones with a positive root subgraph. An illustrative simulation example and a prescribed-time bipartite formation experiment on a swarm of nano-quadcopters are implemented to show the validity and practicability of these proposed protocols.
title: Prescribed-Time Interval Bipartite Consensus of Multi-Agent Systems on Directed Graphs: Theory and Experiment
venue: IEEE Transactions on Network Science and Engineering

abstract: Band engineering of two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides (2D TMDCs) is of great significance with regard to both fundamental exploration and practical application. Here we report on a study of the band evolution of monolayer and bilayer TMDCs (WS2, WSe2, and MoS2) under vertical electric fields. Our results show that the electric field has a negligible influence on the bandgaps of monolayer TMDCs. For bilayer TMDCs, our results show that their intralayer direct bandgaps are also immune to the electric field. However, the indirect bandgaps of bilayer TMDCs can be effectively tuned by a vertical electric field. Interestingly, we find that the field tunability of the bandgap in bilayer WSe2 is much larger than those in bilayer WS2 and MoS2.
summary_zh: 二维过渡金属硫族化合物（2D TMDCs）的能带工程对于基础物理探索及实际应用均具有重要意义。本文研究了单层及双层TMDCs（包括WS2、WSe2和MoS2）在垂直电场作用下的能带演变特性。研究结果表明，垂直电场对单层TMDCs的带隙影响微乎其微。对于双层TMDCs，其层内直接带隙同样对电场表现出免疫性，不受电场调控。然而，双层TMDCs的间接带隙可以通过垂直电场实现有效调控。值得注意的是，研究发现双层WSe2带隙的电场可调性显著高于双层WS2和MoS2。该研究为通过电场手段实现二维材料能带特性的精准调控提供了理论依据。
title: Band evolution of two-dimensional transition metal dichalcogenides under electric fields

summary_zh: 针对流行病传播的数学建模是评估疫情威胁及防控干预措施的重要手段。然而，现有模型在处理室内传播风险时存在局限性，主要表现为忽视了人与人之间动态变化的物理距离，且未能区分必要与非必要出行特征。本文提出了一种基于行人的流行病传播模型，旨在模拟社交活动过程中的室内疾病传播风险。通过分析马里兰大学COVID-19影响分析平台的移动性数据发现，当出行频率受限时，人们倾向于在杂货店等场所增加停留时间，即通过延长停留时间来补偿出行频率的下降以满足生活需求。基于该模型与实证结果，本文评估了不同运营层级的非药物干预措施。数值模拟结果表明，单纯限制出行频率和室内场所营业时间在降低个体平均感染风险方面并不具有普遍有效性。相比之下，限制入场人数是一种更为有效的替代方案，但决策者需权衡风险接触减少与室外排队长度增加之间的矛盾，以避免影响民众的基本出行需求。研究结论强调，决策者之间的协同配合能够显著提升组合非药物干预措施的效能，并为未来短期及长期防控决策提供参考。
title: Modeling indoor-level non-pharmaceutical interventions during the COVID-19 pandemic: A pedestrian dynamics-based microscopic simulation approach
Machine learning based early mortality prediction in the emergency department

abstract: 欧盟出于政治、经济和高等教育发展等多种需求．在2009到2011年间研发了多维度全球大学排名系统。这个系统在现有大学排名基础上取长补短，以多维度的评价内容、科学可行的评价方法、“以使用者为本”的排名呈现，开创了一种新颖的大学排名形式。它的“多重优秀”理念符合各方利益相关者的诉求，在全球赢得了广泛的支持，但它也面临着如何在“欧洲”与“全球”、“责任”与“利益”之间取得平衡的问题。
summary_zh: 为应对政治、经济及高等教育发展的多元需求，欧盟在2009至2011年间研发了一套多维度全球大学排名系统。该系统旨在改进现有排名机制的局限性，通过构建多维度的评价指标、科学严谨的评估方法以及“以使用者为本”的呈现方式，开创了全新的大学评价模式。其核心理念在于强调“多重优秀”，旨在兼顾不同利益相关者的诉求，并在全球范围内获得了广泛认可。然而，该系统在实际应用中仍面临挑战，即如何在维护欧洲区域利益与兼顾全球视野、平衡机构责任与商业利益之间寻求有效的平衡点。
title: 欧盟“多维度全球大学排名”：理论创新与方法超越
venue: 国家教育行政学院学报

abstract: The omnipresence of filterable bacteria that can pass through 0.22-μm membrane filters demands a change in the sterile filtration practice. In this study, we identified that filterable bacteria enriched from a surface water are members of the Bacteroidetes, Proteobacteria, Spirochaetae, Firmicutes, and Actinobacteria. Filterable bacteria displayed superior filterability during the entire bacterial growth phase, especially at the exponential phase. Maximal passage percentages were comparable at different cell densities, and achieved earlier at high cell density. Furthermore, filter retention for the investigated bacteria is independent of liquid temperature. However, cultivation temperature could affect the growth of some specific filterable bacteria and lead to variability in the passage percentage. Additionally, membrane materials, pore size and filtering flux greatly affected the passage of filterable bacteria. The majority of filterable Hylemonella and SAR324 could pass through 0.1-μm polyvinylidene fluoride and polyethersulfone filters but could not pass through 0.1-μm polycarbonate and mixed cellulose esters filters. Taken together, our results demonstrated that the ultra-small size of filterable bacteria, membrane characteristics and filtration operational conditions could challenge the validity of the 0.22/0.1-μm sterilizing grade filters in providing bio-safety barriers.
title: Passage and community changes of filterable bacteria during microfiltration of a surface water supply

abstract: As the bounds of convergence time (CT) for fixed-time (FxT) stability have connections with some parameters of the system, the existing methods of FxT stability are still not really FxT. Therefore, this article studies FxT synchronization of complex networks (CNs) by proposing a new FxT stability theorem. First, the new FxT stability theorem is proposed, the CT of the system is any given time in advance, which is not concerning the starting value and parameters of the system. Second, a set of new controllers, including the continuous controller (CCr) and discontinuous controller (DCCr) are, respectively, designed to obtain the new FxT synchronization criteria for the CNs. Moreover, the control methods effectively solve the CT boundary problem associated with the system parameters in the previous FxT stability methods. Finally, numerical simulations and analog circuits are used to verify the effectiveness of the discussed method.
title: Synchronization of Complex Networks With Continuous or Discontinuous Controllers Based on New Fixed-Time Stability Theorem
venue: IEEE Transactions on Systems Man and Cybernetics Systems

summary_zh: 本研究利用手机定位数据，探讨用户重识别风险与数据效用之间的定量关系。以中国深圳市为案例，首先采用两种已知攻击模型——高频访问地点模型和时空点模型——评估移动用户的重识别风险，结果显示深圳的风险水平与西方国家已有研究存在显著差异，证实了重识别风险的空间异质性。在此基础上，提出并实施了一种空间泛化隐私保护方法，通过空间聚合分析衡量隐私保护后的数据效用损失。研究发现，在两种攻击模型下，重识别风险（x）与数据效用（y）之间均遵循统一的数学关系：y = -ax^b + c（a, b, c > 0; 0 < x < 1），其中指数b随攻击者背景知识的增加而增大。该数学关系为数据发布者在隐私保护与数据效用之间选择合理折衷提供了定量依据。本研究深化了对手机位置数据重识别风险的认识，并为共享精细轨迹数据时的隐私-效用权衡提供了基准参考，对位置隐私保护领域具有重要指导意义。
title: Re-identification risk versus data utility for aggregated mobility research using mobile phone location data

abstract: Patching microarchitectural side channels in real-world cryptographic software is a challenging task that does not always result in efficient and secure patches. Despite the continuous efforts of researchers and developers, the security and performance of microarchitectural side-channel patches have not been comprehensively studied before. To systematically study this patching effort, this paper conducts the first measurement study on in-the-wild side-channel patches, yielding the SideBench dataset comprising 165 patches from three mainstream cryptographic libraries (OpenSSL, WolfSSL, and MbedTLS), and offering an automated analysis tool, SideEval, tailored to analyze side-channel patches through a combination of dynamic taint analysis and static symbolic execution. Our analysis reveals that even among patches written by experienced developers, 25 are insecure, leaving residual side-channel leakages potentially unnoticed by developers for years. Furthermore, some patches rashly issued to fix one microarchitectural side channel may inadvertently open new leakages against other side-channel models. We also observed that patches in different cryptographic libraries, even when fixing the same code pattern, can incur drastically different overheads, varying from 10% to 170%. Additionally, our measurements show that recent rule-based and large language model (LLM)-based automated patching tools are not as secure as expected. We summarize our findings and provide insights for developers to fix side channels securely and efficiently.
title: An Empirical Study Measuring In-The-Wild Cryptographic Microarchitectural Side-Channel Patches
venue: Proceedings of the 2025 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security

summary_zh: 基于医学影像的图像引导机器人因其高精度和广阔的工作空间，在手术领域展现出显著优势，能有效降低手术对患者的损伤。然而，现有的图像引导手术机器人多面临稳定性不足（串联机器人）或正运动学求解困难（并联机器人）的挑战。针对现有手术辅助系统的局限性，本文提出了一种紧凑型六自由度解耦并联机器人，并建立了其运动学模型。研究采用牛顿迭代法解决了该机器人的正运动学求解问题。通过神经外科手术模拟实验，验证了运动规划轨迹的准确性及运动学模型的正确性。实验结果表明，该并联机器人在手术应用中具有良好的运动性能，为提升手术辅助系统的稳定性与精度提供了新的解决方案。
title: Design and Kinematic Analysis of a 6-DoF Parallel Robot for Image-Guided Surgery

summary_zh: 反应烧结碳化硅（RB-SiC）是一种高硬度复相陶瓷，由硅基体与碳化硅颗粒组成，因两相电化学与力学性能差异显著，加工难度极大。放电加工（EDM）可突破硬度限制，但材料去除机理尚不明确，导致加工效率与质量难以兼顾。本文提出干式单脉冲放电加工方法，从加工表面形貌与物相组成角度揭示RB-SiC的材料去除机制。采用扫描电子显微镜、能谱分析及拉曼光谱，分别对硅基体与碳化硅颗粒的去除行为进行表征，并通过设置五种脉宽调节放电能量，考察材料去除的变化规律。结果表明，短脉宽条件下，硅基体因电阻率较低且熔点较低而优先被去除；碳化硅颗粒的去除主要源于热震引起的剥落与高温分解。此外，放电加工表面还观察到材料迁移与氧化现象。该研究为协调RB-SiC放电加工的效率和表面质量提供了理论依据。
title: Material removal mechanism of RB-SiC ceramics in dry impulse electrical discharge machining
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

abstract: Abstract. We simulated elemental carbon (EC) and organic carbon (OC) aerosols in China and compared model results to surface measurements at Chinese rural and background sites, with the goal of deriving "top-down" emission estimates of EC and OC, as well as better quantifying the secondary sources of OC. We included in the model state-of-the-science Chinese "bottom-up" emission inventories for EC (1.92 TgC yr−1) and OC (3.95 TgC yr−1), as well as updated secondary OC formation pathways. The average simulated annual mean EC concentration at rural and background sites was 1.1 μgC m−3, 56% lower than the observed 2.5 μgC m−3. The average simulated annual mean OC concentration at rural and background sites was 3.4 μgC m−3, 76% lower than the observed 14 μgC m−3. Multiple regression to fit surface monthly mean EC observations at rural and background sites yielded the best estimate of Chinese EC source of 3.05 ± 0.78 TgC yr−1. Based on the top-down EC emission estimate and observed seasonal primary OC/EC ratios, we estimated Chinese OC emissions to be 6.67 ± 1.30 TgC yr−1. Using these top-down estimates, the simulated average annual mean EC concentration at rural and background sites was significantly improved to 1.9 μgC m−3. However, the model still significantly underestimated observed OC in all seasons (simulated average annual mean OC at rural and background sites was 5.4 μgC m−3), with little skill in capturing the spatiotemporal variability. Secondary formation accounts for 21% of Chinese annual mean surface OC in the model, with isoprene being the most important precursor. In summer, as high as 62% of the observed surface OC may be due to secondary formation in eastern China. Our analysis points to four shortcomings in the current bottom-up inventories of Chinese carbonaceous aerosols: (1) the anthropogenic source is underestimated on a national scale, particularly for OC; (2) the spatiotemporal distributions of emissions are misrepresented; (3) there is a missing source in western China, likely associated with the use of biofuels or other low-quality fuels for heating; and (4) sources in fall are not well represented, either because the seasonal shifting of emissions and/or secondary formation are poorly captured or because specific fall emission events are missing. In addition, secondary production of OC in China is severely underestimated. More regional measurements with better spatiotemporal coverage are needed to resolve these shortcomings.
title: Carbonaceous aerosols in China: top-down constraints on primary sources and estimation of secondary contribution

abstract: Deuteron elastic scattering from C 15 and inelastic scattering reactions to the first excited state of C 15 were studied using a radioactive beam of C 15 in inverse kinematics. The scattered deuterons were measured using HELIOS. The elastic scattering differential cross sections were analyzed using the optical model. A matter deformation length δ d = 1.04 ( 11 ) fm has been extracted from the differential cross sections of inelastic scattering to the first excited state. The ratio of neutron and proton matrix elements M n / M p = 3.6 ( 4 ) has been determined from this quadrupole transition. Neutron effective charges and core-polarization parameters of C 15 were determined and discussed. Results from no-core configuration interaction calculations were also compared with the experimental observations. This result supports a moderate core decoupling effect of the valence neutron in C 15 similarly to its isotone O 17 , in line with the interpretation of other neutron-rich carbon isotopes.
title: Probing the quadrupole transition strength of C15 via deuteron inelastic scattering

abstract: The detailed reaction mechanisms of rhodium-catalyzed cycloisomerization of benzylallene-terminal alkynes involving C sp2 −H bond activation on the benzyl phenyl ring have been investigated with the aid of density functional theory calculations.
summary_zh: 采用密度泛函理论计算，系统研究了铑催化下苄基联烯与末端炔烃环异构化反应的微观机理，重点关注苄基苯环上C(sp²)–H键的活化过程。计算结果表明，该反应并非经历传统设想的协同插入路径，而是通过铑中心介导的逐步活化机制完成。首先，铑催化剂与炔烃配位形成活性物种，随后苄基联烯底物通过其联烯基团与铑中心配位，诱导苯环上特定C(sp²)–H键发生氧化加成，生成关键的铑氢中间体。该步骤为整个催化循环的决速步，其能垒高度决定了反应的选择性。后续经过炔烃插入、还原消除等基元步骤，最终生成环化产物并再生催化剂。研究揭示了取代基电子效应对C–H键活化能垒的调控规律，以及配体环境对反应路径选择性的影响。该理论工作为理解铑催化碳氢键官能团化反应中的区域选择性起源提供了分子层面的解释，对设计新型催化体系、拓展此类反应在有机合成中的应用具有指导意义。
title: Insights into the mechanism and selectivity of the Rh(i)-catalyzed cycloisomerization reaction of benzylallene-alkynes involving C–H bond activation

abstract: The assessment of the wave-induced soil liquefaction plays a key role in the geotechnical design for offshore foundations. The underlying shortcomings of the existing momentary liquefaction criteria are identified and clarified by mechanism analyses and the recent field observations. A modified criterion for the wave-induced momentary liquefaction of a sandy seabed is given to describe the vertical pore-pressure distributions. An improved approximation of the momentary liquefaction depth is further presented. Parametric study of the effects of the saturation degree of soils indicates that this modification is significant for the evaluation of wave-induced momentary liquefaction.
summary_zh: 波浪诱发土壤液化评估是海上基础岩土工程设计的关键环节。本文通过机理分析与最新的现场观测数据，识别并阐明了现有瞬时液化判别准则存在的缺陷。针对砂质海床的特性，研究提出了一种改进的波浪诱发瞬时液化判别准则，能够更准确地描述孔隙水压力沿垂直方向的分布规律，并进一步给出了瞬时液化深度的改进近似计算方法。通过对土壤饱和度影响的参数化研究表明，该改进准则在评估波浪诱发瞬时液化过程中具有显著作用，为海上工程基础的安全设计提供了更可靠的理论依据。
title: A modified criterion for wave-induced momentary liquefaction of sandy seabed

summary_zh: 容量约束弧路径问题（CARP）因其在现实生活中的广泛应用，近年来受到广泛关注。由于CARP属于NP难问题，精确算法仅适用于小规模实例，启发式与元启发式方法成为求解该问题的主流手段。本文揭示了传统搜索算法在求解CARP时面临的一个主要缺陷，并提出一种名为全局修复算子（GRO）的新型操作来克服该问题。我们将GRO嵌入近期提出的禁忌搜索算法（TSA）中，形成基于修复的禁忌搜索（RTS）算法，并在五个公认的基准测试集上进行评估。实验结果表明，RTS不仅在解的质量上优于TSA，而且收敛速度更快。同时，RTS与当前多种领先的CARP求解方法相比也具有竞争力，从而验证了GRO的有效性。更重要的是，GRO并非针对所引用的TSA专门设计，因此它有望作为一种通用工具，用于改进任何采用相同解表示方式的现有方法。
title: A Global Repair Operator for Capacitated Arc Routing Problem
venue: IEEE Transactions on Systems Man and Cybernetics Part B (Cybernetics)

summary_zh: 本研究结合超声干涉测量与原位X射线技术，在多面砧压机中测量了MgSiO3钙钛矿（Mg-Pv）和含铁钙钛矿（Mg0.95Fe²⁺0.04Fe³⁺0.01SiO3，(Mg,Fe)-Pv）在最高25 GPa压力和1200 K温度下的纵波、横波速度及密度。Mg-Pv的数据与已有研究一致，而(Mg,Fe)-Pv样品的剪切性质与Mg-Pv几乎相同。然而，(Mg,Fe)-Pv的绝热体积模量Ks显著低于Mg-Pv，精修值为236 GPa，压力导数为4.7。研究提出，这一较低的Ks值源于含铁钙钛矿在低于30 GPa低压下弹性性质的变化。高温数据与近期模型相符，并表明所获得的(Mg,Fe)-Pv弹性性质与具有整体硅酸盐地球成分的下地幔并不矛盾。该工作为理解下地幔矿物组成及其弹性行为提供了关键实验约束。
title: Acoustic velocities of pure and iron-bearing magnesium silicate perovskite measured to 25 GPa and 1200K

summary_zh: 本研究针对利用结构化电子健康记录进行疾病预测时面临的时变协变量、罕见发病率、协变量失衡及诊断延迟等问题，系统探讨了这些因素对深度学习模型性能的影响，并提出相应改进策略，最终应用于非酒精性脂肪性肝病患者肝细胞癌风险预测。基于全国电子健康记录数据库，纳入220,838例非酒精性脂肪性肝病患者，将肝细胞癌发生预测构建为考虑删失和随访时长的分类任务，评估两种代表性深度学习模型。针对电子健康记录分析中常见的诊断延迟问题，提出了一种新颖的后向掩码策略，并考察了索引日期后纵向信息长度对预测效果的影响。研究发现，对时变协变量进行建模可提升算法性能，迁移学习能够缓解因数据不足导致的性能下降。此外，协变量失衡（如性别偏倚）会损害模型表现，在单一性别上训练并在另一性别上评估时性能明显降低，表明在模型训练数据准备阶段评估协变量失衡的重要性。本研究提出的策略不仅显著提高了非酒精性脂肪性肝病患者肝细胞癌风险预测的性能，还可推广至其他基于结构化电子健康记录的疾病风险预测任务，尤其适用于以某一疾病为条件的继发疾病风险预测。
title: Developing deep learning-based strategies to predict the risk of hepatocellular carcinoma among patients with nonalcoholic fatty liver disease from electronic health records

abstract: We analyse simultaneous velocity and temperature measurements in turbulent thermal convection. Our results show the existence of a cross-scaling between the normalized velocity and temperature structure functions, as implied by the Bolgiano-Obukhov scaling, at the centre of the convection cell. We find that the cross-scaling exponents are, however, different from the values implied by the Bolgiano-Obukhov scaling.
summary_zh: 本文通过对湍流热对流过程中速度与温度的同步测量进行了深入分析。研究结果表明，在对流单元中心区域，归一化速度与温度的结构函数之间存在跨尺度关联，这一现象符合Bolgiano-Obukhov标度理论的预示。然而，研究进一步发现，实际观测到的跨尺度标度指数与Bolgiano-Obukhov理论所推导的数值并不一致。该研究为理解热对流湍流中的能量传递与标度特性提供了新的实验依据。
title: Velocity and temperature cross-scaling in turbulent thermal convection

abstract: The Lieb lattice featuring flat band is not only important in strongly-correlated many-body physics, but also can be utilized to inspire new quantum devices. Here we propose an optomechanical Lieb lattice, where the flat-band physics of photon-phonon polaritons is demonstrated. The tunability of the band structure of the optomechanical arrays allows one to obtain an approximate photon or phonon flat band as well as the transition between them. This ultimately leads to the result that the controllable photon or phonon localization could be realized by the path interference effects. This study offers an alternative approach to explore the exotic photon and phonon many-body effects, which has potential applications in the future hybrid-photon-phonon quantum network and engineering new type solid-state quantum devices.
summary_zh: 具有平带特性的Lieb晶格不仅在强关联多体物理研究中具有重要意义，还可用于启发新型量子器件的设计。本文提出了一种光力学Lieb晶格结构，并成功演示了光子-声子极化激元的平带物理特性。通过对光力学阵列能带结构的调控，可以实现光子平带或声子平带的近似构建，并观测到两者之间的转换过程。研究表明，利用路径干涉效应可以实现对光子或声子局域性的精确控制。这项研究为探索奇异的光子与声子多体效应提供了一种新途径，在未来构建混合光声量子网络以及开发新型固态量子器件领域具有潜在的应用价值。
title: Controllable photon and phonon localization in optomechanical Lieb lattices

abstract: Abstract Among the over 200 molecular species identified in interstellar clouds, many are organic molecules. It has been proposed that some of these molecules survive the star and planet formation process and are eventually delivered to Earth where they can form the molecular basis of the origin of life. It is now well established that one of the most important factories of these molecules are ice mantles that cover the dust grains in star-forming molecular clouds. Simple atoms and molecules such as H, O, N, and CO condense from the gas phase onto the grain surface and then react with each other in the ice to form increasingly complex molecules. At the extremely low temperature (10–15 K) in these clouds, the widely accepted mechanism to bring reactive species together—diffusion—is severely impeded in the ice, raising the question of the mechanism of their formation. In laboratory experiments we find that the top layers of the ice mantle, which are made primarily of CO, transform from a disordered phase to a polycrystalline phase at such a low temperature. During the phase transition, reactive species buried inside may migrate and react without the need to overcome activation energy for diffusion. By quantifying the kinetics of crystallization, we predict that CO ice in interstellar clouds is mostly in the polycrystalline form. The reorganization of CO ice, which occurs below 10 K, may promote mobility of reactive species, and therefore can be a driving force of molecular complexity in molecular clouds.
title: Phase Transition of Interstellar CO Ice

summary_zh: 我们提出AUDIT，一种基于潜在扩散模型的指令引导音频编辑方法，旨在解决现有零样本音频编辑技术存在的关键局限。现有方法未在编辑任务上训练，难以保证编辑质量；可能错误修改无需编辑的片段；且依赖完整的目标音频文本描述，在实际应用中往往不可行。AUDIT通过三项核心设计克服这些问题：第一，针对添加、删除、替换、修复和超分辨率等多种音频编辑任务，构建由编辑指令、输入音频和输出音频组成的三元组训练数据，并以指令和待编辑音频为条件训练扩散模型，生成编辑后的音频；第二，模型通过比较输入与输出音频的差异，自动学习仅对需要编辑的片段进行修改，避免误编辑；第三，文本输入仅需简洁的编辑指令，无需完整描述目标音频。在客观指标和主观评价上，AUDIT在多项音频编辑任务中均取得了当前最优性能。
title: AUDIT: Audio Editing by Following Instructions with Latent Diffusion Models

abstract: 利用密度泛函与自洽反应场理论在B3LYP/6-311G(d)水平下对16种邻苯二甲酸酯(PAEs)进行结构优化,并计算气态环境及溶剂中PAEs的拉曼光谱振动频率和去偏振度。研究显示,16种PAEs拉曼振动归属为苯环变形、酯基振动、C—C伸缩、C—H摇摆、C—H伸缩与耦合振动。其中酯基官能团出峰位置在1 700~1 780cm-1之间,拉曼峰较强,去偏振度较低(振动的对称性较强),可将酯基振动作为特征振动;但气态环境下仅12种PAEs拉曼峰之间的最小波数差大于显微拉曼光谱仪的检出限(0.2 cm-1),即利用酯基频区的去偏振度和拉曼峰不能完全辨识16种PAEs。溶剂化效应分析显示,溶剂苯对16种PAEs具有明显的溶剂化增强效应,16种PAEs拉曼峰之间最小波数差均增大到0.2 cm-1以上,且峰强增加了23%~183%,说明溶剂化效应下可利用酯基频区的去偏振度和拉曼峰辨识16种PAEs。本文的研究结果为PAEs拉曼光谱检测提供了理论依据。
title: Identification of the Raman Characteristic Spectrum Vibrations for Various PAEs Based on Benzene Solvent Effect

abstract: Chatter is a harmful self-excited vibration that commonly occurs during milling processes. Data-driven chatter detection and prediction is critical to achieve high surface quality and process efficiency. Most existing chatter detection approaches are based on external sensors, such as accelerometers and microphones, which require installation of extra devices. Some recent studies have proved the feasibility of online chatter detection using internal signals such as drive motor current. This study aims to investigate the effectiveness of different internal signals extracted from CNC system for chatter detection and compare them with external acceleration signals. The external and internal signals are first compared with time–frequency analysis using Discrete Fourier Transform and Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition approaches. Two chatter detection methods are then presented based on manually and automatically extracted features respectively. The first method uses two nonlinear dimensionless indicators, C0 complexity and Power Spectral Entropy, of filtered signals. The second approach uses autoencoder for automatic feature extraction and Support Vector Machine as classifier for chatter identification. A series of milling experiments are conducted and chatters are intentionally created by changing the milling process parameters. Multiple internal signals are collected using software provided by the machine manufacturer. Results show that several internal CNC signals, such as the nominal current signal and the actual torque signal, can achieve comparable performance to external signals for chatter detection.
title: Exploring the effectiveness of using internal CNC system signals for chatter detection in milling process

summary_zh: 本文针对中国高铁票务销售中的收益管理问题展开研究，重点探讨了“即时分配座位”这一特殊约束对决策的影响。与传统的网络收益管理问题不同，该约束要求一旦接受订单，必须在整个行程中将乘客分配至单一固定座位，且后续不允许调整，这要求管理者不仅要监控总座位容量，还需实时追踪每个座位的状态。研究首先构建了改进的网络收益管理模型，针对所有请求已知的静态问题，在识别出多项式时间可解条件的基础上，提出了高效的近似算法。随后，基于创新的最大序列原理，提出了一种能够处理报价非线性特征的报价控制策略，相比传统策略能更精确地逼近价值函数。最后，通过结合最大序列的动态视角与原问题的静态解，提出了一种“动态原问题重解”策略，在温和假设下实现了有界收益损失。数值实验表明，该策略在资源分配效率上具有显著优势。研究结果揭示了该问题与传统网络收益管理问题的内在联系，并证明通过自适应应用所提方法，可以有效缓解“即时分配座位”约束带来的负面影响。
title: Assign-to-Seat: Dynamic Capacity Control for Selling High-Speed Train Tickets

summary_zh: 本研究针对新型有机磷酸酯（OPEs）普遍缺乏关键理化性质数据的问题，通过评估多种计算工具并建立基于分子量的预测策略，系统预测了46种新型OPEs在25℃下的水溶解度、蒸气压、辛醇-水分配系数和辛醇-空气分配系数。研究发现，不同计算工具间的预测差异随分子量和结构复杂度的增加而增大。对于分子量超过450 g/mol的化合物，方法评估表明COSMOtherm在预测烷基OPEs的水溶解度和蒸气压方面具有优势，而SPARC更适用于预测芳基和卤代OPEs的蒸气压。当分子量超过500 g/mol时，推荐分别采用COSMOtherm和SPARC预测辛醇-水分配系数和辛醇-空气分配系数。对于分子量较小的OPEs，建议基于传统阻燃剂的验证结果，选取COSMOtherm、SPARC、EPI Suite和OPERA中排名前三工具的平均值作为预测值。若选用不当软件，可能导致环境多介质分布和整体持久性的预测偏差分别高达83%和350%。本研究提供的理化性质数据和预测策略有助于提升各类OPEs及新兴污染物的环境归趋、暴露与风险评估的可靠性。
title: Strategies to Reduce Uncertainties from the Best Available Physicochemical Parameters Used for Modeling Novel Organophosphate Esters across Multimedia Environments

abstract: Abstract In distributed optimization of multi-agent systems, agents cooperate to minimize a global function which is a sum of local objective functions. Motivated by applications including power systems, sensor networks, smart buildings, and smart manufacturing, various distributed optimization algorithms have been developed. In these algorithms, each agent performs local computation based on its own information and information received from its neighboring agents through the underlying communication network, so that the optimization problem can be solved in a distributed manner. This survey paper aims to offer a detailed overview of existing distributed optimization algorithms and their applications in power systems. More specifically, we first review discrete-time and continuous-time distributed optimization algorithms for undirected graphs. We then discuss how to extend these algorithms in various directions to handle more realistic scenarios. Finally, we focus on the application of distributed optimization in the optimal coordination of distributed energy resources.
title: A survey of distributed optimization

abstract: An optically pumped gas terahertz fiber laser based on gold-coated quartz hollow-core fiber is demonstrated. When the terahertz fiber laser is filled with methanol gas and pumped by a piezoelectric-ceramic-transducer-adjusted transversely excited atmospheric pressure carbon dioxide laser, a continuous 2.52 THz laser with the output power of 110 mW is obtained. Attributed to the adjustment of the piezoelectric ceramic transducer in the carbon dioxide laser, the fluctuation of the terahertz fiber laser output power is controlled within ±5%. The result confirms the possibility of a compact flexible optically pumped gas terahertz fiber laser.
summary_zh: 本文展示了一种基于镀金石英空芯光纤的光泵浦气体太赫兹光纤激光器。该激光器以甲醇气体为增益介质，采用压电陶瓷换能器调谐的横向激励大气压二氧化碳激光器作为泵浦源，实现了连续波2.52 THz激光输出，功率达110 mW。得益于二氧化碳激光器中压电陶瓷换能器的精密调节，太赫兹光纤激光器的输出功率波动被控制在±5%以内。这一结果验证了紧凑型、可柔性化的光泵浦气体太赫兹光纤激光器的可行性，为太赫兹光源在光谱检测、成像及通信等领域的便携化应用提供了新途径。
title: Optically pumped gas terahertz fiber laser based on gold-coated quartz hollow-core fiber

summary_zh: 我们提出了一种工业规模直接再生混合异质退化LiNi0.5Co0.2Mn0.3O2正极材料的方法。该方法首先利用Li-1-甲基-2-吡咯烷酮与正极材料分子间的范德华力实现均匀接触补锂，使不同来源的退化颗粒达到均匀富锂状态；随后在加热过程中触发自饱和合成补锂反应，确保每颗颗粒按需修复。该工艺已实现单批次处理50公斤正极材料，再生材料性能均匀优异，在安时级软包电池中循环1500次后容量保持率达90.7%，为目前报道的再生LiNixCoyMn1-x-yO2正极材料最佳性能，树立了可直接商业化应用的新基准。
title: Flexible direct regeneration of heterogeneous cathode materials of spent lithium-ion batteries at industrial scale

abstract: ABSTRACT Deprimary reverse time migration (RTM) mitigates the problem of low-wavenumber noise and false events in conventional RTM, and the generation of high-quality angle-domain common-image gathers or angle gathers during deprimary RTM greatly extends its further applications in velocity model updating and subsurface parameter inversion. Poynting-vector-based methods are the most efficient approach to extract angle gathers from RTM or deprimary RTM. However, the instability problem of Poynting-vector-based methods seriously degrades the quality of the generated angle gathers. The instability problem arises from the oscillatory nature of the Poynting vector. To overcome this issue, we propose a novel approach by harnessing the extra simulated Hilbert transformed wavefield in deprimary RTM. Our approach consists of adding the conventional Poynting vector with an ancillary one derived from the Hilbert transformed wavefield, which allows us to eliminate the oscillatory nature of the conventional Poynting vector and obtain a stable algorithm to extract high-quality angle gathers from RTM or deprimary RTM. By using numerical examples with two synthetic data sets and a field data set from the deepwater Gulf of Mexico, we prove the effectiveness of our method in generating high-quality angle gathers.
title: Deprimary reverse time migration angle gathers with a stabilized Poynting vector

abstract: For an m x n binary matrix with d nonzero elements per column, it is interesting to identify the minimal column degree d that corresponds to the best recovery performance. Consider this problem is hard to be addressed with currently known performance parameters, we propose a new performance parameter, the average of nonzero correlations between normalized columns. The parameter is proved to perform better than the known coherence parameter, namely the maximum correlation between normalized columns, when used to estimate the performance of binary matrices with high compression ratios n/m and low column degrees d. By optimizing the proposed parameter, we derive an ideal column degree d = [√m 1, around which the best recovery performance is expected to be obtained. This is verified by simulations. Given the ideal number d of nonzero elements in each column, we further determine their specific distribution by minimizing the coherence with a greedy method. The resulting binary matrices achieve comparable or even better recovery performance than random binary matrices.
summary_zh: 针对具有每列 $d$ 个非零元素的 $m \times n$ 二进制矩阵，如何确定能实现最佳恢复性能的最优列度 $d$ 是一个关键问题。由于现有性能参数难以有效解决该问题，本文提出了一种全新的性能评价指标，即归一化列向量之间非零相关性的平均值。研究证明，在处理高压缩比（$n/m$ 较大）且低列度 $d$ 的二进制矩阵时，该指标在估计恢复性能方面优于传统的相干性参数（即归一化列向量间的最大相关性）。通过对该指标进行优化，本文推导出实现最佳恢复性能的理想列度约为 $d = \sqrt{m}$，并得到了仿真实验的验证。此外，在确定理想列度 $d$ 的基础上，本文进一步利用贪心算法通过最小化相干性来确定非零元素的具体分布。实验结果表明，由此构建的二进制矩阵在恢复性能上可达到甚至超过随机二进制矩阵的表现。
title: Binary matrices for Compressed Sensing

abstract: Drosophila has long been a successful model organism in multiple biomedical fields. Spatial gene expression patterns are critical for the understanding of complex pathways and interactions, whereas temporal gene expression changes are vital for studying highly dynamic physiological activities. Systematic studies in Drosophila are still impeded by the lack of spatiotemporal transcriptomic information. Here, utilizing spatial enhanced resolution omics-sequencing (Stereo-seq), we dissected the spatiotemporal transcriptomic changes of developing Drosophila with high resolution and sensitivity. We demonstrated that Stereo-seq data can be used for the 3D reconstruction of the spatial transcriptomes of Drosophila embryos and larvae. With these 3D models, we identified functional subregions in embryonic and larval midguts, uncovered spatial cell state dynamics of larval testis, and revealed known and potential regulons of transcription factors within their topographic background. Our data provide the Drosophila research community with useful resources of organism-wide spatiotemporally resolved transcriptomic information across developmental stages.
title: High-resolution 3D spatiotemporal transcriptomic maps of developing Drosophila embryos and larvae

summary_zh: 本研究系统探讨了杂芳基偶氮化合物与偶氮苯的光致异构化行为，重点解决紫外光激发在生物医学及光药理学应用中的局限性。通过密度泛函理论计算，结合各向异性感应电流密度分析与核独立化学位移等多种芳香性描述符，揭示了反芳香性与杂环偶氮分子吸收光谱之间的构效关系。研究发现，在反芳香性杂环上引入二氮烯基团可显著红移E式和Z式异构体的n→π*及π→π*跃迁吸收带，且进一步在杂环上引入取代基能够有效调控吸收波长。最终，偶氮化合物E式异构体的第一跃迁带最大吸收波长达到约1026纳米，Z式异构体达到约1167纳米，成功将吸收拓展至近红外区域。该工作为设计近红外光响应的偶氮分子开关提供了理论依据，有望推动其在材料科学与光控药物等领域的应用。
title: Near-infrared Absorbance of E and Z Diazene Isomers via Antiaromaticity

abstract: Abstract Understanding the influence of grain boundaries (GBs) on the electrical and thermal transport properties of graphene films is essentially important for electronic, optoelectronic and thermoelectric applications. Here we report a segregation–adsorption chemical vapour deposition method to grow well-stitched high-quality monolayer graphene films with a tunable uniform grain size from ∼200 nm to ∼1 μm, by using a Pt substrate with medium carbon solubility, which enables the determination of the scaling laws of thermal and electrical conductivities as a function of grain size. We found that the thermal conductivity of graphene films dramatically decreases with decreasing grain size by a small thermal boundary conductance of ∼3.8 × 10 9 W m −2 K −1 , while the electrical conductivity slowly decreases with an extraordinarily small GB transport gap of ∼0.01 eV and resistivity of ∼0.3 kΩ μm. Moreover, the changes in both the thermal and electrical conductivities with grain size change are greater than those of typical semiconducting thermoelectric materials.
title: Tailoring the thermal and electrical transport properties of graphene films by grain size engineering

abstract: Consider M-estimation in a semiparametric model that is characterized by a Euclidean parameter of interest and an infinite-dimensional nuisance parameter. As a general purpose approach to statistical inferences, the bootstrap has found wide applications in semiparametric M-estimation and, because of its simplicity, provides an attractive alternative to the inference approach based on the asymptotic distribution theory. The purpose of this paper is to provide theoretical justifications for the use of bootstrap as a semiparametric inferential tool. We show that, under general conditions, the bootstrap is asymptotically consistent in estimating the distribution of the M-estimate of Euclidean parameter; that is, the bootstrap distribution asymptotically imitates the distribution of the M-estimate. We also show that the bootstrap confidence set has the asymptotically correct coverage probability. These general conclusions hold, in particular, when the nuisance parameter is not estimable at root-n rate, and apply to a broad class of bootstrap methods with exchangeable bootstrap weights. This paper provides a first general theoretical study of the bootstrap in semiparametric models.
summary_zh: 本文针对具有欧几里得参数及无限维干扰参数的半参数M-估计模型，探讨了自助法（Bootstrap）作为统计推断工具的理论依据。尽管基于渐近分布理论的推断方法较为常用，但自助法因其操作简便，在半参数M-估计领域展现出广泛的应用前景。本文通过理论证明，在满足一般性条件下，自助法能够渐近一致地估计M-估计量的分布，即自助分布能够渐近地模拟M-估计量的真实分布。此外，研究进一步证实了自助置信集具有渐近正确的覆盖概率。值得注意的是，上述结论在干扰参数无法以根号n速率进行估计的情况下依然成立，并适用于一类具有可交换自助权重的广泛自助方法。本文为半参数模型中的自助法应用提供了首个系统的理论研究框架。
title: Bootstrap consistency for general semiparametric M-estimation

summary_zh: 针对医学影像领域因医院设备与模型差异导致的数据异质性问题，本文提出了一种开源学习范式PPPML-HMI，用于实现个性化且隐私保护的联邦异构医学影像分析。该框架首次在联邦场景下同时达成个性化与隐私保护，通过融合PerFedAvg算法与自主设计的基于同态加密的循环安全聚合机制，无需修改现有模型结构或共享任何私有数据。为验证其效用，PPPML-HMI被应用于两项任务：一是基于RAD-ChestCT数据集的健康人与患者分类模拟任务，二是面向COVID-19 CT影像的肺部感染分割真实任务。在异构场景下的真实任务中，PPPML-HMI的平均Dice系数较传统联邦学习提升约5%。同时，采用改进的梯度深度泄露方法模拟对抗攻击，结果证实了该框架坚实的隐私保护能力。通过在不同神经网络、用户数量及样本规模下对两项任务的实验，进一步展示了PPPML-HMI的强鲁棒性。
title: Personalized and privacy-preserving federated heterogeneous medical image analysis with PPPML-HMI

summary_zh: 随着多模态数据的指数级增长，传统的单模态检索方法已难以满足用户跨模态获取数据的需求。跨模态检索通过实现不同模态间的交互、语义匹配，并利用异构数据间的互补性与一致性，成为了当前的研究热点。针对现有综述文献在时效性、分类体系及全面性方面的不足，本文对跨模态检索的发展历程进行了系统性的回顾，涵盖了从早期的浅层统计分析技术到近年兴起的视觉-语言预训练（VLP）模型。文章首先基于机器学习范式、机制和模型构建了全面的分类体系，深入探讨了现有跨模态检索方法的底层原理与架构设计；随后，本文概述了领域内广泛使用的基准测试集、评价指标及性能表现；最后，文章剖析了当前跨模态检索面临的挑战与前景，并对其未来的研究方向进行了探讨。此外，为了推动该领域的持续研究，本文还开发了一个易于使用的工具箱及开源代码库。
title: Cross-Modal Retrieval: A Systematic Review of Methods and Future Directions

abstract: Recently, Wang and Chen [1] showed that network coding (NC) can double the throughput as compared to routing in delay-constrained single-unicast communication. This is in sharp contrast to its delay-unconstrained counterpart where coding has no throughput gain. The result reveals that the landscape of delay-constrained communication is fundamentally different from the well-understood delay-unconstrained one and calls for investigation participation. In this paper, we generalize the Koetter-Medard algebraic approach [2] for delay-unconstrained network coding to the delay-constrained setting. The generalized approach allows us to systematically model deadline-induced interference, which is the unique challenge in studying network coding for delay-constrained communication. Using this algebraic approach, we characterize the coding capacity for single-source unicast and multicast, as the rank difference between an information space and a deadline-induced interference space. The results allow us to numerically compute the NC capacity for any given graph, serving as a benchmark for existing and future solutions on improving delay-constrained throughput.
summary_zh: 本文针对时延受限通信场景下的网络编码容量问题，将经典的 Koetter-Medard 代数方法从无时延约束推广到时延受限情形。通过系统建模由截止时间引发的干扰，揭示了时延受限网络编码面临的独特挑战。研究将单源单播与多播的编码容量刻画为信息空间与截止时间干扰空间之间的秩差，从而为任意给定拓扑图提供了网络编码容量的数值计算方法。该结果不仅为评估现有方案提供了理论基准，也为进一步提升时延受限吞吐量的未来研究奠定了基础。
title: On coding capacity of delay-constrained network information flow: An algebraic approach
venue: 2016 IEEE International Symposium on Information Theory (ISIT)

abstract: Abstract The near-superhydrophobic Ti3SiC2 surfaces with regular and controllable micro-grooved structures were fabricated by wire electrical discharge machining (WEDM). The surface topographies and chemical compositions of smooth and micro-grooved Ti3SiC2 surfaces were characterized. The micro removal mechanism of Ti3SiC2 in the process of electrical discharge machining was also analyzed. The wetting mechanism of micro-grooved Ti3SiC2 surface was discussed along with the static contact angle, anisotropic wettability and contact angle evolution versus time. The relationships between parallel and perpendicular contact angles, depth-width ratio of micro-grooved structures and surface roughness of textured surface were investigated. The experimental results show that the parallel contact angle on the textured Ti3SiC2 surface increased by about 164% compared with the one on the smooth surface, and near-superhydrophobic surface with obvious anisotropy was roughly achieved. The experimental parallel contact angles were very close to theoretical contact angles calculated by Cassie-Baxter formula. It is confirmed that the depth-width ratio may be used to predict the parallel contact angle with the average prediction error of 2.4%. The perpendicular contact angles had a good correlation with the depth-width ratio and surface roughness.
title: Fabrication of hydrophobic Ti3SiC2 surface with micro-grooved structures by wire electrical discharge machining

abstract: Communication compression techniques are of growing interests for solving the decentralized optimization problem under limited communication, where the global objective is to minimize the average of local cost functions over a multiagent network using only local computation and peer-to-peer communication. In this article, we propose a novel compressed gradient tracking algorithm (C-GT) that combines gradient tracking technique with communication compression. In particular, C-GT is compatible with a general class of compression operators that unifies both unbiased and biased compressors. We show that C-GT inherits the advantages of gradient tracking-based algorithms and achieves linear convergence rate for strongly convex and smooth objective functions. Numerical examples complement the theoretical findings and demonstrate the efficiency and flexibility of the proposed algorithm.
summary_zh: 本文针对多智能体网络中的去中心化优化问题，提出了一种新型压缩梯度追踪算法（C-GT）。该算法将梯度追踪技术与通信压缩机制相结合，旨在有限通信条件下，仅通过局部计算和点对点通信实现各节点局部代价函数平均值的全局最小化。C-GT 兼容一类通用的压缩算子，统一涵盖了无偏和有偏压缩器。理论分析表明，C-GT 继承了基于梯度追踪类算法的优势，对于强凸且光滑的目标函数，能够实现线性收敛速率。数值实验验证了理论结果，并展示了所提算法的高效性与灵活性。
title: A Compressed Gradient Tracking Method for Decentralized Optimization With Linear Convergence

abstract: Abstract The sound generated or absorbed by short circular holes with a mean flow passing through them is relevant in many practical applications. Analytical models for their acoustic response often ignore the fact that such holes open to a confined or finite space either side, or account for this effect simply by adding an end mass inertial correction. The vortex–sound interaction within a short hole has been recently shown to strongly affect the acoustic response at low frequencies (D. Yang, A.S. Morgans, J. Sound Vib. 384 (2016) 294–311 [ 19] ). The present study considers a semi-analytical model based on Green's function method to investigate how the expansion ratios either side of a short hole affect the vortex–sound interaction within it. After accounting for expansions to confined spaces using a cylinder Green's function method, the model is substantially simplified by applying a half-space Green's function for expansions to large spaces. The effect of both the up- and downstream expansion ratios on the acoustics of the hole is investigated. These hole models are then incorporated into a Helmholtz resonator model, allowing a systematic investigation into the effect of neck-to-cavity expansion ratio and neck length. Both of these are found to affect the resonator damping.
title: The acoustics of short circular holes opening to confined and unconfined spaces

summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于物理信息约束与部分充电数据重构的锂离子电池健康状态估计框架，以解决实际应用中难以获取完整充放电数据的问题。该方法设计卷积神经网络将部分电压曲线重构为增量容量曲线的峰值区域，从而捕获关键老化信息。从重构的增量容量曲线中提取特征用于健康状态估计，并将重构增量容量峰值的物理约束引入损失函数，以增强模型的可解释性与估计精度。在三个不同数据集上的实验验证表明，该方法在使用有限电压片段的情况下，估计误差低于2%，具有较高的估计准确性。结果证实了方法的有效性和泛化能力，为真实场景中数据受限条件下的电池健康状态估计提供了实用解决方案。
title: A SOH Estimation Method for Lithium-Ion Battery Based on Partial Charging Data Reconstruction With Physical Information Constraints

abstract: As a type of promising hardware for next-generation artificial visual systems with extended perceptual and anti-interference capabilities, circular-polarization-resolved retinomorphic sensors are underexplored due to the lack of suitable chiral materials that enable highly dissymmetric circular-polarization responses and multiple biomimetic functions. Here, we demonstrate a self-assembly heterogeneous microstructure consisting of chiral-deficient grains and chiral-rich grain boundaries in chiral perovskites that simultaneously facilitate spin selectivity and optoelectronic properties for highly dissymmetric and multifunctional circular-polarization-resolved retinomorphic sensors. Our sensors not only exhibit a photocurrent dissymmetry factor as high as 1.98 and a panchromatic circular-polarization-resolved response, but also possess multiple biomimetic functions that simulate human retinas, including synaptic behaviors, light adaptation, and color recognition. As a proof-of-concept, we respectively demonstrate their applications using a sensor array that resolves a single circular-polarization handedness for information encryption, as well as binocular sensor arrays that resolve the opposite circular-polarization handedness for virtual stereoscopic reconstruction. Yu et al. report a self-assembled heterogeneous microstructure consisting of chiral-deficit grains and chiral-rich grain boundaries in chiral perovskite with the former as in-plane spin valves for spin selection. Retinomorphic sensor arrays based on the chiral perovskite film enable binocular artificial visual systems.
title: Spin-selective heterogeneous chiral perovskites for circular-polarization-resolved retinomorphic sensors

abstract: While triplet carbenes have been stabilized through spin delocalization, capturing triplet aluminyl anions─isoelectronic counterparts of carbenes─has remained an unsolved challenge in main-group chemistry. All previously reported aluminyl anions exhibit a singlet ground state, despite the use of diverse ligand frameworks. Herein, we report the first example of formally triplet aluminyl anions within bimetallic clusters, [((CH 3 ) 2 C(CH 2 NP i Pr 2 ) 2 ) 2 Al 2 Pd 2 ]M 2 (M = Li, Na, K). These clusters are obtained via chemical reduction of a σ-aromatic Al(II) precursor, [((CH 3 ) 2 C(CH 2 NP i Pr 2 ) 2 ) 2 Al 2 Pd 2 ]. Combined structural and theoretical analyses reveal that each Al(I) center bears two electrons, which exhibit significant electron delocalization across the cluster. This delocalization confers four-center two-electron (4c-2e) σ and 4c-2e π double aromaticity to the [Al 2 Pd 2 ] 2– unit, providing the necessary stabilization for the two Al(I) centers. This work not only demonstrates the viability of formally triplet aluminyl anions but also establishes electron delocalization as a general strategy for stabilizing electron-rich main-group systems.
title: Formally Triplet Aluminyl Anions within the [Al2Pd2]2– Cluster Stabilized by All-Metal Double Aromaticity

summary_zh: 应变工程能够调控外延薄膜的基态及相关相变，但过渡金属氮化物因难以制备化学计量比精确的高质量薄膜，其本征特性与应变依赖关系的系统研究仍面临挑战。本文报道了在高度结晶的反铁磁CrN薄膜中，通过应变和维度缩减实现的电子态转变。当薄膜厚度减薄至约30个单胞的临界值时，CrN薄膜出现显著的导电性下降并伴随异常体积膨胀。令人意外的是，当CrN层薄至仅一个单胞厚度时仍可观测到导电性，这远低于大多数金属薄膜的临界厚度。研究发现，通过制备自支撑氮化物薄膜释放生长应变后，超薄CrN薄膜的金属性可从绝缘行为中恢复。第一性原理计算与线性二向色性测量共同揭示，应变调控的轨道劈裂能够有效定制费米能级附近相对较小的带隙，从而在CrN中引发奇异的相变。利用应变调控竞争相态实现高导电性氮化物超薄薄膜的能力，可推动其优异特性的实际应用。
title: Strain‐Mediated High Conductivity in Ultrathin Antiferromagnetic Metallic Nitrides

summary_zh: 骨形态发生蛋白4（BMP4）是一种通过多种信号通路发挥生物学效应的多功能细胞因子。既往研究表明BMP4能够诱导肺癌细胞进入早衰状态，但其具体的信号通路及其相互作用机制尚不明确。本研究旨在探讨BMP4诱导肺癌细胞早衰的分子机制。研究结果显示，p38 MAPK通路与Smad通路在BMP4诱导的细胞早衰过程中起到了关键作用。在NCI-H460肺癌细胞系中，虽然ERK1/2通路是细胞早衰所必需的，但并未被BMP4激活。进一步研究发现，BMP4响应型R-Smads（即Smad1和Smad5）对于上调细胞周期抑制因子p16(INK)4a和p21(WAF)1/cip1以及诱导早衰过程至关重要。此外，BMP4激活的p38 MAPK通路对于充分激活Smad1/5的转录潜力具有决定性意义。综上所述，本研究揭示了p38 MAPK通路与Smad通路在BMP4介导的肺癌细胞早衰过程中存在复杂的协同作用机制。
title: Role of p38 MAPK pathway in BMP4-mediated Smad-dependent premature senescence in lung cancer cells

abstract: In this paper, we address the problem of learning object class models from weakly labeled training images, where labels of object classes are only provided at image level. Such weakly supervised object learning can be considered as a Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) problem. We observed that object instances of a common category are visually similar and when characterized as high-dimensional feature representations, they approximately lie in a low-dimensional subspace. Therefore, we propose to learn a subspace based generative model for solving the weakly supervised object class learning task. The promising empirical studies on real data sets demonstrate that our proposed method is reasonable.
summary_zh: 本文针对弱标注训练图像中的目标类别学习问题展开研究，其中仅提供图像级别的类别标签，此类弱监督目标学习可视为多示例学习问题。我们观察到，同一类别的目标实例在视觉上具有相似性，且当以高维特征表示时，它们近似分布于低维子空间中。基于此，我们提出一种基于子空间的生成式模型，用于解决弱监督目标类别学习任务。在真实数据集上的实验结果表明，所提方法具有合理性和有效性，可应用于图像分类、目标检测等需要从弱标注数据中学习目标模型的计算机视觉领域。
title: Weakly Supervised Object Class Learning Via Discriminative Subspace Models
venue: 2015 IEEE/WIC/ACM International Conference on Web Intelligence and Intelligent Agent Technology (WI-IAT)

summary_zh: 本研究利用傅里叶变换红外光谱与二维相关分析技术，考察了聚（丙烯腈-co-2-丙烯酰胺基-2-甲基丙磺酸）共聚物在热氧化稳定化过程中的环化反应。结果表明，不同温度下环化反应遵循不同机理：在200 °C时，环化反应以自催化环化机理进行；而在更高温度下，则通过离子环化机理和自由基环化机理发生。AMPS共聚单体可降低环化反应的热释放，并在200 °C和230 °C下提升热稳定性。在更高温度下，环化反应虽被快速促进，但氧化与降解反应也显著加剧，导致分子链断裂并在最终碳纤维中形成缺陷。该研究对聚丙烯腈共聚物作为碳纤维前驱体时热处理工艺的优化具有理论指导意义。
title: Cyclization mechanism and kinetics of poly(acrylonitrile-co-2-acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid) copolymer investigated by FTIR spectroscopy

abstract: Aromaticity, as a classical and fundamental concept in chemistry, can enhance thermodynamic stability. In sharp contrast, a previous study showed that antiaromaticity rather than aromaticity can enhance the radical stability of α-methyl heterocyclic compounds. Here, we demonstrate a similar antiaromaticity-promoted radical stability when the methyl group is replaced by five-membered (alkyl)(amino)cyclics (AACs). More interestingly, when an AAC is fused with an antiaromatic ring, the radical stability could be either reduced or enhanced, depending on the spin population. Specifically, when the spin density is populated on an incoming antiaromatic 1,4-dihydro-1,4-diborinine moiety, the radical stability is enhanced whereas when the spin density is maintained on the original five-membered ring, the radical stability is reduced. Our findings highlight the importance of spin density in tuning the radical stability, inviting experimental chemists' verification.
summary_zh: 芳香性作为化学中经典且基础的概念，通常能增强分子的热力学稳定性。然而，与此形成鲜明对比的是，此前研究表明，在α-甲基杂环化合物中，反芳香性而非芳香性能够提升自由基稳定性。本工作进一步证实，当甲基被五元（烷基）（氨基）环状结构替代时，同样存在这种反芳香性促进自由基稳定性的现象。更有趣的是，当五元环与反芳香环稠合时，自由基稳定性的变化取决于自旋布居分布：若自旋密度主要分布在新引入的反芳香性1,4-二氢-1,4-二硼杂苯片段上，自由基稳定性增强；若自旋密度保持在原有的五元环上，则自由基稳定性降低。这些发现揭示了自旋密度分布在调控自由基稳定性中的关键作用，为实验化学家的进一步验证提供了理论依据。
title: Spin population determines whether antiaromaticity can increase or decrease radical stability

summary_zh: 在水相电化学合成氨的过程中，析氢反应会消耗法拉第电荷，从而降低硝酸盐还原制氨的法拉第效率，这是该领域面临的一个普遍难题。当单一相催化剂在高电流条件下运行时，这一问题尤为突出，因此需要一种能协同促进氢捕获与脱氧过程的助催化体系，以抑制析氢反应并强化硝酸盐还原。本研究选取典型的析氢催化剂碳化二钼，系统探讨了金属掺杂如何将其反应动力学从以析氢为主导向以硝酸盐还原为主导转变。在钌掺杂量为3.8 wt%时，于16平方厘米流动电解池中实现了0.1 M硝酸盐向氨的75%单程转化率，在2 V全电池电压下氨的产率达到9.07毫摩尔每小时。密度泛函理论计算和动力学同位素实验证实，基质中的钌掺杂原子在硝酸盐还原过程中充当吸附氢的汇集点，从而促进Ru–Mo助催化位点上*NO3和*NO2的协同脱氧。本研究表明，优化助催化体系中的氢捕获与脱氧反应是实现高效电化学合成氨的有效策略。
title: Swinging Hydrogen Evolution to Nitrate Reduction Activity in Molybdenum Carbide by Ruthenium Doping

abstract: Existing methods for gene regulatory network (GRN) inference rely on gene expression data alone or on lower resolution bulk data. Despite the recent integration of chromatin accessibility and RNA sequencing data, learning complex mechanisms from limited independent data points still presents a daunting challenge. Here we present LINGER (Lifelong neural network for gene regulation), a machine-learning method to infer GRNs from single-cell paired gene expression and chromatin accessibility data. LINGER incorporates atlas-scale external bulk data across diverse cellular contexts and prior knowledge of transcription factor motifs as a manifold regularization. LINGER achieves a fourfold to sevenfold relative increase in accuracy over existing methods and reveals a complex regulatory landscape of genome-wide association studies, enabling enhanced interpretation of disease-associated variants and genes. Following the GRN inference from reference single-cell multiome data, LINGER enables the estimation of transcription factor activity solely from bulk or single-cell gene expression data, leveraging the abundance of available gene expression data to identify driver regulators from case-control studies.
title: Inferring gene regulatory networks from single-cell multiome data using atlas-scale external data

summary_zh: 本文对模块化可重构机器人系统从1985年至2023年的机构与设计研究进行了全面综述，并提出一种统一的概念框架以厘清该领域的分类体系。针对当前因技术演进和概念设计多样化导致的分类模糊问题，该框架围绕连接器、执行器与同质性三个核心要素构建，为理解模块化可重构机器人硬件提供了结构化视角。基于这一三要素框架，论文对历年来的系统进行了系统化解读与归类，阐释了表征此类系统的基本属性及其组成特征，从而深入剖析其设计思想、技术实现、功能特性与类别归属。此外，文章还借助该框架梳理了模块化可重构机器人的演化轨迹、当前趋势、主要挑战及未来前景，突显其在多功能性、容错能力和经济性等方面的优势，以及在各类应用中的广泛潜力。
title: Decoding modular reconfigurable robots: A survey on mechanisms and design
venue: The International Journal of Robotics Research

summary_zh: 针对基于骨架的动作识别中如何从稀疏骨架数据提取具有判别力的鲁棒时空特征这一核心问题，本文提出了一种结合卷积与注意力机制的深度网络，称为局部与全局注意力网络（LAGA-Net）。首先，将骨架序列编码为关节特征演化图，以紧凑描述其时空特性。其次，设计运动引导的通道注意力模块，通过计算时序帧级运动来建模特征通道间的相互依赖关系，并以通道方式增强运动显著特征。进而，提出时空注意力模块，在序列层面建模时空上下文协同关系，提取包含长程依赖的时空注意力特征。二者结合构成LAGA-Net，能够提取融合骨架序列局部与全局表示的判别性特征。此外，采用双流架构分别从关节和骨骼两个角度学习互补特征。在NTU RGB+D、Northwestern-UCLA、UTD-MHAD和NTU RGB+D 120等多个基准数据集上的大量实验验证了该方法相较于现有先进方法的有效性和优越性。
title: LAGA-Net: Local-And-Global Attention Network for Skeleton Based Action Recognition

summary_zh: 本文提出一种支持多精度浮点运算的多项点积单元设计，采用单指令多数据流架构，面向卷积神经网络与高性能计算中的卷积运算加速。该设计通过可配置乘法器与对齐移位器实现多精度支持，能够在两个连续时钟周期内完成FP16二十项、FP32五项或FP64一项的点积运算，且乘法资源无空闲，有效提升硬件利用率。为加速求和过程，设计了一种进位选择加法器，在面积-延迟积与功耗-延迟积方面均表现出色。基于联电55纳米工艺完成物理实现与实验验证。与当前领先的多精度设计方案相比，本设计在FP16运算下的功耗性能最高提升3.76倍；与已有进位选择加法器相比，面积-延迟积与功耗-延迟积分别改善4.7%与3.91%。该设计适用于对计算精度与能效有差异化需求的神经网络推理与高性能计算场景。
title: Multiple-Precision Floating-Point Dot Product Unit for Efficient Convolution Computation
venue: 2021 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence Circuits and Systems (AICAS)

summary_zh: 成骨细胞由间充质前体分化而来，这一过程涉及一系列由转录因子层级网络调控的细胞命运决定，关键因子包括 RUNX2、Osterix、ATF4 及多种核辅调控因子。在骨发育早期，RUNX2 的表达与间充质凝聚形成同步，远早于软骨与成骨谱系的分支，因此其活性受到多层次调控，涵盖核辅助因子互作和翻译后修饰，尤其是磷酸化。RUNX2 的调控实例包括与 DLX 家族蛋白及 ATF4 的相互作用，以及经由 ERK/MAP 激酶通路的磷酸化修饰，关键磷酸化位点位于 P/S/T 结构域的丝氨酸残基。体内研究进一步证实 MAPK 通路可激活 RUNX2：在成骨细胞中转基因表达组成型活化的 MEK1 可加速骨骼发育，而显性负效 MEK1 则以 RUNX2 依赖方式延缓发育。上述研究揭示了骨形成响应细胞外基质互作、力学载荷和激素刺激等胞外信号时，实现精细调控所依赖的复杂分子机制。
title: Transcriptional Regulation of Osteoblasts
venue: Annals of the New York Academy of Sciences

summary_zh: 针对猴痘病毒（MPXV）引发的全球性传染病威胁，本研究开发了一种新型原型生物传感器，旨在解决现有CRISPR检测方法因需预扩增而耗时较长的问题。该研究通过将CRISPR/Cas12b系统与超灵敏石墨烯场效应晶体管（gFET）相结合，实现了无需扩增的核酸直接检测。实验结果表明，该CRISPR/Cas12b–gFET传感器能够在约20分钟内实现对MPXV DNA目标的检测，灵敏度高达1 aM量级。研究通过设计多种单向导RNA（sgRNA）识别MPXV靶基因，利用Cas12b蛋白切割靶基因产生双链断裂。特异性验证显示，所设计的sgRNA能够有效区分其他同源正痘病毒，并能精准识别2022年新发MPXV与西非MPXV之间的突变位点。该CRISPR–gFET检测技术为MPXV及其他DNA病毒的快速、高灵敏度临床诊断提供了一种极具潜力的工具。
title: Rapid and ultrasensitive detection of mpox virus using CRISPR/Cas12b-empowered graphene field-effect transistors

abstract: A simple yet robust route to the synthesis of Ru decorated S, N co-doped carbon (denoted Ru-SNC) is reported. The Ru-SNC-2 exhibits a superior catalytic performance due to the boosted water dissociation kinetics with an <italic>η</italic>@10 of only 14 mV.
summary_zh: 本文报道了一种简便且稳健的钌修饰硫氮共掺杂碳（Ru-SNC）催化剂的合成方法。通过硫和氮的协同掺杂调控碳基底的电子结构，有效增强了钌活性位点的本征催化活性。所制备的Ru-SNC-2催化剂在碱性析氢反应中展现出卓越性能，其关键在于硫氮共掺杂显著加速了水解离动力学过程，使得该催化剂在10 mA cm⁻²电流密度下的过电位仅为14 mV。该工作为设计高效钌基析氢电催化剂提供了新思路，在可再生能源制氢领域具有重要应用前景。
title: Boosting the water dissociation kinetics via charge redistribution of ruthenium decorated on S, N-codoped carbon

summary_zh: Stille缩聚反应作为一种高效构建碳-碳键的合成工具，在功能材料制备领域展现出重要价值。本综述系统梳理了该反应的核心机理与关键工艺参数，重点探讨了催化剂体系（如钯配合物与配体的协同作用）、单体结构设计以及溶剂效应如何协同调控聚合效率与产物分子量。通过优化反应条件，Stille缩聚法成功实现了多种共轭聚合物的可控合成，包括聚噻吩、聚芴及给体-受体交替共聚物等光电活性材料。文章进一步总结了这些聚合物在有机太阳能电池、场效应晶体管和发光二极管等光电器件中的应用进展，揭示了材料化学结构与器件性能之间的构效关系。该综述为通过Stille缩聚反应理性设计高性能功能高分子材料提供了全面的理论指导与实验参考。
title: Stille Polycondensation for Synthesis of Functional Materials

summary_zh: 微束团不稳定性（MBI）由束流集体效应驱动，会对高亮度存储环、直线加速器及自由电子激光器（FEL）产生显著负面影响。抑制该不稳定性的一种已知有效手段是通过激光加热器为电子束引入适量的能量展宽，而诱导出的能量展宽分布特性对抑制效果影响极大，可通过调节加热激光的横向剖面进行控制。本文在直线加速器相干光源（LCLS）上首次实验演示了利用LG$_{01}$横向激光模式有效抑制MBI的效果，并将其与传统的高斯横向激光模式进行了对比。研究通过纵向相空间分析及相干辐射光谱等多种下游测量手段对MBI抑制效果进行了表征。此外，本文还探讨了LG$_{01}$模式整形在软X射线自种子自由电子激光发射中的作用，而受控抑制MBI对于实现这一先进FEL运行模式至关重要。
title: Laguerre-Gaussian Mode Laser Heater for Microbunching Instability Suppression in Free-Electron Lasers

summary_zh: 黑磷作为一种无金属二维催化剂，在光电化学氮还原反应中展现出优异性能。本研究通过层层组装法将黑磷纳米片沉积于氧化铟锡基底上制备电极，在无牺牲剂的氮气饱和水系电解液中实现了高效合成氨。在-0.4 V电位下，氨产率达到102.4 µg h⁻¹ mgcat.⁻¹，法拉第效率为23.3%，这是目前非金属催化剂在光催化和电催化合成氨领域报道的最佳性能。连续六次循环测试后，电极仍保持出色的稳定性。该催化体系的高效性源于光激发增强电催化过程与外偏压促进光催化过程的协同效应，二者共同提升了氨合成效率。该成果不仅展示了黑磷在光电化学催化领域的巨大潜力，也为利用太阳能和电能实现常温常压合成氨提供了一种有前景的技术路线。
title: Photoelectrochemical Synthesis of Ammonia with Black Phosphorus

abstract: To investigate the role of tumor cytokines/chemokines in melanoma immune response, we estimated proportions of immune cell subsets in melanoma tumors from TCGA, followed by evaluation of association between cytokine/chemokine expression and these subsets. We then investigated association of immune cell subsets, chemokines, and cytokines with patient survival. Finally, we evaluated immune cell TIL score for correlation with melanoma patient outcome in a separate cohort. There was good agreement between RNA-seq estimation of T-cell subset with pathologist-determined TIL score. Expression levels of cytokines IL-12A, IFNG, IL-10, and chemokines CXCL9 and CXCL10 were positively correlated with PDCD1, CTLA-4, and CD8+ T cell subset, but negatively correlated with tumor purity (Bonferroni-corrected P<0.05). In multivariable analysis, higher expression levels of cytokines IFNG and TGFB1, but not chemokines, were associated with improved OS. Higher expression level of CD8+ T cell subset was also associated with improved OS (HR = 0.06, 95% CI = 0.01-0.35, P = 0.002). Finally, multivariable analysis showed that patients with brisk TIL score had improved melanoma-specific survival compared to those with non-brisk score (HR = 0.51, 95% CI = 0.27-0.98, P = 0.0423). These results suggest that expression of specific tumor cytokines represent important biomarkers of melanoma immune response.
title: Role of Immune Response, Inflammation, and Tumor Immune Response–Related Cytokines/Chemokines in Melanoma Progression

summary_zh: 针对高维数据最近邻搜索中局部敏感哈希（LSH）及其改进算法C2LSH存在的不足，本文提出一种基于哈希桶堆排序的局部敏感哈希方案（HSLSH）。该方法核心思路是利用堆排序在海量数据排序中的高效特性来提升近邻查询效率。HSLSH仅需依赖少量哈希函数，既克服了传统LSH需要构建大量哈希表导致空间复杂度过高的问题，又避免了C2LSH因需检测大量数据点碰撞次数而增加查询时间的缺陷。实验结果表明，与C2LSH相比，所提算法在查询精度上提升超过20%，同时查询时间降低40%以上。该算法可广泛应用于机器学习、模式识别及图像检测等需要高效高维数据检索的领域。
title: Locality-Sensitive Hashing Scheme Based on Heap Sort of Hash Bucket
venue: 2019 14th International Conference on Computer Science & Education (ICCSE)

summary_zh: 颗粒蛋白前体（PGRN）具有抑制炎症的作用，并对炎性关节炎展现出治疗潜力，但其背后的免疫学机制尚不明确。本研究利用PGRN与白介素-10（IL-10）基因修饰小鼠模型，在胶原诱导性关节炎中证实，抗炎细胞因子IL-10是PGRN发挥抗炎效应的关键介质。通过IL-10绿色荧光蛋白报告小鼠发现，调节性T细胞（Treg）是响应PGRN产生IL-10的主要细胞来源。进一步研究表明，PGRN促进Treg细胞扩增、活化及IL-10生成的过程依赖于JNK信号通路，而非已知的ERK和PI3K通路。通过基因芯片和染色质免疫共沉淀测序筛选，研究团队鉴定出叉头框蛋白O4（Foxo4）和信号转导及转录激活因子3（Stat3）是PGRN在Treg细胞中诱导IL-10表达所必需的转录因子。这些发现揭示了一条此前未知的、由PGRN在Treg细胞中驱动IL-10产生的信号通路，为理解PGRN在炎症性疾病和自身免疫病（尤其是炎性关节炎）中缓解炎症的机制提供了新见解。
title: Foxo4‐ and Stat3‐dependent IL‐10 production by progranulin in regulatory T cells restrains inflammatory arthritis

summary_zh: 本文报道了一种含缬氨酸的噻咯衍生物的合成。通过在噻咯骨架中引入手性缬氨酸侧基，该化合物不仅表现出圆二色性和圆偏振发光特性，还具备聚集诱导发光性质。聚集诱导发光效应使荧光量子效率从纯四氢呋喃溶液中的0.33%显著提升至加水条件下的18.9%，增幅达57倍；在薄膜状态下，经积分球校准测得的量子效率更高达80.3%，较溶液态提高了243倍。两亲性缬氨酸基团赋予该化合物自组装能力，原子力显微镜图像显示其可形成复杂有序结构。四氢呋喃溶液蒸发过程中，化合物自组装为螺旋纤维，与其圆二色性和圆偏振发光性质高度吻合。向四氢呋喃溶液中加入水或己烷等不良溶剂同样诱导聚集结构形成，并导致螺旋手性在不同程度上增强或反转。该研究为设计兼具高效固态发光与可调手性光学特性的功能材料提供了新策略，在光电器件、手性传感及生物成像等领域具有潜在应用前景。
title: Valine-containing silole: synthesis, aggregation-induced chirality, luminescence enhancement, chiral-polarized luminescence and self-assembled structures

abstract: Abstract First principles calculation has been directed to calculate the surface energy, stacking fault energy, and ductility parameter of the { 1 10} and {11 2 ‾ } slip systems of BCC Fe and Fe47X (X = Cr, Mo, Pb, and Bi). It is found that Cr and Mo should have a negligible effect on surface energy, unstable stacking fault energy, and ductility parameter of the two slip systems of BCC Fe. Calculation also reveals that both Pb and Bi could considerably reduce the ductility, surface energy, and unstable stacking fault energy of BCC Fe, and that such a decrease of the { 1 10} slip system is much greater than that of the {11 2 ‾ } slip system. In addition, the decrease of the surface energy of both slip systems of Fe47Pb and Fe47Bi is much more remarkable than that of the unstable stacking fault energy, i.e., the easier cleavage because of the weaker cohesion with a lower surface energy intrinsically brings about the brittleness of Fe47Pb and Fe47Bi. The obtained results are in nice agreement with experimental and theoretical evidence in the literature, and could offer a deep understanding of the intrinsic mechanism of liquid metal embrittlement of the T91 steel.
title: Effect of alloying elements on stacking fault energy and ductility of iron

abstract: To facilitate the practical deployment and engineering implementation of multi-robot coordination for biomimetic underwater spherical robots (BUSRs), it is imperative to develop a formation tracking control method with a simple structure, a small number of tunable parameters, convenient parameter tuning and strong anti-disturbance capability. This study proposes a formation controller integrating virtual structure (VS), consensus protocol, and parallel output-velocity-type active disturbance rejection control (POV-ADRC), denoted as VS-C-POV-ADRC. A rotating global (RG) coordinate system is established to decouple robot positions from heading angles, which makes the parameter tuning more convenient. A double-loop control architecture is constructed, where the outer consensus control loop generates the desired velocity for each robot based on virtual-structure reference positions, and the inner POV-ADRC loop achieves high-precision velocity tracking. The proposed controller features a compact structure with only five adjustable parameters per motion direction, realizing easy engineering implementation and adaptation to the limited computing capacity of BUSRs. The simulation and experiment results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm enables robots to maintain a stable formation and achieve trajectory tracking accuracy within one body length, while exhibiting superior disturbance rejection. The proposed method provides a feasible and practical solution for BUSR formation control.
title: Integrated ADRC and Consensus Control for Anti-Disturbance Formation Tracking Control of Multiple Biomimetic Underwater Spherical Robots

summary_zh: 本文提出并验证了一种基于复合左右手耦合器的新型色散延迟结构。该结构采用低温共烧陶瓷技术实现，具有紧凑、屏蔽的多层封装形式。与传统全通C节色散延迟结构相比，所提出的复合左右手C节结构凭借更强的耦合能力，实现了更大的群时延摆幅，从而在模拟信号处理应用中带来更高的分辨率。此外，该结构还具有更宽的工作带宽和更小的尺寸。文中建立了广义波干涉分析模型，不仅严格推导了C节色散延迟结构的传递函数与群时延特性，还深入揭示了其在左手和右手工作模式下的物理机制。全波仿真与实验测试结果共同验证了该设计的有效性。
title: CRLH–CRLH C-Section Dispersive Delay Structures With Enhanced Group-Delay Swing for Higher Analog Signal Processing Resolution
venue: IEEE Transactions on Microwave Theory and Techniques

summary_zh: 我们提出一种软迁移网络（Soft Transfer Network, STN），用于解决异构域自适应问题，即借助异构源域知识辅助目标域学习任务。该方法以端到端方式联合学习一个域共享分类器和一个域不变子空间，不仅对齐不同域的判别方向，还同时匹配域间的边缘分布和条件分布。为避免负迁移，STN 采用基于无标签目标数据的软标签策略来对齐条件分布，从而避免将每个无标签目标样本强制分配到单一类别而可能引入错误标注。此外，模型引入自适应系数，随着迭代次数增加逐步提升软标签的重要性，以利用其准确性不断提高的特性。我们在图像到图像、文本到图像以及文本到文本等多种迁移任务上进行了实验，结果表明 STN 显著优于当前多个领先方法。
title: Heterogeneous Domain Adaptation via Soft Transfer Network
venue: Proceedings of the 27th ACM International Conference on Multimedia

summary_zh: 微小RNA（miRNA）在肿瘤发生与转移中发挥重要作用。已有研究表明，miR-203在肝细胞癌、前列腺癌、口腔癌及造血系统恶性肿瘤中常作为抑癌因子被沉默，但其在乳腺癌发生中的功能尚不明确。本研究发现，在原发性乳腺肿瘤及部分非转移性细胞系中，miR-203表达上调，而在BT549、Hs578T和MDA-MB-231等转移性细胞系中显著下调，该下调由其启动子区域高甲基化所致。功能实验显示，在BT549和MDA-MB-231乳腺癌细胞中过表达miR-203可诱导细胞周期阻滞和凋亡，并抑制体外侵袭与迁移能力。生物信息学分析预测促侵袭和转移的转录因子SNAI2（SLUG）为miR-203的靶基因，表达分析和含miR-203靶序列的SNAI2 3'非翻译区荧光素酶报告实验验证了这一预测。上述结果表明，在恶性乳腺癌细胞中，miR-203通过表观遗传机制被沉默，该沉默至少部分通过上调SNAI2转录因子促进肿瘤细胞生长与侵袭。
title: Epigenetic Silencing of miR-203 Upregulates SNAI2 and Contributes to the Invasiveness of Malignant Breast Cancer Cells

summary_zh: 随着电动汽车普及与先进计量技术的发展，需求侧在灵活用能调度中的作用日益凸显，同时电力公司对风电、光伏等可再生能源的并网需求持续增长。然而，这类资源的间歇性特征给电网运行带来了显著不确定性。本文提出一种利用需求侧柔性资源缓解电网运行不确定性的机制，通过构建局域电网运营商与多个聚合商之间的两阶段斯塔克尔伯格博弈模型，设计了一种基于节点边际电价的新型定价方案，以激励需求侧主动参与。采用子博弈完美均衡概念对博弈过程进行分析，推导出最优定价策略，并进一步探讨了局域电网运营商在风电并网条件下为实现供需最小化失配所需的最优实时常规容量规划方法。基于现场数据的仿真结果验证了所提方案的最优性，同时表明采用简化启发式方法亦可获得良好的长期运行性能。
title: LMP-based real time pricing for optimal capacity planning with maximal wind power integration
venue: 2012 IEEE Third International Conference on Smart Grid Communications (SmartGridComm)

abstract: Bipropellant-powered hydraulic free piston engine (BHFPE), as a new type of HFPE, takes advantage of bipropellant in place of conventional fossil fuel, and adopts a catalytic ignition instead of the conventional spark or compression ignition. In this paper, the operational principle and working process of a BHFPE are described firstly, then the chemical formula and molar mass as well as the heating value of the bipropellant i.e. kerosene/HTP combination are dealt with respectively. Thereafter analysis on the internal energy-flow i.e. energy input, transfer, dissipation and output, during a working cycle of the BHFPE are analyzed. Additionally the operating parameters such as working efficiency, maximum speed of the free piston assembly (FPA) and the output hydraulic energy are derived.
title: Analysis on Energy-flow of a bipropellant-powered Hydraulic Free Piston Engine

abstract: The tea green leafhopper Empoasca onukii is one kind of insect pest threatening the tea production, and the mite Anystis baccarum has been used as an agent for pest control. In this paper, we introduce a generalist predator-prey model to study the dynamics for informing biological control. There have been some bifurcation studies of the generalist predator-prey model in the last few years. Except for the bifurcations include saddle-node bifurcation of codimension 1 and 2, Hopf bifurcations, and Bogdanov-Takens bifurcation of codimension 2 and 3, we also present the bifurcations of nilpotent singularities of elliptic and focus type of codimension 3. We ﬁnd that the nilpotent singularities are associated with a cubic Liénard system, and the nilpotent bifurcations are three-parameter bifurcations of a codimension 4 nilpotent focus. Furthermore, we show that the nilpotent focus serves as an organizing center to connect all the codimension 3 bifurcations in the system. We also present the bifurcation diagrams to unfold the nilpotent singularities of codimension 3. One interesting observation is that we show numerically the existence of three limit cycles in the system . Keywords Generalist predatory mite · Pest leafhopper · Hopf bifurcation · Bogdanov-Takens bifurcation · Nilpotent singularity of codimension 3 · Nilpotent focus of codimension 4 · limit cycles
title: Dynamics Complexity of Generalist Predatory Mite and the Leafhopper Pest in Tea Plantations
venue: Journal of Dynamics and Differential Equations

summary_zh: 针对时变无线网络中最大加权队列控制策略难以实时获取最优解的问题，本文研究了传统最大加权队列迭代算法在信道状态信息和队列状态信息与算法迭代处于相同时间尺度变化条件下的收敛行为与队列时延性能。通过构建等效虚拟随机动态系统，并应用扩展的福斯特-李雅普诺夫判据进行稳定性分析，推导出无线网络时延的闭式上界，该上界由信道状态信息衰落速率以及最大加权队列策略对信道状态信息和队列状态信息的敏感度共同决定。基于等效虚拟随机动态系统，提出一种带有补偿机制的新型最大加权队列迭代算法以提升跟踪性能。理论证明表明，在温和条件下，尽管信道状态信息和队列状态信息随时间变化，所提出的改进最大加权队列算法仍能收敛至最优控制策略。该研究为时变无线通信场景下的跨层资源调度提供了理论依据与算法支撑。
title: Delay analysis of max-weight queue algorithm for time-varying wireless ad hoc networks – Control theoretical approach

summary_zh: 本文针对岛屿背风侧常出现的双排涡旋现象进行了深入研究。研究利用MODIS卫星遥感数据，对太平洋西北部济州岛周边长达20年的云图进行了统计分析，并结合ERA5逐小时再分析数据探讨了大气涡旋脱落（VS）的形成判据。研究结果表明，在强逆温条件下，当上游气流达到特定速度时，更有利于大气涡旋脱落现象的发生。通过机器学习方法筛选出关键的上游流速与逆温强度参数，并构建了预测涡旋发生的拟合曲线，其预测准确率超过98%。该研究建立的拟合关系为中尺度大气模拟系统提供了有效的参数化方案，有助于提升模型对山地后方小尺度涡旋脱落现象的模拟精度。
title: Identification of the atmospheric vortex shedding behind the Jeju Island based on MODIS and ERA5 data

summary_zh: 氮化铝凭借其强二阶与三阶非线性效应的结合，是集成光子学中极具前景的材料。然而，该材料本征硬度高且电子束曝光过程中存在荷电效应，使得氮化铝纳米加工面临挑战。传统方法通常需要多层硬掩模和金属掩模来制备纳米结构。本文报道一种新颖简便的氮化铝微腔制备方法，仅采用单层氮化硅掩模并结合薄层导电聚合物。该导电层可在显影过程中便捷去除，无需额外刻蚀步骤。我们在氮化铝与掩模之间实现了高达4:1的刻蚀选择比，从而支持中红外光子器件的制备，并在氮化铝微腔中获得高达1.0×10⁶的本征品质因数。此外，我们在这些器件中展示了多种非线性现象，包括频率梳产生、拉曼激光、三次谐波产生以及超连续谱产生。
title: Simplified aluminum nitride processing for low-loss integrated photonics and nonlinear optics

abstract: Differentiable rendering has gained significant attention in the field of robotics, with differentiable robot rendering emerging as an effective paradigm for learning robotic actions from image-space supervision. However, the lack of physical world perception in this approach may lead to potential collisions during action optimization. In this work, we introduce a novel improvement on previous efforts by incorporating physical awareness of collisions through the learning of a neural robotic collision classifier. This enables the optimization of actions that avoid collisions with static, non-interactable environments as well as the robot itself. To facilitate effective gradient optimization with the classifier, we identify the underlying issue and propose leveraging Eikonal regularization to ensure consistent gradients for optimization. Our solution can be seamlessly integrated into existing differentiable robot rendering frameworks, utilizing gradients for optimization and providing a foundation for future applications of differentiable rendering in robotics with improved reliability of interactions with the physical world. Both qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate the necessity and effectiveness of our method compared to previous solutions.
title: Prof. Robot: Differentiable Robot Rendering Without Static and Self-Collisions
venue: 2025 IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)

summary_zh: 二维过渡金属氮化物作为新兴材料，在高倍率储能领域展现出巨大潜力，可应用于便携式及可穿戴电子设备等场景。然而，高效、高产率合成方法的缺失严重制约了该类材料的规模化制备，此前仅有氮化钼、氮化钛和氮化镓的报道。本研究提出了一种可扩展的合成策略，通过在氨气气氛中还原二维六方氧化物，成功制备了氮化钼等二维氮化物。对亚纳米厚度氮化钼纳米片的深入研究表明，理论计算与实验结果均证实其具有金属性。亲水性再堆叠的二维氮化钼薄膜在硫酸电解液中展现出高达928法拉每立方厘米的体积电容，并兼具优异的倍率性能。该工作所展示的金属性二维氮化钼以及氮化钨、氮化钒的合成方法，为拓展二维材料家族并引入更多具有优异特性的新成员提供了有效途径。
title: Salt-Templated Synthesis of 2D Metallic MoN and Other Nitrides

summary_zh: 本文研究在线奖励投毒问题，即攻击者在训练过程中蓄意篡改奖励函数，诱导学习智能体采纳有害策略。现有奖励投毒研究多聚焦于离线攻击，需预先掌握环境的状态转移概率，而本工作探索更具现实意义且更具挑战性的动态未知场景。具体而言，我们假设攻击者可访问智能体的经验回放缓冲区并修改奖励数据，但对转移概率一无所知。我们将投毒任务形式化为一个优化问题，并采用重构方法规避双重采样难题。所提算法在表格型设定下具备可证明的收敛性，并可扩展至函数逼近场景，通过联合学习被投毒的奖励网络与被投毒的Q值网络来求解问题。算法有效性通过四项不同的实验评估得到验证。
title: Online Reward Poisoning in Reinforcement Learning With Convergence Guarantee
venue: IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security

abstract: We consider the problem of minimizing emission of a heavy-duty truck transporting freight between two locations subject to a hard deadline constraint. The truck is equipped with a multi-speed transmission and a modern combustion engine that intelligently switches among multiple fuel injection strategies at certain engine speeds (called switching speeds) to achieve lower emission profiles. Our objective is to minimize the emission by optimizing both path and speed planning for heavy-duty trucks with multi-speed transmission and multiple injection strategies in the engine. This emission minimization problem, while pervasive in practice, has two challenges: i) the emission rate function is discontinuous and non-convex due to switching of the fuel injections and gear ratios, which makes the common practice of driving at a constant speed on a road segment not eco-friendly; ii) the problem is NP-hard due to the combinatorial nature of the simultaneous path and speed planning. We tackle the first challenge by considering the case where the truck can travel at a heterogeneous speed profile over a road segment and then formulate the speed planning problem as a convex problem. We further identify special structures in this problem and provide an efficient method for computing the optimal speed profile. We then tackle the second challenge by developing an efficient heuristic for both path planning and speed planning to solve the emission minimization problem on the scale of national highway systems. Our extensive simulations on the US highway system show that our solution reduces up to 46% NOx emission as compared to the commonly-adopted fastest path approach. We also find that optimizing heterogeneous speed profiles reduce up to 32% emission as compared to their homogeneous counterpart, thus are necessary to be considered in eco-friendly truck operations.
title: Minimizing Emission for Timely Heavy-Duty Truck Transportation
venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems

abstract: Abstract Transient response accuracy of the fiber optic seismic accelerometer influences greatly the seismic reservoir monitoring in the smart oilfield fields. This study demonstrates the transient response analysis of an optimized fiber optic seismic accelerometer, and the effects of damping on the transient response are experimentally verified. The silicone oil is injected into the accelerometer structure to increase the damping, and an additional elastic rubber ring is used to provide an adjustable damping. The experimental results show that the injected silicone oil increases obviously the stamper damping, and the variations of torsional moment also modify slightly the damping of the accelerometer. The increase of the damping avoids the oscillation tailing phenomenon, and therefore largely improves the transient response, which is confirmed by the commercial piezoelectric accelerometer. This study can be used to modify the measurement error and improve the accuracy of the seismic reservoir monitoring in the smart oilfield applications.
summary_zh: 本研究针对智能油田地震储层监测对光纤地震加速度计瞬态响应精度的需求，提出了一种优化结构并开展瞬态响应分析，实验验证了阻尼对瞬态特性的影响。通过在加速度计结构中注入硅油以增大阻尼，并引入弹性橡胶环实现阻尼可调。实验结果表明，注入硅油显著提高了振膜阻尼，同时扭转力矩的变化也会轻微改变加速度计的阻尼特性。阻尼的增加有效抑制了振荡拖尾现象，从而大幅改善瞬态响应性能，该结论已通过商用压电加速度计对比验证。本研究成果可用于修正测量误差，提升智能油田地震储层监测的精度。
title: Experimental study on transient response of the fiber optic seismic accelerometer

summary_zh: 尽管视觉语言模型（VLM）在静态视觉理解方面取得了显著进展，但在复杂的3D具身环境中应用仍面临巨大挑战。现有基准测试普遍存在任务过于被动、缺乏深度感知、存在特权信息泄露以及人工评估成本过高等缺陷。为此，本文提出了PokeGym，这是一个基于《宝可梦传说：Z-A》这一复杂3D开放世界RPG游戏构建的视觉驱动长程任务基准。PokeGym通过严格的代码级隔离机制，确保智能体仅能基于原始RGB观测进行决策，并利用独立的内存扫描技术实现自动化的任务验证，从而保证了评估的纯视觉性和可扩展性。该基准包含30个涵盖导航、交互及混合场景的任务，并提供三种不同粒度的指令（视觉引导、步骤引导、仅目标引导），旨在系统性地解构模型的视觉定位、语义推理与自主探索能力。研究发现，当前VLM在具身环境中的主要瓶颈并非高层规划能力，而是物理死锁的恢复能力，且死锁现象与任务成功率呈强负相关。此外，研究还揭示了模型性能与死锁认知之间的元认知差异：较弱的模型多表现为“无意识死锁”（无法察觉陷入困境），而先进模型则表现为“有意识死锁”（能识别困境但无法脱困）。这一发现强调了在VLM架构中集成显式空间直觉的必要性。
