The multiple signal amplification was realized by Y-shaped arrays, HCR amplification, and poly-HRP catalyzed CL reaction. Using this multiple signal amplification method, our microfluidic CL biosensor achieves a limit of detection of miRNAs of 0.49 fM, with a linear range of 1 fM-10 pM, which is better or comparable to previously reported biosensors. What's more, the proposed microfluidic biosensor exhibits great specificity and selectivity to the target miRNA. Moreover, the microfluidic CL strategy exhibited excellent accuracy and could significantly distinguish different cancer subtypes as well as cancer patients and healthy people. These results suggest that this simple, high sensitive, and more accurate analytical strategy by analyzing different types of exosomal miRNAs has the potential applications in cancer diagnosis and stage monitoring.
title: A microfluidic-based chemiluminescence biosensor for sensitive multiplex detection of exosomal microRNAs based on hybridization chain reaction

abstract: Abstract Understanding kidney disease relies on defining the complexity of cell types and states, their associated molecular profiles and interactions within tissue neighbourhoods 1 . Here we applied multiple single-cell and single-nucleus assays (>400,000 nuclei or cells) and spatial imaging technologies to a broad spectrum of healthy reference kidneys (45 donors) and diseased kidneys (48 patients). This has provided a high-resolution cellular atlas of 51 main cell types, which include rare and previously undescribed cell populations. The multi-omic approach provides detailed transcriptomic profiles, regulatory factors and spatial localizations spanning the entire kidney. We also define 28 cellular states across nephron segments and interstitium that were altered in kidney injury, encompassing cycling, adaptive (successful or maladaptive repair), transitioning and degenerative states. Molecular signatures permitted the localization of these states within injury neighbourhoods using spatial transcriptomics, while large-scale 3D imaging analysis (around 1.2 million neighbourhoods) provided corresponding linkages to active immune responses. These analyses defined biological pathways that are relevant to injury time-course and niches, including signatures underlying epithelial repair that predicted maladaptive states associated with a decline in kidney function. This integrated multimodal spatial cell atlas of healthy and diseased human kidneys represents a comprehensive benchmark of cellular states, neighbourhoods, outcome-associated signatures and publicly available interactive visualizations.
title: An atlas of healthy and injured cell states and niches in the human kidney

abstract: In this paper, a novel multiple sub-models maintenance technique, named maintaining and processing sub-models (MAPS), is proposed. MAPS aims to enhance the ability of estimation of distribution algorithms (EDAs) on multimodal problems. The advantages of MAPS over the existing multiple sub-models based EDAs stem from the explicit detection of the promising areas, which can save many function evaluations for exploration and thus accelerate the optimization speed. MAPS can be combined with any EDA that adopts a single Gaussian model. The performance of MAPS has been assessed through empirical studies where MAPS is integrated with three different types of EDAs. The experimental results show that MAPS can lead to much faster convergence speed and obtain more stable solutions than the compared algorithms on 12 benchmark problems.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种新颖的多子模型维护技术，称为子模型维护与处理策略（MAPS），旨在增强分布估计算法在多模态优化问题上的求解能力。与现有基于多子模型的分布估计算法相比，MAPS的核心优势在于能够显式检测有前景的搜索区域，从而节省大量用于探索的函数评估次数，加快优化速度。MAPS可与任何采用单高斯模型的分布估计算法相结合。通过将MAPS集成到三种不同类型的分布估计算法中开展实证研究，实验结果表明，在12个基准测试问题上，MAPS能够显著提升收敛速度，并获得比对比算法更稳定的解。
title: Improving Estimation of Distribution Algorithm on Multimodal Problems by Detecting Promising Areas

summary_zh: 本文研究了在通用网格上，针对具有通用状态方程的多维狭义相对论磁流体力学（SRMHD）问题的物理约束保持（PCP）方案。该研究是对此前针对理想状态方程及均匀笛卡尔网格研究工作的扩展。由于通用状态方程缺乏特定解析表达式，在讨论流体速度、密度和压力等物理约束下的容许状态集数学性质时面临额外挑战。本文针对在非自交多面体通用网格上、采用Lax–Friedrichs（LxF）型通量的有限体积法或间断伽辽金法，对其PCP性质进行了严谨分析。研究基于更具普适性的广义LxF分裂性质，并采用了不同的凸分解技术。理论证明表明，PCP性质与离散散度自由条件密切相关；本文在通用网格上提出了该条件，且其约束强度较此前研究更为宽松。该成果为复杂几何网格下的相对论磁流体力学数值模拟提供了理论支撑。
title: On physical-constraints-preserving schemes for special relativistic magnetohydrodynamics with a general equation of state
venue: Zeitschrift für angewandte Mathematik und Physik

summary_zh: 多项式余数码是一类基于多项式环上中国剩余定理构造的线性码，Reed-Solomon码为其特例。其中，不可约多项式余数码采用两两互质的不可约多项式作为模。本文针对有限域F₂ₘ上的不可约多项式余数码，提出一种利用加法快速傅里叶变换的高效编译码方法。该方法的计算复杂度为O(N log²(N − K))，其中N和K分别表示码长和维数，且需满足N − K < 2ᵐ⁻¹且N − K为2的幂次。这一复杂度显著优于该类编码目前已知最优算法的O(N²)水平。此外，我们在特定参数下进行了非渐近复杂度对比，数值结果表明所提算法有效降低了计算开销。例如，在码长N=256、维数K=224的条件下，与多项式余数码的现有最佳方法相比，本文编码的乘法复杂度降低约83%，译码复杂度降低约50%。
title: Efficient Encoding/Decoding Algorithms for Irreducible Polynomial Remainder Codes via Additive FFT

abstract: Significance Despite decades of biophysical and structural research, little is understood about how voltage-gated ion channels (VGICs) activate during membrane depolarization, and less is known about how VGICs can be modulated by lipids and other ligands. We identify multiple functional states of the voltage- and Ca 2+ -gated ion channel TPC1 from Arabidopsis thaliana (AtTPC1), which confers electrical excitability to the plant vacuole. Here, we show how a voltage-sensing domain (VSD) functions during electrical activation and the mechanism of inhibition by vacuolar Ca 2+ . We show that the VSD undergoes large-scale, domain-wide structural changes during activation that involves Ca 2+ -dependent in-membrane plane rotation, subsequent charge transfer, and a Ca 2+ -dependent gate in the pore mouth that is allosterically coupled to the VSD.
summary_zh: 尽管经过数十年的生物物理与结构研究，人们对电压门控离子通道在膜去极化过程中的激活机制仍知之甚少，脂质及其他配体如何调控这些通道也尚不明确。本研究鉴定了拟南芥双孔通道蛋白 AtTPC1 的多种功能状态，该通道赋予植物液泡电兴奋性。我们揭示了电压敏感结构域在电激活过程中的工作机制以及液泡钙离子对其抑制的机理。研究表明，电压敏感结构域在激活时经历大规模、全结构域的结构重排，包括钙离子依赖的膜平面内旋转、随后的电荷转移，以及位于孔道口的钙离子依赖门控，该门控与电压敏感结构域之间存在别构耦合。
title: Molecular basis of multistep voltage activation in plant two-pore channel 1
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

summary_zh: 本文首次提出并实现了一种基于飞秒激光逐点写入技术制备耐高温超弱光纤布拉格光栅阵列的新方法。传统紫外光刻写的超弱光栅无法承受450 °C以上高温，而本研究采用飞秒激光透过光纤涂覆层直接在常规单模光纤中逐点刻写，成功制备出峰值反射率低至约-45 dB（对应约0.0032%）的超弱光栅。系统研究了光栅长度、激光脉冲能量和光栅阶数对光栅性能的影响，最终选用1 mm光栅长度、29.2 nJ脉冲能量和120阶光栅参数进行制备。长期高温退火实验表明，该超弱光栅可耐受高达1000 °C的高温，且在1000 °C下具有优异的热重复性，温度灵敏度为18.2 pm/°C。在此基础上，沿2米长常规单模光纤以10 mm间隔成功制备了包含200个一致超弱光栅的阵列，并利用光频域反射计进行解调，实现了最高1000 °C的分布式高温传感。所提出的飞秒激光刻写超弱光栅阵列在航空航天器、核电站和冶炼炉等严苛环境下的分布式高温监测中具有广阔的应用前景。
title: Femtosecond laser point-by-point inscription of an ultra-weak fiber Bragg grating array for distributed high-temperature sensing

summary_zh: 针对锂金属电池中锂枝晶生长导致的库仑效率低及安全性差等瓶颈问题，本文开发了一种基于二氧化硅（SiO2）空心纳米球的新型复合固态电解质（SiSE）。该电解质通过在含有液态电解质的SiO2空心纳米球层中原位聚合丙二醇二丙烯酸酯（TPGDA）单体构建而成。这种分级结构电解质具有准固态特性，有效避免了电解液泄漏带来的安全风险；同时，得益于SiO2空心纳米球的高孔隙率和强大的电解液吸附能力，该电解质在室温下展现出优异的离子电导率（1.74 × 10⁻³ S cm⁻¹），且SiO2层兼具机械强度高的隔膜功能。实验结果表明，将该SiSE原位构建于正极并应用于LiFePO4/SiSE/Li电池中，由于其能够提供稳定的电极/电解质界面并显著抑制锂枝晶生长，电池的循环稳定性得到了大幅提升。该研究为空心纳米氧化物的应用拓展提供了新思路，为下一代高安全性、高效率的储能系统提供了技术支撑。
title: SiO 2 hollow nanosphere-based composite solid electrolyte for lithium metal batteries to suppress lithium dendrite growth and enhance cycle life

summary_zh: 本文基于介电弹性体致动器构建仿生人工下颌，针对其强非线性与率相关粘弹性所导致的蠕变与迟滞控制难题，提出一种基于非平衡态热力学的非线性动力学模型。该模型综合描述了粘弹性效应，并引入下颌与膜片的阻尼和惯性影响，建立了膜片变形与外加电压之间的定量关系。实验验证表明，模型预测与实测结果一致。在此基础上，设计了基于粘弹性非线性动力学模型的前馈控制器，能够精确跟踪正弦、三角波及阶梯轨迹。通过再现马丁·路德·金“我有一个梦想”演讲中的下颌运动视频，验证了控制器的有效性。本研究是粘弹性介电弹性体驱动软体机器人控制领域的早期探索之一。
title: Dynamic Modeling and Feedforward Control of Jaw Movements Driven by Viscoelastic Artificial Muscles

abstract: Abstract The continuous supersymmetry transformation is applied to the silicon waveguides, and the guidance and conversion of any mode in a wide spectral range are successfully realized in experiments. This proves its great potential in optical spatial mode modulation and space division multiplexing in optical communication.
summary_zh: 本文提出将连续超对称变换应用于硅波导，在实验中成功实现了宽光谱范围内任意模式的导引与转换。该方法利用超对称变换设计波导折射率分布，使得不同模式在传播过程中保持稳定导引，并能高效完成模式间的转换。实验结果表明，该方案在宽波段内对多种空间模式具有良好的操控能力，验证了其在光学空间模式调控中的有效性。该技术有望应用于光通信中的空分复用系统，为提升信道容量和光谱效率提供新的物理实现途径。
title: Guiding flow of light with supersymmetry

summary_zh: 鉴于皮肤及皮下疾病在全球非致命疾病负担中占据重要地位，皮肤科诊断的智能化发展具有重要意义。本文提出了一种基于多模态大语言模型的交互式皮肤科诊断系统SkinGPT-4。该研究通过收集包含52,929张公开及私有皮肤疾病图像、临床概念及医生笔记的大规模数据集，设计了一种两阶段训练策略，实现了预训练视觉Transformer与Llama-2-13b-chat大语言模型的对齐。通过对150例真实临床病例与皮肤科专科医生的对比定量评估，验证了系统的有效性。SkinGPT-4支持用户上传皮肤照片进行自主诊断，能够自动评估图像、识别皮肤病变的特征与类别，并进行深入分析，最终提供交互式的治疗建议，在皮肤病辅助诊断领域展现出巨大的应用潜力。
title: Pre-trained Multimodal Large Language Model Enhances Dermatological Diagnosis using SkinGPT-4

abstract: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD+) is a redox cofactor and signal central to cell metabolisms. Disrupting NAD homeostasis in plant alters growth and stress resistance, yet the underlying mechanisms remain largely unknown. Here, by combining genetics with multi-omics, we discover that NAD+ deficiency in qs-2 caused by mutation in NAD+ biosynthesis gene-Quinolinate Synthase retards growth but induces biosynthesis of defense compounds, notably aliphatic glucosinolates that confer insect resistance. The elevated defense in qs-2 is resulted from activated jasmonate biosynthesis, critically hydroperoxidation of α-linolenic acid by the 13-lipoxygenase (namely LOX2), which is escalated via the burst of chloroplastic ROS-singlet oxygen (1O2). The NAD+ deficiency-mediated JA induction and defense priming sequence in plants is recapitulated upon insect infestation, suggesting such defense mechanism operates in plant stress response. Hence, NAD homeostasis is a pivotal metabolic checkpoint that may be manipulated to navigate plant growth and defense metabolism for stress acclimation. NAD+ deficiency in plants retards growth but enhances insect resistance via coopted 1O2-jasmonate biosynthesis activation and defense priming. Thus, NAD homeostasis is a pivotal metabolic checkpoint for navigating plant growth and defense metabolism.
title: NAD+ deficiency primes defense metabolism via 1O2-escalated jasmonate biosynthesis in plants

summary_zh: 本研究对传统内凝胶法进行了系统性改进，成功制备出表面光滑、机械稳定性强且细胞存活率高的核壳结构水凝胶微胶囊，尺寸范围为200至600微米。通过设计同轴流聚焦毛细管组装微流控装置，实现了海藻酸盐的快速内凝胶化，从而获得结构明确、均一的海藻酸盐水凝胶微结构作为微胶囊外壳。在壳层流体中引入4-羟乙基哌嗪乙磺酸缓冲液，使得油相中可使用高浓度酸以增强海藻酸盐交联，同时维持高细胞活性。实验进一步证实，该凝胶条件温和，适用于HepG2肝细胞和3T3成纤维细胞的封装，在共培养环境中可保持其活力与功能。该技术为药物递送、细胞治疗及组织再生等领域提供了高性能微载体平台。
title: Mild formation of core–shell hydrogel microcapsules for cell encapsulation

summary_zh: 本文提出一种新型形状自适应吸盘机制，通过将软体多层结构挤压贴合于目标表面，形成与粗糙度匹配的密封吸着区域，从而在复杂表面上实现高度自适应的吸附功能。基于该机制，设计了两种形状自适应吸盘：位移驱动型与力驱动型。位移驱动型吸盘在90度转角、气球等极端形貌上表现出更优的适应能力；力驱动型吸盘则更轻便（仅26克）、结构紧凑（直径46毫米、高35毫米），且吸附响应更快（仅需0.4秒）。通过物理模型分析了自适应吸附机理，并与现有吸盘进行定性对比，验证了其在高度弯曲、棱角、纹理、不平整及倾斜表面上的优异吸附性能。最后总结了提升吸附适应性的设计原则。该形状自适应吸附机制为下一代机器人抓取、锚定与操作中实现复杂表面可靠吸附提供了新方案。
title: Shape-Conformable Suction Cups With Controllable Adaptive Suction on Complex Surfaces

abstract: Abstract As a result of global warming, plants are subjected to ever-increasing abiotic stresses including heat and drought. Drought stress frequently co-occurs with heat stress as a result of water evaporation. These stressors have adverse effects on crop production, which in turn affects human food security. Rice is a major food resource grown widely in crop-producing regions throughout the world. However, increasingly common heat and drought stresses in growth regions can have negative impacts on seedling morphogenesis, reproductive organ establishment, overall yield, and quality. This review centers on responses to heat and drought stress in rice. Current knowledge of molecular regulation mechanisms is summarized. We focus on approaches to cope with heat and drought stress, both at the genetic level and from an agricultural practice perspective. This review establishes a basis for improving rice stress tolerance, grain quality, and yield for human benefit.
summary_zh: 全球变暖导致植物遭受日益加剧的非生物胁迫，其中高温与干旱尤为突出，且因水分蒸发二者常相伴发生，严重威胁作物生产与粮食安全。水稻作为全球广泛种植的主要粮食作物，其幼苗形态建成、生殖器官发育、产量及品质均易受高温干旱胁迫的负面影响。本文围绕水稻对高温与干旱胁迫的响应展开综述，系统总结了当前已知的分子调控机制，重点从遗传改良与农艺措施两个层面探讨了应对策略，旨在为提升水稻抗逆性、籽粒品质及产量、保障人类粮食需求奠定基础。
title: Enhancement of Heat and Drought Stress Tolerance in Rice by Genetic Manipulation: A Systematic Review

abstract: Excessive osteoclast activation disrupts bone homeostasis, contributing to osteoporosis (OP). While Runx2 is known to regulate osteoblast differentiation, its role in osteoclasts is less clear. Using conditional knockout models, we demonstrate that Runx2 directly drives osteoclast differentiation by regulating Ctsk transcription. However, its dual function in both osteoblasts and osteoclasts limits therapeutic potential. We identify Ip6k2 as a Runx2-interacting protein that enhances Runx2-dependent Ctsk transcription specifically in osteoclasts. Genetic deletion of Ip6k2 phenocopies Runx2 loss in osteoclasts, suppressing osteoclastogenesis and increasing bone mass without affecting osteoblast function. Notably, dual deletion of Runx2 and Ip6k2 yields no additive effects, indicating a shared regulatory pathway. Importantly, both genetic and pharmacological inhibition of Ip6k2 protect against estrogen deficiency- and age-induced bone loss. Collectively, our findings position Ip6k2 as a promising osteoclast-specific target and highlight that disruption of the Ip6k2-Runx2 complex may offer an effective strategy for OP treatment.
title: Targeting the Ip6k2–Runx2 axis disrupts osteoblast–osteoclast coupling to treat osteoporosis

summary_zh: 本文研究了在存在空间分布的被动窃听者环境下，多发射端LED与单个合法用户设备组成的可见光通信（VLC）系统的安全性增强机制。针对仅能获取窃听者位置统计信息而非精确位置的约束条件，本文提出了一种基于幅度约束的波束赋形方案，通过将信号沿特定特征模态进行传输，以平衡窃听过程强度与目标信道特性，从而提升通信安全性。此外，为降低系统安全性中断概率（SOP），本文还提出了一种复杂度较低的LED选择方案。通过利用安全速率边界推导出了SOP的近似闭式解，并利用蒙特卡洛模拟对理论分析进行了数值验证。研究结果表明，波束赋形方案在性能上优于LED选择方案，但考虑到多发射端波束赋形的计算复杂度，LED选择方案仍是一种高效的替代手段。本文的研究结论及系统参数间的精确关系，可为应对随机分布窃听者的安全可见光通信系统开发提供理论支撑。
title: Securing Visible Light Communication Systems by Beamforming in the Presence of Randomly Distributed Eavesdroppers

abstract: The limited capabilities of user equipment restrict the local implementation of computation-intensive applications. Edge computing, especially the edge intelligence system, enables local users to offload the computation tasks to the edge servers to reduce the computational energy consumption of user equipment and accelerate fast task execution. However, the limited bandwidth of upstream channels may increase the task transmission latency and affect the computation offloading performance. To overcome the challenge arising from scarce wireless communication resources, we propose a semantic-aware multi-modal task offloading system that facilitates the extraction and offloading of semantic task information to edge servers. To cope with the different tasks with multi-modal data, a unified quality of experience (QoE) criterion is designed. Furthermore, a proximal policy optimization-based multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm (MAPPO) is proposed to coordinate the resource management for wireless communications and computation in a distributed and low computational complexity manner. Simulation results verify that the proposed MAPPO algorithm outperforms other reinforcement learning algorithms and fixed schemes in terms of task execution speed and the overall system QoE.
title: Resource Optimization for Semantic-Aware Networks With Task Offloading

abstract: The main objective of this paper is to focus on the study of limit cycle characteristics due to backlash nonlinearity in drive system. For a two-mass system, the existence of gear reduction mechanism or ball screw will introduce transmission backlash inevitably, which can aggravate mechanical resonance. Therefore, it is essential to study the limit cycle characteristics, so as to provide a good theoretical basis for limit cycle suppression. Firstly, based on describing function analysis, the system is separated into linear part and nonlinear part in order to facilitate the analysis. Then the stability and oscillation frequency of limit cycle are predicted. Through the study, it is found that the increasing of backlash amplitude does not affect the limit cycle frequency, yet it will aggravate the oscillation amplitude. Moreover, the limit cycle frequency and amplitude will increase with the increasing of system control stiffness. Finally, the theoretical analyses are confirmed by the experimental results.
summary_zh: 本文针对传动系统中间隙非线性引发的极限环特性展开研究。在双质量系统中，减速机构或滚珠丝杠不可避免地引入传动间隙，从而加剧机械谐振，因此深入分析极限环特性对抑制振荡具有重要理论意义。研究采用描述函数法，将系统划分为线性与非线性两部分，以便于分析极限环的稳定性与振荡频率。结果表明，间隙幅值的增大不会改变极限环频率，但会显著加剧振荡幅度；而系统控制刚度的提升则同时导致极限环频率与幅值的增大。上述理论分析均通过实验验证，为传动系统极限环抑制提供了可靠依据。
title: Analysis of limit cycle mechanism for two-mass system with backlash nonlinearity
venue: IECON 2016 - 42nd Annual Conference of the IEEE Industrial Electronics Society

summary_zh: 本文针对瓶颈最小化着色旅行商问题，提出一种高效的双轨迹混合搜索方法。该问题在部分重叠工作空间的规划任务中具有重要应用价值，例如面向及时配送的运输资源调度。所提方法融合了三项核心策略：基于路径的交叉算子用于生成高质量子代解，多邻域模拟退火机制执行局部优化，以及停滞检测与跳出机制帮助搜索逃离局部最优。在解的编码方面，设计了双向邻接表示法，在传统邻接表示基础上额外引入一个数组记录反向路径，从而扩展了表示能力。在两组共58个广泛使用的基准实例上进行充分评估，结果表明该方法显著优于现有最优算法。对关键算法模块的深入分析验证了所提思想和策略的新颖性与有效性。此外，通过将该方法应用于以平衡销售人员工作量为目标的着色旅行商问题，进一步验证了其泛化能力。本研究面向实际应用，可为及时配送场景下的运输资源调度提供高质量路径规划方案，帮助决策者设计最优配送路线。
title: Bi-Trajectory Hybrid Search to Solve Bottleneck-Minimized Colored Traveling Salesman Problems
venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering

summary_zh: 本文首次提出两种无需训练与学习的无参考图像质量评价方法。方法基于失真图像相邻除归一化变换系数的联合直方图，提取条件直方图形状一致性作为感知特征，并与LIVE数据库中参考图像和退化图像的特征属性进行对比。第一种方法在自然参考图像的特征属性空间中寻找聚类中心，以失真图像特征属性到该中心的距离作为质量评分；第二种方法利用数据库中所有图像的特征属性与主观评分构建字典，通过插值字典中邻近词条的主观分数计算最终质量得分。与传统基于支持向量机的方法不同，所提指标具有显式表达式，能够清晰反映感知特征与图像质量之间的关系。在LIVE、CSIQ和TID2008等公开数据库上的实验结果表明，该方法性能良好，具有较高的实用价值。
title: No training blind image quality assessment

abstract: We give a formula for the Lipschitz constant in Thompson's part metric of any order-preserving flow on the interior of a (possibly infinite dimensional) closed convex pointed cone. This provides an explicit form of a characterization of Nussbaum concerning non order-preserving flows. As an application of this formula, we show that the flow of the generalized Riccati equation arising in stochastic linear quadratic control is a local contraction on the cone of positive definite matrices and characterize its Lipschitz constant by a matrix inequality. We also show that the same flow is no longer a contraction in other natural Finsler metrics on this cone, including the standard invariant Riemannian metric. This is motivated by a series of contraction properties concerning the standard Riccati equation, established by Bougerol, Liverani, Wojtowski, Lawson, Lee and Lim: we show that some of these properties do, and that some other do not, carry over to the generalized Riccati equation.
summary_zh: 本文给出了在（可能无限维）闭凸尖锥内部上任意保序流的 Thompson 部分度量 Lipschitz 常数的显式公式，从而为 Nussbaum 关于非保序流的刻画提供了具体形式。作为该公式的应用，我们证明了随机线性二次控制中广义 Riccati 方程生成的流在正定矩阵锥上是局部压缩的，并通过矩阵不等式刻画了其 Lipschitz 常数。同时，我们还证明该流在该锥上的其他自然 Finsler 度量（包括标准不变黎曼度量）下不再是压缩的。这一研究受到 Bougerol、Liverani、Wojtowski、Lawson、Lee 和 Lim 关于标准 Riccati 方程一系列压缩性质的启发：我们揭示了其中哪些性质可推广至广义 Riccati 方程，哪些则不能。
title: The contraction rate in Thompson metric of order-preserving flows on a cone-applications to generalized Riccati equations

summary_zh: 本文针对单光子雪崩二极管阵列在飞行时间深度成像与瞬态成像中面临的分辨率低和填充因子不足问题，提出通过光学结构设计实现超分辨成像的方法。研究重点探索了SPAD阵列的光学编码方案，包括利用微结构组装提升阵列填充因子，以及采用衍射光学元件对入射光进行直接调制。部分设计成果已应用于近期研究，并在深度成像和瞬态成像中展示了多种应用场景。该方法在不显著增加硬件成本的前提下，有效缓解了低填充因子导致的逆问题病态性，为高时间分辨率、低成本SPAD阵列的超分辨成像提供了可行途径。
title: Optical coding of SPAD array and its application in compressive depth and transient imaging
venue: Optoelectronic Imaging and Multimedia Technology VI

abstract: Face hallucination is a domain-specific super-resolution problem that aims to generate a high-resolution (HR) face image from a low-resolution (LR) input. In contrast to the existing patch-wise super-resolution models that divide a face image into regular patches and independently apply LR to HR mapping to each patch, we implement deep reinforcement learning and develop a novel attention-aware face hallucination (Attention-FH) framework, which recurrently learns to attend a sequence of patches and performs facial part enhancement by fully exploiting the global interdependency of the image. Specifically, our proposed framework incorporates two components: a recurrent policy network for dynamically specifying a new attended region at each time step based on the status of the super-resolved image and the past attended region sequence, and a local enhancement network for selected patch hallucination and global state updating. The Attention-FH model jointly learns the recurrent policy network and local enhancement network through maximizing a long-term reward that reflects the hallucination result with respect to the whole HR image. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our Attention-FH significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on in-the-wild face images with large pose and illumination variations.
title: Face Hallucination by Attentive Sequence Optimization with Reinforcement Learning
venue: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence

summary_zh: 本文在标准 AGV 机制的基础上进行推广，旨在平衡所有智能体获得的净收益，同时保留原机制的贝叶斯激励相容性、事后效率与事后预算平衡。在智能体类型与委托人成本相互独立的私人价值设定下，我们将机制设计问题形式化为一个凸优化问题，通过最大化事后最小净收益的期望值，在参数化广义 AGV 机制集合中寻找能够实现事后最大最小公平性的机制。进一步，我们将该凸规划重新表述为线性规划，在智能体数量较少时可高效求解；当智能体数量较多时，则提出采用增量次梯度方法进行求解。针对两个行动模型的数值实验表明，所提出的机制在期望事后最小收益方面显著优于标准 AGV 机制。
title: Ex-Post Max-Min Fairness of Generalized AGV Mechanisms

summary_zh: 本研究探讨了在微波等离子体化学气相沉积（MPCVD）工艺条件下，等离子体边缘沉积前驱体的形成对薄膜质量的影响机制。研究结果表明，在保持衬底温度高于500 °C的前提下，等离子体边缘形成的沉积前驱体颗粒尺寸极小，不足以对外延薄膜的晶体结构或整体薄膜质量产生负面干扰。这一发现为优化MPCVD工艺参数提供了重要依据，特别是在控制衬底温度以确保高质量薄膜生长方面具有实际指导意义。该研究成果对于提升微波等离子体化学气相沉积过程中外延薄膜的生长稳定性及结构完整性具有潜在的应用价值。
title: High-rate and wide-area deposition of epitaxial Si films by mesoplasma chemical vapor deposition
venue: Science and Technology of Advanced Materials

abstract: Myocardial infarction rapidly depletes the endogenous cardiac progenitor cell pool, and the inefficient recruitment of exogenously administered progenitor cells limits the effectiveness of cardiac cell therapy. Recent reports indicate that interactions between the CXC chemokine stromal cell-derived factor 1 and its receptor CXC chemokine receptor 4 (CXCR4) critically mediate the ischemia-induced recruitment of bone marrow-derived circulating stem/progenitor cells, but the expression of CXCR4 in cardiac progenitor cells is very low. Here, we studied the influence of hypoxia on CXCR4 expression in cardiac progenitor cells, on the recruitment of intravenously administered cells to ischemic heart tissue, and on the preservation of heart function in a murine myocardial infarction model. We found that hypoxic preconditioning increased CXCR4 expression in CLK (cardiosphere-derived, Lin(-)c-kit(+) progenitor) cells and markedly augmented CLK cell migration (in vitro) and recruitment (in vivo) to the ischemic myocardium. Four weeks after surgically induced myocardial infarction, infarct size and heart function were significantly better in mice administered hypoxia-preconditioned CLK cells than in mice treated with cells cultured under normoxic conditions. Furthermore, these effects were largely abolished by the addition of a CXCR4 inhibitor, indicating that the benefits of hypoxic preconditioning are mediated by the stromal cell-derived factor 1/CXCR4 axis, and that therapies targeting this axis may enhance cardiac-progenitor cell-based regenerative therapy.
title: Hypoxic Preconditioning Enhances the Benefit of Cardiac Progenitor Cell Therapy for Treatment of Myocardial Infarction by Inducing CXCR4 Expression

abstract: In this article, a digitally controlled voltage-mode buck converter with embedded transient improvement using delay line-based control techniques is presented. Two voltage-controlled delay lines (VCDL's) are used to convert the difference between the feedback and reference voltages to a delay time difference. The delay difference is then fed to the multiple-outputs bang-bang phase detector (MOBBPD), which converts the input delay difference to multiple-bits digital codes in a simple nonlinear way. The MOBBPD scheme leads to high resolution for small output ripple and improved response when large load transient happens in a low-cost way. A digital loop filter (DLF) accumulates the MOBBPD output codes to control the duty cycle through a novel digital pulse width modulator (DPWM) to regulate the output voltage. By designing the coefficients of the DLF, a type-II compensator can be achieved through the integral and proportional paths to make the loop stable. The proposed DPWM, which consists of a divide-by-8 frequency divider, two delay lines and a few simple digital logics, achieves a wide tunable range of duty cycle under various process corners and supply voltages. A proof-of-concept design of the proposed buck converter was fabricated in a standard 0.18μm CMOS technology. The measured results show that it achieves a very wide output voltage range from 0.1 V to 3.5 V for a input supply range from 2.4 V to 3.6 V. With a 400 mA step in the load current, the overshoot/undershoot is less than 87 mV and the 1% settling time is less than 16μs. The peak efficiency is 95.2% with 250 mA load current at 2.4 V output voltage with 3.3 V input voltage.
title: A 4-MHz Digitally Controlled Voltage-Mode Buck Converter With Embedded Transient Improvement Using Delay Line Control Techniques
venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems I Regular Papers

summary_zh: 缺氧会激活细胞内保守的分解代谢过程——自噬，而自噬通路的功能障碍与癌症等多种人类疾病密切相关。本研究发现，缺氧诱导产生的特定微RNA（miRNA）在调节自噬中发挥关键作用，重点阐明了MIR155作为缺氧诱导的自噬强效诱导剂的新功能。实验表明，在人鼻咽癌和宫颈癌细胞中，过表达MIR155可显著增强自噬活性，而敲低内源性MIR155则能抑制缺氧诱导的自噬过程。机制研究显示，MIR155通过直接结合RHEB、RICTOR及RPS6KB2等多个MTOR信号通路关键组分的3'非翻译区（UTR），抑制其基因表达，进而下调MTOR信号通路。此外，MIR155通过抑制该通路还能减缓细胞增殖并诱导G1/S期细胞周期阻滞。综上所述，本研究揭示了MIR155通过调控MTOR通路进而驱动自噬的新机制，为理解缺氧环境下肿瘤细胞的代谢调控提供了重要依据。
title: Hypoxia-induced MIR155 is a potent autophagy inducer by targeting multiple players in the MTOR pathway

summary_zh: 本文开发了一种结合材料挤出式3D打印与环氧树脂浸渍处理的新型制造技术，用于制备具有弯曲连续碳纤维增强的复合材料。研究首先利用连续碳纤维增强聚酰胺6（PA-6）热塑性长丝进行材料挤出3D打印，构建复合材料预制件；随后通过真空袋压和烘箱固化工艺，将粉末状热固性环氧树脂引入预制件中，以填充打印路径间的间隙、消除气孔并增强界面结合力。单轴拉伸测试结果表明，与纯热塑性复合材料相比，经环氧树脂浸渍处理后的复合材料刚度和强度分别提升了29.3%和22.1%。此外，该技术还被应用于制造具有弯曲纤维排列的复合材料，并研究了3D打印缺口试样的性能。研究发现，若将连续碳纤维沿主应力轨迹进行布置，其失效强度和断裂韧性较单向排列和同心排列方式分别显著提高了81%和157%。该方法在保持定制化纤维排列的同时，有效解决了3D打印复合材料孔隙率高和层间结合不足的问题，为制造复杂几何形状的高性能各向异性复合材料结构提供了新途径。
title: 3D printing and epoxy-infusion treatment of curved continuous carbon fibre reinforced dual-polymer composites

abstract: Let $\{X_i;\, i\geq 1\},\,\{Y_i;\,i\geq 1\},\,\{U, U_i;\, i\geq 1\}$ and $\{V, V_i;\, i\geq 1\}$ be four i.i.d. sequences of random variables. Suppose U and V are uniformly distributed on $[0,1]^3.$ For each realization of $\{U_j;\, 1\leq j\leq n\},\ \{X_{i,p};\break \, 1\leq p \leq n\}$ is constructed as a certain permutation of $\{X_p;\, 1\leq p\leq n\}$ for any $1\leq i \leq n.$ Also, $\{Y_{j,p};\, 1\leq p \leq n\}, 1\leq j\leq n,$ are constructed the same way, based on $\{Y_j\}$ and $\{V_j\}.$ For a score function F, we show that \begin{eqnarray*} W_n:= \max_{1\leq i, j,m \leq n}\sum_{p=1}^m F(X_{i,p},Y_{j, p}) \end{eqnarray*} has an asymptotic extreme distribution with the same parameters as in the one-dimensional case. This model is constructed for a comparison of scores of protein structures with foldings.
summary_zh: 本文研究了一种用于比较蛋白质结构折叠评分的随机模型。设定四组独立同分布的随机变量序列，其中U和V在三维单位立方体上均匀分布。对于每个U_j的实现，通过特定置换方式构造序列X_{i,p}，类似地基于Y_j和V_j构造Y_{j,p}。针对评分函数F，我们证明了统计量W_n（即对所有可能的i、j、m，求前m项F(X_{i,p},Y_{j,p})之和的最大值）的渐近极值分布与一维情形具有相同的参数。该模型为蛋白质结构折叠相似性评分提供了理论分析框架。
title: A comparison of scores of two protein structures with foldings

abstract: The theoretical calculation of protein-protein binding free energy is a grand challenge in computational biology. Accurate prediction of critical residues along with their specific and quantitative contributions to protein-protein binding free energy is extremely helpful to reveal binding mechanisms and identify drug-like molecules that alter protein-protein interactions. In this paper, we propose an interaction entropy approach combined with the molecular mechanics/generalized Born surface area (MM/GBSA) method for solvation to compute residue-specific protein-protein binding free energy. In the current approach, the entropic loss in binding free energy of individual residues is explicitly computed from moledular dynamics (MD) simulation by using the interaction entropy method. In this approach the entropic contribution to binding free energy is determined from fluctuation of the interaction in MD simulation. Studies for an extensive set of realistic protein-protein interaction systems showed that by including the entropic contribution, the computed residue-specific binding free energies are in better agreement with the corresponding experimental data.
summary_zh: 本研究提出一种将相互作用熵方法与分子力学/广义玻恩表面积溶剂化模型相结合的计算策略，用于精确计算蛋白质-蛋白质结合自由能中单个残基的定量贡献。蛋白质-蛋白质结合自由能的理论计算是计算生物学领域的重大挑战，准确预测关键残基及其对结合自由能的具体贡献对于揭示结合机制和识别能够调控蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的药物分子至关重要。在该方法中，单个残基在结合过程中的熵损失通过相互作用熵方法从分子动力学模拟中显式计算获得，其核心在于利用模拟过程中相互作用的涨落来确定熵对结合自由能的贡献。通过对一系列真实蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用体系的系统研究，结果表明纳入熵贡献后，计算得到的残基特异性结合自由能与实验数据的一致性显著提高。该方法为深入理解蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的分子机制和指导靶向蛋白界面的药物设计提供了可靠的理论工具。
title: Interaction Entropy for Computational Alanine Scanning
venue: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling

summary_zh: 针对量子点转换发光二极管中高浓度量子点易发生荧光猝灭、限制光转换效率的难题，本文设计了一种由零维二氧化硅纳米球与二维氮化硼纳米片组装而成的光学散射体，并系统研究了其提升器件光转换效率的机制。实验与时域有限差分分析表明，该零维–二维杂化结构融合了零维二氧化硅球的前向散射与二维氮化硼片对蓝光的后向散射特性。通过优化二氧化硅与氮化硼的配比，杂化散射体能够平衡后向与前向散射光，从而在低量子点浓度下最大化激发光吸收与光提取效率。实验结果显示，与无散射体、仅含零维二氧化硅或仅含二维氮化硼散射体的器件相比，采用二氧化硅–氮化硼杂化散射体的量子点转换发光二极管的光转换效率分别提高了99%、13%和27%。此外，在相同光输出条件下，该杂化散射体可节省高达75%的量子点用量，展现出显著的经济价值。该研究为高效、低成本的量子点光转换器件提供了新的散射体设计思路。
title: Efficiency Enhancement of Quantum-Dot-Converted LEDs by 0D–2D Hybrid Scatterers

abstract: To improve the operation efficiency of multi-shuttle Automated Storage and Retrieval System(AS/RS)in term of job scheduling,a mathematical model for job scheduling optimization was established according to the operational characteristic of multi-shuttle AS/RS.The job scheduling problem was proved to be NP-hard after complexity analysis,and a genetic simulated annealing algorithm was developed to solve this NP-hard problem.The performance of proposed algorithm was demonstrated by numerical examples,and the results showed that the algorithm had better solution precision and efficiency.The travel time of performing storage and retrieval operations was reduced effectively by this algorithm.
summary_zh: 针对多梭车自动化存取系统（AS/RS）的任务调度效率问题，本文结合多梭车系统的运行特性，构建了任务调度优化的数学模型。通过复杂度分析证明了该调度问题属于NP-hard问题，进而提出了一种结合遗传算法与模拟退火算法的混合启发式算法进行求解。数值仿真结果表明，该算法在求解精度与计算效率方面均表现优异，能够有效缩短存取作业过程中的梭车行驶时间，为提升多梭车AS/RS系统的整体运行效率提供了有效的决策支持。
title: Job scheduling optimization in multi-shuttle automated storage and retrieval system

abstract: A new control pipeline has been proposed for the Rope-Base Soft-tip Manipulator (RBSM) to execute the surface contact task to prevent the jamming and slipping problems. The control pipeline enables smooth surface-to-surface contact for the RBSM using only force sensors, eliminating the dependence on additional pose measurement of the window surface plane and soft-tip deformation information. The pipeline consists of three steps: free contact step implemented by an exponential force shape controller to avoid force overshoot to the window surface; orientation refinement step implemented by a force and torque combined controller to make the RBSM cleaning head surface stable adapt to the smooth window surface; and finally, a release normal force step to reduce head jamming and region covering with a pre-defined vibration-less cleaning trajectory for smooth cleaning on the slippery window surface. The proposed pipeline has been validated in a Rope base Cleaning Manipulator prototype to clean a common window surface. The force and velocity curves during the cleaning experiment show that the proposed method achieves smooth scraping and cleaning under unknown initial significant errors in surface orientation.
title: Smooth Surface-to-Surface Contact Control for Rope-Base Soft-Tip Manipulator
venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering

abstract: To simulate the concept acquisition and binding of different senses in the brain, a biologically inspired neural network model named perception coordination network (PCN) is proposed. It is a hierarchical structure, which is functionally divided into the primary sensory area (PSA), the primary sensory association area (SAA), and the higher order association area (HAA). The PSA contains feature neurons which respond to many elementary features, e.g., colors, shapes, syllables, and basic flavors. The SAA contains primary concept neurons which combine the elementary features in the PSA to represent unimodal concept of objects, e.g., the image of an apple, the Chinese word "[píng guǒ]" which names the apple, and the taste of the apple. The HAA contains associated neurons which connect the primary concept neurons of several PSA, e.g., connects the image, the taste, and the name of an apple. It means that the associated neurons have a multimodal response mode. Therefore, this area executes multisensory integration. PCN is an online incremental learning system, it is able to continuously acquire and bind multimodality concepts in an online way. The experimental results suggest that PCN is able to handle the multimodal concept acquisition and binding effectively.
title: Perception Coordination Network: A Neuro Framework for Multimodal Concept Acquisition and Binding
venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems

abstract: A compact and high-precision three-degrees-of-freedom (DOF; X, Y, and Z directions) grating encoder based on the quadrangular frustum pyramid (QFP) prisms is proposed in this paper to solve the insufficient installation space problem of the reading head of the multi-DOF in high-precision displacement measurement applications. The encoder is based on the grating diffraction and interference principle, and a three-DOF measurement platform is built through the self-collimation function of the miniaturized QFP prism. The overall size of the reading head is 12.3 × 7.7 × 3 cm3 and has the potential for further miniaturization. The test results show that three-DOF measurements can be realized simultaneously in the range of X-250, Y-200, and Z-100 μm due to the limitations of the measurement grating size. The measurement accuracy of the main displacement is below 500 nm on average; the minimum and maximum errors are 0.0708% and 2.8422%, respectively. This design will help further popularize the research and applications of multi-DOF grating encoders in high-precision measurements.
summary_zh: 针对高精度位移测量中多自由度读取头安装空间受限的问题，本文提出了一种基于四棱台（QFP）棱镜的紧凑型高精度三自由度（X、Y、Z方向）光栅编码器。该编码器利用光栅衍射与干涉原理，通过微型化四棱台棱镜的自准直功能，构建了三自由度测量平台。读取头整体尺寸仅为12.3 × 7.7 × 3 cm³，具备进一步小型化的潜力。实验结果表明，受限于测量光栅的尺寸，该系统可在X轴250 μm、Y轴200 μm及Z轴100 μm的范围内实现同步三自由度测量。在测量精度方面，主要位移的平均误差低于500 nm，误差范围在0.0708%至2.8422%之间。该设计为多自由度光栅编码器在高精度测量领域的深入研究与广泛应用提供了新的解决方案。
title: A compact and high-precision three-degree-of-freedom grating encoder based on a quadrangular frustum pyramid prism

summary_zh: 氮化钛作为一种典型的生物相容性过渡金属氮化物，通过金纳米团簇修饰以提升载流子迁移率，并对其物理特性进行了系统表征。基于微纳光纤制备了氮化钛可饱和吸收体，实验研究了其非线性光学吸收特性。将该可饱和吸收体应用于通信波段超快光纤激光器，实现了稳定超短脉冲输出，脉冲宽度为1.66皮秒，基频重复频率为7.49兆赫兹，光谱带宽为2.61纳米。更重要的是，首次在基于微纳光纤氮化钛可饱和吸收体的光纤激光器中获得了混沌多脉冲，该脉冲展现出高平均脉冲能量、变化的脉冲间隔和脉冲强度等特性。研究结果表明，氮化钛在先进光强调制器、超快脉冲动力学及光纤通信等领域具有广阔应用前景。
title: Nanocluster‐Modified Titanium Nitride for Ultrafast Photonics Applications

summary_zh: 推理型大语言模型在数学、编程等复杂推理任务上展现出优于通用大语言模型的竞争力，但其服务性能与行为特征尚未得到充分研究，这制约了此类模型在实际场景中的部署与应用。本文对推理型大语言模型的服务进行了系统性研究。首先，通过对比推理型大语言模型与传统大语言模型的服务性能，揭示了二者在服务行为上的显著差异，具体表现为：内存占用大且波动剧烈、存在滞后请求、运行时间具有自适应性以及领域偏好明显。在此基础上，进一步考察了现有推理优化技术对推理型大语言模型的有效性。主要发现包括：模型量化方法与推测解码能够在轻微牺牲精度的前提下提升服务系统效率，而前缀缓存和键值缓存量化等技术在小规模推理型大语言模型上反而可能导致精度下降或服务性能劣化。最后，采用基于伽马分布建模的真实工作负载进行评估，以验证上述发现。跨数据集的真实负载评估实验结果与关于推理型大语言模型服务的主要结论一致。本研究旨在为学术界与工业界提供洞见，以推动推理型大语言模型推理服务的发展。
title: Reasoning Language Model Inference Serving Unveiled: An Empirical Study

summary_zh: 扩散模型在图像和视频等多个领域展现出卓越的生成能力，其成功在很大程度上依赖于训练数据的高数量与高质量。然而，当前主流扩散模型对数据的需求日益庞大，例如训练一个Stable Diffusion模型需要数十亿图像-文本对，这带来了高昂的数据获取与存储成本。为缓解这一数据负担，我们提出一种新场景：利用已有扩散模型作为数据源，训练任意架构的新扩散模型，并将该场景称为扩散模型的无数据知识蒸馏。在此场景下，扩散模型的生成能力以无数据的方式迁移至新模型。针对这一挑战，我们做出两项主要贡献。其一，提出一种无数据知识蒸馏目标，使得新扩散模型的训练无需访问原始数据即可通过蒸馏完成。其二，开发一种动态迭代蒸馏方法，能够高效地从已有扩散模型中提取时域知识，从而直接获取训练数据，无需经历耗时的生成过程。据我们所知，这是首次对该场景的探索。实验结果表明，所提出的无数据方法不仅取得了有竞争力的生成性能，在某些情况下甚至优于使用完整数据集训练的模型。
title: DKDM: Data-Free Knowledge Distillation for Diffusion Models with Any Architecture
venue: 2025 IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)

summary_zh: 本文提出一种利用入射波极化状态调控空间移相器色散斜率的新方法。基于超表面的空间移相器通过色散群延时响应，可对空间电磁波的时间频谱进行实时模拟信号处理，如傅里叶变换、脉冲啁啾、展宽与压缩，其功能与群延时色散斜率密切相关。现有空间移相器大多具有固定色散斜率，仅能实现单一功能，难以满足通信与感知领域对多功能系统的需求。针对这一问题，本文采用极化调控方案，相比传统可调电路方法更为简洁高效。为验证该方案，设计并实验展示了一款工作在9.4–10.6 GHz频段的一阶空间移相器，在x极化、y极化和±45°极化波入射条件下，分别产生负斜率、正斜率和零斜率群延时色散。这种可重构移相器在集成通信与感知系统中具有广阔应用前景。
title: Tailoring Group Delay Dispersion of Spatial Phaser using Anisotropic Metasurface and Polarized Incident Waves

summary_zh: 随着物联网的快速发展，对便捷式能源的需求日益增长，有机光伏电池因其在为小型物联网设备供电方面的潜力而备受关注。本文报道了一种高结晶性小分子受体材料FCC-Cl，其光学带隙为1.71 eV，适用于室内光环境应用。该材料的设计核心在于将弱给电子中心单元与适中吸电子端基相结合，从而获得所需的带隙和高结晶性。基于D18:FCC-Cl的有机光伏器件得益于FCC-Cl的高吸收系数和强结晶性，实现了高达85%的外部量子效率和80%的填充因子。在2600 K色温、500 lux照度的LED光源下，器件取得了28.8%的显著光电转换效率。此外，基于PM6:FCC-Cl的器件在较宽的活性层厚度范围内均能保持高效率，这一特性对于大规模卷对卷印刷工艺至关重要。
title: A highly crystalline non-fullerene acceptor enabling efficient indoor organic photovoltaics with high EQE and fill factor

summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向建筑能源系统的新型随机优化框架，用于光伏系统与供暖、制冷及储能技术的组合选型、容量配置与运行调度。该框架整合建筑能耗模拟、技术成本与性能分析以及能源系统优化，同时考虑未来技术与电价的不确定性。研究构建了一个双目标优化问题，旨在最小化不确定输入下的期望总成本与成本波动性。工具涵盖多种光伏技术（多晶硅、单晶硅及单轴跟踪单晶硅）、电热泵（空气源、地源及可逆式空气源）和储能系统（锂电池与热水储罐）。以塞浦路斯尼科西亚典型办公与居住建筑为对象，基于物理模型获取电、热、冷负荷需求。成本效益技术组合结果表明，用光伏、锂电池、可逆式空气源热泵和空气源热泵替代传统系统可显著降低成本和碳排放。将成本波动最小化纳入优化目标可带来更多样化的技术组合，增强能源独立性与鲁棒性，但会提高期望成本。采用均衡的双目标方法同时优化两个目标时，期望成本上升约2%–3%（因建筑类型而异），但最差情景成本降低5%，成本波动范围收窄最高达29%。结果证实，在建筑能源系统优化设计中纳入不确定性具有重要意义。
title: A stochastic optimisation framework for integrating photovoltaic systems, heat pumps, and energy storage in buildings

summary_zh: 本研究针对广东新丰江水库这一曾诱发6级以上地震的活跃区域，利用2012至2015年间固定与流动台站波形数据，对1528次地震进行重定位，并反演了地壳纵波和横波速度结构，同时分析了震级大于1.5级地震的震源机制。结果显示，库区下方地壳结构复杂，主要断裂带下方存在延伸至5至10公里深度的多个低速带，这是此前未被揭示的精细结构特征。震源机制解表明，倾滑型地震多于走滑型，且两类地震大致以水库边界为界；地震主压应力方向为北西—南东向，与区域构造主应力方向一致。综合上述结果及历史地震与水位变化分析，研究认为水体加载循环和渗透扩散在新丰江水库地震活动中起重要作用，它们增加了孔隙压力，促使地震向深部迁移，并改变了地震类型。该研究为深入理解水库诱发地震机理及该区域地震危险性评估提供了重要依据。
title: Upper Crustal Structure and Earthquake Mechanism in the Xinfengjiang Water Reservoir, Guangdong, China
venue: Journal of Geophysical Research: Solid Earth

abstract: Gas serves as one of the most indispensable energy sources for industrial production and household life. In order to improve the gas utilization efficiency, smart gas meters for the Internet of Things (IoT) has been designed to achieve two-way communication and remote control functions. However, the existing smart gas meter does not consider further reduction of power consumption. Thus, we designed an ultralow-power sensing framework for IoT and applied it to the smart gas meter. Based on a thorough analysis of the metering system, we propose an ultralow power system framework and a low-power peripheral management solution to reach ultralow power consumption. Also, we propose a cooperative sensing scheme to achieve stability and accuracy of gas volume detection. Finally, we implement a real smart gas manage system to evaluate our low-power smart gas meter solution. Verified by a comparative test, the proposed gas meter successfully reduces the power consumption by at least 37% compared to the baseline. The experimental results verify the innovative design and confirm that the proposed gas meter features ultralow power consumption, high precision, and high reliability.
title: Ultralow-Power Sensing Framework for Internet of Things: A Smart Gas Meter as a Case

summary_zh: 本研究通过实验探讨了受周期性脉冲驱动的湍流瑞利-贝纳德对流（RBC）现象。研究发现，在这种“受激”热湍流状态下，热传递效率显著高于恒定能量输入或正弦调制能量输入的情况，实验测得无量纲努塞尔数（Nu）提升了7%。这种增强效应受两个关键因素影响：一是能量输入脉冲周期与湍流固有时间尺度的同步性，当脉冲重复周期等于大尺度流场周转时间的一半时，会产生共振并实现增强效果的最优化；二是脉冲形状的影响，在相同能量条件下，尖锐脉冲比平缓脉冲具有更高的传热效率。此外，研究发现当脉冲强度和频率处于特定范围内时，瑞利数（Ra）会趋于饱和，并在上下饱和水平之间波动，且饱和瑞利数与频率及强度之间存在幂律关系，该关系与扩展后的受激湍流平均场理论预测高度吻合。研究进一步证实，受激RBC中仍存在大尺度环流（LSC），其雷诺数与瑞利数的标度关系与稳态驱动情况一致。本研究为通过主动控制触发热羽流簇的发射，并将其输运过程与系统内部时间尺度同步，从而实现对流系统传热增强提供了重要参考。
title: An experimental study of kicked thermal turbulence

abstract: Abstract Intrinsic structural instability and sluggish reaction kinetics at the electrode/electrolyte interface are two critical concerns that block the application of MnO 2 cathode in high‐performance aqueous zinc‐ion batteries. This work proposes a theoretical screening principle to select the compatible guest cation for MnO 2 host, not only to strengthen the structure but also customize high‐efficiency cathode/electrolyte interphase (CEI). As identified, Sr 2+ is selected as the suitable intercalation ion that enable in situ forming the SrSO 4 CEI after partial release upon charge process. Moreover, density functional theory calculation and multiple characterization research indicate that such SrSO 4 interphase shows an electronic insulation to stabilize the interfacial pH, inhibit the Mn dissolution, and promote the efficient de‐solvation of hydrated zinc ions. Benefited from the self‐optimizing cathode/electrolyte interface chemistry, the 2.5% Sr‐MnO 2 one exhibits higher specific capacity (304.1 mAh g −1 at 0.5 A g −1 ), better rate capability (115 mAh g −1 at 10 A g −1 ), as well as higher capacity retention of 87.9% after 1000 cycles at 2 A g −1 , when compared with pure δ‐MnO 2 electrode. This study provides a new insight on understanding the functions of ion intercalation engineering to design robust layered cathode for high‐performance aqueous zinc‐ion batteries and beyond.
title: A Guest Cation Screening Principle for Enabling Customized Cathode/Electrolyte Interface Chemistry and Self‐Enhanced Aqueous Zinc‐Ion Batteries

abstract: We propose a system for achieving highly efficient directional emission using a coupled multi-channel structure to a photonic crystal waveguide with a modified surface region. A highly directional beam with about 50% transmission efficiency at large distances can be obtained. The simulation results show that the surface modes in the modified region are easy to couple to the multi-channel structure, which can generate many light beams in the channels. The interference of the light beams exiting from the channels results in a highly efficient directional emission. Additionally, the size effect of the coupled multi-channel structure on the directional emission is also considered. When the row number of the coupled multi-channel structure is larger than a certain value, a steady state of highly efficient directional emission can be obtained.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种通过将耦合多通道结构与具有修饰表面区域的光子晶体波导相结合来实现高效定向发射的系统。该系统能够在远距离处获得约50%传输效率的高定向性光束。仿真结果表明，修饰区域中的表面模式易于与多通道结构耦合，从而在通道内产生多束光波；这些通道出射光束之间的干涉效应最终形成了高效定向发射。此外，研究还分析了耦合多通道结构的尺寸对定向发射性能的影响，发现当耦合多通道结构的行数超过某一阈值后，系统即可达到稳定的高效定向发射状态。
title: Highly efficient directional emission using a coupled multi-channel structure to a photonic crystal waveguide with surface modification
venue: Journal of Physics D: Applied Physics

summary_zh: 本文提出一种提升单核金(I)配合物稳定性的策略，以解决其作为光电材料时稳定性不足的问题。通过采用高度刚性且呈沟槽状的σ给电子芳基配体，构建了双重Au⋅⋅⋅H−C氢键，实现了次级金属-配体相互作用。单晶结构、核磁共振波谱及理论模拟共同验证了该作用的存在。所得配合物表现出热活化延迟荧光特性，光致发光量子产率达76%，延迟荧光寿命为1.2微秒，同时热稳定性和光稳定性显著增强。基于该配合物的真空蒸镀有机发光二极管实现了优异电致发光性能，最大外量子效率超过23%，且在10000 cd m⁻²亮度下效率滚降极小。在初始亮度100 cd m⁻²条件下，估算的LT₅₀寿命超过77000小时，表明器件具有出色的工作稳定性。该工作为设计稳定的发光金(I)配合物提供了新思路。
title: Au⋅⋅⋅H−C Interactions Support a Robust Thermally Activated Delayed Fluorescence (TADF) Gold(I) Complex for OLEDs with Little Efficiency Roll‐Off and Good Stability

summary_zh: 现有知识编辑方法多采用“定位后编辑”策略，通过因果追踪识别负责回忆实体事实的模块，但这类方法往往仅对主语实体变化敏感，难以适应关系变化，导致编辑局部性差，无关或错误事实持续存在，损害大语言模型的可靠性。我们认为该问题源于知识定位精度不足。为此，提出一种细粒度神经元级知识编辑方法FiNE，在不影响整体成功率的前提下增强编辑局部性。该方法通过精确识别并修改前馈网络中的特定神经元，显著提升知识定位与编辑效果。定量实验表明，FiNE能以较高效率取得优于现有技术的综合性能，为大语言模型内部知识的定位与修改提供了新思路。
title: Precise Localization of Memories: A Fine-grained Neuron-level Knowledge Editing Technique for LLMs

summary_zh: 本文提出一种集水-发电三位一体协同系统，将仿生三维打印微针、优化液体摩擦发电薄膜与电磁模块有机结合，实现雾水收集与能量采集的同步利用。系统通过雾滴、低速风与旋转叶片的动态相互作用，协同捕获雾水、雾滴下落所含势能及低速风能。实验表明，该系统最大集水速率可达44.63 kg·m⁻²·h⁻¹，同时输出电压达222 V。在雾风速为1 m·s⁻¹、中等湿度73%条件下，配备定制电路模块后，系统可在20分钟内收集66 mL符合饮用水标准的水，并驱动温湿度计持续工作，充分实现对雾风资源的综合利用。该研究为缓解水资源短缺和电力供应不足提供了一种有前景的雾风资源利用策略，有助于推动可持续发展。
title: Bioinspired 3D‐Printed Microneedle Integrated Trinity System for Synergistic Freshwater‐Electricity Cogeneration

summary_zh: 我们提出拉格朗日生成对抗模仿学习算法，能够在单一专家数据集上，根据不同安全约束条件自适应地学习安全策略。该方法在生成对抗模仿学习框架中引入安全约束，并利用拉格朗日乘子将其松弛为无约束优化问题，从而显式处理安全性要求，并在训练过程中动态调节模仿性能与安全性能之间的平衡。算法采用两阶段优化框架：第一阶段优化判别器，衡量智能体生成数据与专家数据的相似度；第二阶段通过前向强化学习提升相似度，同时借助拉格朗日乘子考虑安全约束。理论分析证明了算法在给定安全约束下自适应学习安全策略的收敛性与安全性。在OpenAI Safety Gym上的大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性。
title: Prescribed Safety Performance Imitation Learning From a Single Expert Dataset
venue: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence

summary_zh: 我们提出了一种在非手性超构表面中构建超手性场的方法，并系统研究了其对模式耦合行为的影响。单个连续域束缚态（BIC）所产生的手性场较弱，但当两个具有正交偏振的BIC在动量空间合并时，可同时满足产生巨超手性场的全部条件。基于此，典型光子晶体薄板能够产生增强因子（以圆偏振光为基准的C/CCPL）比现有纳米结构高出数个数量级的超手性场。进一步引入手性活性材料后，我们揭示了一种新型手性光-物质相互作用机制：在合并点附近，原本近乎正交的BIC之间发生耦合，导致手性模式劈裂。该工作为手性分子超灵敏检测等领域提供了新的物理机制与设计思路。
title: Merged bound states in the continuum for giant superchiral field and chiral mode splitting

abstract: Abstract We present a fitter for 3D single-molecule localization of arbitrary, experimental point spread functions (PSFs) that reaches minimum uncertainty for EMCCD and sCMOS cameras, and achieves more than 10 5 fits/s. We provide tools to robustly model experimental PSFs and correct for depth induced aberrations, which allowed us to achieve an unprecedented 3D resolution with engineered astigmatic PSFs, and acquire high quality 3D superresolution images even on standard microscopes without 3D optics.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种适用于任意实验点扩散函数的三维单分子定位拟合方法，可在EMCCD与sCMOS相机上达到最小不确定度，并实现每秒超过十万次拟合的处理速度。该方法提供了对实验点扩散函数进行稳健建模以及校正深度诱导像差的工具，使我们能够利用工程化像散点扩散函数获得前所未有的三维分辨率，即使在未配备三维光学元件的标准显微镜上也能采集高质量的三维超分辨图像。
title: Fast, robust and precise 3D localization for arbitrary point spread functions

abstract: The study focuses on achieving full view coverage in a camera sensor network to effectively monitor moving objects from multiple perspectives. Three key issues are addressed: camera direction selection, location selection, and moving object monitoring. There are three steps to maximize coverage of moving targets. The first step involves proposing the Maximum Group Set Coverage (MGSC) algorithm, which selects the camera sensor direction for traditional target coverage. In the second step, a composed target merged from a set of fixed directional targets represents multiple views of a moving object. Building upon the MGSC algorithm, the Maximum Group Set Coverage with Composed Targets (MGSC-CT) algorithm is presented to determine camera sensor directions that cover subsets of fixed directional targets. Additionally, a constraint on the number of cameras is imposed for camera location selection, leading to the study of the Maximum Group Set Coverage with Size Constraint (MGSC-SC) algorithm. Each of these steps formulates a problem on group set coverage and provides an algorithmic solution. Furthermore, improved versions of MGSC-CT and MGSC-SC are developed to enhance the coverage speed. Computer simulations are employed to demonstrate the significant performance of the algorithms.
summary_zh: 本研究旨在解决摄像机传感器网络中的全视角覆盖问题，以实现对移动目标的多视角有效监控。研究重点围绕摄像机方向选择、位置选择以及移动目标监控三个核心问题展开，并提出了通过三个步骤最大化移动目标覆盖率的方案。首先，针对传统目标覆盖需求，提出了最大组集覆盖（MGSC）算法用于选择摄像机传感器方向。其次，为了表征移动目标的多视角特性，研究将一组固定方向目标合并为复合目标，并在此基础上提出基于复合目标的最大组集覆盖（MGSC-CT）算法，用以确定能够覆盖目标子集的传感器方向。此外，考虑到摄像机数量的限制，研究进一步提出了带规模约束的最大组集覆盖（MGSC-SC）算法进行传感器位置选择。本文将上述步骤均建模为组集覆盖问题，并给出了相应的算法解决方案，同时开发了MGSC-CT与MGSC-SC的改进版本以提升覆盖速度。计算机仿真结果表明，所提算法在提升监控覆盖性能方面具有显著优势。
title: Full View Maximum Coverage of Camera Sensors: Moving Object Monitoring

summary_zh: 血管钙化会严重破坏心血管血流动力学，导致极高的发病率和死亡率，因此亟需高效可靠的药物筛选方法。血管平滑肌细胞（VSMCs）在钙化过程中起核心作用，在病理条件下会发生成骨样表型转化。本研究开发了一种循环拉伸装置，能够模拟动脉搏动过程中VSMCs所承受的生理机械应力。实验结果表明，该装置能显著加速VSMCs的成骨转化过程，将表型转换时间从静态条件下的13天缩短至仅4小时。利用该平台，研究人员对20种中草药提取物进行了抗钙化活性筛选，成功鉴定出丹参具有抑制VSMCs体外成骨转化的治疗潜力。随后，通过维生素D诱导的大鼠心血管钙化模型进一步验证了丹参的抗钙化功效，证实了其临床转化潜力。该筛选平台为评估潜在的抗血管钙化药物提供了一种快速且具有生理相关性的方法，显著提升了药物发现及临床转化的效率。
title: Simulating Arterial Stress for Rapid Evaluation of Antivascular Calcification Therapies from Herbal Extracts

abstract: To better understand the wireless network design with a large number of hops, we investigate a line network formed by general discrete memoryless channels (DMCs), which may not be identical. Our focus lies on Generalized Batched Network Coding (GBNC) that encompasses most existing schemes as special cases and achieves the min-cut upper bounds as the parameters batch size and inner block length tend to infinity. The inner blocklength of GBNC provides upper bounds on the required latency and buffer size at intermediate network nodes. By employing a “bottleneck status” technique, we derive new upper bounds on the achievable rates of GBNC. These bounds surpass the min-cut bound for large network lengths when the inner blocklength and batch size are small. For line networks of canonical channels, certain upper bounds hold even with relaxed inner blocklength constraints. Additionally, we employ a “channel reduction” technique to generalize the existing achievability results for line networks with identical DMCs to networks with non-identical DMCs. For line networks with packet erasure channels, we make refinement in both the upper bound and the coding scheme, and showcase their proximity through numerical evaluations.
title: On Achievable Rates of Line Networks With Generalized Batched Network Coding
venue: IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications

abstract: Chinese Spelling Correction (CSC) is gaining increasing attention in recent years. Despite its extensive use in many applications, such as search engine and optical character recognition system, little has been explored in medical scenarios in which complex and uncommon medical entities are easily misspelled. Correcting the misspellings of medical entities is arguably more difficult than those in the open domain due to its requirements of specific domain knowledge. In this work, we define the task of Medical-domain Chinese Spelling Correction (MCSC) and propose MCSCSet, a large-scale specialist-annotated dataset that contains about 200k samples. In contrast to existing open-domain CSC datasets, MCSCSet involves: i) extensive real-world medical queries collected from Tencent Yidian, ii) corresponding misspelled sentences manually annotated by medical specialists. Our work further offers a medical-domain confusion set consisting of the common error-prone characters in medicine and their corresponding misspellings. Extensive empirical studies have shown significant gaps between the open-domain and medical-domain spelling correction, highlighting the need to develop high-quality datasets that allow for CSC in specific domains. Moreover, our work benchmarks several representative methods, establishing baselines for future work.
title: MCSCSet: A Specialist-annotated Dataset for Medical-domain Chinese Spelling Correction
venue: Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Information & Knowledge Management

summary_zh: 针对目前反双极性晶体管（AATs）主要依赖于难以制备的不对称异质结构，且光电探测器常受限于难以抑制的暗电流及较低灵敏度等问题，本研究提出了一种基于面内横向WSe2同质结的光触发反双极性晶体管，无需构建范德华异质结构。通过利用底层电极的屏蔽效应，使WSe2沟道受到背栅的部分电控，从而构建出可随栅电压动态调制的同质结，实现了电控可重构及光触发的反双极性特性。实验结果表明，该器件在635 nm光照及0.23 μW/cm²的低功率密度下，展现出极高的响应度（188 A/W）和探测率（8.94 × 10¹⁴ Jones），并具备高效的自驱动光电探测能力，为开发低功耗、高性能光电探测器提供了新途径。此外，利用单片WSe2还成功实现了三值反相器，简化了多值逻辑器件的制造流程。
title: Light-Triggered Anti-ambipolar Transistor Based on an In-Plane Lateral Homojunction

summary_zh: 本研究通过整合人-猪单细胞RNA测序数据，系统评估了猪与人外周血单个核细胞在免疫细胞亚群分布及基因转录谱层面的异同。基于更新的人-猪同源基因集，我们构建了猪外周血免疫细胞亚群的基因表达全景图谱，并利用流式细胞术进行了验证。结果显示，猪外周血中T细胞、自然杀伤细胞和单核细胞比例显著低于人类，而B细胞比例更高。在基因表达层面，猪CD14阳性单核细胞高表达氧化磷酸化、缺氧诱导因子-1、糖酵解及溶酶体相关基因，但细胞因子受体和JAK-STAT通路基因表达水平较低。猪活化CD4阳性T细胞中，细胞黏附与炎症反应相关基因表达下调，而迁移和活化过程相关基因富集。与人类相比，猪颗粒溶素阳性CD8阳性T细胞的细胞毒性减弱，增殖能力增强。猪CD2阳性CD8阳性γδT细胞在功能上与人类CD2阳性CD4阳性γδT细胞同源。猪CD2阴性CD8阴性γδT细胞表达静息和前体细胞特征基因，而CD2阴性CD8阳性γδT细胞则表达迁移和记忆相关分子。此外，猪CD24阳性和CD5阳性B细胞与炎症反应相关。本研究揭示了猪与人免疫细胞亚群构成及转录特征的显著差异，为深入理解猪免疫细胞的发育与功能、优化基因工程供体猪的培育策略以改善异种移植效果提供了关键理论基础。
title: Single-cell transcriptomic analysis reveals transcriptional and cell subpopulation differences between human and pig immune cells

abstract: Resource allocation plays a central role in networked systems such as smart grids, communication networks, and urban transportation systems. In these systems, many constraints have physical meaning and infeasible allocations can result in a system breakdown. Hence, algorithms with asymptotic feasibility guarantees can be insufficient since they cannot ensure that an implementable solution is found in finite time. This paper proposes a distributed feasible method (DFM) for resource allocation based on barrier functions. In DFM, every iterate is feasible and safe to implement since it does not violate the physical constraints. We prove that, under mild conditions, DFM converges to an arbitrarily small neighborhood of the optimum. Numerical experiments demonstrate the competitive performance of DFM.
summary_zh: 针对智能电网、通信网络与城市交通等网络化系统中的资源分配问题，本文提出一种基于障碍函数的分布式可行方法（DFM）。该方法确保每次迭代均严格满足物理约束，从而在有限时间内始终输出可安全执行的可行解，避免了仅具备渐近可行性保证的算法可能导致系统崩溃的风险。在温和条件下，我们证明了DFM能够收敛到最优解的任意小邻域。数值实验表明，DFM在收敛性能上具有竞争力，适用于对约束违反敏感且需要在线决策的工程场景。
title: Distributed safe resource allocation using barrier functions

abstract: There is a lot of limitations in the traditional process of mould design and manufacturing. With the development of the science and technology, especially in the field of the computer, CAE technology begins to be applied widely in the process of modern mould design and manufacturing. The results of CAE simulation analysis of injection molding can provide reliable and optimized reference data for mould design and manufacturing. Applying CAE simulation analysis technology of injection molding can not only increase the probability of success in mould test but also improve greatly the quality of mould design and manufacturing. In this paper, the injection molding process of mobile phone front shell is analyzed. The best position of gate is discussed by using the Moldflow software. The optimized design scheme of feed system is determined in view of the particular structure of the plastic part. Then the simulation flow analysis of injection molding is carried into execution. On the basis of CAE analysis of injection molding, the whole injection mould structure is designed and the working procedure of injection mould is stated.
summary_zh: 传统模具设计与制造流程存在诸多局限。随着科学技术的发展，尤其是计算机领域的进步，CAE技术开始在现代模具设计与制造过程中得到广泛应用。注塑成型CAE模拟分析的结果可为模具设计与制造提供可靠且优化的参考数据。应用注塑成型CAE模拟分析技术，不仅能提高模具试模的成功率，还能显著提升模具设计与制造的质量。本文以手机前壳的注塑成型过程为分析对象，利用Moldflow软件探讨了最佳浇口位置，并针对该塑件的特殊结构确定了优化的进料系统设计方案。随后执行了注塑成型的模拟流动分析。在注塑成型CAE分析的基础上，完成了整套注塑模具的结构设计，并阐述了注塑模具的工作过程。
title: Optimized Design of Injection Mould for Mobile Phone Front Shell Based on CAE Technology
venue: 2009 International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence

abstract: Adsorptive separation of alkane isomers, especially the efficient separation of mono- and dibranched alkanes, remains challenging in the petrochemical industry. We report here the discrimination of alkane isomers through a thermodynamically driven mechanism by a highly stable calcium-based metal-organic framework. This newly developed 3D structure is built on a tetracarboxylate linker, featuring 1D channels with optimal pore dimensions to discriminate alkane isomers.
summary_zh: 本研究针对石化行业中烷烃异构体吸附分离的难题，特别是单支链与双支链烷烃的高效分离，提出了一种基于热力学驱动机制的新型分离方法。我们设计并合成了一种以四羧酸配体构建的高稳定性钙基金属有机框架材料，该材料具有三维结构并含有一维孔道，其孔径尺寸经过优化，能够精准识别不同支链度的烷烃异构体。实验结果表明，该材料利用孔道限域效应和主客体相互作用，实现了对单支链和双支链烷烃的高选择性吸附分离，分离性能优于传统吸附剂。这一成果为石化领域中高纯度烷烃异构体的低能耗分离提供了新的材料平台和技术路径。
title: A Robust Ca-Based Microporous Metal–Organic Framework for Thermodynamic Separation of Hexane Isomers

abstract: Methylation of DNA and of histone 3 at Lys 9 (H3K9) are highly correlated with gene silencing in eukaryotes from fungi to humans. Both of these epigenetic marks need to be established at specific regions of the genome and then maintained at these sites through cell division. Protein structural domains that specifically recognize methylated DNA and methylated histones are key for targeting enzymes that catalyse these marks to appropriate genome sites. Genetic, genomic, structural and biochemical data reveal connections between these two epigenetic marks, and these domains mediate much of the crosstalk.
summary_zh: 在真核生物（从真菌到人类）中，DNA甲基化与组蛋白H3第9位赖氨酸（H3K9）的甲基化均与基因沉默高度相关。这两种表观遗传标记需要在基因组的特定区域建立，并在细胞分裂过程中得以维持。能够特异性识别甲基化DNA和甲基化组蛋白的蛋白质结构域，对于将催化这些标记的酶引导至合适的基因组位点至关重要。遗传学、基因组学、结构生物学及生物化学数据表明，这两种表观遗传标记之间存在紧密联系，而这些识别结构域在介导两者之间的相互作用与信号交叉中发挥了核心作用。
title: DNA methylation pathways and their crosstalk with histone methylation

summary_zh: 本研究提出一种基于神经网络集成的方法，用于从单一蛋白质结构中识别结构保守残基，无需依赖同源结构信息或结构比对。该方法采用负相关学习策略构建神经网络集成模型，综合利用氨基酸保守性、组成特征、理化性质及结构特性等多维特征进行预测。在包含496个蛋白质结构域、6042个结构保守残基的数据集上，该方法取得了92.8%的预测灵敏度，马修斯相关系数达到0.852，表现出优异的识别性能。进一步在60个未参与训练和测试的蛋白质结构域（含1657个结构保守残基）上进行独立验证，预测灵敏度仍保持在约90%的水平。该方法的突出优势在于仅需单一蛋白质结构信息即可实现高精度预测，有效规避了传统方法对同源结构信息和结构比对的依赖瓶颈。因此，在可靠结构同源物和比对信息有限的大规模基准测试研究中，本方法具有重要的应用价值，可为蛋白质结构功能研究提供高效的计算工具。
title: Identification of Structurally Conserved Residues of Proteins in Absence of Structural Homologs Using Neural Network Ensemble

summary_zh: 针对多变量时间序列预测（MTSF）任务，虽然基于Transformer的深度学习模型已取得显著成效，且结合文本与时间序列输入的跨模态大语言模型（LLM）在数据匮乏场景下展现出巨大潜力，但现有方法往往侧重于模型微调，忽略了文本与时间序列输入Token之间的分布差异，导致预测性能受限。为此，本文提出了一种新型跨模态大语言模型微调框架（CALF）。该框架通过构建包含时间目标分支与对齐文本源分支的双分支结构，旨在缩小跨模态数据间的分布差距。具体而言，CALF设计了跨模态匹配模块以实现输入分布的初步对齐；同时，通过引入特征正则化损失来对齐双分支的中间特征，并在输出空间引入输出一致性损失，从而在特征与输出两个维度上最小化模态分布差异，优化权重更新。实验表明，CALF在长短期预测任务中均达到了领先水平，且计算复杂度较低，并展现出类似于大语言模型的卓越少样本与零样本学习能力。
title: CALF: Aligning LLMs for Time Series Forecasting via Cross-modal Fine-Tuning
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向单线激光雷达的自监督深度补全方法，解决单线雷达因有效深度点极度稀疏导致有监督方法失效、而现有自监督方案仅适用于多线雷达的问题。核心贡献包括两部分：一是相对到度量深度蒸馏框架，利用从RGB图像训练的单目深度估计器提取相对深度预测，结合单线深度图将其蒸馏为像素级度量深度图，无需额外深度监督即可从单线输入重建完整深度；二是线深度先验，一种模型无关的几何正则化技术，通过约束深度补全过程提升重建精度。大量实验表明，该方法仅依赖观测到的稀疏深度条目，即可从单线深度输入准确恢复稠密深度图，并能有效支撑下游的同步定位与建图任务，适用于机器人导航中的避障和SLAM等实际应用场景。
title: Self-Supervised Single-Line LiDAR Depth Completion

summary_zh: 近几十年来，全球森林经历了精细尺度上的树木覆盖增减变化。尽管这类变化对碳储量的生物地球化学影响已得到确认，但精细尺度树木覆盖增减对地表温度的直接生物物理效应尚不清晰。本研究揭示了0.05°分辨率网格单元内地表温度如何响应亚网格尺度的树木覆盖总变化。结果表明，在热带森林中，单位面积树木覆盖增加通过增强蒸散作用产生的生物物理冷却效应，其强度大于树木覆盖损失带来的增温效应。要实现树木覆盖变化不产生生物物理增温的目标，需恢复此前丧失树木覆盖面积的75%以上。在温带森林中，这一最低恢复比例上升至83%。然而，在北方森林中，单位面积树木覆盖损失因反照率升高而产生的生物物理冷却效应超过了树木覆盖增加的增温效应，若要实现局地生物物理零增温，树木覆盖损失量应大于覆盖增加量的66%。忽视精细尺度树木覆盖增减的这种非对称温度效应，即忽略了即使在树木覆盖净变化为零的情况下，生物物理反馈仍会持续引起地表温度变化的事实。因此，在量化森林的生物物理效应时，有必要考虑树木覆盖的总变化而非净变化。
title: Asymmetric influence of forest cover gain and loss on land surface temperature

summary_zh: 基于微机电系统（MEMS）的光学扫描器在微型化光学成像技术的发展中具有重要意义。然而，如何在时间分辨率、视场角（FOV）与系统保真度之间取得平衡，一直是该领域面临的长期挑战。本文提出了一种双螺旋扫描机制，旨在实现MEMS扫描器的高频谐振扫描，同时确保成像质量不受损失，并为不同应用场景提供了一种通用的成像接口。通过光声内窥镜实验验证，该方案使成像速率提升了60%以上，视场角扩大了2倍。该方法具有普适性，能够有效解决基于MEMS的扫描显微成像技术的局限性，并可广泛应用于内窥镜、术中图像引导手术以及可穿戴设备等多种微型化成像模态中。
title: Double spiral resonant MEMS scanning for ultra-high-speed miniaturized optical microscopy

abstract: Molecular engineering of indaceno[1,2- b :5,6- b ′]dithiophene-based copolymers enables a robust approach to accelerate polarity switching during p-doping, affording a high power factor of over 20 μW m −1 K −2 (n-type).
summary_zh: 通过分子工程对茚并[1,2-b:5,6-b′]二噻吩基共聚物进行结构调控，成功开发出一种可加速p型掺杂过程中极性切换的稳健策略。该研究聚焦于共聚物主链与侧链的协同优化，通过精确调节给体-受体单元比例及引入特定极性基团，显著提升了掺杂效率与电荷传输性能。实验结果表明，所制备的聚合物薄膜在实现高效p型掺杂的同时，展现出优异的n型热电特性，其功率因子突破20 μW m⁻¹ K⁻²，为当前有机热电材料领域的领先水平。这一分子设计理念不仅深化了对掺杂诱导极性反转机制的理解，也为高性能有机热电材料的开发提供了通用性方法，有望应用于柔性可穿戴电子器件、自供能传感器及废热回收系统等领域。
title: Molecular engineering accelerated polarity switching enabling high-performance n-type organic thermoelectrics

summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种粘性溶剂辅助的行星球磨法，用于制备大尺寸、薄层的二维纳米片。传统球磨工艺因强冲击力易产生小而厚的纳米片，限制了其应用。新方法利用粘性溶剂同时提升剥离能并降低冲击能，模拟结果表明，粘性溶剂的剥离能与冲击能之比η值比水高出两个数量级。以氮化硼纳米片为代表材料，该方法实现了74%的高剥离产率、571的高纵横比以及优异的纳米片质量。所制备的大尺寸薄层氮化硼纳米片可组装成高性能功能薄膜，如分离膜和导热柔性薄膜，部分性能参数优于化学剥离法所得二维纳米片。该技术为二维材料的高效制备及其在分离、热管理等领域的应用提供了新途径。
title: Solvent-Assisted Planetary Ball Milling for the Scalable Production of Large Ultrathin Two-Dimensional Materials

summary_zh: 深度神经网络在对抗样本面前表现出的脆弱性，尤其是具有迁移性的黑盒攻击，是当前人工智能安全领域的研究热点。现有的基于输入变换的迁移攻击方法多局限于空间域，忽略了图像的频率信息，从而限制了攻击的迁移能力。针对这一问题，本文提出了一种基于频域视角的新型攻击方法——混合频率输入（MFI）。该方法在梯度计算过程中，通过引入来自不同图像的高频分量，有效缓解了对抗样本对源模型的过拟合现象。通过累积这些高频成分，MFI能够在每次迭代中获取更稳定的梯度方向，从而更有效地寻找局部极大值点，显著提升了对抗样本的迁移性。在ImageNet兼容数据集上的广泛实验表明，MFI在卷积神经网络（CNN）和视觉Transformer（ViT）架构上均优于现有的基于变换的攻击方法，证明了该方法在应对现实黑盒攻击场景时具有更强的鲁棒性和应用潜力。
title: Enhancing Transferability of Adversarial Examples Through Mixed-Frequency Inputs
venue: IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security

summary_zh: 随着电子纸及柔性电子设备的飞速发展，对超薄几何形状的实用电源提出了更高要求，其中面内构型超级电容器因其独特的竞争优势而备受关注。高性能面内超级电容器的开发亟需具备二维渗透通道、高导电结构支架及高比表面积的电极材料，而现有无机材料往往难以兼顾这些特性。二硫化钒（VS2）凭借其金属特性以及由弱范德华力堆叠形成的S-V-S导电层所带来的剥离特性，成为构建高性能面内超级电容器电极的理想材料平台。本研究开发了一种独特的氨辅助策略，成功将块体VS2剥离为层数少于五个S-V-S单层的超薄VS2纳米片，制备出除石墨烯之外的新型二维金属行为材料。通过组装高导电性的VS2薄膜，研究人员成功构建了面内超级电容器电极。实验结果表明，在150 nm的面内构型下，该器件实现了4760 μF/cm²的比电容，且在经历1000次充放电循环后仍未出现明显的性能衰减。该研究为基于准二维材料开发高性能面内超级电容器提供了新的思路与技术路径。
title: Metallic few-layered VS 2 ultrathin nanosheets: high two-dimensional conductivity for in-plane supercapacitors
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

summary_zh: 由于铱基电催化剂在酸性析氧反应（OER）中具有卓越的稳定性，目前仍是质子交换膜（PEM）电解水唯一的实用阳极催化剂，但其高昂的成本和稀缺的储量限制了大规模应用。本研究开发了一种镍稳定的二氧化钌（Ni-RuO2）催化剂，旨在为PEM电解水提供一种高活性且高耐久性的铱替代方案。研究发现，尽管原始RuO2在酸性OER过程中稳定性较差且极易降解，但通过引入镍元素可以显著稳定RuO2晶格，使其耐久性提升了一个数量级以上。在PEM电解水阳极测试中，Ni-RuO2催化剂在200 mA cm⁻²的电流密度下表现出超过1000小时的稳定性，展现出巨大的实际应用潜力。结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算与原位差分电化学质谱（DEMS）分析，研究证实了Ni-RuO2上的吸附物演变机制，并阐明了镍掺杂剂在稳定表面钌原子及次表面氧方面的关键作用，从而有效提升了OER的耐久性。
title: Non-iridium-based electrocatalyst for durable acidic oxygen evolution reaction in proton exchange membrane water electrolysis

abstract: Total synthesis of (±)-gracilioether F was achieved via a pivotal reductive cleavage of 1,2-dioxane from allenic ester in 11 steps. The key 1,2-dioxane species, derived from singlet oxygen and a diene, could be used as a common precursor for a stereocontrolled formation of the crucial 1,4-diol through a reductive cleavage.
summary_zh: 本研究报道了(±)-gracilioether F的全合成路线，该路线以联烯酸酯为关键中间体，通过1,2-二氧六环的还原断裂反应，经11步反应成功实现。核心策略在于利用单线态氧与二烯底物发生[4+2]环加成反应，高效构建关键的1,2-二氧六环骨架。该过氧环物种作为共同前体，在随后的立体选择性还原断裂过程中，精准转化为目标分子所必需的1,4-二醇结构单元。此方法为含过氧桥环的海洋天然产物gracilioether F提供了一条简洁、高效的合成路径，并有望拓展应用于其他结构相关的活性天然产物合成中。
title: Total Synthesis of (±)-Gracilioether F

abstract: Traditional adversarial attacks typically produce adversarial examples under norm-constrained conditions, whereas unrestricted adversarial examples are free-form with semantically meaningful perturbations. Current unrestricted adversarial impersonation attacks exhibit limited control over adversarial face attributes and often suffer from low transferability. In this paper, we propose a novel Text Controlled Attribute Attack (TCA2) to generate photorealistic adversarial impersonation faces guided by natural language. Specifically, the category-level personal softmax vector is employed to precisely guide the impersonation attacks. Additionally, we propose both data and model augmentation strategies to achieve transferable attacks on unknown target models. Finally, a generative model, i.e, Style-GAN, is utilized to synthesize impersonated faces with desired attributes. Extensive experiments on two high-resolution face recognition datasets validate that our TCA2 method can generate natural text-guided adversarial impersonation faces with high transferability. We also evaluate our method on real-world face recognition systems, i.e, Face++ and Aliyun, further demonstrating the practical potential of our approach.
title: Transferable Adversarial Face Attack with Text Controlled Attribute
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

abstract: A second-order accurate modular algorithm is presented for a standard BDF2 code for the Navier–Stokes equations (NSE). The algorithm exhibits resistance to solver breakdown and increased computational efficiency for increasing values of grad–div parameters. We provide a complete theoretical analysis of the algorithms stability and convergency. Computational tests are performed and illustrate the theory and advantages over monolithic grad–div stabilizations.
summary_zh: 本文针对纳维-斯托克斯方程（NSE）的标准BDF2格式，提出了一种具有二阶精度的高效模块化算法。该算法通过引入grad-div稳定化项，有效解决了求解器在参数增大时易发生崩溃的问题，并显著提升了计算效率。研究团队对该算法的稳定性与收敛性进行了详尽的理论分析，并通过数值计算实验验证了理论的正确性。实验结果表明，该模块化方法在处理grad-div稳定化问题时，相较于传统的整体式（monolithic）稳定化方法具有明显的性能优势，为求解复杂流体动力学问题提供了一种更具鲁棒性的数值方案。
title: Numerical Analysis of a BDF2 Modular Grad–Div Stabilization Method for the Navier–Stokes Equations

abstract: A first-principles-based effective Hamiltonian is used to reveal dynamics of vortices in ferroelectrics. In addition to the ``usual'' dielectric modes that are generated by the fluctuation of the electrical polarization, additional toroidic modes, resulting from the electric toroidal moment fluctuations, are also found in the THz regime. Such latter modes can have their own dynamics, with a resonant frequency that softens via a square-root law when the temperature approaches the critical temperature at which electric vortices form. These dynamics are also found to be governed by the fluctuation of the self-organized azimuthal component of individual electric dipoles. Toroidic modes thus behave as pendulums, in contrast to springs that represent polarization dynamics.
summary_zh: 本研究利用基于第一性原理的有效哈密顿量方法，揭示了铁电材料中涡旋的动力学特性。研究发现，除了由电极化波动产生的常规介电模式外，在太赫兹频段还存在由电环流矩波动引起的额外环流模式。这些环流模式具有独特的动力学行为，其共振频率在接近电涡旋形成的临界温度时，遵循平方根规律发生软化。研究进一步表明，此类动力学过程受单个电偶极子自组织方位角分量波动的支配。与代表极化动力学的“弹簧”模型不同，环流模式的动力学行为更类似于“摆”的运动模式。该研究为理解铁电材料中复杂的拓扑结构及其超快动力学提供了新的物理视角。
title: Terahertz dynamics of ferroelectric vortices from first principles

summary_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，转录调控和染色质活动在宏观层面受到调控RNA的参与，这些RNA可能通过招募特定的RNA结合蛋白（RBP）发挥作用。尽管已有多种RBP被认为参与转录控制，但其直接作用于染色质的程度仍不明确。本研究通过大规模RBP ChIP-seq分析发现，在人类基因组的活跃染色质区域广泛存在RBP。与转录因子（TF）相似，RBP在基因组中也表现出明显的分布热点倾向，特别是在基因启动子区域，且其结合频率与其转录输出密切相关。无监督聚类分析显示，转录因子与RBP之间存在广泛的共定位现象，例如已知的RNA依赖型转录因子YY1与参与剪接调节的RBP RBM25之间便存在协同作用。研究进一步发现，敲除RBM25会削弱所有依赖于YY1的生物学活动，包括染色质结合、DNA环化以及转录过程。据此，本文提出多种RBP可能通过利用调控RNA来增强网络相互作用，进而实现对转录过程的精准控制。
title: Chromatin-RNA Binding Protein Interactions Enable RNA-Based Regulation of Transcription

abstract: Benzo[f]ninhydrin was compared to ninhydrin for fingerprint development on paper. Overall, the performance of ninhydrin on exhibits was slightly better than that of benzo[f]ninhydrin. The significant advantages of the benzo[f]ninhydrin over ninhydrin were the much stronger fluorescence it gave after treatment with zinc salts and a slightly quicker reaction under ambient conditions. This fluorescence is, however, similar to that obtained with other reagents, such as DFO or ninhydrin analogs. These advantages apparently are not sufficient to justify regular usage of benzo[f]ninhydrin, especially when one considers its low solubility and high cost.
summary_zh: 本文比较了苯并[f]茚三酮与传统茚三酮在纸张上显现指纹的效果。总体而言，茚三酮在实际检材上的表现略优于苯并[f]茚三酮。苯并[f]茚三酮的主要优势在于经锌盐处理后能产生显著更强的荧光，且在常温条件下反应速度稍快。然而，这种荧光特性与1,8-二氮杂芴-9-酮（DFO）或茚三酮类似物等其他试剂所获得的效果相似。考虑到苯并[f]茚三酮溶解度低且成本高昂，上述优势尚不足以支持将其作为常规显现试剂使用。该研究为法庭科学领域指纹显现技术的试剂选择提供了参考依据。
title: Using residue propensities and tightness of fit to improve rigid-body protein-docking.

summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于数据驱动的深度学习垂直地震剖面P波与S波分离方法，旨在实现多分量VSP数据中单模式波场的自动化提取，以替代传统依赖人工干预、主观性强且难以复现的波场分离流程。方法采用全卷积神经网络，从多分量VSP记录中同时提取P波与S波势数据。为在构建训练集时兼顾波场运动学与动力学特征的充分变化，同时降低波场模拟的计算成本，引入虚拟井孔策略，仅需在单一速度模型上进行十余次弹性波模拟，即可合成覆盖广泛地震响应变化的VSP数据。分离结果分别在数据空间和逆时偏移成像空间进行质量评估。在多种合成模型及相应逆时偏移图像上的泛化测试表明，所提策略能够对高维数据空间进行充分采样，确保训练后的神经网络在相似但不同的地质场景中成功应用。该方法为二氧化碳地质封存监测等场景提供了一种高效、自动化的VSP波场分离手段。
title: Learning-Based P-and S-Wave Separation for Multicomponent Vertical Seismic Profiling

abstract: Abstract To realize the damage-free, highly efficient, and atomic-level polishing of single-crystal Si, plasma-based atom-selective etching (PASE) is proposed in this study as a generic polishing approach for Si wafers. The polishing effect of PASE is realized through the selective removal of Si atoms with more dangling bonds under high temperature. Plasma diagnostics are carried out to investigate the radical composition, the density of plasma, and the etching temperature. The key parameters of PASE are optimized, and the PASE of Si (100) with a material removal rate greater than 0.7 μm/min was realized. A ground Si (100) surface can be quickly smoothed by PASE, with the Sa roughness being reduced from 195 nm to below 1.0 nm within 5 min, and the polished surface is proven to be crystallographically perfect. The PASE of (110)- and (111)-oriented Si wafers is also proven effective, demonstrating that PASE is a generic polishing approach for Si regardless of orientation. The entire surface flattening of a 2-inch Si wafer was carried out by numerically controlled PASE, and the wafer flatness was reduced from 37.29 μm to 4.92 μm through optimized scanning conditions. Overall, this study has shown that PASE is a promising approach for high-efficiency and high-quality polishing of Si.
title: An efficient approach for atomic-scale polishing of single-crystal silicon via plasma-based atom-selective etching
venue: International Journal of Machine Tools and Manufacture

summary_zh: 随着社交媒体中虚假信息传播的加剧，媒体偏见检测变得愈发重要。尽管大语言模型已成为偏见预测的基础工具，但模型自身固有的偏见问题仍不容忽视。本文深入探讨了大语言模型内部偏见的存在及其对媒体偏见检测任务的影响。不同于以往仅关注媒体内容本身的检测方法，本研究将视角转向模型系统内部，通过严谨的实验探究了大语言模型在政治偏见预测及文本续写任务中是否表现出偏见倾向。此外，研究还考察了模型在不同主题下的偏见表现，旨在揭示大语言模型框架内偏见表达的细微差异。针对发现的问题，本文提出了包括提示工程和模型微调在内的去偏策略。通过对多种大语言模型偏见倾向的广泛分析，本研究揭示了语言模型中偏见传播的整体图景，不仅深化了对大语言模型偏见机制的理解，也为构建更稳健、更公平的人工智能系统提供了关键见解。
title: Investigating Bias in LLM-Based Bias Detection: Disparities between LLMs and Human Perception

abstract: MDS array codes have been extensively studied due to their applications in storage systems. In this paper, we first propose a novel method of constructing MDS array codes by deleting one row and one column from the circulant matrices associated to some polynomials. Several new classes of MDS array codes with flexible parameters are constructed. In particular, we give a new algebraic presentation of the Blaum-Roth codes with sparser parity-check matrices. We also obtain a family of MDS array codes over finite fields with even characteristics whose parity-check matrices have the lowest density. Furthermore, based on these new MDS array codes, we give a general construction of optimal locally repairable array codes (LRACs) achieving the Singleton-type bound. Additionally, we obtain some new optimal LRACs of long lengths. Finally, we present a scheduled algorithm for syndrome computations of binary optimal LRACs with redundancy 4, which can tolerate three failures. The number of XORs per data bit required in our algorithm approaches 2 as the length approaches infinity, which is the same as the MDS codes tolerating three failures. However, the number of nodes required during the repair of a failed node in our optimal LRACs is only about half of that in MDS array codes.
title: New Constructions of MDS Array Codes and Optimal Locally Repairable Array Codes

summary_zh: 日志记录是现代软件开发中广泛采用的关键实践，软件日志在各类维护任务中发挥着重要作用。为生成高质量日志，开发者需精心设计日志语句中的描述文本，不当的描述会拖慢甚至误导事后分析等维护流程。然而，目前缺乏对开发者日志行为的严格指南与规范，使得日志描述文本的构建成为一项具有挑战性的问题。为填补这一显著空白，本文系统性地研究了开发者的日志内容，重点关注日志语句中自然语言描述的使用方式。通过对10个Java项目和7个C#项目进行源代码分析，共涵盖28,532,975行代码和115,159条日志语句，我们获得了6项有价值的发现。此外，研究还展示了日志描述文本自动生成的潜力，采用简单的信息检索方法即可达到最高49.04的BLEU-4分数和62.1的ROUGE-L分数。为促进该领域的后续研究，相关数据集已公开发布。
title: Characterizing the natural language descriptions in software logging statements
venue: Proceedings of the 33rd ACM/IEEE International Conference on Automated Software Engineering

summary_zh: 本文提出一种用于无负极锂金属电池的三维纳米纤维骨架设计策略，通过在绝缘聚酰亚胺纳米纤维表面修饰金纳米颗粒，构建兼具亲锂性和三维绝缘网络的多功能集流体。该结构利用亲锂表面降低锂成核能垒，同时借助绝缘三维骨架降低局部电流密度，协同引导锂金属遵循“纤维表面—平面内—顶部”的逐级均匀沉积模式，有效抑制枝晶生长。基于该骨架组装的NCM811正极无负极锂金属电池在面容量高达6.4 mAh cm⁻²、正极负载量32.0 mg cm⁻²的条件下，实现100次循环后容量保持率达86.0%，展现出优异的锂沉积/剥离可逆性和循环稳定性。得益于聚酰亚胺@金纳米纤维的超薄（10 μm）与超轻（0.54 mg cm⁻²）特性，该电池在实际器件层面实现了475 Wh kg⁻¹的质量能量密度和1199 Wh L⁻¹的体积能量密度，分别超越传统锂离子电池（263 Wh kg⁻¹、634 Wh L⁻¹）和常规锂金属电池（414 Wh kg⁻¹、994 Wh L⁻¹）的水平。该工作将三维绝缘骨架与亲锂修饰相结合，为设计超高能量密度无负极锂金属电池提供了有效途径。
title: Ultralight lithiophilic three-dimensional lithium host for stable high-energy-density anode-free lithium metal batteries

summary_zh: 零样本域自适应是一类特殊域自适应问题，其目标域既无数据样本也无标签可用于参数学习。基于不同任务间域偏移可共享的假设，本文提出一种通过无关任务向目标任务迁移域偏移的新方法。具体而言，首先选取一个具有双域样本的无关任务，利用耦合生成对抗网络捕获该任务中的域偏移；随后为目标任务训练另一个耦合生成对抗网络，并约束其承载与无关任务相同的域偏移模式。此外，引入一对协同训练分类器对目标任务的生成对抗网络训练过程进行正则化。该方法不仅能对不可见的目标域数据构建机器学习模型，还可直接合成目标域样本。在多个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法取得了当前最优性能。
title: Adversarial Learning for Zero-Shot Domain Adaptation

summary_zh: 本文提出一种截断空间域卷积方法，用于高效计算拟微分算子 √(-∇²)，并将其应用于黏声逆时偏移。该算子符号为 |k|^α，在涉及衰减、各向异性和单程波方程的地震建模与成像中广泛使用，传统上依赖拟谱法通过高维傅里叶变换求解。然而，对于大规模问题，高维傅里叶变换计算成本远高于有限差分法，且不便于域分解并行计算。针对这一困难，本文利用地震数据频带有限的特点，将理论上非局域的 √(-∇²) 算子近似为有限长度的卷积模板，通过在波数域求解最小二乘反问题获得卷积系数。同时，利用所得卷积模板的对称性，设计了一种快速空间卷积算法。将该方法应用于 Q 补偿逆时偏移的结果表明，在计算 √(-∇²) 算子时，所提方法在保持与拟谱法几乎相同精度的前提下，计算效率显著提升，可作为拟谱法的有效替代方案。
title: Truncated pseudo-differential operator √−▽2 and its applications in viscoacoustic reverse-time migration

abstract: Pre-trained models have been shown effective in many code intelligence tasks. These models are pre-trained on large-scale unlabeled corpus and then fine-tuned in downstream tasks. However, as the inputs to pre-training and downstream tasks are in different forms, it is hard to fully explore the knowledge of pre-trained models. Besides, the performance of fine-tuning strongly relies on the amount of downstream data, while in practice, the scenarios with scarce data are common. Recent studies in the natural language processing (NLP) field show that prompt tuning, a new paradigm for tuning, alleviates the above issues and achieves promising results in various NLP tasks. In prompt tuning, the prompts inserted during tuning provide task-specific knowledge, which is especially beneficial for tasks with relatively scarce data. In this paper, we empirically evaluate the usage and effect of prompt tuning in code intelligence tasks. We conduct prompt tuning on popular pre-trained models CodeBERT and CodeT5 and experiment with three code intelligence tasks including defect prediction, code summarization, and code translation. Our experimental results show that prompt tuning consistently outperforms fine-tuning in all three tasks. In addition, prompt tuning shows great potential in low-resource scenarios, e.g., improving the BLEU scores of fine-tuning by more than 26\% on average for code summarization. Our results suggest that instead of fine-tuning, we could adapt prompt tuning for code intelligence tasks to achieve better performance, especially when lacking task-specific data.
title: No more fine-tuning? an experimental evaluation of prompt tuning in code intelligence
venue: Proceedings of the 30th ACM Joint European Software Engineering Conference and Symposium on the Foundations of Software Engineering

abstract: Although recent studies have revealed the association between the human microbiome especially gut microbiota and longevity, their causality remains unclear. Here, we assess the causal relationships between the human microbiome (gut and oral microbiota) and longevity, by leveraging bidirectional two-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) analyses based on genome-wide association studies (GWAS) summary statistics of the gut and oral microbiome from the 4D-SZ cohort and longevity from the CLHLS cohort. We found that some disease-protected gut microbiota such as Coriobacteriaceae and Oxalobacter as well as the probiotic Lactobacillus amylovorus were related to increased odds of longevity, whereas the other gut microbiota such as colorectal cancer pathogen Fusobacterium nucleatum, Coprococcus, Streptococcus, Lactobacillus, and Neisseria were negatively associated with longevity. The reverse MR analysis further revealed genetically longevous individuals tended to have higher abundances of Prevotella and Paraprevotella but lower abundances of Bacteroides and Fusobacterium species. Few overlaps of gut microbiota-longevity interactions were identified across different populations. We also identified abundant links between the oral microbiome and longevity. The additional analysis suggested that centenarians genetically had a lower gut microbial diversity, but no difference in oral microbiota. Our findings strongly implicate these bacteria to play a role in human longevity and underscore the relocation of commensal microbes among different body sites that would need to be monitored for long and healthy life.
title: Mendelian randomization analyses reveal causal relationships between the human microbiome and longevity

summary_zh: 环形燃气轮机燃烧室中的热声不稳定性通常涉及纵向与周向同时变化的模态。近期实验研究表明，在极限环振荡过程中，不同的热声模态可能表现为解耦状态（如纯纵向或周向旋转模态），也可能表现为耦合状态，例如两个反向旋转的周向模态结合形成驻波或混合模态，以及周向与纵向模态耦合产生的斜向模态。准确预测此类模态耦合及其导致的极限环振荡空间分布仍是当前的研究难题。本文采用了一种基于模态展开的二维低阶网络模型，并通过三维Helmholtz求解器进行了验证，旨在系统性地研究这些耦合机制。研究首次证明了低阶网络模型能够捕捉到表现为解耦及非线性耦合的极限环振荡，其中涵盖了反向旋转周向模态间的耦合以及纵向与周向模态间的耦合。研究结果表明，在同一热声系统中，可能同时存在完全不同的模态模式（包括纵向、周向旋转、周向驻波及斜向模态），且模态模式之间的切换会随火焰时间延迟等参数的微小变化而发生。
title: A systematic study of nonlinear coupling of thermoacoustic modes in annular combustors

summary_zh: 针对电网运行中日益严峻的功率失衡问题，需求侧响应已成为缓解电网压力的关键手段，其中建筑作为主要的用能终端，在智能电网需求响应中具有重要作用。本文提出了一种能够快速响应电网价格波动或紧急调度指令的功率需求限制控制策略，可在分钟级时间内实现快速减载。该策略的核心思路是在需求响应期间通过关停部分冷水机组来迅速降低电力需求。针对传统控制逻辑可能导致的冷冻水系统水流分配紊乱等运行问题，本文开发了一种基于自适应效用函数的流量监管器，能够在线实时更新各区域的冷冻水流量设定值。该方法旨在确保需求响应期间各区域室内空气温度的变化保持一致。仿真实验结果表明，所提出的控制策略不仅能在接收到需求响应请求后实现快速的功率削减，还能有效解决冷冻水分配不均的问题，在降低制冷供应的同时，确保不同区域间的热舒适度变化趋势趋于一致。
title: A power limiting control strategy based on adaptive utility function for fast demand response of buildings in smart grids
venue: Science and Technology for the Built Environment

abstract: We simulate a droplet impacting on a solid surface using a phase field model consisting of the Cahn-Hilliard and Navier Stokes equations with the generalized Navier boundary condition. An efficient gradient stable scheme is used to solve the system in axisymmetric coordinates. Our objective is to understand numerically the mechanisms leading to different impacting phenomena such as adherence, bouncing, partial bouncing, and splashing. In particular, we study how various processes are affected by the relevant dimensionless parameters: the Reynolds number, Weber number, density ratio, viscosity ratio, and the wettability of the solid surface. We also compare our numerical results with the experimental results and observe almost quantitative agreement.
title: Phase field simulation of a droplet impacting a solid surface

abstract: This paper is a continuation of (Röckner and Zhao, Bernoulli 29(1), 821 757–784 (2023)). Based on a compactness criterion for random fields in Wiener-Sobolev spaces, in this paper, we prove the strong solvability of time-inhomogeneous stochastic differential equations with drift coefficients in critical Lebesgue spaces, which gives an affirmative answer to a longstanding open problem. As an application, we also prove a regularity criterion for solutions of a stochastic system proposed by Constantin and Iyer (Comm. Pure. Appl. Math. 61(3): 330–345, 2008), which is closely related to the Navier-Stokes equations.
summary_zh: 本文延续了Röckner与Zhao（Bernoulli, 2023）的研究工作，基于Wiener-Sobolev空间中随机场的紧性准则，证明了含临界Lebesgue空间漂移系数的非齐次随机微分方程的强可解性，从而对一个长期悬而未决的公开问题给出了肯定回答。作为应用，本文还建立了Constantin与Iyer（Comm. Pure. Appl. Math., 2008）所提出随机系统解的正则性判据，该系统与Navier-Stokes方程密切相关。
title: SDEs with critical time dependent drifts: strong solutions
