summary_zh: 我们提出了一种统一体素化框架 UniVoxel，用于高效地联合学习场景的几何、材质与光照，从而显著加速逆向渲染过程。与现有方法分别建模各要素并依赖大量优化计算不同，UniVoxel 将场景编码为隐式体素表示，并通过轻量神经网络以统一方式同时推断几何结构、材质属性和光照信息。其关键设计在于利用局部球面高斯函数表达入射光辐射度，使光照建模能够无缝融入统一体素框架，从而无需昂贵的多次弹射光线追踪即可高效捕捉直接光照、间接光照及可见性效应。在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，UniVoxel 大幅提升了优化效率，将单场景训练时间从数小时缩短至 18 分钟，同时保持了良好的重建质量。该方法适用于需要快速、高质量逆向渲染的图形学与视觉应用场景。
title: UniVoxel: Fast Inverse Rendering by Unified Voxelization of Scene Representation

abstract: Abstract A highly enantioselective catalytic Diels–Alder (DA) cycloaddition of 2 H ‐pyran‐2,5‐diones (synthon of 5‐hydroxy‐2‐pyrones) has been developed with a Cinchona ‐derived thiourea as the catalyst. The conditions were optimized by using 0.2 equiv. of the catalyst and 0.1 equiv. of formic acid in 2‐propanol at room temperature, which afforded the DA products in yields of up to 90% ( exo / endo =5.5:1, 98% ee ) with trans ‐β‐nitrostyrene derivatives as the dienophiles. The structure/activity relationships of the bifunctional catalyst and the effects of the steric, electronic and hydrogen‐bonding properties of the dienophiles have been studied.
summary_zh: 本文报道了一种基于金鸡纳碱衍生硫脲催化剂的高对映选择性Diels–Alder环加成反应，以2H-吡喃-2,5-二酮（作为5-羟基-2-吡喃酮合成子）为双烯体，反式-β-硝基苯乙烯衍生物为亲双烯体。在室温条件下，以2-丙醇为溶剂，使用0.2当量催化剂和0.1当量甲酸作为添加剂，可获得最高90%的产率，产物外型/内型比达5.5:1，对映体过量值高达98%。研究系统探讨了双功能催化剂的结构-活性关系，以及亲双烯体的空间位阻、电子效应和氢键性质对反应效率与立体选择性的影响。该方法为手性多环骨架的高效构建提供了新途径，在天然产物合成和药物化学领域具有潜在应用价值。
title: A New Class of Enantioselective Catalytic 2‐Pyrone Diels–Alder Cycloadditions

summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶是当前自动驾驶领域的研究热点，但现有方法在处理异构传感器融合以及将稠密感知特征转化为稀疏运动表示方面仍面临挑战。本文提出了一种名为BevDrive的新型端到端自动驾驶框架，通过鸟瞰图（BEV）表示实现了摄像头与激光雷达（LiDAR）的融合以及运动规划的统一。该框架由三个核心模块组成：首先，双向引导的BEV特征构建模块通过深度引导的图像BEV特征构建与图像引导的LiDAR BEV特征构建两条分支，实现了图像特征向BEV空间的转换以及LiDAR特征的语义增强；其次，双注意力BEV特征融合模块利用窗口自注意力与全局自注意力机制的混合方法，在局部和全局层面完成多模态特征的融合；最后，基于BEV的运动规划模块通过控制与轨迹查询与融合特征中的场景上下文进行交互，从而生成精确的轨迹点和控制指令。在CARLA Town05 Long基准测试上的实验结果表明，BevDrive达到了当前领先水平。此外，通过在真实车辆平台上的验证，证明了该算法在实际应用中的可行性与鲁棒性。
title: Camera–LiDAR Fusion and Motion Planning Using Bird’s-Eye View Representation for End-to-End Autonomous Driving

abstract: The attention mechanism is becoming an integral part of modern neural networks, bringing breakthroughs to Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications and even Computer Vision (CV) applications. Unfortunately, the superiority of attention mechanism comes from its ability to model relations between any two positions in long sequence, which incurs high inference overhead. For state-of-the-art AI workloads such as Bert or GPT-2, attention mechanism is reported to account up to 50% of the inference overhead. Previous works seek to alleviate this performance bottleneck by removing useless relations for each position and accelerate position-specific operations. However their attempts require selecting from a sequence of relations once for each position, which is essentially frequent on-the-fly pruning and breaks the inherent parallelism in attention mechanism. In this paper, we propose CTA, an algorithm-architecture co-designed solution that can substantially reduce theoretic complexity of attention mechanism, enabling significant speedup and energy saving. Inspired by the fact that the feature sequence encoded by attention mechanism contain a large number of semantic feature repetition, we propose a novel approximation scheme that can efficiently remove that repetition, only calculating attention among necessary features thus reducing computation complexity quadratically. To utilize this algorithmic bonus and empower high performance attention mechanism inference, we devise specialized architecture to efficiently support the proposed approximation scheme. Extensive experiments show that, on average, CTA achieves 27.7× speedup, 634.0× energy savings with no accuracy loss, and 44.2× speedup, 950.0× energy savings with around 1% accuracy loss over Nvidia V100-SXM2 GPU. Also, CTA achieves 22.8× speedup, 479.6× energy savings over ELSA accelerator+GPU system.
title: CTA: Hardware-software co-design for compressed token attention mechanism

abstract: The compatibility of perovskite and organic photovoltaic materials in solution processing provides a significant advantage in the fabrication of high-efficiency perovskite/organic tandem solar cells. However, additional recombination losses can occur during exciton dissociation in organic materials, leading to energy losses in the near-infrared region of tandem devices. Consequently, a ternary organic rear subcell is designed containing two narrow-bandgap non-fullerene acceptors to enhance the absorption of near-infrared light. Simultaneously, a unique diffusion-controlled growth technique is adopted to optimize the morphology of the ternary active layer, thereby improving exciton dissociation efficiency. This innovation not only broadens the absorption range of near-infrared light but also facilitates the generation and effective dissociation of excitons. Owing to these technological improvements, the power conversion efficiency (PCE) of organic solar cells increased to 19.2%. Furthermore, a wide-bandgap perovskite front subcell is integrated with a narrow-bandgap organic rear subcell to develop a perovskite/organic tandem solar cell. Owing to the reduction in near-infrared energy loss, the PCE of this tandem device significantly improved, reaching 24.5%.
title: Boosting the Efficiency of Perovskite/Organic Tandem Solar Cells via Enhanced Near‐Infrared Absorption and Minimized Energy Losses

abstract: Abstract Almost no in situ seismic data are available for Venus; therefore, we can constrain the deep structure of this planet only from the geodetic data obtained by spacecraft. Of particular interest is Venus’s core‐mantle boundary, which holds clues about the origin and evolution of this celestial body. In this study, we build a series of different mantle/core models of Venus based on several mantle composition models and compare their associated Love numbers k 2 with the observed values. Due to the large uncertainty in the observed values of k 2 , the state of Venus’s core cannot be reliably constrained. However, the expected precision of k 2 obtained by the EnVision mission will sufficiently reduce the acceptable model space and contribute to estimating the mantle viscosity structure. Based on current geodetic data, we find that the bottom of Venus’s mantle may not feature a phase transition from perovskite to post‐perovskite if the FeO content of the mantle is less than 8.1 wt%; this region may be different from Earth’s D” layer. Furthermore, we find that the combination of observed k 2 and Q can be used to distinguish whether the lowermost part of Venus’s mantle is a high‐temperature basalt layer or a thin thermal boundary layer if observations of Q can be obtained.
title: Possible Deep Structure and Composition of Venus With Respect to the Current Knowledge From Geodetic Data

summary_zh: 类脑计算在加速高性能并行低功耗存内计算、人工智能及自适应学习方面具有巨大潜力。然而，现有的电子人工突触器件在柔韧性、鲁棒性及超低功耗方面仍难以达到生物突触的标准。本文展示了一种基于云母铁电场效应晶体管的全无机柔性人工突触器件。该器件不仅能够实现优异的电脉冲调制电导更新以模拟突触功能，还展现出卓越的机械柔韧性和高温可靠性，使其能够在应力或加热等外部干扰下实现稳健的类脑计算。凭借线性、可重复且稳定的长期塑性特征，研究人员利用该器件模拟了人工神经网络，并在NIST手写数字识别任务中实现了94.4%的准确率。这项工作为实现模仿大脑功能、具备柔性、低功耗、高鲁棒性且高效的类脑计算提供了一种极具前景的新途径。
title: Flexible electronic synapse enabled by ferroelectric field effect transistor for robust neuromorphic computing

abstract: We present the global phase diagram of the extended boson Hubbard model on a simple cubic lattice by quantum Monte Carlo simulation with the worm update algorithm. Four kinds of phases are supported by this model, including superfluid, supersolid, Mott, and charge density wave (CDW) states, which are identified in the phase diagram of chemical potential $\ensuremath{\mu}$ versus nearest-neighbor interaction $V$. By changing the chemical potential, a continuous transition is found from the Mott phase to a superfluid phase without breaking the translational symmetry. For an insulating CDW state, adding particles to it gives rise to a continuous transition to a supersolid phase, while removing particles usually leads to a first-order transition to either a supersolid or superfluid phase. By tuning the nearest-neighbor interaction, one can realize the transition between two insulating phases, Mott and CDW, with the same particle density, which turns out to be first order. We also confirm the result in Phys. Rev. B 79, 094503 (2009) that a supersolid phase with average particle density less than 1/2 can exist in a small region of the $\ensuremath{\mu}$-$V$ phase diagram.
title: Global phase diagram of three-dimensional extended Boson Hubbard model: A continuous-time quantum Monte Carlo study
Genome wide association study of response to interval and continuous exercise training: the Predict-HIIT study

summary_zh: 本研究旨在探讨非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者外周血γδ T细胞的免疫表型与化疗或靶向治疗疗效之间的关联。研究回顾性分析了52例EGFR野生型（EGFR-WT）及突变型（EGFR-Mut）NSCLC患者的临床病理特征及治疗数据，并利用全谱流式细胞术检测了外周血中αβ T细胞与γδ T细胞的免疫表型。结果显示，EGFR突变状态并未显著改变αβ T细胞或γδ T细胞的比例及免疫耗竭标志物的表达。然而，在EGFR突变型和野生型患者中，临床获益率较高的响应者（R）其外周血Vδ2 T细胞比例均显著高于无响应者（NR）。此外，响应者Vδ2 T细胞上的免疫耗竭标志物PD-1表达水平显著较低，且无论EGFR突变状态如何，响应者的TNF-α水平均高于无响应者。研究表明，具有低免疫耗竭特征的循环Vδ2 T细胞是提升NSCLC化疗及靶向治疗疗效的关键因素，针对Vδ2 T细胞的免疫干预有望成为提高NSCLC患者临床获益率的新策略。
title: Low-exhaustion peripheral circulating γδ T cells serve as a biomarker for predicting the clinical benefit rate of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients to chemotherapy or targeted therapy: a single-center retrospective study

summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于主动容错控制的质子交换膜燃料电池健康管理方法，旨在延长电池使用寿命并降低维护成本。该方法首先构建低成本、高响应速度的堆电压模型，用于实时状态监测；当监测模块检测到故障时，触发快速电化学阻抗谱测量，并利用弛豫时间分布提取阻抗谱特征进行故障诊断。根据诊断结果，系统自动调用相应的性能恢复策略以应对故障。为验证方法有效性，选取水淹、膜干和空气饥饿三种典型故障进行实验。结果表明，所提健康管理方法能够实现实时健康监测与快速故障诊断，并在故障状态下有效恢复电池性能，从而显著提升质子交换膜燃料电池系统的可靠性。
title: Health Management for PEM Fuel Cells Based on an Active Fault Tolerant Control Strategy

abstract: Behavior, Interaction, Priorities (BIP) is a component framework for constructing systems from a set of atomic components by using two kinds of composition operators: interactions and priorities. In this paper, we present a method that transforms the interactions of a component-based program in BIP and generates a functionally equivalent program. The method is based on the successive application of three types of source-to-source transformations: flattening of components, flattening of connectors, and composition of atomic components. We show that the system of the transformations is confluent and terminates. By exhaustive application of the transformations, any BIP component can be transformed into an equivalent monolithic component. From this component, efficient standalone C++ code can be generated. The method combines advantages of component-based description such as clarity, incremental construction, and reasoning with the possibility to generate efficient monolithic code. It has been integrated in the design methodology for BIP and it has been successfully applied to two non trivial examples described in this paper.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向行为-交互-优先级（BIP）组件框架的源到源转换方法，可将基于组件的程序自动转化为功能等价的单体程序。该方法依次应用三类转换：组件扁平化、连接器扁平化及原子组件合成。研究证明该转换系统具有合流性且可终止，通过穷尽应用这些转换，任意BIP组件均可转化为等价的单体组件，进而生成高效独立C++代码。该方法兼具组件化描述的优势——结构清晰、支持增量构建与推理，以及生成高效单体代码的能力。该方案已集成至BIP设计方法论中，并在两个非平凡实例上成功验证。
title: Source-to-Source Architecture Transformation for Performance Optimization in BIP

summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向软体机器人的“调低刚度”新方法，将本体感知与变刚度调节融合于过约束软体关节设计中，仅利用单一机载传感器实现基本气动控制，同时获得多方向本体感知与刚度可调能力。研究从概念设计、建模、驱动控制到实验验证进行了系统阐述。通过过约束结构增强软体关节的力学响应特性，克服了传统超弹性软体机器人因刚度过低而难以连续变形感知的瓶颈，使关节在保持柔顺性的同时具备更高的力输出潜力。实验结果表明，该关节能够在不依赖外部专用传感器的情况下实时感知自身姿态与环境交互，并通过调节气压实现刚度连续变化，验证了本体感知与变刚度协同工作的有效性。该方法为软体机器人在需要环境感知与力调控兼备的场景（如柔性抓取、人机交互与可穿戴辅助装置）提供了新的设计思路与技术途径。
title: Multi-Dimensional Proprioception and Stiffness Tuning for Soft Robotic Joints
venue: 2022 International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)

abstract: We present a polymer thermo-optic mode switch based on the structure of two vertical Mach-Zehnder interferometers (MZIs). It can achieve a rapid switch between E <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub> , E <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> , E <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub> and E <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> with the different heaters turning on. In our simulation, we compare two structures (the metal top electrode and the graphene electrode). The Finite element method (FEM) is used to simulate the parameters of the graphene electrode device. The power consumption of 1 and 3 heaters is 1.72 mW, and that of 2 and 4 heaters is 1.85 mW. In addition, the response speeds of the 1 and 3 graphene heater mode switch calculated are 36.9 μs (rise) and 103.4 μs (down), and that of 2 and 4 graphene heater mode switch calculated are 17.3 μs (rise) and 87.9 μs (down). The proposed model can be used in the field of low power consumption mode division and multiplexer of three-dimensional integrated.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于双垂直马赫-曾德尔干涉仪结构的聚合物热光模式开关，通过控制不同加热器的工作状态，可在E00、E01、E10和E11四种模式间实现快速切换。研究中对比了金属顶电极与石墨烯电极两种设计方案，并采用有限元法对石墨烯电极器件进行参数仿真。结果表明，1号和3号加热器的功耗为1.72 mW，2号和4号加热器的功耗为1.85 mW。在响应速度方面，1号和3号石墨烯加热器模式开关的上升时间为36.9 μs、下降时间为103.4 μs，而2号和4号石墨烯加热器模式开关的上升时间为17.3 μs、下降时间为87.9 μs。该器件模型可应用于三维集成光路中的低功耗模式复用与解复用领域。
title: Low Power Consumption Mode Switch Based on Three-Dimensional Polymer Mach-Zehnder Interferometer

summary_zh: 本研究针对我国广泛使用的杀菌剂多菌灵（Carbendazim）在植物性食品中的时空分布特征及其膳食暴露风险进行了系统评估。通过对2011至2020年间中国植物性食品的监测数据分析发现，多菌灵在水果中的检出频率较高（26.4%），而在蔬菜中的残留浓度显著，最高可达约110 mg/kg，反映出该杀菌剂存在滥用现象。风险评估结果显示，摄入特定蔬菜和谷物的急性风险分别超过了建议限值的12倍和5倍。尽管自2015年中国实施农药使用量零增长行动计划以来，食品中多菌灵的残留水平呈下降趋势，但部分省份在多种食品类别中仍表现出高水平残留，且残留量与当地农药年施用量呈正相关。研究指出，多菌灵污染问题折射出我国农药使用管理的深层挑战，亟需通过更有针对性的国家政策来降低食品中的残留水平。此外，鉴于农药滥用具有普遍性，研究建议应重新评估多菌灵的最大残留限量（MRL），特别是针对谷物等高消费食品类别。
title: Carbendazim residue in plant-based foods in China: Consecutive surveys from 2011 to 2020

summary_zh: 本研究首次提出利用褶皱石墨烯表面作为细胞培养的拓扑结构基底，并证明通过调控褶皱形貌可显著改变细胞的排列取向与形态。该方法将氧化石墨烯湿法沉积于预拉伸弹性体上，随后释放应力并辅以温和热处理，使薄膜在细胞培养基中保持稳定。所得多层氧化石墨烯薄膜形成周期性分层屈曲结构，其波长与振幅可通过改变湿法沉积工艺参数实现系统调控。人源及鼠源成纤维细胞在该拓扑薄膜上能够良好贴附并保持活性，同时相较于平面石墨烯对照组，细胞表现出显著的定向排列与伸长形态。与传统纳米光栅的刻蚀图案化方法相比，本策略在制备简便性和可扩展性方面具有明显优势，并且为将拓扑线索与石墨烯材料独特的导电性、吸附性或阻隔性能相结合、开发功能性生物医学器件提供了新的可能。
title: Wrinkled, wavelength-tunable graphene-based surface topographies for directing cell alignment and morphology

summary_zh: 边缘计算通过将计算与存储资源部署在网络边缘，显著降低了端到端延迟及骨干网的数据传输量，改变了传统云计算的架构。然而，由于单个边缘节点资源有限，分布式应用通常需要将其分解为多个相互依赖的任务，并分配至资源受限的分布式节点执行。由于涉及计算、存储与传输等多维资源的协同分配，且需兼顾任务间的依赖约束，如何实现高效的任务调度仍是一项挑战。若仅考虑单一优化因素，往往会导致任务分配不当，进而增加延迟并降低资源利用率。针对这一问题，本文构建了一个数学模型，旨在通过综合考虑多维资源可用性与任务间依赖关系，实现作业完成时间的最小化。通过优化软件在小规模拓扑下的验证，证明了该数学模型的正确性。针对大规模拓扑场景，本文通过缩小搜索空间设计了一种实用算法，并进行了复杂度分析。仿真结果表明，该算法的性能优于贪婪算法。最后，通过概念验证实验进一步证实了所提策略的可行性。
title: Leveraging joint allocation of multidimensional resources for distributed task assignment
venue: Journal of Optical Communications and Networking

summary_zh: 本研究探讨了机械应力在软骨老化及骨关节炎进展中的作用及其机制。通过体外实验、实验性骨关节炎小鼠模型及人骨关节炎软骨组织，检测了F-box/WD重复域蛋白7（FBXW7）泛素连接酶的表达与软骨细胞衰老的关系。研究构建了软骨细胞特异性Fbxw7基因敲除小鼠，并通过关节腔注射FBXW7腺相关病毒进行干预，采用内侧半月板失稳术诱导骨关节炎，以国际骨关节炎研究学会评分评估软骨损伤并检测软骨细胞衰老变化。结果显示，机械过载加速了培养软骨细胞和小鼠关节软骨的衰老。FBXW7在机械过载的原代软骨细胞和小鼠软骨中表达下调，且在骨关节炎患者、老龄小鼠及骨关节炎小鼠软骨中表达降低。软骨细胞中Fbxw7缺失可诱导软骨细胞衰老并加速软骨分解代谢，表现为p16INK4A、p21和Colx上调及Col2a1和ACAN下调，进而加剧骨关节炎；而关节腔注射FBXW7腺病毒则能缓解骨关节炎。机制上，机械过载降低Fbxw7 mRNA转录及FBXW7介导的MKK7降解，从而激活JNK信号通路。使用MKK7抑制剂DTP3抑制JNK活性可改善软骨细胞衰老和软骨退变。结论表明，FBXW7是机械过载与软骨细胞衰老及软骨老化在骨关节炎病理中关联的关键因子。
title: Mechanical overloading promotes chondrocyte senescence and osteoarthritis development through downregulating FBXW7

summary_zh: 我们提出 PepperPose，一种面向全身姿态估计的新型伴侣机器人系统，旨在以用户友好且不受位置限制的方式，准确捕捉多样化动作，从而服务于运动、健身和医疗健康等交互应用。与传统固定视角方法不同，PepperPose 通过主动跟踪用户并动态优化观测视角，显著提升了在不同位置和动作类型下的姿态估计精度，使用户获得自然流畅的动作感知体验。系统在类家居环境中对 30 名参与者进行了评估，覆盖日常功能动作和锻炼动作，结果表明该机器人具备良好的性能潜力。此外，我们还探讨了 PepperPose 在人机交互中的应用机遇、当前局限以及未来发展方向。
title: PepperPose: Full-Body Pose Estimation with a Companion Robot
venue: Proceedings of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems

abstract: Epigenetics is a versatile player in manipulating viral infection and a potential therapeutic target for the treatment of viral-induced diseases. Both epigenetics and metabolism are crucial in establishing a highly specific transcriptional network, which may promote or suppress virus infection. Human herpesvirus infection can induce a broad range of human malignancies and is largely dependent on the status of cellular epigenetics as well as its related metabolism. However, the crosstalk between epigenetics and metabolism during herpesvirus infection has not been fully explored. Here, we describe how epigenetic regulation of cellular metabolism affects herpesvirus infection and induces viral diseases. This further highlights the importance of epigenetics and metabolism during viral infection and provides novel insights into the development of targeted therapies.
summary_zh: 表观遗传在调控病毒感染中扮演多重角色，是治疗病毒性疾病的重要潜在靶点。表观遗传与代谢共同构建高度特异的转录调控网络，既可促进也可抑制病毒感染。人类疱疹病毒感染可诱发多种恶性肿瘤，其致病过程高度依赖宿主细胞的表观遗传状态及相关代谢活动。然而，疱疹病毒感染过程中表观遗传与代谢之间的交互调控机制尚未被充分阐明。本文系统阐述了细胞代谢的表观遗传调控如何影响疱疹病毒感染并诱导病毒相关疾病，进一步揭示了表观遗传与代谢在病毒感染中的关键作用，为开发靶向治疗策略提供了新的思路。
title: The Crosstalk of Epigenetics and Metabolism in Herpesvirus Infection

summary_zh: 本文报道了一种化学气相沉积方法，可控制备高质量二硒化铂纳米片，并系统研究了其厚度依赖的电子输运与磁输运特性。拉曼光谱分析表明，随着纳米片厚度增加，所有拉曼活性振动模式均发生红移。电学测量结果显示，厚度为1.7纳米的纳米片呈现半导体特性，室温场效应迁移率达66平方厘米每伏秒，开关比高达10的6次方；厚度在2.3至3.8纳米范围内的纳米片表现出微弱的栅压调控能力，室温场效应迁移率最高可达324平方厘米每伏秒；当厚度超过3.8纳米时，纳米片转变为金属性导电行为，电导率和击穿电流密度分别达到6.8×10的5次方西门子每米和6.9×10的7次方安培每平方厘米。磁阻研究进一步揭示，这一本征非磁性材料体系中存在磁有序现象，表现为厚度依赖的近藤效应，降温过程中同时出现金属-绝缘体转变和负磁阻。上述结果表明，二硒化铂在新型功能电子器件开发和二维磁性基础研究领域均具有重要价值。
title: Controlled Synthesis of Ultrathin PtSe2 Nanosheets with Thickness‐Tunable Electrical and Magnetoelectrical Properties

abstract: A unique belt-like one-dimensional Dy chain linked through hydroxyl groups was synthesized and structurally characterized. Magnetic studies showed that this Dy chain exhibited significant frequency-dependent ac behavior and clear hysteresis loop below 0.6 K.
summary_zh: 通过羟基桥联成功合成了一维带状镝链配合物，并对其进行了结构表征。该配合物呈现独特的链状拓扑结构，镝离子通过羟基氧原子桥连形成一维无限延伸的带状骨架。磁性测试结果表明，该镝链体系表现出显著的交流磁化率频率依赖行为，在零直流场下观察到明显的慢磁弛豫现象，其弛豫时间随温度降低而逐渐增大，符合单链磁体的典型特征。进一步低温磁测量显示，在0.6 K以下温度区间，该配合物展现出清晰的磁滞回线，表明体系在极低温条件下具有磁双稳态行为。这种由羟基桥连镝离子形成的一维链状结构为设计新型分子基磁性材料提供了有效策略，在单分子磁体和单链磁体领域具有潜在应用价值。
title: A belt-like one-dimensional Dy chain exhibiting slow magnetic relaxation behavior

abstract: To confront the energy consumption, high performance membrane materials are urgently needed. Carbon molecular sieve (CMS) membranes exhibit superior capability in separating gas mixtures efficiently. However, it remains a grand challenge to precisely tune the pore size and distribution of CMS membranes to further improve their molecular sieving properties. Herein, we report an approach of finely modulating CMS pore structure by using the reactive Al(CH3)3 to in situ defluorinate the polymer precursor to form Al-Fx(CH3)3-x in the polymer matrix, which is further converted to atomic-level Al2O3 and Al-F3 in the polymer matrix. These nanoparticles play the key role in regulating the pore size of CMS membranes by suppressing the formation of unfavorable large pores during pyrolysis, thus enhancing the gas selectivity considerably. The resultant CMS membranes demonstrate a H2/CH4 and CO2/CH4 selectivity of 192.6, and 58.4, respectively, 128% and 93% higher than the untreated samples, residing far above the latest upper bounds. Carbon molecular sieve (CMS) membranes efficiently separate gas mixtures tuning the pore size of CMS membranes remains challenging. Here, the authors report an approach to finely modulate CMS pore structure via reactive Al(CH3)3 to atomic-level Al2O3 and defluorinated the polymer precursor in situ to Al-F3 particles during pyrolysis.
title: Atomically distributed Al-F3 nanoparticles towards precisely modulating pore size of carbon membranes for gas separation

summary_zh: 未来传统或低自动化车辆将与网联自动驾驶车辆长期共享道路，这种混合交通流的复杂性可能给实时碰撞风险评估带来新的不确定性。本文针对混合交通流环境构建了若干特殊交通变量，并提出核逻辑回归模型用于实时碰撞风险评价。以上海南北高架路为原型，在SUMO中搭建城市快速路仿真走廊，采集混合交通流环境下的交通安全数据与交通数据（包括虚拟检测器数据和全球导航卫星系统数据）。利用仿真数据对核逻辑回归模型的预测性能进行测试分析，并与支持向量机模型进行对比。结果表明，核逻辑回归具有与支持向量机相当的预测能力。考虑到核逻辑回归可直接提供概率估计且能自然扩展至多类分类，在类似问题中应优先选用，尤其当碰撞风险被划分为多个等级时。因此，所提出的核逻辑回归模型值得推荐，具备在混合交通流环境中进行实时碰撞风险评估的潜力。
title: Crash risk analysis for the mixed traffic flow with human-driven and connected and autonomous vehicles
venue: 2021 IEEE International Intelligent Transportation Systems Conference (ITSC)

summary_zh: 本文构建了一种面向综合能源系统（IES）的多目标优化模型，其目标函数分别代表电力网络、天然气网络以及分布式区域供热供冷单元的利益，旨在协调各参与方的效益。为高效求解该多目标优化问题，提出一种改进的目标缩减方法，以获取最小目标集合。该方法基于自适应协方差与Lévy飞行多目标群搜索优化器所捕获的Pareto前沿，利用Spearman秩相关系数度量目标间关系，并采用多种策略逐步精简目标数量。在由改进的IEEE 30节点电力网络与15节点天然气网络构成的IES上开展仿真验证，结果表明，所提方法将原多目标优化问题转化为双目标形式，不仅提升了调度方案的整体质量，还减轻了决策负担。
title: Many-objective optimization for coordinated operation of integrated electricity and gas network
venue: Journal of Modern Power Systems and Clean Energy

summary_zh: 本文提出一种新型太阳能驱动界面蒸汽生成系统，旨在解决传统技术蒸发速率有限和蒸发器使用寿命不足的问题。该系统由全纤维多孔圆柱状泡沫三维蒸发器、侧面辅助蒸发方案以及具有聚集诱导发光特性的太阳能吸收剂组成。该吸收剂兼具高效光热转换与光动力抗菌双重功能，可谓一举两得。在侧面辅助蒸发结构配合下，系统在一个太阳辐照强度下实现了高达3.6 kg m⁻² h⁻¹的蒸发速率，显著提升了太阳能界面蒸发性能。同时，该吸收剂在光照下可高效产生活性氧物种，对纤维周围细菌产生强效光动力杀灭作用，有效防止生物污损，从而延长蒸发器的工作寿命。该研究为缓解水资源短缺提供了一种环保、低成本的可行方案，在海水淡化和废水处理等领域具有广阔应用前景。
title: Area‐Assisted 3D Evaporator with Antibiofouling Function for Ultra‐Efficient Solar Steam Generation

abstract: A promising approach to hedge against the inherent uncertainty of renewable generation is to equip the renewable plants with energy storage systems. This paper focuses on designing profit maximization offering strategies, i.e., the strategies that determine the offering price and volume, for a storage-assisted renewable power producer that participates in hour-ahead electricity market. Designing the strategies is challenging since (i) the underlying problem is coupled across time due to the evolution of the storage level, and (ii) inputs to the problem including the renewable output and market clearing price are unknown when submitting offers. Following the competitive online algorithm design approach, we first study a basic setting where the renewable output and the clearing price are known for the next hour. We propose sOffer, a simple online offering strategy that achieves the best possible competitive ratio of O(log θ), where $θ$ is the ratio between the maximum and the minimum clearing prices. Then, we consider the case where the clearing price is unknown. By exploiting the idea of submitting multiple offers to combat price uncertainty, we propose mOffer, and demonstrate that the competitive ratio of mOffer converges to that of sOffer as the number of offers grows. Finally, we extend our approach to the scenario where the renewable output has forecasting error. We propose gOffer as the generalized offering strategy and characterize its competitive ratio as a function of the forecasting error. Our trace-driven experiments demonstrate that our algorithms achieve performance close to the offline optimal and outperform a baseline alternative significantly.
title: Online Offering Strategies for Storage-Assisted Renewable Power Producer in Hour-Ahead Market

summary_zh: 受近期实验中电场调控磁性的丰富物理现象启发，本研究采用第一性原理计算，系统探究了全满d带非磁性金属中由电荷转移诱导的磁性行为。研究发现，所有全满d带非磁性金属在电场诱导电荷转移作用下均可发生铁磁相变。除铜和银中遵循常规洪德规则外，其他金属（尤其是钯）的电荷量与诱导磁化强度之间呈现出更为复杂的关联。这种反常电荷诱导磁化的根源在于特定电荷量下库仑相互作用引发的自旋简并不稳定性。此外，研究还揭示了一种显著的非平庸反常霍尔效应，其反常霍尔电导率的符号可随电荷数变化而改变，这一特性在未来自旋电子学应用中具有潜在价值。
title: Charge-induced ferromagnetic phase transition and anomalous Hall effect in full d -band nonmagnetic metals

summary_zh: 本文提出一种集成电子系统的软体仿生章鱼臂（E-SOAM），其设计灵感源于章鱼利用弯曲传播运动实现灵活捕食的生物机制。E-SOAM 采用弯曲-伸长传播模型，以少量控制输入实现大范围伸展、感知与抓取，运动方式简洁高效。其末端作为执行抓取的功能部件，集成了基于液态金属的可拉伸电子电路，能够承受 710% 单轴拉伸和 270% 双轴拉伸，在高度变形状态下仍可稳定处理弯曲、吸附和温度等多模态传感信息，从而在狭窄环境中自主完成任务。将传感末端与软体臂身结合后，E-SOAM 可完成伸展-抓取-收回的完整动作，工作范围可达原臂长的 1.5 倍，与生物章鱼臂性能相近。此外，通过一款可产生吸附触觉的可穿戴指套，操作者仅用单指即可远程交互控制机器人在空气和水下环境中的平面内与平面外运动。该成果不仅加深了对章鱼臂运动功能的理解，也为设计集成可拉伸电子的仿生自主系统提供了设计思路，这类系统能够与人类及环境进行交互。
title: Octopus-inspired sensorized soft arm for environmental interaction

abstract: We propose a method to study the secrecy constraints in key generation problems where side information might be present at untrusted users. Our method is inspired by a recent work of Hayashi and Tan who used the Rényi divergence as the secrecy measure to study the output statistics of applying hash functions to a random sequence. By generalizing the achievability result of Hayashi and Tan to the multi-terminal case, we obtain the output statistics of applying hash functions to multiple random sequences, which turn out to be an important tool in the achievability proof of strong secrecy capacity regions of key generation problems with side information at untrusted users. To illustrate the power of our method, we derive the capacity region of the multiple private key generation problem with an untrusted helper for continuous memoryless sources under Markov conditions. The converse proof of our result follows by generalizing a result of Nitinawarat and Narayan to the case with side information at untrusted users.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种研究密钥生成问题中保密约束的方法，重点针对非可信用户可能掌握边信息的场景。该方法受Hayashi与Tan近期工作的启发，他们以Rényi散度作为保密度量，分析了将哈希函数作用于随机序列时的输出统计特性。我们将Hayashi与Tan的可达性结果推广至多终端情形，得到了将哈希函数作用于多个随机序列时的输出统计特性，这一工具在证明非可信用户存在边信息时强保密容量区域的可达性中发挥关键作用。为展示方法的有效性，我们推导了马尔可夫条件下连续无记忆信源在非可信辅助者参与时的多私钥生成问题的容量区域。结果的逆命题证明则通过将Nitinawarat与Narayan的结论推广至非可信用户具有边信息的情形而完成。
title: Multiple Private Key Generation for Continuous Memoryless Sources With a Helper
venue: IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security

summary_zh: 本文提出一种全集成的降压型开关电容直流-直流转换器环形结构，包含123个相位，可为可穿戴设备微处理器实现快速动态电压调节。该对称多相转换器环以方形布局环绕负载，向芯片边缘任意位置均可方便接入的片上电网供电。压控振荡器的频率通过其电源电压VDD进行调节，使得单位增益频率可设计得高于开关频率。该转换器环采用低漏电65纳米CMOS工艺制造，实现了3纳秒的响应时间、2.5 V/μs的参考跟踪速度以及2.2毫伏的最小输出纹波。在功率密度为66.6 mW/mm²时，峰值效率达到80%，最大功率密度为180 mW/mm²。该设计适用于对动态电压调节速度和供电紧凑性要求较高的可穿戴设备微处理器电源管理场景。
title: A Multiphase Switched-Capacitor DC–DC Converter Ring With Fast Transient Response and Small Ripple

abstract: Deep oceans receive large amounts of complex organic carbon and anthropogenic pollutants. The deep-sea sediments of the continental slopes serve as the biggest carbon sink on Earth.
summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于厌氧微生物在烷烃、脂肪烃、单芳烃及卤代有机化合物降解过程中的“胞质分裂”（Yaplasmales）现象。通过对厌氧海洋沉积物进行深入分析，研究成功识别出了在该过程中发挥关键作用的古菌类群。这些古菌在海洋有机碳循环中扮演着至关重要的角色，对于理解全球海洋复杂有机碳的降解与回收机制具有重要的科学意义。
title: Genomic Evidence for the Recycling of Complex Organic Carbon by Novel Thermoplasmatota Clades in Deep-Sea Sediments

abstract: Abstract Estuaries represent an important link between the land and the ocean. Heterotrophic microorganisms in the estuary are fuelled by a composite pool of both recalcitrant terrestrial organic carbon (OC) transported by rivers and labile OC produced by aquatic phototrophs. Bathyarchaeota that are widely distributed in estuarine sediments have unique metabolic functions in carbon metabolism. However, their ecology and physiological capacities are not fully understood. In this study, we coupled taxonomic composition with comprehensive geochemical data to investigate the distribution and the OC utilization potential of Bathyarchaeota in the sediment of Pearl River Estuary (PRE). The subgroups of Bathy-6, Bathy-8, Bathy-15 and Bathy-17 dominated in all sediment samples. Different bathyarchaeotal subgroups occupied different niches along the salinity gradient in the PRE sediment. Seasonal variations of bathyarchaeotal subgroups presented in freshwater sediments are significantly positively correlated with ammonium. The abundance of Bathyarchaeota, such as Bathy-8, was significantly correlated with δ13C and fraction of terrestrially derived OC. These results indicated that Bathyarchaeota potentially utilized recalcitrant terrestrial OC in PRE sediments and may play an important role in the OC turnover in dynamic subtropical estuarine systems.
title: Niche specificity and potential terrestrial organic carbon utilization of benthic Bathyarchaeota in a eutrophic subtropic estuarine system

abstract: checkpoint that enforces suppressive activity and acts as a gatekeeper of GC entry.
summary_zh: 该研究识别出一种关键的检查点机制，该机制通过强化抑制性活动，在生发中心（GC）的进入过程中发挥着“守门员”的核心调控作用。研究表明，这一检查点能够有效管控细胞进入生发中心的过程，通过维持特定的抑制状态来确保免疫反应的精准性。这一发现为理解生发中心反应的启动与维持机制提供了重要依据，并为针对性调节免疫细胞进入生发中心的过程提供了潜在的干预靶点。
title: Control of Germinal Center Localization and Lineage Stability of Follicular Regulatory T Cells by the Blimp1 Transcription Factor

summary_zh: 本研究提出一种利用飞秒激光制备图案化超疏水/超亲水复合表面以提升表面增强拉曼散射传感性能的方法。通过调控超亲水图案的形状，可有效控制液滴蒸发过程及分析物沉积特性。实验发现，非圆形超亲水图案边缘处的不均匀蒸发能够促进分析物分子富集，从而显著增强拉曼信号；同时，图案中高度可辨识的尖角结构有助于在拉曼测试中快速定位富集区域。基于优化的三点星形超疏水/超亲水基底，仅需5微升R6G溶液即可实现低至10⁻¹⁵ M的检测极限，对应增强因子达9.73×10¹¹；在10⁻⁷ M浓度下，相对标准偏差为8.20%。该研究表明，具有设计图案的超疏水/超亲水表面在超痕量分子检测领域具有重要的实用价值。
title: Non-uniform droplet deposition on femtosecond laser patterned superhydrophobic/superhydrophilic SERS substrates for high-sensitive detection

summary_zh: 本文报道了一种由热电制冷器（TEC）驱动的新型双向光流体可调微透镜的设计与制备。研究采用高分辨率三维打印技术实现了光流体芯片真实三维结构的制造。利用热电制冷器的双向热学特性，通过可编程直流电源的控制，该器件能够实现膜片向上或向下两种形貌的调节。实验结果表明，随着电压从0.2 V增加至1.1 V，液体透镜的焦距从25 mm减小至5 mm；当电流方向反转时，焦距则在-25 mm至-5 mm之间变化。此外，研究通过COMSOL有限元仿真评估了器件内的温度分布，并深入探讨了热电制冷器在加热与制冷过程中的响应函数，同时对其成像特性进行了表征。该研究为开发高性能、可调焦的光流体光学器件提供了新的技术路径。
title: A Bidirectionally Focus-Tunable Optofluidic Microlens With Miniature Thermoelectric Coolers

summary_zh: 本研究合成了六种氘代愈创木烷衍生物及其前体，包括d5-2R-rotundol、d5-2S-rotundol、d5-bulnesone、d5-2R-bulnesol、d7-α-guaiene和d7-α-bulnesene，产率良好，用作气相色谱-质谱联用的内标物，以比较α-愈创木烯与α-布藜烯在自氧化条件下的行为差异。实验发现，涂布于滤纸并暴露于常温空气中的α-愈创木烯，48小时后约99%发生自氧化，期间生成高达7%的rotundone和0.6%的rotundols。相比之下，α-布藜烯的自氧化速度显著较慢，暴露2天后仍有约80%未反应，5天后生成的α-bulnesone不足1.5%，bulnesols 6a和6b的产率分别为0.3%和0.9%。这些结果表明，草药及其他植物材料暴露于空气时，其香气轮廓可能随时间发生快速变化，该发现对香料化学、食品风味及植物原料储存等领域具有参考价值。
title: Comparison of the Formation of Peppery and Woody Sesquiterpenes Derived from α-Guaiene and α-Bulnesene under Aerial Oxidative Conditions
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Food Chemistry

abstract: Sperm morphology is an important technique in identifying the health of sperms. In this paper we present a new system and novel approaches to classify different kinds of sperm images in order to assess their health. Our approach mainly relies on a one-dimensional feature which is extracted from the sperm's contour with gray level information. Our approach can handle rotation and scaling of the image. Moreover, it is fused with SVM classification to improve its accuracy. In our evaluation, our method has better performance than the existing approaches to sperm classification.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于一维特征与支持向量机融合的精子形态分类新方法，用于评估精子健康状况。该方法从精子轮廓中提取融合灰度信息的一维特征，具备旋转和尺度不变性，能有效应对图像旋转与缩放变化。将该特征与支持向量机分类器结合，可显著提升分类精度。实验评估表明，本方法在精子分类任务中优于现有方法，为精子健康自动识别提供了可靠的技术途径。
title: Computer-Assisted System with Multiple Feature Fused Support Vector Machine (SVM) for Sperm Morphology Diagnosis

abstract: The study on multiple scattering propagation of non-line-of-sight ultraviolet communication is based on the stochastic Monte Carlo method in the previous studies. In this letter, an integral model of two-order and three-order scattering is deduced in a narrow beam case. A prolate-spheroidal coordinates system and an isotropic scattering hypothesis are used to simplify the three-order scattering model. Compared with the Monte Carlo method, the computational efficiency and the stability of proposed model are much better and do not decrease with the increase of the communication range. This letter provides a new way to obtain the path loss of multiple scattering in long communication ranges.
summary_zh: 针对非视距紫外通信中的多重散射传播问题，本文提出了一种基于积分模型的分析方法，旨在解决以往研究中过度依赖随机蒙特卡洛模拟所带来的计算效率问题。研究重点针对窄波束场景，推导出了二阶与三阶散射的积分模型，并利用长椭球坐标系与各向同性散射假设对三阶散射模型进行了简化处理。仿真结果表明，与传统的蒙特卡洛方法相比，该积分模型在计算效率与数值稳定性方面表现更为出色，且其性能不会随通信距离的增加而下降。该研究为长距离通信条件下多重散射路径损耗的精确评估提供了一种高效的新途径。
title: An Integral Model of Two-Order and Three-Order Scattering for Non-Line-of-Sight Ultraviolet Communication in a Narrow Beam Case

summary_zh: 睡眠监测在医院及居家养老等场景中对于预防睡眠事故和评估睡眠健康至关重要。尽管基于摄像头的非接触式监测具有用户友好和视觉语义丰富等优势，但视频采集带来的隐私泄露风险限制了其广泛应用。本文提出了一种基于离焦摄像头的隐私保护睡眠参数测量框架，利用光学模糊图像无法进行人脸检测与识别的特性，从根本上解决了隐私问题。该框架包含生理测量分支和基于ResNet-18的语义分析分支，能够同时监测心率、呼吸频率、睡眠姿态及身体运动四项关键指标。实验结果表明，该方法在心率、呼吸频率和运动监测方面与参考值具有高度相关性，其中心率和呼吸频率的平均绝对误差分别为5.2 bpm和1.5 bpm，可靠估计覆盖率分别达到72.1%和93.6%，睡眠姿态检测的总体准确率达94.5%。研究证明，离焦摄像头在保障隐私的前提下，能够实现多维度的睡眠健康参数监测，在睡眠健康信息化领域具有广阔的应用前景。
title: Privacy-Protected Contactless Sleep Parameters Measurement Using a Defocused Camera
venue: IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics

abstract: A cost-effective, simple method is developed for m-BiVO 4 hierarchical spheres, which show a higher specific capacitance of 1203 F g −1 at 2 A g −1 , no detectable degradation after 2000 cycles, and beneficial cycling stability due to the unique porous hierarchical architecture.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种经济简便的合成方法，成功制备了单斜相钒酸铋（m-BiVO₄）多级结构微球。该材料凭借其独特的多孔分级结构，展现出优异的电化学储能性能：在2 A g⁻¹电流密度下，比电容高达1203 F g⁻¹，且经过2000次循环后未出现可检测的性能衰减，表现出卓越的循环稳定性。这一成果为高性能超级电容器电极材料的设计提供了新思路，在能量存储领域具有广阔的应用前景。
title: Fabrication of flower-like bismuth vanadate hierarchical spheres for an improved supercapacitor efficiency

abstract: Abstract This paper reports a novel thermal-visco-elasohydrodynamic lubrication (TVEHL) model for analyzing the lubrication behavior of the interface formed by an elastic sphere and a polymer half-space. The temperature-dependent viscoelastic displacement of the polymer surface is calculated through the elastic-viscoelastic correspondence theory and frequency-temperature superposition. The discrete convolution and fast Fourier transform (DC-FFT) algorithm is used for efficient solution computation. The model is verified by comparing results from its degenerated forms with those from thermal-viscoelastic (TVE) contact and thermal-elastohydrodynamic lubrication (TEHL) theories. The results from the current model with and without considering temperature effect are also compared. The new TVEHL model is explored to study the viscoelastic material property, entraining speed, sliding-to-rolling ratio, and the coupled thermal-viscoelasticity effects.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新型的热-粘弹性-流体动力润滑（TVEHL）模型，用于分析弹性球体与聚合物半空间接触界面的润滑行为。研究通过弹性-粘弹性对应原理及频率-温度叠加原理，计算了聚合物表面随温度变化的粘弹性位移，并采用离散卷积与快速傅里叶变换（DC-FFT）算法实现了高效的数值求解。通过将该模型退化为热-粘弹性接触模型及热弹性流体动力润滑模型，验证了新模型的准确性。对比分析表明，考虑温度效应对润滑行为具有显著影响。利用该TVEHL模型，本文深入探讨了粘弹性材料属性、卷入速度、滑动/滚动比以及热-粘弹性耦合效应对润滑性能的影响，为聚合物接触界面的润滑设计与材料特性研究提供了理论依据。
title: Modeling thermal-visco-elastohydrodynamic lubrication (TVEHL) interfaces of polymer-based materials

abstract: Abstract In this work, a 3D porous cellular NiCoO2/graphene (NC-GN) network is readily synthesized using a sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS)-templated strategy via filtration assembly of NiCoO2 precursor and partially reduced graphene oxide (rGO) nanosheets, freeze-casting, and thermal treatment processes. The 3D porous cellular NiCoO2/graphene (NC-GN) network demonstrates advantageous bifunctional electrocatalytic durability and activity toward oxygen evolution reaction (OER) and oxygen reduction reaction (ORR), owing to its fascinating 3D morphology, the high conductivity of graphene oxide (rGO) nanosheets, and catalytic active sites of NiCoO2 binary transition oxides. In comparison with the commercial OER electrocatalyst (IrO2) and ORR electrocatalyst (Pt/C), the 3D porous cellular NiCoO2/graphene (NC-GN) network exhibits superior OER catalytic performance with a satisfactory overpotential of 436 mV vs. RHE at 10 mA cm−2. Furthermore, the 3D porous NC-GN network displays a good ORR catalytic activity with an adequate half-wave potential of 665 mV vs. RHE. The cycling stability and limiting current density of the 3D porous NC-GN network towards OER and ORR are both better than the commercial IrO2 and Pt/C catalysts. The 3D porous cellular NiCoO2/graphene (NC-GN) network shows excellent potentials toward various energy conversion applications such as metal-air batteries, fuel cells, and water splitting.
title: 3D porous cellular NiCoO2/graphene network as a durable bifunctional electrocatalyst for oxygen evolution and reduction reactions

abstract: In this letter, we investigate the outage probability of a simultaneously transmitting and reflecting reconfigurable intelligent surface (STAR-RIS) assisted downlink non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) network over spatially correlated channels. To evaluate the impact of channel correlations on the system performance, we first approximate the distribution of the composite channel gain as a gamma random variable via a moment-matching approach and then derive new close-form outage probability expressions for a pair of NOMA users. Based on the approximate results, the diversity of each user is studied. Numerical results are provided to validate the effectiveness of the theoretical analysis and illustrate the performance loss due to channel correlations.
summary_zh: 本文研究了在空间相关信道环境下，由同时透射与反射可重构智能表面（STAR-RIS）辅助的下行非正交多址接入（NOMA）网络的中断概率问题。为了评估信道相关性对系统性能的影响，研究首先采用矩匹配方法将复合信道增益的分布近似为伽马随机变量，并据此推导出了针对一对NOMA用户的中断概率闭式表达式。在此基础上，本文进一步探讨了每个用户的分集增益特性。数值仿真结果验证了理论分析的有效性，并定量展示了信道相关性导致的性能损失。该研究为利用STAR-RIS提升NOMA网络覆盖范围及频谱效率提供了理论支撑。
title: Outage Probability Analysis of STAR-RIS Assisted NOMA Network With Correlated Channels

summary_zh: 脑电图（EEG）是评估麻醉剂对中枢神经系统影响的常用手段，但其信号极易受到伪影干扰。本文提出了一种基于脑电图变异性（EEGV）的新方法，并利用非线性模型分析EEGV以监测麻醉深度（DoA）。研究首先提取EEG连续局部极大值之间的时间间隔，通过重采样与微分处理重构EEGV时间序列，随后采用样本熵（SampEn）、排列熵（PeEn）、去趋势波动分析（DFA）及庞加莱图（PoP）进行特征分析。通过对比双频指数及专家标注数据，验证了所提指标与意识水平的相关性。此外，研究进一步利用长短期记忆网络（LSTM）融合多维特征以预测麻醉深度。对59名患者的实验结果表明，这四种指标能够有效区分清醒与无意识状态，并实时追踪麻醉状态的变化。其中，基于EEGV提取的SampEn、DFA和PoP在曲线下面积（AUC）及相关系数方面均显著优于传统原始EEG指标。研究证明，将EEG与EEGV特征融合可实现更精准的麻醉深度监测。本文首次通过非线性方法分析重构的EEGV信号而非传统原始EEG，为麻醉深度监测提供了一种更具鲁棒性的新途径。
title: Nonlinear Analysis of Electroencephalogram Variability as a Measure of the Depth of Anesthesia
venue: IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement

abstract: Spin waves, whose quanta are called magnons, are propagating excitations of magnetic materials. Magnonics is an emerging field of modern condensed matter physics that aims to study and utilize the properties and behaviors of magnons. The topological magnon band is an interesting topic of magnonics, and nontrivial topology is usually accompanied with many exotic phenomena such as emergence of robust edge states and the magnon Hall effect. In this Tutorial, using a honeycomb ferromagnet as a prototypical platform, we pedagogically demonstrate how to compute the magnon spectra and the topological invariants characterizing the topology of the magnon bands. We also briefly discuss some numerical techniques.
summary_zh: 自旋波是磁性材料中的传播激发，其量子称为磁振子。磁振子学是现代凝聚态物理的新兴领域，旨在研究并利用磁振子的性质与行为。拓扑磁振子能带是该领域的重要课题，非平庸拓扑常伴随鲁棒边缘态和磁振子霍尔效应等奇异现象。本教程以蜂窝铁磁体为典型平台，系统讲解如何计算磁振子谱以及表征磁振子能带拓扑性质的拓扑不变量，并简要介绍相关数值方法。
title: J. of Appl. Phys. 129

abstract: The impact of mother-infant microbiota on neurodevelopment is an area of interest, but longitudinal studies are scarce. Using a cohort of 520 families from the Jiangsu birth cohort in China, we reveal that the maternal gut microbiota during early pregnancy play a substantial role, accounting for 3.34% of the variance in offspring neurodevelopmental scores. This contribution is notably higher than the 1.24% attributed to the infants' own microbiota at 1 year of age, underscoring the significant influence of maternal gut health on early child development. Remarkably, an elevation in maternal Bifidobacterium pseudocatenulatum is linked to decreased cognitive scores, whereas an enrichment of Bifidobacterium longum at 1 year of age is associated with higher cognitive scores. Furthermore, we find that maternal B. pseudocatenulatum is linked to the heterolactic fermentation metabolic pathway, while infant B. longum is associated with the Bifidobacterium shunt pathway. In summary, our analysis implies that maternal and infant gut microbiota play a distinct role in neurodevelopment, suggesting potential strategies for improving neurodevelopmental outcomes during early pregnancy or infant development by targeting gut microbiota composition.
title: Varying Bifidobacterium species in the maternal-infant gut microbiota correlate with distinct early neurodevelopmental outcomes
venue: Journal of genetics and genomics/Journal of Genetics and Genomics

abstract: We study analytically topological properties of a noninteracting modified dimerized Kitaev chain and an exactly solvable interacting dimerized Kitaev chain under open boundary conditions by analyzing two introduced edge correlation functions. The interacting dimerized Kitaev chain at the symmetry point $\mathrm{\ensuremath{\Delta}}=t$ and the chemical potential $\ensuremath{\mu}=0$ can be exactly solved by applying two Jordan-Wigner transformations and a spin rotation, which permits us to calculate the edge correlation functions analytically. We demonstrate that the two edge correlation functions can be used to characterize the trivial, Su-Schrieffer-Heeger-like topological and topological superconductor phases of both the noninteracting and interacting systems and give their phase diagrams.
summary_zh: 我们通过解析方法研究了两种一维拓扑系统的边界性质：一种是无相互作用的修正二聚化Kitaev链，另一种是在开边界条件下可严格求解的相互作用二聚化Kitaev链。分析的核心工具是引入的两个边界关联函数。对于相互作用系统，在对称点Δ=t且化学势μ=0时，通过两次Jordan-Wigner变换和一次自旋转操作，模型可被严格对角化，从而使得边界关联函数能够被解析计算。研究表明，这两个边界关联函数能够清晰地区分和表征非相互作用与相互作用系统中的三种不同量子相：平庸相、类Su-Schrieffer-Heeger拓扑相以及拓扑超导相，并据此给出了完整的相图。该工作为理解相互作用拓扑系统中的边界态特征提供了可解析计算的诊断手段，对凝聚态物理中拓扑量子态的识别与分类具有参考价值。
title: Characterization of topological phases of dimerized Kitaev chain via edge correlation functions

summary_zh: 本研究探讨了光反馈对1.3微米量子点法布里-珀罗激光器静态与动态特性的影响，反馈强度范围为-40 dB至-8 dB。通过光谱和电谱分析，确定相干崩塌起始阈值为-14 dB。尽管在小信号调制下，超过该临界反馈水平后性能出现劣化，但在大信号调制条件下，激光器仍展现出更高的反馈容忍度。在10 Gb/s调制速率下，即使反馈强度达到-8 dB，眼图的形状和消光比均未出现明显退化。量子点激光器在大信号调制下的高反馈耐受性主要归因于增益压缩效应。这种高速抗反馈特性表明，量子点激光器是无隔离器光子集成电路中极具潜力的光源。
title: Analysis of the regimes of feedback effects in quantum dot laser
venue: Journal of Physics D: Applied Physics

abstract: In a human-robot coexisting environment, it is pivotal for a mobile service robot to arrive at the goal position safely and efficiently. In this article, an elastic band-based rapidly exploring random tree (EB-RRT) algorithm is proposed to achieve real-time optimal motion planning for the mobile robot in the dynamic environment, which can maintain a homotopy optimal trajectory based on current heuristic trajectory. Inspired by the EB method, we propose a hierarchical framework consisting of two planners. In the global planner, a time-based RRT algorithm is used to generate a feasible heuristic trajectory for a specific task in the dynamic environment. However, this heuristic trajectory is nonoptimal. In the dynamic replanner, the time-based nodes on the heuristic trajectory are updated due to the internal contraction force and the repulsive force from the obstacles. In this way, the heuristic trajectory is optimized continuously, and the final trajectory can be proved to be optimal in the homotopy class of the heuristic trajectory. Simulation experiments reveal that compared with two stateof-the-art algorithms, our proposed method can achieve better performance in dynamic environments.
title: EB-RRT: Optimal Motion Planning for Mobile Robots
venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering

summary_zh: 我们提出了一种面向天气短时临近预报的三维雷达序列预测框架，该框架由动态雷达表征方法 STC-GS 和高效精准的预测模型 GauMamba 组成。STC-GS 摒弃了传统四维高斯动态场景重建思路，转而针对每一帧独立优化三维场景，通过一组高斯体及其在连续帧间的运动关联，实现对每个高斯体在时间维度上的一致跟踪，从而为后续预测任务提供时序关联的高斯分组。在此基础上，GauMamba 将记忆机制融入 Mamba 架构，利用已建立的时序高斯分组学习其时间演化规律，能够高效处理大量高斯标记，兼顾计算效率与预测精度。实验表明，STC-GS 对三维雷达序列的表征空间分辨率相比现有三维表征方法提升超过 16 倍，而 GauMamba 在多种高动态天气条件的预报中均优于当前最优方法。该框架在灾害管理、交通调度和城市规划等领域具有重要应用价值。
title: High-Dynamic Radar Sequence Prediction for Weather Nowcasting Using Spatiotemporal Coherent Gaussian Representation

abstract: Biosensors based on carbon nanotube (CNT) thin-film transistors (TFTs) have outstanding potential for ultrasensitive and label-free DNA detection. However, at present, the sensing mechanisms of the all-carbon-nanotube biosensors with metallic CNTs as electrodes are still controversial. In this work, a platform is established for universal DNA detection. By analyzing the biosensor responses obtained by passivating the channel, electrodes and contact of the biosensors, respectively, the sensing mechanisms can be clearly investigated. It is found that the electrostatic gating is dominant, while the Schottky barrier modulation plays a relatively minor role, where the Schottky barrier height is co-modulated by the adsorbed DNA in the channel and electrodes.
summary_zh: 基于碳纳米管薄膜晶体管的生物传感器在超灵敏、无标记DNA检测方面展现出巨大潜力，但以金属性碳纳米管为电极的全碳管传感器的传感机制仍存在争议。本研究建立了一个通用DNA检测平台，通过对传感器沟道、电极及接触区域分别进行钝化处理并分析其响应，系统探究了传感机理。结果表明，静电栅控效应在传感中起主导作用，而肖特基势垒调制的作用相对次要，且肖特基势垒高度由沟道和电极上吸附的DNA共同调控。该工作为全碳纳米管生物传感器的设计优化提供了机制层面的指导，可应用于高灵敏度基因检测与分子诊断领域。
title: Mechanism Exploration of Enhanced Biosensing Performance for All-Carbon-Nanotube Thin-Film Transistors
venue: 2022 IEEE Nanotechnology Materials and Devices Conference (NMDC)

summary_zh: 本文研究失配逐次细化问题，即在二次失真测度下，采用高斯码本和逐次最小欧氏距离编码对任意无记忆信源进行压缩。我们分别在联合过量失真概率和分离过量失真概率准则下，推导了可达的精细渐近性能。针对二阶渐近和中偏差渐近，考虑了两种码本类型：球面码本，其每个码字独立均匀地取自球面；独立同分布高斯码本，其每个码字的各分量独立服从高斯分布。在联合过量失真概率下，建立了可达的二阶速率区域，并证明在分离过量失真概率下，任何满足温和矩条件的无记忆信源均具有强逐次可细化性。当信源特化为高斯无记忆信源时，所得结果给出了具有特定码本设计的另一种可达性证明。研究表明，在联合和分离过量失真概率准则下，相同的中偏差常数均可达到。对于大偏差渐近，仅考虑独立同分布高斯码本，因为在该机制下单层失配率失真问题中，此类码本性能优于球面码本。我们推导了联合和分离过量失真概率的可达指数，并将结果特化至高斯无记忆信源，这一结果具有独立的理论价值。
title: Achievable Refined Asymptotics for Successive Refinement Using Gaussian Codebooks

abstract: Mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) have emerged as a highly promising strategy in regenerative medicine due to their self-renewal, pluripotency and immunomodulatory properties. MSCs are nonhematopoietic, multipotent stem cells that can differentiate into various mesodermal lineages and modulate the immune system. The therapeutic potential of MSCs from different tissues has been widely explored in preclinical models and clinical trials for human diseases, ranging from autoimmune diseases and inflammatory disorders to neurodegenerative diseases and orthopedic injuries. The therapeutic effects of MSCs can be mediated through the release of bioactive molecules, including growth factors, cytokines, and extracellular vesicles, which play crucial roles in modulating the local cellular environment, promoting tissue repair, angiogenesis, and cell survival, and exerting anti-inflammatory effects. MSCs can also interact with various immune cells, such as T cells, B cells, dendritic cells, and macrophages, modulating the immune response through both direct cell‒cell interactions and the release of immunoregulatory molecules. This review delves into the molecular mechanisms, signaling pathways, and regulatory factors that underpin the therapeutic effects of MSCs. This review also highlights the clinical applications and challenges associated with the use of MSC-based drugs to promote the safety and efficacy of MSC-based therapies. Overall, this comprehensive review provides valuable insights into the current state of MSC research and its potential for transforming the field of regenerative medicine as well as immune-mediated inflammatory diseases.
title: Mesenchymal stem cells in treating human diseases: molecular mechanisms and clinical studies

abstract: The meta-heuristic algorithm is a global probabilistic search algorithm for the iterative solution. It has good performance in global optimization fields such as maximization. In this paper, a new adaptive parameter strategy and a parallel communication strategy are proposed to further improve the Cuckoo Search (CS) algorithm. This strategy greatly improves the convergence speed and accuracy of the algorithm and strengthens the algorithm’s ability to jump out of the local optimal. This paper compares the optimization performance of Parallel Adaptive Cuckoo Search (PACS) with CS, Parallel Cuckoo Search (PCS), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Sine Cosine Algorithm (SCA), Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO), Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA), Differential Evolution (DE) and Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) algorithms by using the CEC-2013 test function. The results show that PACS algorithm outperforms other algorithms in 20 of 28 test functions. Due to the superior performance of PACS algorithm, this paper uses it to solve the problem of the rectangular layout. Experimental results show that this scheme has a significant effect, and the material utilization rate is improved from 89.5% to 97.8% after optimization.
title: Application of a Parallel Adaptive Cuckoo Search Algorithm in the Rectangle Layout Problem

summary_zh: 本文提出了一种利用非对称寄生元件设计滤波偶极子天线的创新方案。传统滤波偶极子天线通常通过寄生元件产生单个反射系数零点和辐射零点，或利用寄生元件的高阶模来增加零点数量。不同于现有技术，本文提出的方案首次实现了仅通过单个简单的寄生元件，即可同时引入两个反射系数零点和两个辐射零点。理论证明，通过寄生元件与奇模及偶模之间的电磁耦合，可以在低频和高频阻带处分别引入辐射零点。该设计为滤波天线的设计提供了更大的自由度，具有结构简单且尺寸紧凑的优势。为验证该设计思路，本文设计并制作了一款体积小于0.24×0.24×0.25λ₀³的双极化天线，适用于基站应用场景。实测结果与仿真结果高度一致，证明了该方案的有效性。
title: Compact Dual-Polarized Filtering Dipole Antenna by Using Asymmetric Parasitic Element
venue: IEEE Transactions on Antennas and Propagation

summary_zh: 本文提出一种边缘引导的表示学习网络ERL-Net，旨在解决水下目标检测中低对比度、小目标及生物拟态等核心难题。该方法基于水下目标边缘具有高度独特性的观察，通过边缘线索引导判别性特征的提取与聚合。具体而言，首先设计边缘引导注意力模块，对显式边界信息进行建模，从而生成更具判别力的特征表示；其次构建层次化特征聚合模块，将多尺度判别特征重组为三个层级，有效融合全局与局部信息以提升目标定位与识别能力；最后引入宽非对称感受野模块，扩展特征感受野，增强模型对小目标信息的关注。在三个具有挑战性的水下数据集上的综合实验表明，ERL-Net在水下目标检测任务中取得了优越性能，可广泛应用于海洋经济开发、环境保护及可持续发展等领域。
title: Edge‐guided representation learning for underwater object detection

summary_zh: 量子系统对各类噪声高度敏感，因而其工程实现极为困难。其中，含时噪声在实验中频繁出现，但如何有效克服这类噪声仍是一个具有挑战性的难题。本文基于在滤波函数框架下工作的逆向几何优化方法，提出了一种灵活的鲁棒控制技术来抵御含时噪声。其核心思想是对控制滤波函数进行几何参数化，并最小化该函数与噪声谱密度的重叠程度，从而有效降低受控系统演化对噪声的敏感性。研究表明，该方法能够在真实噪声模型下生成高质量的鲁棒脉冲，以实现预期的量子演化。此外，本文在动力学解耦和量子传感协议等实例中验证了该方法，展示了其对系统性能的显著提升效果。
title: Quantum control for time-dependent noise by inverse geometric optimization

abstract: Most current domain adaptation methods for fault diagnosis focus on single target domain. However, test data often comes from multiple target domains, as machines work under different operating conditions, subsequently generating a more complex and extensive distribution of target data. Unfortunately, single target domain adaptation methods are not adaptive for multiple target domains adaptation (MTDA), which results in transfer performance degradation. To this end, a novel disentanglement learning with adaptive centroid alignment is proposed for MTDA. Specifically for disentanglement learning, two encoders and two classifiers are constructed independently for fault-related and domain-related feature extractions and classifications. Followed by the dual-adversarial strategy, only fault-related but domain-irrelevant features are extracted. Furthermore, to achieve the category alignment, we also propose an adaptive centroid alignment strategy, so that the feature centroids of the same fault category in different domains are enforced to be close to each other. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our proposed method compared with other popular approaches.
title: Disentanglement Learning With Adaptive Centroid Alignment for Multiple Target Domains Fault Diagnosis

summary_zh: 本文分析了烟花算法在决策空间或目标空间存在最优解偏移问题上的求解性能。标准基准测试问题在群智能算法研究中存在若干不足，例如最优解位于搜索范围中心且各维度取值相同，而决策空间或目标空间的最优解偏移会显著增加问题求解难度。原始烟花算法采用模运算映射策略处理超出搜索范围的解，该策略在对称搜索范围问题上会隐式地将解引导至搜索范围中心，从而可能影响算法在偏移函数上的优化表现。本文对比了四种映射策略，包括模运算映射、边界映射、随机区域映射和有限随机区域映射，在不同维度和不同最优解偏移范围的问题上进行了实验。结果表明，采用边界映射或有限随机区域映射的烟花算法在最优解偏移问题上表现良好，原因可能在于这两种策略能够保持算法的搜索趋势。此外，本文还提出了种群多样性度量定义，通过观察种群多样性的变化，可获取烟花算法求解不同类型问题时的有用信息。
title: Analytics on Fireworks Algorithm Solving Problems with Shifts in the Decision Space and Objective Space
venue: International Journal of Swarm Intelligence Research

summary_zh: 电化学生物传感器在通过非侵入性汗液分析监测人体生理动态方面展现出巨大潜力，但在柔性平台上实现多路传感器的高可控性、高重复性以及长期可靠集成仍面临挑战。本文首次报道了一种通过全喷墨打印技术集成的多路生物传感贴片，该贴片具有极高的稳定性和灵敏度。通过优化墨水配方与液滴辅助打印工艺，研究人员实现了对活性物质负载量的精确控制，并利用独特的互穿界面设计赋予了传感器优异的性能。实验结果显示，该传感器对葡萄糖和酒精的灵敏度分别达到313.28 µA m⁻¹ cm⁻²和0.87 µA m⁻¹ cm⁻²，且在30小时内表现出极小的漂移，性能处于文献报道的领先水平。该集成贴片可通过表皮分析实现可靠的无线饮食监测或医疗干预，为智能医疗领域的穿戴式设备开发提供了新的思路。
title: Ultra‐Sensitive and Stable Multiplexed Biosensors Array in Fully Printed and Integrated Platforms for Reliable Perspiration Analysis

abstract: The graph representation of complex materials plays a crucial role in the field of inorganic and organic materials investigations for developing data-centric materials science, such as those using graph neural networks (GNNs). However, the currently prevalent GNN models are primarily employed for investigating periodic crystals and organic small molecule data, yet they still encounter challenges in terms of interpretability and computational efficiency when applied to polymer monomers and organic macromolecules data. There is still a lack of graph representation of organic polymers and macromolecules specifically tailored for GNN models to explore the structural characteristics. The Polymer-unit Graph, a novel coarse-grained graph representation method introduced in study, is dedicated to expressing and analyzing polymers and macromolecules. By incorporating the Polymer-unit Graph into the GNN models and analyzing the organic semiconductor (OSC) materials database, it becomes possible to uncover intricate structure–property relationships involving branched-chain engineering, fluoridation substitution, and donor–acceptor combination effects on the elementary structure of OSC polymers. Furthermore, the Polymer-unit Graph enables visualizing the relationship between target properties and polymer units while reducing training time by an impressive 98% and minimizing molecular graph representation models. In conclusion, the Polymer-unit Graph successfully integrates the concept of Polymer-unit into the field of GNNs, enabling more accurate analysis and understanding of organic polymers and macromolecules.
title: Polymer-Unit Graph: Advancing Interpretability in Graph Neural Network Machine Learning for Organic Polymer Semiconductor Materials
venue: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation

abstract: Liquid metals are a class of metals that are ﬂuids at room tem-perature. They have surface tension, that is approximately an order of magnitude higher than that of water, owing to the high surface energy of metals. The ultra-high surface tension creates a stream of liquid metal droplets to minimize surface energy, and therefore, creating other shapes is difﬁcult. Enormous efforts have been made to manipulate liquid metals into various shapes and patterns, and are driven by emerging opportunities for soft, stretchable and reconﬁgurable electronic and electromagnetic devices to form liquid is onto a injected into and liquid droplets are stacked into 3D architectures To the printing of liquid metal, it is either enveloped by a viscous sheath ﬂuid or formulated into pastes by adding large amounts of nanoparticles
title: Turning liquid metals into elastic ropes

abstract: Hierarchical functional data are widely seen in complex studies where sub-units are nested within units, which in turn are nested within treatment groups. We propose a general framework of functional mixed effects model for such data: within unit and within sub-unit variations are modeled through two separate sets of principal components; the sub-unit level functions are allowed to be correlated. Penalized splines are used to model both the mean functions and the principal components functions, where roughness penalties are used to regularize the spline fit. An EM algorithm is developed to fit the model, while the specific covariance structure of the model is utilized for computational efficiency to avoid storage and inversion of large matrices. Our dimension reduction with principal components provides an effective solution to the difficult tasks of modeling the covariance kernel of a random function and modeling the correlation between functions. The proposed methodology is illustrated using simulations and an empirical data set from a colon carcinogenesis study. Supplemental materials are available online.
title: Reduced Rank Mixed Effects Models for Spatially Correlated Hierarchical Functional Data
venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association

summary_zh: 本研究将两种合成路线较短的给体聚合物相结合，制备了兼具高效率与优良综合性能的三元有机太阳能电池。通过系统表征发现，三元共混薄膜的最优形貌源于PTQ10与PTVT-T之间的耦合与竞争：PTQ10原有的分子堆积和相分离模式被打破，同时PTVT-T的强聚集倾向受到抑制，从而实现了高效的电荷传输与收集，并有效抑制了双分子复合。在此基础上，采用先前报道的溶剂蒸气辅助成膜方法作为理解导向的优化手段，将最优体系的效率进一步提升至19.11%。此外，得益于稳定的聚合物基体，含PTVT-T的体系在光浸泡和热稳定性方面均明显优于PTQ10二元对照体系。该工作通过三元策略的形貌调控，为基于先进给体/受体体系开发高效、稳定且低成本的有机太阳能电池提供了有效途径。
title: High-Efficiency Ternary Organic Solar Cells with a Good Figure-of-Merit Enabled by Two Low-Cost Donor Polymers

summary_zh: 本文开发了一种基于均相反应的快速配体交换法，利用原儿茶酸将高质量疏水磁性氧化铁纳米晶转化为水溶性纳米颗粒。研究表明，经过配体交换后的纳米颗粒在保持高结晶度和高饱和磁化强度的同时，展现出卓越的水稳定性，且细胞实验证实其具有良好的生物相容性。在MRI仿体实验中，粒径为12 nm的磁性氧化铁纳米颗粒凭借14 nm的较小水动力学直径，实现了17.8 mM⁻¹ s⁻¹的高T1弛豫率；同时，其77.8 emu g⁻¹的高饱和磁化强度使其具备220 mM⁻¹ s⁻¹的高T2弛豫率。体内磁共振成像实验进一步证实，该纳米颗粒是优异的T1和T2双模对比剂。此外，该高质量纳米颗粒在交变磁场下表现出出色的磁热效应。凭借多模态成像与磁热疗的双重功能，该纳米颗粒可作为单组分多功能剂，广泛应用于癌症诊断与治疗等生物医学领域。
title: Developing Fe3O4 nanoparticles into an efficient multimodality imaging and therapeutic probe

abstract: The current Internet architecture was founded upon a host-centric communication model, which was appropriate for coping with the needs of the early Internet users. Internet usage has evolved however, with most users mainly interested in accessing (vast amounts of) information, irrespective of its physical location. This paradigm shift in the usage model of the Internet, along with the pressing needs for, among others, better security and mobility support, has led researchers into considering a radical change to the Internet architecture. In this direction, we have witnessed many research efforts investigating Information-Centric Networking (ICN) as a foundation upon which the Future Internet can be built. Our main aims in this survey are: (a) to identify the core functionalities of ICN architectures, (b) to describe the key ICN proposals in a tutorial manner, highlighting the similarities and differences among them with respect to those core functionalities, and (c) to identify the key weaknesses of ICN proposals and to outline the main unresolved research challenges in this area of networking research.
summary_zh: 现有互联网架构基于以主机为中心的通信模型，适用于早期用户需求，但随着用户主要关注信息获取而不再关心物理位置，使用模式已发生根本转变。这一变化以及对更高安全性和移动支持等迫切需求，促使研究者探索以信息为中心的网络（ICN）作为未来互联网的基础。本综述旨在系统梳理ICN架构的核心功能，以教学式方法阐述主要ICN方案，围绕核心功能对比其异同，并指出当前方案的关键不足与尚未解决的研究挑战。
title: A Survey of Information-Centric Networking Research

abstract: We disclose the first catalytic activation of carbohydrates as formaldehyde equivalents to generate acyl anions as one-carbon nucleophilic units for a Stetter reaction. The activation involves N-heterocyclic carbene (NHC)-catalyzed C-C bond cleavage of carbohydrates via a retro-benzoin-type process to generate the acyl anion intermediates. This Stetter reaction constitutes the first success in generating formal formaldehyde-derived acyl anions as one-carbon nucleophiles for non-self-benzoin processes. The renewable nature of carbohydrates, accessible from biomass, further highlights the practical potential of this fundamentally interesting catalytic activation.
summary_zh: 本文首次报道了以碳水化合物作为甲醛等价物的催化活化策略，通过生成酰基负离子作为单碳亲核单元参与Stetter反应。该活化过程利用氮杂环卡宾（NHC）催化，通过逆安息香型断裂机制实现碳水化合物中碳-碳键的选择性断裂，从而生成酰基负离子中间体。这一Stetter反应首次成功实现了由甲醛形式衍生的酰基负离子作为单碳亲核试剂参与非自身安息香缩合过程，突破了传统甲醛等价物在极性反转反应中的应用局限。碳水化合物可从生物质中获取，其可再生特性进一步凸显了这一催化活化方法在基础研究与应用开发中的重要潜力。
title: Catalytic Activation of Carbohydrates as Formaldehyde Equivalents for Stetter Reaction with Enones
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

summary_zh: 针对分布式光伏大规模接入配电网引发的电压稳定问题，本文提出一种利用光伏逆变器无功调节能力的分布式电压控制方法。该方法无需依赖中央协调单元，且具备理论性能保证。核心挑战在于潮流方程所定义的非凸约束集。为此，我们首先分析简化线性网络模型下的问题结构，据此设计分布式控制方案。进而构建分析框架，证明所提方案在非凸支路潮流模型下能以几何速率收敛至局部最优解，并对收敛过程中的系统误差进行了定量刻画。仿真结果验证了方案的有效性。该研究为高比例光伏配电网的电压自治调控提供了理论支撑。
title: Distributed voltage regulation in distribution power grids: Utilizing the photovoltaics inverters

summary_zh: 本文提出了一种改进的视觉地点识别特征聚合方法 SuperVLAD，旨在解决传统 VLAD 类方法（如 NetVLAD）因聚类中心数量多导致特征维度过高、且训练与推理域不匹配时性能下降的问题。SuperVLAD 的核心创新在于去除聚类中心依赖，仅保留极少量聚类（例如 4 个），从而简化网络结构并增强跨域泛化能力。在此基础上，通过引入不参与最终输出的幽灵聚类，进一步设计了极低维的 1-Cluster VLAD 描述子，其维度与 GeM 池化输出相当，但识别性能显著更优。实验表明，结合 Transformer 骨干网络时，SuperVLAD 以远少于 NetVLAD 的参数量实现了更优的域泛化效果；在多个基准数据集上，该方法以更低特征维度超越了现有最优方法。该技术可广泛应用于增强现实、机器人定位等需要鲁棒视觉地点识别的场景。
title: SuperVLAD: Compact and Robust Image Descriptors for Visual Place Recognition
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 37

summary_zh: 本研究评估了荷兰入侵蚊种亚洲丛林伊蚊对寨卡病毒和乌苏图病毒的媒介能力。该蚊种自2013年在莱利斯塔德建立稳定种群后持续扩散。通过实验室感染实验，野外采集的雌蚊经液滴饲喂法分别摄入含寨卡病毒或乌苏图病毒的感染性血液，在28°C条件下饲养14天后，唾液病毒检出率分别为3%和13%，证实该蚊种具备传播两种病毒的能力。为探究中肠屏障对病毒传播的影响，采用胸腔注射法直接接种病毒，相同饲养条件下唾液阳性率显著提升至96%（寨卡病毒）和88%（乌苏图病毒），表明两种病毒均能在蚊体内高效复制，但中肠屏障严重制约病毒扩散。小RNA深度测序进一步证实口服感染蚊虫体内存在活跃的病毒复制过程，表现为针对两种病毒的强效小干扰RNA应答，同时通过从头组装发现该蚊种携带一种新型裸露病毒。鉴于亚洲丛林伊蚊在实验条件下可传播寨卡病毒和乌苏图病毒等虫媒病毒，且其分布范围持续扩张，应将该蚊种视为欧洲虫媒病毒病的潜在传播媒介。
title: The invasive Asian bush mosquito Aedes japonicus found in the Netherlands can experimentally transmit Zika virus and Usutu virus

summary_zh: 基于2005年和2012年采集的43个水样实测数据，本研究系统分析了西藏玛旁雍错流域湖水与入湖河流水化学的时空格局及其控制因素。结果表明，该流域水体呈弱碱性，pH值介于7.4至7.9之间；湖水和河水的溶解性总固体均值分别约为325.4 mg/l和88.7 mg/l，低于青藏高原多数地表水体。受长期蒸发结晶作用影响，湖水中Na⁺和HCO₃⁻占主导，分别占阳离子总量的46.8%和阴离子总量的86.8%；而入湖河流则以Ca²⁺和HCO₃⁻为主，占比分别为59.6%和75.4%。由于大型湖泊水体交换不充分，离子组成呈现显著空间差异：湖泊北侧有多条较大入湖河流，其离子浓度明显高于其他区域，河水TDS分别达468.9 mg/l和254.9 mg/l。受复杂环境影响，河流水化学空间变异更为突出，上游离子含量普遍较高。(Ca²⁺+Mg²⁺)与(Na⁺+K⁺)的摩尔比值远大于1.0，揭示水体离子主要来源于碳酸盐岩风化。尽管岩石风化等自然过程是控制流域主量离子化学的主导因素，但未来需更多关注人类活动对水环境的影响。
title: Spatial-temporal patterns of major ion chemistry and its controlling factors in the Manasarovar Basin, Tibet

summary_zh: 针对心肌细胞固有的力学敏感性，现有生物电子器件通常具有兆帕级模量，与天然组织存在显著力学失配。本文提出一种可拉伸超薄层状传感电子平台PULSE，其模量约10千帕，与心肌组织相匹配，并集成可拉伸金微电路，用于体外心脏电生理的长期高保真监测。该器件由软凝胶基质与嵌入金电路的纳米薄膜构成，实现了前所未有的组织融合度，并完整保留了心肌细胞的自然力学特性。与传统电子器件相比，PULSE使心肌组织的机械收缩幅度提升140%，电信号强度提升100%。在PULSE上培养的心肌组织表现出增强的药物敏感性与功能障碍响应，为疾病建模带来突破。通过在组织-电子界面实现无缝交互，该平台为推进心脏建模及下一代生物电子应用提供了变革性视角。
title: Ultrapliable bioelectronic interface for mechanosensitive cardiac electrophysiology

summary_zh: Y染色体微缺失（YCM）是导致男性非梗阻性无精症（NOA）的关键遗传因素。传统检测方法多采用多重PCR技术通过追踪序列标签位点（STS）进行识别，但分辨率有限。本研究开发了一种全新的高通量测序方法，通过并行测序分布于男性特异性Y染色体（MSY）全长范围内的1,787个STS，旨在发现已知及新型的YCM。通过对766名中国NOA患者与683名健康对照者的临床验证，研究共检测到481个和98个缺失的STS，其中包含大量显著影响精子发生基因功能的新型YCM。研究结果显示，NOA患者携带的缺失数量更多且类型更罕见，且这些缺失在基因内区域显著富集。此外，单倍型分析表明，O2*单倍型对NOA具有保护作用，而C单倍型中则观察到b1/b3缺失的富集现象。本研究为Y染色体缺失提供了高分辨率的遗传图谱，为NOA的遗传机制研究提供了重要参考。
title: Novel Y-chromosomal microdeletions associated with non-obstructive azoospermia uncovered by high throughput sequencing of sequence-tagged sites (STSs)

summary_zh: 双目立体视觉系统在科研与工程应用中日益重要，但在恶劣工况下相机不可避免的微小运动将严重影响三维测量精度。本文聚焦相机运动对立体视觉三维测量的影响，将相机运动划分为四类：同向平移、同向旋转、相对平移和相对旋转，并建立了三维坐标与距离测量的误差模型。实验验证了数学模型的有效性。结果表明：同向平移引起的三维坐标误差随两相机位置变化线性增大，但距离测量不受影响；同向旋转仅在旋转平面内引入坐标误差，在10°范围内与旋转角成正比，距离误差为零；相对平移时，坐标与距离误差均随相对位置变化线性增长；相对旋转引起的坐标误差与旋转角呈类正弦余弦曲线的非线性关系，且对距离测量精度的影响并非单调变化。相对旋转是影响精度的主要因素，即使仅发生10°旋转，最大坐标误差可达2000 mm，距离误差高达220%。本文结果可作为减少测量误差的实践指南。
title: Study of the error caused by camera movement for the stereo-vision system

summary_zh: 本研究报道了一种违反洪德规则、具有负单重态-三重态能隙的荧光分子，其能隙值为-11±2 meV。传统洪德规则预测分子激发态中自旋单重态能量应高于自旋三重态，这一规律在近一个世纪的实验观测中得到广泛验证。然而，该分子实现了单重态与三重态激发态的能量反转，导致最低能量激发态呈现单重态特征，从而产生延迟荧光，时间常数仅为0.2微秒。反常的是，随着温度降低，该延迟荧光的时间常数进一步缩短，这与常规热激活延迟荧光的行为截然相反。基于该分子制备的有机发光二极管展现出快速瞬态电致发光衰减特性，峰值外量子效率达到17%。这一发现为有机光电器件领域提供了新的材料设计思路，在显示、照明和激光等应用中具有重要潜力。
title: Delayed fluorescence from inverted singlet and triplet excited states

abstract: Abstract Modulation bandwidth and energy efficiency of metallic cavity nanolasers are studied in both small signal and digital modulation formats. Special emphasis is placed on the effects of noise on data rate and energy efficiency. It is found that the data rate for nanolasers of small sizes is severely limited by noise‐induced bit‐error rate. The trade‐off between size‐reduction and noise effects leads to an optimal cavity size to achieve the highest data rate. The energy data‐rate ratio decreases in general with device size, but starts to increase in ultrasmall devices, due to increased threshold current and noise effects. However, relatively high modulation rate and energy efficiency can be achieved in metallic cavity nanolasers. Calculations show that a low energy consumption of 30 fJ/bit at a high data rate of 120 Gbit/s can be realized in nanolasers as small as V = 16 ( λ / n r ) 3 ( V is the laser cavity volume). Ultralow energy consumption per bit (<10 fJ/bit) does require smaller devices ( V <2.1 ( λ / n r ) 3 ), while the noise limits the data rate to below 50 Gbit/s. Such a balanced and holistic consideration between device size, data rate, noise effects, and energy efficiency offers new perspectives to nanolaser design strategy for future onchip integrated nanophotonics systems. image
title: Modulation bandwidth and energy efficiency of metallic cavity semiconductor nanolasers with inclusion of noise effects

summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种低成本、高可靠性的智能隐形眼镜石墨烯光栅制备方法。针对目前智能隐形眼镜因制造工艺昂贵而难以商业化的瓶颈，我们采用Nd:YAG激光直接干涉图案化技术，在商用隐形眼镜表面的石墨烯薄膜上加工微纳结构。系统考察了薄膜厚度与干涉角度对图案质量的影响，通过光学表征与仿真评估了周期为0.92至3.04微米的光栅结构，并利用二次激光干涉成功制备了二维图案。考虑到智能隐形眼镜的实际使用环境，测试了不同干涉角度下样品的接触角。采用四探针法评估导电性能，最优样品的方阻低于30 Ω/sq。该研究验证了激光烧蚀法图案化石墨烯的可行性，为可控成本下制造智能隐形眼镜提供了一种候选方案。
title: Cost-Efficient Printing of Graphene Nanostructures on Smart Contact Lenses

abstract: Secure password storage is a vital aspect in systems based on password authentication, which is still the most widely used authentication technique, despite some security flaws. In this paper, we propose a password authentication framework that is designed for secure password storage and could be easily integrated into existing authentication systems. In our framework, first, the received plain password from a client is hashed through a cryptographic hash function (e.g., SHA-256). Then, the hashed password is converted into a negative password. Finally, the negative password is encrypted into an encrypted negative password (ENP) using a symmetric-key algorithm (e.g., AES), and multi-iteration encryption could be employed to further improve security. The cryptographic hash function and symmetric encryption make it difficult to crack passwords from ENPs. Moreover, there are lots of corresponding ENPs for a given plain password, which makes precomputation attacks (e.g., lookup table attack and rainbow table attack) infeasible. The algorithm complexity analyses and comparisons show that the ENP could resist lookup table attack and provide stronger password protection under dictionary attack. It is worth mentioning that the ENP does not introduce extra elements (e.g., salt); besides this, the ENP could still resist precomputation attacks. Most importantly, the ENP is the first password protection scheme that combines the cryptographic hash function, the negative password, and the symmetric-key algorithm, without the need for additional information except the plain password.
title: Authentication by Encrypted Negative Password
venue: IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security

abstract: Prior-free imaging beyond the memory effect (ME) is critical to seeing through the scattering media. However, methods proposed to exceed the ME range have suffered from the availability of prior information of imaging targets. Here, we propose a blind target position detection for large field-of-view scattering imaging. Only exploiting two captured multi-target near-field speckles at different imaging distances, the unknown number and locations of the isolated imaging targets are blindly reconstructed via the proposed scaling-vector-based detection. Autocorrelations can be calculated for the speckle regions centered by the derived positions via low-cross-talk region allocation strategy. Working with the modified phase retrieval algorithm, the complete scene of the multiple targets exceeding the ME range can be reconstructed without any prior information. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by testing on a real scattering imaging system.
summary_zh: 针对散射介质成像中超越记忆效应（ME）范围的挑战，现有方法往往依赖于成像目标的先验信息。本文提出了一种无需先验信息的盲目标位置检测方法，旨在实现大视场散射成像。该方法仅需利用在不同成像距离下获取的两组多目标近场散斑数据，通过提出的基于缩放向量的检测技术，即可盲重建未知数量及位置的孤立成像目标。通过低串扰区域分配策略，可以计算出以推导位置为中心的散斑区域自相关性。结合改进的相位检索算法，该方法能够在没有任何先验信息的情况下，实现超越记忆效应范围的多目标完整场景重建。通过真实散射成像系统的实验验证，证明了该算法的有效性。
title: Blind position detection for large field-of-view scattering imaging

summary_zh: 在社会辅助机器人领域，适应性技术的开发及其对人机交互的影响是一个重要研究方向。本文提出一种基于元学习的策略梯度方法，用于解决人机交互中的适应性问题，并探讨其作为信任建模机制的作用。通过在混合现实中构建一个机器人密室逃脱场景，我们验证了双向信任可受不同适应算法影响的假设。研究发现，所提模型提升了机器人被感知的可信度，并影响了人类信任获取的动态过程。此外，参与者评估认为，与先前研究的统计适应模型相比，在基于元学习的适应交互过程中，机器人感知到他们具有更高的可信度。
title: Fast Adaptation with Meta-Reinforcement Learning for Trust Modelling in Human-Robot Interaction
venue: 2019 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS)

abstract: Many public pre-trained word embeddings have been shown to encode different types of biases. Embeddings are often obtained from training on large pre-existing corpora, and therefore resulting biases can be a reflection of unfair representations in the original data. Bias, in this scenario, is a challenging problem since current mitigation techniques require knowing and understanding existing biases in the embedding, which is not always possible. In this work, we propose to improve word embedding fairness by borrowing methods from the field of data privacy. The idea behind this approach is to treat bias as if it were a special type of training data leakage. This has the unique advantage of not requiring prior knowledge of potential biases in word embeddings. We investigated two types of privacy algorithms, and measured their effect on bias using four different metrics. To investigate techniques from differential privacy, we applied Gaussian perturbation to public pre-trained word embeddings. To investigate noiseless privacy, we applied vector quantization during training. Experiments show that both approaches improve fairness for commonly used embeddings, and additionally, noiseless privacy techniques reduce the size of the resulting embedding representation.
title: Bias Invariant Approaches for Improving Word Embedding Fairness
venue: Proceedings of the 32nd ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management

abstract: Abstract An efficient rhodium‐catalyzed asymmetric hydrogenation of challenging tetrasubstituted cyclic enamides has been developed, affording cyclic chiral amides with high yields and excellent enantioselectivities (up to 99% yield and >99% ee ). This novel methodology provides an efficient and concise synthetic route to chiral cycloalkylamines with two contiguous stereogenic centers. The potential utility of this protocol in the synthesis of bioactive molecules is also disclosed. magnified image
summary_zh: 本文报道了一种高效的铑催化不对称氢化方法，用于合成具有挑战性的四取代环状烯酰胺底物。该方法以优异的产率和对映选择性（产率高达99%，对映体过量值超过99%）获得手性环状酰胺产物，为构建含有两个连续手性中心的环烷基胺类化合物提供了一条简洁高效的合成路线。研究还展示了该策略在生物活性分子合成中的应用潜力。
title: Rhodium‐Catalyzed Asymmetric Hydrogenation of Tetrasubstituted Cyclic Enamides: Efficient Access to Chiral Cycloalkylamine Derivatives

abstract: Large amplitude vibrations can cause hazards and failure to engineering structures. Active control has been an effective strategy to suppress vibrations, but it faces great challenges in the real-time control of nonlinear flexible structures such as wind turbine blades and aircraft wings. Here, we present a control design framework using reductions on aperiodic spectral submanifolds (SSMs) to address the challenges. We formulate high-dimensional nonlinear optimal control problems to suppress the vibrations and then use the SSM-based reductions to transform the original optimal control problems into low-dimensional linear optimal control problems. We further establish extended linear quadratic regulators to solve the reduced optimal control problems, paving the road for real-time active control of nonlinear flexible structures. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our control design framework via a suite of examples with increasing complexity, including a finite element model of an aircraft wing with more than 130,000 degrees of freedom.
title: Active vibration control of nonlinear flexible structures via reduction on spectral submanifolds

summary_zh: 我们提出HierMoE，一种面向稀疏激活混合专家（MoE）Transformer模型的高效分布式训练系统。MoE架构通过动态选择令牌激活部分专家，在扩展模型规模的同时降低计算开销，但令牌与专家跨GPU分布会引发严重的通信开销与负载不均，制约集群可扩展性。HierMoE引入两项拓扑感知优化：一是令牌去重，通过消除冗余令牌传输减少通信流量；二是专家交换，在GPU间动态重分配专家以均衡工作负载。为使上述策略在不同模型配置与硬件环境下均能取得最优效果，我们构建了理论模型，用于推导最佳令牌去重与专家交换方案。我们在Megatron-LM上实现HierMoE原型，并在32-GPU集群上使用DeepSeek-V3与Qwen3-30B-A3B模型进行实验。结果表明，与当前先进的MoE训练系统Tutel-2DH、SmartMoE和Megatron-LM相比，HierMoE的通信速度提升1.55至3.32倍，端到端训练速度提升1.18至1.27倍。
title: HierMoE: Accelerating MoE Training with Hierarchical Token Deduplication and Expert Swap

abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) are used to cover destination areas for a lot of practical applications. To enhance the performance of the WSN, the virtual backbone based on the connected dominating set is an efficient way with respect to the routing cost between sensors, lifetime of entire network, and so on. In this paper, especially for the WSN with different transmission radii among different sensors, we study the problem of constructing the minimum ρ-range connected dominating set under the constraint α-times of the minimum routing cost (αMOC-ρCDS), where α ) 5 and ρ is the ratio of the maximum-to-minimum transmission radius. Our contributions are three folds. First, we propose a polynomial time approximation scheme which generates the αMOC-ρCDS with the size of at most (1 + ϵ) times of the optimum solution, where ϵ is the error parameter. Second, we propose a polynomial time algorithm and prove that it has two approximation ratios (6ρ+1) <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> (2ρ+1) <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and 10[(2π/θ)I[(ln 3ρ/(ln(1/ cos θ)))] [(ln ρ/(ln(2 cos(π/5))))], where θ <; arcsin(1/3ρ). Finally, we propose the distributed version of the constant approximation ratio algorithm which has both the time complexity and message complexity O(n3), where n is the number of sensor nodes. Besides, the simulation results demonstrate the efficiency of our algorithms.
title: Minimum connected dominating set under routing cost constraint in wireless sensor networks with different transmission ranges

summary_zh: 利用二维纳米材料构筑三维结构，能够实现平面薄膜或块体材料所不具备的化学、力学及物理新功能。本文综述了基于新兴二维材料构建复杂面外表面形貌和三维材料架构的研究进展，重点介绍可产生周期性纹理或图案的四种代表性技术：平面片层的起皱与揉皱、皱褶纳米片壳层封装、通过折纸与剪纸工艺实现可编程曲率，以及二维材料悬浮液的三维打印。该领域目前主要以石墨烯和氧化石墨烯为二维构筑单元，本文进一步探讨了如何将这些非常规方法拓展至其他二维材料及其异质结构。综合来看，这些新兴的图案化与纹理化技术为传统材料合成与加工方法提供了独特替代方案，有望推动新型复合材料、可拉伸电子器件、储能装置、化学屏障及生物材料的发展。
title: From Flatland to Spaceland: Higher Dimensional Patterning with Two‐Dimensional Materials

summary_zh: 为了应对下一代低延迟、无缝通信对无线数据流量日益增长的需求，太赫兹频段因其巨大的频谱潜力而备受关注。然而，大气湿度引起的衰减和自由空间路径损耗严重限制了太赫兹信号的传输。高增益、具有方向性辐射和可重构波束赋形能力的天线对于补偿信号损耗及进行太赫兹信号处理至关重要。本文通过实验演示了一种时空介质超表面，实现了太赫兹波的单向传播和超快空间波束转向。该超表面的空间维度通过可控的方向性解决了准直单向传播中的背向散射问题，而其空间光学特性的时间调制则实现了超快的可重构波束转向。这种基于硅基的时空器件结合了超表面的物理特性与先进技术，为克服未来太赫兹通信中的瓶颈提供了有效途径，在高速安全无线数据传输、波束赋形及超快数据处理等应用领域具有广阔的前景。
title: Spatiotemporal Dielectric Metasurfaces for Unidirectional Propagation and Reconfigurable Steering of Terahertz Beams

summary_zh: 像素级视觉异常检测旨在识别图像中的异常区域，在工业缺陷检测和医学诊断领域具有重要意义。针对异常形态多样性大以及异常区域与正常背景边界模糊这两个核心挑战，本文提出了一种不确定性感知原型Transformer（UPformer）模型，旨在通过兼顾异常的多样性与不确定性来实现精准检测。该方法首先设计了一个记忆引导的原型学习Transformer编码器，通过学习并记忆异常的原型表示，使模型能够捕捉异常的多样化特征；其次，设计了一个异常检测不确定性量化器，通过学习检测分布来衡量检测过程中的不确定性；最后，提出了一种不确定性感知Transformer解码器，利用检测到的不确定性引导模型聚焦于模糊区域，从而生成最终的检测结果。实验结果表明，通过结合原型学习与不确定性估计的优势，该方法在五个数据集上均达到了当前最先进的异常检测性能。
title: Pixel-Level Anomaly Detection via Uncertainty-aware Prototypical Transformer
venue: Proceedings of the 30th ACM International Conference on Multimedia

abstract: Abstract This paper presents the design and preliminary evaluation of a quasi-passive lower limb exoskeleton for walking efficiency improvements. The exoskeleton recycles the negative work performed by the knee joint in late swing phase and the ankle joint in mid-stance phase, to assist ankle push-off in late-stance phase when a burst of positive power is needed. The exoskeleton consists of a torsion spring as an energy storage element, and two clutches attached to both ends of the spring to control the timing of recycling and releasing energy in a gait cycle. The two clutches are actively controlled by two small servo motors with very low power consumption based on the plantar pressure. The novelty of this exoskeleton is it makes the extra kinetic energy dissipated at the knee joint reusable, by transferring it to the ankle joint to assist positive power generation during push-off, for the first time. Eight male subjects walked with the exoskeleton engaged (EXO_ON), disengaged (EXO_OFF), and without the exoskeleton (NO_EXO). Inverse dynamics analysis demonstrated reduced negative biological work at the knee joint during late swing and at the ankle joint during mid stance, as well as reduced positive biological work at the ankle joint during late stance comparing the EXO_ON to EXO_OFF conditions. These results prove the effectiveness of the exoskeleton at joint level.
title: A Lower Limb Exoskeleton Recycling Energy From Knee and Ankle Joints to Assist Push-Off

summary_zh: 服务网络设计旨在解决运输服务运营与起点至终点货物流量分配相关的决策问题。本文针对大规模运输网络，研究了使用异构车队提供服务的优化问题。除了传统的运输服务与货物流量决策外，该模型还进一步确定了在各服务链路上配置的不同类型车辆数量，从而更真实地模拟实际应用场景。研究中提出了基于弧（arc-based）和基于环路路径（cycle-path）的两种数学模型进行问题建模。针对大规模算例，本文开发了一种混合算法，通过定价技术和割平面技术来获取紧致的下界，并结合局部搜索算法以获取高质量解。计算实验结果表明，与先进的求解器CPLEX相比，该算法具有更高的有效性和求解效率。最后，通过将该方法应用于实际网络案例，验证了在服务网络设计中考虑异构车队必要性。
title: A hybrid algorithm for large-scale service network design considering a heterogeneous fleet

abstract: High penetration of wind energy has intensified system pressure in balancing supply and demand due to the uncertainty nature of wind velocity. To mitigate the negative impacts brought along by wind power integration, an optimal power regulation scheme for a wind farm is proposed in this work. Specifically, the benefits of the designed wind power regulation scheme is innovatively quantified via the reduction of balancing cost. To handle wind uncertainty while determining generation profile for the wind farm, a robust strategy is introduced in the proposed control. In addition, the aerodynamic interactions among wind turbines are considered. To bypass the nonlinearity and non-convexity involved in the optimization problem and achieve online application, an artificial intelligence aided control is newly designed. Simulation results demonstrate the good performance of the proposed control scheme under multiple operation scenarios.
summary_zh: 为应对风电高比例并网带来的供需平衡压力，本文提出一种风电场最优功率调控方案，创新性地以平衡成本削减量来量化调控效益。针对风速不确定性，在制定风电场发电计划时引入鲁棒策略，同时考虑机组间气动耦合效应。为规避优化问题中的非线性与非凸性并实现在线应用，设计了一种人工智能辅助控制方法。多场景仿真结果表明，所提方案能有效降低平衡成本，具有良好的运行性能。
title: System-Oriented Power Regulation Scheme for Wind Farms: The Quest for Uncertainty Management

summary_zh: 大规模多输入多输出系统作为5G无线通信的关键使能技术，能够显著提升频谱效率。然而，成百上千根天线不可避免地引入极高计算复杂度，阻碍其直接部署。现有迭代检测方法如共轭梯度法虽较传统最小均方误差检测具有复杂度优势，但在天线配置更复杂时收敛速度会明显下降。针对这一问题，本文首先深入探究迭代线性求解器的收敛特性，进而提出一种自适应预条件技术以加速收敛。该技术具有通用性，并以最速下降检测为例进行融合展示。为进一步降低复杂度，文中还提出一种对数似然比的近似计算方法。分析与数值结果表明，在相同迭代次数下，自适应预条件最速下降检测器在误码率为十万分之三时性能优于共轭梯度检测器约1分贝。本文首次基于迭代边界分析与架构优化，提出了该检测器的硬件架构，其他自适应预条件迭代线性检测器的架构可遵循类似设计流程轻松推导。与现有先进设计相比，FPGA实现验证了该检测器在吞吐率与复杂度之间取得良好平衡，保障了其在5G无线通信中的应用可行性。
title: Adaptive Preconditioned Iterative Linear Detection and Architecture for Massive MU-MIMO Uplink

summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于无线供电生物医学设备的具有分数电容自动调谐环路（ATL）的主驱动器。该设计通过模拟ATL实现了对主LC谐振槽路在电感大幅波动下的实时谐振频率维持，具备宽环路带宽，并能在六个周期内完成相位锁定。为了实现分数电容，研究采用开关控制电容技术，通过调节开关的导通时间来改变有效电容，从而精确调节谐振频率。主驱动器采用全桥Class-D功率放大器架构，并利用自举电路驱动高侧NMOS功率开关。此外，文中还提出了一种自适应偏移控制器，用以补偿比较器延迟并提升调谐精度。该芯片采用0.18 $\mu$m BCD工艺制造，有效面积为0.66 mm$^2$。实验结果表明，系统在13.56 MHz频率下工作，稳态时可同时实现零电压开关（ZVS）和零电流开关（ZCS）。该驱动器的最大功率放大器输出功率为200 mW，实测调谐范围达31.5%，调谐误差仅为1.89 ns。
title: A 13.56MHz Primary Driver with Fractional Capacitance Auto-Tuning Loop for Wireless-Powered Implantable Medical Devices

abstract: Personalized federated learning (PFL) enhances the performance of customized client models through collaborative training without compromising data privacy and ownership.
