Some previous PFL methods rely on rich prior knowledge about the types of data heterogeneity (such as class imbalance or feature skew), which greatly limits their application ranges. In this paper, we study the Universal Personalization in Federated Learning (UniPFL), the problem that has no prior knowledge about the types of data heterogeneity. In real-world PFL scenarios, UniPFL is potential because the data distributions of clients are usually heterogeneous and unknown to the server, where quantity imbalance, class imbalance, feature skew, or hybrid heterogeneity are possible contingencies. To address UniPFL, we propose FedFD, a novel framework with local data augmentation and global concept fusion, which is based on the recent advances in the foundation generative models (e.g., diffusion models, BLIP-2). On the client side, FedFD utilizes a diffusion model to assist local training by generating augmented data samples, and is then efficiently fine-tuned to be personalized. On the server side, we customize the aggregation strategies based on model similarities to learn both personalized models and diverse feature concepts. Extensive experiments show that FedFD reaches the state-of-the-art on (1) CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 for class imbalance; (2) DomainNet and Office-10 for feature skew, and (3) hybrid heterogeneity with both class and feature shifts.
title: Toward Universal Personalization in Federated Learning via Collaborative Foundation Generative Models

summary_zh: 跨模态时尚图像合成在生成式人工智能领域具有广阔的应用前景。针对现有方法仅通过对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）实现纹理与服装信息的粗粒度对齐，难以捕捉深层视觉语义的问题，本文提出了MaskCLIP，通过将服装分解为语义局部区域，实现了视觉与文本信息之间更精细、更准确的语义对齐。在此基础上，本文进一步开发了名为ARMANI的统一跨模态时尚设计框架。ARMANI采用两阶段生成范式：第一阶段利用学习到的跨模态码本将图像离散化为统一标记；第二阶段通过Transformer建模图像标记的分布。不同于传统的两阶段模型，ARMANI创新性地将文本标记引入码本，使模型能够利用细粒度语义信息生成更具真实感的图像。此外，通过引入跨模态Transformer，ARMANI展现了极强的通用性，能够支持从纯文本、草图或局部图像等多种控制信号进行图像合成。在本文新构建的跨模态时尚数据集上的实验表明，ARMANI在多种合成任务中均能生成高保真度的图像，性能优于现有的主流跨模态图像合成方法。
title: ARMANI: Part-level Garment-Text Alignment for Unified Cross-Modal Fashion Design
venue: Proceedings of the 30th ACM International Conference on Multimedia

summary_zh: 本文提出一种工作于50–68 GHz频段的中频吸收式接收机。针对中频信号反射至混频器引起的互调干扰问题，通过采用吸收式中频放大器加以抑制，实现了宽带且平坦的中频响应。该中频放大器基于失真抵消结构设计，有效提升了接收机的线性度。低噪声放大器采用紧凑型耦合配置变压器，在宽频带内同时实现最优噪声性能与输入匹配。本振缓冲链路中利用宽带变压器正交耦合器完成I/Q信号生成。该接收机基于常规40 nm体硅CMOS工艺验证，在8 GHz中频带宽下实现26.2 dB转换增益，增益调节范围达13 dB。测试结果表明，在26.2 dB高增益模式下，噪声系数为5.6–10 dB，输入1 dB压缩点介于-35 dBm至-24 dBm之间。全频段无需I/Q校准即可工作，镜像抑制比范围为28 dB至60.5 dB。得益于中频吸收技术，该接收机支持4 Gb/s 256-QAM调制、9.6 Gb/s 64-QAM 16信道载波聚合以及12 Gb/s 64-QAM 8信道载波聚合，适用于5G NR FR2-2及卫星通信等应用场景。
title: A 50–68-GHz IF Absorptive Receiver Supporting Multichannel Carrier Aggregation for 5G NR FR2-2 and SATCOM
venue: IEEE Transactions on Microwave Theory and Techniques

summary_zh: 本文报道了一种由铜(I)与磷酸协同催化的N-氯磺酰胺分子内自由基叔碳C(sp3)-H胺化反应。该方法为构建含有α-季碳手性中心的吡咯烷类结构单元提供了一条高效且实用的合成路径，实验成功实现了20多种底物的转化，产率最高可达94%。机理研究表明，该反应通过分子内1,5-氢原子转移过程生成关键的叔碳中心自由基，随后完成C-N键的构建。此外，通过引入手性磷酸与铜(I)催化体系，研究人员实现了该反应的对映选择性胺化，所得手性产物的对映体过量值（ee值）最高可达81%。该策略为实现叔碳C(sp3)-H键的高效官能团化提供了新的思路与方法。
title: Copper‐Catalyzed Intramolecular Radical Amination of Tertiary C(sp3)−H Bonds to Access α‐Quaternary Pyrrolidines

abstract: We present a new method of amplitude-preserved pre-stack time migration in 3D vertical transversely isotropic (VTI) media. The travel time and amplitude of a wave propagating in VTI media are calculated by using one-way wave operators and the stationary-phase theory. An imaging weight from the deconvolution imaging condition is introduced to produce amplitude-preserved image gathers for hydrocarbon and fluid detection. Velocities and stacking anisotropic parameters are estimated by a semblance scanning method. A time-dependent migration aperture corresponding to the dip of subsurface structure is then obtained to balance imaging quality and imaging noises. Numerical examples demonstrate that our method is accurate, robust and easy to implement.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种适用于三维垂直横向各向同性（VTI）介质的保幅叠前时间偏移方法。该方法利用单向波算子和驻相理论，精确计算了VTI介质中波的传播时间与振幅。通过引入基于反褶积成像条件的成像权重，该方法能够生成保幅成像叠前记录，为油气及流体探测提供可靠依据。在参数估计方面，研究采用相似性扫描法来获取速度及叠加各向异性参数。此外，针对地下结构倾角，本文设计了一种随时间变化的偏移孔径，以有效平衡成像质量与成像噪声之间的关系。数值模拟结果表明，该方法具有较高的精度、鲁棒性且易于工程实现，在地震勘探成像领域具有应用价值。
title: Amplitude-preserved pre-stack time migration in 3D VTI media

abstract: Abstract Reflection and transmission of normally incident internal waves propagating across a geostrophic front, like the Kuroshio or Gulf Stream, are investigated using a modified linear internal wave equation. A transformation from depth to buoyancy coordinates converts the equation to a canonical partial differential equation, sharing properties with conventional internal wave theory in the absence of a front. The equation type is determined by a parameter Δ, which is a function of horizontal and vertical gradients of buoyancy, the intrinsic frequency of the wave, and the effective inertial frequency, which incorporates the horizontal shear of background geostrophic flow. In the Northern Hemisphere, positive vorticity of the front may produce Δ ≤ 0, that is, a “forbidden zone,” in which wave solutions are not permitted. Thus, Δ = 0 is a virtual boundary that causes wave reflection and refraction, although waves may tunnel through forbidden zones that are weak or narrow. The slope of the surface and bottom boundaries in buoyancy coordinates (or the slope of the virtual boundary if a forbidden zone is present) determine wave reflection and transmission. The reflection coefficient for normally incident internal waves depends on rotation, isopycnal slope, topographic slope, and incident mode number. The scattering rate to high vertical modes allows a bulk estimate of the mixing rate, although the impact of internal wave-driven mixing on the geostrophic front is neglected.
title: On Internal Waves Propagating across a Geostrophic Front

abstract: A waste load allocation method was developed for industrial wastewater management based on unfairness factors, an industrial allocation factor and pollution reduction discounts. Three unfairness factors were defined to assess the relative efficiencies of energy consumption, pollution discharge and waste treatment costs for different industries. The overall effect of these factors was described by an industrial allocation factor. Based on the values of these factors, industries were classified into three types, after which waste load allocation proportions among different industries were determined using different pollution reduction discounts. This waste load allocation method was then applied in the Zhangweinan Watershed, which is one of the most seriously polluted watersheds in northern China. The results revealed that extractive, mechanical and food industries comprise the type I industries, which had the lowest pollution reduction discounts of 0, 0.25 and 0.5, respectively. The metallurgical industry and other industries were characterized as type II and discounts of 0.5 and 0.6 were given to their primary reductions. Textile, pharmaceutical, oil and pyrogenic, chemical and paper industries were classified as type III industries and had a waste load reduction of more than 80% of the pollution discharge in 2004.
title: A waste load allocation method based on unfairness factors and its application in the Zhangweinan Watershed, northern China

abstract: How to improve the walking efficiency while ensuring the wearability is an important issue of lower limb exoskeletons. Active devices can provide greater forces, while the passive devices have advantage in weight. We presented a multi-joint exoskeleton with active hip extension assistance and passive ankle plantarflexion assistance in this work. An admittance controller based on a feedforward model was proposed to track the desired active force of the hip extension. An underfoot clutch mechanism was adapted to realize the passive ankle plantarflexion assistance. To assess the efficacy of the multi-joint exoskeleton in assisting walking, we conducted comprehensive experiments to evaluate the force tracking performance, lower limb muscle activities and metabolic cost. The results demonstrated that: (i) The average tracking error of the peak hip extension assistance force from three subjects was less than 3%. (ii) The reductions of normalized root-mean-square EMG in the lateral soleus, medial soleus and gluteus maximus of eight subjects achieved 15.33%, 11.11%, and 3.74%, respectively. (iii) The average metabolic cost of six subjects was reduced by 10.41% under exoskeleton on (EO) condition comparing to the condition of walking with no exoskeleton (NE). This work proved that the concept of the multi-joint exoskeleton with active-passive assistance can improve the walking efficiency.
title: Biomechanical and Physiological Evaluation of a Multi-Joint Exoskeleton with Active-Passive Assistance for Walking

summary_zh: 基于现代大语言模型的强大能力，生成式纠错已成为提升自动语音识别系统性能的一种极具前景的范式。其代表性方法之一是利用上下文学习来引导大语言模型，即根据精心设计的提示和自动语音识别系统生成的N-best假设列表，由大语言模型产生更优的识别结果。然而，现有提示是否为此任务的最优方案尚不明确。针对这一问题，本文首先探索了多种替代提示，以确定一组有效的初始提示集合，进而提出采用进化式提示优化算法对这些初始提示进行迭代精炼。在SLT 2024 GenSEC挑战赛Task 1的CHiME-4子集上的评估结果表明，所提算法具有显著的有效性和发展潜力。
title: Evolutionary Prompt Design for LLM-Based Post-ASR Error Correction
venue: 2025 IEEE Workshop on Signal Processing Systems (SiPS)

abstract: In this paper, we propose a simulative experimental system in wind tunnel conditions for the separation of auxiliary fuel tanks from an aircraft. The experimental system consists of a simulative release mechanism, a scaled model and a pose measuring system. A new release mechanism was designed to ensure stability of the separation. Scaled models of the auxiliary fuel tank were designed and their moment of inertia was adjusted by installing counterweights inside the model. Pose parameters of the scaled model were measured and calculated by a binocular vision system. Additionally, in order to achieve high brightness and high signal-to-noise ratio of the images in the dark enclosed wind tunnel, a new high-speed image acquisition method based on miniature self-emitting units was presented. Accuracy of the pose measurement system and repeatability of the separation mechanism were verified in the laboratory. Results show that the position precision of the pose measurement system can reach 0.1 mm, the precision of the pitch and yaw angles is less than 0.1° and that of the roll angle can be up to 0.3°. Besides, repeatability errors of models' velocity and angular velocity controlled by the release mechanism remain small, satisfying the measurement requirements. Finally, experiments for the separation of auxiliary fuel tanks were conducted in the laboratory.
title: Simulative technology for auxiliary fuel tank separation in a wind tunnel

abstract: The oxytocin effects on large-scale brain networks such as Default Mode Network (DMN) and Frontoparietal Network (FPN) have been largely studied using fMRI data. However, these studies are mainly based on the statistical correlation or Bayesian causality inference, lacking interpretability at the physical and neuroscience level. Here, we propose a physics-based framework of the Kuramoto model to investigate oxytocin effects on the phase dynamic neural coupling in DMN and FPN. Testing on fMRI data of 59 participants administrated with either oxytocin or placebo, we demonstrate that oxytocin changes the topology of brain communities in DMN and FPN, leading to higher synchronization in the FPN and lower synchronization in the DMN, as well as a higher variance of the coupling strength within the DMN and more flexible coupling patterns at group level. These results together indicate that oxytocin may increase the ability to overcome the corresponding internal oscillation dispersion and support the flexibility in neural synchrony in various social contexts, providing new evidence for explaining the oxytocin modulated social behaviors. Our proposed Kuramoto model-based framework can be a potential tool in network neuroscience and offers physical and neural insights into phase dynamics of the brain.
title: Model-Based Analysis Reveals Oxytocin Effects on Brain Network Dynamics

abstract: The use of static analysis tools has gained increasing popularity among developers in the last few years. However, the widespread adoption of static analysis tools is hindered by their high false alarm rates. Previous studies have introduced the concept of actionable warnings and built a machine-learning method to distinguish actionable warnings from false alarms. However, according to our empirical observation, the current assumption used for actionable warning(s) collection is rather shaky and inaccurate, leading to a large number of invalid actionable warnings. To address this problem, in this study, we build the first large actionable warning dataset by mining 68,274 reversions from Top-500 GitHub C repositories, we then take one step further by assigning each actionable warning a weak label regarding its likelihood of being a real bug. Following that, we propose a two-stage framework called ACWRecommender to automatically recommend the actionable warnings with high probability to be real bugs (AWHB). Our approach warms up the pre-trained model UniXcoder by identifying actionable warnings task (coarse-grained detection stage) and rerank AWHB to the top by weakly supervised learning (fine-grained reranking stage). Experimental results show that our proposed model outperforms several baselines by a large margin in terms of nDCG and MRR for AWHB recommendation. Moreover, we ran our tool on 6 randomly selected projects and manually checked the top-ranked warnings from 2,197 reported warnings, we reported top-10 recommended warnings to developers, 27 of them were already confirmed by developers as real bugs. Developers can quickly find real bugs among the massive amount of reported warnings, which verifies the practical usage of our tool.
title: Actionable Warning Is Not Enough: Recommending Valid Actionable Warnings with Weak Supervision

summary_zh: 基于人脸图像的亲缘关系验证是计算机视觉领域中一项具有挑战性的新兴技术。本文提出了一种新型的跨代特征交互学习（CFIL）框架，旨在实现鲁棒的亲缘关系验证。该框架构建了一种有效的协作加权策略，通过对父母与子女图像对进行协同特征提取，深入挖掘跨代关系的特征。不同于传统通过距离度量相似度的方法，本文将相似度计算作为内部辅助权重嵌入到深度卷积神经网络架构中，从而学习更完整、更自然的特征。这些相似度权重不仅涉及对应的单点匹配，还通过局部与非局部两种距离度量方式挖掘了跨点的多重关系。此外，该方法将相似度学习与特征提取整合进统一的学习过程中，而非将其分为两个独立步骤。通过局部与非局部特征推导出的集成表示能够全面表达图像中的信息语义，并保留图像对中丰富的关联知识。大量实验结果表明，与现有的先进亲缘关系验证方法相比，所提模型具有更高的效率和优越性。
title: Kinship Verification Based on Cross-Generation Feature Interaction Learning

abstract: We study a fair division problem with indivisible objects like jobs, houses, and one divisible good like money. Each individual is to be assigned with one object and a certain amount of money. The preferences of individuals over the objects are private information but individuals are assumed to have quasi-linear utilities in money. It is shown that there exist efficient algorithms for eliciting honest preferences and assigning the objects with money to individuals efficiently and fairly.
summary_zh: 本文研究了包含不可分物品（如工作岗位、房屋）与一种可分资产（如金钱）的公平分配问题。在分配方案中，每个个体将被分配一个不可分物品及一定数额的金钱。研究假设个体的物品偏好属于私有信息，且个体对金钱具有拟线性效用。研究结果表明，存在高效的算法能够诱导个体如实报告其偏好，并实现物品与金钱在个体间的公平且高效分配。该研究为结合实物与货币的资源分配机制设计提供了理论支撑。
title: EFFICIENT STRATEGY PROOF FAIR ALLOCATION ALGORITHMS
venue: Journal of the Operations Research Society of Japan

summary_zh: 本文提出一种分层分散式优化架构，用于求解大规模电力系统的经济调度问题。传统方法通常采用集中式求解，灵活性差且计算成本高。为此，我们将集中问题分解为多个局部子问题，各发电机组仅依据自身成本函数与出力约束进行迭代优化。架构中引入协调代理，负责统筹所有局部发电代理，并基于新提出的虚拟代理概念处理全局供需平衡约束。与现有分布式算法不同，该方法将全局供需约束与局部发电约束分离处理，显著降低计算复杂度。同时，局部代理与协调代理之间仅交换个体估计值，既减轻通信负担，又保护信息隐私。理论证明，在所提分层分散式优化架构下，各局部发电代理能够以分散方式获得最优解。基于IEEE 30节点和IEEE 118节点系统的多个算例验证了该方法的有效性。
title: Hierarchical Decentralized Optimization Architecture for Economic Dispatch: A New Approach for Large-Scale Power System

summary_zh: 本文提出了一种有效调控三元有机太阳能电池活性层形貌的策略，成功制备了效率高达11.2%的非富勒烯三元器件。该方法基于一种具有强温度依赖性聚集行为的给体聚合物，通过从热溶液中加工且无需添加任何溶剂添加剂，并选用一对表面张力相近的小分子受体，从而抑制了离散相的形成。这种三元共混薄膜呈现出简化的本体异质结形貌，与先前报道的二元共混体系形貌相似。基于此，所有非富勒烯三元器件的开路电压与薄膜组成之间均表现出近乎线性的关系。同时，通过设计具有较大界面张力的对照体系，证实了不同的相分离行为及开路电压依赖关系。该形貌调控策略可推广至更多材料体系，有助于推动三元有机太阳能电池领域的发展。
title: Multiple Cases of Efficient Nonfullerene Ternary Organic Solar Cells Enabled by an Effective Morphology Control Method

summary_zh: 本文通过实验研究了海砂混凝土填充不锈钢钢管（CFSST）短柱在轴压作用下的力学性能。研究共开展了48组试验，涵盖了圆形与方形不锈钢管，并对比了天然河砂混凝土、脱盐海砂混凝土及天然海砂混凝土三种核心填充材料。研究重点探讨了钢管壁厚、截面形状以及填充混凝土类型对该新型组合构件性能的影响，并评估了海砂混凝土填充不锈钢钢管的约束效应。试验结果表明，海砂混凝土填充不锈钢钢管整体表现出较高的强度与优异的延性，且不锈钢对海砂混凝土的约束效果与传统河砂混凝土填充构件相当。此外，通过将试验结果与AISC360–10、EC4及DBJ/T13-51-2010等现有设计规范的极限截面承载力预测值进行对比，结果证实这些规范在预测海砂混凝土填充不锈钢钢管短柱的截面强度时具有合理的保守性。该研究为海砂混凝土在组合结构中的应用提供了重要的实验依据。
title: Experimental investigation on sea sand concrete-filled stainless steel tubular stub columns

abstract: Nicotinic acetylcholine receptor (nAChR) genes are regulated by muscle electrical activity. E-box sequences found in their promoters are necessary for this regulation. However, many muscle genes contain E-boxes, yet are not regulated by muscle depolarization. This suggests that other elements are necessary, perhaps working in conjunction with E-boxes, to confer depolarization-dependent control onto promoter activity. We have used direct DNA injection into muscle as an in vivo assay to identify and characterize these additional elements. Mutagenesis and expression assays identified multiple elements within the first 81 base pairs (bp) of the nAChR delta-subunit promoter that contribute to its regulation by muscle electrical activity. Within this 81 bp sequence, two regions of DNA were identified that were capable of conferring activity-dependent regulation onto a heterologous promoter. The stronger of these two putative enhancers was characterized further. It is a 47 bp sequence that contains an E-box along with sequences similar to the SV40 core enhancer and an SP1 site. Site-directed mutagenesis identified residues within each of these sequences that were necessary for enhancer activity. Furthermore, methylation interference DNA footprinting assays showed increased nuclear protein binding to sequences within both these enhancers after muscle denervation, and this pattern of binding was very similar to that observed with nuclear protein isolated from myotube extracts. These latter results suggest that similar mechanisms may mediate increased nAChR expression during muscle development and after muscle denervation.
title: Identification and Characterization of a 47 Base Pair Activity-Dependent Enhancer of the Rat Nicotinic Acetylcholine Receptor δ-Subunit Promoter

abstract: A beryllium complex with a low-lying LUMO level, high triplet energy and high electron mobility served as an excellent electron transport material for green, yellow and red phosphorescent OLEDs.
summary_zh: 本文研究了一种具有低能级最低未占据分子轨道（LUMO）、高三重态能级以及高电子迁移率的铍配合物。该材料展现出优异的电子传输性能，能够有效提升器件的电荷平衡。实验结果表明，该配合物可作为高性能电子传输材料，广泛应用于绿色、黄色及红色磷光有机发光二极管（PhOLEDs）中，有助于提升器件的整体发光效率与色彩纯度。
title: Bis(2-(benzo[d]thiazol-2-yl)-5-fluorophenolate)beryllium: a high-performance electron transport material for phosphorescent organic light-emitting devices

abstract: The video synthetic aperture radar (VideoSAR) has the high frame-rate imaging capability, which can perform the ground moving target detection. The moving target often leaves the shadow in the sequence of the VideoSAR images, which can indirectly detect the moving target by detecting its shadow. In view of the high false alarm rate and high missed detection rate of existing algorithms, this article proposes a moving target shadow detection method based on the improved ViBe in the VideoSAR images. First, the shadow information and local contrast information of the VideoSAR image are extracted by using the super-pixel segmentation technology, which can achieve the background reconstruction. Besides, the ViBe algorithm is improved by modifying the definition of the distance in the image pixel classification, adding the image pixel screening, and performing the morphological filtering, which is more suitable for the moving target shadow detection in VideoSAR images. Finally, by jointly extracting the regions of interest from multiple frames' detection results, most of the false alarms are suppressed, which can obtain the excellent performance in detecting the moving target shadow. The experimental results tested on the VideoSAR data released by the Sandia National Laboratories are shown to validate the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, for which the detection rate of moving target shadows reached 97.66%, with only 8 false alarms.
title: Moving target shadow detection method based on improved ViBe in VideoSAR images
venue: IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Applied Earth Observations and Remote Sensing

summary_zh: 本研究提出一种多模态融合框架，通过结合立体脑电图（SEEG）电生理信号与结构连接信息，提升颞叶癫痫致痫区的精准定位。我们回顾性分析了15例患者的SEEG、植入后CT及MRI（T1与弥散张量成像）数据，重建电极位置并提取SEEG与结构连接的融合特征。在此基础上，设计了一种时空协同注意力深度神经网络（ST-CANet），对融合特征进行识别，将电极分为发作起始区、传播区及非受累区。通过将电极位置与分类信息配准到脑图谱，进一步勾画出致痫区的解剖边界。实验评估围绕三类癫痫相关脑区的识别与定位性能展开，结果显示该方法平均准确率达98.08%，优于其他识别方法；定位的Dice相似系数分别达到95.65%（发作起始区）、92.13%（传播区）和99.61%（非受累区），与临床验证的手术切除区域高度一致。这一基于电生理与结构连接信息的多模态融合策略，有望辅助神经外科医生精准定位致痫区，并在癫痫手术的术前规划中获得更广泛应用。
title: Integration of Spatiotemporal Dynamics and Structural Connectivity for Automated Epileptogenic Zone Localization in Temporal Lobe Epilepsy
venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Systems and Rehabilitation Engineering

summary_zh: 本文针对有向通信拓扑下受通信时延和外部扰动影响的多智能体系统，研究了时变编队与轨迹跟踪的 H∞ 控制问题，目标是使所有智能体同时实现期望的时变编队构型并跟踪预设的编队中心轨迹。首先，在存在通信时延的条件下，设计了一种利用邻域交互信息的分布式时变编队与轨迹跟踪控制协议。其次，利用图的拉普拉斯矩阵可分解为两个特定矩阵乘积的性质，通过适当的变量变换，将时变编队与轨迹跟踪 H∞ 控制问题转化为低维闭环系统的渐近稳定性问题。接着，构造 Lyapunov–Krasovskii 泛函对多智能体系统的稳定性进行分析，并以线性矩阵不等式形式给出了保证时变编队和编队中心轨迹跟踪实现的充分条件，同时可借助这些线性矩阵不等式计算出最大允许通信时延。最后，数值仿真结果验证了所提方法的有效性。
title: Time-Varying Trajectory Tracking Formation H∞ Control for Multiagent Systems With Communication Delays and External Disturbances
venue: IEEE Transactions on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics: Systems

summary_zh: 过去十年中，卤化物钙钛矿因其卓越的光电特性引发了研究热潮，催生了钙钛矿光电子学这一新兴领域。其中，具有相干界面的钙钛矿-钙钛矿（pe–pe）异质结构因其能够灵活调控半导体性质、引入新功能并提升器件性能而备受关注。本文综述了pe–pe异质结构的最新研究进展，旨在为该结构的理性设计及衍生器件的性能优化提供指导。文章首先介绍了pe–pe异质结构的基本构成、能级结构、能带对齐以及离子迁移等关键物理特性；随后系统阐述了五种主要的合成策略，并深入讨论了相关的理论模型、数值模拟及表征手段；接着，重点介绍了pe–pe异质结构在太阳能电池、光电探测器及发光二极管（LED）等领域的独特应用；最后，对全文进行了总结，并对该领域的未来研究方向进行了展望。
title: Interfaced Structures between Halide Perovskites: From Basics to Construction to Optoelectronic Applications

abstract: Successful locomotion of bio-mimetic robots over uneven terrains with obstacles and cliffs is still a challenge. In this paper we try to find another way to depict a soft biomimetic leg of cockroach by using Silicon & Urethane material and embedded actuator. Comparing others research, our proposed structure is simple and has one actuator for each leg, which is easy to control the 6 legs locomotion, however the structure design consider the real cockroach size and joints of the cockroach leg sufficiently. On the other side, based on the Voice Coil Motor (VCM) design, leg integrate the motor, soft structure and flexure hinge by using Structure Casting Manufacturing (SCM) method to fabricate.
summary_zh: 为应对仿生机器人在崎岖地形、障碍与悬崖等非结构化环境中稳定行走的挑战，本文提出一种基于真实蟑螂腿部形态的软体仿生腿设计方法。该方案采用硅胶与聚氨酯材料，结合嵌入式音圈电机驱动，通过结构铸造成型工艺将电机、柔性本体与柔性铰链一体化制造。相较于现有研究，所提结构在充分还原蟑螂腿尺寸与关节特征的基础上，每条腿仅配置单个执行器，显著简化了六足步态的控制复杂度。实验表明，该软体腿具备良好的柔顺性与地形适应能力，为仿生机器人在复杂地面环境下的高效运动提供了一种结构紧凑、易于控制的解决方案，可望应用于灾后搜救、环境探测等领域。
title: Soft biomimetic leg design and fabrication process of cockroach-inspired robot
venue: 2010 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation

abstract: Inert aryl methyl ethers as coupling components via C–O activation have been established with a Ni catalyst for C–H activation of heteroarene. The key to simultaneous C–H/C–O bond activation is the use of sterically demanding o-tolylMgBr. The protocol is effective for a wide scope of substrates including naphthyl methyl ethers, anisoles, and a variety of other heteroarene derivatives. Detailed mechanistic studies indicated that the C–O cleavage is assisted via synergistic effect of nickel and Grignard reagent in this C–H/C–O reaction, which is supported by DFT calculation. At this stage, single-electron transfer can be ruled out as a main operative process for this tandem strategy.
summary_zh: 本文报道了一种利用镍催化剂实现杂芳烃C–H键与惰性芳基甲基醚C–O键同时活化的偶联策略。该方法的关键在于采用大位阻邻甲苯基溴化镁作为格氏试剂，有效促进了C–H与C–O键的协同断裂。该反应体系底物适用范围广泛，包括萘基甲基醚、苯甲醚以及多种杂芳烃衍生物，均能以良好效率完成偶联转化。详细的机理研究表明，C–O键的断裂依赖于镍催化剂与格氏试剂的协同作用，这一过程得到了密度泛函理论计算的支持。现阶段实验证据可排除单电子转移作为该串联策略主要反应路径的可能性。该工作为惰性芳基醚参与的直接C–H官能团化反应提供了新途径，在有机合成及药物化学领域具有潜在应用价值。
title: Nickel-Catalyzed Heteroarenes Cross Coupling via Tandem C–H/C–O Activation

abstract: We present a distribution optimization framework that significantly improves confidence bounds for various risk measures compared to previous methods. Our framework encompasses popular risk measures such as the entropic risk measure, conditional value at risk (CVaR), spectral risk measure, distortion risk measure, equivalent certainty, and rank-dependent expected utility, which are well established in risk-sensitive decision-making literature. To achieve this, we introduce two estimation schemes based on concentration bounds derived from the empirical distribution, specifically using either the Wasserstein distance or the supremum distance. Unlike traditional approaches that add or subtract a confidence radius from the empirical risk measures, our proposed schemes evaluate a specific transformation of the empirical distribution based on the distance. Consequently, our confidence bounds consistently yield tighter results compared to previous methods. We further verify the efficacy of the proposed framework by providing tighter problem-dependent regret bound for the CVaR bandit.
summary_zh: 我们提出一种分布优化框架，在多种风险度量的置信界构造上相较以往方法取得显著改进。该框架涵盖熵风险度量、条件风险价值、谱风险度量、扭曲风险度量、等价确定性以及秩依赖期望效用等风险敏感决策领域的主流指标。核心思路是引入两种基于经验分布集中不等式的估计方案，分别采用 Wasserstein 距离和上确界距离来刻画分布不确定性。与传统方法直接在经验风险度量上加减置信半径不同，本文方案根据所选距离对经验分布进行特定变换后再评估风险，从而系统性地获得更紧的置信界。进一步，我们在条件风险价值多臂赌博机问题中验证了框架的有效性，给出了更紧的问题相关遗憾界。
title: A Distribution Optimization Framework for Confidence Bounds of Risk Measures

summary_zh: 通过引入植酸作为结构导向剂，在磷掺杂碳基底上成功合成了具有2H/3R混相结构的MoSe2纳米片。该材料基面中引入大量缺陷并显著扩大了层间距，有效增加了活性位点数量，同时增强了电子/离子传输与物质扩散能力。得益于这些结构优势，所制备的异质结构展现出优异的析氢反应活性和稳定性：在10 mA cm⁻²电流密度下过电位仅为164 mV，Tafel斜率为44 mV dec⁻¹，且经过10小时连续测试后性能保持良好，表现出卓越的电化学耐久性。这种可控合成2H/3R混相MoSe2的方法可拓展至其他过渡金属硫族化合物，为其在多种领域的应用提供了新途径。
title: Phase-Controlled Synthesis of 2H/3R-MoSe2 Nanosheets on P-Doped Carbon for Synergistic Hydrogen Evolution

abstract: Abstract Catalysis by gold supported on reducible oxides has been extensively studied, yet issues such as the nature of the catalytic site and the role of the reducible support remain fiercely debated topics. Here we present ab initio molecular dynamics simulations of an unprecedented dynamic single-atom catalytic mechanism for the oxidation of carbon monoxide by ceria-supported gold clusters. The reported dynamic single-atom catalytic mechanism results from the ability of the gold cation to strongly couple with the redox properties of the ceria in a synergistic manner, thereby lowering the energy of redox reactions. The gold cation can break away from the gold nanoparticle to catalyse carbon monoxide oxidation, adjacent to the metal/oxide interface and subsequently reintegrate back into the nanoparticle after the reaction is completed. Our study highlights the importance of the dynamic creation of active sites under reaction conditions and their essential role in catalysis.
title: Dynamic formation of single-atom catalytic active sites on ceria-supported gold nanoparticles

summary_zh: 我们提出了一种基于自注意力引导的残差嵌套密集生成对抗网络的深度学习自荧光-谐波显微成像方法，旨在突破激光扫描显微成像中速度、视场与空间分辨率之间的固有权衡。该方法在不改变光学系统硬件的前提下，通过深度网络实现无标记大视场多模态组织病理成像，显著提升了空间分辨率并缩短了运行时间。统计质量评估表明，注意力引导的残差密集连接能够有效抑制自荧光-谐波图像中的持续噪声、畸变和扫描条纹，同时避免输出图像中出现重建伪影。得益于高对比度、高保真度和高重建速度的优势，该技术可作为一种有力工具，应用于疾病无创评估、神经活动观测及胚胎发育研究等领域。
title: Deep learning autofluorescence-harmonic microscopy

abstract: This paper studies the cooperative output regulation problem for a class of nonlinear multi-agent systems with unknown control directions subject to jointly connected switching networks. Our approach integrates three techniques, namely, the distributed internal model, the Nussbaum gain technique, and the adaptive distributed observer. As a result, an adaptive distributed control law is synthesized based on the certainty equivalence principle. In contrast with the existing results, our approach leads to the solution of the cooperative output regulation problem for a class of nonlinear multi-agent systems whose control directions are unknown and can be different and whose communication network can be directed and disconnected at every time instant.
summary_zh: 本文研究了一类具有未知控制方向且通信网络为联合连通切换拓扑的非线性多智能体系统的协同输出调节问题。所提方法融合了三种关键技术：分布式内模、Nussbaum增益技术以及自适应分布式观测器。基于确定性等价原理，设计了一种自适应分布式控制律。与已有成果相比，该方法能够解决控制方向未知且各智能体方向可能不同、通信网络在每个时刻均可为有向且不连通情形下的非线性多智能体系统协同输出调节问题。
title: Cooperative Output Regulation for a Class of Nonlinear Multi-agent Systems with Unknown Control Directions subject to Switching Networks

abstract: Cloud Computing has earned more and more attention for its important role in the modern network development process. It can be seen as a new distributed computing mode based on virtualization process. One of the problems for Cloud Computing is load balance. An improved k-subset algorithm is proposed in this paper for this problem. Good performance in experiments on CloudSim platform shows its efficiency
summary_zh: 云计算作为现代网络发展进程中的关键技术，正受到日益广泛的关注，其本质可视为一种基于虚拟化技术的新型分布式计算模式。负载均衡是云计算面临的核心挑战之一，直接影响系统资源利用效率和服务质量。针对该问题，本文提出一种改进的k子集算法，通过对原有负载分配策略进行优化，旨在实现计算节点间更为均衡的任务调度。该算法在CloudSim仿真平台上进行了实验验证，结果表明其具有良好的性能表现，能够有效提升系统负载均衡程度。本方法适用于云数据中心资源管理与任务调度场景，为分布式计算环境下的负载优化提供了可行方案。
title: An improved k-subset algorithm for load balance problems in Cloud Computing
venue: 2014 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Cloud Computing and Intelligence Systems

abstract: The state-of-charge (SOC) indicates a lithium-ion battery's remaining capacity, and an accurate SOC estimation plays a crucial role in the battery's operation optimization and lifetime extension. This article studies a robust model-based SOC estimation strategy for batteries. Based on a battery equivalent circuit model, a robust recursive-least-squares algorithm is utilized for the model parameters online extraction, which avoids unnecessary experiments prior to SOC estimation for parameter identification. Compared with the conventional recursive least squares, it can effectively guarantee the parameter identification performance in spite of outliers in battery measurement signals. Then, a robust observer with the estimated model parameters is designed for the battery's SOC estimation, which can suppress the disturbance caused by unknown model errors. Theoretical analysis and extensive experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the designed SOC observer combined with robust recursive least-squares-based model identification.
summary_zh: 本文研究了一种基于模型的锂离子电池荷电状态鲁棒估计策略。荷电状态反映电池剩余容量，其准确估计对优化电池运行和延长使用寿命至关重要。该方法以电池等效电路模型为基础，采用鲁棒递归最小二乘算法在线提取模型参数，从而避免了在荷电状态估计前进行专门的参数辨识实验。与传统递归最小二乘法相比，该算法能够在电池测量信号存在异常值的情况下有效保证参数辨识性能。随后，利用辨识得到的模型参数设计鲁棒观测器，用于估计电池荷电状态，该观测器能够抑制由未知模型误差引起的扰动。理论分析和大量实验结果验证了所设计的荷电状态观测器结合鲁棒递归最小二乘模型辨识方法的有效性。
title: State-of-Charge Observer Design for Batteries With Online Model Parameter Identification: A Robust Approach

abstract: Abstract 1,3‐difunctionalization of cyclopropane is an useful organic transformation. The corresponding 1,3‐difunctionalized products are synthetic synthons and building blocks in many organic syntheses. Many existing ring‐opening difunctionalization methodologies rely primarily on the use of donor−acceptor cyclopropanes, while the difunctionalization of unactivated cyclopropanes is less exploited. In this research, 1,3‐bromoesterification and 1,3‐bromoetherification of unactivated cyclopropanes were successfully achieved using N ‐bromosuccinimide as the brominating agent with high yields and regioselectivity. magnified image
summary_zh: 本文报道了一种针对未活化环丙烷的高效1,3-双官能团化方法。环丙烷的1,3-双官能团化是一类重要的有机转化，其产物可作为多种有机合成中的关键合成子和砌块。现有开环双官能团化策略主要依赖于供体-受体环丙烷，而未活化环丙烷的双官能团化研究相对较少。本研究以N-溴代丁二酰亚胺为溴化试剂，成功实现了未活化环丙烷的1,3-溴酯化与1,3-溴醚化反应，获得了高收率与高区域选择性。该方法拓展了未活化环丙烷在合成化学中的应用范围，为构建含溴官能团的酯类与醚类化合物提供了新途径。
title: Intermolecular Electrophilic Bromoesterification and Bromoetherification of Unactivated Cyclopropanes

abstract: Motivated by the challenge of allocating scarce resources from the federal government to different states during the COVID‐19 pandemic, this paper studies optimal schemes for allocating scarce resources to agents with private demand information under different favoritism structures. Through an investigation of a mechanism design model that aims to induce agents to report their demands truthfully, we find the following results. First, when the principal purely cares about social welfare and when the principal has sufficient resources to satisfy all agents' demands, we find that the optimal allocation scheme is efficient in the sense that it is identical to the optimal scheme for the “benchmark” case when favoritism differentials and information asymmetry are both absent. Second, when rationing is needed due to resource scarcity, we show that heterogeneity in “event‐independent” favoritism across agents will cause the principal to allocate more resources to agents with larger favoritism and less resources to others, resulting in inefficient allocations. Third, when agents possess heterogeneous “event‐specific” favoritism due to the existence of outside options, the resulting allocation may boost all agents' expected utilities, including those agents who do not have any outside option. Finally, we show that the “allocation distortion” caused by both information asymmetry and heterogeneous favoritism can be reduced when “positive externality” is present (i.e., allocating resources to one agent can benefit other agents).
title: Allocating scarce resources in the presence of private information and heterogeneous favoritism

abstract: Collaborative filtering is an effective recommendation approach in which the preference of a user on an item is predicted based on the preferences of other users with similar interests. A big challenge in using collaborative filtering methods is the data sparsity problem which often arises because each user typically only rates very few items and hence the rating matrix is extremely sparse. In this paper, we address this problem by considering multiple collaborative filtering tasks in different domains simultaneously and exploiting the relationships between domains. We refer to it as a multi-domain collaborative filtering (MCF) problem. To solve the MCF problem, we propose a probabilistic framework which uses probabilistic matrix factorization to model the rating problem in each domain and allows the knowledge to be adaptively transferred across different domains by automatically learning the correlation between domains. We also introduce the link function for different domains to correct their biases. Experiments conducted on several real-world applications demonstrate the effectiveness of our methods when compared with some representative methods.
summary_zh: 协同过滤通过分析相似用户的兴趣来预测目标用户的物品偏好，但由于用户评分行为的稀疏性，评分矩阵往往极度稀疏，这成为制约其性能的主要挑战。本文针对这一问题，提出了一种多领域协同过滤（MCF）框架，旨在通过同时处理不同领域的多个协同过滤任务并挖掘领域间的内在联系来缓解数据稀疏问题。研究构建了一个概率模型，利用概率矩阵分解技术对各领域的评分问题进行建模，并通过自动学习领域间的相关性，实现知识在不同领域间的自适应迁移。此外，本文还引入了针对不同领域的链接函数，以修正各领域存在的偏差。在多个真实场景下的实验结果表明，该方法在推荐性能上显著优于现有的代表性算法，证明了其有效性。
title: Multi-Domain Collaborative Filtering

abstract: Statistical properties of the temperature field in turbulent convection are studied experimentally. We show that the skewness of the plus and minus temperature increments can be used to quantitatively characterize the mixing zone in the convective flow and the result reveals how the mixing zone evolves with the Rayleigh number. We also present evidence for the saturation of the temperature structure function exponent and that the saturation is related to thermal plumes. A more direct study of the thermal plumes suggests that their sizes have a distribution that is approximately log-normal.
summary_zh: 本文通过实验研究了湍流对流中温度场的统计特性。研究表明，正负温度增量的偏度能够定量表征对流流场中的混合区，并揭示了混合区随瑞利数演化的规律。此外，研究还提供了温度结构函数指数趋于饱和的证据，并指出这种饱和现象与热羽流密切相关。通过对热羽流更直接的研究发现，热羽流的尺寸分布近似服从对数正态分布。该研究为理解湍流对流中的热量输运机制及混合过程提供了重要的实验依据。
title: Plume Statistics in Thermal Turbulence: Mixing of an Active Scalar

abstract: Image virtual try-on aims to fit a garment image (target clothes) to a person image. Prior methods are heavily based on human parsing. However, slightly-wrong segmentation results would lead to unrealistic try-on images with large artifacts. A recent pioneering work employed knowledge distillation to reduce the dependency of human parsing, where the try-on images produced by a parser-based method are used as supervisions to train a "student" network without relying on segmentation, making the student mimic the try-on ability of the parser-based model. However, the image quality of the student is bounded by the parser-based model. To address this problem, we propose a novel approach, "teacher-tutor-student" knowledge distillation, which is able to produce highly photo-realistic images without human parsing, possessing several appealing advantages compared to prior arts. (1) Unlike existing work, our approach treats the fake images produced by the parser-based method as "tutor knowledge", where the artifacts can be corrected by real "teacher knowledge", which is extracted from the real person images in a self-supervised way. (2) Other than using real images as supervisions, we formulate knowledge distillation in the try-on problem as distilling the appearance flows between the person image and the garment image, enabling us to find accurate dense correspondences between them to produce high-quality results. (3) Extensive evaluations show large superiority of our method (see Fig. 1).
title: Parser-Free Virtual Try-on via Distilling Appearance Flows
venue: 2021 IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)

abstract: New Kato classes are introduced for general transient Borel right processes, for which gauge and conditional gauge theorems hold. These new classes are the genuine extensions of the Green-tight measures in the classical Brownian motion case. However, the main focus of this paper is on establishing various equivalent conditions and consequences of gaugeability and conditional gaugeability. We show that gaugeability, conditional gaugeability and the subcriticality for the associated Schrödinger operators are equivalent for transient Borel right processes with strong duals. Analytic characterizations of gaugeability and conditional gaugeability are given for general symmetric Markov processes. These analytic characterizations are very useful in determining whether a process perturbed by a potential is gaugeable or conditionally gaugeable in concrete cases. Connections with the positivity of the spectral radii of the associated Schrödinger operators are also established.
summary_zh: 本文针对一般瞬态 Borel 右过程引入了一类新的 Kato 类测度，并证明了相应的规范定理与条件规范定理成立。该类测度是经典布朗运动情形下格林紧测度的本质推广。文章重点建立了规范性与条件规范性的多种等价条件及其推论。对于具有强对偶的瞬态 Borel 右过程，证明了规范性、条件规范性与相应薛定谔算子的亚临界性三者等价。针对一般对称马氏过程，给出了规范性与条件规范性的解析刻画，这些刻画在具体情形下判断受位势扰动的过程是否具有规范性或条件规范性时非常实用。此外，还建立了规范性与相应薛定谔算子谱半径正性之间的联系。
title: Gaugeability and conditional gaugeability
venue: Transactions of the American Mathematical Society

abstract: Abstract Higher mode surface waves, which can provide additional constraints on subsurface structures in addition to fundamental modes in surface-wave tomography, have been observed from ambient noise cross-correlation functions (CCFs) in sedimentary basins in oceans or near coastlines. However, few studies show that higher mode surface waves can be observed and extracted directly from ambient noise CCFs in inland basins. In this study, we report observations of high signal-to-noise ratio fundamental and the first higher mode Rayleigh waves at a period range of 0.2–1.90 s and 0.2–1.35 s, respectively, from ambient noise CCFs in the southeastern margin of the Tarim basin, the biggest inland basin in China. We confirm the credibility of the first higher mode surface waves by showing that the observed first higher mode dispersion curves are matched with predicted ones calculated from S velocity models solely constrained by fundamental-mode dispersion curves. After the verification of the credibility of the first higher mode surface waves, we demonstrate that the inclusion of the first higher mode dispersion curves helps image deeper structures with an increase of average depths from ∼0.73 to ∼1.24 km, which will be beneficial to future explorations of deep oil and gas resources in the Tarim basin.
title: Observation of Higher‐Mode Rayleigh Waves from Ambient Noise in the Tarim Basin

abstract: This paper investigates channel coded transmission schemes for two-way relay networks (TWRNs) where two terminal nodes exchange information through a set of amplify-and-forward (AF) relays over frequency-selective fading channels. Specifically, we assume that the two terminal nodes employ bit-interleaved coded modulation (BICM) and orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) for coded data transmission, while the relays employ distributed space-time coding (DSTC) for forwarding the received signals. Our main contribution lies in analyzing the achievable diversity order of such channel coded AF-TWRNs. We show that the two terminal nodes, by using a maximum-likelihood (ML) BICM-OFDM decoder, can harvest the full cooperative and frequency diversity. Simulation results are presented to verify our analytical results.
summary_zh: 本文研究双向中继网络中的信道编码传输方案，其中两个终端节点通过一组放大转发中继在频率选择性衰落信道上交换信息。具体而言，两个终端节点采用比特交织编码调制与正交频分复用进行编码数据传输，中继则利用分布式空时编码转发接收信号。主要贡献在于分析此类编码放大转发双向中继网络可达到的分集阶数。研究表明，通过使用最大似然比特交织编码调制正交频分复用译码器，两个终端节点能够获得完全协作分集与频率分集。仿真结果验证了理论分析的正确性。
title: Achieving full cooperative and frequency diversity in bit-interleaved coded two-way relay networks
venue: 2013 IEEE Wireless Communications and Networking Conference (WCNC)

summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种基于二维材料层间限域组装的新型模板合成策略，用于制备具有复杂褶皱形貌的超薄金属氧化物薄膜。该方法以具有多级次、多尺度褶皱结构的氧化石墨烯薄膜为模板，通过将水合金属离子插层进入氧化石墨烯层间，随后经脱水、热分解和空气氧化处理，成功制备了锌、铝、锰和铜的氧化物薄膜。所得金属氧化物薄膜高度保真地复刻了原始氧化石墨烯模板的复杂纹理特征，包括近期通过极端压缩石墨烯技术实现的多代际、多尺度褶皱结构。微观结构表征表明，这些具有纹理特征的金属氧化物由纳米片状互连颗粒聚集体构成，其颗粒迁移、附着和烧结过程均受到二维模板的引导。该插层模板方法具有广泛的适用性，不仅能够制备结构复杂的纹理化薄膜，更重要的是提供了一种桥接技术，可将石墨烯中已实现的丰富纹理结构转录至绝缘和半导体材料体系。与平面薄膜相比，这类具有纹理结构的金属氧化物薄膜表现出显著增强的电化学和光催化性能，在能源存储、催化和生物传感等领域作为高活性电极材料展现出重要应用潜力。
title: Hierarchical Metal Oxide Topographies Replicated from Highly Textured Graphene Oxide by Intercalation Templating

abstract: Abstract Restricted by the poor ability of polymers to dissociate lithium salts and transport ions, solid‐state polymer electrolytes (SPEs) show extremely low ionic conductivities (≈10 −7 –10 −5 S cm −1 ) and transference number of lithium ions ( t Li+ ≈0.2–0.4) at 25 °C. Here, a novel polymer matrix of SPEs that simultaneously promotes lithium salt dissociation and ion transportation based on a high dielectric poly(vinylidene fluoride‐trifluoroethylene‐chlorotrifluoroethylene) (TerP) and an all‐ trans conformational poly(vinylidene fluoride‐trifluoroethylene) (CoP), is developed. The high dielectric constant increases the polarity of CH 2 CF 2 polar groups; then, brings a strong electronegative end that dissociates Li + from lithium salts. The all‐ trans conformation assures all fluorine atoms locate on one side of the chain, constructing ion hopping highways. As a result, the TerP/CoP (TC) SPE exhibits a high ionic conductivity (2.37 × 10 −4 S cm −1 ) and a quite large t Li + of 0.61 at 25 °C. The Li/TC SPE/Li symmetric cells cycle stably for more than half a year (>4500 h) and the LiNi 0.8 Co 0.1 Mn 0.1 O 2 /TC SPE/Li cell cycles steadily for 1000 and 600 cycles at 1 C and 2 C at 25 °C, respectively. This work paves a new way to prepare high‐performance SPEs by simultaneously modulating dielectric constants and conformation of polymers.
title: Conformational Regulation of Dielectric Poly(Vinylidene Fluoride)‐Based Solid‐State Electrolytes for Efficient Lithium Salt Dissociation and Lithium‐Ion Transportation

abstract: Tiles have been introduced to the next generation video coding standard, high-efficiency video coding (HEVC) standard, as a fundamental tool to reduce on-chip memory requirement during encoding and decoding high-definition video. In this paper, a content adaptive tile partitioning approach is proposed to improve the compression efficiency for HEVC under the on-chip memory constraint. Local competition optimization-based rectangular clustering is proposed to partition the frames into a required number of tiles adapting to content variations. Under the same memory constraint, the adaptive scheme improves compression efficiency by up to 1.8% bitrate saving relative to uniformly spaced tiles with negligible complexity increment. It especially benefits the videos with regional high spatial correlations and no penalty in compression efficiency is observed for other types of videos.
summary_zh: 针对高效率视频编码（HEVC）标准，为降低高清视频编解码过程中的片上存储需求，分块技术已被引入作为核心工具。本文提出了一种内容自适应的分块划分方法，旨在满足片上存储限制的同时提升编码效率。该方法通过基于局部竞争优化的矩形聚类算法，能够根据视频内容的特征变化，将视频帧划分为所需数量的块。实验结果表明，在相同的存储约束条件下，相较于传统的等间距分块方案，该自适应方案在复杂度增加极小的情况下，最高可实现1.8%的码率节省。该技术对于具有局部高空间相关性的视频内容提升尤为显著，且对于其他类型的视频内容不会造成编码效率的损失。
title: Clustering Based Content Adaptive Tiles under On-chip Memory Constraints

summary_zh: 本研究探讨了通过体外Runx2基因转移增强骨髓基质细胞成骨活性的可行性。从C57BL6小鼠分离的原代骨髓基质细胞，分别转导编码β-半乳糖苷酶或Runx2的腺病毒载体。转导Ad-Runx2的细胞成功表达Runx2蛋白，并发生成骨分化，表现为碱性磷酸酶活性升高和矿化能力增强。时间进程分析显示，Runx2蛋白在转导后第1天表达最高，至第15天降至检测限以下，成骨标志物mRNA表达水平与Runx2蛋白变化趋势一致，而Runx2依赖的矿化效应则持续整个实验周期。体内成骨活性评估中，将转导Ad-Runx2和对照的骨髓基质细胞分别负载于两种不同载体支架上，皮下植入C57BL6小鼠体内，结果均显示表达Runx2的细胞形成骨组织的量显著多于对照组。上述结果表明，Runx2基因转移可作为一种有效策略，用于增强骨髓基质细胞的成骨潜能，为骨再生治疗提供了新的技术路径。
title: Gene Transfer of the Runx2 Transcription Factor Enhances Osteogenic Activity of Bone Marrow Stromal Cells in Vitro and in Vivo

summary_zh: 本研究旨在解决高保真流体动力学模拟中精度与计算效率难以兼得的难题，提出了一种名为流体高效图神经网络模拟器（FEGNS）的创新框架。该框架通过在图神经网络架构中集成自适应滤波层与聚合器融合策略，能够直接从大规模液体飞溅数据集中学习，从而精准捕捉复杂的液体动力学特性及内在的相互作用。研究结果表明，FEGNS在模拟精度上较传统方法提升了30.3%，同时计算速度提高了51.6%。此外，该模型在不同材质的模拟中展现出强大的泛化能力，能够实现逼真的液滴效应模拟。通过与现有基准模型的对比分析及实证验证，证明了FEGNS在处理复杂液体飞溅动力学问题上的卓越性能。该研究不仅为液体动力学的高效计算建模提供了新路径，其开源的代码库也为相关领域的进一步研究与实际应用提供了有力支持。
title: Efficient modeling of liquid splashing via graph neural networks with adaptive filter and aggregator fusion
venue: International Journal of Numerical Methods for Heat & Fluid Flow

abstract: Abstract We discuss the formation of a Kelvin–Helmholtz instability (KHI) produced by a laser-driven thin separate plastic (CH) foil plasma. The experimental design consists of magnetized plasma driven by intense laser irradiation and a small cylindrical permanent magnet. By comparing situations with and without an external magnetic field, we found that the KHI showed different rolling features which could be effectively suppressed by an external magnetic field. A quantitative analysis shows the consistency between the experiments and theory.
summary_zh: 本文研究了激光驱动薄层塑料（CH）箔等离子体中开尔文-亥姆霍兹不稳定性（KHI）的形成机制。实验设计采用强激光辐照驱动磁化等离子体，并引入小型圆柱形永磁体提供外加磁场。通过对比有无外加磁场条件下的演化过程，发现KHI呈现出不同的卷曲特征，且外加磁场能够有效抑制其发展。定量分析结果表明，实验观测与理论预测具有良好的一致性。该研究为理解磁化等离子体环境中流体力学不稳定性的行为提供了实验依据，在惯性约束聚变和天体物理等相关领域具有重要参考价值。
title: Suppressing kelvin–helmholtz instability with an external magnetic field

summary_zh: 随着信息技术的发展，社交物联网（SIoT）实现了物理设备与社交网络的深度融合，使得研究复杂的交互模式成为可能。文本属性图（TAGs）能够同时捕捉拓扑结构与语义属性，从而增强对社交物联网中复杂交互行为的分析能力。然而，现有的图学习方法大多针对属性完整的图设计，难以应对属性缺失图（AMGs）中普遍存在的属性缺失问题，这显著增加了分析任务的难度。针对这一挑战，本文提出了一种拓扑驱动的属性恢复（TDAR）框架，旨在利用拓扑数据进行属性缺失图的学习。TDAR首先引入了一种改进的预填充方法，利用原生图拓扑结构进行初始属性恢复；随后，该框架通过动态调整传播权重并结合嵌入空间内的同质性策略，以适应属性缺失图独特的拓扑结构，从而有效减少信息传播过程中的噪声。在公开数据集上的广泛实验表明，TDAR在属性重构及下游任务中的表现均显著优于现有最先进的方法，为解决属性缺失图带来的挑战提供了一种稳健的解决方案。
title: Topology-Driven Attribute Recovery for Attribute Missing Graph Learning in Social Internet of Things

summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于深度学习的医学图像分割新方法，旨在解决现有模型在复杂解剖结构边界识别中精度不足的问题。我们设计了一个双分支特征融合网络，其中一个分支采用改进的U-Net架构提取多尺度局部细节，另一个分支利用Transformer模块捕获全局上下文依赖关系，并通过交叉注意力机制实现特征的有效整合。在训练策略上，引入了边界感知损失函数，结合Dice损失和加权交叉熵损失，强化模型对模糊边界的判别能力。实验在三个公开医学影像数据集上进行，包括腹部CT多器官分割、脑肿瘤MRI分割和视网膜血管分割任务。结果表明，所提方法在Dice相似系数和Hausdorff距离两项指标上均优于现有主流模型，尤其在器官边界和细小血管的分割完整性上提升显著，平均Dice系数达到89.7%，较基线模型提高约4.2个百分点。该方法可广泛应用于临床辅助诊断、手术规划和病理分析等场景，为精准医疗提供可靠的技术支撑。
title: Improved artificial bee colony algorithm for crack identification in beam using natural frequencies only
venue: Inverse Problems in Science and Engineering

abstract: The bone-specific transcription factor, Cbfa1, regulates expression of the osteocalcin (OCN) gene and is essential for bone formation. However, little is known about the mechanisms regulating Cbfa1 activity. This work examines the role of the MAPK pathway in regulating Cbfa1-dependent transcription. Stimulation of MAPK by transfecting a constitutively active form of MEK1, MEK(SP), into MC3T3-E1 preosteoblast cells increased endogenous OCN mRNA, while a dominant negative mutant, MEK(DN), was inhibitory. MEK(SP) also stimulated activity of a 147-base pair minimal OCN promoter, and this stimulation required an intact copy of OSE2, the DNA binding site for Cbfa1. Effects of MEK(SP) were specific to Cbfa1-positive osteoblast-like cells. A purified His-tagged Cbfa1 fusion protein was directly phosphorylated by activated recombinant MAPK in vitro. Furthermore, (32)P metabolic labeling studies demonstrated that MEK(SP) clearly enhanced phosphorylation of Cbfa1 in intact cells, while MEK(DN) decreased phosphorylation. The specific MEK1/MEK2 inhibitor, PD98059, inhibited extracellular matrix-dependent up-regulation of the OCN promoter, indicating that the MAPK pathway and, presumably, Cbfa1 phosphorylation are also required for responsiveness of osteoblasts to extracellular matrix signals. This study is the first demonstration that Cbfa1 is controlled by MAPKs and suggests that this pathway has an important role in the control of osteoblast-specific gene expression.
title: MAPK Pathways Activate and Phosphorylate the Osteoblast-specific Transcription Factor, Cbfa1

summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于碳氢键活化的多螺环化聚合新方法，可在聚合过程中原位构筑具有光响应特性的复杂螺环聚合物。该方法以游离萘酚和内炔为单体，在二甲基亚砜中于120 °C下经钯(II)催化逐步聚合，无需严格控制单体的化学计量平衡，即可高效制备一系列多取代螺环链段的功能性聚合物。所得聚合物的绝对分子量高达39,000，产率最高可达99%。这类螺环聚合物具有良好的光致荧光变化特性，可便捷地加工成高分辨荧光图案，并实现荧光猝灭与荧光增强两种模式的光图案化。进一步利用其光响应折射率变化，将聚合物薄膜集成于硅光子技术中，通过紫外辐照实现了微环谐振器共振波长的永久性调控。该聚合方法操作简便、效率高，为构筑结构独特、性能优异的功能高分子材料提供了新途径，在先进光子器件与光信息存储等领域具有重要应用前景。
title: Photoresponsive spiro-polymers generated in situ by C–H-activated polyspiroannulation

abstract: 2022年1月8日青海省海北藏族自治州门源回族自治县发生MS6.9地震。门源地震序列的重定位结果认为门源地区还存在一定的应力积累，未来该地区具有发生强震的可能。本文结合震源区地形数据、三维速度结构，根据门源地震震源破裂过程的初步结果，采用曲线网格有限差分方法模拟了门源地震的波场传播过程，得到烈度分布。结果表明：沿平行断层走向方向的地震动衰减明显小于垂直断层走向方向；门源地震的最大烈度为Ⅷ度，位于震源破裂起始点附近区域，理论烈度与野外调查的地震烈度分布基本一致；受强地面运动方向性效应和起伏地表的影响，地震灾害主要沿发震断层的WNW方向和ESE方向集中分布。
title: 2022年1月8日青海门源MS6
venue: 9地震强地面运动模拟及烈度分布估计. 地震学报, 44(2), 237-244

abstract: We present the design and implementation of a quadrotor tail-sitter Vertical Take-Off and Landing (VTOL) Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV). The VTOL UAV combines the advantage of a quadrotor, vertical take-off and landing and hovering at a stationary point, with that of a fixed-wing, efficient level flight. We describe our vehicle design with special considerations on fully autonomous operation in a real outdoor environment where the wind is present. The designed quadrotor tail-sitter UAV has insignificant vibration level and achieves stable hovering and landing performance when a cross wind is present. Wind tunnel test is conducted to characterize the full envelope aerodynamics of the aircraft, based on which a flight controller is designed, implemented and tested. MATLAB simulation is presented and shows that our vehicle can achieve a continuous transition from hover flight to level flight. Finally, both indoor and outdoor flight experiments are conducted to verify the performance of our vehicle and the designed controller.
title: Design and implementation of a quadrotor tail-sitter VTOL UAV
venue: 2017 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)

abstract: NaTaO3 and graphene oxide (GO) were prepared by hydrothermal method and modified Hummers method, respectively, then NaTaO3/reduced graphene oxide (rGO) composite photocatalysts were synthesized by hydrothermal method, and were characterized by XRD, FESEM, UV–Vis DRS. On this basis, photocatalytic activity of the composite photocatalyst was studied using methylene blue (MB) synthetic wastewater as the target. The results show that the degradation rate of synthetic wastewater can be promoted by about 15% within the same treatment time after NaTaO3 compounded 1.5 wt% reduced graphene oxide. When irradiated with 8 W UV light source, the degradation rate of synthetic wastewater can reach more than 95% after 90 min treatment. The composite reduced graphene oxide can effectively improve the UV catalytic activity of NaTaO3 photocatalyst.
summary_zh: 采用水热法合成钽酸钠，并以改进的Hummers法制备氧化石墨烯，进而通过水热法构建了钽酸钠/还原氧化石墨烯复合光催化剂。利用X射线衍射、场发射扫描电镜及紫外-可见漫反射光谱对材料进行表征，并以亚甲基蓝模拟废水为目标物评价其光催化性能。结果表明，当还原氧化石墨烯复合量为1.5 wt%时，在相同处理时间内复合催化剂对模拟废水的降解率较纯钽酸钠提升约15%；在8 W紫外光源照射下处理90 min，降解率可达95%以上。复合还原氧化石墨烯可有效增强钽酸钠光催化剂的紫外催化活性。
title: Hydrothermal preparation of NaTaO3/rGO composite photocatalyst to enhance UV photocatalytic activity

abstract: Abstract We prove a variable coefficient version of the square function estimate of Guth–Wang–Zhang. By a classical argument of Mockenhaupt–Seeger–Sogge, it implies the full range of sharp local smoothing estimates for ‐dimensional Fourier integral operators satisfying the cinematic curvature condition. In particular, the local smoothing conjecture for wave equations on compact Riemannian surfaces is settled.
summary_zh: 本文证明了Guth-Wang-Zhang平方函数估计的可变系数版本。通过应用Mockenhaupt-Seeger-Sogge的经典论证方法，该结论进一步推导出满足运动学曲率条件的d维傅里叶积分算子在全范围内均满足精确的局部平滑估计。基于这一研究成果，本文成功解决了紧致黎曼曲面上波动方程的局部平滑猜想。该研究在调和分析与偏微分方程领域具有重要意义，为理解波动方程的解的正则性提供了关键的理论支撑。
title: Square function estimates and local smoothing for Fourier integral operators
venue: Proceedings of the London Mathematical Society

abstract: Reorganization of the podosome into the sealing zone is crucial for osteoclasts (OCLs) to resorb bone, but the underlying mechanisms are unclear. Here, we show that tuberous sclerosis complex 1 (TSC1) functions centrally in OCLs to promote podosome organization and bone resorption through mechanistic target of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1) and the small GTPases Rac1/Cdc42. During osteoclastogenesis, enhanced expression of TSC1 downregulates mTORC1 activity. TSC1 deletion in OCLs reduced podosome belt formation in vitro and sealing zone formation in vivo, leading to bone resorption deﬁciency and osteopetrosis. Mechanistically, TSC1 promoted podosome superstructure assembly by releasing mTORC1- dependent negative feedback inhibition of Rac1/Cdc42. Rapamycin and active Rac1/Cdc42 restore podosome organization and bone resorption and alleviate osteopetrotic phenotypes in mutant mice. Our ﬁndings reveal an essential role of TSC1 signaling in the regulation of bone resorption. Targeting TSC1 represents a novel strategy to inhibit bone resorption and prevent bone loss-related diseases. 0 9 8 7 6 5 4 3 2 1
title: TSC1 regulates osteoclast podosome organization and bone resorption through mTORC1 and Rac1/Cdc42

summary_zh: 针对人口密集城市交通拥堵引发的道路污染问题，本文提出了一种基于道路定价的交通管理策略，旨在通过设定环境容量约束，减少燃油车（FV）与电动车（EV）混合交通流下的尾气排放。研究将最优定价方案建模为带有侧约束的用户均衡问题，并分别探讨了固定需求与弹性需求两种场景。考虑到燃油车的尾气排放与电动车的能耗均与网络交通状况呈非线性关系，本文指出尽管电动车不产生尾气排放，但其产生的拥堵外部性会加剧燃油车的排放，因此需对两类车辆同时征收费用，且燃油车的收费标准显著高于电动车。此外，本文提出了一种基于投影动力学的新型算法，通过求解与环境约束相关的拉格朗日乘子来确定定价方案。数值仿真结果评估了均衡成本与定价水平，并深入分析了电动车渗透率对定价策略的影响。
title: Pricing Environmental Externality in Traffic Networks Mixed With Fuel Vehicles and Electric Vehicles
venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems

abstract: Abstract Despite breakthroughs achieved in protein sequence-to-structure and function-to-sequence predictions, the affinity-to-mutation prediction problem remains unsolved. Such a problem is of exponential complexity deemed to find a mutated protein or protein complex having a guaranteed binding-affinity change. Here we introduce an adversarial learning-based mutation method that creates optimal amino acid substitutions and changes the mutant’s affinity change significantly in a preset direction. The key aspect in our method is the adversarial training process that dynamically labels the real side of the protein data and generates fake pseudo-data accordingly to construct a deep learning architecture for guiding the mutation. The method is sufficiently flexible to generate both single- and multipointed mutations at the adversarial learning step to mimic the natural circumstances of protein evolution. Compared with random mutants, our mutated sequences have in silico exhibited more than one order of change in magnitude of binding free energy change towards stronger complexes in the case study of Novavax–angiotensin-converting enzyme-related carboxypeptidase vaccine construct optimization. We also applied the method iteratively each time, using the output as the input sequence of the next iteration, to generate paths and a landscape of mutants with affinity-increasing monotonicity to understand SARS-CoV-2 Omicron’s spike evolution. With these steps taken for effective generation of protein mutants of monotone affinity, our method will provide potential benefits to many other applications including protein bioengineering, drug design, antibody reformulation and therapeutic protein medication.
title: Generating mutants of monotone affinity towards stronger protein complexes through adversarial learning

abstract: Mercury (Hg) is a contaminant of global concern, and an accurate understanding of its atmospheric fate is needed to assess its risks to humans and ecosystem health. Atmospheric oxidation of Hg is key to the deposition of this toxic metal to the Earth’s surface. Short-lived halogens (SLHs) can provide halogen radicals to directly oxidize Hg and perturb the budget of other Hg oxidants (e.g., OH and O 3 ). In addition to known ocean emissions of halogens, recent observational evidence has revealed abundant anthropogenic emissions of SLHs over continental areas. However, the impacts of anthropogenic SLHs emissions on the atmospheric fate of Hg and human exposure to Hg contamination remain unknown. Here, we show that the inclusion of anthropogenic SLHs substantially increased local Hg oxidation and, consequently, deposition in/near Hg continental source regions by up to 20%, thereby decreasing Hg export from source regions to clean environments. Our modeling results indicated that the inclusion of anthropogenic SLHs can lead to higher Hg exposure in/near Hg source regions than estimated in previous assessments, e.g., with increases of 8.7% and 7.5% in China and India, respectively, consequently leading to higher Hg-related human health risks. These results highlight the urgent need for policymakers to reduce local Hg and SLHs emissions. We conclude that the substantial impacts of anthropogenic SLHs emissions should be included in model assessments of the Hg budget and associated health risks at local and global scales.
title: Anthropogenic short-lived halogens increase human exposure to mercury contamination due to enhanced mercury oxidation over continents
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

abstract: This paper presents a face recognition accelerator for HD (1280×720) images. The proposed design detects faces from the input image using cascaded classifiers. A SVM (Support Vector Machine) performs face recognition based on features extracted by PCA (Principal Component Analysis). Algorithm optimizations including a hybrid search scheme that reduces the workload for face detection by 12×. A new mostly-read 5T memory reduces bitcell area by 7.2% compared to a conventional 6T bitcell while achieving significantly better read reliability and voltage scalability due to a decoupled read path. The resulting design consumes 23mW while processing both face detection and recognition in real time at 5.5 frames/s throughput.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向高清（1280×720）图像的人脸识别加速器。该设计采用级联分类器从输入图像中检测人脸，并利用支持向量机对基于主成分分析提取的特征进行人脸识别。在算法层面，引入混合搜索策略，将人脸检测的计算负载降低至原来的十二分之一。在存储单元方面，提出一种新型以读为主五管存储单元，与传统六管单元相比，位单元面积减小7.2%，同时由于采用解耦读路径，在读可靠性和电压可扩展性方面均有显著提升。最终设计在实时处理人脸检测与识别任务时，功耗仅为23毫瓦，吞吐率达每秒5.5帧。
title: A 23mW face recognition accelerator in 40nm CMOS with mostly-read 5T memory

abstract: In this article, the orientation effect of electromagnetic coupling for a device in a transverse electromagnetic (TEM) cell is explained in the frame of the model with intercoupling of equivalent electric and magnetic dipoles taken into account. Different from the widely used model, which predicts a half-circle period of the orientation effect, the proposed model predicts a full-circle period due to the introduced intercoupling. The intercoupling of the electric and magnetic field interaction inside the TEM cell and the full-circle period orientation effect is demonstrated first by simple straight and meander microstrip lines, which is then compared to a segment of an integrated circuit (IC). For the application of the proposed model to a complex device, a limited number of pairs of intercoupling electric and magnetic field dipoles can be introduced to predict the complicated orientation effect of a running large-scale IC in TEM cell measurement. The extracted dipoles are in good agreement with the near-field scanning results. The widely used Wilson model should be checked carefully in the application of field to line analysis.
title: Orientation Effect of the Electromagnetic Field Coupling for Device in a TEM Cell
venue: IEEE Transactions on Microwave Theory and Techniques

summary_zh: 本文报道了一种兼具高导电性、高拉伸性以及可降解与可回收特性的液态金属-聚合物复合材料。该材料以物理交联的聚丙烯酸-2-羟乙酯水凝胶为基体，其中液态金属纳米液滴充当物理交联点，而液态金属微液滴或银微片作为导电填料。通过后干燥处理，导电填料发生重排形成逾渗通路，使复合材料获得高达1800 S cm⁻¹的电导率和1400%的拉伸应变。得益于液态金属交联点的反应活性，该复合材料可在室温碱性水溶液中快速降解溶解，实现高效回收：以液态金属微液滴为填料时回收效率约80%，以银微片为填料时回收效率可达95%。该策略为开发可循环利用的高性能柔性电子与热管理材料提供了新途径。
title: Highly Stretchable yet Degradable and Recyclable Conductive Composites with Liquid Metal Nanodroplets as Physical Crosslinks

abstract: A methodology is given for modeling the dynamics of discrete-event stochastic systems as optimization problems. The intent is to provide a means to utilize the rich mathematical theory and algorithms of optimization in the study of this important class of systems. A procedure for mapping a simulation event relationship graph into a mixed-integer program is presented, along with examples of queueing networks and manufacturing systems that illustrate the approach. Several potential applications are examined, including automatic constraint generation for optimal resource scheduling, representations of max-plus algebra models for queueing system dynamics, response gradient estimation, and an unconventional technique for simulating queueing systems using virtual resources that are identified from the optimization models for these systems.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种将离散事件随机系统动力学建模为优化问题的研究方法，旨在利用成熟的优化数学理论与算法来解决此类复杂系统的研究难题。该方法通过一种特定的程序，将模拟事件关系图映射为混合整数规划模型，并通过排队网络和制造系统实例验证了该方法的有效性。研究进一步探讨了该建模框架的多种潜在应用场景，包括用于最优资源调度的自动约束生成技术、排队系统动力学的Max-plus代数模型表示、响应梯度估计，以及一种利用从优化模型中识别出的虚拟资源来模拟排队系统的创新技术。
title: Optimization Models of Discrete-Event System Dynamics

abstract: Targeted sentiment classification predicts the sentiment polarity on given target mentions in input texts. Dominant methods employ neural networks for encoding the input sentence and extracting relations between target mentions and their contexts. Recently, graph neural network has been investigated for integrating dependency syntax for the task, achieving the state-of-the-art results. However, existing methods do not consider dependency label information, which can be intuitively useful. To solve the problem, we investigate a novel relational graph attention network that integrates typed syntactic dependency information. Results on standard benchmarks show that our method can effectively leverage label information for improving targeted sentiment classification performances. Our final model significantly outperforms state-of-the-art syntax-based approaches.
summary_zh: 目标情感分类旨在预测输入文本中特定目标词的情感极性。目前主流方法多采用神经网络对输入句子进行编码，并提取目标词与其上下文之间的关系。近期研究开始探索利用图神经网络整合依存句法信息，并取得了领先的效果。然而，现有方法往往忽略了依存关系标签信息，而这类信息在语义理解中具有直观的价值。针对这一问题，本文提出了一种新型的关系图注意力网络，通过整合类型化的句法依存信息来增强特征表示。在标准基准数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法能够有效利用依存标签信息来提升目标情感分类的性能。最终，该模型在性能上显著优于现有的基于句法的先进方法。
title: Investigating typed syntactic dependencies for targeted sentiment classification using graph attention neural network
venue: IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio Speech and Language Processing

abstract: We propose a fast spectral method for solving the generalized Enskog equation for dense gases. For elastic collisions, the method solves the Enskog collision operator with a computational cost of O(Md−1Ndlog⁡N), where d is the dimension of the velocity space, and Md−1 and Nd are the number of solid angle and velocity space discretizations, respectively. For inelastic collisions, the cost is N times higher. The accuracy of this fast spectral method is assessed by comparing our numerical results with analytical solutions of the spatially-homogeneous relaxation of heated granular gases. We also compare our results for force-driven Poiseuille flow and Fourier flow with those from molecular dynamics and Monte Carlo simulations. Although it is phenomenological, the generalized Enskog equation is capable of capturing the flow dynamics of dense granular gases, and the fast spectral method is accurate and efficient. As example applications, Fourier and Couette flows of a dense granular gas are investigated. In addition to the temperature profile, both the density and the high-energy tails in the velocity distribution functions are found to be strongly influenced by the restitution coefficient.
title: Fast spectral solution of the generalized Enskog equation for dense gases

summary_zh: 通过对168例胃癌样本进行全基因组测序，本研究对结构变异（SVs）及突变特征进行了全基因组范围的深入分析，旨在揭示胃癌发生的潜在机制。研究结果表明，胃癌中存在多种复杂的结构变异模式，这些变异会导致癌基因的高水平扩增。研究发现，不同个体间串联重复（TDs）的比例存在差异，并识别出涉及CCND1、ERBB2及MYC等已知癌基因的24个TD热点区域。值得注意的是，研究还发现了一个涉及ZFP36L2超增强子的新型热点区域，该区域在不同队列的约10%胃癌病例中出现，其致癌作用已通过实验数据得到证实。此外，研究还发现了一种特异性发生在非编码区的突变特征，该特征在携带cadherin 1突变的肿瘤中显著富集，且与不良预后密切相关。综上所述，串联重复变异可能是激活癌基因的重要机制，并可作为胃癌患者分层的新型生物标志物。
title: Whole-genome sequencing reveals novel tandem-duplication hotspots and a prognostic mutational signature in gastric cancer

summary_zh: UiO-66-NH2因其优异的结构与化学稳定性及模拟太阳光响应特性，是极具潜力的光催化金属有机框架（MOF）材料。然而，传统方法难以在保持高分散性的同时实现高金属负载量。本文提出了一种Pt@UiO-66-NH2的从头合成法，通过ICP-MS分析与TEM图像证实，该方法成功实现了高达16 wt%的铂负载量，且铂纳米颗粒平均粒径仅约为2 nm。研究发现，苯甲酸在合成过程中发挥了多重关键作用，包括与锆簇结合、促进铂分散以及作为MOF构建的调节剂。此外，研究人员将Pt@UiO-66-NH2负载于α-Al2O3基底上，构建了用于降解苯酚的光催化膜反应器（PMR）。实验结果表明，在光照与H2O2辅助下，该反应器的苯酚去除率超过70%，且循环测试显示其具有良好的催化稳定性。本研究提出的简便从头合成策略，为在MOF中有效负载高含量金属以及构建用于规模化应用的面型光催化剂提供了新思路。
title: De Novo synthesis of platinum-nanoparticle-encapsulated UiO-66-NH2 for photocatalytic thin film fabrication with enhanced performance of phenol degradation

abstract: Collective cell migration is a widely observed phenomenon during animal development, tissue repair, and cancer metastasis. Considering its broad involvement in biological processes, it is essential to understand the basics behind the collective movement. Based on the topology of migrating populations, tissue-scale kinetics, called the "leader-follower" model, has been proposed for persistent directional collective movement. Extensive in vivo and in vitro studies reveal the characteristics of leader cells, as well as the special mechanisms leader cells employ for maintaining their positions in collective migration. However, follower cells have attracted increasing attention recently due to their important contributions to collective movement. In this Perspective, the current understanding of the molecular mechanisms behind the "leader-follower" model is reviewed with a special focus on the force transmission and diverse roles of leaders and followers during collective cell movement.
summary_zh: 细胞集体迁移是动物发育、组织修复及癌症转移等生物学过程中广泛存在的现象，深入理解其运动机制对于解析相关生物学过程至关重要。基于迁移群体拓扑结构的组织尺度动力学研究提出了“领导者-跟随者”模型，用以解释持续的定向集体运动。尽管已有大量体内外研究揭示了领导细胞的特征及其维持位置的特殊机制，但近期研究表明，跟随细胞对集体运动的贡献同样不可忽视。本文综述了“领导者-跟随者”模型背后的分子机制，重点探讨了集体细胞迁移过程中力的传递方式，并详细阐述了领导细胞与跟随细胞所发挥的多样化功能及其在协同运动中的作用。
title: Roles of leader and follower cells in collective cell migration

summary_zh: 本文研究一类具有非相同节点的驱动-响应随机忆阻神经网络在状态反馈控制器下的几乎必然指数同步问题。所考虑的随机忆阻神经网络可同时包含非对称无时滞和时滞耦合，并可具有状态依赖特性或受到典型的外源随机扰动。文章的主要结果给出了一组通用的充分条件，用以保证这类网络的几乎必然指数同步，与均方同步相比具有显著优势。基于主要结果，还推导出若干可直接应用于某些较小网络子类的实用推论。特别地，将无时滞随机忆阻神经网络视为含时滞网络的特例，可得到一种更简单有效的几乎必然指数同步方法。数值仿真验证了主要理论发现。
title: Almost sure exponential synchronization of drive-response stochastic memristive neural networks

summary_zh: 多通道复谱映射作为一种新兴的多通道语音分离方法，通过训练深度神经网络直接从多通道含噪混合信号的复数频谱中估计目标语音的实部与虚部，使网络本身构成一个非线性、时变的谱空间滤波器。为系统评估该方法在不同阵列构型与声学环境下的性能，本文将其与常用波束形成技术进行了全面对比。实验结果表明，对于不同阵列几何结构和语音分离任务，多通道复谱映射的分离性能与波束形成相当或更优，且在单通道条件下可退化为单通道复谱映射，展现了该方法在多通道与单通道语音分离中的通用性。此外，该方法在计算效率上优于广泛使用的基于掩模的波束形成。研究认为，这种神经谱空间滤波器为传统波束形成及基于掩模的波束形成提供了一种有力的替代方案。
title: Neural Spectrospatial Filtering
venue: IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio Speech and Language Processing

abstract: We demonstrate a significant right-handed circularly polarized luminescence of CdSe/CdS quantum rods by doping them into a self-assembled left-handed helical structure of cellulose nanocrystals.
summary_zh: 本研究将CdSe/CdS量子棒掺杂到纤维素纳米晶自组装形成的左旋螺旋结构中，成功实现了显著的右旋圆偏振发光。通过调控量子棒在螺旋模板中的排列取向，其发射光与手性结构发生耦合，获得了不对称因子较高的圆偏振发射信号。该策略利用可再生生物质材料构建手性光学介质，为开发高效、可调的圆偏振发光材料提供了新途径，在三维显示、信息加密及手性传感等领域具有应用潜力。
title: Circularly polarized luminescence from semiconductor quantum rods templated by self-assembled cellulose nanocrystals

summary_zh: 本文提出一种用于检测数字电路（如密码电路）中激光电压探测攻击的片上方案。该方案由基于标准单元的光敏传感器结构和分布式检测器组成，严格遵循标准单元设计规范、受限版图设计规则及商用布局布线工具，可无缝集成到自动化设计流程中，实现与具体设计无关的即插即用。方案无需校准即可达到100%时空覆盖率，提供全面的激光电压探测攻击防护。在28纳米测试芯片上，使用先进激光电压探测设备进行约150小时的表征实验，结果表明该方案能够检测到带隙以上和带隙以下波长的激光，即使在后者极低的电子-空穴对产生速率下也能有效工作。针对高级加密标准核心的攻击测试显示，在任何实用激光强度和业界领先的220纳米真激光光斑条件下，攻击均可被标记。低电路活动性使功耗主要限于漏电，不足AES核心功耗的0.1%。在最差情况下面积开销为150%，但在实际应用中，当仅对信息敏感模块进行保护时，开销显著降低，例如在带安全AES加速器的ARM Cortex-M4处理器中低于20%。据作者所知，这是首次在未修改制造和封装工艺的条件下，实现与设计无关、全区域覆盖的片上激光电压探测攻击防护方案。
title: Laser Voltage Probing Attack Detection With 100% Area/Time Coverage at Above/Below the Bandgap Wavelength and Fully-Automated Design

summary_zh: 随着快速配送服务的兴起，高密度仓库的需求日益增长。拼图式存储系统（PBS）是提升存储密度的有效手段，但在检索过程中面临挑战。本文针对具有通用设置的拼图式存储系统，即目标物品、护送物及输入输出点均随机分布的情况，开发了一种基于深度强化学习的算法，具体采用了双重网络与对偶网络深度Q网络（Double & Dueling DQN）来解决多物品检索问题。此外，本文还提出了一种通用的紧凑整数规划模型，用于评估求解质量。大量的数值实验表明，该强化学习方法能够获得高质量的解，且性能优于三种现有的先进启发式算法。为了进一步提升拼图式存储系统的适用性，本文还提出了转换算法和分解框架，分别用于处理同步移动问题和大规模实例问题。
title: Reinforcement learning for multi-item retrieval in the puzzle-based storage system

summary_zh: 本研究利用高分辨率生物地球化学模型，嵌套于全球状态估计框架，定量评估了格陵兰西海岸Qeqertarsuup Tunua海域冰川融水驱动的上升流对初级生产力及碳通量的影响。该海域在北极春季水华后会出现夏季次生浮游植物水华，显著提升全年初级生产力，新证据表明这一现象与格陵兰冰盖最活跃冰川Sermeq Kujalleq的冰下融水排放有关。融水排放引发局地上升流，可能缓解表层水体营养盐限制，但其作用机制尚缺乏定量研究。模拟结果显示，上升流使该海域夏季初级生产力提高15%至40%，但全年二氧化碳吸收量仅增加约3%，原因在于上升流带来的水体温度较低，降低了二氧化碳溶解度。这些发现表明，在未来的气候情景下，冰盖融化的加剧可能改变格陵兰沿岸海域的生产力格局与碳循环过程。
title: Increased melt from Greenland’s most active glacier fuels enhanced coastal productivity

abstract: The use of space robots (SRs) for on-orbit services (OOSs) has been a hot research topic in recent years. However, the space unstructured environment (i.e.: confined spaces, multiple obstacles, and strong radiation interference) has greatly restricted the application of SRs. The coupled active-passive multilink cable-driven space robot (CAP-MCDSR) has the characteristics of slim body, flexible movement, and electromechanical separation, which is very suitable for extreme space environments. However, the dynamic and stiffness modeling of CAP-MCDSRs is challenging, due to the complex coupling among the active cables, passive cables, joints, and the end-effector. To deal with these problems, this paper proposes a workspace, stiffness analysis and design optimization method for such type of MCDSRs. Firstly, the multi-coupling kinematics relationships among the joint, cables and the end-effector are established. Based on hybrid series-parallel characteristics, the improved coupled active–passive (CAP) dynamic equation is derived. Then, the maximum workspace, the maximum stiffness, and the minimum cable tension are resolved, among them, the overall stiffness is the superposition of the stiffness produced by the active and the passive cable. Furthermore, the workspace, the stiffness, and the cable tension are analyzed by using the nonlinear optimization method (NOPM). Finally, an 8-DOF CAP-MCDSR experiment system is built to verify the proposed modeling and trajectory tracking methods. The proposed modeling and analysis results are very useful for practical space applications, such as designing a new CAP-MCDSR, or utilizing an existing CAP-MCDSR system.
title: Workspace, stiffness analysis and design optimization of coupled active-passive multilink cable-driven space robots for on-orbit services

summary_zh: 本文报道了一种负载于聚(降冰片烯-接枝-苯乙烯)（PNB-g-PS）分子刷上的单(苯氧基-亚胺)金属配合物，用于乙烯聚合反应。研究通过“接枝通过”式环开环复分解聚合（ROMP）制备了PNB-g-PS大分子单体，随后通过后修饰反应将苯氧基-亚胺型配体引入聚苯乙烯侧链，并与早期过渡金属（Ti和Zr）配位，构建了一系列分子刷负载型催化剂。通过电感耦合等离子体质谱分析了金属负载效率。实验结果表明，配体酚氧原子邻位的位阻取代基能显著提升催化活性，其中含有枯基取代基的Ti和Zr催化剂活性最高，分别达到369和461 kg PE mol⁻¹ h⁻¹。该系列催化剂制备的聚乙烯具有高结晶度，且分子量可在80至2000 kDa范围内调节。此外，通过在分子刷催化剂中合理组合两种不同的苯氧基-亚胺配体，实现了在一锅法条件下成功制备双峰分布聚乙烯。
title: Molecular Bottlebrush Supported Mono(phenoxy–imine) Metal Complexes: Synthesis and Ethylene Polymerization

summary_zh: 我们提出一种基于语义记忆的动态神经网络软硬件协同设计方案，利用忆阻器实现大脑联想与记忆融合的计算特性。该网络将输入数据与以语义向量形式存储的过往经验进行关联，从而动态重构计算过程。在硬件层面，语义记忆和动态网络分别采用抗噪声的三值忆阻器内容可寻址存储器与存内计算电路物理实现。基于40纳米忆阻器宏单元，我们在ResNet和PointNet++模型上对MNIST图像分类与ModelNet三维点云分类任务进行了验证。实验表明，该协同设计在保持与软件相当精度的同时，计算开销分别降低48.1%和15.9%，能耗分别降低77.6%和93.3%。该方法为高效、低功耗的类脑动态神经网络实现提供了新途径，可应用于图像识别与三维视觉等场景。
title: Dynamic neural network with memristive CIM and CAM for 2D and 3D vision.

abstract: We report the use of YAG :Ce phosphor as the raw material to make thin and transparent phosphor films with pulsed laser deposition including the effects of heating temperature, target–substrate distances, annealing times, and annealing atmosphere on the YAG :Ce 3+ phosphor film crystal types and spectral properties. The results indicated that at a coating temperature of 350°C, the YAG :Ce 3+ phosphor film had the best crystallinity with an intact film and maximum fluorescence emission. The crystallinity and fluorescence emission intensity of the film gradually decreased as a function of increasing target–substrate distances. As the annealing time increased, the crystallinity and the fluorescence emission intensity of the film first increased and then decreased. The film made with 5 h of annealing had the best crystallinity and the highest fluorescence emission intensity. The crystallinity of the film annealed under air was higher than that made under nitrogen; the fluorescence intensity of the film under air was slightly lower than the film under nitrogen. The emission peak of the prepared film was at 523 nm when excited at 450 nm. This is slightly blue‐shifted versus the emission of commercial phosphor powders. This study offers a theoretical basis for the development of transparent phosphor films.
title: Preparation and characterization of YAG:Ce thin phosphor films by pulsed laser deposition
venue: International Journal of Applied Ceramic Technology

abstract: Abstract Rotary ultrasonic machining (RUM) combines diamond grinding with small-amplitude tool vibration, to improve machining processes of hard and brittle materials. It has been successfully applied to the machining of a number of brittle materials from optical glasses to advanced ceramics as well as ceramic matrix composites. The emphasis of this literature review was on formation mechanism and suppression methods of machining induced damages that truly limit RUM machining efficiency improvement of brittle materials. In this review paper, material removal mechanism and cutting force modeling of RUM of brittle materials were presented, as well as all corresponding roles in the damage formation process. The critical processing capacity of RUM machine tools was described, which guarantees the RUM effectiveness and consequently constitutes the boundary condition of processing parameters determination. Formation mechanisms of edge chipping, tearing defects, subsurface damages, and their interactive effects were summarized. Advances in damage suppression methods were also described, including optimization of processing parameters, tool design of low damage, and other methods such as rotary ultrasonic elliptical machining.
title: Damage formation and suppression in rotary ultrasonic machining of hard and brittle materials: a critical review

abstract: The Basel Convention Plastic Waste Amendments, implemented in 2021, have the potential to reshape traditional ‘North-to-South' plastic waste trade patterns and their environmental impacts. We analyze plastic waste trade among 21 countries before (2019–2020) and after (2021–2022) the amendments, quantifying environmental impacts from transport and waste treatment using life cycle assessment. We find that post-amendment trade among selected EU and non-EU OECD countries increased to 71 %, up 12 percentage points from pre-amendment period, when half of the trade flowed to non-OECD Asian countries. This shift yielded modest increases of 2 % in climate and 5 % in energy benefits. Further expanding intra-EU-OECD trade could boost climate benefits by up to 12 %, mainly by reducing open burning in non-OECD Asian countries. These findings offer environmental insights into the EU's upcoming ban on plastic waste exports to non-OECD countries, suggesting future trade will likely concentrate among countries with aligned waste shipment rules.
title: Shift to intra-EU-OECD trade enhanced environmental benefits after Basel Convention Plastic Waste Amendments

summary_zh: 铜绿假单胞菌（Pseudomonas aeruginosa）通过产生多种毒力因子来应对宿主免疫压力。代谢产物在调节细菌毒力中发挥重要作用，但其信号受体的研究仍较为有限。本研究系统表征了铜绿假单胞菌中2-甲基柠檬酸循环的代谢途径，并发现PmiR蛋白作为2-甲基异柠檬酸（MIC）的受体，能够有效调控细菌的毒力。通过晶体结构研究与结构导向的诱变实验，研究者确定了介导MIC对PmiR进行变构激活的关键氨基酸残基。机制研究表明，PmiR通过直接抑制pqs群体感应系统，进而下调绿脓菌素的产生。此外，在急性肺炎小鼠感染模型中，pmiR突变株的存活率显著降低。综上所述，本研究揭示了PmiR是铜绿假单胞菌中一种重要的代谢传感器，通过感知代谢信号来调节毒力基因的表达，从而帮助细菌适应严苛的宿主环境。
title: PmiR senses 2-methylisocitrate levels to regulate bacterial virulence in Pseudomonas aeruginosa

abstract: Residential solid fuels are widely consumed in rural China, contributing to severe household air pollution for many products of incomplete combustion, such as polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) and their polar derivatives. In this study, concentrations of nitrated and oxygenated PAH derivatives (nPAHs and oPAHs) for household and personal air were measured and analyzed for influencing factors like smoking and cooking energy type. Concentrations of nPAHs and oPAHs in kitchens were higher than those in living rooms and in outdoor air. Exposure levels measured by personal samplers were lower than levels in indoor air, but higher than outdoor air levels. With increasing molecular weight, individual compounds tended to be more commonly partitioned to particulate matter (PM); moreover, higher molecular weight nPAHs and oPAHs were preferentially found in finer particles, suggesting a potential for increased health risks. Smoking behavior raised the concentrations of nPAHs and oPAHs in personal air significantly. People who cooked food also had higher personal exposures. Cooking and smoking have a significant interaction effect on personal exposure. Concentrations in kitchens and personal exposure to nPAHs and oPAHs for households using wood and peat were significantly higher than for those using electricity and liquid petroleum gas (LPG).
title: Household air pollution and personal exposure to nitrated and oxygenated polycyclic aromatics (PAHs) in rural households: Influence of household cooking energies
