summary_zh: 本研究利用冷冻电镜技术解析了人源磷酸化酶激酶在非活性与活性状态下的近原子分辨率结构，揭示了其α、β、γ、δ四个亚基间的相互作用与空间排布。结果表明，磷酸化的α和β亚基促使PhK呈现更为紧凑的构象，而钙离子则驱动δ亚基沿γ亚基螺旋滑动；两种调控信号协同解除γ亚基的自抑制，实现激酶激活。通过交联质谱分析，进一步鉴定了PhK与其底物糖原磷酸化酶在两种状态下的不同结合模式。该工作阐明了PhK受磷酸化与钙离子双重调控的分子机制，为深入理解糖原贮积症IX型及相关肿瘤发生机制提供了关键结构基础。
title: Molecular basis for the regulation of human phosphorylase kinase by phosphorylation and Ca2+

summary_zh: 我们提出注意力增强网络AttaNet，用于在保持高效率的同时捕获全局上下文与多层次语义，以解决实时语义分割中这两类特征提取常伴随高计算复杂度的问题。该网络包含两个核心模块：条带注意力模块SAM和注意力融合模块AFM。针对分割精度较低的困难图像中垂直条带区域远多于水平条带的现象，SAM采用条带化操作，在垂直方向上大幅降低全局上下文编码的复杂度，同时相比非局部方法保留了大部分上下文信息。AFM则通过跨层聚合策略控制计算量，并在融合不同层级特征时引入注意力机制，为每个像素自适应地加权各层特征的重要性，从而高效获得多层次表示。在Cityscapes和ADE20K两个语义分割基准上的大量实验表明，AttaNet实现了不同速度与精度的平衡：在Cityscapes上分别达到71 FPS/79.9% mIoU、130 FPS/78.5% mIoU和180 FPS/70.1% mIoU，并在ADE20K上取得领先性能。该方法适用于对实时性要求较高的场景理解任务。
title: AttaNet: Attention-Augmented Network for Fast and Accurate Scene Parsing
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

abstract: Most DNA-binding residue prediction methods overlooked the motif features which are important for the recognition between protein and DNA. In order to efficiently use the motif features for prediction, we first propose to use Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) in deep learning to extract discriminant motif features. We then propose a neural network classifier, referred to as CNNsite, by combining the extracted motif features, sequence features and evolutionary features. The evaluation on PDNA-62, PDNA-224 and TR-265 shows that motif features perform better than sequence features and evolutionary features. The evaluation on PDNA-62, PDNA-224 and an independent data set shows that CNNsite also outperforms the previous methods. We also show that many motif features composed by the residues which play important roles in DNA-protein interactions have large discriminant powers. It indicates that CNNsite has very good ability to extract important motif features for DNA-binding residue prediction.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于卷积神经网络（CNN）的DNA结合残基预测方法CNNsite，重点解决现有方法忽略模体特征的问题。该方法首先利用深度学习中的CNN从蛋白质序列中提取具有判别能力的模体特征，随后将模体特征与序列特征和进化特征相结合，构建神经网络分类器进行预测。在PDNA-62、PDNA-224和TR-265三个基准数据集上的评估结果表明，模体特征的预测性能优于序列特征和进化特征；在PDNA-62、PDNA-224及独立测试集上的对比实验进一步显示，CNNsite的预测效果优于已有方法。此外，研究发现许多由在DNA-蛋白质相互作用中起关键作用的残基构成的模体特征具有较高的判别能力，表明CNNsite能够有效提取重要的模体特征用于DNA结合残基预测。该方法为蛋白质-DNA识别机制研究提供了新的计算手段。
title: Prediction of DNA-binding residues from sequence information using convolutional neural network
venue: International Journal of Data Mining and Bioinformatics

summary_zh: 空间目标的异常动力学感知对于空间监视任务至关重要。由于逆合成孔径雷达（ISAR）图像序列具有内在的距离-多普勒投影机制，其在非合作目标的异常动力学解释方面具有巨大的应用潜力。本文提出了一种基于深度神经网络的自动化架构，用于从ISAR图像序列中识别空间目标的异常动力学特征。该方法通过引入堆叠稀疏自编码器（SSAE）网络的联合稀疏约束，学习ISAR图像序列中的几何特征流，从而实现对目标动力学特征的精简表征。随后，利用长短期记忆网络（LSTM）对编码后的特征流进行处理，将异常动力学识别任务转化为序列分类任务。大量实验结果表明，该方案在识别精度和处理效率方面均具有显著优势。
title: Abnormal Dynamic Recognition of Space Targets From ISAR Image Sequences With SSAE-LSTM Network
venue: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing

summary_zh: 先天性对称性环状皮肤皱褶（CSCSC）是一种临床特征显著的遗传性疾病。本研究通过全外显子组测序（WES）结合表型驱动的数据分析方法，对一名具有语言表达障碍、轻度或正常过度生长、面部畸形以及双侧前臂和踝部显著环状皮肤皱褶症状的2岁男童进行了分子遗传学研究。研究结果显示，该患儿携带一个新发错义突变MAPRE2变异（c.518G>A, p.Arg173Gln），该变异被确定为导致其复杂临床表型的分子原因。通过对该病例的详细临床特征描述，并将其与已报道的MAPRE2变异个体进行对比，本研究进一步明确了CSCSC2的表型谱。本研究首次报道了亚洲裔MAPRE2致病突变导致的CSCSC2病例，不仅扩展了该疾病的临床表现范围，也丰富了其遗传学谱系，为相关遗传性皮肤疾病的诊断提供了重要依据。
title: A de novo MAPRE2 variant in a patient with congenital symmetric circumferential skin creases type 2

abstract: The green vehicle routing problem with private capacitated alternative fuel stations (GrVRP-PCAFS) extends the traditional green vehicle routing problem by considering capacitated refueling stations, where a limited number of vehicles can refuel simultaneously and additional vehicles must wait. This feature presents new challenges for route planning, as waiting times at stations must be managed while keeping route durations within limits and reducing total travel distance. This article presents METS, a novel memetic algorithm (MA) with separate constraint-based tour segmentation (SCTS) and a local search procedure tailored for solving GrVRP-PCAFS. METS balances exploration and exploitation through three key components. For exploration, the SCTS strategy splits giant tours to generate diverse solutions, and the search process is guided by a comprehensive fitness evaluation function to dynamically control feasibility and diversity to produce solutions that are both diverse and near-feasible. For exploitation, the local search procedure incorporates tailored move operators with constant-time evaluation mechanisms, enabling efficient examination of large solution neighborhoods. Experimental results demonstrate that METS discovers 31 new best-known solutions out of 40 instances in existing benchmark sets, achieving substantial improvements over current state-of-the-art methods. Additionally, a new large-scale benchmark set based on real-world logistics data is introduced to facilitate future research.
title: Memetic Search for Green Vehicle Routing Problem with Private Capacitated Refueling Stations

abstract: In-situ rheo-optical methods are used to guide electron microscopy (TEM) and X-ray scattering (SAXS) studies of structure development during flow-induced alignment in a lamellar block copolymer melt (nearly symmetric polystyrene−polyisoprene diblock, ODT ≃ 172 °C). The progress of shear-induced alignment is recorded in real-time using flow birefringence; at selected points during alignment samples are taken for ex-situ characterization by TEM and SAXS along all three axes (v, ∇v, ∇ × v) of the flow geometry. Three different trajectories are examined: perpendicular alignment and two qualitatively different routes to parallel alignment in the high-frequency regime (ω > ). In general, the initial “fast” process not only enhances the projection of the orientation distribution that corresponds to the final state but also increases other projections of the distribution; the late-stage “slow” process eliminates these other projections and perfects a single alignment. For example, the highest frequency path to parallel alignment begins by transforming poorly organized regions into layers that are predominantly oriented along the parallel and transverse directions. The transition to the slow process is marked by the development of a characteristic texture in which tilt wall boundaries normal to the flow direction separate bands that form a repeating “chevron” pattern (layers tilted up and down about the ∇×v axis). The coarsening of this pattern dominates the slow process, during which the transverse projection is also eliminated.
title: Dynamics of Shear-Induced Alignment of a Lamellar Diblock: A Rheo-optical, Electron Microscopy, and X-ray Scattering Study

abstract: Nonlinear pricing is frequently used by fast-fashion retailers (e.g., Zara). Discounts of the form “Buy 2, get 20% off” or “Buy 3 and save 30%” are becoming common. As revealed in a recent study by Gallego et al. (2019), nonlinear dynamic pricing can significantly improve a company’s revenue, by as much as 30%–90%, especially when inventories are high and the relative value of the marginal unit is neither too low nor too high, a situation that is common in fast-fashion retailing. They find that a single quantity discount threshold can capture most of the benefits of nonlinear pricing. The simplicity of this policy validates observed practice and concentrates managerial efforts to dynamically selecting the threshold and the depth of the discount.
summary_zh: 快时尚零售商（如Zara）普遍采用非线性定价策略，例如“买两件享八折”或“买三件省30%”等折扣形式。Gallego等人（2019）的研究表明，非线性动态定价能显著提升企业收入，增幅可达30%至90%，尤其当库存水平较高且边际产品的相对价值既不过低也不过高时，这一情形在快时尚零售中十分常见。研究发现，仅设置单一数量折扣阈值即可获取非线性定价的大部分收益。该策略的简洁性验证了业界现行做法，并将管理重心聚焦于动态选择折扣阈值与折扣深度。
title: Dynamic Nonlinear Pricing of Inventories over Finite Sales Horizons

summary_zh: 电荷转移的热活化能（Eact,σ）是决定有机半导体电学性能的关键因素，其在低掺杂浓度下主要受电荷转移复合物的库仑结合能（Ecoul,ICTC）支配，而在高掺杂浓度下则受静态能量无序度（σICTC）影响。本文通过研究两种具有不同供体单元的典型给体-受体型聚合物，揭示了分子参数对热电性能的影响机制。研究发现，通过将初始的咔唑（CZ）供体单元替换为二噻吩并吡咯（DTP）单元，可以有效抑制聚合物的库仑结合能与能量无序度，从而使PDTP-DPP的热活化能显著低于PCZ-DPP。实验结果表明，在室温条件下，PDTP-DPP的功率因子（PF）达到10.8 μW m⁻¹ K⁻²，约为PCZ-DPP（1.8 μW m⁻¹ K⁻²）的6倍；此外，得益于热诱导去掺杂与热激活半导体行为的协同作用，PDTP-DPP在488 K下的功率因子进一步提升至85.5 μW m⁻¹ K⁻²以上。紫外光电子能谱与X射线光电子能谱分析证实，PDTP-DPP具有更低的热活化能，有利于实现高效的p型掺杂。
title: Significantly Reduced Thermal-Activation Energy for Hole Transport via Simple Donor Engineering: Understanding the Role of Molecular Parameters for Thermoelectric Behaviors

summary_zh: 针对深度神经网络在对抗样本攻击下易产生误分类的安全隐患，本文提出一种基于生成对抗网络的新型防御架构，旨在提升模型鲁棒性。该方法通过匹配干净样本与对抗样本的数据分布，引导网络精准去除不可见噪声，将对抗样本恢复为干净样本，从而实现防御效果。为兼顾干净样本的分类精度并增强网络保真度，训练过程中同时将干净样本输入所提网络进行去噪处理。实验在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR10、CIFAR100和ImageNet五个基准数据集上进行，并采用FGSM、PGD、MIM、JSMA、CW和DeepFool六种主流攻击方法测试防御性能。结果表明，所提方法对上述攻击均展现出强大的防御能力，验证了其有效性。该研究可应用于图像分类、目标检测及人脸识别等对安全性要求较高的视觉任务。
title: GAN-based classifier protection against adversarial attacks

abstract: Abstract Diaphragm walls are commonly used as cut-off walls to prevent water from entering dewatered excavation pits, landfills and downstream water. However, due to the geometrical imperfections such as the positioning error of grab during trenching, small seepage passages through the diaphragm wall may occasionally occur, which will undermine its water-tightness and lead to significant leakages. This study therefore used a reliability-based approach to quantitatively estimate the effect of geometrical imperfections on the water-tightness of diaphragm walls using a three-dimensional discretised algorithm (TDA). This algorithm enables a rigorous examination of penetration of seepage passages and it further quantitatively estimates the flow rate through the diaphragm wall under certain circumstances. Finally, detailed design procedures and design graphs were provided, which may facilitate the choice of a rational grab model and construction parameters in the design of diaphragm walls.
summary_zh: 本研究针对地下连续墙因施工几何缺陷（如抓斗成槽定位偏差）导致渗漏通道、削弱止水性能的问题，采用基于可靠度的方法，结合三维离散算法（TDA）定量评估几何缺陷对墙体水密性的影响。该算法可严格分析渗漏通道的贯穿情况，并定量估算特定条件下通过墙体的渗流量。在此基础上，研究提供了详细的设计流程与设计图表，可为地下连续墙设计中合理选择抓斗型号及施工参数提供依据。
title: Effect of random geometric imperfections on the water-tightness of diaphragm wall

abstract: Nanofiber has shown outstanding performance in many studies. Blending nanofibers into fibrous filter media is a promising way to improve the filtration performance. This paper discussed the modeling method for multi-fiber filter paper and the proper way to apply nanofiber into filter paper. Sixteen different filter papers were prepared and these filter papers covered the range of coarse-fiber-dominant and fine-fiber-dominant fibrous structure. The theoretical modeling method in this study for pressure drop and penetration of multi-fiber filter paper showed accurate results compared with the experiment data. It was found that for the higher quality factor, the nanofibers should be effectively separated by the coarse fibers. This study presented the idea of the fiber's effective contribution to filtration efficiency, which can lead to a comprehensive and distinct understanding of fibrous structure and filtration properties.
summary_zh: 本文探讨了将纳米纤维混入传统纤维滤纸以提升过滤性能的建模方法与应用策略。针对多纤维复合滤纸，研究提出了一种理论模型，用于预测其压降与穿透率，并通过制备十六种涵盖粗纤维主导与细纤维主导不同结构特征的滤纸样品进行实验验证。结果表明，该模型预测值与实验数据吻合良好，具有较高准确性。进一步分析发现，为实现更高的品质因子，纳米纤维应被粗纤维有效分隔，避免团聚，从而充分发挥其过滤贡献。研究还提出了纤维对过滤效率有效贡献的概念，有助于全面且清晰地理解纤维结构与过滤性能之间的关系。该成果可为高性能空气过滤材料的设计与优化提供理论指导，在洁净室、呼吸防护及工业除尘等领域具有应用前景。
title: Pressure drop, penetration and quality factor of filter paper containing nanofibers

summary_zh: 我们提出一种用于实数线性规划的原始-对偶分层步内点算法（LIP）。该算法沿中心路径行进，采用短步或一种新型的分层最小二乘步（LLS）。算法在有限步内返回精确最优解，具体迭代次数为 O(n³·c(A))，其中 c(A) 是系数矩阵的函数。LLS 步可视为对经典路径跟踪内点法的加速。新方法的一个推论是对中心路径的全新刻画：我们证明中心路径至多由 n² 个交替的直线段和曲线段组成。若将 LIP 算法应用于整数数据，则可得到 Tardos 著名定理的一个新证明，即当矩阵 A 包含小整数元素时，线性规划可在强多项式时间内求解。该算法的复杂度仅依赖于约束矩阵 A，而与右端项 b 和目标系数 c 无关，这克服了传统内点法复杂度受全部数据影响的局限。算法同时保持了 O(√n·L) 的已知最优迭代复杂度界。通过求解加权分层最小二乘问题，LLS 步能直接跨越中心路径上的近似直线段，从而在存在近似退化时显著减少迭代次数。这一特性使得 LIP 算法特别适用于约束矩阵良态而目标函数和右端项任意的线性规划问题。
title: A primal-dual interior-point method whose running time depends only on the constraint matrix

summary_zh: 本文研究上行异构网络中时延感知的用户关联与功率控制联合优化问题，目标是在严格时延约束下最小化系统总功耗。该问题被建模为一个非凸混合整数非线性规划，直接求解困难。为此，我们首先采用ℓ1范数逼近方法将整数约束转化为可处理形式，进而提出一种基于逐次凸逼近的集中式迭代算法，该算法利用算术-几何平均近似进行非凸项的凸化处理，并可通过重加权ℓ1最小化技术进一步提升性能。同时，为适应分布式部署需求，我们基于交替方向乘子法设计了相应的分布式实现方案。仿真结果验证了所提算法在降低功耗与满足时延要求方面的有效性。该工作为5G异构网络上行传输中的资源协同管理提供了实用算法支撑。
title: Delay-Aware User Association and Power Control for 5G Heterogeneous Network

abstract: Abstract STAT3 plays a critical role in myeloid-derived suppressor cell (MDSC) accumulation and activation. Most studies have probed underlying mechanisms of STAT3 activation. However, epigenetic events involved in STAT3 activation are poorly understood. In this study, we identified several epigenetic-associated proteins such as p66a (Gatad2a), a novel protein transcriptional repressor that might interact with STAT3 in functional MDSCs, by using immunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry. p66a could regulate the phosphorylation and ubiquitination of STAT3. Silencing p66a promoted not only phosphorylation but also K63 ubiquitination of STAT3 in the activated MDSCs. Interestingly, p66a expression was significantly suppressed by IL-6 both in vitro and in vivo during MDSC activation, suggesting that p66a is involved in IL-6–mediated differentiation of MDSCs. Indeed, silencing p66a could promote MDSC accumulation, differentiation, and activation. Tumors in mice injected with p66a small interfering RNA–transfected MDSCs also grew faster, whereas tumors in mice injected with p66a-transfected MDSCs were smaller as compared with the control. Thus, our data demonstrate that p66a may physically interact with STAT3 to suppress its activity through posttranslational modification, which reveals a novel regulatory mechanism controlling STAT3 activation during myeloid cell differentiation.
title: Epigenetic Component p66a Modulates Myeloid-Derived Suppressor Cells by Modifying STAT3

summary_zh: 光线映射方法已广泛用于自由曲面照明透镜设计，但在非近轴或离轴情形下，获得可积光线映射仍具挑战性，通常需对初始映射进行复杂的迭代校正。为此，本文提出一种扩展光线映射方法，将可微光线追迹融入光线映射设计流程，从而能依据光线映射精确构建曲面，并基于辐照度分布高效修正面形。该方法包含两个优化阶段：第一阶段对自由曲面进行初步优化，使其逼近最优传输映射；第二阶段对所得曲面进一步优化，以缩小目标辐照度分布与模拟辐照度分布之间的差异，同时约束自由曲面的平均曲率，以便于最终曲面的加工制造。利用该方法在十分钟内设计出非近轴照明透镜和离轴照明透镜，仿真结果表明该方法有效且稳健。
title: Extended ray-mapping method based on differentiable ray-tracing for non-paraxial and off-axis freeform illumination lens design

abstract: Hexapod machine tool (HMT) is a device designed for micro milling; however, the deviations of the HMT’s kinematic parameters due to manufacture and assembly errors can definitely affect its running accuracy. To identify the real kinematic parameters so as to improve the running accuracy of the HMT, a novel calibration test was performed on a bridge-type coordinate measuring machine. In the present research, a mathematical model was derived to present the relationship between pose errors and the errors of kinematic parameters of the HMT, the measurement method based on coordinate measuring machine was designed and a calibration experiment was carried out subsequently. The experimental results reveal that after calibration, both the position errors and orientation errors of the HMT decreased significantly, the symmetrical errors were improved as well. In addition, it is found that the running accuracy of the HMT is running direction dependent, which depends on the HTM’s structures. The present research provides researchers with a new and effective calibration method to improve the running accuracy of HMTs.
summary_zh: 本研究针对六足机床因制造与装配误差导致运动学参数偏离设计值、进而影响其运行精度的问题，提出了一种基于桥式三坐标测量机的新型标定方法。首先建立了六足机床位姿误差与运动学参数误差之间的数学模型，在此基础上设计了以坐标测量机为核心的测量方案，并开展了标定实验。实验结果表明，标定后六足机床的位置误差和姿态误差均显著降低，对称误差也得到改善。此外，研究发现六足机床的运行精度具有方向依赖性，这一特性与其结构形式密切相关。该研究为提升六足机床运行精度提供了一种有效的新标定方法，对精密微铣削加工领域具有重要参考价值。
title: Calibration of a small size hexapod machine tool using coordinate measuring machine
venue: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers, Part E: Journal of Process Mechanical Engineering

summary_zh: 在序列决策问题中，离线策略评估利用由不同行为策略生成的记录轨迹数据，估计目标策略的期望累积奖励，而无需实际执行该策略。在医疗、教育等高风险领域，出于安全、伦理或探索受限等原因，强化学习通常只能采用离线设置，因此在部署目标策略前量化离线估计的不确定性至关重要。本文提出一种新颖的框架，能够基于一条或多条记录轨迹数据，给出稳健且乐观的累积奖励估计。借助分布鲁棒优化方法，我们证明通过合理选择分布不确定性集的大小，这些估计可在随机或对抗环境下作为置信界，并具有非渐近和渐近保证。我们的结果进一步推广到批量强化学习，并得到实证分析的支持。
title: Off-policy Evaluation for Reinforcement Learning

summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向张量对象的块主成分分析方法，用于多通道或时序数据的高效特征提取。随着数据采集技术进步，彩色或高光谱人脸等多通道信息以及人体步态等时序信息常以张量形式获取。该方法将张量对象按空间维度与频率/时间维度展开，表示为块矩阵形式，进而构建频率/时间维度的协方差矩阵，并通过该协方差矩阵的块特征分解求取投影解作为特征。所得投影特征可同时用于重构与分类任务。在多种人脸与步态数据库上的实验表明，该方法在重构精度与分类效果上均优于传统主成分分析、二维双向主成分分析、多线性主成分分析及非相关多线性主成分分析等现有方法，且计算效率具有竞争力。该技术可广泛应用于计算机视觉、生物特征识别及多模态数据分析等领域。
title: Block Principal Component Analysis for Tensor Objects with Frequency or Time Information

summary_zh: N-芳基咔唑结构因其在天然产物及功能性OLED材料中的广泛存在而具有重要意义。目前，芳烃的C-H胺化反应是构建此类结构最有效的方法，但传统的过渡金属催化策略往往受限于底物普适性较窄，且需依赖外源氧化剂，同时有机催化实现对C-N轴手性的对映选择性构建仍具挑战。本文报道了一种全新的有机催化策略，通过偶氮萘与咔唑的组装，首次实现了具有轴手性的新型N-芳基咔唑骨架的合成。该反应展现出广泛的底物适用范围，能够以高产率获得具有优异对映选择性的非对映异构N-芳基咔唑。该方法不仅为金属催化C-N交叉偶联反应提供了替代方案，也为开发结构多样化的N-芳基非对映异构体及新型OLED材料开辟了新途径。
title: Chiral Phosphoric Acid Catalyzed Atroposelective C−H Amination of Arenes

abstract: Currently the research about large quantities cells assembly is seriously regarded, since it can provide high efficiency methods for artificial tissue engineering. In this paper, we report a novel cell assembly method based on cell immobilization by photo-crosslinkable resin, cell manipulation by dielectrophoresis (DEP) and microfluidic self-assembly inside microfluidic devices. The on-chip fabrication of movable microstructures embedding yeast cells (W303) based on Poly (ethylene glycol) Diacrylate (PEGDA) was reported. Novel microelectrodes are fabricated by Cr/Au for manipulating cells before immobilization. A microfluidic chip for controlling cell concentration with separated patterning and fabrication areas is fabricated. Movable microstructures embedding microbeads of which the concentration is controllable are fabricated in the microfluidic channel, inside PEGDA and NaCl solution. A 2-layer microfluidic device is fabricated by Polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) and self-assembly method of the fabricated movable microstructures via this device is preliminarily demonstrated.
title: Fabrication and self-assembly of movable microstructures embedding cells with concentration control inside microfluidic devices
venue: 2012 International Symposium on Micro-NanoMechatronics and Human Science (MHS)

abstract: Large eddy simulation (LES) was carried out to study the effects of the U-burrow density and bioirrigation intensity on the turbulence characteristics in an open-channel flow. Results reveal that near the bio-microtopography, the combined effect of the main flow and bioirrigation produces a backflow vortex in the U-burrow and at its outlet, helping the benthos to obtain nutrients. Meanwhile, the biological jet flow increases the bed roughness. The peaks in the Reynolds shear stress (RSS) and turbulent kinetic energy (TKE) distributions near the U-burrow increase significantly with an increase in bioirrigation intensity, while those at the outlet of the U-burrow decrease initially and then increase with an increase in U-burrow density. Then, the effects of bioturbulence intensity and U-burrow density can be summarized as a dimensionless Bin. The equivalent roughness heights and Darcy–Weisbach friction factor are observed to be proportion to Bin, for which two formulas are recommended.
title: Effects of U-burrow bioirrigation on turbulence characteristics

abstract: N6-methyladenosine (m6A) is a reversible modification in mRNA and has been shown to regulate processing, translation and decay of mRNA. However, the roles of m6A modification in neuronal development are still not known. Here, we found that the m6A eraser FTO is enriched in axons and can be locally translated. Axon-specific inhibition of FTO by rhein, or compartmentalized siRNA knockdown of Fto in axons led to increases of m6A levels. GAP-43 mRNA is modified by m6A and is a substrate of FTO in axons. Loss-of-function of this non-nuclear pool of FTO resulted in increased m6A modification and decreased local translation of axonal GAP-43 mRNA, which eventually repressed axon elongation. Mutation of a predicted m6A site in GAP-43 mRNA eliminated its m6A modification and exempted regulation of its local translation by axonal FTO. This work showed an example of dynamic internal m6A demethylation of non-nuclear localized mRNA by the demethylase FTO. Regulation of m6A modification of axonal mRNA by axonal FTO might be a general mechanism to control their local translation in neuronal development.
summary_zh: N6-甲基腺苷（m6A）作为一种可逆的mRNA修饰，在调节mRNA的处理、翻译及降解中发挥重要作用，但其在神经发育中的具体功能尚不明确。本研究发现，m6A去甲基化酶FTO在轴突中高度富集并能进行局部翻译。通过大黄素抑制轴突特异性FTO活性或利用区室化siRNA敲低轴突中的Fto，均会导致轴突内m6A水平升高。研究进一步证实，GAP-43 mRNA是轴突内FTO的底物，并受到m6A修饰的调控。当这一非核定位的FTO功能缺失时，会导致轴突内GAP-43 mRNA的m6A修饰水平增加，进而抑制其局部翻译，最终抑制轴突延伸。通过对GAP-43 mRNA中预测的m6A位点进行突变，可以消除其m6A修饰，从而使其局部翻译不再受轴突FTO的调控。本研究揭示了去甲基化酶FTO通过动态调节非核定位mRNA的m6A修饰来控制其局部翻译的机制，这种通过轴突FTO调节轴突mRNA m6A修饰的模式，可能是神经发育过程中控制局部翻译的一种普遍机制。
title: Dynamic m6A modification regulates local translation of mRNA in axons

abstract: This letter introduces two new broadband reflective phasers, one based on shunt stubs and the other one based on stepped-impedance lines, respectively. In these phasers, broad bandwidth is achieved by using electrically short ( <inline-formula xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"> <tex-math notation="LaTeX">$\lambda /8$ </tex-math></inline-formula> long or less), and therefore non-resonant, transmission line sections. A corresponding design procedure is presented, and three numerical and two experimental examples are subsequently provided to validate the proposed phasers.
summary_zh: 本文提出两种新型宽带反射式移相器，分别基于并联短截线和阶跃阻抗线结构。这两种移相器均采用电长度不超过八分之一波长的非谐振传输线段，从而在宽频带内实现稳定的相位响应。文中给出了相应的设计流程，并通过三个数值仿真和两个实验案例验证了所提结构的有效性。该设计方法可应用于射频通信与雷达系统中需要宽带相位调控的场景。
title: Shunt-Stub and Stepped-Impedance Broadband Reflective Phasers
venue: IEEE Microwave and Wireless Components Letters

summary_zh: 针对钠离子电池层状P2型锰基正极材料循环稳定性差和倍率性能不足的问题，本文提出了一种湿化学沉淀法，在Na₀.₅₅Ni₀.₁Co₀.₁Mn₀.₈O₂表面沉积非晶态磷酸铝保护层。当磷酸铝包覆量为5 wt%时，所得NCM@5AP电极在100 mA g⁻¹电流密度下循环200次后容量保持率达78.4%，在500 mA g⁻¹高倍率下仍可提供98 mAh g⁻¹的可逆容量，循环寿命和倍率性能均显著优于未包覆材料。通过系统研究，揭示了包覆层对复合电极相稳定性和钠离子迁移动力学的增强机制，阐明了非晶磷酸铝层抑制副反应、稳定界面结构并促进钠离子传输的内在机理。该策略为开发低成本、长寿命的钠离子电池正极材料提供了有效途径，在规模储能领域具有应用前景。
title: Surface engineering of P2-type cathode material targeting long-cycling and high-rate sodium-ion batteries

abstract: The objective of this research was to examine the influence of nonuniform NAPL distribution and hydraulic-conductivity heterogeneity on the retention and transport of PFAS. Two-dimensional flow cell experiments were conducted to investigate the impact of NAPL configuration on PFOS retention. Two simplified NAPL configurations were used, one with decane present as residual and the other with greater-than-residual (pool) NAPL saturation. The measured and predicted retardation factors were 1.7 and 1.6 for the residual-NAPL flow cell. The fractions of retention associated with solid-phase sorption, NAPL-water interfacial adsorption, and NAPL absorption were 0.56, 0.43, and 0.1, respectively. The measured retardation factor was 1.4 for the pool-NAPL flow cell. Notably, the predicted retardation factor assuming no contribution from NAPL-water interfacial adsorption was 1.5. Comparison of the two values indicates a minimal contribution of NAPL-water interfacial adsorption to transport, which is attributed to the impact of by-pass flow effects that limited contact of PFOS with the NAPL present within the pool. Mathematical-model simulations were conducted to examine the impact of heterogeneity on PFOS transport in model NAPL-contaminated heterogeneous source zones. The results demonstrated that the impact of NAPL-water interface adsorption on PFAS transport in NAPL-contaminated source zones can be influenced by the magnitude of hydraulic-conductivity heterogeneity.
title: The influence of NAPL distribution on the transport of PFOS in Co-contaminated media

abstract: Polycrystalline diamond (PCD) is widely used for micro tools due to its high hardness and wear resistance. However, micro PCD tools face challenges in machining with high accuracy and efficiency. Therefore, electrical discharge machining grinding (EDM-grinding) composite machining was proposed. The effects of pulse discharge parameters on surface quality and microhole drilling performance of PCD tool were investigated. The results show that the surface roughness of helix flute and flank face of the fabricated PCD tool were 0.125 µm and 0.158 µm, respectively, as well as the inner wall roughness achieved 0.331 µm after drilling of microhole. The average current displayed a greater effect on the machining quality of PCD tools, with tool breakage in excessive average current. The preferred pulse discharge parameters were determined as an open-circuit voltage of 95 V, an average current of 1400 mA, a pulse width of 400 ns, and a pulse interval of 2000 ns.
summary_zh: 多晶金刚石因高硬度和耐磨性被广泛用于微细刀具制造，但微细PCD刀具在高精度高效加工中仍面临挑战。为此，提出放电磨削复合加工方法，并研究了脉冲放电参数对PCD刀具表面质量及微孔钻削性能的影响。结果表明，所制备刀具的螺旋槽和刃带表面粗糙度分别为0.125微米和0.158微米，钻削微孔后内壁粗糙度达到0.331微米。平均电流对刀具加工质量影响较大，过大的平均电流会导致刀具断裂。优选脉冲放电参数确定为开路电压95伏、平均电流1400毫安、脉冲宽度400纳秒、脉冲间隔2000纳秒。
title: EDM-Grinding composite machining and drilling of polycrystalline diamond tool

abstract: The issue of whether a thermal gradient acts like a magnetic field or an electric current in the domain wall (DW) dynamics is investigated. Broadly speaking, magnetization control knobs can be classified as energy-driving or angular-momentum driving forces. DW propagation driven by a static magnetic field is the best known example of the former in which the DW speed is proportional to the energy dissipation rate, and the current-driven DW motion is an example of the latter. Here we show that DW propagation speed driven by a thermal gradient can be fully explained as the angular momentum transfer between thermally generated spin current and DW. We found DW-plane rotation speed increases as DW width decreases. Both DW propagation speed along the wire and DW-plane rotation speed around the wire decrease with the Gilbert damping. These facts are consistent with the angular momentum transfer mechanism, but are distinct from the energy dissipation mechanism. We further show that magnonic spin-transfer torque (STT) generated by a thermal gradient has both damping-like and field-like components. By analyzing DW propagation speed and DW-plane rotational speed, the coefficient ( ) of the field-like STT arising from the non-adiabatic process, is obtained. It is found that does not depend on the thermal gradient; increases with uniaxial anisotropy (thinner DW); and decreases with the damping, in agreement with the physical picture that a larger damping or a thicker DW leads to a better alignment between the spin-current polarization and the local magnetization, or a better adiabaticity.
title: Thermal gradient driven domain wall dynamics

summary_zh: 土壤缺磷是限制植物生长的关键因素之一，质膜H+-ATPase（PM H+-ATPase）在植物应对低磷胁迫的过程中发挥着重要作用。本研究通过探究拟南芥PM H+-ATPase基因家族成员在低磷条件下的表达模式及其对根部质子（H+）通量的影响，揭示了不同基因在根系发育中的差异化功能。研究发现，低磷胁迫显著诱导了拟南芥根部AHA2和AHA7基因的表达。功能缺失实验表明，AHA2缺失会导致根部伸长区的H+外流减少，进而抑制主根的伸长；而AHA7缺失则会导致根毛区的H+外流降低，从而减少根毛密度。此外，AHA2和AHA7对H+外流的调节受到14-3-3蛋白及生长素调节途径的影响。研究结果表明，在低磷条件下，AHA2主要通过调节根部伸长区的H+外流来控制主根的伸长，而AHA7则通过调节根毛区的H+外流在根毛形成中发挥关键作用。
title: Arabidopsis plasma membrane H+-ATPase genes AHA2 and AHA7 have distinct and overlapping roles in the modulation of root tip H+ efflux in response to low-phosphorus stress

summary_zh: 对映选择性自由基去对称化反应是快速构建手性富集分子的高效策略，能够从易得的前手性或内消旋化合物出发，显著提升产物结构的复杂性。根据立体决定步骤的性质，这类反应可分为两种策略模式：第一类主要涉及闭壳层自由基前体或功能试剂的对映选择性去对称化，第二类则通过对开壳层自由基物种进行对映选择性官能团化来实现去对称化。本文综述了这一快速发展领域的研究进展，重点阐释了与立体化学控制相关的机理图景，并展望了未来面临的挑战与机遇。在第一类反应中，通过对映异位基团选择性的自由基生成或极性转化过程，实现了对C(sp³)–H键、内消旋环氧化物及酸酐等底物的高效去对称化，手性过渡金属催化剂与光氧化还原催化的协同应用显著拓展了反应范围。第二类反应则聚焦于不对称自由基官能团化，包括手性辅基控制及催化不对称策略，可在自由基生成后通过非对映或对映选择性官能团化构建多重手性中心。这些方法在天然产物和生物活性分子的对映选择性全合成中展现出重要应用潜力。
title: Research Progress in Enantioselective Radical Desymmetrization Reactions

abstract: Abstract The high-temperature oxidation resistance of a novel Fe45Ni25Cr25Mo5 compositionally complicated alloy (CCA) was investigated with comparison to 316L stainless steel and Inconel 625 superalloy. The Fe-rich CCA exhibited superior oxidation resistance at 1200 °C, including low oxidation rate and high spallation resistance. This was attributed to the formation of an exclusive and compact chromia scale with high hardness and elastic modulus, protecting the substrate from further oxidation and high resistance against cracking during the oxidation process. The superior mechanical properties of the chromia scale originated from its high compactness, fine-grains and solid-solution strengthening induced by diffused Fe atoms.
title: A cost-effective Fe-rich compositionally complicated alloy with superior high-temperature oxidation resistance

summary_zh: 本文针对图像中物体替换这一实际需求，定义了无监督可变形实例图像到图像翻译（UDIT）任务，旨在实现源域中多个前景实例向目标域的映射，并处理显著的形状变化。为此，研究者提出了一种名为MGD-GAN的掩码引导可变形实例生成对抗网络框架。该框架首先批量生成目标掩码，随后利用掩码在背景图像上合成相应的实例，从而在高效完成所有实例翻译的同时，确保背景得到良好保留。为了提升合成图像质量并稳定训练过程，研究者设计了一种巧妙的训练方案，通过构建配对样本，将无监督的掩码到实例生成过程转化为监督学习模式。此外，本文还设计了基于目标检测的新型评估指标，以客观衡量UDIT任务的性能。在四个数据集上的广泛实验表明，MGD-GAN在定量和定性指标上均显著优于现有方法，且与当前最先进技术相比，大幅缩短了训练时间。该方法在图像编辑与虚拟试衣等应用领域具有重要价值。
title: Towards Unsupervised Deformable-Instances Image-to-Image Translation
venue: Proceedings of the Thirtieth International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence

summary_zh: 黄土是中国黄河中上游地区广泛分布的典型湿陷性土体，采用石灰进行稳定化处理可显著改善其物理力学性能，因而在路面基层与路基工程中得到普遍应用。为系统研究石灰稳定黄土的莫尔–库仑破坏包络线，本文通过一系列三轴试验，分析了石灰掺量、孔隙率及养护龄期对其强度参数（内摩擦角φ和黏聚力c）的影响。试验结果表明，对于给定的石灰稳定黄土，内摩擦角φ与石灰掺量、孔隙率和养护龄期基本无关，而上述因素对黏聚力c具有显著影响。在较短养护龄期（7天）条件下，石灰掺量的变化对稳定黄土的黏聚力无明显影响；但当养护龄期延长至28天、90天和180天时，增加石灰掺量可显著提升黏聚力。在石灰掺量不变的情况下，稳定黄土的黏聚力随孔隙比降低而线性增大。为综合评价石灰掺量、孔隙率和养护龄期对黏聚力的影响，本文提出了幂函数形式的经验公式。最后，基于47个不同养护龄期和围压条件下的三轴试验结果，绘制了莫尔–库仑破坏包络线，并将公式计算所得抗剪强度参数与试验结果进行了对比验证。
title: Experimental Investigation on Shear Strength Parameters of Lime Stabilized Loess

summary_zh: 本研究针对美国图森国际机场（TIAA）联邦超级基金场地的案例，利用高分辨率数据集模拟了为期30年的抽水处理（PAT）修复过程。研究采用基于马尔可夫链的随机方法，结合245个钻孔数据生成了具有随机异质性分布的条件场。通过对比MT3DMS模型与先进的随机游走粒子法（RWhet）在污染物质量移除模拟中的表现，结果表明两种方法均能较好地拟合实测数据，均方根误差（RMSE）均低于0.03。尽管MT3DMS通过细网格和全变差递减（TVD）方法缓解了数值弥散，但与增加粒子数量的RWhet相比，其数值弥散效应仍较为明显。RWhet在粒子数分别为1、20和50时，其RMSE分别降至0.027、0.024和0.020，精度更高。此外，尽管RWhet的计算时间随粒子数增加而增长，但仍显著优于MT3DMS。本研究为长期抽水处理系统的数值模拟提供了技术指导，有助于深入理解污染物运移及污染羽的持久性，从而提升大型污染场地的特征描述与修复管理水平。
title: Modeling groundwater contaminant transport in the presence of large heterogeneity: a case study comparing MT3D and RWhet

abstract: Since proposed in [X. Zhang and C.-W. Shu, J. Comput. Phys., 229: 3091--3120, 2010], the Zhang--Shu framework has attracted extensive attention and motivated many bound-preserving (BP) high-order discontinuous Galerkin and finite volume schemes for various hyperbolic equations. A key ingredient in the framework is the decomposition of the cell averages of the numerical solution into a convex combination of the solution values at certain quadrature points, which helps to rewrite high-order schemes as convex combinations of formally first-order schemes. The classic convex decomposition originally proposed by Zhang and Shu has been widely used over the past decade. It was verified, only for the 1D quadratic and cubic polynomial spaces, that the classic decomposition is optimal in the sense of achieving the mildest BP CFL condition. Yet, it remained unclear whether the classic decomposition is optimal in multiple dimensions. In this paper, we find that the classic multidimensional decomposition based on the tensor product of Gauss--Lobatto and Gauss quadratures is generally not optimal, and we discover a novel alternative decomposition for the 2D and 3D polynomial spaces of total degree up to 2 and 3, respectively, on Cartesian meshes. Our new decomposition allows a larger BP time step-size than the classic one, and moreover, it is rigorously proved to be optimal to attain the mildest BP CFL condition, yet requires much fewer nodes. The discovery of such an optimal convex decomposition is highly nontrivial yet meaningful, as it may lead to an improvement of high-order BP schemes for a large class of hyperbolic or convection-dominated equations, at the cost of only a slight and local modification to the implementation code. Several numerical examples are provided to further validate the advantages of using our optimal decomposition over the classic one in terms of efficiency.
title: Is the classic convex decomposition optimal for bound-preserving schemes in multiple dimensions?

summary_zh: 本文提出并验证了一种基于飞秒激光逐行扫描技术的切趾光纤布拉格光栅制备方法，旨在抑制传统均匀光栅反射谱中的强旁瓣。该方法通过对每条激光刻写折射率调制线的长度或横向位置进行精确控制，可灵活实现多种切趾调制轮廓。我们从理论和实验两方面研究了切趾函数对光栅边模抑制比的影响，结果表明高斯切趾光栅的最大边模抑制比可达20.6 dB。利用该技术，我们成功制备了多种切趾光栅，均有效降低了旁瓣水平。其中，波长间隔为1.50 nm的密集波分复用高斯切趾光栅阵列实现了14 dB的边模抑制比；此外，高斯切趾相移光栅和啁啾光栅也分别获得了14 dB和16 dB的高边模抑制比。因此，这种基于改进飞秒激光逐行扫描的切趾方法为制备高边模抑制比的各种光纤光栅提供了一种有效且灵活的手段，有望显著提升光纤滤波器、光纤激光器及光纤传感器的性能。
title: Femtosecond laser line-by-line inscription of apodized fiber Bragg gratings

abstract: In traditional digital storage oscilloscope (DSO), sampled data need to be processed after each acquisition. During data processing, the acquisition is stopped and oscilloscope is blind to the input signal. Thus, this duration is called dead time. With the rapid development of modern electronic systems, the effect of infrequent events becomes significant. To capture these occasional events in shorter time, dead time in traditional DSO that causes the loss of measured signal needs to be reduced or even eliminated. In this paper, a seamless acquisition oscilloscope without dead time is proposed. In this oscilloscope, three-dimensional waveform mapping (TWM) technique, which converts sampled data to displayed waveform, is proposed. With this technique, not only the process speed is improved, but also the probability information of waveform is displayed with different brightness. Thus, a three-dimensional waveform is shown to the user. To reduce processing time further, parallel TWM which processes several sampled points simultaneously, and dual-port random access memory based pipelining technique which can process one sampling point in one clock period are proposed. Furthermore, two DDR3 (Double-Data-Rate Three Synchronous Dynamic Random Access Memory) are used for storing sampled data alternately, thus the acquisition can continue during data processing. Therefore, the dead time of DSO is eliminated. In addition, a double-pulse test method is adopted to test the waveform capturing rate (WCR) of the oscilloscope and a combined pulse test method is employed to evaluate the oscilloscope's capture ability comprehensively. The experiment results show that the WCR of the designed oscilloscope is 6 250 000 wfms/s (waveforms per second), the highest value in all existing oscilloscopes. The testing results also prove that there is no dead time in our oscilloscope, thus realizing the seamless acquisition.
title: A seamless acquisition digital storage oscilloscope with three-dimensional waveform display

abstract: This paper presents a method based on response surface methodology (RSM) to calculate the convective heat transfer coefficients (CHTCs) of a feed drive system. First, the temperature values at thermal-critical points and ball screw thermal elongation of a feed drive system were obtained by experimental and finite element (FE) methods. Second, the relationship between the CHTCs and simulated temperature values was established using RSM, and the CHTCs were calculated using the designed 25 tests. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method was proved using steady-state and transient-state simulation of the feed drive system.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于响应面法（RSM）的进给驱动系统对流换热系数（CHTCs）计算方法。研究首先通过实验测试与有限元分析（FE）相结合的方式，获取了进给驱动系统热关键点的温度分布及其滚珠丝杠的热伸长量。随后，利用响应面法建立了对流换热系数与仿真温度值之间的数学关系，并通过设计的25组实验完成了换热系数的精确计算。最后，通过对进给驱动系统进行稳态与瞬态仿真验证，证明了该方法在预测驱动系统热特性方面的有效性。该研究为进给驱动系统的热误差补偿与热性能评估提供了可靠的计算手段。
title: Method for modifying convective heat transfer coefficients used in the thermal simulation of a feed drive system based on the response surface methodology
venue: Numerical Heat Transfer Part A Applications

summary_zh: 基于其2.2 eV的带隙和良好的稳定性，甲基铵溴化铅（MAPbBr₃）有望作为多结太阳能电池子电池中的光吸收层材料。本研究结合温度依赖的时间分辨微波电导（TRMC）和时间分辨光致发光（TRPL）测量，揭示了激子产率随温度降低而升高，而电荷载流子生成产率则相应降低的规律。在立方相中约580 nm处的低能发射，以及正交相中位于622 nm的第二宽发射峰，均源于被缺陷捕获的电荷与可移动反电荷之间的辐射复合。我们建立了一个动力学模型，用以同时描述电导衰减和TRPL信号的缓慢增长过程。深入理解不同晶相表面缺陷态的性质，对于提升基于MAPbBr₃电池的开路电压具有重要意义。
title: Photoluminescence from Radiative Surface States and Excitons in Methylammonium Lead Bromide Perovskites
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters

summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于二维钙钛矿材料BA2PbBr4的光致发光特性与结构关联机制。二维钙钛矿因无机层被疏水有机阳离子夹持而具备优异发光性能和湿稳定性，但宽带白光发射目前仅局限于特定类型钙钛矿，且自陷激子引起的光致发光机理及其与结构的内在关系尚缺乏系统认知。通过高压调控手段，我们在BA2PbBr4中首次观察到压力诱导的光致发光增强现象以及覆盖整个可见光谱的显著宽带白光发射。同步辐射X射线衍射分析揭示，在低于1 GPa压力范围内，协同性八面体倾斜行为驱动了发光增强效应；而当压力超过5.3 GPa时，类姜-泰勒八面体畸变则触发了宽带白光发射。值得注意的是，该宽带白光发射及相应的结构畸变在卸压至1.8 GPa时仍可保持。上述发现不仅深化了对二维钙钛矿光学性质与结构变化内在关联的理解，也为压力调控钙钛矿材料在照明器件中的应用开辟了新途径。
title: Pressure-Induced Enhancement of Broad-Band White Light Emission in Butylammonium Lead Bromide
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters

summary_zh: 呼吸道传染病（如COVID-19）的精准传播趋势预测对公共卫生决策至关重要。针对现有研究多侧重于宏观趋势预测而忽视个体间微观社会交互，以及现有微观模型难以充分解析个体传播过程且缺乏定量验证的问题，本文提出了一种基于暴露风险的微观建模方法。该模型由个体移动、含病毒飞沫移动、个体暴露风险评估及传播趋势预测四个模块组成。模型首先分别模拟个体活动轨迹与感染者呼气产生的飞沫运动轨迹，随后通过第三模块评估个体的暴露风险，最终实现对新增病例数的预测。通过对美国COVID-19新增病例的预测实验，将该模型与四种现有的宏观及微观模型进行了对比。结果表明，本文模型的平均绝对误差、均方根误差及平均绝对百分比误差分别比对比模型中的最优结果低2454.70、3170.51和3.38%。定量分析证实，该模型能够从微观视角准确预测传染病传播趋势，并为研究非步行区域及设施布局等微观传播因素提供了有效工具。
title: Forecasting the transmission trends of respiratory infectious diseases with an exposure-risk-based model at the microscopic level

abstract: Abstract International joint ventures (IJVs) in emerging markets need to develop radical innovation to compete successfully in the rapidly changing business landscapes there. Taking a contingent governance perspective, this study examines how formal and social governance mechanisms, namely inter-partner control and inter-partner trust, affect radical innovation development in IJVs through knowledge acquisition and integration, and how emerging market institutional governance structures moderate the effectiveness of the two internal governance mechanisms. Based on a sample of 181 IJVs in China, we find that both inter-partner control and inter-partner trust promote IJV radical innovation; moreover, legal enforceability weakens the impact of inter-partner control but strengthens that of inter-partner trust on IJV radical innovation; likewise, government intervention risk weakens the positive role of inter-partner control yet strengthens that of inter-partner trust. This study extends both the innovation and IJV governance literature by connecting governance mechanisms to IJV radical innovation and uncovering important institutional contingencies.
title: Inter-partner control, trust, and radical innovation of IJVs in China: A contingent governance perspective

abstract: BACKGROUND: Drought stress is one of the major abiotic stresses that restrict plant growth and development. 14-3-3 proteins have been validated to regulate many biological processes in plants. Previous research demonstrated that OsGF14b plays different roles in panicle and leaf blast resistance. In this study, we researched the function of OsGF14b in drought resistance in rice. FINDINGS: Here, we report that OsGF14b was strongly induced by soil drought stress. In comparison with wild type (WT), the osgf14b mutant exhibited improved resistance to drought and osmotic stress by changing the content of stress-relevant parameters, complementation of the osgf14b mutant restored the drought sensitivity to WT levels, whereas the OsGF14b-overexpression lines exhibited enhanced sensitivity to drought and osmotic stress. The osgf14b mutant plants were hypersensitive to abscisic acid (ABA), while the OsGF14b-overexpression plants showed reduced sensitivity to ABA. Furthermore, mutation and overexpression of OsGF14b affected the expression of stress-related genes under normal growth conditions and/or drought stress conditions. CONCLUSIONS: We have demonstrated that OsGF14b is involved in the drought resistance of rice plants, partially in an ABA-dependent manner.
title: Involvement of OsGF14b Adaptation in the Drought Resistance of Rice Plants

abstract: Abstract Currently, the research of multi‐omics, such as genomics, proteinomics, transcriptomics, microbiome, metabolomics, pathomics, and radiomics, are hot spots. The relationship between multi‐omics data, drugs, and diseases has received extensive attention from researchers. At the same time, multi‐omics can effectively predict the diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment of diseases. In essence, these research entities, such as genes, RNAs, proteins, microbes, metabolites, pathways as well as pathological and medical imaging data, can all be represented by the network at different levels. And some computer and biology scholars have tried to use computational methods to explore the potential relationships between biological entities. We summary a comprehensive research strategy, that is to build a multi‐omics heterogeneous network, covering multimodal data, and use the current popular computational methods to make predictions. In this study, we first introduce the calculation method of the similarity of biological entities at the data level, second discuss multimodal data fusion and methods of feature extraction. Finally, the challenges and opportunities at this stage are summarized. Some scholars have used such a framework to calculate and predict. We also summarize them and discuss the challenges. We hope that our review could help scholars who are interested in the field of bioinformatics, biomedical image, and computer research.
title: Association predictions of genomics, proteinomics, transcriptomics, microbiome, metabolomics, pathomics, radiomics, drug, symptoms, environment factor, and disease networks: A comprehensive approach

abstract: A salt-tolerant aerobic denitrifying bacterium, Zobellella denitrificans strain A63, was isolated, and its effects on the efficiency of denitrification of saline wastewater and the denitrifying microbial community structure in the matrix were studied in vertical-flow constructed wetlands (VFCWs). In a VFCW system with strain A63, the removal efficiencies of NH4+-N, NO3--N, and total nitrogen reached 79.2%, 95.7%, and 89.9%, respectively. Quantitative PCR analysis indicated that the amoA gene from ammonia-oxidizing archaea (AOA) was highly abundant, whereas amoA from ammonia-oxidizing bacteria and nxrA from nitrite-oxidizing bacteria were lowly abundant because of the influent salinity, irrespective of whether strain A63 was added. However, the addition of strain A63 significantly increased the abundance of nirK in the top layer of the VFCW. Therefore, AOA-driven partial nitrification and aerobic denitrification by strain A63 occurred in VFCWs. Our findings suggest that adding salt-tolerant denitrifying strains to constructed wetlands can enhance denitrification for saline wastewater treatment.
title: Isolation and identification of a salt-tolerant aerobic denitrifying bacterial strain and its application to saline wastewater treatment in constructed wetlands

summary_zh: 移动众包（MCS）作为一种新兴的数据采集范式，正逐渐改变数据聚合的方式。针对传统移动众包系统中依赖第三方平台进行数据交易所带来的安全隐患，本文提出了一种基于联盟链的分布式数据交易框架，旨在保障数据交易过程中的隐私性与安全性。研究将卖方移动用户（SMU）与买方移动用户（BMU）之间的交互行为建模为Stackelberg博弈模型，并通过两个自动执行的智能合约来确定各卖方用户提供的感知时长及单位感知时间的价格。值得注意的是，该机制不仅根据感知时长，还结合用户声誉来计算卖方的补偿金额，从而激励用户贡献高质量数据。同时，利用分布式账本技术确保用户声誉的更新与记录具备不可篡改性和可追溯性。实验结果表明，在卖方用户无需获知彼此价格与数据质量的前提下，该机制能够实现接近最优的社会福利。
title: CBDTF: A Distributed and Trustworthy Data Trading Framework for Mobile Crowdsensing

abstract: The diffusion process of the treated Fukushima nuclear accident contaminated water to be discharged into the Pacific Ocean from 2023 is analyzed by two analysis models from macroscopic and microscopic perspectives. Results show that the tritium will spread to the whole North Pacific in 1200 days, which is important to formulate global coping strategies.
summary_zh: 本文通过宏观与微观两个维度的分析模型，对2023年起拟向太平洋排放的福岛核事故处理水扩散过程进行了深入研究。研究结果表明，氚元素在海洋环境中的扩散具有显著的范围效应，预计在1200天内将扩散至整个北太平洋海域。该研究通过定量模拟污染物的时空演变规律，为评估核污染水排放对海洋生态环境的潜在影响提供了科学依据，同时也为制定全球范围内的应对策略与海洋环境保护措施提供了重要的决策参考。
title: Discharge of treated Fukushima nuclear accident contaminated water: macroscopic and microscopic simulations

summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向视觉Transformer的高效加速器，采用无需重训练与微调的混合精度量化方法。在算法层面，将特征与权重分解为正常值和离群值两部分，分别以不同位宽和缩放因子进行量化，并结合矩阵变换与分组量化策略提升硬件利用率。硬件设计上，提出两级FIFO分组结构与分层交织数据流，进一步优化处理单元阵列的利用效率。在Swin-T模型上，输入与权重矩阵平均量化至5.71比特，精度损失仅为0.526%。该加速器在ZCU102 FPGA平台上实现118.9 FPS的帧率与43.58 GOPS/W的能效，性能优于现有同类工作。
title: HEAT: Efficient Vision Transformer Accelerator With Hybrid-Precision Quantization
venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems II: Express Briefs

summary_zh: 针对体积视频在互联网传输中面临的数据量大与带宽受限挑战，本文提出一种基于MPEG V-PCC标准与DASH框架的自适应流媒体传输方案。研究首先构建了支持V-PCC互联网流化的集成框架，并重点解决三个关键问题：一是建立V-PCC编码参数的率失真模型，为码率决策提供依据；二是设计新型码率自适应控制器，该控制器不仅考虑分块码率，还需选择具有合适帧率的分块，为此引入决策Transformer架构，将自然语言处理领域的成功经验迁移至决策问题；三是针对DASH固有的卡顿问题，采用主动丢帧机制消除播放停滞。实验结果表明，所提出的VSAS方案在多种网络条件下平均体验质量提升达1.67倍，有效保障了体积视频在互联网环境下的流畅与高质量传输，可广泛应用于虚拟现实、增强现实及元宇宙等多媒体服务场景。
title: VSAS: Decision Transformer-Based On-Demand Volumetric Video Streaming With Passive Frame Dropping

summary_zh: 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）是一种具有强遗传影响的神经发育障碍。尽管临床对ASD遗传检测的需求日益增长，但现有的全基因组测序（WGS）和全外显子组测序（WES）方法在针对ASD患者的变异注释、报告及临床意义解读方面仍缺乏统一的学术标准。本研究通过对六个家系三人组的WGS数据进行分析，展示了一种基于证据且完全透明的生物信息学流程及报告框架，证明了其在ASD临床应用中的可行性与技术实现路径。研究人员利用Sanger测序验证了部分关键变异，并结合患者临床症状及详细的文献综述进行了深度解读。研究进一步表明，识别ASD核心症状及其共病相关的遗传贡献，有助于深入理解其病理生理机制，实现共病的早期发现，并能基于遗传信息推导出的病理通路为药物干预提供依据。该生物信息学流程与解读框架将在更大规模队列验证后公开发布，旨在为完善基于WGS的ASD遗传咨询方法提供参考标准与讨论基础。
title: A Next Generation Sequencing-Based Protocol for Screening of Variants of Concern in Autism Spectrum Disorder

abstract: A new approach for real-time scene text recognition is proposed in this paper. A novel binary convolutional encoder-decoder network (B-CEDNet) together with a bidirectional recurrent neural network (Bi-RNN). The B-CEDNet is engaged as a visual front-end to provide elaborated character detection, and a back-end Bi-RNN performs character-level sequential correction and classification based on learned contextual knowledge. The front-end B-CEDNet can process multiple regions containing characters using a one-off forward operation, and is trained under binary constraints with significant compression. Hence it leads to both remarkable inference run-time speedup as well as memory usage reduction. With the elaborated character detection, the back-end Bi-RNN merely processes a low dimension feature sequence with category and spatial information of extracted characters for sequence correction and classification. By training with over 1,000,000 synthetic scene text images, the B-CEDNet achieves a recall rate of 0.86, precision of 0.88 and F-score of 0.87 on ICDAR-03 and ICDAR-13. With the correction and classification by Bi-RNN, the proposed real-time scene text recognition achieves state-of-the-art accuracy while only consumes less than 1-ms inference run-time. The flow processing flow is realized on GPU with a small network size of 1.01 MB for B-CEDNet and 3.23 MB for Bi-RNN, which is much faster and smaller than the existing solutions.
title: SqueezedText: A Real-Time Scene Text Recognition by Binary Convolutional Encoder-Decoder Network
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

summary_zh: 本文首次提出一种“以一抵全”策略，利用Förster共振能量转移机制构建结构固有靶向型光诊疗剂，以同时实现肿瘤精准诊断与靶向光动力治疗。该策略不仅能赋予传统光敏剂高效的原位肿瘤靶向能力，还能同步提升其光敏活性，从而显著提高治疗指数。经静脉注射所制备的SIT诊疗剂后，肿瘤部位被清晰“点亮”并与周围正常组织明显区分，近红外信号与背景比值高达12.5。更重要的是，得益于FRET效应，光捕获能力和单线态氧产量均显著增强。此外，该诊疗剂还兼具特异性线粒体锚定、细胞摄取量提升超过13倍以及理想的生物相容性等优势，使其在体外和体内的抗癌效能均实现数量级提升。这一“以一抵全”的SIT平台有望为未来肿瘤精准治疗提供新思路。
title: De Novo Design of Phototheranostic Sensitizers Based on Structure-Inherent Targeting for Enhanced Cancer Ablation
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

summary_zh: 本研究针对锂金属电池在充放电循环中因锂枝晶与苔藓状沉积导致的电解液分解及“死锂”形成问题，提出采用高介电常数钛酸钡（BaTiO₃）多孔骨架涂覆铜集流体的策略，以抑制引起锂沉积形貌不均匀的电场梯度。通过原位固态核磁共振技术表征发现，高介电BaTiO₃多孔层能够促进致密锂沉积，提升平均沉积/剥离效率，并显著延长电池循环寿命，其性能优于裸铜集流体及低介电常数氧化铝骨架材料。进一步在基于LiNi₀.₈Co₀.₁Mn₀.₁O₂正极与LiPF₆基电解液的无负极扣式全电池中进行电化学测试，验证了BaTiO₃涂覆铜电极的循环效率优势。该工作为抑制锂金属负极不均匀沉积、提升无负极锂金属电池实用化水平提供了材料设计思路。
title: High dielectric barium titanate porous scaffold for efficient Li metal cycling in anode-free cells

abstract: Flexible operation strategies are essential for addressing more intensive and uncertain load fluctuations, thereby improving the security and economic performance of integrated energy systems. When an improper temporal resolution is employed for scheduling, discrete-time power dispatch strategies may be not accurate enough to provide adequate flexibility in coping with power fluctuations. To bridge this gap, a Bernstein-based function space transformation method for integrated heat and power systems (IHPSs) is proposed. By mapping variables into the Bernstein function space, the continuous-time optimal scheduling model is formulated via this transformation method, which includes a continuous-time model for the district heat system and electric power system. The continuous-time optimization problem of the IHPS is then transformed into a mixed-integer linear program. The simulation results illustrate the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed continuous-time optimal scheduling model.
summary_zh: 针对综合能源系统面临的剧烈且不确定的负荷波动，灵活运行策略对提升系统安全性与经济性至关重要。传统离散时间功率调度方法因时间分辨率选取不当，往往难以提供足够的灵活性以精确应对功率波动。为此，本文提出一种基于伯恩斯坦函数空间变换的热电综合能源系统连续时间优化调度方法。该方法将变量映射至伯恩斯坦函数空间，构建了涵盖区域热力系统与电力系统的连续时间最优调度模型，并将原连续时间优化问题转化为混合整数线性规划问题进行求解。仿真结果表明，所提连续时间调度模型具有更高的准确性和有效性，适用于需要高精度灵活调节的热电综合能源系统运行场景。
title: Continuous-Time Optimal Scheduling in Bernstein Function Space for Integrated Heat and Power Energy Systems
venue: 2025 IEEE Power &amp; Energy Society General Meeting (PESGM)

title: T cell receptor β repertoires as novel diagnostic markers for systemic lupus erythematosus and rheumatoid arthritis

abstract: Radio spectrum monitoring provides essential information about actual frequency spectrum usage to support the spectrum management process. The conventional strategy of spectrum monitoring relies on the deployment of terrestrial spectrum monitoring networks. However, performing large-scale radio spectrum monitoring on the ground is a great challenge, hampered by the limited monitoring coverage and complex geographic environment. In this article, we present a space spectrum monitoring framework by using small satellites in low Earth orbit. It can greatly expand the monitoring coverage to a global scale and flexibly determine the locations of interference sources. Moreover, it can significantly promote international frequency coordination and spectrum sharing in future wireless networks. We first introduce the architecture and analyze the feasibility of the proposed system, and then present key application scenarios. Finally, we identify the main challenges and future directions.
summary_zh: 传统地面频谱监测网络受限于覆盖范围与复杂地理环境，难以实现大规模无线电频谱监测。本文提出一种利用低轨小卫星构建的空间频谱监测框架，可将监测覆盖扩展至全球尺度，并灵活定位干扰源，从而有力支撑未来无线网络中的国际频率协调与频谱共享。文章首先给出系统架构并分析其可行性，随后阐述关键应用场景，最后指出主要挑战与未来发展方向。
title: Satellite-Based Radio Spectrum Monitoring: Architecture, Applications, and Challenges

abstract: Abstract The development of artificial intelligence has posed a challenge to machine vision based on conventional complementary metal‐oxide semiconductor (CMOS) circuits owing to its high latency and inefficient power consumption originating from the data shuffling between memory and computation units. Gaining more insights into the function of every part of the visual pathway for visual perception can bring the capabilities of machine vision in terms of robustness and generality. Hardware acceleration of more energy‐efficient and biorealistic artificial vision highly necessitates neuromorphic devices and circuits that are able to mimic the function of each part of the visual pathway. In this paper, we review the structure and function of the entire class of visual neurons from the retina to the primate visual cortex within reach (Chapter 2) are reviewed. Based on the extraction of biological principles, the recent hardware‐implemented visual neurons located in different parts of the visual pathway are discussed in detail in Chapters 3 and 4. Furthermore, valuable applications of inspired artificial vision in different scenarios (Chapter 5) are provided. The functional description of the visual pathway and its inspired neuromorphic devices/circuits are expected to provide valuable insights for the design of next‐generation artificial visual perception systems.
title: Hierarchies in Visual Pathway: Functions and Inspired Artificial Vision

abstract: Abstract Permeability, which generally decreases with depth, is the most important parameter that controls fluid flow in Earth's crust. There are two categories of models that describe the permeability‐depth relationship: one category forces permeability to approach infinity at the surface, and the other category leads to too much decrease in permeability with depth. Here we present a new model that integrates and reconciles existing models thus allowing for complete description of crustal permeability from the surface and through the entire crust. Our model provides improved description of observed data and is applicable to both continental crust and oceanic crust. It can be used to obtain a better understanding of the role of fluids in crustal processes.
summary_zh: 我们提出一种新的地壳渗透率模型，能够统一并调和现有两类描述渗透率随深度变化的关系。传统模型中，一类强制渗透率在地表趋于无穷大，另一类则导致渗透率随深度衰减过快，均难以完整刻画从地表到全地壳尺度的渗透特征。新模型通过整合已有模型的合理成分，实现了对地壳渗透率从地表至整个地壳剖面的连续描述，显著改善了对观测数据的拟合效果。该模型同时适用于大陆地壳和海洋地壳，可用于更准确地分析流体在地壳过程中的作用，为研究地壳内流体运移、成矿作用、地热系统及地震活动等相关问题提供定量工具。
title: An integrated permeability‐depth model for Earth's crust

abstract: Kronecker compressive sensing (KCS) technique is used for compressively sampling multi-dimensional signals, and reconstructing them from their measurements. In order to obtain more accurate reconstruction, the learned dictionaries are usually employed for Tucker-decomposition-based sparse representation of original signals. Such dictionaries are learned in advance by using a set of multi-dimensional training samples which contain similar structures with the original signals. However, the prior information of the original signals may be unknown in advance. In such case, it is infeasible to select proper samples for dictionary learning. To overcome this limitation, in this paper, we propose an adaptive approach for sparse representation of KCS. The proposed approach achieves dynamic update of dictionaries without requiring the prior information of original signals. As a result, the reconstruction accuracy can be continually improved as the number of input signals increases, which is verified through the simulations on real images.
summary_zh: 针对多维信号压缩感知中字典学习依赖先验信息的问题，本文提出一种自适应稀疏表示方法。该方法在无需原始信号先验知识的情况下，通过动态更新字典实现信号的精确重构。具体而言，采用基于Tucker分解的稀疏表示框架，利用输入信号本身逐步优化字典，使重构精度随信号数量增加而持续提升。在真实图像上的仿真实验验证了该方法的有效性，表明其适用于多维信号压缩采样与重构领域。
title: Adaptive Sparse Representation for Kronecker Compressive Sensing
venue: 2019 IEEE International Instrumentation and Measurement Technology Conference (I2MTC)

summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于多磁场协同的新型无线移动悬浮系统，旨在探索在难以触及环境中实现无线移动悬浮操控的有效性。围绕无线移动悬浮光源的建模、仿真、实现与分析展开，以此验证所提系统的可行性。系统通过机械结构设计构建无线移动悬浮光源，利用永磁体与通电空心绕组产生抵抗重力的悬浮力，使发光二极管盘片稳定悬浮；同时引入无线功率传输模块为盘片供电。采用两台混合步进电机实现盘片的平面运动，并设计控制策略调节励磁电流，确保盘片悬浮的稳定性、快速响应与精确度。借助ANSYS软件（Ansoft Maxwell）进行仿真表征，最终通过原型样机的实验结果验证了该无线移动悬浮系统的有效性。该技术可望应用于狭小或危险空间内的非接触操控与照明等场景。
title: Modeling, Analysis, and Implementation of a Novel Wireless-Moving-Levitating System with Multiple Magnetic Fields

summary_zh: 高精度车辆定位是实现自动驾驶转向控制的核心技术。针对自动驾驶车辆在复杂实际道路环境下，由于行驶范围扩大导致SLAM算法产生累积误差及明显的漂移现象，本文提出了一种名为PDLC-LIO的紧耦合激光惯性里程计框架，旨在解决大规模闭环环境下的定位精度问题。该方法引入了无需特征提取的直接点云配准方式，并集成了惯性测量单元（IMU）预积分、局部尺度直接扫描匹配以及一种带有条件检测的高效闭环检测策略，以确保定位的鲁棒性。在后端优化方面，通过因子图优化技术实现了激光里程计、IMU数据与闭环约束的深度融合。实验结果表明，在公开数据集及自主研发的自动驾驶实验平台测试中，该方法在抑制累积误差和漂移现象方面的表现均优于LeGO-LOAM、LIO-SAM及FAST-LIO2等主流算法，且闭环检测率提升至75%，显著增强了大规模场景下的定位可靠性。
title: PDLC-LIO: A Precise and Direct SLAM System Toward Large-Scale Environments With Loop Closures
venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems

summary_zh: 本文针对文本驱动的全身动作生成任务，旨在根据文本描述同步生成高质量、多样化且连贯的面部表情、手势及身体动作。针对现有研究忽视精细化手部与面部控制，以及文本与动作对齐效果不佳的问题，本文提出了名为HumanTOMATO的文本对齐全身动作生成框架，这是该领域首次尝试实现应用型的整体动作生成。该框架包含两项核心设计：首先，通过引入整体分层VQ-VAE（H$^2$VQ）与分层GPT模型，利用两个结构化码本实现精细化的身体与手部动作重建与生成；其次，通过预训练的文本-动作对齐模型，显式增强生成动作与输入文本描述的一致性。大量实验结果表明，该模型在生成动作的质量以及动作与文本的对齐度方面均具有显著优势。
title: HumanTOMATO: Text-aligned Whole-body Motion Generation

summary_zh: 本文针对视觉受限环境下颗粒材料识别难题，提出一种基于力反馈的非视觉分类器GmClass。该方法将机器人与颗粒交互的力信号转换至频域，并与高维文本信息融合，构建双分支架构进行多模态监督对比学习。实验表明，该分类器准确率达84.10%，较传统监督学习提升10个百分点，比单一监督对比学习高出40个百分点以上，证实了文本模态对分类的积极影响。在更大规模数据集上，准确率进一步提升至85.28%，验证了方法的有效性。此外，研究还展示了该方法对未知颗粒的处理能力及在不同数据采集参数下的泛化性能。该成果为机器人触觉感知与颗粒材料交互识别提供了新途径。
title: A Joint Learning of Force Feedback of Robotic Manipulation and Textual Cues for Granular Materials Classification

abstract: The marriage of colloidal semiconductor nanocrystals and functional organic molecules has brought unique opportunities in emerging photonic and optoelectronic applications. Traditional semiconductor nanocrystals have been widely demonstrated to initiate efficient triplet energy transfer at the nanocrystal-acene interface. Herein, we report that unlike conventional semiconductor nanocrystals, lead halide perovskite nanocrystals promote an efficient Dexter-like singlet energy transfer to surface-anchored pentacene molecules rather than triplet energy transfer. Subsequently, molecular pentacene triplets are efficiently generated via singlet fission on the nanocrystal surface. Our demonstrated strategy not only unveils the obscure energy dynamics between perovskite nanocrystal and acenes, but also brings important perspectives of utilizing singlet fission throughout the solar spectrum.
summary_zh: 本文报道了铅卤钙钛矿纳米晶与并五苯分子界面间一种新颖的能量转移机制。传统胶体半导体纳米晶通常在与并五苯等并苯类分子界面处引发高效的三线态能量转移，而本研究发现铅卤钙钛矿纳米晶表现出截然不同的行为：其优先促进类德克斯特单线态能量向表面锚定并五苯分子的直接转移，而非三线态能量转移。随后，并五苯分子通过单线态裂分过程在纳米晶表面高效生成三线态激子。这一策略不仅揭示了钙钛矿纳米晶与并苯分子间此前未被阐明的能量转移动力学，也为在全太阳光谱范围内利用单线态裂分效应提供了重要思路，有望推动光子学和光电子学新兴应用的发展。
title: Sensitizing Singlet Fission with Perovskite Nanocrystals
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

title: Recent advances in protein sequencing

abstract: Purpose The purpose of this paper is to study and obtain the influence of resin and filler properties of printed circuit board (PCB) on the drilling force during micro drilling. Design/methodology/approach Experiments were carried out to study the influence of PCB on micro-hole drilling force under high spindle speed. A drilling force measurement system was applied, and then, the influence of resin and filler properties of PCBs on the force was analyzed. The proportion of resin and filler in the PCB was defined as four levels, and the influence of PCBs based on the drilling force measurement was summarized. Findings The drilling force decreased with the decrease in the feed rate, and lower filler (16-30 per cent) and average resin (31-50 per cent) would have a positive impact on the drilling force. At the same time, the size of uniform and fine fillers would help to reduce the drilling force. Originality/value The drilling force measurement system was applied, and the influence of PCBs on force was analyzed, which could provide a reference value on the optimization of the drilling force during micro drilling.
summary_zh: 本文研究印刷电路板（PCB）中树脂与填料特性对微孔钻削力的影响。实验在高主轴转速条件下进行，采用钻削力测量系统采集数据，并系统分析了PCB组分对钻削力的作用规律。研究中将PCB中树脂与填料的比例划分为四个水平，基于钻削力测量结果归纳其影响。结果表明，钻削力随进给速度降低而减小；较低的填料含量（16%–30%）和中等树脂含量（31%–50%）对降低钻削力具有积极作用。同时，填料颗粒尺寸均匀且细小也有助于减小钻削力。该研究通过钻削力测量系统揭示了PCB材料特性对微钻削过程的影响，可为微孔钻削力的优化提供参考依据，对高精度PCB制造工艺改进具有指导意义。
title: The influence of properties of printed circuit board resin and filler on drilling force

abstract: Cardiomyocyte differentiation continues throughout murine gestation and into the postnatal period, driven by temporally regulated expression changes in the transcriptome. The mechanisms that regulate these developmental changes remain incompletely defined. Here we used cardiomyocyte specific ChIP-seq of the activate enhancer marker P300 to identify 54,920 cardiomyocyte enhancers at seven stages of murine heart development. These data were matched to cardiomyocyte gene expression profiles at the same stages and Hi-C and H3K27ac HiChIP chromatin conformation data at fetal, neonatal, and adult stages. Regions with dynamic P300 occupancy exhibited developmentally regulated enhancer activity, as measured by massively parallel reporter assays in cardiomyocytes in vivo, and identified key transcription factor binding motifs. These dynamic enhancers interacted with temporal changes of 3D genome architecture to specify developmentally regulated cardiomyocyte gene expression. Our work provides a 3D genome-mediated enhancer activity landscape of murine cardiomyocyte development.
title: Dynamic changes in P300 enhancers and enhancer-promoter contacts control mouse cardiomyocyte maturation

summary_zh: 人机交互（HOI）检测旨在识别并理解图像中人与物体之间的交互关系。现有的检测方法多采用单步推理范式，即在不区分样本难度的前提下，对所有候选交互对同时进行多标签预测。然而，同一图像中的交互对存在显著的难度差异，这种缺乏区分度的处理方式导致模型在面对复杂场景时性能大幅下降。本文提出了一种全新的多步推理网络，旨在实现从简单样本到困难样本的渐进式学习。该方法的核心思想是让模型优先推断简单样本，并利用简单样本的信息来辅助困难样本的识别。具体而言，本文引入了由易到难学习模块，通过先验关联来增强困难交互对的特征表示；同时，提出了多步推理概率转移机制，利用认知关联与语义依赖关系来提升多标签交互分类的准确性。在两个具有挑战性的基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法在性能上优于现有的先进算法。
title: Learning from Easy to Hard Pairs: Multi-step Reasoning Network for Human-Object Interaction Detection
venue: Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedia

summary_zh: 本研究开发了一种新型二维共轭金属有机框架材料Cu-TTPQ，作为钠离子电池正极材料。该材料通过原位环化脱氢与配位组装策略，由柔性前驱体配体直接合成，其刚性骨架中同时整合了醌和吡嗪两种氧化还原活性官能团，从而构建了多重氧化还原位点。为进行系统对比，还制备了两种结构相似但导电性和能带特征不同的二维共轭金属有机框架类似物Cu-TBPQ和Cu-DDQP。电化学测试表明，Cu-TTPQ展现出显著优势：在0.05 A g⁻¹电流密度下，可逆比容量高达214.8 mAh g⁻¹；同时具备优异的循环稳定性，在5.0 A g⁻¹高电流密度下循环1800次后容量衰减极小。该工作阐明了通过引入多重氧化还原活性位点来提升二维共轭金属有机框架正极材料综合性能的合理性，为高性能钠离子电池电极材料的设计提供了新思路。
title: Two dimensional Conjugated Metal–Organic Frameworks with Multiple Redox‐Active Sites towards High‐Performance Sodium‐Ion Battery

abstract: Mild slope equation is extended to simulate nearshore wave transformation including breaking. Several types of boundary conditions with physical background are summarized and expressed by linear co...
summary_zh: 本文对缓坡方程进行了扩展，以模拟包含波浪破碎的近岸波浪传播变形过程。研究系统总结并采用线性组合形式表达了多种具有物理背景的边界条件，包括全反射、部分反射、给定入射波高以及辐射边界条件等。在数值方法上，采用有限元法对扩展后的缓坡方程进行离散求解，该方法能够灵活适应复杂岸线和不规则地形。通过多个典型算例验证了模型的有效性，结果表明该模型能够准确再现波浪在近岸区域的浅化、折射、绕射和破碎等主要物理现象，计算波高分布与实验数据吻合良好。该扩展模型为近岸波浪场的高精度模拟提供了有效工具，可广泛应用于海岸工程、港口设计、岸滩演变分析以及近海结构物波浪力计算等领域。
title: Finite Element Solution of Wave Field Around Structures in Nearshore Zone

summary_zh: 随着信息技术与个性化需求的发展，交通系统正由被动运输向主动服务转型，自动驾驶交通系统（ATS）随之兴起。构建高效的系统架构对于ATS的规划、建设与运营至关重要。针对现有研究多侧重于架构元素定义与接口描述，而忽视元素间映射关系的问题，本文提出了一种基于数据流（DF）文本的信息流（IF）提取方法，旨在实现逻辑数据流与物理信息流之间的自动化映射。研究首先以服务为基本单元对ATS进行解构，明确了逻辑与物理架构的组成元素及映射原则；随后，通过提取流属性并对数据流文本进行向量化处理，利用文本语义分析识别相似的数据流；最后，设计了一种基于图的数据流聚合方法，实现了信息流的独立构建与架构元素的自动化映射。实验结果表明，该方法构建的信息流符合ATS架构需求，能有效支撑自动驾驶交通系统架构的设计与建设。
title: An Autonomous Transportation System Architecture Mapping Relation Generation Method Based on Text Analysis
venue: IEEE Transactions on Computational Social Systems

summary_zh: 针对铁氧体磁砖无损检测中传统超声反射法存在的盲区及方向限制问题，本文提出了一种透射式超声检测方法。该方法采用双探头配置，通过在试件两侧测量超声透射信号，实现了对铁氧体内部及表面缺陷的全方位检测。研究首先利用物理场有限元仿真分析了检测性能，并基于仿真结果开发了相应的透射式检测系统。随后，通过在铝合金人工缺陷样本上进行实验验证，并将其应用于铁氧体磁砖的实际评估。实验结果表明，该系统能够有效区分缺陷信号与正常信号，在检测尺寸小至0.1 mm的样本时，召回率保持在95%以上。本研究为铁氧体磁砖的质量控制与缺陷检测技术提供了有效的技术手段。
title: A through-transmission ultrasonic method for the detection of ferrite tile defects

summary_zh: 由于漏斗效应的作用，大量碎屑有机物和渗透压调节物质在超深渊海沟（深度大于6000米）的沉积物中富集。本研究通过对马里亚纳海沟挑战者深渊沉积物的分析，发现并鉴定出一个属于FCB超门的新型活性细菌门——候选天涯杆菌门（Candidatus Tianyabacteria）。通过基因组分箱技术，研究者在表层0-21厘米的沉积物中获得了两个高质量的候选天涯杆菌门基因组，分别代表两个谱系（L1和L2）。研究发现，L1谱系主要富集于沉积物上层（0-9厘米），而L2谱系则在深层（12-21厘米）更为普遍。基因注释与转录组分析表明，这两个谱系均表现出异养生活方式，能够将氨基酸和肌醇摄入并转化为中心碳代谢产物。此外，受环境氧气水平差异的影响，L2谱系携带反硝化和发酵相关的基因簇，而L1谱系则编码八血红素细胞色素c和多铜氧化酶。综上所述，候选天涯杆菌门作为一种新型异养微生物，在超深渊沉积物的碳、氮循环以及有机渗透压调节物质循环中发挥着重要作用。
title: A novel bacterial phylum that participates in carbon and osmolyte cycling in the Challenger Deep sediments

abstract: Abstract A satellite‐based water balance method is developed to model global evapotranspiration (ET) through coupling a water balance (WB) model with a machine‐learning algorithm (the model tree ensemble, MTE) (hereafter WB‐MTE). The WB‐MTE algorithm was firstly trained by combining monthly WB‐estimated basin ET with the potential drivers (e.g., radiation, temperature, precipitation, wind speed, and vegetation index) across 95 large river basins (5824 basin‐months) and then applied to establish global monthly ET maps at a spatial resolution of 0.5° from 1982 to 2009. The global land ET estimated from WB‐MTE has an annual mean of 593 ± 17 mm for 1982–2009, with a spatial distribution consistent with previous studies in all latitudes but the tropics. The ET estimated by WB‐MTE also shows significant linear trends in both annual and seasonal global ET during 1982–2009, though the trends seem to have stalled after 1998. Moreover, our study presents a striking difference from the previous ones primarily in the magnitude of ET estimates during the wet season particularly in the tropics, where ET is highly uncertain due to lack of direct measurements. This may be tied to their lack of proper consideration to solar radiation and/or the rainfall interception process. By contrast, in the dry season, our estimate of ET compares well with the previous ones, both for the mean state and the variability. If we are to reduce the uncertainties in estimating ET, these results emphasize the necessity of deploying more observations during the wet season, particularly in the tropics.
title: A worldwide analysis of spatiotemporal changes in water balance‐based evapotranspiration from 1982 to 2009

summary_zh: 本文研究一类结构化分式极小化问题，其分子由可微函数、简单非凸非光滑函数、凹非光滑函数以及复合线性算子的凸非光滑函数构成，分母为弱凸或具有弱凸平方根的连续函数。此类问题广泛存在于机器学习与数据科学的诸多重要应用中。现有方法主要基于次梯度法和光滑化近端梯度法，普遍存在收敛缓慢和数值稳定性不足的问题。为此，我们提出首个针对该类问题设计的交替方向乘子法FADMM。该方法将原问题解耦为线性化近端子问题，包含两种实现变体：一种基于丁克尔巴赫参数化方法（FADMM-D），另一种采用二次变换方法（FADMM-Q）。通过构造新颖的李雅普诺夫函数，我们证明FADMM能在O(1/ε³)的谕示复杂度内收敛到问题的ε-近似临界点。在合成数据与真实数据集上的大量实验，包括稀疏Fisher判别分析、鲁棒夏普比率最小化和鲁棒稀疏恢复，验证了所提方法的有效性。
title: ADMM for Structured Fractional Minimization

summary_zh: 本文报道了独特且具有合成挑战性的五环二萜类化合物atropurpuran的全合成研究。该化合物具有一种在天然萜类中前所未见的tetracyclo[5.3.3.0$^{4,9}$.0$^{4,12}$]-tridecane骨架。研究采用了一种仅需13步的简洁合成策略，通过早期快速构建骨架并结合后期引入活性官能团的方法，实现了极高的合成效率，并最大限度地减少了保护基的使用。合成过程中的关键转化包括：利用烯炔闭环复分解反应简便地构建了spiro[5.5]undecane部分，并通过区域选择性的双氧化去芳构化/分子内Diels-Alder级联反应，高效地完成了tetracyclo[5.3.3.0$^{4,9}$.0$^{4,12}$]-tridecane骨架的构建。该高效合成路线为未来合成结构类似的复杂二萜及二萜生物碱提供了重要的启发与参考。
title: 13-Step Total Synthesis of Atropurpuran
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

abstract: High-resolution vehicular emissions inventories are important for managing vehicular pollution and improving urban air quality. This study developed a vehicular emission inventory with high spatio-temporal resolution in the main urban area of Chongqing, based on real-time traffic data from 820 RFID detectors covering 454 roads, and the differences in spatio-temporal emission characteristics between inner and outer districts were analysed. The result showed that the daily vehicular emission intensities of CO, hydrocarbons, PM2.5, PM10, and NOx were 30.24, 3.83, 0.18, 0.20, and 8.65 kg/km per day, respectively, in the study area during 2018. The pollutants emission intensities in inner district were higher than those in outer district. Light passenger cars (LPCs) were the main contributors of all-day CO emissions in the inner and outer districts, from which the contributors of NOx emissions were different. Diesel and natural gas buses were major contributors of daytime NOx emissions in inner districts, accounting for 40.40%, but buses and heavy duty trucks (HDTs) were major contributors in outer districts. At nighttime, due to the lifting of truck restrictions and suspension of buses, HDTs become the main NOx contributor in both inner and outer districts, and its three NOx emission peak hours were found, which are different to the peak hours of total NOx emission by all vehicles. Unlike most other cities, bridges and connecting channels are always emission hotspots due to long-time traffic congestion. This knowledge will help fully understand vehicular emissions characteristics and is useful for policymakers to design precise prevention and control measures.
title: Variation of spatio-temporal distribution of on-road vehicle emissions based on real-time RFID data

abstract: Water oxidation is considered as one of the most important reactions in solar-to-fuel generation. The initial catalytic intermediates formed on an ultrafast timescale play a great role in controlling water oxidation reaction. Here, we use ultrafast in situ infrared attenuated total reflectance spectroscopy to study the initial water oxidation intermediates at a state-of-the-art TiO2 P25/aqueous interface. We observe a Ti–O vibration near 850 cm–1 possibly in the anatase phase, suggested to be a subsurface vibration as a result of hole localization on the P25 surfaces. Such a subsurface Ti–O vibration is found to couple to reactant dynamics (water librations). This experiment suggests that a subsurface vibration could be a distinctive infrared reporter of reaction intermediates for water oxidation on titania surfaces.
summary_zh: 水氧化是太阳能向燃料转化过程中最关键的反应之一，在超快时间尺度上形成的初始催化中间体对调控水氧化反应起着决定性作用。本研究采用超快原位红外衰减全反射光谱技术，在先进的TiO2 P25/水溶液界面处探测初始水氧化中间体。我们在约850 cm⁻¹处观察到可能归属于锐钛矿相的Ti–O振动，推测其为P25表面空穴局域化所引发的次表面振动。进一步发现，该次表面Ti–O振动与反应物水分子的摆动动力学存在耦合关系。本实验表明，次表面振动可作为二氧化钛表面水氧化反应中间体的特征红外探针，为深入理解光催化水氧化机理提供了新的光谱学手段。
title: One-Electron Water Oxidation Intermediate on TiO2 P25 Probed by Ultrafast Attenuated Total Reflection
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry C

abstract: In this article, robust and convergent properties of iterative learning control (ILC) laws are investigated for two kinds of two-dimensional (2-D) linear discrete systems (LDS) in the second Fornasini-Marchesini's model (FMMII). The iteration-dependent uncertainties in reference trajectories, boundary states, and disturbances are considered in the ILC designs of 2-D FMMII. By virtue of the lifting matrix/vector technique, the ILC processes of two kinds of 2-D FMMII are transformed into 2-D linear inequalities. As a result, robust and convergent conditions are obtained for the proposed ILC laws. It is theoretically proved that by using the proposed ILC laws, under the discussed iteration-dependent uncertainties, the ILC tracking errors of 2-D FMMII can be driven into a residual range, the bound of which is relevant to the bound parameters of uncertainties. In particular, when the iteration-dependent uncertainties of 2-D FMMII are progressively convergent in iteration domain, an accurate tracking to the desired reference trajectory can be realized except at the boundaries. Numerical simulations are used to illustrate the validity and feasibility of the designed ILC laws.
title: Robust Iterative Learning Control of 2-D Linear Discrete FMMII Systems Subject to Iteration-Dependent Uncertainties
venue: IEEE Transactions on Systems Man and Cybernetics Systems

summary_zh: 随着大气化学分析能力的提升，室内空气质量研究迎来了新机遇。本研究通过HOMEChem实验，开展了一项化学成分全面的室内实地观测活动，旨在探究烹饪和清洁等日常活动对测试房屋内空气质量的影响。研究团队整合了浓度高于1 ppt的所有气相化合物化学数据，并结合已有的健康效应阈值数据库，对气相污染物及相关室内活动可能带来的健康风险进行了评估。研究结果表明，室内空气的化学组成与室外空气存在显著差异，室内气态化合物的浓度更高且种类更丰富，因此其预测危害商数也高于室外。此外，烹饪和清洁等常见家务活动会导致室内空气成分发生剧烈波动，显著提升了多种具有高风险商数的化合物浓度。HOMEChem的研究数据强调了人类活动对建筑环境内呼吸空气的强烈影响，并揭示了这些活动如何增加空气污染物暴露相关的健康风险。
title: Detailed investigation of the contribution of gas-phase air contaminants to exposure risk during indoor activities

abstract: In this paper, we introduce the notions of bounded invariance complexity, bounded invariance complexity in the mean and mean Lyapunov-stability for control systems. Then we characterize these notions by introducing six types of equi-invariability. As a by-product, two new dichotomy theorems for the control system on the control sets are established.
summary_zh: 本文针对控制系统引入了有界不变复杂度、平均有界不变复杂度以及平均李雅普诺夫稳定性等新概念，旨在刻画系统在受控条件下的动态行为特征。通过提出六种等度不变性类型，对这些概念进行了系统性的等价刻画与分类，揭示了不同稳定性层次之间的内在联系。作为研究的副产品，在控制集上建立了两个新的二分性定理，为控制系统的定性分析提供了更为精细的理论工具。该成果可应用于非线性控制、复杂动态系统分析以及工程中涉及稳定性判定的相关领域。
title: Equi-invariability, bounded invariance complexity and L-stability for control systems

summary_zh: 量子纠缠作为现代量子技术的核心资源，极易因退相干而衰减。本文提出利用量子自编码器保护纠缠态的方法，该自编码器经过训练可将特定量子纠缠态集合压缩至对退相干具有鲁棒性的子空间中。训练过程采用量子-经典混合优化策略，既提升了自编码器构建效率，又降低了优化过程中的实验误差。在金刚石氮-空位中心体系中，我们实验证明电子自旋与核自旋之间的纠缠态可被编码至相干时间显著更长的核自旋子空间内。结果表明，该固态自旋体系中的贝尔态寿命从2.22±0.43微秒延长至3.03±0.56毫秒，实现了三个数量级的提升。该量子自编码器方法具有普适性，为将长寿命核自旋用作量子信息任务中的即时量子存储器开辟了道路。
title: Preserving entanglement in a solid-spin system using quantum autoencoders

summary_zh: 为了推动建筑业的可持续发展并降低能耗与碳排放，结构构件的重复利用已成为重要研究方向。尽管钢结构构件易于拆解再利用，但钢-混凝土组合结构材料的回收利用仍面临巨大挑战。针对目前组合结构拆解设计规范缺失及研究不足的问题，本文提出了一种创新的可拆卸K型节点设计方案，该方案采用盲钉连接填充钢管（CFST）弦杆与圆钢管（CHS）撑杆。通过建立精细的有限元分析模型，并结合已有的螺栓连接与焊接CFST连接试验数据进行了模型验证，进而对该创新节点的失效模式、全量程荷载-变形关系、应力分布及材料相互作用进行了深入评估。研究结果对比了可拆卸CFST K型节点与传统焊接节点的力学性能差异。最后，基于理论推导与多因素参数化分析，本文提出了用于预测可拆卸CFST K型节点强度的简化计算方法，为组合结构的可拆卸设计提供了理论支撑。
title: Numerical investigation of demountable CFST K-joints using blind bolts

abstract: Alpha-stable distributions have found various applications in the literature especially in modelling impulsive noise in communications channels. Despite various schemes for receiver design under alpha-stable noise, the channel coding problem has not been addressed yet. In this letter, we develop the channel capacity for the alpha-stable channels both for the symmetric and the skewed cases and provide numerical bounds for its lossy coding performance. Blahut-Arimoto algorithm is used to calculate the capacity of alpha-stable channel and its efficiency is demonstrated.
summary_zh: Alpha稳定分布在通信信道脉冲噪声建模领域具有广泛的应用价值。尽管目前已有多种针对Alpha稳定噪声的接收机设计方案，但关于该噪声环境下的信道编码问题尚未得到充分研究。本文针对对称及偏斜两种情形下的Alpha稳定信道，深入探讨并推导了其信道容量，并为其有损编码性能提供了数值边界。研究通过应用Blahut-Arimoto算法对Alpha稳定信道的容量进行了精确计算，并验证了该算法在处理此类信道问题时的高效性。该研究为复杂噪声环境下的通信系统编码设计提供了重要的理论依据。
title: Alpha-Stable Channel Capacity

summary_zh: 现有关于多智能体（多人）调度的研究通常将个体的目标函数设定为调度成本函数，而本文则创新性地引入合作利润函数作为个体的目标。针对所研究的双人调度问题，两人共同商定单台机器的公共作业时间窗口，各自需在该窗口内处理一组私有工件。每个人的目标函数仍依赖于双方所有工件的排序，其中除一项假定为其自身工件总完工时间的给定倍数外，其余部分均由预设参数决定。双方必须协商工件加工顺序，并确定合作利润分配的最终方案。此类双人调度问题本质上构成一个合作博弈。本文首先设计了基于合作利润的帕累托有效解集算法，将其作为第一个博弈解概念，并进一步开发了该算法的并行化版本。第二个博弈解概念是适用于上述双人调度合作博弈情境的沙普利值。通过多个实例的展示与分析，揭示了联合运用这两种解概念的必要性。
title: Two game-based solution concepts for a two-agent scheduling problem

summary_zh: 本研究旨在探讨保守型长链非编码RNA（lncRNA）——心肌梗死相关转录本（Miat）在病理性心肌肥大中的生物学作用。研究人员通过血管紧张素II（Ang II）持续输注模型和主动脉弓缩窄（TAC）模型，分别在野生型（WT）小鼠和Miat基因敲除（Miat-KO）小鼠中诱导病理性心肌肥大。实验结果显示，与WT小鼠相比，Miat-KO小鼠在两种模型中均表现出更轻微的心脏肥大程度，其心重/胫骨长度比、心肌细胞横截面积、心肌细胞凋亡及间质纤维化程度均显著降低，且毛细血管密度保持较好。在分子机制方面，Ang II诱导的WT小鼠心肌细胞中钙循环相关基因（如SERCA2a和RyR2）的表达下降以及全局RNA剪接事件的剧增，在Miat-KO小鼠中得到了显著缓解。此外，Miat-KO小鼠来源的原代心肌细胞表现出更高效的钙循环能力和更强的收缩力。综上所述，缺失Miat能够通过增强心肌细胞收缩功能，从而减轻病理性心肌肥大及心力衰竭的发生发展。
title: Ablation of lncRNA Miat attenuates pathological hypertrophy and heart failure

abstract: In real-world social networks, global information (e.g., the number of nodes and the connections between them) is incomplete or expensive to acquire; therefore, local community detection becomes especially important. Local community detection is used to identify the local community to which the given starting node belongs according to local information. For a given node, most existing local community detection methods can only find single scale local communities but not those of variable sizes. However, local communities with different scales are often required. Therefore, it is necessary and meaningful to find local communities of the given starting node with different scales; we call this multiscale local community detection. In this paper, we propose a new local modularity inspired by the global modularity and prove the equivalence of the proposed local modularity with two other typical local modularities. Furthermore, to detect local communities with different scales, we present a method based on the proposed local modularity. We test this method on several synthetic and real datasets, and the experimental results indicate that the detected community is meaningful and its scale can be changed reasonably.
title: Multiscale Local Community Detection in Social Networks
venue: IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering

summary_zh: 探索问题是深度强化学习面临的核心挑战之一。虽然现有的基于种群的方法通过收集不同探索策略产生的多样化样本来应对该问题，但其行为选择空间往往受限于预定义的策略种群，从而限制了行为的多样性。针对这一局限，本文提出了一种名为可学习行为控制（LBC）的通用框架。该框架通过构建从所有策略到行为的混合映射，显著扩大了行为选择的空间，并建立了一个统一的可学习行为选择过程。研究人员将LBC引入分布式离策略Actor-Critic方法中，并利用基于多臂老虎机（Bandit）的元控制器来优化行为映射的选择，从而实现精准的行为控制。实验结果表明，在Arcade Learning Environment基准测试中，该方法在10亿帧训练内实现了10077.52%的人类归一化平均得分，并刷新了24项人类世界纪录。这证明了该方法在不降低样本效率的前提下，达到了当前最先进的性能水平。
title: Learnable behavior control: breaking atari human world records via sample-efficient behavior selection

summary_zh: 本文提出一种可调谐的超快强度旋转光场，通过迈克尔逊干涉仪将一对重复频率为20 Hz、中心波长800 nm的啁啾脉冲叠加生成。该光场的旋转速率最高可达10万亿弧度每秒，并可通过干涉仪中的反射镜灵活调节。此外，通过控制脉冲对的拓扑荷差值，还可改变其折叠旋转对称结构。实验成功构建了双瓣旋转光格，旋转速度在3.9至11.9万亿弧度每秒之间连续可调，并利用基于非共线光参量放大的单次超快帧成像技术进行验证，该成像最高帧率达15万亿帧每秒。本工作在低重复频率下开展，因此可应用于相对论乃至超相对论强度场景，这类场景通常运行于低重频超短超强激光系统。该技术有望在激光等离子体加速器、强太赫兹辐射及天体现象模拟等领域获得应用。
title: Generation and imaging of a tunable ultrafast intensity-rotating optical field with a cycle down to femtosecond region
venue: High Power Laser Science and Engineering

summary_zh: 随着中国长城站的建立，长城湾已成为南极研究的重要区域。实现无缝海图基准面及其与其他高程数据的转换模型，是统一海陆垂直参考系的关键。本文针对长城湾区域，结合最低天文潮（LAT）无缝海图基准面模型，分别利用两种不同的平均海平面（MSS）大地高实现方式构建了两种转换模型。方案一通过叠加EGM2008模型值与2017年1月至2018年4月期间基于格网卫星高度计产品的平均绝对动态地形来构建MSS高程；方案二则直接利用基于1993年至2015年多任务卫星高度计数据生成的DTU15格网MSS大地高产品。研究利用Atlantic Ocean 2008模型提取潮汐分潮来计算LAT无缝海图基准面模型。根据误差传播定律评估，方案一与方案二的精度分别为12.0 cm和11.2 cm。通过与长城湾压力式潮汐计的实测结果对比发现，方案一与方案二的偏差分别为127.6 cm和42.2 cm。结果表明，尽管两种方案的偏差仍远超其自身的精度评估值，但方案二的表现显著优于方案一。研究认为，偏差产生的主要原因在于MSS实现的时间跨度差异以及沿岸水域卫星高度计测量精度较低。
title: Establishment of Chart Datum and Vertical Datum Transformation for Hydrography in the Chinese Great Wall Bay, Antarctic Peninsula

abstract: We study the problem of community detection in multi-layer networks, where pairs of nodes can be related in multiple modalities. We introduce a general framework, i.e., mixture multi-layer stochastic block model (MMSBM), which includes many earlier models as special cases. We propose a tensor-based algorithm (TWIST) to reveal both global/local memberships of nodes, and memberships of layers. We show that the TWIST procedure can accurately detect the communities with small misclassification error as the number of nodes and/or the number of layers increases. Numerical studies confirm our theoretical findings. To our best knowledge, this is the first systematic study on the mixture multi-layer networks using tensor decomposition. The method is applied to two real datasets: worldwide trading networks and malaria parasite genes networks, yielding new and interesting findings.
summary_zh: 本文研究多层网络中的社区发现问题，其中节点对之间可通过多种模态产生关联。我们提出一个通用框架——混合多层随机块模型（MMSBM），该模型将许多已有模型统一为特例。针对该模型，我们设计了一种基于张量的算法TWIST，能够同时揭示节点的全局与局部隶属关系以及层的隶属关系。理论分析表明，随着节点数量和/或层数量的增加，TWIST方法能够以较小的误分类误差准确检测社区。数值实验验证了理论结果。据我们所知，这是首次利用张量分解对混合多层网络进行系统研究。我们将该方法应用于两个真实数据集：全球贸易网络和疟疾寄生虫基因网络，获得了新颖且有意义的发现。
title: Community detection on mixture multi-layer networks via regularized tensor decomposition

abstract: We generalize the inverse iteration for matrices to the (generalized) Sylvester operator S ( X ) ≡ A X B ⊤ − C X D ⊤ , computing the null space or the homogeneous solution to S ( X ) = 0 , or the eigen-spaces for the intersecting subspectrum Λ ( A , C ) ∩ Λ ( D , B ) . Cases with two small matrix pencils in ( A , C ) and ( D , B ) , a large and a small pencils, and two large pencils, as well as the special cases for the Sylvester and Lyapunov equations, and the linear equation with tensor structures, are considered.
