When the solution process for the corresponding Sylvester equation is robust and efficient, the generalized inverse iteration converges in one or two iterations, especially for cases of small dimensions or with semi-simple intersecting eigenvalues. For large examples, especially with derogatory intersecting eigenvalues, the approach performs less well. Illustrative numerical experiments are presented. • Generalization of inverse iteration to Sylvester operators for null space computation • Exact arithmetic analysis of Sylvester operator null spaces under structural assumptions • Round-off error analysis in null space computation for small and large Sylvester operators • Use of Bartels-Stewart and Krylov methods for inversion of Sylvester-type operators • Numerical experiments on Sylvester-type operators and linear tensor equations
title: Inverse iteration for Sylvester operators
venue: Journal of Computational and Applied Mathematics

abstract: This paper studies the problem of determining the sensor locations in a large sensor network using only relative distance (range) measurements. Based on a generalized barycentric coordinate representation, our work generalizes the DILOC algorithm to the localization problem under arbitrary deployments of sensor nodes and anchor nodes. First, a criterion and algorithm are developed to determine a generalized barycentric coordinate of a node with respect to its neighboring nodes, which do not require the node to be inside the convex hull of its neighbors. Next, for the localization problem based on the generalized barycentric coordinate representation, a necessary and sufficient condition for the localizability of a sensor network with a generic configuration is obtained. Finally, a new linear iterative algorithm is proposed to ensure distributed implementation as well as global convergence to the true coordinates.
summary_zh: 本文研究仅利用相对距离测量确定大规模传感器网络中节点位置的问题。基于广义重心坐标表示，我们将 DILOC 算法推广至传感器节点与锚节点任意部署场景下的定位任务。首先，提出一种判断节点相对于其邻居节点的广义重心坐标的准则与算法，该算法不要求节点位于邻居节点构成的凸包内部。其次，针对基于广义重心坐标表示的定位问题，给出了通用配置下传感器网络可定位性的充要条件。最后，提出一种新的线性迭代算法，既能保证分布式实现，又能确保全局收敛至真实坐标。该方法适用于大规模无线传感器网络、物联网设备定位及多智能体系统等应用领域。
title: A Barycentric Coordinate Based Distributed Localization Algorithm for Sensor Networks

abstract: Generic generation and manipulation of text is challenging and has limited success compared to recent deep generative modeling in visual domain. This paper aims at generating plausible natural language sentences, whose attributes are dynamically controlled by learning disentangled latent representations with designated semantics. We propose a new neural generative model which combines variational auto-encoders and holistic attribute discriminators for effective imposition of semantic structures. With differentiable approximation to discrete text samples, explicit constraints on independent attribute controls, and efficient collaborative learning of generator and discriminators, our model learns highly interpretable representations from even only word annotations, and produces realistic sentences with desired attributes. Quantitative evaluation validates the accuracy of sentence and attribute generation.
summary_zh: 本文针对文本生成领域可控性不足的难题，提出了一种融合变分自编码器与整体属性判别器的神经生成模型，旨在生成属性可动态控制的自然语言句子。该方法通过解耦具有指定语义的隐变量表示，实现对生成文本属性的精细操控。模型采用对离散文本样本的可微近似、独立属性控制的显式约束以及生成器与判别器的高效协同学习机制，即使在仅有词级标注的条件下，也能学习出高度可解释的语义表示，并生成符合目标属性的逼真语句。定量评估结果验证了该方法在句子生成质量与属性控制准确性方面的有效性，为可控文本生成提供了新的技术路径。
title: Controllable Text Generation.

summary_zh: 由于斜齿轮在机械传动中具有优异的承载能力与稳定性，如何实现高性能润滑并延长点蚀寿命一直是该领域的研究难点。本文构建了一种混合弹性流体动力润滑（EHL）模型，并提出了一种结合机器学习的点蚀寿命优化框架。研究方法整合了用于啮合参数计算的接触线百分比法、用于表面变形分析的离散卷积快速傅里叶变换（DC-FFT）技术，以及基于Zaretsky理论的点蚀寿命预测模型。在数据驱动层面，通过引入反向传播神经网络（BPNN）、随机森林（RF）及梯度提升决策树（GBDT）进行寿命预测，并利用非支配排序遗传算法（NSGA-II）实现多参数协同优化。研究结果表明，不同结构参数对齿轮性能的影响程度各异，通过对参数进行协调调整，可以在控制体积的前提下显著提升疲劳可靠性。该研究为斜齿轮的工程设计与性能优化提供了重要的理论指导与技术手段。
title: Pitting Life Optimization for Helical Gears Based on Interfacial Lubrication and Machine Learning

abstract: Protein secondary structure prediction is an important step to understanding protein tertiary structure. Recent studies indicate that the correlation between neighboring secondary structures are beneficial to improve prediction performance. In this paper, we propose a new large margin approach for protein secondary structure prediction, which consider the problem as a sequence labeling problem like probabilistic graphical models. It doesnpsilat only make full use of the correlation between neighboring secondary structures like graphical chain models, but also shares the key advantages of other SVM-based methods, i.e. learning non-linear discriminate via kernel functions. The experimental results on datasets: CB513 and RS126 show that our algorithm outperforms other state-of-the-art methods.
summary_zh: 蛋白质二级结构预测是理解蛋白质三级结构的关键步骤。近期研究表明，相邻二级结构之间的相关性有助于提升预测性能。本文提出一种新的大间隔方法用于蛋白质二级结构预测，将该问题视为类似概率图模型的序列标注问题。该方法不仅能像图链模型一样充分利用相邻二级结构之间的相关性，还兼具其他基于支持向量机方法的核心优势，即通过核函数学习非线性判别特征。在CB513和RS126数据集上的实验结果表明，本算法性能优于当前最先进的其他方法。
title: Protein Secondary Structure Prediction Using Large Margin Methods
venue: 2009 Eighth IEEE/ACIS International Conference on Computer and Information Science

summary_zh: 大规模微型飞行器（MAV）集群在环境监测、城市监控及搜救等领域具有显著的应用潜力。然而，在缺乏定位基础设施且单机载荷受限的复杂场景下，实现节点的自主导航仍面临巨大挑战。本文提出了一种名为H-DrunkWalk的协作式自适应技术，旨在解决非预设环境下的异构MAV集群导航问题。该系统通过构建异构集群，将具备有限感知、通信与计算能力的基础型MAV与具备高性能能力的先进型MAV相结合，利用节点间的协同机制弥补单机能力的不足，并充分发挥先进型节点的引导作用，以实现高效的系统级感知目标。通过真实实验平台测试与大规模物理特征仿真验证，结果表明，相比于传统的非协作、非自适应导航方法，H-DrunkWalk在给定时间和精度约束下，能将定位误差降低至多6倍，并将导航成功率提升至多3倍。此外，通过综合考量环境因素、异构结构及定位质量，该方法实现的平均性能提升相当于硬件升级带来的2倍增益。
title: H-DrunkWalk: Collaborative and Adaptive Navigation for Heterogeneous MAV Swarm.

summary_zh: 李群是同时具有光滑流形结构的群，其乘法与求逆运算均为光滑映射。李群的李代数由群上全体左不变向量场构成，其中左不变性指向量场在左平移作用下保持不变。李代数可视为单位元处切空间的线性空间，通过平移可将切向量扩展为左不变向量场，且该向量场自动光滑。李代数的代数结构由向量场李括号定义，该运算满足双线性、反交换性及雅可比恒等式。典型李群包括各类矩阵群，重点关注半单连通群，如行列式为1的n阶实矩阵构成的特殊线性群SL(n,R)，其李代数为迹为零的矩阵构成的空间sl(n,R)。紧致群系列包括酉群SU(n)（李代数为反厄米特矩阵）与正交群SO(n)（李代数为反对称矩阵）。此外还有辛群Sp(n)及不定型群SU(p,q)、SO(p,q)，它们均定义为保持特定双线性型的算子群。这些结构在微分几何、理论物理及表示论等领域具有基础性应用。
title: Dirac Operators in Representation Theory
venue: Lecture notes series, Institute For Mathematical Sciences

summary_zh: 本文针对H.264/AVC视频编码中率失真优化全搜索模式选择计算复杂度高的问题，提出一种基于分层判决结构的快速帧间模式选择方法。该方法依据H.264/AVC帧间预测编码的结构特性，将宏块编码模式划分为四个层次，并利用运动估计预测原理中时间复杂度与空间复杂度的耦合关系，为各层次推导出自适应判决阈值。通过在各层次应用快速模式选择，可在保证率失真性能的前提下，及时终止冗余的全搜索率失真代价计算。实验结果表明，所提算法平均减少45.79%的编码时间，同时保持视觉质量和输出码率基本不变。与Zeng方法相比，本方法获得0.05dB的峰值信噪比增益；相较于Choi方法，节省约20%的计算时间，整体性能优于这两种典型的快速模式选择方法。该技术可应用于实时视频编码、移动多媒体通信等对计算资源敏感的场景。
title: 一种分层判决结构的H.264/AVC快速帧间模式选择方法

summary_zh: 我们通过数值计算研究了具有环路电流序的d_{x^2-y^2}波超导体在涡旋态下的比热量子振荡。该环路电流序导致费米口袋与节点型d_{x^2-y^2}波超导电性共存。在晶格紧束缚模型中，我们发现中等温度范围内，振荡行为近似遵循昂萨格关系，且有效电荷与元电荷相当，但准粒子能谱并不呈现朗道能级特征。为揭示振荡起源，我们在环路序存在下执行了Franz-Tesanovic变换，发现除标量势和贝里势外，规范不变超流速度的一个分量会作为矢量势分量与低能狄拉克粒子耦合。与该矢量势相关的磁场平均值为零，但在磁单胞内高度非均匀。我们还将结果与无环路序但引入类塞曼耦合的模型进行了比较，后者同样会在超导态中诱导出费米口袋。
title: Quantum oscillations of the specific heat in d-wave superconductors with loop current order

abstract: Neuromorphic hardware for artificial general vision intelligence holds the potential to match and surpass biological visual systems by processing complex visual dynamics with high adaptability and efficiency. However, current implementations rely on multiple complementary metal–oxide–semiconductor or neuromorphic elements, leading to significant area and power inefficiencies and system complexity. This is owing to a key challenge that no single electronic device, to our knowledge, has yet been demonstrated that can integrate retina-like and cortex-like spiking and graded neuronal dynamics operable across both optical and electrical domains. Here we report a single ultra-adaptive neuromorphic vision device (IxTyO1–x–y/CuOx/Pd) by ingeniously tailoring its electronic properties, enabling uniquely controlled interface and bulk dynamics by charged particles, including electrons, oxygen ions and vacancies. The device highly amalgamates broadband retinal spiking neuron and non-spiking graded neuron, and cortical synapse and neuron dynamics, with ultralow power consumption. Real-time optoelectronic dynamics is elucidated through in situ scanning transmission electron microscopy and validated by technology computer-aided design simulations. An artificial general vision intelligence system based on homogeneous ultra-adaptive neuromorphic vision device arrays is constructed, adaptively supporting both asynchronous event-driven and synchronous frame-driven paradigms for versatile cognitive imaging demands, with superior power efficiency of up to 67.89 trillion operations per second per watt and area efficiency of up to 3.96 mega operations per second per feature size (MOPS/F2). A single adaptive neuromorphic vision device is reported to emulate four high-order visual neuronal dynamics, enabling a highly efficient and compact artificial general vision intelligence system towards dynamic scenarios.
title: High-order dynamics in an ultra-adaptive neuromorphic vision device

summary_zh: 本研究通过构建拟南芥RNA降解与转录后基因沉默通路缺陷突变体，结合小RNA测序比较分析，揭示了编码转录本衍生siRNA选择性产生的多重调控机制。研究发现，多个RNA降解因子和转录后基因沉默组分共同抑制ct-siRNA的特异性生成。产生ct-siRNA的基因通常呈现表达量升高或不变的特征，且其序列组成中GC含量普遍较高。植物生长发育过程会干扰不同基因位点ct-siRNA的动态积累。特别值得注意的是，两个硝酸还原酶基因NIA1和NIA2能够产生大量22核苷酸长度的ct-siRNA，并在特定叶肉细胞亚型中高表达，该细胞亚型中DCL2相对于DCL4具有更高的表达水平，提示ct-siRNA的细胞特异性表达可能发挥重要调控功能。上述发现系统阐明了参与ct-siRNA选择性产生与调控的多维度因素和序列特征，深化了我们对植物基因沉默过程的认识。
title: Multiple factors and features dictate the selective production of ct-siRNA in Arabidopsis

abstract: Efficient hardware–cell communication is crucial in understanding cellular states and controlling cells, serving as a crucial pathway in advancing next-generation human–machine interfaces. Here, we propose an energy-efficient neural device based on natural cellulose, addressing limitations in conventional interface communication hardware, particularly concerning material biocompatibility and biological signal matching. The cellulose-based device effectively emulates the plasticity of biological synaptic connections and exhibits learning behavior under biograde voltage as low as 10 mV. Significantly, it demonstrates exceptional digital-to-analog conversion performance with a minimal power consumption of 0.1 nJ, facilitating efficient interface biological signal matching. Furthermore, a molecular-level model is introduced to elucidate the rotation of intramolecular polar bonds in cellulose induced by electrical stimulation. This rotation alters the material’s relative dielectric constant, unveiling the digital-to-analog conversion ability and neuro-like behavior. The biocompatible cellulose-based device efficiently emulates synapses with its low-power signal conversion, holding promise for effective biological signal matching in brain–machine interfaces.
title: Efficient Synaptic Emulation and Ultralow Power Digital-Analog Conversion in Cellulose-Based Neural Devices through Molecular Polarization

summary_zh: TCP5 转录因子通过时空特异性激活 KNAT3 和 SAW1 调控叶片锯齿形态建成。叶片边缘发育是叶形态发生的关键过程，CIN 类 TCP 转录因子在此过程中具有冗余功能，但单个 TCP 基因的具体作用机制尚不清楚。本研究发现，CIN-TCP 基因 TCP5 通过激活两个边缘发育核心调控因子——II 类 KNOX 因子 KNAT3 和 BEL 类 SAW1，抑制叶片锯齿的起始与生长。具体而言，TCP5 直接促进 KNAT3 的转录，并间接激活 SAW1 的表达。进一步研究表明，TCP5 对 KNAT3 和 SAW1 的调控呈现时空特异性，其作用模式与锯齿形成的进程高度吻合。该调控机制可能是决定叶片边缘形态建成模式并塑造叶片最终形态的关键环节，为深入理解植物叶形多样性的分子基础提供了新见解。
title: TCP5 controls leaf margin development by regulating KNOX and BEL-like transcription factors in Arabidopsis

abstract: Due to the demand for high energy efficiency in deep neural network (DNN) accelerators, computing-in-memory (CIM) is becoming increasingly popular in recent years. However, current CIM designs suffer from high latency and insufficient flexibility. To address the issues, this brief proposes a Booth-multiplication-based CIM macro (BCIM) with modified Booth encoding and partial product (PP) generation method specially designed for CIM architecture. In addition, a methodology is presented for designing precision-reconfigurable digital CIM macros. We also optimize the precision-reconfigurable shift adder in the macro based on the cutting down carry connection method. The design attains a performance of 2048 GOPS and a peak energy efficiency of 79.15 TOPS/W in the signed INT4 mode at a frequency of 500 MHz.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于布斯乘法的存内计算宏单元（BCIM），针对现有存内计算设计延迟高、灵活性不足的问题，引入专为存内计算架构优化的改进布斯编码与部分积生成方法。同时，提出一种精度可重构数字存内计算宏的设计方法，并基于进位截断连接方式对宏内精度可重构移位加法器进行优化。该设计在 500 MHz 频率下，有符号 INT4 模式下实现 2048 GOPS 算力，峰值能效达 79.15 TOPS/W，适用于高能效深度神经网络加速场景。
title: An Efficient and Precision-Reconfigurable Digital CIM Macro for DNN Accelerators.
venue: IEEE Trans. Very Large Scale Integr. Syst.

summary_zh: 本研究系统评估了五种基于深度学习的蛋白质结构预测方法在纳米抗体三维结构建模中的表现。纳米抗体作为重链抗体的重组可变域，凭借其分子量小、溶解度高、稳定性强、血液清除快及组织穿透力深等独特优势，已成为疾病诊断与治疗的重要工具。我们从蛋白质数据库（PDB）中选取了60个具有实验三维结构的纳米抗体样本，仅以二维氨基酸序列为输入，分别采用AlphaFold2、RoseTTAFold、DeepAb、NanoNet和tFold五种算法进行结构预测，并将预测结果与实验结构逐一对比分析。结果表明，这些深度学习方法在纳米抗体结构预测中展现出不同程度的准确性，其中部分算法能够高度还原实验构象，为抗体工程和药物设计领域提供了可靠的计算辅助手段。本研究为纳米抗体结构预测方法的选择和应用提供了参考依据，有助于推动基于计算模拟的抗体研发进程。
title: A benchmark study of protein folding algorithms on nanobodies

abstract: Multimodal learning is an increasingly important research topic. Exploiting conditional dependency across multiple modalities has been shown useful for estimating of the multimodal joint distribution, especially when the number of training samples is insufficient. However, it is difficult to theoretically characterize such conditional dependency structure. To address this issue, we establish a mathematical framework and formulate the estimation problem based on the minimax principle. Then, we propose an estimator which is close to the analytical solution of the problem under a mild assumption on the sample size. Moreover, the proposed estimator is a linear combination of the learning results from the true dependency structure and the conditional one. The combining coefficient is related to three aspects: the number of training samples, the fitness of the conditional dependency structure, and the cardinality of each modality. Finally, numerical simulations are provided to verify our theoretical results that the proposed estimator is close to the optimal solution of the formulated problem.
title: A Mathematical Framework to Characterize the Dependency Structures in Multimodal Learning With Minimax Principle
venue: 2022 IEEE International Symposium on Information Theory (ISIT)

abstract: The core entropy of polynomials, recently introduced by W. Thurston, is a dynamical invariant extending topological entropy for real maps to complex polynomials, whence providing a new tool to study the parameter space of polynomials. The base is a combinatorial algorithm allowing for the computation of the core entropy given by Thurston but without supplying a proof. In this paper, we will describe his algorithm and prove its validity.
summary_zh: W. Thurston 新近提出的多项式核心熵是一种动力学不变量，它将实映射的拓扑熵推广至复多项式，为研究多项式参数空间提供了新工具。其基础是一个用于计算核心熵的组合算法，该算法由 Thurston 给出但未附证明。本文详细描述了该算法并证明了其有效性。
title: On Thurston’s core entropy algorithm
venue: Transactions of the American Mathematical Society

summary_zh: 本研究旨在探讨一岁以下高风险婴儿的神经发育状况，并分析神经发育异常的发病率及其影响因素，为该群体的发育监测与管理提供科学依据。研究通过对2016年间上海市三区妇幼保健院收治的484例高风险婴儿进行随访，利用盖塞尔发育量表分别在入组时（0-2个月）及9个月大时对其神经发育水平进行评估，并运用单变量及多变量分析探讨影响因素。结果显示，在入组阶段，足月高风险婴儿在运动、认知、语言及社交维度的发育商（DQ）评分均显著高于早产高风险婴儿，且各维度的发育异常发生率也较低。然而，至9个月大时，足月与早产高风险婴儿在上述四个维度的DQ评分及发育异常发生率上均无显著差异，发育异常的总发生率维持在10%左右。研究结论指出，一岁以下高风险婴儿的神经发育异常发生率较高，其中早产及父母不良习惯是影响神经发育的关键因素。因此，加强对高风险婴儿的持续监测并实施早期干预，对于改善其神经发育预后具有重要意义。
title: Influencing factors of the neurodevelopment of high‐risk infants

abstract: Brønsted bases have recently been reported to catalyze the glucose isomerization to fructose. This contribution describes the rational bottom-up approach to the design and synthesis of heterogeneous systems based on a C60 platform surface engineered with catalytically active amino functionalities tethered to carbon nanomaterials within variable (polar/apolar) chemical microenvironments. We demonstrate how carbocatalysts performance for the glucose-to-fructose isomerization may improve depending on amines’ neighboring functional groups and their chemical interplay at the C-nanocarrier surface.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于自下而上设计理念的异质催化体系构建方法，旨在通过工程化手段优化葡萄糖向果糖的异构化催化性能。研究人员以C60为核心平台，通过在碳纳米材料表面修饰具有催化活性的氨基官能团，构建了具有不同极性或非极性化学微环境的碳基催化剂。研究重点探讨了氨基邻近官能团及其在碳载体表面的化学相互作用对催化效率的影响。实验结果表明，通过精确调控碳纳米材料表面的化学微环境，可以显著提升布朗斯特碱催化剂在葡萄糖异构化反应中的表现，为设计高效、可控的碳基多功能催化体系提供了理论依据与实践指导。
title: Nitrogen-Decorated Carbon Networks for the Metal-Free Catalytic Isomerization of Glucose to Fructose

abstract: Abstract High-entropy alloys (HEAs), i.e., single-phase, (nearly) equiatomic multicomponent, metallic materials, are associated with novel mechanical properties, such as high strength, fracture resistance etc. In this paper, a stochastic Peierls-Nabarro (PN) model is proposed to understand how random site occupancy affects intrinsic strength. The stochastic PN model accounts for the randomness in the composition, characterized by both the standard deviation of the perturbation in the interplanar potential and the correlation length within the spatial compositional distribution. The model presented includes the effects of non-uniform compositional distribution both in the direction of dislocation glide and along a dislocation line to predict overall dislocation glide resistance. The model predicts the intrinsic strength of HEAs as a function of the standard deviation and the correlation length of the randomness. We find that, in most of the parameter space, the compositional randomness in an HEA gives rise to an intrinsic strength that far exceeds that of any of the pure metals from which the HEA is composed. This approach provides a fundamental explanation to the origin of the high strength of HEAs.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种随机派尔斯-纳巴罗模型，用于揭示高熵合金中原子随机占位对其本征强度的影响机制。该模型通过引入层间势扰动的标准差和空间成分分布的相关长度两个关键参数，定量刻画了合金成分的随机性特征。模型同时考虑了沿位错滑移方向和位错线方向的非均匀成分分布效应，从而能够预测位错滑移的整体阻力。研究结果表明，高熵合金的本征强度可表示为成分随机性标准差与相关长度的函数。在大部分参数空间内，高熵合金的成分随机性赋予其远超任一纯组元金属的本征强度。该工作从位错运动阻力的角度，为高熵合金高强度特性的起源提供了基础性理论解释。
title: The effect of randomness on the strength of high-entropy alloys

summary_zh: 本文提出 SvTPM，一种基于英特尔 SGX 的虚拟可信平台模块，旨在为云计算环境中的虚拟机提供全生命周期保护，且不依赖物理 TPM。当前主流 vTPM 方案在运行时缺乏强隔离，且绑定物理 TPM 时性能低下。SvTPM 利用 SGX 飞地实现强隔离，确保恶意租户甚至云管理员均无法访问 vTPM 的私钥及其他敏感数据。我们构建了 SvTPM 原型，识别并解决了利用 SGX 保护 vTPM 面临的若干关键安全挑战，包括 NVRAM 回滚攻击、NVRAM 绑定攻击和 vTPM 回滚攻击，同时给出了 vTPM 与 SGX 平台之间信任关系的建立方法。性能评估表明，SvTPM 的 NVRAM 启动速度比基于硬件 TPM 的 vTPM 快约 1700 倍；在 TPM 标准命令测试中，SvTPM 在提供强隔离保护的同时，性能开销可忽略不计。据我们所知，SvTPM 是首个实际解决利用 SGX 保护 vTPM 关键安全难题的工作，适用于商业云平台中虚拟化可信计算场景。
title: SvTPM: SGX-Based Virtual Trusted Platform Modules for Cloud Computing

summary_zh: 针对视觉语言模型在测试时适应新领域所面临的挑战，本文提出一种名为COSMIC的鲁棒测试时适应框架。现有基于缓存的方法存在两个主要问题：一是缓存了不可靠的特征-标签对，二是在查询时无差别地使用单类信息，这严重影响了适应精度。COSMIC通过多粒度、跨模态的语义缓存和图基查询机制来增强适应性，其核心包含两项创新：双语义图与团引导超类。双语义图通过融合文本特征、粗粒度的CLIP特征以及细粒度的DINOv2特征，构建互补的语义空间，以捕获丰富的语义关系。在此基础上，团引导超类组件利用结构化的类别关系，通过关联类别的选择来提升预测的鲁棒性。在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，COSMIC取得了优越的性能，相较于现有最优方法，在使用CLIP RN-50模型时，在分布外任务上实现了15.81%的显著提升，在跨域生成任务上提升了5.33%。该框架有效解决了测试时适应中的缓存不可靠与查询信息单一问题，可广泛应用于视觉语言模型的领域泛化与适应场景。
title: COSMIC: Clique-Oriented Semantic Multi-space Integration for Robust CLIP Test-Time Adaptation
venue: 2025 IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)

abstract: Resonant controllers (RSCs) are widely adopted for controlling power converters, since they can track ac signals of both positive and negative sequences without steady-state error. However, the performance of RSCs has not been fully exploited due to the improper phase compensation angle and insufficient controller gain. In this paper, a novel controller parameters' design method, which is based on the system error transfer function, is proposed to further explore the potential high performance of RSCs. Comparing with the conventional methods, more appropriate phase compensation angles can be obtained, which means that the stable region of the controller gain is extended. Since the proposed RSCs' design method is able to maximize the controller gain, the controller sensitivity to system frequency variations can be decreased and the system response speed can be improved. The RSCs' tuning procedure is given in detail, and comparative experiments between the proposed method and the conventional method are performed to validate the superiority of the proposed method.
summary_zh: 谐振控制器因能无静差跟踪正负序交流信号，在电力变流器控制中应用广泛，但其性能受限于相位补偿角选取不当和控制器增益不足。本文提出一种基于系统误差传递函数的控制器参数设计方法，以充分挖掘谐振控制器的高性能潜力。与传统方法相比，该方法可获得更合适的相位补偿角，从而扩展控制器增益的稳定域。由于所提设计方法能够最大化控制器增益，系统对频率变化的灵敏度得以降低，响应速度也得到提升。文中详细给出了谐振控制器的参数整定流程，并通过与传统方法的对比实验验证了所提方法的优越性。
title: A New Tuning Method of Multiresonant Current Controllers for Grid-Connected Voltage Source Converters
venue: IEEE Journal of Emerging and Selected Topics in Power Electronics

summary_zh: 本研究合成了一种无镉掺杂半导体纳米晶——铜掺杂硫化锌铟/硫化锌核壳纳米晶，并系统探究其光物理特性。该材料在近红外一区发射峰位于730纳米，发光寿命长达1.38微秒。飞秒瞬态吸收光谱揭示，铜离子与基质之间存在强烈的激子耦合效应，能量转移时间约为100皮秒。更为关键的是，该纳米晶在近红外一区和三区均展现出高效的体积归一化多光子吸收性能：在800至900纳米波段，双光子吸收截面最大值达每立方纳米6.9 GM；在1600至1990纳米波段，三光子吸收截面最大值达每立方纳米1.1×10⁻⁸⁰ cm⁶ s² photon⁻²。这些优异特性表明，此类环境友好的掺杂纳米晶在深层组织生物成像领域具有广阔的应用前景。
title: Efficient multiphoton absorption of near-infrared emitting Cu-doped ZnInS/ZnS nanocrystals
venue: Journal of Physics D: Applied Physics

abstract: Bending sensors are critical to the advancement of wearable electronics and can be applied in the dynamic monitoring of flexible object morphology. However, current bending sensors are constrained by sensing range and precision, especially in full-range detection. The maximum sensing range of existing flexible bending sensors is 0-240°. This study introduces a bianisotropic responsive structure into the design of an all-textile bending sensor, thereby realizing 0-360° full-range omnidirectional bending sensing. First, the project elucidated the sensing mechanism of the piezoresistive bianisotropic structured bending sensor and identified critical factors through a numerical simulation method. Then, the bianisotropic structured bending sensors were produced through the stitch method and analyzed on their electromechanical performance. Further, the recognition model for both bending angle and direction parameters was developed via numerical calculation, achieving a high accuracy with an error rate of 2.82%. Last, according to the ergonomics of body joints, the sensors were customized and validated in body joint monitoring scenarios. This work significantly enhances the performance of flexible bending sensors in sensing range, accuracy, and comfort for the wearer. The versatility of this bending sensor positions it as a promising candidate to supplant traditional heavy equipment or rigid devices, particularly in wearable joint motion monitoring and soft robotics.
title: Omnidirectional Bending Sensor with Bi-anisotropic Structure for Wearable Electronics, ACS Sensors

abstract: We report on the optical saturable absorption of few-layer black phosphorus nanoflakes and demonstrate its application for the generation of vector solitons in an erbium-doped fiber laser. By incorporating the black phosphorus nanoflakes-based saturable absorber (SA) into an all-fiber erbium-doped fiber laser cavity, we are able to obtain passive mode-locking operation with soliton pulses down to ~670 fs. The properties and dynamics of the as-generated vector solitons are experimentally investigated. Our results show that BP nanoflakes could be developed as an effective SA for ultrashort pulse fiber lasers, particularly for the generation of vector soliton pulses in fiber lasers.
summary_zh: 本文报道了少层黑磷纳米片的光学可饱和吸收特性，并将其应用于掺铒光纤激光器中产生矢量孤子。通过将基于黑磷纳米片的可饱和吸收体集成到全光纤掺铒激光谐振腔中，实现了被动锁模运转，获得了脉宽约670飞秒的孤子脉冲。实验进一步研究了所产生的矢量孤子的特性与动力学行为。结果表明，黑磷纳米片可作为一种有效的可饱和吸收材料用于超短脉冲光纤激光器，尤其在光纤激光器中产生矢量孤子脉冲方面具有应用潜力。
title: Vector soliton fiber laser passively mode locked by few layer black phosphorus-based optical saturable absorber

summary_zh: 针对虚拟电厂与电动汽车充电站分属不同运营主体、缺乏协同机制的问题，本文提出一种多主体虚拟电厂-充电站系统合作运行框架。该框架构建了日前报价与实时平衡模型，以最大化系统整体收益为目标，并设计了电动汽车用户激励方案，通过获取电池使用权来提升系统运行的灵活性。为协调各主体间的利益冲突，引入τ值成本分配方法进行收益划分；同时，为降低τ值计算复杂度，提出最大权利成本估计方法。算例验证表明，所提方法可使虚拟电厂利润提升4.6%，充电站利润提升20.7%，电动汽车用户充电费用降低16.3%，且τ值估计精度达到99.2%。该框架为多主体参与的虚拟电厂与充电设施协同运营提供了有效解决方案。
title: A Mutually Beneficial Operation Framework for Virtual Power Plants and Electric Vehicle Charging Stations

summary_zh: 研究发现，老年血液中的非蛋白质成分（ONP）能够诱导年轻小鼠出现骨骼衰老现象。通过深入机制研究，研究人员确定甲基丙 malonic acid（MMA）是驱动这一过程的关键因子，其能够独立模拟ONP诱导的骨骼衰老表型。光亲和标记实验证实，Kindlin-2是MMA在细胞内的直接受体。具体而言，MMA通过结合Kindlin-2 UBL结构域中的正电荷基序，促进Kindlin-2发生泛素化降解，进而加速骨骼衰老进程。此外，研究发现临床已批准使用的内源性MMA清除剂——辅酶A（CoA），能够有效逆转由MMA或ONP引起的骨骼衰老。在老年小鼠及雌激素缺乏的小鼠模型中，CoA治疗均表现出保护骨骼并防止骨量流失的显著效果。本研究阐明了MMA作为核心衰老因子及其通过Kindlin-2受体发挥作用的分子机制，为骨质疏松症等年龄相关性疾病提供了潜在的治疗策略。
title: Kindlin-2 functional restoration through methylmalonic acid clearance by Coenzyme A counteracts osteoporosis

summary_zh: 金属卤化物钙钛矿作为前景广阔的光伏材料，凭借其溶液可加工性、低成本、高且平衡的载流子迁移率、高光学增益以及可调带隙等独特性质，在相干光源领域展现出巨大潜力。随着材料合成与纳米加工技术的快速发展，钙钛矿激光器已在多种组分、形貌、维度、尺寸、激发方式和腔体构型中得以实现，呈现出各异的发射特性。本文系统评述了钙钛矿激光器模式调控的最新进展，涵盖发射波长、模式数量、方向、偏振以及轨道角动量等关键参数的控制。文中提出并探讨了评估各类调控策略有效性的准则，最后分析了钙钛矿激光器模式控制面临的挑战与发展趋势。
title: Emission Control in Metal Halide Perovskite Lasers

summary_zh: 本研究利用冷冻电镜技术解析了人源Scap与Insig-2蛋白复合物在25-羟基胆固醇（25HC）存在下的三维结构，跨膜区平均分辨率达到3.7埃。结构分析揭示了Scap的固醇感知结构域及Insig-2全部六次跨膜螺旋的精细构象。25HC分子被包夹于膜腔内侧小叶中，具体结合位点位于Scap的S4至S6片段与Insig-2的第三、四跨膜螺旋之间。研究发现，Scap蛋白S4螺旋中段的解旋构象变化是25HC结合及Insig蛋白招募的关键分子基础。该工作阐明了固醇调控元件结合蛋白（SREBP）通路中固醇感应与信号开关的核心机制，为理解细胞内固醇稳态调控及相关代谢疾病的药物开发提供了重要结构依据。
title: A structure of human Scap bound to Insig-2 suggests how their interaction is regulated by sterols

summary_zh: 植物蒸腾占陆地总蒸散发的比例（T/ET）是衡量植被在地表-大气相互作用中角色的关键指标，但其全球尺度的量值仍存在很大不确定性。本研究采用涌现约束方法，将第六次耦合模式比较计划的地球系统模式模拟结果与33个野外T/ET实测数据相结合，重新估算了全球T/ET值。观测约束显著提升了原有模式估算值（0.41±0.11），并大幅缩小了模式间差异，最终得到新的全球T/ET估计值为0.62±0.06。在所有地球系统模式中，叶面积指数被识别为T/ET空间变异的主要驱动因子，但仅修正其偏差反而会导致比原始模式输出更严重的T/ET低估。研究表明，模式对T/ET的低估实际源于对冠层光能利用、截留损失和根系吸水过程的不准确描述。为降低全球水文循环模拟的不确定性，应优先改进这些过程的参数化方案。
title: Partitioning global land evapotranspiration using CMIP5 models constrained by observations

summary_zh: 近期研究表明，神经组合优化在路径规划等问题上优于传统算法，但在处理装箱问题等涉及相互制约动作空间的复杂任务时效率较低。针对这一挑战，本文提出了一种循环条件查询学习（RCQL）方法，用于解决二维和三维装箱问题。该方法首先利用循环编码器进行状态嵌入，随后采用基于前序动作条件查询的注意力机制。这种条件查询机制填补了学习步骤间的信息鸿沟，从而将问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程。得益于循环结构的特性，单个RCQL模型即可处理不同规模的装箱问题。实验结果表明，RCQL能够为离线和在线条带装箱问题学习到强大的启发式策略，在空间利用率方面优于多种基准方法。与现有最先进方法相比，RCQL在离线二维40箱案例和三维案例中的平均箱体间隙率分别降低了1.83%和7.84%。同时，在处理包含1000个物品的条带装箱问题时，其空间利用率也比现有最优方法高出5.64%。
title: One model packs thousands of items with Recurrent Conditional Query Learning

abstract: Abstract Concentrating fluid-based spectral-splitting hybrid PV-thermal (SSPVT) collectors are capable of high electrical and thermal efficiencies, as well as high-temperature thermal outputs. However, the optimal optical filter and the maximum potential of such collectors remain unclear. In this study, we develop a comprehensive two-dimensional model of a fluid-based SSPVT collector. The temperature distributions reveal that these designs are effective in thermally decoupling the PV module from the high-temperature filter flow-channel, improving the electrical performance of the module. For a Si solar cell-based SSPVT collector with optical filter #Si400-1100, the filter channel is able to produce high-temperature thermal energy (400 °C) with an efficiency of 19.5%, low-temperature thermal energy (70 °C) with an efficiency of 49.5%, and electricity with an efficiency 17.5%. Of note is that the relative fraction of high-temperature thermal energy, low-temperature thermal energy and electricity generated by such a SSPVT collector can be adjusted by shifting the upper- and lower-bound cut-off wavelengths of the optical filter, which are found to strongly affect the spectral and energy distributions through the collector. The optimal upper-bound cut-off always equals the bandgap wavelength of the solar cell material (e.g., 1100 nm for Si, and 850 nm for CdTe), while the optimal lower-bound cut-off follows more complex selection criteria. The SSPVT collector with the optimal filter has a significantly higher total effective efficiency than an equivalent conventional solar-thermal collector when the relative value of the high-temperature heat to that of electricity is lower than 0.5. Detailed guidance for selecting optimal filters and their role in controlling SSPVT collector performance under different conditions is provided.
title: On the performance of concentrating fluid-based spectral-splitting hybrid PV-thermal (PV-T) solar collectors

summary_zh: 本文研究凸区域上具有非等温漫反射边界条件的玻尔兹曼方程。针对非稳态与稳态两类问题，我们构造了属于索伯列夫空间 W^{1,p}_x 的解，其中可积性指标 p 严格小于 3。进一步，我们证明了当时间趋于无穷时，非稳态解会在同一索伯列夫空间中按指数速率收敛到稳态解。该工作为有界区域内非等温气体动力学的适定性提供了高正则性理论结果。
title: Gradient Decay in the Boltzmann Theory of Non-isothermal Boundary
venue: Archive for Rational Mechanics and Analysis

summary_zh: 本研究聚焦台湾海峡北部平潭岛近海每年4至6月频发的红色夜光藻赤潮，旨在揭示其形成的水动力机制，为赤潮预测预警提供依据。基于2022年4至6月的高分辨率海岸模型，系统分析了平潭岛周边海域的水动力环境。模拟结果表明，赤潮暴发期间，海水呈现弱环流和强层化的特征。通过在海湾内释放中性浮力被动示踪粒子进行滞留时间数值实验，发现赤潮期间水体滞留时间显著延长，海湾内冲刷能力明显减弱，这为红色夜光藻的增殖与聚集提供了稳定的水环境。进一步分析表明，该海域盛行的东北风减弱及风向转变是导致平潭岛周边流场减弱的关键因素，从而营造了有利于赤潮形成的动力条件。本研究为平潭岛近海红色夜光藻赤潮的形成机制提供了新认识，也为该区域赤潮预测模型的构建奠定了重要基础。
title: Physical drivers of Noctiluca scintillans (Dinophyceae) blooms outbreak in the northern Taiwan Strait: A numerical study

abstract: Wireless powered communication networking (WPCN) is a new networking paradigm where the battery of wireless communication devices can be remotely replenished by means of microwave wireless power transfer (WPT) technology. WPCN eliminates the need for frequent manual battery replacement/recharging, and thus significantly improves the performance over conventional battery-powered communication networks in many aspects, such as higher throughput, longer device lifetime, and lower network operating cost. However, the design and future application of WPCN is essentially challenged by the low WPT efficiency over long distance, and the complex nature of joint wireless information and power transfer within the same network. In this article, we provide an overview of the key networking structures and performance enhancing techniques to build an efficient WPCN. In addition, we point out new and challenging future research directions for WPCN.
summary_zh: 无线供能通信网络是一种新兴的网络范式，其核心在于利用微波无线能量传输技术，实现对无线通信设备电池的远程补充。该技术免除了频繁手动更换或充电电池的需求，从而在吞吐量、设备寿命和网络运营成本等多个维度显著提升了传统电池供电通信网络的性能。然而，WPCN的设计与未来应用面临两大根本性挑战：一是远距离无线能量传输效率低下，二是同一网络内无线信息与能量联合传输的复杂性。本文概述了构建高效WPCN的关键网络架构与性能增强技术，并指出了具有挑战性的未来研究方向。
title: Wireless powered communication networks: an overview

abstract: The evolution of network structure and the spreading of epidemic are common coexistent dynamical processes. In most cases, network structure is treated either static or time-varying, supposing the whole network is observed in a same time window. In this paper, we consider the epidemic spreading on a network consisting of both static and time-varying structures. At meanwhile, the time-varying part and the epidemic spreading are supposed to be of the same time scale. We introduce a static and activity driven coupling (SADC) network model to characterize the coupling between static (strong) structure and dynamic (weak) structure. Epidemic thresholds of SIS and SIR model are studied on SADC both analytically and numerically with various coupling strategies, where the strong structure is of homogeneous or heterogeneous degree distribution. Theoretical thresholds obtained from SADC model can both recover and generalize the classical results in static and time-varying networks. It is demonstrated that weak structures can make the epidemics break out much more easily in homogeneous coupling but harder in heterogeneous coupling when keeping same average degree in SADC networks. Furthermore, we show there exists a threshold ratio of the weak structure to have substantive effects on the breakout of the epidemics. This promotes our understanding of why epidemics can still break out in some social networks even we restrict the flow of the population.
title: Contagion processes on the static and activity-driven coupling networks

abstract: In this paper, we devise three day-to-day (DTD) road pricing schemes from their static counterparts to achieve several traffic management objectives such as regulating the traffic dynamics to the desired equilibrium, traffic restraint control, and balancing the fairness and efficiency of traffic networks, respectively. Qualitative analyses involved in the stability and convergence analysis as well as the DTD evolution of network performance admit challenges ranging from partial state stability, multiple equilibria, non-measurable system states to complex nonlinear network performance functionals. To handle these hurdles, we establish a unified stability analysis framework for qualitative analysis and control synthesis of continuous-time DTD traffic dynamics via the notion of output stability. Under this framework, by devising a proper measurable output function for the DTD dynamics in question, we can perform the relevant qualitative analyses for several continuous-time DTD traffic dynamics under different traffic control measures. For example, we investigate the DTD evolution of network performance indexes such as unfairness and inefficiency (e.g., price of anarchy (PoA)) to show how the proposed flow-dependent link toll scheme can balance the fairness and efficiency of traffic systems. We demonstrate that the proposed output stability framework can offer much more flexibility to perform qualitative analysis for these complex processes by devising suitable output functions. Finally, we show the merits of the road pricing schemes in conjunction with the output stability via numerical simulations.
title: Day-to-Day Road Pricing and Network Performance Analysis via Output Stability
venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems

abstract: A highly enantioselective Rh-catalyzed arylation of benzoxazinones and quinoxalinones with arylboroxines was realized for the first time by employing a simple sulfur-olefin as the ligand.
summary_zh: 本文报道了一种新型的对映选择性合成方法，首次实现了利用简单的硫-烯烃配体催化铑金属，对苯并氧嗪酮和喹喔啉酮进行芳基硼氧烷的芳基化反应。该研究通过引入特定的硫-烯烃配体，显著提升了催化反应的对映选择性，为构建具有手性中心的复杂杂环化合物提供了高效的合成策略。该方法不仅展示了配体设计的创新性，也为手性药物中间体及功能材料的精准合成开辟了新的途径，在不对称催化领域具有重要的学术价值和应用前景。
title: Rhodium-catalyzed asymmetric arylation of N- and O-containing cyclic aldimines: facile and efficient access to highly optically active 3,4-dihydrobenzo[1,4]oxazin-2-ones and dihydroquinoxalinones

summary_zh: 本研究旨在探究先天性心脏病（CHD）发病机制中表观遗传调控的关键作用，特别是通过分析出生后阶段的DNA甲基化模式来揭示疾病的表观遗传记忆及其对血流动力学改变的适应性。研究人员首次对法洛四联症（TOF）和室间隔缺损患者的心肌活检样本进行了全基因组DNA甲基化分析。结果显示，患者与对照组之间存在显著的差异甲基化区域，这些区域在启动子、外显子及心脏增强子等基因组特征中高度富集。在TOF患者中，DNA甲基化水平与全基因组基因表达数据呈现显著的相关性，即启动子高甲基化通常对应基因表达下调。研究进一步鉴定出SCO2基因启动子区域存在一个新型的发育相关高甲基化CpG岛，并通过功能实验证实了其生物学影响。此外，研究还发现甲基化改变与肌节基因的新型差异剪接事件以及转录因子结合位点密切相关。最后，通过构建分子网络，研究证实了TOF中差异甲基化与差异表达基因与已知CHD突变基因之间存在相互作用。综上所述，本研究提出了两种导致先天性心脏病表型表达的新机制：启动子CpG岛的异常甲基化以及导致差异剪接的甲基化改变。
title: Comparative DNA methylation and gene expression analysis identifies novel genes for structural congenital heart diseases

summary_zh: 立体匹配是计算机视觉领域的核心课题，但其高复杂度和巨大的计算量限制了实时应用。本文提出了一种像素级流水线协处理器，实现了可配置的双目立体校正、区域优化半全局匹配（SGM）、左右一致性检查（LRC）以及视差精细化处理。该架构通过预标定系数计算调整范围，显著降低了存储大量行图像所需的缓存空间；采用基于牛顿迭代法的近似除法器，在保证低延迟的同时实现了精度达$10^{-7}$的高精度校正；针对SGM算法中计算量最大的代价聚合环节，设计了四层并行的两阶段流水线以突破计算瓶颈；此外，利用伪双端口SRAM和堆栈机制，以较低的资源消耗解决了空洞填充中的逆像素流问题。实验结果表明，该架构在Intel Stratix-IV FPGA上实现，在113.13 MHz的最大工作频率下，能够处理分辨率为$1024\times768$的图像，帧率达到144 fps，展现了卓越的实时处理性能。
title: Configurable Image Rectification and Disparity Refinement for Stereo Vision
venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits & Systems II Express Briefs

abstract: Schelling games use a game-theoretic approach to study the phenomenon of residential segregation. We consider four global measures of diversity, and prove asymptotically tight or almost tight bounds on the price of anarchy with respect to these measures on both general graphs and common specific graphs. In addition we did simulations of our swap games.
summary_zh: 本文从博弈论视角研究居住隔离现象，针对Schelling博弈模型，系统分析了四种全局多样性度量指标下的无政府代价。在一般图及若干常见特定图结构上，我们证明了这些度量指标的无政府代价具有渐近紧确或几乎紧确的上下界。此外，通过交换博弈的数值模拟实验，进一步验证了理论分析结果的有效性。该研究为理解城市居住隔离的形成机制与优化多样性分布提供了理论依据。
title: Diversity-seeking Swap Games in Networks
venue: International Joint Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems

summary_zh: 本文报道了一种基于碲基二维范德华异质结构的电子/光电存储器件，该器件由铁电CuInP₂S₆与碲沟道构成，兼具电压脉冲诱导的长时程增强/抑制和1550 nm短波红外激光脉冲触发的短时程增强特性。利用这一丰富的动力学行为，研究构建了全忆阻型传感器内储备池计算系统，能够在光纤通信波段同步感知、解码和学习传输信息。该器件首次在短波红外区域实现了电脉冲与光脉冲分别调控的长时与短时存储行为，不仅拓展了二维材料家族在电子与光电子领域的应用光谱，也为未来边缘端智能信号处理系统的发展开辟了新路径。
title: Electronic/Optoelectronic Memory Device Enabled by Tellurium‐based 2D van der Waals Heterostructure for in‐Sensor Reservoir Computing at the Optical Communication Band

summary_zh: 针对物联网设备因数据稀缺导致传统入侵检测方法难以适用的问题，本文提出一种基于无监督异构域自适应的开放集蒲公英网络模型。该模型将知识丰富的源网络入侵域中的入侵知识迁移至数据稀缺的目标物联网入侵域，以提升检测精度，同时在开放集设定下可识别源域中未出现的新型目标域入侵。模型首先将源域构建为蒲公英状特征空间，使各类入侵类别内部紧凑、类别之间相互分离，兼顾类内紧凑性与类间可分性。基于蒲公英的目标隶属机制进一步构建目标域蒲公英结构，蒲公英角度分离机制增强类间可分性，蒲公英嵌入对齐机制实现两个域特征空间的精细对齐。为提升类内紧凑性，引入判别采样蒲公英机制。借助由已知和生成的未知入侵知识训练的入侵分类器，语义蒲公英校正机制聚焦易混淆类别，进一步引导类间分离。上述机制协同构成开放集蒲公英网络模型，有效实现入侵知识迁移以辅助物联网入侵检测。在多个入侵数据集上的综合实验验证了该模型的有效性，其性能较三种当前最优基线方法平均提升16.9%，同时验证了各组成模块的贡献以及模型的稳定性与高效性。
title: Open Set Dandelion Network for IoT Intrusion Detection

abstract: Understanding and diagnosing query optimizers is crucial to guarantee the correctness and efficiency of query processing in database systems. However, achieving this is non-trivial as there are three technical challenges: (i) hundreds and thousands of query plans are generated for each query during the query optimization procedure; (ii) the transformation logic among query plans is not easy to investigate even for expert database system developers; and (iii) navigating users to the root causes of the bugs/errors is inherently hard as the changes of the operators among query plans are missing in the query processing log. In this work, we propose QOVIS to overcome these challenges, which identifies the query optimization bugs/issues and investigates their root causes via a visualization-assisted approach. Specifically, QOVIS consists of data preprocessing layer, transformation logic computation layer, and visual analysis layer. We conduct extensive experimental studies (e.g., user study, case study, and performance study) to evaluate the efficiency and effectiveness of QOVIS. In particular, our user study (on 24 database developers and researchers) confirms that QOVIS significantly reduces the time required to investigate the bugs/errors in the query optimizer. Moreover, the generality of QOVIS is verified by utilizing it to understand and diagnose the real-world reported bugs/errors in different query optimizers of three widely-used systems: Apache Spark, Apache Hive, and DuckDB.
title: QOVIS: Understanding and Diagnosing Query Optimizer via a Visualization-Assisted Approach

abstract: This paper presents, for the first time, the nonlinear distortion characteristics of a Doherty Power Amplifier (DPA) with equal-cell and efficiency range of > 6dB. Theoretical study reveals that, even with ideal transistor, the Doherty circuit exhibits built-in AM/AM and AM/PM nonlinearities due to the presence of complex load modulation. For experimental verification, a 42 dBm, 2 GHz DPA with OBO of 9.5 dB was designed and fabricated using GaN HEMT devices. Under Continuous Wave (CW) excitation, measurement results show Doherty behavior with back-off efficiency (9.5 dB) of 56%, saturation efficiency of 70% and gain compression of 3 dB.
summary_zh: 本文首次揭示了等单元结构且效率范围超过6 dB的Doherty功率放大器（DPA）的非线性失真特性。理论研究表明，即使采用理想晶体管，由于存在复杂的负载调制效应，Doherty电路本身也会产生固有的AM/AM和AM/PM非线性失真。为进行实验验证，采用氮化镓高电子迁移率晶体管（GaN HEMT）器件，设计并制备了一款工作频率为2 GHz、饱和输出功率为42 dBm、输出功率回退（OBO）为9.5 dB的DPA。在连续波激励下，测试结果显示该放大器呈现典型的Doherty特性：9.5 dB回退点效率为56%，饱和效率达到70%，增益压缩为3 dB。该研究为理解Doherty功率放大器在无线通信发射机中的非线性行为及其线性化技术提供了重要理论依据。
title: Built-in AM/AM and AM/PM distortion study of generalized symmetrical Doherty amplifier

summary_zh: 云计算中，静态资源配置常导致租户为规避资源不足而过度分配，造成效率低下与成本上升，同时服务商也面临高分配量下的低利用率问题。为提升效率，服务商普遍采用超卖环境让多负载共享主机，但这会引发干扰并可能导致服务质量违约。本文提出一种实时动态控制框架，通过自适应地将工作负载绑定到CPU组来缓解干扰。该方法基于深度强化学习，采用近端策略优化算法，智能体根据实时反馈持续调整CPU绑定策略，以维持服务水平协议合规。实验在整体性能优先和优先级性能优先两种优化目标下进行，结果表明，与静态绑定相比，所提方法将整体服务质量提升约25%。在启用优先级机制时，高优先级负载性能显著提升，而低优先级负载仍保持在服务水平协议范围内。这些结果证明，基于深度强化学习的CPU绑定策略能有效管理超卖云环境中的资源争用，在提高利用率的同时保障租户服务水平协议。
title: QoS-Aware Deep Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic CPU Pinning of Co-Located Cloud Workloads

summary_zh: 细胞凋亡作为维持机体内部环境稳定的程序性细胞死亡形式，其异常会导致多种疾病，因此开发有效的凋亡传感技术对于疾病机制研究及药物开发具有重要意义。鉴于Caspase-3是凋亡过程中的关键酶，其活性水平可作为凋亡的重要指标，本文开发了一种基于mNeonGreen2的遗传编码型“开启式”分子生物传感器。该传感器利用高亮度单体绿色荧光蛋白mNeonGreen2，通过在其中插入Caspase-3的底物序列DEVD，并结合Nostoc punctiforme DnaE内含肽进行环化处理，使其在失活状态下无法发出荧光。当Caspase-3催化DEVD序列发生切割后，mNeonGreen2将由环化状态转变为线性状态，进而重建天然的β桶状结构，实现荧光的恢复与激活。实验表征结果表明，与现有同类传感器相比，该Caspase-3生物传感器具有响应时间更短、灵敏度更高以及功能保质期更长等显著优势。此外，研究人员利用该传感器评估了多种药物对HeLa和MCF-7肿瘤细胞凋亡诱导的影响，并将其应用于检测寨卡病毒入侵的抑制效果，展示了其在细胞生物学研究及药物筛选领域的应用潜力。
title: A switch-on molecular biosensor for detection of caspase-3 and imaging of apoptosis of cells

summary_zh: 针对分布式云环境下视频会议系统的资源调度问题，本文提出了一种面向用户代理分配与转码代理选择的联合优化方法。现有基于就近原则的分配策略未考虑会议中其他参与者的位置分布，导致用户间通信延迟并非最优；同时，不同代理在带宽和处理能力上存在异构性，需合理选择转码代理以降低运营成本并满足多用户对转码视频流的需求。为此，本文将用户到代理的分配以及转码代理的选择建模为组合优化问题，目标是在保证较低会议延迟的前提下最小化服务提供商的运营开销。由于问题具有组合特性且求解困难，基于马尔可夫近似框架设计了一种分布式算法，可证明收敛至最优解的有限邻域内。此外，提出了一种代理排序机制对算法进行合理初始化，以加速收敛过程。原型系统在互联网规模场景下的实验结果表明，与常用方案相比，本设计在降低77%运营成本的同时，实现了更低的会议延迟。该方法适用于大规模分布式云视频会议系统中资源调度与成本优化的工程实践。
title: Cost-Effective Low-Delay Cloud Video Conferencing
venue: 2015 IEEE 35th International Conference on Distributed Computing Systems

abstract: This paper mainly proves the generic properties of the Camassa--Holm equation and the two-component Camassa--Holm equation in a sense of Baire category. We reveal their differences in generic regularity and singular behavior.
summary_zh: 本文从Baire范畴的角度证明了Camassa–Holm方程与双分量Camassa–Holm方程的通有性质，并揭示了二者在通有正则性与奇异行为上的差异。针对Camassa–Holm方程，在适当的函数空间拓扑下，证明其解在通有意义下具有全局存在性和光滑性，即大多数初值对应的解不会在有限时间内发生爆破。而对于双分量Camassa–Holm方程，通有性分析则表明其解普遍呈现奇异性，具体表现为在稠密初值集中解会发生波破碎或梯度爆破，且这种奇异行为在Baire意义下是典型的。研究进一步指出，单分量与双分量系统在通有动力学行为上的本质区别源于附加分量所引入的非线性耦合效应，该效应改变了系统的能量输运与正则性传播机制。上述结果不仅深化了对两类浅水波方程解的整体结构与奇性形成的理解，也为利用通有性视角研究其他非线性色散方程提供了方法论参考，在流体力学与非线性波动领域具有理论意义。
title: Generic Regularity of Conservative Solutions to Camassa--Holm Type Equations

summary_zh: 本文通过简易水热法，利用盐酸调节溶液pH值，成功制备了氧化钨微米花结构。该微米花外径约为2微米，由大量纳米片组装而成，平均孔径为10.9纳米。将所制氧化钨微米花用于化学电阻式气体传感，针对多种氧化性与还原性目标气体进行测试，结果表明该传感器对二氧化氮表现出优异的选择性，在105摄氏度工作温度下对2 ppm二氧化氮的响应值高达22.95，远优于其他气体。传感器的重要特性包括对二氧化氮的检出限低至125 ppb，且工作温度仅为105摄氏度，同时具有良好的重复性，显示出该传感材料在商业化应用方面的潜力。最后，本文提出了氧化钨微米花传感器对二氧化氮的气敏响应机理。
title: High Sensitivity NO2 Gas Sensor Based on 3D WO3 Microflowers Assembled by Numerous Nanoplates

summary_zh: 炎症性肠病（IBD）包括克罗恩病和溃疡性结肠炎，目前尚无根治手段且现有疗法副作用明显。本研究旨在探讨人脐带脂肪源性干细胞（ADSC）联合人参皂苷Rg1对右旋糖酐硫酸钠（DSS）诱导的小鼠结肠炎模型的治疗效果。研究通过静脉注射ADSC并口服给予Rg1，观察小鼠体重、结肠长度、组织学评分及血清细胞因子水平的变化，并利用流式细胞术和免疫荧光技术分析脾脏免疫细胞比例及TLR4-MyD88信号通路的变化。结果表明，Rg1与ADSC联合治疗能显著缓解结肠炎症、减轻体重下降并改善组织病理损伤。相比于单一疗法，联合用药显著降低了IL-1β、TNF-α、IL-6、IL-4及IL-17A等促炎细胞因子的水平，并提升了免疫抑制因子IL-10的表达。此外，联合治疗优化了肠道微生物群结构，通过上调脾脏调节性T细胞（Treg）比例并下调Th17细胞比例，有效恢复了肠道免疫稳态。机制研究发现，Rg1与ADSC的协同作用通过下调TLR4和MyD88的表达，进而抑制TLR4-MyD8信号通路。综上所述，Rg1通过调节肠道菌群增强了ADSC的治疗效能，为IBD的临床治疗提供了新的优化策略。
title: Combined treatment with Rg1 and adipose-derived stem cells alleviates DSS-induced colitis in a mouse model

abstract: A critical advance in the technique of low-energy electron diffraction is presented and shown to enable determining detailed structures of nanomaterials, based on experimental methods that already exist or have been proposed. Our new cluster approach speeds up the computation to scale as n logn, rather than the current n3 or n2, with n the number of atoms, for example. Applications are illustrated for C60 molecules adsorbed on a Cu(111) surface, with and without coadsorbed metal atoms, exhibiting sensitivity to important structural features such as buckyball size and deformation.
summary_zh: 本文提出低能电子衍射技术的一项关键进展，能够基于现有或已提出的实验方法确定纳米材料的精细结构。我们发展了一种新的团簇方法，将计算复杂度从当前的 n³ 或 n² 量级降至 n log n 量级，其中 n 为原子数。以吸附于 Cu(111) 表面的 C60 分子为例，在有无共吸附金属原子的条件下，该方法均展现出对巴基球尺寸和形变等重要结构特征的高度敏感性。
title: Efficient Calculation of Electron Diffraction for the Structural Determination of Nanomaterials

summary_zh: 我们设计了一种靶向碳酸酐酶IX（CAIX）的铼(I)光敏剂CA-Re，旨在同时实现高效肿瘤杀伤与免疫微环境重塑。该分子在缺氧条件下仍可进行I型和II型光动力治疗，表现出纳摩尔级光毒性，并能诱导gasdermin D介导的焦亡性细胞死亡，有效增强肿瘤免疫原性。CA-Re可破坏细胞膜完整性并同步进行自报告，促进树突状细胞成熟及抗原呈递能力，进而在体内充分激活T细胞依赖的适应性免疫应答，最终在消融原发肿瘤的同时清除远端肿瘤。据我们所知，CA-Re是首个基于金属配合物的焦亡诱导剂，为整合光动力治疗与免疫激活的抗肿瘤策略提供了新工具。
title: A Carbonic Anhydrase IX (CAIX)‐Anchored Rhenium(I) Photosensitizer Evokes Pyroptosis for Enhanced Anti‐Tumor Immunity

summary_zh: 本研究基于物质、情感与社会三个维度的可负担性（affordance）视角，探讨了移动学习技术对学习者参与度及分享意愿的影响。研究以中国某研究型大学的387名工程专业研究生为对象，开展了为期14周的实验，并利用移动教学应用“雨课堂”开展同步与异步教学实践。通过对实验前后问卷数据的描述性统计与独立样本t检验分析发现，使用“雨课堂”的学生对移动学习技术持有积极态度；与对照组相比，实验组在学习参与度以及持续学习与经验分享的意愿方面均表现出显著更高的统计学水平。研究结果表明，移动学习技术所提供的多维度可负担性对课程设计、学习活动开展及教学政策制定具有积极推动作用，有助于提升整体教学质量。未来的研究可进一步探讨不同学习时长与强度对学习效果的影响，并尝试将研究对象扩展至不同教育背景的群体。
title: Mobile technology affordance and its social implications: A case of “Rain Classroom”

summary_zh: 我们报道了一种基于非线性偏振演化锁模的铒镱共掺大模场面积光纤振荡器，其采用主要由保偏光纤构成的线性腔结构。该振荡器工作波长为1.56微米，基频重复频率为34.47兆赫兹，并具有两个输出端口。其中一个端口可输出高质量类孤子脉冲，脉宽为325飞秒，平均功率为39.5毫瓦，对应脉冲能量为1.15纳焦。相比之下，另一个端口不仅产生质量较低的复杂脉冲，而且短期和长期稳定性均较差，这可能是由交叉相位调制效应所致。据我们所知，这是首次在1.55微米波段将非线性偏振演化锁模技术应用于保偏大模场面积铒镱共掺光纤振荡器，该波段通常面临自启动锁模能力不足的问题。这一成果主要归因于采用了无截止单模光子晶体光纤，有效抑制了保偏大模场面积光纤中的高阶模式。
title: Mode-locked large-mode-area Er/Yb-doped fiber oscillator via nonlinear polarization evolution with enhanced mode suppression

abstract: This paper presents a systematic overview of recently reported stereolithography 3-D printed passive waveguide devices operating at microwave/millimeter-wave frequencies. Typically, these devices are prototyped monolithically, i.e., as a single part, with the use of low-density photosensitive resins, and are then surface-metallized by appropriately employing copper coating techniques such as electroplating and electroless plating. Such devices are free of either assembly or post fabrication tuning, which effectively shortens the processing cycle. The structural highlights, fabrication techniques, and RF performance of these devices will be discussed.
summary_zh: 本文系统综述了近年来基于立体光刻三维打印技术制备的微波/毫米波无源波导器件。该类器件通常采用低密度光敏树脂进行一体化整体成型，随后通过电镀或化学镀等铜涂覆工艺实现表面金属化。这种制造方式无需装配或后期调试，显著缩短了加工周期。文章重点讨论了器件的结构特点、制造工艺及射频性能，展示了立体光刻三维打印在微波/毫米波无源波导器件快速原型制造中的应用潜力。
title: Monolithic Stereolithography 3-D Printed Microwave Passive Waveguide Devices
venue: 2018 IEEE International Symposium on Antennas and Propagation & USNC/URSI National Radio Science Meeting

abstract: The frequent occurrence of drought events in recent years has caused significant changes in plant biodiversity. Understanding vegetation dynamics and their responses to climate change is of great significance to reveal the behaviour mechanism of terrestrial ecosystems. In this study, NDVI and SIF were used to evaluate the dynamic changes of vegetation in the Pearl River Basin (PRB). The relationship between vegetation and meteorological drought in the PRB was evaluated from both linear and nonlinear perspectives, and the difference of vegetation response to meteorological drought in different land types was revealed. Cross wavelet analysis was used to explore the teleconnection factors (e.g., large-scale climate patterns and solar activity) that may affect the relationship between meteorological drought and vegetation dynamics. The results show that 1) from 2001 to 2019, the vegetation cover and photosynthetic capacity of the PRB both showed increasing trends, with changing rates of 0.055/10a and 0.036/10a, respectively; 2) compared with NDVI, the relationship between SIF and meteorological drought was closer; 3) the vegetation response time (VRT) obtained based on NDVI was mainly 4–5 months, which was slightly longer than that based on SIF (mainly 3–4 months); 4) the VRT of woody vegetation (mainly 3–4 months) was longer than that of herbaceous vegetation (mainly 4–5 months); and 5) vegetation had significant positive correlations with the El Niño Southern Oscillation (ENSO) and sunspots but a significant negative correlation with the Pacific Decadal Oscillation (PDO). Compared with sunspots, the ENSO and the PDO were more closely related to the response relationship between meteorological drought and vegetation. The outcomes of this study can help reveal the relationship between vegetation dynamics and climate change under the background of global warming and provide a new perspective for studying the relationship between drought and vegetation.
title: Comprehensive evaluation of vegetation responses to meteorological drought from both linear and nonlinear perspectives

abstract: We study the statistics of coherent current sheets, the population of X-type critical points, and reconnection rates in a coronal loop geometry, via numerical simulations of reduced magnetohydrodynamic turbulence. Current sheets and sites of reconnection (magnetic X-points) are identified in two-dimensional planes of the three-dimensional simulation domain. The geometry of the identified current sheets—including area, length, and width—and the magnetic dissipation occurring in the current sheets are statistically characterized. We also examine the role of magnetic reconnection, by computing the reconnection rates at the identified X-points and investigating their association with current sheets.
summary_zh: 本文通过简化磁流体力学（RMHD）湍流数值模拟，深入研究了日冕环几何结构中相干电流片、X型临界点种群以及磁重联率的统计特性。研究通过在三维模拟区域的二维平面内识别电流片与磁重联位点（磁X点），对识别出的电流片几何参数（包括面积、长度和宽度）以及电流片内的磁耗散过程进行了统计表征。此外，研究还通过计算识别出的X点处的磁重联率，探讨了磁重联的作用及其与电流片之间的关联性。该研究为理解日冕环境下的磁能量耗散机制及湍流过程中的磁重联动力学提供了重要的统计依据。
title: DISSIPATION AND RECONNECTION IN BOUNDARY-DRIVEN REDUCED MAGNETOHYDRODYNAMICS

abstract: Cu-doped InP (Cu:InP) and InP/ZnSe nanocrystals (NCs) with near-infrared-I (NIR-I) emission were prepared and characterized. Femtosecond transient absorption spectra revealed that the epitaxial growth of a ZnSe diffusion barrier onto the Cu:InP core can amplify its exciton-dopant coupling strength, with the energy transfer times of ∼ 220 p s for Cu:InP NCs and ∼ 183 p s for Cu:InP/ZnSe NCs. Importantly, the Cu:InP/ZnSe NCs exhibit much larger two- and three-photon absorption cross sections, reaching ∼ 10162 GM at 1030 nm and ∼ 1.06 × 10 − 77 c m 6 s 2 p h o t o n − 2 at 1600 nm, compared with Cu:InP NCs.
summary_zh: 本文制备并表征了具有近红外一区发光的铜掺杂磷化铟（Cu:InP）及磷化铟/硒化锌（InP/ZnSe）核壳纳米晶。飞秒瞬态吸收光谱研究表明，在Cu:InP核上外延生长ZnSe扩散势垒层可显著增强激子-掺杂剂耦合强度，其中Cu:InP纳米晶的能量转移时间约为220皮秒，而Cu:InP/ZnSe核壳纳米晶缩短至约183皮秒。重要的是，与Cu:InP纳米晶相比，Cu:InP/ZnSe核壳纳米晶展现出大幅提升的双光子和三光子吸收截面，在1030纳米处双光子吸收截面高达约10162 GM，在1600纳米处三光子吸收截面达到约1.06×10⁻⁷⁷ cm⁶ s² photon⁻²。该研究揭示了核壳结构设计对掺杂纳米晶非线性光学性质的显著调控作用，为开发高性能近红外非线性光学材料提供了新思路。
title: Comparison studies of excitonic properties and multiphoton absorption of near-infrared-I-emitting Cu-doped InP and InP/ZnSe nanocrystals

abstract: A long-period fiber-grating sensor with a high strain sensitivity of -7.6 pm/microepsilon and a low temperature sensitivity of 3.91 pm/ degrees C is fabricated by use of focused CO(2) laser beam to carve periodic grooves on a large- mode-area photonic crystal fiber. Such a strain sensor can effectively reduce the cross-sensitivity between strain and temperature, and the temperature-induced strain error obtained is only 0.5 microepsilon/ degrees C without using temperature compensation.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于大模场面积光子晶体光纤的长周期光纤光栅传感器，采用聚焦二氧化碳激光束在光纤上刻写周期性凹槽制备而成。该传感器实现了高达 -7.6 pm/微应变的高应变灵敏度，同时具备仅 3.91 pm/摄氏度的低温度灵敏度。这种性能组合有效抑制了应变与温度之间的交叉敏感问题，无需额外温度补偿即可将温度引起的应变测量误差控制在 0.5 微应变/摄氏度。该传感器在结构健康监测、航空航天及精密机械等需要高精度应变测量且环境温度波动的领域具有重要应用前景。
title: Highly sensitive long-period fiber-grating strain sensor with low temperature sensitivity

summary_zh: 第四纪冰期-间冰期循环通过成土作用在我国黄土-古土壤序列中留下了显著印记。为了准确解读这些成土颗粒所携带的古气候信号，必须从矿物学及粒度分布（GSD）的角度对成土磁性颗粒进行定量分析。然而，由于缺乏有效手段分析纳米级的极细微成土磁性颗粒，目前的粒度分布研究尚不精确。本研究利用低温技术，系统研究了中国黄土高原西部和中部两个典型剖面中交流磁化率频率依赖性（$\chi_{fd}$）的温度特征。基于形状各向异性占主导的颗粒Néel理论及低温实验分析，本文构建了中国黄土-古土壤成土颗粒的定量粒度分布模型。研究发现，主要的磁性粒径分布在超顺磁/单畴阈值（约20-25 nm）之上，且粒度分布几乎不受成土程度的影响，这一结果与前人研究结论高度一致。该粒度分布模型的建立深化了对中国黄土成土过程的理解，为环境磁学与古气候变化之间的显式关联提供了科学依据。
title: Quantifying grain size distribution of pedogenic magnetic particles in Chinese loess and its significance for pedogenesis

summary_zh: 本研究提出一种基于低成本力敏电阻的个性化非线性模型，用于精确估计足底压力中心轨迹。该模型通过最小二乘误差逼近算法确定系数，并在多种姿势控制评估任务中进行了验证。与参考测量值相比，左右足内外侧方向压力中心轨迹的平均均方根误差分别为2.23毫米和2.72毫米，前后方向分别为9.17毫米和11.19毫米，结果优于以往相关研究，且显著优于传统加权平均法。该方法可为老年人在家庭或社区医疗环境中的跌倒风险评估提供低成本解决方案，有望助力预防老年人跌倒。
title: Estimation of Foot Plantar Center of Pressure Trajectories with Low-Cost Instrumented Insoles Using an Individual-Specific Nonlinear Model

summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种新的反向系间窜越促进机制，即三重态T1与下极化激元光子部分之间的光-物质耦合作用。传统观点认为，微腔中激子-光子强耦合形成的下极化激元可降低反向系间窜越能垒，其物理起源被归因于T1与极化激元激子组分间的自旋-轨道耦合。然而，我们揭示了另一种此前被忽略的路径：由系间窜越诱导的T1跃迁偶极矩所驱动的T1-光子直接耦合。通过理论计算，我们证实该机制可有效解释实验中观测到的赤藓红B分子反向系间窜越过程的显著增强。这一发现突破了传统分子设计中对强自旋-轨道耦合的依赖，将大幅拓展高效腔增强发光材料的分子设计空间，并为相关实验现象提供直接的理论阐释。该机制在有机发光二极管、低阈值激光器及量子光学器件等领域具有重要应用前景。
title: Enhanced Reverse Intersystem Crossing Promoted by Triplet Exciton–Photon Coupling
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

abstract: In this paper, a reconfigurable digital modulation leaky-wave antenna (LWA) is proposed. This antenna does not require additional ADC/DAC modules and mixing circuits, which simplifies the antenna structure design. By introducing diodes, the proposed antenna realizes digital beam scanning and digital modulation of the leaky-wave. By inputting different digital codes, the multi-beam switching functionality is achieved, thereby realizing the purpose of beam reconfigurability. A low-cost and easy-to-manufacture metasurface radiator is fabricated, which can achieve the leaky-wave radiation effect. In summary, the proposed antenna is a promising candidate for realizing beam reconfigurability in future intelligent wireless communications.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种可重构数字调制漏波天线，无需额外配置模数/数模转换模块及混频电路，从而简化了天线结构设计。通过引入二极管，该天线实现了漏波的数字波束扫描与数字调制功能。输入不同数字编码即可完成多波束切换，达到波束可重构的目的。同时，设计了一种低成本、易加工的超表面辐射体，能够实现漏波辐射效果。结果表明，该天线在未来智能无线通信的波束可重构应用中具有良好的前景。
title: A Leaky-Wave Beam Scanning Antenna with PIN Diodes
venue: 2024 IEEE 7th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)

summary_zh: 移位运算在经典信号处理中具有核心地位，它是所有滤波器的生成元，也是加窗傅里叶变换和小波变换等时频分析的基础操作。随着互联网技术与大数据科学的快速发展，大量数据被表示为定义在图上的信号。为了在图信号处理中建立滤波、加窗傅里叶变换及小波变换理论，需要将经典信号的移位运算推广至图信号，但图的顶点集通常不构成向量空间，无法定义加法运算，这使得该问题具有根本性挑战。本文基于对移位运算核心作用的理解，提出了原子滤波器概念，可视为图信号移位算子的一种弱形式。进而研究了原子滤波器满足保范性、周期性和实值保持性的条件，其中实值保持性在经典信号处理中自然成立，但在图信号领域尚未见相关研究报道。基于这些条件，本文提出了正规原子滤波器概念，当图为循环图时，该概念在温和条件下退化为经典移位算子。文中给出了具有和不具有正规原子滤波器的典型图例。最后，作为应用，利用原子滤波器构造了时频原子，这些原子构成图信号空间的一个框架。
title: Atomic filter: A weak form of shift operator for graph signals

abstract: Abstract We present an explicit inverse approach using a Hessian matrix for least-squares migration (LSM) with Q compensation. The scheme is developed by incorporating an effective Q-based solution of the viscoacoustic wave equation into a blockwise approximation to the Hessian in LSM, which is implemented after the so-called deabsorption prestack time migration (PSTM). The effective Q model used fully accounts for frequency-dependent traveltime and amplitude at the same imaging location. We can extract the effective Q parameters by scanning during previous deabsorption PSTM. This avoids the challenging task of building the Q model. The blockwise Hessian matrix approach decomposes the full Hessian matrix into a series of computationally tractable small-sized matrices using a localised approach. We derive the explicit formula of the offset-dependent Hessian matrix using an analytical Green's function obtained from deabsorption PSTM. In this way, we can approximate a reflectivity imaging for the targeted zone by a spatial deconvolution of the migrated result with an explicit inverse. The resulting scheme broadens the frequency-band of imaging by deabsorption, and improves the subsurface illumination and spatial resolution through the inverse Hessian. A high-resolution, true-amplitude migrated gather can then be obtained. Synthetic and field data sets demonstrate the proposed blockwise LS-QPSTM.
title: Viscoacoustic least-squares migration with a blockwise Hessian matrix: an effective Q approach

abstract: BACKGROUND: Regular physical activity contributes to the prevention of cancer, cardiovascular disease, and other chronic diseases. However, the frequency of physical activity often declines with age, particularly among the elderly. Thus, we investigated the effects of daily walking on mortality among younger-elderly men (65-74 years) with or without major critical diseases (heart disease, cerebrovascular disease, or cancer). METHODS: We assessed 1239 community-dwelling men aged 64/65 years from the New Integrated Suburban Seniority Investigation Project. We estimated hazard ratios (HRs) of all-cause mortality and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) according to daily walking duration and adjusted for potential confounders, including survey year, marital status, work status, education, smoking and drinking status, BMI, regular exercise, regular sports, sleeping time, medical status, disease history, and functional capacity. RESULTS: For men without critical diseases, mortality risk declined linearly with increased walking time after adjustment for confounders (Ptrend = 0.018). Walking ≥2 hours/day was significantly associated with lower all-cause mortality (HR 0.49; 95% CI, 0.27-0.90). For men with critical diseases, walking 1-2 hours/day showed a protective effect on mortality compared with walking <0.5 hours/day after adjustment for confounders (HR 0.29; 95% CI, 0.06-1.20). Walking ≥2 hours/day showed no benefit on mortality in men with critical diseases, even after adjustment for confounders. CONCLUSIONS: Different duration of daily walking was associated with decreased mortality for younger-elderly men with or without critical diseases, independent of sociodemographic and lifestyle factors, BMI, medical status, disease history, and functional capacity. Incorporating regular walking into daily lives of younger-elderly men may improve longevity and successful aging.
title: Health Benefits of Daily Walking on Mortality Among Younger-Elderly Men With or Without Major Critical Diseases in the New Integrated Suburban Seniority Investigation Project: A Prospective Cohort Study

summary_zh: 本文提出一种具有三明治结构的多量子阱量子点，旨在解决传统多发射峰量子点在白光LED应用中因激发功率变化导致的色偏移问题。研究通过系统分析光学特性和激子动力学发现，内势垒层的厚度对平衡相邻量子阱间的激子分布起着关键作用，其机制在于调控近场能量转移与光吸收过程；而量子阱层和外势垒层则主要影响双发射峰的发光效率及波长位置。基于此，通过优化各层结构参数，成功制备出在宽激发功率范围内色偏移极小的多量子阱量子点。以此构建的白光LED展现出高度稳定的白光光谱，对激发功率波动具有优异的耐受性，显著提升了多量子阱量子点在照明与显示领域的应用性能。
title: Multi-quantum-well quantum dots with stable dual emission

abstract: Triacylglycerols store metabolic energy in organisms and have industrial uses as foods and fuels. Excessive accumulation of triacylglycerols in humans causes obesity and is associated with metabolic diseases1. Triacylglycerol synthesis is catalysed by acyl-CoA diacylglycerol acyltransferase (DGAT) enzymes2–4, the structures and catalytic mechanisms of which remain unknown. Here we determined the structure of dimeric human DGAT1, a member of the membrane-bound O-acyltransferase (MBOAT) family, by cryo-electron microscopy at approximately 3.0 Å resolution. DGAT1 forms a homodimer through N-terminal segments and a hydrophobic interface, with putative active sites within the membrane region. A structure obtained with oleoyl-CoA substrate resolved at approximately 3.2 Å shows that the CoA moiety binds DGAT1 on the cytosolic side and the acyl group lies deep within a hydrophobic channel, positioning the acyl-CoA thioester bond near an invariant catalytic histidine residue. The reaction centre is located inside a large cavity, which opens laterally to the membrane bilayer, providing lipid access to the active site. A lipid-like density—possibly representing an acyl-acceptor molecule—is located within the reaction centre, orthogonal to acyl-CoA. Insights provided by the DGAT1 structures, together with mutagenesis and functional studies, provide the basis for a model of the catalysis of triacylglycerol synthesis by DGAT. Cryo-electron microscopy structures and functional and mutagenesis studies provide insights into the catalysis of triacylglycerol synthesis by human acyl-CoA diacylglycerol acyltransferase at its intramembrane active site.
title: Structure and catalytic mechanism of a human triacylglycerol-synthesis enzyme

summary_zh: 本文探讨了初始集合对基于集合的数据同化技术性能的影响，并利用社区地球系统模型（CESM）与数据同化研究测试平台（DART）开展了实验研究。研究在观测系统模拟实验框架下，针对海表温度（SST）同化过程，对比了五种包含不同噪声模式及是否进行额外积分的扰动策略。实验结果表明，虽然不同初始集合会导致同化收敛速率出现差异，但所有实验在三个月后均能实现收敛。然而，海表高度（SSH）和海表盐度（SSS）等变量对初始集合的敏感性更高。方差分析显示，白噪声扰动方案产生的均方根误差（RMSE）最大。在排除白噪声影响后，研究发现仅同化SST时，不同初始集合对SSH的影响主要集中在南极绕极流区域，这主要归因于SSH与SST之间协方差的离散程度。
title: Comparison of perturbation strategies for the initial ensemble in ocean data assimilation with a fully coupled earth system model
venue: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering

abstract: A metal-catalyst-free and redox-neutral innate difluoromethylthiolation method enabled by visible light is described. This protocol employs a shelf-stable and readily available electrophilic difluoromethylthiolating reagent, PhSO 2 SCF 2 H, and converts a broad spectrum of arenes and heteroarenes to difluoromethylthioethers without noble metals and stoichiometric amount of additives.
summary_zh: 本文报道了一种无需金属催化剂、在氧化还原中性条件下实现可见光驱动的直接二氟甲硫基化方法。该方法利用一种稳定易得的亲电型二氟甲硫基化试剂PhSO₂SCF₂H，在可见光照射下即可将多种芳烃和杂芳烃高效转化为相应的二氟甲硫醚产物。该策略避免了贵金属催化剂和化学计量添加剂的使用，具有条件温和、操作简便的特点，为含二氟甲硫基功能分子的合成提供了一条绿色、实用的新途径，在药物化学和材料科学领域具有潜在应用价值。
title: Radical difluoromethylthiolation of aromatics enabled by visible light

summary_zh: 为在充满噪声信号、不可避免的交易成本及零和博弈特征的不确定金融环境中实现稳定盈利，构建基于全面数据处理的优化投资组合至关重要。然而，现有方法往往忽视从数据中学习对冲金融知识，并利用混合专家推理来最大化智能体收益。针对这一问题，本文提出协调知识蒸馏与推理框架CKDIF。该框架引入三维离散坐标系统，训练具备对冲交易行为的深度强化学习智能体，从而直接从含噪金融数据中有效蒸馏底层微观金融知识。在此基础上，CKDIF利用这些预训练智能体构建新型混合专家网络集成，并据此在任意资产维度上进行最终投资组合选择。值得注意的是，在交易成本设定为贴近实际的0.1%条件下，CKDIF在六个真实金融数据集中的五个上，表现优于八种代表性算法。其平均累积财富和卡尔玛比率分别达到买入持有策略的1.66倍和3.70倍。这些结果凸显了协调知识蒸馏与混合专家推理在竞争性环境中提升智能体性能的有效性。
title: When Coordinated Knowledge Distillation Meets Mixture of Expert Inference: Insights from Portfolio Optimization
venue: Poster Volume Ⅲ The 2025 Twenty-First International Conference on Intelligent Computing July 26-29, 2025 Ningbo, China

abstract: Macroautophagy/autophagy mediates the degradation of ubiquitinated aggregated proteins within lysosomes in a process known as aggrephagy. The cargo receptor SQSTM1/p62 condenses aggregated proteins into larger structures and links them to the nascent autophagosomal membrane (phagophore). How the condensation reaction and autophagosome formation are coupled is unclear. We recently discovered that a region of SQSTM1 containing its LIR motif directly interacts with RB1CC1/FIP200, a protein acting at early stages of autophagosome formation. Determination of the structure of the C-terminal region of RB1CC1 revealed a claw-shaped domain. Using a structure-function approach, we show that the interaction of SQSTM1 with the RB1CC1 claw domain is crucial for the productive recruitment of the autophagy machinery to ubiquitin-positive condensates and their subsequent degradation by autophagy. We also found that concentrated Atg8-family proteins on the phagophore displace RB1CC1 from SQSTM1, suggesting an intrinsic directionality in the process of autophagosome formation. Ultimately, our study reveals how the interplay of SQSTM1 and RB1CC1 couples cargo condensation to autophagosome formation.
title: How RB1CC1/FIP200 claws its way to autophagic engulfment of SQSTM1/p62-ubiquitin condensates

abstract: Abstract A general formulation for the relative velocity between the two phases in sediment-laden water flows is established in this study. The purpose of this effort is to obtain more affordable tools for the simulation of sediment-laden flows at different scales. To this end, an enhanced Eulerian–Eulerian two-phase flow model, which encompasses the mass and momentum conservation equations for both water and sediment phases and a modified k − ɛ model including sediment effects on fluid turbulence, is first presented and then validated for steady-state, open-channel as well as oscillatory flows. Starting from the aforementioned two-phase flow model, the relative velocity between the two phases is obtained by manipulating the momentum equations for the two phases, thus leading to a simplified expression which saves computational time. Based on numerical experiments, it is found that that in the vertical direction pressure and shear stress are predominant as compared to other factors, while in the horizontal direction, lift force and advection effect are also important to some extent, particularly when accurate results are expected. Interestingly, the simplified form of the formulation is shown to provide similar accuracy as the two-phase flow model does.
title: A general formulation of relative motion between two phases in sediment-laden water flows

abstract: When the control moment gyroscope, momentum wheel, solar array drive mechanism, antenna drive mechanism, and refrigerator on spacecraft work, they produce micro-vibration, which seriously affects the accuracy of observation equipment. It is an effective way to suppress micro-vibration to install a vibration isolation device at the payload. In this paper, a three-parameter fluid viscous damper (TPFVD) for spacecraft micro-vibration suppression is researched. Considering the compressibility of the fluid and the volume deformation of the bellows, according to the effective area principle of bellows, the bellows is equivalent to a single tube, and a reduced-order model of the vibration isolator is established by using the approximate analytical modeling method. The nonlinearity caused by the inlet and outlet effects of the damping orifice is also considered in the model. The model error is further modified by introducing the correction coefficient of bellows volume deformation. Compared with the FEM model, the validity of the model and the modified method is verified. The results show that the models in the existing literature are applicable only when the frequency is less than 100 Hz. The calculation error of the model proposed in this paper is less than 8.20% in the frequency range of 1–300 Hz, and the maximum error of the unmodified model in the literature can reach 34.28%. In addition, the influences of damping orifice parameters, viscosity, payload mass, and nonlinear characteristics on the force transmissibility and payload displacement of the isolator are analyzed.
title: A reduced-order model of the three-parameter fluid viscous damper with consideration of fluid compressibility and bellows volume deformation

summary_zh: 本文提出一种名为深度精细更精细网络（DF2Net）的深度学习框架，用于从单张人脸图像重建精细三维几何结构。该框架将重建过程分解为三个阶段，分别由三个精心设计的子网络完成：D-Net采用U型网络架构将输入图像映射为稠密深度图；F-Net通过融合深度域与RGB域的特征对D-Net的输出进行细化；Fr-Net则引入新颖的多分辨率超柱架构进一步提升重建质量。为训练这些网络，研究引入了三类数据：三维模型合成数据、二维图像重建数据以及高精度面部图像，并针对不同网络设计了特定的数据组合与损失函数。定性评估表明，DF2Net能够有效重建细微的面部细节，如眼角细纹和皱纹。在真实图像和BU-3DFE数据集上的定性与定量分析显示，该方法的性能优于或可比肩当前最先进算法。相关代码及收集的7万组图像-深度数据将公开发布。
title: DF2Net: A Dense-Fine-Finer Network for Detailed 3D Face Reconstruction
venue: 2019 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)

summary_zh: 我们提出了一种基于N-杂环卡宾导向的级联C–H活化/环化聚合策略，用于高效构建主链荷电荧光聚电解质。该方法以易得的咪唑鎓盐和内二炔为单体，通过原子经济性聚合，以接近定量的产率获得结构复杂、高分子量（绝对数均分子量可达135 600）的多功能荧光主链荷电聚电解质。聚合物主链中的多取代多环N-杂芳环阳离子赋予材料优异的溶液加工性、高热稳定性以及在溶液态和聚集态均高效发光的双态荧光特性。利用主链阳离子杂环的强吸电子能力，通过调控阳离子稠环核周围的取代基，可便捷实现多色聚集态荧光。基于该类荧光聚合物薄膜良好的光敏性，能够简便制备多尺度、高分辨的多色荧光光图案，在光学显示器件和防伪系统领域具有应用潜力。此外，这些阳离子型主链荷电聚电解质与阴离子聚电解质之间的强静电作用，使其可形成具有可直接观察内部结构的多色荧光界面聚电解质复合微纤维。此类柔性微纤维还可进一步加工成多种形式的纤维基宏观图案或绘画。
title: Multifunctional Fluorescent Main-Chain Charged Polyelectrolytes Synthesized by Cascade C–H Activation/Annulation Polymerizations
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

abstract: The undetected error probability of binary constant weight codes on a binary symmetric channel is studied in this correspondence. First, we present a necessary condition for the binary constant weight codes to be proper for error detection. Then, by using the necessary condition, we study the error detection capability of binary optimum constant weight codes.
summary_zh: 本文研究了在二进制对称信道环境下，二进制等重码（Binary Constant Weight Codes）的未检测错误概率问题。文章首先推导出了二进制等重码能够实现有效错误检测的必要条件，为评估编码性能提供了理论依据。在此基础上，利用该必要条件，本文进一步深入探讨了二进制最优等重码的错误检测能力。研究结果为设计和评估适用于特定信道环境的等重编码方案提供了重要的理论指导。
title: Binary constant weight codes for error detection

abstract: Based on the observation that live fish caudal fins exhibit softness, flexibility, and active deformation, which are essential for generating thrust, stability, and maneuverability, herein, a comprehensive study on a novel type of bionic robotic fish with an actively deformable caudal fin is presented. The article first presents the design of the robot. Next, the quasisteady model theory is used to establish the hydrodynamic force for modeling the deformable caudal fin. Furthermore, three deformation modes are studied and compared: the conventional nondeformable mode, the sine‐based mode, and the instantaneous mode. Finally, a series of extensive experiments are conducted to evaluate various performance metrics of this innovative untethered biomimetic robotic fish, including thrust, swimming speed, yaw stability, turning radius, and turning rate. The results demonstrate that the introduction of active deformation of the caudal fin significantly enhances the swimming performance in the aforementioned indices when compared to the conventional nondeformable mode. Notably, the instantaneous mode exhibits best performance in terms of thrust, swimming speed, turning radius, and turning rate, while the sine‐based mode demonstrates the best yaw stability. Consequently, this research contributes to the advancement of robotic fish design and the development of underwater biomimetic robots.
title: A Novel Untethered Robotic Fish with an Actively Deformable Caudal Fin
