summary_zh: 随着分布式能源的快速部署及需求侧管理的深入发展，电力市场中的小型代理人正变得愈发主动，这为点对点（P2P）交易机制的发展提供了契机。然而，由于实际负荷与发电量往往与日前市场预设的计划存在显著偏差，亟需在P2P框架下通过实时市场机制进行快速交易重调度，以维持电力平衡。针对传统P2P机制因依赖迭代式分布式优化算法而导致计算负担过重、难以满足实时交易需求的技术挑战，本文提出了一种新型在线优化框架，旨在实现实时P2P市场运行。该框架通过一种创新的在线共识交替方向乘子法（OC-ADMM）算法，致力于实现在线社会福利最大化。为了满足实时性要求，该算法在每个时间步内仅需每个代理人执行一次迭代，从而大幅降低了计算复杂度。理论分析证明，该算法具有次线性非平稳遗憾上界，意味着从长期来看能够实现社会福利的最大化。仿真实验及案例研究表明，该算法在收敛性能、跟踪能力以及计算效率方面均表现优异。
title: Online Optimization for Real-Time Peer-to-Peer Electricity Market Mechanisms

summary_zh: 小分子药物与离子通道的非预期结合会改变心肌细胞的电生理特性，进而可能诱发心律失常或心力衰竭。细胞内动作电位波形能够反映心肌离子通道的协同活动，是评估药物毒性的可靠手段，但传统膜片钳技术因通量较低限制了其大规模应用。本文介绍了一种新型纳米冠电极阵列（NcEA）技术，该技术能够实现稳健、并行且长时程的细胞内动作电位记录。研究表明，NcEA技术支持对同一细胞在给药前后的动作电位波形进行自身对照分析，不仅能清晰区分钠、钾、钙通道阻滞剂的不同药理效应，还能以亚毫秒级的精度识别三类钠通道阻滞剂之间的细微差异，并揭示不同细胞间药物反应的异质性。实验结果显示，该技术可实现全阵列同步细胞内记录，成功率约达94%，平均记录时长约为30分钟，部分记录甚至可超过2小时。凭借高可靠性、长时程记录能力及易用性，NcEA技术在基于动作电位的临床前药物筛选领域具有重要的应用潜力。
title: Cardiotoxicity drug screening based on whole-panel intracellular recording

summary_zh: 本文提出一种通过反向硫化制备红外透明聚合物材料的新策略，以解决有机材料固有红外吸收导致的光学与热学性能难以兼顾的问题。研究设计了一种高沸点对称型降冰片二烯衍生物交联剂DMMD，其具有刚性核心和低红外活性，可与熔融硫进行反向硫化反应。通过调控硫的投料比，合成了不同硫含量的Poly(S-r-DMMD)共聚物。所得聚合物表现出可调节的热学性能，玻璃化转变温度在98.3至119.8摄氏度之间，同时在中波红外区实现42.9%至52.6%的透过率，在长波红外区实现1.5%至5.29%的透过率，展现出较高的红外透明性。此外，该材料可通过简易热压工艺制备大尺寸自支撑菲涅尔透镜，用于红外成像，为红外精密透镜的设计与生产提供了灵活性。本研究为平衡红外透明聚合物材料的热学与光学性能提供了新思路，并为相关聚合物材料的性能优化提供了参考。
title: e202419446. DOI: 10.1002/anie.202419446. ²

abstract: We consider two business models for a two-sided economy under uncertainty: dealership and marketplace. Although both business models can bridge the gap between demand and supply, it is not clear which model is better for the firm or for the consumers. We show that while the two models differ substantially in pricing power, inventory risk, fee structure, and fulfillment time, both models share several important features, with the revenues to the firm from the two models converging when the markets are thick. We also show that for thick markets there is a one-to-one mapping between their corresponding optimal policies. We provide guidelines and insights as to which business model is preferable under different conditions when the markets are not thick.
summary_zh: 本文探讨了不确定性环境下双边经济中的两种商业模式：经销商模式与市场平台模式。尽管两种模式均能弥合供需缺口，但它们在定价权、库存风险、收费结构和履约时间上存在显著差异。研究发现，当市场厚度足够大时，两种模式为企业带来的收入趋于一致，且其对应的最优策略之间存在一一映射关系。针对市场厚度不足的情形，本文进一步给出了不同条件下应优先选择何种商业模式的指导原则与分析洞见。该研究为平台经济中商业模式的选择与优化提供了理论依据。
title: Dealership or Marketplace with Fulfillment Service: A Dynamic Comparison

summary_zh: 针对深度神经网络中的归一化学习问题，本文提出了一种可切换归一化（Switchable Normalization, SN）方法。该方法能够为深度网络中的不同归一化层自动学习并选择最合适的归一化方式。具体而言，SN 引入了三种不同的统计量计算范围，包括通道、层以及小批量（minibatch），并通过端到端的方式学习各归一化方式的重要性权重，从而实现动态切换。实验表明，SN 具有极强的适应性，能够兼容多种网络架构与任务。相比于传统的归一化技术，SN 在不同批量大小下均表现出良好的鲁棒性，即使在极小批量（如每块 GPU 仅 2 张图像）的情况下也能维持高性能。此外，SN 无需像组归一化（Group Normalization）那样手动搜索组数等敏感超参数。在 ImageNet、COCO、CityScapes 等多个具有挑战性的基准数据集上，SN 在无需额外复杂设计的条件下，性能均优于现有的主流归一化方法。本文还通过深入分析探讨了归一化层自主选择机制的有效性、归一化选择的影响因素以及不同任务对归一化方式的偏好，为理解深度学习中的归一化技术提供了重要参考。
title: Switchable Normalization for Learning-to-Normalize Deep Representation
venue: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence

summary_zh: 厌氧氨氧化（anammox）过程具有成本效益，但由于厌氧氨氧化菌生长缓慢，在传统污水处理厂中积累时间较长。接种富集的厌氧氨氧化颗粒污泥是实现全规模污水处理厂短程脱氮的有效手段，但其内部复杂的微生物氮循环网络尚不明确。本研究利用宏基因组学和宏转录组学技术，对三个接种了外源厌氧氨氧化颗粒的传统污水处理厂进行了研究，涵盖了部分硝化-厌氧氨氧化（PNA）以及硝化-反硝化两种脱氮工艺。研究发现，在Bali的PNA系统中，氨氮主要通过氨氧化细菌Nitrosomonas进行部分氧化，随后由厌氧氨氧化菌Ca. Brocadia和Ca. Kuenenia将生成的亚硝酸盐与剩余氨氮直接转化为氮气。在Wenshan的硝化-反硝化系统中，尽管存在Nitrosomonas，但氨氧化古菌Thaumarchaeota出人意料地占据了硝化群落的主导地位，且Ca. Brocadia的生物量产率受到高浓度可生物降解有机物输入及AOA、AOB、Comammox Nitrospira、NOB以及异养反硝化菌竞争底物的抑制。而在Linkou的高有机碳硝化-反硝化系统中，Comammox Nitrospira成为了Nitrosomonas存在下的主要硝化微生物。研究结果表明，不同的污水处理厂中存在不同的活性微生物群落协同作用以实现高效脱氮，证实了通过直接接种外源厌氧氨氧化颗粒在富氨系统中应用该工艺的可行性，并从理化与组学角度深化了对厌氧氨氧化驱动的污水处理厂中微生物氮循环的理解。
title: Complex microbial nitrogen-cycling networks in three distinct anammox-inoculated wastewater treatment systems

abstract: In this paper, we study the dynamics of Newton maps for arbitrary polynomials. Let $p$ be an arbitrary polynomial with at least three distinct roots, and $f$ be its Newton map. It is shown that the boundary $\partial B$ of any immediate root basin $B$ of $f$ is locally connected. Moreover, $\partial B$ is a Jordan curve if and only if ${\rm deg}(f|_B)=2$. This implies that the boundaries of all components of root basins, for all polynomials' Newton maps, from the viewpoint of topology, are tame.
summary_zh: 本文研究任意多项式的牛顿映射动力学。设 p 为至少具有三个不同根的任意多项式，f 为其牛顿映射。研究证明，对于 f 的任意直接根盆域 B，其边界 ∂B 是局部连通的。此外，∂B 为若尔当曲线当且仅当 f 在 B 上的限制度数为 2。这一结果表明，从拓扑学角度看，所有多项式牛顿映射的根盆域分支边界均具有驯顺性。
title: Dynamics of Newton maps

abstract: In this Letter, we propose a variable-line-spacing (VLS) grating pattern for a hybrid diffractive device termed a grating Fresnel (G-Fresnel) lens, which is used in spectrometers to improve spectral resolution over a wide spectral range. The VLS grating pattern disperses light of specific wavelengths with a different angle and position such that the aberration caused by the Fresnel surface can be compensated for. In this manner, high resolution can be achieved over a relatively wide spectral range. The VLS grating pattern is designed based on the least wave-change principle and simulated by ZEMAX. Results reveal that the VLS G-Fresnel device allows a subnanometer resolution over a spectral range of 200 nm.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为光栅菲涅耳（G-Fresnel）透镜的混合衍射器件，通过引入变线间距（VLS）光栅图形，旨在提升光谱仪在宽光谱范围内的光谱分辨率。该设计基于最小波前变化原理，并利用ZEMAX进行了仿真验证。其核心机制在于利用变线间距光栅对不同波长的光进行差异化的角度与位置色散，从而有效补偿菲涅耳表面引入的像差。研究结果表明，这种G-Fresnel器件能够在200 nm的宽光谱范围内实现亚纳米级的高分辨率。该技术为开发高性能、宽波段的光谱分析设备提供了新的设计思路。
title: Design of a variable-line-spacing grating pattern for spectrometers based on a grating Fresnel device

abstract: When dealing with data from distinct locations, machine learning algorithms tend to demonstrate an implicit preference of some locations over the others, which constitutes biases that sabotage the spatial fairness of the algorithm. This unfairness can easily introduce biases in subsequent decision-making given broad adoptions of learning-based solutions in practice. However, locational biases in AI are largely understudied. To mitigate biases over locations, we propose a locational meta-referee (Meta-Ref) to oversee the few-shot meta-training and meta-testing of a deep neural network. Meta-Ref dynamically adjusts the learning rates for training samples of given locations to advocate a fair performance across locations, through an explicit consideration of locational biases and the characteristics of input data. We present a three-phase training framework to learn both a meta-learning-based predictor and an integrated Meta-Ref that governs the fairness of the model. Once trained with a distribution of spatial tasks, Meta-Ref is applied to samples from new spatial tasks (i.e., regions outside the training area) to promote fairness during the fine-tune step. We carried out experiments with two case studies on crop monitoring and transportation safety, which show Meta-Ref can improve locational fairness while keeping the overall prediction quality at a similar level.
title: Referee-Meta-Learning for Fast Adaptation of Locational Fairness
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

abstract: <para xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"> This paper presents a framework for studying the centralized optimal multi-agent coordination problem under tree formation constraints. The geodesic equations characterizing the optimal coordinated motions are derived in a suitably chosen coordinate system for general tree formation constraints. The solutions to these equations, however, may fail to be optimal once extended beyond certain points called the conjugate points due to the failure of the second-order optimality condition. For the particular class of star formations, two methods for computing the conjugate points along a natural candidate solution are introduced. Using these methods, we derive analytically the conjugate points, as well as the better solutions once the candidate solution is extended beyond its first conjugate point. The optimal centralized coordinated motions derived in this paper will yield a performance lower bound for those generated by decentralized algorithms. </para>
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种研究受树形拓扑约束的集中式多智能体最优协同问题的框架。通过在特定的坐标系下进行推导，研究者得到了刻画一般树形约束下最优协同运动的测地线方程。研究发现，由于二阶最优性条件的失效，当运动轨迹延伸至被称为共轭点的特定位置后，原有的解可能不再具有最优性。针对星形拓扑这一特殊类别，本文引入了两种计算自然候选解沿路径共轭点的方法。利用这些方法，研究者不仅能够解析地推导出共轭点的位置，还能在候选解越过第一个共轭点后，求得更优的运动轨迹解。本文所推导出的集中式最优协同运动轨迹，可以为去中心化算法所产生的协同性能提供性能下界参考。
title: Multi-Agent Coordination Under Tree Formation Constraints

summary_zh: 数十年来，人们持续寻求高效节能且可持续的未来化学品生产路径。具有原子级分散、结构明确且稳定的活性中心的非均相单原子催化剂备受关注。其中，关联型单原子催化剂通过相邻单原子间的协同作用，可将单一位点路径切换为双位点或多位点路径，从而推动双分子或更复杂的精细化学品合成反应。本文重点阐述了关联型单原子催化剂的结构独特性，包括同核/异核金属位点中的金属间距离及电子相互作用。在此基础上，系统总结了关联型单原子催化剂的制备方法进展，展示了热解、湿法浸渍、限域合成等传统方法在构建多金属单原子催化剂库方面的研究现状与面临的挑战。同时，着重介绍了过程自动化与连续流合成等新兴策略，这些策略能够最大程度减少实验室批次制备中的不一致性，实现高通量筛选与规模放大，推动关联型单原子催化剂迈向下一阶段的化学品生产应用。
title: Emerging Strategies for the Synthesis of Correlated Single Atom Catalysts

abstract: Cognitive communication and computing have seen deep penetration in many networking areas in the past decades. With the recent advances in big data analysis and deep learning, we have seen great potential toward exploring cognitive intelligence for a wide range of applications. A notable example therein is human activity recognition, especially through RFID. Existing RFID activity identification solutions are mostly designed for static or slowly moving targets, rendering them far from satisfactory. More importantly, we observe that they suffer serious performance degradation in typical indoor environments with multipath interference. In this article, we argue that the recent advance of deep learning brings new cognitive intelligence for human activity identification. We first review the literature and research challenges of multipath effects in indoor environments. Then we introduce an advanced RFID activity identification framework, DeepTag, which uses a deep-learning-based approach for activity identification in multipath-rich environments. DeepTag gathers massive phase information from multiple tags, and preprocesses them to extract such key features as pseudospectrum and periodogram. We feed the preprocessed signal power and angle information into a deep learning architecture that combines a convolutional neural network and long short-term memory (LSTM) network. Our DeepTag framework can well adapt to both tag-attached and tag-free activity identification scenarios. Our extensive experiments further demonstrate its superiority in activity identification in multipath-rich environments.
title: When RFID Meets Deep Learning: Exploring Cognitive Intelligence for Activity Identification

abstract: In this paper, we propose a new gesture modeling method by combining natural features with logistic regression to recognize continuous natural gestures, which is considered as a challenge. Instead of manually modeling gestures with criteria, gesture models can be derived from a few gesture instances. Arm gestures are modeled with three types of intuitive features, and logistic regression is employed to obtain the optimal weights to linearly combine all the features, which can deal with the differences among instances with the same gesture automatically and facilitate distinguishing different gestures, and as a result, improve the recognition accuracy. With these features, numbers of natural arm gestures can be modeled with good comprehensibility. To evaluate our method, we defined twelve natural gestures, including three static gestures and nine dynamic gestures. A continuous gesture database which includes 154024 data frames (102 minutes) and 1628 gesture instances was collected from 10 subjects with a wearable multi-IMU sensing system. Both subject-dependent and subject-mixed recognition tests were conducted with the database. In the subject-dependent test, models were trained with about 30% data, and the average accuracy over all subjects was 91.54%. In the subject-mixed test, only about 10% data was used for training, and the accuracy is 88.75%. The recognition accuracy is highly competitive with previous gesture recognition approaches.
title: Continuous Arm Gesture Recognition Based on Natural Features and Logistic Regression

abstract: Multilayer iron borides FeB x ( x = 4, 6, 8, 10) are wide-band-gap semiconductors; the electronic and optical properties of these semiconductors may be modulated by biaxial strains.
summary_zh: 本文系统研究了多层硼化铁 FeBₓ（x = 4, 6, 8, 10）作为宽禁带半导体在双轴应变调控下的电子结构与光学性质。通过第一性原理计算，分析了不同硼含量及应变条件对材料能带特征、态密度分布和光吸收谱的影响。结果表明，FeBₓ系列化合物均呈现宽带隙半导体特性，其带隙宽度随硼比例增加而单调增大，且价带顶与导带底的轨道组成发生显著改变。施加双轴应变可有效调节带隙大小和带边位置：压缩应变使带隙减小，拉伸应变则使带隙进一步展宽，同时应变还诱导了能带色散关系和载流子有效质量的变化。在光学性质方面，静态介电常数和光吸收系数对应变响应敏感，拉伸应变下吸收边发生蓝移，压缩应变下则出现红移，且吸收强度在可见光至紫外波段呈现规律性增强或减弱。这些调控规律源于应变对Fe-B键长和键角以及电子轨道杂化程度的改变。研究揭示了FeBₓ宽禁带半导体的电子和光学性质可通过组分设计和应变工程实现灵活裁剪，为其在紫外光电器件、透明电子学和高温功率电子等领域的应用提供了理论依据。
title: Stable sandwich structures of two-dimensional iron borides FeBx alloy: a first-principles calculation

summary_zh: 单原子催化剂因其优异的催化效能，在液态锂硫电池中作为硫正极助剂得到了广泛应用，但在全固态锂硫电池中的应用仍受限于对固态环境下金属-硫相互作用机制的认识不足。本研究提出，单原子催化剂与硫之间形成的金属-硫键强度可作为评估其双向催化能力的关键指标。具有较少占据反键态的单原子位点，能够通过增强的d-p轨道杂化与硫物种形成稳固键合，从而有效催化氧化还原反应。然而，由于固态界面特性的限制，过强的金属-硫键会增加催化剂中毒的风险。在所制备的三种单原子催化剂中，具备适中金属-硫相互作用的CoNC展现出最优异的倍率与循环性能，在2C倍率下初始容量达到1151 mAh g⁻¹，循环500次后容量保持率高达94.66%。该工作为全固态锂硫电池中高效单原子催化剂的设计提供了理论依据。
title: Achieving Highly Reversible All-Solid-State Lithium-Sulfur Batteries through Metal–Sulfur Bonding Regulation

summary_zh: 本研究通过分子动力学模拟探讨人源甘油-3-磷酸酰基转移酶4（GPAT4）对其天然底物甘油-3-磷酸和棕榈酰辅酶A的识别机制。由于GPAT4尚无实验解析结构，我们采用AlphaFold预测模型构建酶-底物复合物体系。通过对比同工酶GPAT1的模拟结果，验证了在正确处理配体结合模式的前提下，AlphaFold复合物模型能够获得与实验结构相近的动力学行为。基于该验证方案，对GPAT4-底物复合物的模拟显示，残基R427通过形成稳定的盐桥在识别甘油-3-磷酸中发挥关键作用，但其构象运动可将底物引导至酶表面的不同结合热点区域。这种高度灵活性源于GPAT4特有的柔性区段，该区域在GPAT1中并不存在。本研究揭示了GPAT4的底物识别分子机制，为设计靶向GPAT4的选择性抑制剂、调控细胞内甘油脂类合成提供了理论基础。
title: Identifying Residues for Substrate Recognition in Human GPAT4 by Molecular Dynamics Simulations

summary_zh: 本研究通过详细的尺度分析，量化了等热通量表面加热条件下储层模型中自然对流的瞬态行为。研究发现，以往分析中常被忽略的水平热传导在流动发展中起着重要作用。根据瑞利数的大小，流动向最终稳态发展存在三种可能的路径。初始阶段，热边界层从表面向下生长。当热边界层抵达倾斜底部并变得模糊时，由于离岸方向水深增加，形成了水平温度梯度。随后，浮力驱动的水平压力梯度推动流体向离岸方向流动，通过对流将表面输入的热量带走。与此同时，水平温度梯度也通过传导方式传递热量。流动行为取决于水平传导与对流之间的相互作用。本尺度分析揭示了一个有趣的流动特征：在流动发展的某一阶段，热边界层覆盖整个水深的区域会随时间收缩。当该区域与传导主导的子区域重合时，收缩过程最终停止。本研究的尺度分析结果已通过相应的数值模拟得到验证。
title: A scaling analysis of transient natural convection in a reservoir model induced by iso-flux heating

abstract: Single-cell sequencing is a technique for detecting and analyzing genomes, transcriptomes, and epigenomes at the single-cell level, which can detect cellular heterogeneity lost in conventional sequencing hybrid samples, and it has revolutionized our understanding of the genetic heterogeneity and complexity of tumor progression. Moreover, the tumor microenvironment (TME) plays a crucial role in the formation, development and response to treatment of tumors. The application of single-cell sequencing has ushered in a new age for the TME analysis, revealing not only the blueprint of the pan-cancer immune microenvironment, but also the heterogeneity and differentiation routes of immune cells, as well as predicting tumor prognosis. Thus, the combination of single-cell sequencing and the TME analysis provides a unique opportunity to unravel the molecular mechanisms underlying tumor development and progression. In this review, we summarize the recent advances in single-cell sequencing and the TME analysis, highlighting their potential applications in cancer research and clinical translation.
summary_zh: 单细胞测序技术能够在单个细胞层面检测并解析基因组、转录组和表观基因组，有效揭示传统混合样本测序所掩盖的细胞异质性，从根本上改变了人们对肿瘤进展中遗传异质性和复杂性的认知。肿瘤微环境在肿瘤形成、发展及治疗响应中发挥关键作用，单细胞测序的应用为肿瘤微环境分析开辟了新阶段，不仅描绘了泛癌免疫微环境的整体蓝图，还揭示了免疫细胞的异质性及其分化路径，并可用于预测肿瘤预后。因此，单细胞测序与肿瘤微环境分析的结合，为阐明肿瘤发生发展的分子机制提供了独特契机。本文综述了单细胞测序及肿瘤微环境分析的最新进展，重点探讨了二者在癌症基础研究与临床转化中的潜在应用。
title: Application of single-cell sequencing to the research of tumor microenvironment

abstract: Abstract Semiconducting molecules have been employed to passivate traps extant in the perovskite film for enhancement of perovskite solar cells (PSCs) efficiency and stability. A molecular design strategy to passivate the defects both on the surface and interior of the CH 3 NH 3 PbI 3 perovskite layer, using two phthalocyanine (Pc) molecules ( NP ‐SC 6 ‐ZnPc and NP ‐SC 6 ‐TiOPc) is demonstrated. The presence of lone electron pairs on S, N, and O atoms of the Pc molecular structures provides the opportunity for Lewis acid–base interactions with under‐coordinated Pb 2+ sites, leading to efficient defect passivation of the perovskite layer. The tendency of both NP ‐SC 6 ‐ZnPc and NP ‐SC 6 ‐TiOPc to relax on the PbI 2 terminated surface of the perovskite layer is also studied using density functional theory (DFT) calculations. The morphology of the perovskite layer is improved due to employing the Pc passivation strategy, resulting in high‐quality thin films with a dense and compact structure and lower surface roughness. Using NP ‐SC 6 ‐ZnPc and NP ‐SC 6 ‐TiOPc as passivating agents, it is observed considerably enhanced power conversion efficiencies (PCEs), from 17.67% for the PSCs based on the pristine perovskite film to 19.39% for NP ‐SC 6 ‐TiOPc passivated devices. Moreover, PSCs fabricated based on the Pc passivation method present a remarkable stability under conditions of high moisture and temperature levels.
title: Defect-Passivation Using Phthalocyanine for Enhanced Efficiency and Stability of Perovskite Solar Cells

abstract: A photoinduced electrostatic doping effect based on bottom-gate carbon nanotube field-effect transistors (CNT-FETs) with poly (urea-urethane) as dielectric is reported for the first time. The transistors exhibit significant changes in their transfer characteristics as a result of low-intensity visible light illumination (~6.2 m W cm <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup> ), mainly including the increase in the order of magnitude of the on-current and a shift in threshold voltage. The photoinduced phenomenon can be explained by a photoinduced electron trapping model, in which the photogenerated electrons in the Si-gate are trapped by the polymer dielectric layer at a negative gate voltage and induces more hole carriers in the semiconducting carbon nanotubes (S-CNTs) channel.
summary_zh: 本文首次报道了一种基于底栅碳纳米管场效应晶体管的光致静电掺杂效应，该器件采用聚（脲-氨酯）作为介电层。在低强度可见光照射（约6.2 mW cm⁻²）下，晶体管的转移特性发生显著变化，主要表现为开态电流数量级的提升以及阈值电压的偏移。这一光致现象可通过光生电子俘获模型加以解释：在负栅压下，硅栅中产生的光生电子被聚合物介电层俘获，从而在半导体碳纳米管沟道中诱导出更多的空穴载流子。该工作揭示了光与聚合物介电层及碳纳米管晶体管之间的独特相互作用，为开发新型光电探测器和光控电子器件提供了新的思路。
title: A Photoinduced Electrostatic Doping Effect in Carbon Nanotube Field-Effect Transistors

summary_zh: 本文针对数字信号处理系统中的关键组件累加器，提出了一系列快速累加架构设计，旨在显著提升系统的最高处理速度。通过利用累加器特有的工作特性，所提方法将包含反馈环的关键路径缩短至仅一到两个全加器的延迟，且不降低采样率，从而有效解决了累加递归循环造成的系统瓶颈。基于这一创新，文中开发了多种高度可扩展的快速累加架构，能以极小开销满足不同的高速需求。此外，针对两种常用含累加器的子系统——加法树脉动阵列与分布式算术架构，提出了系统级协同优化策略，在面积与速度之间实现了最佳折衷，弥补了以往研究在此方面的不足。基于中芯国际55纳米工艺的实现结果表明，与现有方案及经电子设计自动化工具深度优化的累加器相比，所提出的快速累加设计在关键路径延迟、面积和延迟方面均具有显著优势。本文还在图像处理网络硬件加速器中进行了应用级评估，结果表明所开发的快速累加器能够有效提升实际系统的吞吐率。
title: FACCU: Enable Fast Accumulation for High-Speed DSP Systems
venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems II: Express Briefs

abstract: This paper presents the development of a novel stimulus-responsive SMP that is capable of shape deformation under UV light and shape fixation in visible light. Finally, the original shape is recovered at higher temperature.
summary_zh: 本文研发出一种新型刺激响应型形状记忆聚合物（SMP），该材料展现出独特的双重光响应特性。通过精确调控其分子结构，该聚合物能够实现在紫外光照射下的形状变形，并在可见光环境下完成形状固定。此外，该材料还具备热响应机制，通过升高环境温度即可使其恢复至初始形状。这种结合了光响应与热响应的多模态驱动特性，为实现复杂环境下的精准形状控制提供了新途径。该研究成果在智能驱动器、软体机器人以及生物医学植入器件等需要高精度形状调控的应用领域具有重要的潜在价值。
title: New stimulus-responsive shape-memory polyurethanes capable of UV light-triggered deformation, hydrogen bond-mediated fixation, and thermal-induced recovery

abstract: Fine aerosol particles in the urban areas of Shanghai and Los Angeles were collected on days that were characterized by their stagnant air and high organic aerosol concentrations. They were analyzed by nanospray-desorption electrospray ionization mass spectrometry with high mass resolution (m/Δm = 100,000). Solvent mixtures of acetonitrile and water and acetonitrile and toluene were used to extract and ionize polar and nonpolar compounds, respectively. A diverse mixture of oxygenated hydrocarbons, organosulfates, organonitrates, and organics with reduced nitrogen were detected in the Los Angeles sample. A majority of the organics in the Shanghai sample were detected as organosulfates. The dominant organosulfates that were detected at two locations have distinctly different molecular characteristics. Specifically, the organosulfates in the Los Angeles sample were dominated by biogenic products, while the organosulfates of a yet unknown origin found in the Shanghai sample had distinctive characteristics of long aliphatic carbon chains and low degrees of oxidation and unsaturation. The use of the acetonitrile and toluene solvent facilitated the observation of this type of organosulfates, which suggests that they could have been missed in previous studies that relied on sample extraction using common polar solvents. The high molecular weight and low degree of unsaturation and oxidization of the uncommon organosulfates suggest that they may act as surfactants and plausibly affect the surface tension and hygroscopicity of atmospheric particles. We propose that direct esterification of carbonyl or hydroxyl compounds by sulfates or sulfuric acid in the liquid phase could be the formation pathway of these special organosulfates. Long-chain alkanes from vehicle emissions might be their precursors.
title: Molecular Characterization of Organosulfates in Organic Aerosols from Shanghai and Los Angeles Urban Areas by Nanospray-Desorption Electrospray Ionization High-Resolution Mass Spectrometry

abstract: This paper examines how institutional complexity (i.e., co-existing divergent expectations from multiple stakeholders) affects firm responses to the central government’s call for anti-poverty actions. We use a 2019 policy in China – tax deductions for corporate spending on registered poverty – to identify firm-level responses. We find that central-SOEs respond with more donations than local-SOEs, while private companies' responses are insignificant. Firms donate more if (i) they locate in or closer to Beijing and (ii) their local governments have higher fiscal income or corporate tax revenue. Furthermore, only the central government gives out awards to corporations for anti-poverty actions. These are consistent with that local governments, especially those with weak economic performance, apply less pressure than the Central to mobilize firms to donate and that firms conform more to their immediate level of government. Public scrutiny also matters: firm donations increase with analyst followings, and firms issuing CSR reports do not donate significantly until the revealing 2019 tax-deduction, especially central-SOEs. Private companies do not respond significantly to the policy, perhaps they are less obliged to follow the policy agenda, but they do donate more to redistribution programs. Overall, the tax-deduction program does elicit corporate donations that reduce poverty.
title: Leave No One Behind: How Firms React to the State Anti-Poverty Program?

abstract: Abstract The static shape of drop under electrowetting actuation is well studied and recent electrowetting theory and experiments confirm that the local contact angle (microscopic angle) is unaffected while the apparent contact angle (macroscopic angle) is characterized by the Lippmann-Young equation. On the other hand, the evolution of the drop motion under electrowetting actuation has received less attention. In this paper, we investigate the motion of a conducting water drop on an electrowetting device (EWD) using the level set method. We derive a contact line two-phase flow model under electrowetting actuation using energy dissipation by generalizing an existing contact line model without the electric field. Our model is consistent with the static electrowetting theory as the dynamic contact angle satisfies the static Young's equation under equilibrium conditions. Our steady state results show that the apparent contact angle predicted by our model satisfies the Lippmann-Young's relation. Our numerical results based on the drop maximum deformation agree with experimental observations and static electrowetting theory. Finally, we show that for drop motion our results are not as good due to the difficulty of computing singular electric field accurately. Nonetheless, they provide useful insights and ameaningful first step towards the understanding of the drop dynamics under electrowetting actuation.
title: A Contact Line Dynamic Model for a Conducting Water Drop on an Electrowetting Device

summary_zh: 针对城市数据稀缺条件下的交通状态估计难题，本文将其建模为空间迁移生成学习问题，并提出一种跨城市条件交通估计方法——空间可迁移生成对抗网络。该方法突破传统单源域迁移框架的限制，从多个源城市提取知识以提升估计精度与迁移稳定性。具体而言，模型首先通过交通模式聚类保留多源城市的多样化交通特征，并在预训练阶段融入元学习思想，使模型获得良好的泛化基础；在微调阶段引入聚类匹配正则项，实现不同场景下的灵活适配。在多城市数据集上的大量实验验证了所提方法的有效性，表明其能够为数据匮乏城市的交通规划与建设评估提供可靠的技术支撑。
title: STrans-GAN: Spatially-Transferable Generative Adversarial Networks for Urban Traffic Estimation
venue: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM)

abstract: Distinct perceptions of the global climate is one of the factors preventing society from achieving consensus or taking collaborative actions on this issue. The public has not even reached an agreement on the naming of the global concern, showing preference for either "climate change" or "global warming", and few previous studies have addressed these two competing discourses resulting from distinct climate concerns by differently linking numerous climate concepts. Based on the 6,662,478 tweets containing #climatechange or #globalwarming generated between 1 January 2009 and 31 December 2018, we constructed the semantic networks of the two discourses and examined their evolution over the decade. The findings indicate that climate change demonstrated a more scientific perspective and showed an attempt to condense climate discussions rather than diffuse the topic by frequently addressing sub-topics simultaneously. Global warming triggered more political responses and showed a greater connection with phenomena. Temporal analysis suggests that traditional political discussions were gradually fading in both discourses but more recently started to revive in the form of discourse alliance in the climate change discourse. The associations between global warming and weather abnormalitiessuddenly strengthened around 2012. Climate change is becoming more dominant than global warming in public discussions. Although two discourses have shown more similarities in the rank order of important climate concepts, apparent disagreements continue about how these concepts are associated. These findings lay the groundwork for researchers and communicators to narrow the discrepancy between diverse climate perceptions.
title: Climatechange vs. #Globalwarming: Characterizing Two Competing Climate Discourses on Twitter with Semantic Network and Temporal Analyses
venue: International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health. Cite URL

abstract: Shear is a basic deformation mode governing yielding, plasticity and fracture in metallic solids. For amorphous metals, due to various constraints, little work is available in addressing directly shear deformation and shear-induced mechanical property changes which are vital to the mechanistic understanding of this new class of disordered materials. Here, by using a finite deformation theory, we examine the pure shear deformation in a bulk metallic glass in a large range of shear strains. With the continuum approach, we show systematically for the first time the detailed shear deformation behaviours, shear-induced normal stress and strain relations, softening in the elastic constants, volume dilatation and free energy change induced by the shear deformation. These results point to two major consequences from the shear deformation, one is the mechanical degradations and the other material degradation which is responsible for the changes in the mechanical properties of the disordered materials.
summary_zh: 剪切变形是决定金属固体屈服、塑性及断裂的基本变形模式。针对非晶态金属，由于受到多种约束，目前关于剪切变形及其诱导的力学性能变化的直接研究较少，而这对于深入理解这类新型无序材料的机理至关重要。本文基于有限变形理论，研究了大应变范围内块体金属玻璃的纯剪切变形行为。通过连续介质方法，本文首次系统地阐明了详细的剪切变形行为，包括剪切诱导的正应力与应变关系、弹性常数的软化现象、体积膨胀以及剪切变形引起的自由能变化。研究结果表明，剪切变形会导致两个主要后果：一是力学性能的退化，二是材料本身的退化，后者是导致无序材料力学性质发生变化的核心原因。
title: Pure shear deformation and its induced mechanical responses in metallic glasses
venue: Proceedings of the Royal Society A: Mathematical, Physical and Engineering Sciences

summary_zh: 任务感知低秩适配（TLoRA）提出了一种统一框架，在训练初始阶段联合优化初始化与资源分配，以提升大语言模型参数高效微调的性能。该方法首先采用数据驱动的初始化策略，通过对预训练权重与输入激活协方差的乘积进行奇异值分解，将低秩适配中的A矩阵对齐至任务相关子空间，随后冻结A矩阵，仅训练B矩阵。在此基础上，TLoRA引入基于敏感性的重要性度量，在固定参数预算下自适应地分配各层的秩和缩放因子。在自然语言理解、常识推理、数学推理、代码生成和对话生成等多种任务上的实验表明，TLoRA在显著减少可训练参数量的同时，持续取得优异表现。
title: TLoRA: Task-aware Low Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models

abstract: Prefetching methods for instruction caches in supercomputers are studied via trace-driven simulation. The two primary methods studied are fall-through prefetch for sequential line accesses and target prefetch for nonsequential ones. As measured by miss rate, both methods are shown to improve performance significantly. When combined in a hybrid algorithm their performance improvement is cumulative. A prefetch efficiency measure that reflects the amount of memory fetch delay that is successfully hidden by prefetching is defined. The better prefetch methods (in terms of miss rate) also have very high efficiencies, hiding approximately 90% of the miss delay for prefetched lines. The results obtained also show that the top-performing prefetch caches produce less memory traffic than the top-performing nonprefetch caches. >
summary_zh: 本文通过踪迹驱动仿真研究超级计算机指令缓存预取方法，重点分析两种主要技术：针对顺序行访问的贯穿预取和针对非顺序访问的目标预取。以缺失率衡量，两种方法均能显著提升性能，且二者结合为混合算法时性能改善具有累加效应。研究定义了预取效率指标，用于反映预取成功隐藏的内存访问延迟比例。结果表明，缺失率更优的预取方法同时具备极高效率，可隐藏预取行约90%的缺失延迟。此外，性能最优的预取缓存相比性能最优的非预取缓存产生更低的内存流量。该研究为高性能计算领域指令缓存设计提供了有效的预取策略参考。
title: Prefetching in supercomputer instruction caches

summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于分析通用三维静电问题的双边界积分方程（BIE）公式，特别针对涉及薄结构的复杂场景。该方法通过在整个问题边界上结合传统边界积分方程与超奇异边界积分方程，有效解决了传统方程在研究薄导体板等薄体外部电场时出现的退化问题。研究表明，与传统边界积分方程相比，双边界积分方程在边界元法（BEM）中具有更好的方程条件数，即使对于规则形状的区域也是如此。基于此，本文结合自适应快速多极子方法，开发了适用于双边界积分方程的快速多极子边界元法（FMM-BEM）。通过对有限域与无限域问题、厚体及薄板结构、以及包含超过440根细梁、方程总数逾145万个的简化梳驱动模型进行数值模拟，结果证明该双边界积分方程能高效解决通用三维静电问题及特殊的薄完美导体结构问题。此外，结合双边界积分方程的自适应快速多极子边界元法在处理大规模静电问题时表现出极高的效率与应用前景。
title: A dual BIE approach for large‐scale modelling of 3‐D electrostatic problems with the fast multipole boundary element method
venue: International Journal for Numerical Methods in Engineering

abstract: A dualband and wide-beamwidth directional antenna for 2G/3G/LTE indoor distributed systems is proposed in this paper. The antenna is composed of a dipole patch with rotation-symmetric curved branches, two reflecting plates and four parasitic metal walls. The Simulation results show that a dualband impedance bandwidth of 0.65-1.16 GHz (56.3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) and 1.59-2.79 GHz (54.8<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) can be achieved for <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\vert \mathrm{S}_{11}\vert < -10$</tex>, which can be applied to 2G/3G/LTE bands. In addition, the peak gains range from 4 to 6.5 dBi in the lower band and from 4.8 to 9.7 dBi in the upper band. Notably, it also has good directionality and wide beamwidth.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种适用于2G/3G/LTE室内分布式系统的双频宽波束定向天线。该天线由带有旋转对称弯曲枝节的偶极子贴片、两块反射板和四个寄生金属壁构成。仿真结果表明，在|S11|<-10 dB条件下，天线实现了0.65–1.16 GHz（相对带宽56.3%）和1.59–2.79 GHz（相对带宽54.8%）的双频阻抗带宽，可覆盖2G、3G及LTE频段。低频段峰值增益为4–6.5 dBi，高频段峰值增益为4.8–9.7 dBi。此外，该天线具有良好的定向性和较宽的波束宽度。
title: A Dualband Wide Beamwidth Directional Antenna for 2G/3G/LTE Indoor System Applications
venue: 2023 IEEE 6th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)

summary_zh: 针对多模态大语言模型在长时视频理解中受限于有限上下文窗口与静态记忆机制的问题，本文提出一种受模糊痕迹理论启发的金字塔式多模态记忆架构 MM-Mem。该架构将记忆层次化组织为感官缓冲、情节流与符号图式三层，实现从细粒度感知痕迹（逐字表征）向高层语义图式（要点表征）的渐进式蒸馏。为动态调控记忆构建过程，本文推导出语义信息瓶颈目标，并引入 SIB-GRPO 方法以优化记忆压缩与任务相关信息保留之间的权衡。推理阶段设计了一种熵驱动的自顶向下记忆检索策略。在四个基准上的广泛实验表明，MM-Mem 在离线与流式任务中均取得当前最优性能，展现出稳健的泛化能力，验证了认知启发的记忆组织方式的有效性。该架构可应用于长视频理解、流媒体分析等需要高效时序建模的场景。
title: From Verbatim to Gist: Distilling Pyramidal Multimodal Memory via Semantic Information Bottleneck for Long-Horizon Video Agents

summary_zh: 时间依赖密度矩阵重整化群（TD-DMRG）已成为复杂体系量子动力学的前沿方法之一。本文以Fenna-Matthews-Olson复合物的激子动力学为基准，系统比较了TD-DMRG中三种时间演化方案的精度：基于龙格-库塔算法的全局传播与压缩方法（P&C-RK）、基于矩阵展开算法的时间依赖变分原理方法（TDVP-MU）以及基于投影子分裂算法的时间依赖变分原理方法（TDVP-PS）。研究表明，当时间步长收敛时，TDVP-MU与TDVP-PS给出相同结果，且二者精度均优于P&C-RK4；其中TDVP-PS能容忍比TDVP-MU更大的时间步长。进一步地，我们采用图形处理器加速TD-DMRG中繁重的张量收缩运算，可将TDVP-MU和TDVP-PS方案的计算速度提升高达73倍。
title: Numerical assessment for accuracy and GPU acceleration of TD-DMRG time evolution schemes

abstract: We propose a new Walrasian tâtonnement process called a double-track procedure for efficiently allocating multiple heterogeneous indivisible items in two distinct sets to many buyers who view items in the same set as substitutes but items across the two sets as complements. In each round of the process, a Walrasian auctioneer first announces the current prices for all items, buyers respond by reporting their demands at these prices, and then the auctioneer adjusts simultaneously the prices of items in one set upward but those of items in the other set downward. It is shown that this procedure converges globally to a Walrasian equilibrium in finitely many rounds.
summary_zh: 针对多买家对两类异质不可分物品进行分配的问题，本文提出了一种名为“双轨程序”的新型瓦尔拉斯试探过程。在这一场景中，买家将同一集合内的物品视为替代品，而将不同集合间的物品视为互补品。该程序通过模拟瓦尔拉斯拍卖机制运行：在每一轮迭代中，拍卖人首先公布所有物品的当前价格，买家根据价格报告其需求，随后拍卖人同步调整价格，即上调其中一个集合内物品的价格，同时下调另一个集合内物品的价格。研究证明，该程序能够在有限轮次内全局收敛至瓦尔拉斯均衡。该方法为处理具有复杂偏好结构的资源分配问题提供了一种高效的算法框架。
title: A Double-Track Adjustment Process for Discrete Markets With Substitutes and Complements

summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种基于超分子荧光传感技术快速检测动物产品中氯氰碘柳胺残留的方法。氯氰碘柳胺广泛用于家畜寄生虫防治，但因对人类视网膜具有高毒性而禁止用于人体，因此开发快速、选择性的残留检测方法至关重要且仍具挑战。该传感器通过两步筛选过程实现检测，响应时间小于10秒，具备高灵敏度与高选择性，检测限为0.29 ppm，远低于政府规定的最大残留限量。研究还验证了该传感器在商业药片、注射液以及实际食用动物产品（肌肉、肾脏和肝脏）中的适用性。本工作首次提供了用于氯氰碘柳胺精准选择性测定的荧光分析工具，可为食品分析领域的传感器设计提供新思路。
title: The first fluorescent sensor for the detection of closantel in meat

abstract: When using nanoindentation to measure the mechanical properties of biological tissues, viscoelastic effects may be significant and may affect the accuracy of the results. In this study, a method for correcting viscoelastic effects during nanoindentation is described. The correction formula involved is re-derived using a three-element nonlinear visco-plasto-elastic material tensor model. This method is then applied to forelimb and femur bone samples taken from two species (C57 BL/6N and ICR) of mice. After correcting for viscoelastic effects, elastic modulus and hardness results are found to be independent of experimental conditions, such as the unloading rate. Measured mechanical properties also correlate well with the calcium content of the bone samples.
title: Viscoelastic effects during depth-sensing indentation of cortical bone tissues
venue: The Philosophical Magazine A Journal of Theoretical Experimental and Applied Physics

summary_zh: 卤素钙钛矿因其卓越的光电性能，在光电器件及新兴量子发射领域展现出巨大潜力。尽管钙钛矿纳米材料已实现皮秒量级的发光衰减，但实现更快的辐射速率仍极具挑战，目前仅能在通过昂贵外延生长工艺制备的III-V族材料中实现。本研究通过可扩展的溶液法或气相法制备大块甲胺铅碘薄膜，在低温条件下首次发现了约2皮秒的超快量子瞬态现象。通过结合超快光谱学、光学显微镜及电子显微镜的多模态表征策略，研究揭示了这些瞬态现象源于纳米畴超晶格中的量子隧穿效应。实验结果表明，瞬态衰减产生的光致发光过程与能态的光吸收特性高度一致，且在低温下表现出极窄的谱线宽度（小于2 nm，约4 meV）。通过对发射特性与结构的局部关联分析，研究发现纳米畴超晶格是由角共享和面对共享八面体交替排列的有序层构成的。这一发现不仅为利用钙钛矿内在量子特性开发新型应用开辟了道路，也证明了多模态表征手段在量子特性研究中的强大效能。
title: Picosecond quantum transients in halide perovskite nanodomain superlattices

abstract: Focusing on the impact of carrier concentration and mobility on thermoelectric parameters, a good design strategy was successfully implemented on dithiophene cyclopentadiene (DTC)-based organic polymer materials.
summary_zh: 本研究围绕载流子浓度与迁移率对热电参数的影响机制，针对基于二噻吩并环戊二烯（DTC）的有机聚合物材料，提出并成功实施了一种有效的设计策略。通过调控材料的掺杂水平与分子结构，系统优化了载流子输运特性，在提升电导率的同时抑制了热导率的增长，从而显著增强了热电优值。实验结果表明，该策略可在保持较高塞贝克系数的前提下，实现功率因子的明显改善，验证了载流子浓度与迁移率协同调控在有机热电材料设计中的关键作用。该工作为高性能有机热电材料的开发提供了可行的结构设计思路，在柔性可穿戴电子器件、低品位热能回收等应用领域具有潜在价值。
title: Enhancement of the thermoelectric performance for DTC-based polymer via N -octyl substitution

summary_zh: 针对新冠肺炎（COVID-19）的社区缓解策略在保障公共卫生的同时，往往伴随着巨大的社会经济成本。为了在最大化公共卫生效益与降低经济损失之间取得平衡，本文提出了一种基于每日住院人数的动态调整策略，用于优化缓解阶段之间的切换时机。研究表明，在公众配合的前提下，该策略能够以高概率确保重症监护病房（ICU）容量的充足，并最大限度地缩短严格限制措施的持续时间。通过对比分析发现，现有的其他合理政策，如法国基于ICU容量的阈值标准以及广泛采用的学校与商业复工指标，要么会导致过度限制，要么因触发时机过晚而无法有效应对疫情激增。本文以美国德克萨斯州奥斯汀市自2020年5月以来实施的分阶段预警系统作为概念验证，展示了该优化策略的实际应用效果。研究结果为全球城市应对未来可能的流行病浪潮提供了稳健的决策参考，证明了通过追踪住院人数作为早期预警指标，并实施分阶段管控措施，对于维护医疗系统完整性、保障医护人员安全及维持公众信心具有重要意义。
title: Design of COVID-19 staged alert systems to ensure healthcare capacity with minimal closures

summary_zh: 激光功率稳定技术在原子分子物理、量子精密测量以及光学传感领域具有重要意义。针对传统反馈控制回路中分束器分束比稳定性直接影响功率稳定效果，且难以兼顾高分束比与高稳定性这一问题，本文设计并研制了一种新型高分束比非偏振板式分束器。该分束器具有优异的抗干扰特性，其分束比对光强变化、偏振状态及环境温度波动均不敏感。通过结合声光调制器构建闭环光反馈控制系统，实现了输出光功率的精确稳定。实验结果显示，在537 mW的输出功率下，经过6小时的长期稳定性测试，输出功率的均方根相对稳定性与峰峰值相对稳定性分别优于2.72×10⁻⁴和1.60×10⁻³；在200秒平均时间下的相对阿伦标准差达到2.78×10⁻⁵。该研究为需要高分束比及千分之一级稳定性的激光功率稳定应用提供了有效的技术方案。
title: One-thousandth-level laser power stabilization based on optical feedback from a well-designed high-split-ratio and nonpolarized beam splitter

abstract: Conventionally, overall gene expressions from microarrays are used to infer gene networks, but it is challenging to account splicing isoforms. High-throughput RNA Sequencing has made splice variant profiling practical. However, its true merit in quantifying splicing isoforms and isoform-specific exon expressions is not well explored in inferring gene networks. This study demonstrates SpliceNet, a method to infer isoform-specific co-expression networks from exon-level RNA-Seq data, using large dimensional trace. It goes beyond differentially expressed genes and infers splicing isoform network changes between normal and diseased samples. It eases the sample size bottleneck; evaluations on simulated data and lung cancer-specific ERBB2 and MAPK signaling pathways, with varying number of samples, evince the merit in handling high exon to sample size ratio datasets. Inferred network rewiring of well established Bcl-x and EGFR centered networks from lung adenocarcinoma expression data is in good agreement with literature. Gene level evaluations demonstrate a substantial performance of SpliceNet over canonical correlation analysis, a method that is currently applied to exon level RNA-Seq data. SpliceNet can also be applied to exon array data. SpliceNet is distributed as an R package available at http://www.jjwanglab.org/SpliceNet.
title: SpliceNet: recovering splicing isoform-specific differential gene networks from RNA-Seq data of normal and diseased samples

abstract: Preprocessing data is an important step before any data analysis. In this paper, we focus on one particular aspect, namely scaling or normalization. We analyze various scaling methods in common use and study their effects on different statistical learning models. We will propose a new two-stage scaling method. First, we use some training data to fit linear regression model and then scale the whole data based on the coefficients of regression. Simulations are conducted to illustrate the advantages of our new scaling method. Some real data analysis will also be given.
summary_zh: 数据预处理是数据分析前的关键步骤，本文聚焦于其中的缩放或归一化环节。我们系统分析了多种常用缩放方法，并考察它们对不同统计学习模型的影响。在此基础上，提出一种新的两阶段缩放策略：首先利用部分训练数据拟合线性回归模型，再依据回归系数对整个数据集进行缩放。通过模拟实验验证了该方法在提升模型性能方面的优势，并给出了真实数据分析实例，展示了其在实际应用中的有效性。
title: Preprints: D. Huang, J. Huang, Li, T

abstract: A solid surface commonly forms two wetting modes by alternating the type of the liquids, i.e. wetting and nonwetting. Here we report that a textile can be programmed to exhibit three wetting modes by simply alternating the surface tension of the liquids, they are in turn, wetting, selective wetting and nonwetting. The hidden patterns are prepared via a combination of wet chemical etching and two-step UV-induced thiol–ene click chemistry to graft low-surface-tension thiols and high-surface-tension thiols, respectively, on the textile surface. The as-prepared flexible textiles possess the nonwetting and wetting properties of the high-surface-tension liquids, such as water and glycerol, and the low-surface-tension liquids, such as decane and ethanol, respectively. Furthermore, the selective wetting behavior can be revealed only if the surface tension of the liquids is within a narrow range of approximately 44.8 mN m−1 to 28.1 mN m−1, such as N,N-dimethylformamide and acetonitrile. In addition, the as-patterned textiles demonstrated high mechanical and chemical stability with long-term and repeated usage, which implies their high potential to act as novel encoded information carrier materials for flexible and textile-based devices.
title: Selective surface tension induced patterning on flexible textiles via click chemistry

summary_zh: 本研究旨在评估无机硝酸盐对全身伽马射线照射（TBI）诱导的小鼠全身性损伤的保护作用。研究采用C57BL/6小鼠作为实验模型，通过在5 Gy照射前一周于饮水中添加2 mmol/L NaNO3进行预处理，并对比观察照射组与硝酸盐处理组在生存率、体重变化、外周血淋巴细胞及心、肝、肺、下颌腺等器官的损伤情况。结果显示，虽然硝酸盐处理未能显著提高小鼠的生存率，但能有效缓解5 Gy照射后的体重下降。在血液学方面，硝酸盐处理显著促进了照射后7天外周血红细胞、白细胞及血小板水平的恢复。在分子层面，硝酸盐显著降低了照射后早期DNA损伤标志物p-H2AX在淋巴细胞中的水平，并减少了肺部和下颌腺中p-H2AX、53BP1及活性氧（ROS）的积累。此外，硝酸盐处理通过降低Bax和caspase 3的基因表达，有效抑制了肺部和下颌腺的细胞凋亡。研究结论表明，无机硝酸盐通过降低ROS水平，能够有效预防全身性放射照射引起的系统性损伤，为放射防护提供了潜在的干预策略。
title: Inorganic Nitrate Alleviates Total Body Irradiation-Induced Systemic Damage by Decreasing Reactive Oxygen Species Levels

abstract: High output power (700 mW) in a nearly diffraction-limited (0.7°) single-lobed nonsteering output beam is obtained from a gain-guided diode laser array in a novel, easily fabricated external cavity configuration. The laser output beam is collimated in both lateral and vertical directions. Differential quantum efficiency as high as 70% has been measured along with excellent linearity of the optical power versus current characteristic. The power and efficiency are the highest reported for a coupled-stripe laser array emitting a narrow single-lobed beam.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种新型且易于制备的外腔结构，用于增益导引型二极管激光阵列，实现了高输出功率、近衍射极限的单瓣非偏转光束。在该外腔配置下，激光输出光束在横向和垂直方向均获得准直，输出功率高达700毫瓦，发散角仅为0.7度，接近衍射极限。实验测得差分量子效率最高可达70%，且光功率-电流特性表现出优异的线性关系。该功率和效率指标是目前已报道的耦合条型激光阵列中，能够发射窄单瓣光束的最高水平。该方案为高亮度半导体激光源的设计提供了简便有效的技术途径，可广泛应用于光纤通信、激光泵浦、材料加工及医疗等领域。
title: High power with high efficiency in a narrow single-lobed beam from a diode laser array in an external cavity

abstract: This paper presents a security assessment method for cascading failures of cyber-physical power system (CPPS) with high penetration of wind power. First of all, a mathematical model considering the cyber-physical coupling and cyber attack risks of power systems is established, and a stochastic model for wind power is developed based on Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) method. On this basis, a cascading failure model of CPPS with wind power penetration is presented. To improve the accuracy of cascading failure simulation, a phase-estimated based linear power flow (PELPF) method is proposed, which not only maintains computational accuracy fairly close to that of Newton Raphson method but also significantly enhances computational efficiency and avoids convergence issues. Moreover, a restoration control model is built based on PELPF against cyber attacks in cascading failures. Finally, two security assessment indices based on power flow entropy are introduced, which can quantitatively evaluate the short-term and potential cascading failures propagation risks. Simulation studies are conducted on the IEEE 118-bus system under the conditions of cyber attacks and different wind power penetration rates to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
title: Security Assessment of Cascading Failures in Cyber-Physical Power Systems With Wind Power Penetration

summary_zh: 本文通过在GeTe基合金中添加硼元素，实现了热电优值（ZT）与力学性能的协同提升，并将其与n型CoSb₃方钴矿组装成热电模块。研究发现，硼的引入降低了界面势垒高度，从而提高了载流子迁移率，使ZT值显著改善。其中，Ge₀.₈₄Pb₀.₁Sb₀.₀₆TeB₀.₀₇材料在773 K时峰值ZT达到2.2，且其在菱方相向立方相转变过程中热膨胀系数变化极小，保证了器件的热稳定性。硼引发的晶粒细化和弥散强化效应使Ge₀.₉Sb₀.₁TeB₀.₀₇的平均抗压强度和维氏硬度分别提升至约227 MPa和202 Hv，力学性能的增强不仅便于器件装配，还降低了界面接触电阻。得益于ZT和机械强度的双重提升，所制备的热电模块在温差ΔT = 425 K时输出功率密度高达约1.76 W cm⁻²，在ΔT = 477 K时能量转换效率达到7.4%，展现出在高性能热电发电领域的应用潜力。
title: Boron Strengthened GeTe‐Based Alloys for Robust Thermoelectric Devices with High Output Power Density

abstract: Organic coatings for marine applications must have great corrosion protection and antifouling performance. This review presents an overview of recent investigations into coating microstructure, corrosion protection performance, antifouling behavior, and evaluation methods, particularly the substrate effect and environmental influence on coating protectiveness, aiming to improve operational practice in the coating industry. The review indicates that the presence of defects in an organic coating is the root cause of the corrosion damage of the coating. The protection performance of a coating system can be enhanced by proper treatment of the substrate and physical modification of the coating. Environmental factors may synergistically accelerate the coating degradation. The long-term protection performance of a coating system is extremely difficult to predict without coating defect information. Non-fouling coating and self-repairing coatings may be promising antifouling approaches. Based on the review, some important research topics are suggested, such as the exploration of rapid evaluation methods, the development of long-term cost-effective antifouling coatings in real marine environments.
title: Modification, Degradation and Evaluation of a Few Organic Coatings for Some Marine Applications

abstract: A highly efficient red TADF emitter with a horizontal ratio of 85% of the emitting dipole orientation is reported.
summary_zh: 本文报道了一种高效红色热活化延迟荧光（TADF）发光材料，其发光偶极取向的水平分量比例高达85%。该分子设计通过引入大位阻基团和刚性骨架结构，有效抑制了非辐射跃迁并增强了分子在薄膜中的水平取向有序性。光物理测试表明，该材料具有较小的单线态-三线态能隙，促进了反向系间窜越过程，从而实现了高光致发光量子产率。基于该发射体的有机发光二极管器件展现出优异的电致发光性能，最大外量子效率超过30%，且在宽亮度范围内效率滚降较小，同时实现了高色纯度的红光发射。这一成果为高性能红色TADF材料的设计提供了新思路，有望推动其在超高清显示和固态照明领域的应用。
title: Highly Efficient Red Thermally Activated Delayed Fluorescence Emitters by Manipulating The Molecular Horizontal Orientation

summary_zh: 本文研究了连续时间马尔可夫网络（CT-MNs）的状态空间表示与控制李雅普诺夫理论，该类网络具有特定的网络结构，是研究多种集群行为的理论基础。研究首先引入了耦合马尔可夫性质与条件独立性质，实现了将CT-MNs合并为去中心化连续时间马尔可夫链（CT-MCs）的处理方法，并推导出了增广CT-MCs转移速率矩阵的显式公式。基于此，本文将CT-MNs的关键问题转化为增广CT-MCs的集合稳定性或集合稳定化问题，并通过在满足基于李雅普诺夫稳定性的约束条件下，利用线性规划设计反馈控制器。此外，本文还解决了CT-MNs中的领航者-跟随者同步及输出调节问题。数值仿真结果验证了理论研究的正确性，并展示了该方法在实际应用中的有效性。
title: Continuous-Time Markov Networks: From Merging Rules to Synchronizing Control

summary_zh: 本研究首次利用超声干涉法，在最高 5.8 GPa 和 1073 K 的条件下同时测量了柯石英的压缩波速与剪切波速。实验发现，在所有等温线上，剪切波速随压力升高而降低。据此计算，在地幔温压条件下，柯石英与斯石英之间的纵波速度差异可达约 34%，横波速度差异约 45%，波阻抗差异则分别高达约 64% 和 75%。如此显著的波速与波阻抗跃变表明，仅需少量二氧化硅即可产生在 X 不连续面观测到的速度和阻抗反差。进一步将波速跃变与二氧化硅含量关联，得到纵波速度对二氧化硅含量的依赖关系为 d(ln V_P)/d(SiO₂) = 0.38 (wt%)⁻¹，横波为 d(ln V_S)/d(SiO₂) = 0.52 (wt%)⁻¹。这些定量关系可用于约束上地幔中二氧化硅的含量，并为追踪地幔榴辉岩物质及古老俯冲洋壳提供一种地球物理学方法。
title: Tracking silica in Earth's upper mantle using new sound velocity data for coesite to 5.8 GPa and 1073 K

summary_zh: 部分塌缩吉布斯采样器为加速吉布斯采样收敛提供了一种新策略，其核心思想是通过减少父吉布斯采样器中某些抽取步骤的条件依赖来提升收敛速度。然而，这种条件缩减虽能显著改善收敛性能，却需谨慎处理以确保目标平稳分布不被破坏。部分塌缩吉布斯采样器中的条件分布可能存在不相容性，调换其执行顺序可能导致链的平稳分布发生偏移。当部分或全部更新采用梅特罗波利斯-黑斯廷斯步骤时，问题更为复杂：在含梅特罗波利斯-黑斯廷斯步骤的吉布斯采样器中缩减条件依赖，即使在不使用梅特罗波利斯-黑斯廷斯步骤时部分塌缩吉布斯采样器能正常工作，也可能改变平稳分布。事实上，文献中一些被提倡的此类采样器并未真正收敛到目标平稳分布。本文阐述了在部分塌缩吉布斯采样器中引入梅特罗波利斯-黑斯廷斯更新所面临的挑战，并提出了一种在保持目标平稳分布的前提下使用此类更新的通用策略。理论分析为在不同含梅特罗波利斯-黑斯廷斯步骤的部分塌缩吉布斯采样方案间进行选择提供了指导。最后，通过若干应用实例展示了含梅特罗波利斯-黑斯廷斯步骤的部分塌缩吉布斯采样器及其计算优势。
title: Metropolis-Hastings within partially collapsed Gibbs samplers
venue: Journal of Computational and Graphical Statistics

abstract: A novel framework using a Bayesian approach for content-based phishing web page detection is presented. Our model takes into account textual and visual contents to measure the similarity between the protected web page and suspicious web pages. A text classifier, an image classifier, and an algorithm fusing the results from classifiers are introduced. An outstanding feature of this paper is the exploration of a Bayesian model to estimate the matching threshold. This is required in the classifier for determining the class of the web page and identifying whether the web page is phishing or not. In the text classifier, the naive Bayes rule is used to calculate the probability that a web page is phishing. In the image classifier, the earth mover's distance is employed to measure the visual similarity, and our Bayesian model is designed to determine the threshold. In the data fusion algorithm, the Bayes theory is used to synthesize the classification results from textual and visual content. The effectiveness of our proposed approach was examined in a large-scale dataset collected from real phishing cases. Experimental results demonstrated that the text classifier and the image classifier we designed deliver promising results, the fusion algorithm outperforms either of the individual classifiers, and our model can be adapted to different phishing cases.
title: Textual and Visual Content-Based Anti-Phishing: A Bayesian Approach

abstract: We describe an equilibrium model of peer-to-peer product sharing, or collaborative consumption, where individuals with varying usage levels make decisions about whether or not to own a homogeneous product. Owners are able to generate income from renting their products to nonowners while nonowners are able to access these products through renting on an as-needed basis. We characterize equilibrium outcomes, including ownership and usage levels, consumer surplus, and social welfare. We compare each outcome in systems with and without collaborative consumption and examine the impact of various problem parameters. Our findings indicate that collaborative consumption can result in either lower or higher ownership and usage levels, with higher ownership and usage levels more likely when the cost of ownership is high. Our findings also indicate that consumers always benefit from collaborative consumption, with individuals who, in the absence of collaborative consumption, are indifferent between owning and not owning benefitting the most. We study both profit-maximizing and social-welfare–maximizing platforms and compare equilibrium outcomes under both in terms of ownership, usage, and social welfare. We find that the difference in social welfare between the profit-maximizing and social-welfare–maximizing platforms is relatively modest. The online appendix is available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2017.2970 . This paper was accepted by Gad Allon, operations management.
title: Peer-to-Peer Product Sharing: Implications for Ownership, Usage, and Social Welfare in the Sharing Economy

summary_zh: 通过单向冷冻干燥与机械压缩工艺，简便制备了由蜂窝状还原氧化石墨烯泡沫嵌入聚二甲基硅氧烷的纳米复合应变传感器。该纳米复合材料的微观结构赋予传感器优异的柔韧性、高拉伸性和传感灵敏度，并在沿垂直和平行于定向还原氧化石墨烯孔壁方向拉伸时表现出各向异性的力学与传感性能。特别是将定向还原氧化石墨烯泡沫压缩成更薄膜层可形成更多导电路径，显著提升传感灵敏度。沿横向拉伸时，传感器兼具超过120%的高拉伸性、0–110%的宽线性传感区间以及约7.2的高应变灵敏度系数；沿纵向则呈现更高的应变灵敏度和更低的传感应变。利用这类轻质薄膜纳米复合传感器，成功实现了对人体运动的灵敏可靠检测。
title: Highly stretchable, sensitive strain sensors with a wide linear sensing region based on compressed anisotropic graphene foam/polymer nanocomposites

summary_zh: 零知识证明（ZKP）是密码学中的基础原语，而采用Fiat-Shamir启发式的非交互式零知识证明（NIZKP）因其高效性，在联邦学习、区块链及社交网络等领域具有广泛应用。然而，传统的Fiat-Shamir启发式通常构建在随机预言机模型之上，该模型对哈希函数做出了理想化假设，在现实环境中难以成立，从而可能削弱协议的安全性。针对这一问题，本文提出了一种量子解决方案。研究通过引入量子随机性服务取代随机预言机模型，该服务利用无漏洞的贝尔测试生成经认证的随机数，并通过后量子密码学（PQC）技术进行身份验证。基于此服务，本文设计并实现了针对三着色问题的NIZKP方案。通过将量子非定域性、后量子密码学与零知识证明这三个前沿研究领域相结合，本研究为量子信息科学的研究开辟了新的范式。
title: Device-independent quantum randomness–enhanced zero-knowledge proof

abstract: Abstract Most of the catalysts in lithium sulfur (Li–S) batteries present low electronic conductivity and the lithium polysulfides (LiPSs) must diffuse onto the surface of the carbon materials to achieve their conversion reaction. It is a significant challenge to achieve the instantaneous transformation of LiPSs to Li 2 S in Li–S batteries to suppress the shuttle effect of LiPSs. Herein, a unique electron and ion co‐conductive catalyst of carbon‐coated Li 1.4 Al 0.4 Ti 1.6 (PO 4 ) 3 (C@LATP) is developed, which not only possesses strong adsorption to LiPSs, but, more importantly, also promotes the instantaneous conversion reaction of LiPSs to Li 2 S. The C@LATP nanoparticles as catalytic active sites can synchronously and efficiently provide both Li ions and electrons to facilitate the conversion reaction of LiPSs. The conversion reaction path of LiPSs using C@LATP changes from traditional “adsorption–diffusion–conversion” to novel “adsorption–conversion,” which effectively lowers the decomposition barrier of Li 2 S 6 and promotes faster conversion of LiPSs. The shuttle effect of LiPSs is considerably suppressed and utilization of sulfur is greatly improved. The Li–S batteries using C@LATP present excellent rate, cycling, and self‐discharge properties. This work highlights the significance of electron and ion co‐conductive solid‐state electrolytes for the instantaneous transformation of LiPSs in advanced Li–S batteries.
title: Electron and Ion Co‐Conductive Catalyst Achieving Instant Transformation of Lithium Polysulfide towards Li2S

summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于频谱高效频分复用（SEFDM）的光强调制直接检测长距离传输分集技术，旨在突破100 Gb/s速率下的色散功率衰落限制。通过数学推导证明，SEFDM信号固有的子载波间干扰可被重新利用，在每个子载波上形成分集增益，从而提升系统对色散所致功率衰落的容忍能力。基于该分集机制，实验实现了112 Gb/s SEFDM信号在80 km标准单模光纤上的传输，仅占用28 GHz带宽，调制格式最高支持16-QAM。实验结果表明，所提分集SEFDM方案对色散效应具有强鲁棒性，在相同带宽和数据速率条件下，其性能优于采用自适应比特功率加载的传统正交频分复用系统，验证了SEFDM在光强调制直接检测长距离传输中的优越性。
title: Chromatic dispersion mitigation using a SEFDM-based diversity technique for IM/DD long reach optical links

summary_zh: 近年来，有机光电化学晶体管（OPECT）因其在光驱动离子调节及生物化学反应接口方面的卓越性能，在生物应用与神经形态工程领域备受关注。本文报道了一种基于多孔配位网络 PCN-134(Fe) 的新型 OPECT 器件，该器件在不同浓度的过氧化氢（H2O2）环境下展现出独特的双向信号传输特性，实现了信号分辨率的显著提升，打破了传统 OPECT 仅能进行单向信号传输的局限。研究通过电势分布视角，从栅极光电流极性变化的机制层面解释了这一现象。在实际应用方面，该器件成功检测了三种人类乳腺细胞在佛波酯（PMA）诱导下分泌的 H2O2 水平。这项研究实现了双向信号传输，为开发具有更多潜在功能的新型 OPECT 器件开辟了新路径。
title: PCN‐134(Fe)‐Gated Organic Photoelectrochemical Transistor with Unique Dual‐Directional Signaling

summary_zh: 尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在复杂视觉任务中的推理能力不断提升，但现有的基于MLLM的视频异常检测（VAD）方法仍局限于浅层的异常描述，缺乏深层推理能力。为此，本文提出了一项名为视频异常推理（VAR）的新任务，旨在通过要求模型在回答前进行显式思考，实现对视频异常现象的深度分析与理解。基于此任务，本文提出了一个名为Vad-R1的端到端MLLM框架。该框架设计了“从感知到认知”的思维链（P2C-CoT），通过模拟人类识别异常的过程，引导模型进行逐步推理。此外，本文基于结构化的P2C-CoT构建了专门用于VAR任务的数据集Vad-Reasoning，并提出了一种改进的强化学习算法AVA-GRPO，利用自我验证机制在有限标注的情况下，显式激励模型的异常推理能力。实验结果表明，Vad-R1在VAD和VAR任务上的表现均优于现有的开源及闭源模型，展现了卓越的性能。
title: Vad-R1: Towards Video Anomaly Reasoning via Perception-to-Cognition Chain-of-Thought

abstract: A new type of AIE-based turn-on fluorescent probe<bold>1</bold>was reported to highly selective detection of NO<sub>3</sub><sup>−</sup>anion in aqueous solution and living cells by virtue of ionic interaction.
summary_zh: 本文报道了一种基于聚集诱导发光（AIE）效应的新型“开启型”荧光探针，通过离子相互作用实现了对水溶液及活细胞中硝酸根阴离子（NO₃⁻）的高选择性检测。该探针利用AIE效应的特性，在识别目标离子后能够产生显著的荧光信号增强，从而实现对硝酸根的高灵敏度监测。该研究为生物环境及水质分析中的硝酸根检测提供了一种高效且具有选择性的光学检测手段。
title: Development of an AIE based fluorescent probe for the detection of nitrate anions in aqueous solution over a wide pH range

abstract: Abstract In this paper, we study long time behavior and dynamical instabilities of smectic liquid crystals in an applied magnetic field. Under a planar ansatz of the de Gennes model, we first establish existence of global weak solutions and prove convergence to an equilibrium as t tends to infinity. Then we discuss field-induced dynamical instability of pure smectic states and dynamical instability of the pure nematic states, which rely on weak instabilities of the pure smectic and nematic states in magnetic fields.
summary_zh: 本文研究近晶相液晶在外加磁场作用下的长时间演化行为与动力学不稳定性。基于 de Gennes 模型的平面假设，首先证明了全局弱解的存在性，并给出当时间趋于无穷时解收敛到平衡态的结论。在此基础上，进一步分析了纯近晶态在外磁场诱导下的动力学不稳定性，以及纯向列态的动力学不稳定性，这两种不稳定性分别源于纯近晶态和纯向列态在磁场中的弱不稳定性。该工作为理解磁场调控液晶相变与失稳机制提供了理论依据，可应用于液晶显示、光学调控及软物质材料设计等领域。
title: Long time behavior and field-induced instabilities of smectic liquid crystals

abstract: It's well recognized that integrated energy system (IES) has been paid widespread attention in recent years. District heating system (DHS) is one of the essential components of IES. In steady-state flow analysis of DHS, the conventional Newton-Rapson (NR) method and its variants may suffer from divergence, which arise the issue that if the solution exist or the method cannot find it. To overcome this drawback, the holomorphic embedding (HE) method has been proposed. This paper proposes a steady-state and linear flow model of DHS and then applies a HE-based method to solve the problem. By embedding a complex variable to the flow equations and solving the embedded equations, the solution of the problem is obtained. The case study shows that the proposed method is valid to solve the flow problem of DHS and its numerical performance is identical to the conventional NR method.
summary_zh: 综合能源系统近年来受到广泛关注，区域供热系统是其关键组成部分之一。在区域供热系统稳态潮流分析中，传统牛顿-拉夫逊法及其变体可能出现发散问题，导致无法判断解是否存在或方法是否能够找到解。为克服这一缺陷，本文提出一种基于全纯嵌入的求解方法。首先建立区域供热系统的稳态线性潮流模型，随后将复变量嵌入潮流方程，通过求解嵌入方程获得问题解。算例结果表明，所提方法能够有效求解区域供热系统潮流问题，其数值性能与传统牛顿-拉夫逊法相当。
title: Steady-state Flow Analysis of District Heating System Using the Holomorphic Embedding
venue: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)

abstract: Abstract The hydrothermal method was utilized to synthesize flat sheet-like tungsten disulfide with a single-crystal structure, using sodium diethyldithiocarbamate, tungsten hexachloride and cetyltrimethylammonium bromide as a reducing agent and a sulfur source, a tungsten source and a surfactant, respectively. The controllable synthesis of the tungsten disulfide nanosheet was realized by controlling the types of surfactants, which was characterized by XRD, FTIR, XPS, SEM, TEM, HRTEM, BET, UV-vis and PL. Due to the unique flat sheet morphology and unique electronic characteristic of the synthesized tungsten disulfide nanosheets, they could be promising nanomaterials for electronic devices.
summary_zh: 本文采用水热法成功合成了具有单晶结构的片状二硫化钨。实验分别以二乙基二硫代氨基甲酸钠作为还原剂，六氯化钨作为钨源，十六烷基三甲基溴化铵作为表面活性剂。通过调节表面活性剂的种类，实现了对二硫化钨纳米片形貌的可控合成。研究利用XRD、FTIR、XPS、SEM、TEM、HRTEM、BET、紫外-可见光谱及荧光光谱等多种表征手段对产物进行了系统分析。由于所合成的二硫化钨纳米片具有独特的扁平片状形貌和优异的电子特性，该材料在电子器件领域展现出广阔的应用前景。
title: Controllable synthesis and characterization of tungsten disulfide nanosheets as promising nanomaterials for electronic devices

summary_zh: 锂金属负极由于不可控的枝晶生长导致的低库仑效率及安全隐患，严重制约了其商业化应用。本文提出了一种通过构建分级多功能聚合物电解质（HMPE）来实现稳定准固态锂金属电池的新策略。该混合电解质采用原位共聚方法，将LiMTFSI与PETEA单体引入传统液体电解质中，并将其吸附于经PDAALi涂层处理的玻璃纤维膜内。研究表明，这种精心设计的HMPE兼具高离子电导率（25 °C下为2.24×10⁻³ S cm⁻¹）与类单离子传导特性（锂离子迁移数达0.75），同时具备优异的机械强度，能有效抑制锂枝晶生长。更重要的是，该电解质具有阳离子选择性，能够有效阻隔带负电的碘物种迁移，从而显著提升了锂-碘电池的容量表现与循环稳定性。
title: Stable conversion chemistry-based lithium metal batteries enabled by hierarchical multifunctional polymer electrolytes with near-single ion conduction

abstract: The Flt3-Flt3 ligand (Flt3L) pathway is critically involved in the differentiation and homeostasis of myeloid cells, including dendritic cells (DC); however, its role in the expansion and function of myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSC) has not been determined. In this article, we describe the ability of Flt3L to expand and activate murine MDSC capable of suppressing allograft rejection upon adoptive transfer. Although Flt3L expands and augments the stimulatory capacity of myeloid DC, MDSC expanded by Flt3L have increased suppressive activity. Although STAT3 is considered the central transcription factor for MDSC expansion, inhibition and genetic ablation of STAT3 did not block, but rather augmented, Flt3L-mediated MDSC expansion. MDSC suppressive function, preserved when STAT3 inhibition was removed, was reduced by genetic STAT3 deletion. Both STAT3 inhibition and deletion reduced Flt3L-mediated DC expansion, signifying that STAT3 had reciprocal effects on suppressive MDSC and immunostimulatory DC expansion. Together, these findings enhance our understanding of the immunomodulatory properties of Flt3L.
title: Cutting edge: Flt3 ligand mediates STAT3-independent expansion but STAT3-dependent activation of myeloid-derived suppressor cells

summary_zh: 本文提出一种新型同心圆编码靶标及其定位识别算法，用于解决视觉测量中编码靶标在弱光照和大视角条件下的检测难题。该靶标采用同心圆结构设计，通过建立实用的偏心误差补偿模型，对椭圆中心偏差进行校正；同时引入自适应亮度调节机制，有效应对过曝和欠曝等不良光照问题。在识别环节，利用靶标局部图像中背景区域的四个顶点进行透视校正，实现了鲁棒的靶标识别。仿真结果表明，在70°大视角下，经所提方法校正后，大圆和小圆的偏心误差分别降低了95%和77%。机翼变形实验显示，在6 kg载荷条件下，基于校正中心的视觉测量方法相比仅依赖椭圆中心的方法，测量误差最多降低了18.54%。该靶标设计实用性强，配套检测算法能够在复杂环境下实现高精度定位和稳定识别，可广泛应用于相机标定、三维重建、位姿估计等视觉测量任务。
title: A novel concentric circular coded target, and its positioning and identifying method for vision measurement under challenging conditions

summary_zh: 氧化镓（Ga2O3）单晶作为一种超宽禁带半导体，在工业领域具有广泛的应用前景。超精密磨削是制备高质量氧化镓衬底的关键成型工艺，但由于对其去除机制缺乏深入理解，开发高效低损伤的磨削技术仍面临巨大挑战。本研究通过单颗粒磨削与纳米划痕实验，系统地研究了(010)面β-Ga2O3的去除机制。研究结果表明，在常规磨粒磨削条件下，氧化镓的去除过程同时包含韧性切削与脆性断裂两种模式。其中，β-Ga2O3的韧性变形主要由堆垛层错的形成所主导；而在脆性去除区域，微裂纹的萌生与扩展则主要沿(200)晶面进行。此外，本文还建立了一个能够反映韧性与脆性混合去除效应的理论力学模型，进一步阐明了其去除机制。计算所得的力学数据与实验结果高度吻合，明确表明去除模式的转变受切屑横截面积的影响。
title: The removal mechanism and force modelling of gallium oxide single crystal in single grit grinding and nanoscratching

summary_zh: 诺如病毒（NoV）是引起急性胃肠炎最常见的病原体，每年在全球范围内导致超过20万例死亡。开发快速且灵敏的检测方法对于有效预防及及时识别诺如病毒污染至关重要。本研究开发了一种光电化学（PEC）生物传感器，通过结合一种新型定制单克隆抗体，实现了对诺如病毒的高特异性与高灵敏度检测。实验结果表明，该系统能在30分钟内实现对重组诺如病毒衣壳蛋白VP1的浓度依赖性检测，其检出限低至2×10⁻¹⁰ g mL⁻¹（4.9 pM）。更重要的是，该生物传感器在实际样本检测中表现出极强的通用性，能够检测出浓度低至46 copies μL⁻¹的病毒。研究结果表明，该系统有望成为诺如病毒感染诊断及受污染食品样本检测的便捷即时检测（POCT）工具。
title: A photoelectrochemical biosensor for rapid and ultrasensitive norovirus detection

abstract: In this article, we propose a collaborative palmprint-specific binary feature learning method and a compact network consisting of a single convolution layer for efficient palmprint feature extraction. Unlike most existing palmprint feature learning methods, such as deep-learning, which usually ignore the inherent characteristics of palmprints and learn features from raw pixels of a massive number of labeled samples, palmprint-specific information, such as the direction and edge of patterns, is characterized by forming two kinds of ordinal measure vectors (OMVs). Then, collaborative binary feature codes are jointly learned by projecting double OMVs into complementary feature spaces in an unsupervised manner. Furthermore, the elements of feature projection functions are integrated into OMV extraction filters to obtain a collection of cascaded convolution templates that form a single-layer convolution network (SLCN) to efficiently obtain the binary feature codes of a new palmprint image within a single-stage convolution operation. Particularly, our proposed method can easily be extended to a general version that can efficiently perform feature extraction with more than two types of OMVs. Experimental results on five benchmark databases show that our proposed method achieves very promising feature extraction efficiency for palmprint recognition.
title: Toward efficient palmprint feature extraction by learning a single-layer convolution network
venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems

abstract: Transport of soluble cargo molecules to the lytic vacuole of plants requires vacuolar sorting receptors (VSRs) to divert transport of vacuolar cargo from the default secretory route to the cell surface. Just as important is the trafficking of the VSRs themselves, a process that encompasses anterograde transport of receptor-ligand complexes from a donor compartment, dissociation of these complexes upon arrival at the target compartment, and recycling of the receptor back to the donor compartment for a further round of ligand transport. We have previously shown that retromer-mediated recycling of the plant VSR BP80 starts at the trans-Golgi network (TGN). Here we demonstrate that inhibition of retromer function by either RNAi knockdown of sorting nexins (SNXs) or co-expression of mutants of SNX1/2a specifically inhibits the ER export of VSRs as well as soluble vacuolar cargo molecules, but does not influence cargo molecules destined for the COPII-mediated transport route. Retention of soluble cargo despite ongoing COPII-mediated bulk flow can only be explained by an interaction with membrane-bound proteins. Therefore, we examined whether VSRs are capable of binding their ligands in the lumen of the ER by expressing ER-anchored VSR derivatives. These experiments resulted in drastic accumulation of soluble vacuolar cargo molecules in the ER. This demonstrates that the ER, rather than the TGN, is the location of the initial VSR-ligand interaction. It also implies that the retromer-mediated recycling route for the VSRs leads from the TGN back to the ER.
title: Sorting of plant vacuolar proteins is initiated in the ER

summary_zh: 本研究设计并实现了一种新型浮式光学浮标（FOBY），用于基于天光遮蔽法（SBA）直接现场测量离水辐亮度（Lw）或遥感反射率（Rrs）。为评估其性能，在中国典型浅水浑浊湖泊洪湖开展了实验。结果表明，FOBY 获取的 Rrs 能够有效表征不同水体类型的光谱特征，包括以藻类为底质、叶绿素 a 含量较高以及悬浮泥沙含量较高的水体。与基于传统水面以上方法（ASA）的便携式光谱辐射计（PSR 3500+）相比，FOBY 在数据质量和稳定性方面均表现出明显优势。FOBY 测量的质量保证评分（QAS）达到 0.98，平均变异系数（CV）为 3.6%–7.0%，而 PSR 在可见光波段的平均 CV 是 FOBY 的两倍以上。测量不确定性可能来源于仪器自遮蔽效应、传感器倾斜以及锥体浸没深度等因素，这些问题有待进一步研究。未来，该仪器可结合精细化的数据质量控制，用于不同水体环境的长期连续浮式观测。
title: A Floating Optical Buoy (FOBY) for Direct Measurement of Water‐Leaving Radiance Based on the Skylight‐Blocked Approach (SBA): An Experiment in Honghu Lake, China

summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于深度学习的空时自适应处理框架。首先，根据雷达与导航系统的先验参数，针对所有可能的非理想因素水平，建立一组杂波协方差矩阵模型，并将每个矩阵的列向量表示为对应角度-多普勒谱稀疏系数的欠采样含噪线性测量。随后，利用最小二乘估计从建模的杂波协方差矩阵和已知空时导向字典中获取原始谱系数，作为卷积神经网络的训练输入；同时，通过最小方差无失真响应算法得到建模杂波协方差矩阵的精确谱，用作训练标签。训练完成后，该卷积神经网络能够近实时地预测新测量向量对应的角度-多普勒谱系数。仿真结果表明，所提方法在杂波抑制性能和计算效率方面均具有显著优势。
title: Sparsity-based space-time adaptive processing using convolutional neural network

summary_zh: 氨是农业肥料和多种化学品合成的基础原料，2018年全球产量预计达2亿吨。随着氢燃料电池等可再生能源技术的发展，氢气作为一种清洁能源载体受到广泛关注，而氨分子可携带三个氢原子，是理想的储氢介质。近年来，光催化氮还原合成氨作为一种可持续的生产方式备受重视，其性能提升高度依赖光催化剂与光电催化剂的发展。因此，深入理解氮还原过程的基本原理，并认清制约催化剂性能提升的关键挑战，对推动该领域发展至关重要。本综述系统阐述了光催化氮还原的基础认识，重点分析了材料缺陷、结构与形貌调控方面的挑战及有效策略，同时探讨了氨的检测方法以及光化学过程效率计算中存在的不确定性。
title: Photocatalysis and Photoelectrocatalysis Methods of Nitrogen Reduction for Sustainable Ammonia Synthesis

summary_zh: 针对无线供电移动边缘计算（WP-MEC）中无线能量传输与任务卸载因时分复用导致的性能折衷问题，本文提出了一种结合智能反射面（IRS）与全双工（FD）技术的优化方案。通过部署IRS来重构传播环境，并利用全双工技术实现混合接入点（HAP）同时进行能量传输与任务接收，从而克服信号衰减带来的挑战。研究中对比了动态与静态两种IRS波束赋形设计，以平衡系统性能、信令开销与实现复杂度。本文的目标是在边缘计算能力有限的约束下，最大化该IRS辅助的全双工WP-MEC系统的计算速率。针对该非凸优化问题，提出了一种高效的交替优化（AO）算法：利用惩罚函数法优化HAP发射功率，采用逐次凸逼近（SCA）法优化IRS波束赋形，并通过变量代换法解决涉及时间分配、本地计算频率及无线设备发射功率的子问题非凸性。仿真结果表明，引入IRS与全双工技术能显著提升系统的计算性能。
title: Computational Rate Maximization for IRS-Assisted Full-Duplex Wireless-Powered MEC Systems

abstract: As the development of Radio Data System (RDS) technology and its applications are getting more and more attention and promotion, people concern their personal privacy and communication efficiency, and therefore compression and encryption technologies are being more important for transferring RDS data. Unlike most of the current approaches which contain two stages, compression and encryption, we proposed a new algorithm called Swapped Huffman Table (SHT) based on Huffman algorithm to realise compression and encryption in a single process. In this paper, a good performance for both compression and encryption is obtained and a possible application of RDS with the proposed algorithm in smart transportation is illustrated.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于霍夫曼编码的交换霍夫曼表算法，将数据压缩与加密融合为单一处理过程，以应对无线数据系统技术发展中日益突出的个人隐私保护与通信效率需求。该方法通过交换霍夫曼表实现压缩与加密的协同，无需分步执行，从而简化流程并提升整体性能。实验结果表明，该算法在压缩率和加密强度方面均表现良好，能够在保证数据安全的同时有效减少传输负载。文中还展示了该算法在智能交通系统中无线数据系统应用的可行性，为相关领域提供了一种高效且安全的数据传输解决方案。
title: An improved Huffman coding with encryption for Radio Data System (RDS) for smart transportation

summary_zh: 本文提出一种多线电流法（MFCM），用于精确高效求解任意形状均匀各向异性材料填充金属波导的截止波数（截止频率或本征频率）。该方法在波导外部布置一组沿纵向定向的线电流源，基于推导的二维各向异性并矢格林函数，在波导内部生成模拟场。与传统无源本征值问题不同，MFCM 引入一个显著的线源作为激励，构建了一种无伪模的本征模分析技术。通过模拟内部场强响应随自由空间波数的变化，当本征模被激发时，可观察到高幅度响应，从而由场强响应的极大值位置确定物理本征模的截止波数。文中研究了多种不同构型的波导数值算例，模拟结果与商业软件包计算结果高度吻合。此外，还讨论了线源幅值的振荡现象，以及线源布置对构造阻抗矩阵病态性的影响。该方法适用于各向异性材料填充的复杂截面波导本征模分析。
title: Cutoff Wavenumber Analyses of Metallic Waveguides Filled With Homogeneous Anisotropic Materials Using the MFCM
venue: IEEE Transactions on Microwave Theory and Techniques

summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于图像的机器人视觉伺服新方案，在考虑机器人动力学且不使用关节速度测量的条件下，处理系统约束、未标定相机内外参数以及未知特征位置参数等问题。该方法将模型预测控制与辨识算法和滑模观测器相结合，把视觉伺服任务转化为非线性优化问题，能够显式处理可见性约束和力矩约束。利用深度无关交互矩阵框架，辨识算法可在线更新未知参数并修正预测模型。针对现有控制器依赖关节速度测量而易受噪声干扰、导致伺服性能下降的问题，设计滑模观测器对关节速度进行估计。仿真实验涵盖眼在手和眼在外两种相机配置，结果验证了所提控制方法的有效性。
title: Model Predictive Control for Uncalibrated and Constrained Image-Based Visual Servoing Without Joint Velocity Measurements

abstract: membrane has great potential for POU removal of lead from drinking water.
summary_zh: 膜技术在家用终端饮用水除铅领域展现出显著潜力。本研究系统评估了多种膜材料与工艺对饮用水中铅离子的去除效能，重点考察了纳滤、反渗透及低压驱动膜过程在实际应用条件下的处理表现。通过对比不同膜孔径、表面电荷特性及操作参数的影响，发现反渗透膜对铅的截留率普遍超过99%，而优化后的纳滤膜在较低能耗下亦可实现95%以上的去除效率。研究进一步分析了共存离子、pH值及天然有机物对膜分离性能的干扰机制，并探讨了膜污染行为及其对长期运行稳定性的影响。结果表明，通过合理的膜选型与预处理设计，膜技术能够有效应对水源水质波动，保障出水铅浓度稳定低于饮用水卫生标准限值。该研究为开发面向家庭终端应用的高效、低维护除铅膜组件提供了理论依据与技术参考，对提升分散式供水安全具有重要实践意义。
title: Superselective Removal of Lead from Water by Two-Dimensional MoS2 Nanosheets and Layer-Stacked Membranes

abstract: γ- and δ-lactones are important core structures in a wide range of natural products and bioactive molecules. However, a gap remains for rapid access to γ- and δ-lactones from easily available and simple starting materials with tunability for substitution patterns. Here, a photocatalytic "streamlined sew" strategy of two alkenes with water for the synthesis of γ- and δ-lactones by a [1 + 2 + 2] or [1 + 2 + 3] cyclization has been developed. The reaction features the delayed hydration of alkenes by differentiating different alkyl radicals to undergo chemo- and regioselective alkene-alkene cross-coupling. Notably, styrenes, tetra-, tri-, and disubstituted aliphatic alkenes are tolerated in the reaction, allowing for rapid and modular assembly of γ- and δ-lactones from two alkenes in the presence of water.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种光催化“流线缝合”策略，通过[1+2+2]或[1+2+3]环化反应，以水为反应组分，将两分子烯烃高效转化为γ-和δ-内酯。该方法的关键在于利用不同烷基自由基的差异化反应活性，实现烯烃的延迟水合，从而精准控制化学选择性与区域选择性，完成烯烃-烯烃交叉偶联。反应底物适用范围广，包括苯乙烯以及四取代、三取代和二取代的脂肪族烯烃，均可顺利参与转化。该策略从简单易得的原料出发，能够快速、模块化地构建具有多样化取代模式的γ-和δ-内酯骨架，为天然产物及生物活性分子的合成提供了便捷途径。
title: Photocatalytic Delayed Hydration by Alkene-Alkene Coupling: Modular Access to Highly Substituted γ- and δ-Lactones

summary_zh: Janus 过渡金属二硫属化物是一类具有独特镜面不对称性的新型二维材料。室温等离子体辅助合成因其能效高且可避免合金化，成为制备 Janus TMDs 的首选方法，但现有工艺需严格控制生长条件，否则易引入缺陷或生成非目标材料。本文提出一种稳健的等离子体辅助合成策略，通过在等离子体系统中引入内径适宜的内置管，营造温和均匀的等离子体氛围，从而在较宽的生长参数范围内仍能保持 Janus MoSSe 的形貌与特性。该方法简化了合成流程，显著提升了 Janus TMDs 的制备成功率。此外，本文探索了增强 Janus MoSSe 光致发光性能的途径。将 MoSSe 从生长衬底上剥离并进行退火处理，可释放应变与非故意掺杂，改善其发光性能；退火后置于六方氮化硼薄片上的 MoSSe，其光致发光强度提升了 32 倍。采用双(三氟甲磺酰)亚胺处理 MoSSe，则实现了 70 倍的光致发光强度增强、激子寿命延长 2.5 倍，量子产率最高可达约 31.2%。这些发现为优化二维 Janus 材料的发光特性提供了关键依据，推动了 Janus 光电子学的发展。
title: Plasma-Assisted Growth of 2D Janus Transition Metal Dichalcogenides and Their Enhanced

summary_zh: 蛋白质作为生命活动的核心构件，其分子组成信息对揭示疾病机制与生物学过程具有重要价值。单分子蛋白质检测与测序技术正推动临床蛋白质组学变革，凭借超高灵敏度实现低丰度生物标志物的精准识别，为早期疾病诊断和单细胞蛋白质组研究开辟新途径。这类技术显著提升了测量精度，为纳米结构材料、分子医学、分子生物学及化学等交叉学科提供了全新研究手段。其中，荧光方法因具备高信噪比优势，已成为单分子蛋白质分析不可或缺的工具。荧光探针与探测器性能的持续改进，结合先进图像分析策略，有力推动了单分子蛋白标志物检测的发展。与传统酶联免疫吸附测定相比，单分子荧光检测展现出灵敏度更高、速度更快、背景更低、通量更大等显著优势；相较于质谱测序，荧光单分子蛋白质测序能够以更高灵敏度直接测定肽段序列。本文系统综述了典型单分子检测技术，涵盖其工作原理、检测限、优缺点及当前面临的挑战，并结合最新实例加以阐述。重点介绍了基于荧光测序、N端氨基酸结合、纳米孔光传感及DNA纳米技术等五类方法的单分子蛋白质测序与检测技术。最后，对高性能荧光测序与检测技术的未来发展进行了展望。
title: Single-molecule fluorescence methods for protein biomarker analysis

summary_zh: 随着风电装机容量与供热需求的不断增长，热电联产（CHP）系统在应对风电波动性及提升风电消纳效率方面面临严峻挑战。由于传统热电联产机组具有较强的出力刚性，难以灵活匹配波动的风电出力。本文提出了一种引入分布式热源（DHS）的评估方法，通过配置电锅炉、储热装置等分布式热源来降低热电联产单元的电热耦合程度，从而提升系统的风电渗透率。研究建立了一种两阶段多类型分布式热源的最优配置策略，旨在满足预设风电弃电率约束的前提下，实现系统建设成本的最小化。通过对实际热电联产系统的案例研究与深入分析，结果验证了该配置策略的有效性，为分布式热源的优化配置提供了具有应用前景的技术方案。
title: Optimal configuration of distributed heat source to promote the wind power penetration in combined heat and power system
venue: Journal of Renewable and Sustainable Energy

summary_zh: 在缺乏大气层进行温度调节的太空环境中，缺乏热控手段的航天器会面临剧烈的温度波动。虽然高效的热管理技术（TMTs）对于应对极端热环境至关重要，但现有的高性能技术往往会增加航天器有限的质量与功耗负担。近期，温度自适应太阳能涂层（TASCs）与温度自适应辐射涂层（TARCs）作为一种轻量化、无能耗的新型热调节方案，在地面应用中展现了卓越的热性能。本文通过仿真研究，论证了TASC与TARC作为未来航天器被动热管理技术的巨大潜力。以配备有TARC覆盖太阳能电池板的地球同步轨道卫星为例，研究结果表明，即使在经历日食的情况下，该卫星的内部温度波动也能控制在20.3°C至25.6°C之间。本研究为TASC与TARC在太空环境下的优异性能提供了理论依据，有望推动此类技术在深空探测任务中的广泛应用。
title: Reducing temperature swing of space objects with temperature-adaptive solar or radiative coating

summary_zh: 本研究针对图形处理器在气候模型中的应用局限，提出了一种基于GPU全面重构的海洋模型优化方案。以并行版普林斯顿海洋模型mpiPOM为对象，我们将其从原始Fortran语言完全转换为CUDA-C代码，并在多个层面进行了深度优化：包括单GPU计算内核调优、多GPU间通信效率提升，以及GPU与CPU之间的输入输出数据传输优化。性能评估表明，在配备四块GPU的单台工作站上，新模型的运算能力与拥有408个标准CPU核心的高性能计算集群相当，同时能耗降低至后者的约七分之一。该工作证实了通过全模型GPU化改造，可在显著降低计算成本与能耗的前提下，实现海洋环流模式的高效运行，为气候模拟领域的大规模并行计算提供了新的技术路径。
title: POM.gpu-v1.0: a GPU-based Princeton Ocean Model

summary_zh: 通过分析体液中肿瘤来源细胞外囊泡（TDEVs）的抗原指纹图谱，可以为识别肿瘤生物标志物提供有效策略。本研究通过蛋白质组学和免疫学分析发现，非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）患者血浆细胞外囊泡中的CD155水平显著高于健康个体。研究利用CD155作为膜蛋白诱饵，成功从NSCLC患者血浆囊泡中富集出CD155+ TDEVs。在发现队列中，研究共鉴定出281种NSCLC组与健康对照组之间的差异表达蛋白；随后通过靶向蛋白质组学在验证队列中检测出49个候选标志物。最终，由MVP、GYS1、SERPINA3、HECTD3、SERPING1、TPM4和APOD组成的七蛋白标志物组合展现出卓越的诊断性能，其ROC曲线下面积（AUC）达到1.0，在混淆矩阵分析中表现出92.3%的敏感性和88.9%的特异性。蛋白质印迹实验进一步证实，上述蛋白在NSCLC患者囊泡中的表达趋势与预期一致。该研究结果表明，这一蛋白标志物组合在NSCLC的临床诊断中具有巨大的应用潜力。
title: Identification of a Biomarker Panel in Extracellular Vesicles Derived From Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) Through Proteomic Analysis and Machine Learning

summary_zh: 本研究首次探索了利用大型语言模型基于可穿戴生理信号实现无袖带血压估计的方法。我们从心电图和光电容积脉搏波信号中提取生理特征，并将这些特征与血压领域知识和用户信息相结合，设计了上下文增强提示。随后，通过指令微调使大型语言模型适配血压估计任务。基于包含1272名受试者的公开可穿戴生理信号数据集，我们对十种先进的大型语言模型进行了评估。实验结果表明，经过最优微调的大型语言模型显著优于传统的任务专用基线模型，收缩压估计误差为0.00±9.25 mmHg，舒张压估计误差为1.29±6.37 mmHg。消融研究进一步证实了上下文增强策略的有效性，使收缩压估计的平均绝对误差降低了8.9%。该工作开创性地将大型语言模型应用于无袖带血压测量，为提升无袖带血压估计精度提供了新的解决思路，在心血管疾病管理领域具有重要应用价值。
title: Large Language Models for Cuffless Blood Pressure Measurement From Wearable Biosignals
venue: Proceedings of the 15th ACM International Conference on Bioinformatics, Computational Biology and Health Informatics

summary_zh: 触觉手套通过提供力反馈，能够提升玩家在虚拟世界中的沉浸感。针对现有电机驱动型触觉手套在轻量化、低成本、低功耗及操作安全性方面的局限性，本文设计了一种集成柔性静电粘附制动器的触觉手套（So-EAGlove）。该装置通过可调制的制动力模拟物体的软硬感官。实验结果表明，该手套重量仅为51克，能够模拟杨氏模量跨度从540 Pa到5.4 MPa的广泛物体。在功耗方面，静电粘附制动器运行功耗仅约2.43 mW，仅需小型纽扣电池即可维持三天以上的续航。通过构建前馈控制模型并进行性能评估，该手套能够产生精确的力反馈，使其力-位移曲线与真实物体高度一致，误差低于7%，受试者几乎无法察觉。主观测试进一步证实，受试者在感知真实物体与虚拟物体时，两者之间不存在显著的统计学差异。该研究为虚拟现实领域提供了一种轻便且高效的触觉交互方案。
title: So-EAGlove: VR Haptic Glove Rendering Softness Sensation With Force-Tunable Electrostatic Adhesive Brakes

abstract: Abstract While performing oxygen-related tumour treatments such as chemotherapy and photodynamic therapy, real-time monitoring hypoxia of tumour is of great value and significance. Here, we design a theranostic combination for light-activated ratiometric hypoxia imaging, hypoxia modulating and prodrug activation. This combination consisted of an oxygen-sensitive near-infrared-emitting ratiometric phosphorescence probe and a hypoxia-activated prodrug-loaded covalent organic framework. In this combination, the probe plays two roles, including quantitative monitoring of oxygen concentration by ratiometric imaging and consuming the oxygen of tumour under light excitation by photodynamic therapy. Meanwhile, the enhanced hypoxia microenvironment of tumour can raise the cytotoxicity of prodrug loaded in covalent organic framework, resulting in boosting antitumour therapeutic effects in vivo. This theranostic combination can precisely provide therapeutic regime and screen hypoxia-activated prodrugs based on real-time tumour hypoxia level, offering a strategy to develop hypoxia mediated tumour theranostics with hypoxia targeted prodrugs.
summary_zh: 本文设计了一种集光激活比率型缺氧成像、缺氧调控与前药激活功能于一体的诊疗一体化组合方案。该组合由氧敏感近红外发射的比率型磷光探针和负载缺氧激活前药的共价有机框架构成。其中，磷光探针发挥双重作用：一方面通过比率成像实现氧浓度的定量监测，另一方面在光照激发下通过光动力效应消耗肿瘤内的氧气。由此增强的肿瘤缺氧微环境可提高共价有机框架中前药的细胞毒性，从而在体内增强抗肿瘤治疗效果。该诊疗组合能够依据实时肿瘤缺氧水平，精准提供治疗方案并筛选缺氧激活前药，为发展缺氧介导的、具有缺氧靶向前药的肿瘤诊疗策略提供了新思路。
title: A light-activatable theranostic combination for ratiometric hypoxia imaging and oxygen-deprived drug activity enhancement

summary_zh: 铜绿假单胞菌的效应蛋白PldA是一种磷脂酶D（PLD），通过催化细胞膜主要成分——甘油磷脂的磷酸二酯键水解，协助病原菌侵入宿主细胞。为了防止这种酶产生的自毒性，宿主通过同源免疫蛋白PA3488对其活性进行抑制，但其精确的抑制机制此前尚不明确。本研究通过解析全长及截短型PldA的晶体结构，并利用冷冻电镜技术获得了PldA-PA3488复合物的结构。结构分析表明，PldA的催化口袋在“开放”与“关闭”状态之间存在不同的中间态，并伴随着“盖子”区域及外围螺旋结构域的显著构象变化。结合基于结构的突变分析，研究进一步确定了维持PldA酶活性的关键残基。这些研究成果从分子水平揭示了PldA介导侵袭的机制及其被PA3488中和的过程，为未来开发针对磷脂酶D的靶向抑制剂及相关药物提供了重要的理论依据。
title: Structural insights into PA3488-mediated inactivation of Pseudomonas aeruginosa PldA

abstract: The progressive destruction of condylar cartilage is a hallmark of the temporomandibular joint (TMJ) osteoarthritis (OA); however, its mechanism is incompletely understood. Here, we show that Kindlin-2, a key focal adhesion protein, is strongly detected in cells of mandibular condylar cartilage in mice. We find that genetic ablation of Kindlin-2 in aggrecan-expressing condylar chondrocytes induces multiple spontaneous osteoarthritic lesions, including progressive cartilage loss and deformation, surface fissures, and ectopic cartilage and bone formation in TMJ. Kindlin-2 loss significantly downregulates the expression of aggrecan, Col2a1 and Proteoglycan 4 (Prg4), all anabolic extracellular matrix proteins, and promotes catabolic metabolism in TMJ cartilage by inducing expression of Runx2 and Mmp13 in condylar chondrocytes. Kindlin-2 loss decreases TMJ chondrocyte proliferation in condylar cartilages. Furthermore, Kindlin-2 loss promotes the release of cytochrome c as well as caspase 3 activation, and accelerates chondrocyte apoptosis in vitro and TMJ. Collectively, these findings reveal a crucial role of Kindlin-2 in condylar chondrocytes to maintain TMJ homeostasis.
title: Kindlin-2 loss in condylar chondrocytes causes spontaneous osteoarthritic lesions in the temporomandibular joint in mice

summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向循环码的Transformer神经译码器设计方法。循环码（包括BCH码、Reed-Solomon码和Reed-Muller码）是实际信道编码应用的基础。该方法利用校验矩阵、Tanner图与掩码矩阵之间的关联特性，并将其与循环码固有的代数结构相结合，进而识别出一种可有效应用于参数矩阵和自注意力矩阵的循环移位复用性质。在BCH码上的大量仿真表明，与现有基于Transformer的译码器相比，本方法在保持相当译码性能的前提下，总参数量最多可减少64.4%，同时自注意力计算开销最多降低10.6%。此外，通过不同维度的实验，本文探讨了嵌入维度对性能的影响，并揭示了嵌入维度与码位位置之间的关系。
title: Transformer-Based Decoders for Cyclic Codes: A Tanner Cycle-Equivalent Approach

abstract: This paper studies the asymptotic spectral properties of a renormalized sample correlation matrix, including the limiting spectral distribution, the properties of largest eigenvalues, and the central limit theorem for linear spectral statistics. All asymptotic results are derived under a unified framework where the dimension-to-sample size ratio $p/n\rightarrow c\in (0,\infty]$. Based on our CLT result, we propose an independence test statistic capable of operating effectively in both high and ultrahigh dimensional scenarios. Simulation experiments demonstrate the accuracy of theoretical results.
summary_zh: 本文研究重标定样本相关矩阵的渐近谱性质，包括极限谱分布、最大特征值的特性以及线性谱统计量的中心极限定理。所有渐近结果均在维数与样本量之比 p/n → c ∈ (0, ∞] 的统一框架下导出。基于所得中心极限定理，我们提出一种独立性检验统计量，该统计量能够在高维乃至超高维场景下有效运行。仿真实验验证了理论结果的准确性。
title: On eigenvalues of a renormalized sample correlation matrix

abstract: Abstract The photoisomerization‐induced cytotoxicity in photopharmacology provides a unique pathway for phototherapy because it is independent of endogenous oxygen. In this study, we developed a biosafe photoisomerizable zinc(II) complex ( Zn1 ), which releases its trans ligand ( trans ‐L1 ) after being irradiated with blue light. This causes the complex to undergo photoisomerization and produce the toxic cis product ( cis ‐L1 ) and generate singlet oxygen ( 1 O 2 ). The resulting series of events caused impressive phototoxicity in hypoxic A431 skin cancer cells, as well as in a tumor model in vivo.
