Interestingly, Zn1 was able to inhibit tumor microtubule polymerization, while still showing good biocompatibility and biosafety in vivo. This photoisomerizable zinc(II) complex provides a novel strategy for addressing the oxygen‐dependent limitation of traditional photodynamic therapy.
summary_zh: 本研究开发了一种生物安全性良好的可光异构化锌(II)配合物 Zn1，其在蓝光照射下释放反式配体 trans-L1，随后发生光异构化生成具有毒性的顺式产物 cis-L1，并同时产生单线态氧。这一连串光激活事件在缺氧的 A431 皮肤癌细胞及体内肿瘤模型中均表现出显著的光毒性。值得注意的是，Zn1 能够抑制肿瘤微管聚合，同时在体内展现出良好的生物相容性和安全性。该可光异构化锌(II)配合物为解决传统光动力疗法对氧气依赖的局限性提供了一种新策略，拓展了光药理学在低氧肿瘤光疗中的应用前景。
title: A Photoisomerizable Zinc (II) Complex Inhibits Microtubule Polymerization for Photoactive Therapy

abstract: We present a time complexity analysis of the Opt-IA artificial immune system (AIS). We first highlight the power and limitations of its distinguishing operators (i.e., hypermutations with mutation potential and ageing) by analysing them in isolation. Recent work has shown that ageing combined with local mutations can help escape local optima on a dynamic optimisation benchmark function. We generalise this result by rigorously proving that, compared to evolutionary algorithms (EAs), ageing leads to impressive speed-ups on the standard Cliff benchmark function both when using local and global mutations. Unless the stop at first constructive mutation (FCM) mechanism is applied, we show that hypermutations require exponential expected runtime to optimise any function with a polynomial number of optima. If instead FCM is used, the expected runtime is at most a linear factor larger than the upper bound achieved for any random local search algorithm using the artificial fitness levels method. Nevertheless, we prove that algorithms using hypermutations can be considerably faster than EAs at escaping local optima. An analysis of the complete Opt-IA reveals that it is efficient on the previously considered functions and highlights problems where the use of the full algorithm is crucial. We complete the picture by presenting a class of functions for which Opt-IA fails with overwhelming probability while standard EAs are efficient.
title: When hypermutations and ageing enable artificial immune systems to outperform evolutionary algorithms

summary_zh: 在工业化生产光学纯药物、天然产物及精细化学品的过程中，具备高周转数（TON）和卓越选择性的过渡金属催化剂至关重要，但此类催化剂的研究报道较少。本文报道了一种前所未有的阴离子铱-f-phamidol催化剂，用于γ-氨基酮的不对称氢化，并随后通过立体选择性环化反应构建具有高价值的手性2-芳基吡咯烷药效团。研究结果表明，该铱催化剂表现出高达1,000,000的周转数以及超过99%的对映选择性（ee值），同时对底物和保护基具有极佳的耐受性，能够高效提供多种手性氨基醇中间体。通过优化反应条件，立体选择性环化过程表现出极高的平稳性与效率，转化率接近定量，且ee值保持在92%至99%以上。该方案最终成功应用于含有手性2-芳基吡咯烷药效团的高价值手性化合物的制备。
title: PPM Ir-f-phamidol-Catalyzed Asymmetric Hydrogenation of γ-Amino Ketones Followed by Stereoselective Cyclization for Construction of Chiral 2-Aryl-pyrrolidine Pharmacophores

summary_zh: 二维半导体材料因强库仑相互作用和激子复合体的共存与相互转化，为在极低载流子密度下实现光增益提供了新途径，这对发展低功耗纳米激光器等能效光子器件至关重要。传统半导体激光器需在超过莫特相变的高密度条件下工作，而本研究基于电控双层二碲化钼，报道了一种远低于莫特密度的带电激子（三子）增益机制。通过实验与理论建模相结合，我们揭示了莫特相变以下激子复合体间的复杂相互作用，证实二维材料可在比传统半导体低四至五个数量级的载流子密度下提供光增益，为超低注入水平的激光发射奠定基础。该工作还有助于澄清近期二维材料研究中的矛盾现象：虽然基于二维材料的激光器已在极低密度下实现，其光谱特征由多种激子复合体主导，但此前光增益仅在超出莫特密度数个数量级的高密度实验中被观测到。本研究有望推动对激子物种相互转化与莫特相变以下光增益之间关系的系统探索。
title: Excitonic complexes and optical gain in two-dimensional molybdenum ditelluride well below the Mott transition

summary_zh: 近年来，拓扑非平庸系统中的集体激发引起了广泛关注。本文研究Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型中低能电子能带仅部分填充、体系呈金属态的等离激元行为。基于无规相近似，我们计算了带内与带间极化函数，并通过介电函数确定了体等离激元的色散关系。研究发现，子晶格基态对极化函数具有显著影响，从而调控体系的等离激元激发。通过调节这些局域轨道的实空间间距，可以在带内与带间屏蔽过程之间实现可调谐的权衡，从而选择性地增强或抑制等离激元能量。特别地，该机制可用于稳定已在相关模型中报道的无阻尼高能等离激元。本文还提出了在实验中调控和观测这些效应的可行方案。
title: Control of Plasmons in Doped Topological Insulators via Basis Atoms

abstract: Abstract In this work, the high electrochemical activity induced by doping different contents of oxygen on the surface of graphene sheets embedded carbon (GSEC) film is studied, which is prepared by electron cyclotron resonance (ECR) plasma sputtering system under electron irradiation. Transmission electron microscopy observation and Raman analysis confirm that doping oxygen induced more graphene edges and oxygen‐containing functional groups on the surface. The electrochemical activities of the films are measured in the redox system and the results show that a proper doping content of oxygen is beneficial to reduce the oxidation‐reduction peak separation. The surface O‐doped GSEC film with 5% content realizes the simultaneous detection of uric acid (UA), xanthine (XA) and hypoxanthine (HXA) with high sensitivity. The mechanism could be that the isolated electron at graphene edge and the polar fraction of oxygen‐containing functional groups provide more active sites to accelerate the electron transfer. These results indicate that surface O‐doped GSEC films are promising electrode materials to construct sensitive electrochemical biosensors.
title: High Electrochemical Activity Induced by Doping Oxygen in Graphene Sheets Embedded Carbon Film

abstract: Counteracting geometrical attacks remains one of the most challenging problems in robust watermarking. In this paper, we resist rotation, scaling, and translation (RST) by constructing a kind of deformable pyramid transform (DPT) that is shift-invariant, steerable, and scalable. The DPT is extended from a closed-form polar-separable steerable pyramid transform (SPT). The radial component of the SPT's basis filters is taken as the kernel of the scalable basis filters, and the angular component is used for the steerable basis filters. The shift-invariance is inherited from the SPT by retaining undecimated high-pass and band-pass subbands. Based on the designed DPT, we theoretically derive interpolation functions for steerability and scalability and synchronization mechanisms for translation, rotation, and scaling. By exploiting the preferable characteristics of DPT, we develop a new template-based robust image watermarking scheme that is resilient to RST. Translation invariance is achieved by taking the Fourier magnitude of the cover image as the DPT's input. The resilience to rotation and scaling is obtained using the synchronization mechanisms for rotation and scaling, for which an efficient template-matching algorithm has been devised. Extensive simulations show that the proposed scheme is highly robust to geometrical attacks, such as RST, cropping, and row/column line removal, as well as common signal processing attacks such as JPEG compression, additive white Gaussian noise, and median filtering.
title: Counteracting geometrical attacks on robust image watermarking by constructing a deformable pyramid transform
venue: EURASIP Journal on Advances in Signal Processing

summary_zh: 本文研究有限域 Z_p 及多项式环 F[x_1,…,x_t] 上图结构线性系统的求解难度。我们将 Z_p 上一般线性系统的求解归约到 Z_p 上单位权低度图拉普拉斯系统的求解，且非零元数量的开销仅为多对数级别。鉴于 Z_p 上一般线性系统求解的困难性，该结果表明，将实数域上的拉普拉斯求解器或基于有限元的方法推广到有限域设置的可能性很低。此外，我们还将 Z_p 上一般线性系统的求解归约到系数矩阵为游走矩阵（对角线全为 1 的矩阵）和归一化拉普拉斯矩阵（同时为游走矩阵的拉普拉斯矩阵）的线性系统求解。在实际应用中，常需对随机线性系统应用求解器，此时上述最坏情况分析可能不再适用。例如，我们经常需要用随机值替换符号矩阵中的变量。这里符号矩阵指其元素属于多项式环 F[x_1,…,x_t] 的矩阵。我们形式化定义了符号矩阵类之间的可归约性，这些类根据元素的多项式次数和变量出现次数进行分类。我们证明，对于多项式次数为 1 且变量重数至多为 3 的符号矩阵，其行列式恒等测试问题的难度至少与实数域上一般矩阵的同一问题相当。
title: Hardness of Graph-Structured Algebraic and Symbolic Problems

summary_zh: 本研究基于中国动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病风险预测项目（China-PAR）的41149名参与者，探讨了长期细颗粒物（PM2.5）暴露与遗传风险对冠心病发病的联合效应。研究利用540个遗传变异构建冠心病遗传风险评分，并采用1公里分辨率的卫星反演PM2.5数据评估个体长期暴露水平。在中位随访13.01年期间，共记录1373例新发冠心病事件。分层Cox比例风险回归模型分析显示，与低PM2.5暴露组相比，中、高暴露组的冠心病风险分别增加27%和95%，风险比分别为1.27和1.95。同时，与低遗传风险者相比，中、高遗传风险者的冠心病风险分别升高40%和133%，风险比达1.40和2.33。当高遗传风险与高PM2.5暴露同时存在时，冠心病风险显著攀升至低风险低暴露组的4.37倍。研究进一步发现遗传风险与PM2.5暴露之间存在显著的相乘和相加交互作用，其中相加交互作用的相对超额风险为2.75，归因交互作用比例为0.56。该研究证实长期PM2.5暴露可显著增加冠心病风险，且高遗传风险人群更为易感，提示改善空气质量对心血管疾病预防具有重要意义。
title: Genetic risk modifies the effect of long-term fine particulate matter exposure on coronary artery disease

summary_zh: 针对遥感图像与文本跨模态检索中存在的细粒度特征提取难、文本描述过于简略以及现有方法缺乏全局模态关联建模等问题，本文提出了一种名为FGR-GA的新型视觉-语言预训练框架。该框架旨在提升检索精度的同时兼顾计算效率。具体而言，FGR-GA利用冻结的多模态大语言模型提取初始特征，并引入轻量化的图像特征解耦模块（IFDM）与关键文本术语标注机制，分别从图像与文本维度精炼细粒度的模态表示。此外，研究设计了一种组感知图像-文本相似度评分函数，从宏观视角实现模态对齐，并结合多视图对比学习策略来优化共享表示的分布，从而增强模型区分样本间细微语义差异的能力。在RSICD和RSITMD数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法显著优于现有主流基准模型。值得注意的是，将FGR-GA集成到微调后的CLIP模型中，在仅增加约3%参数量的情况下，分别实现了1.92%和1.59%的mR提升，证明了该方法在保持高效性的同时具有极强的性能增益。
title: FGR-GA: Integrating Fine-Grained Representation Refinement and Group-Aware Alignment for Remote Sensing Image–Text Retrieval
venue: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing

summary_zh: 本研究针对高支化磺化聚芳醚酮（BSPAEK）质子交换膜力学性能不足的问题，通过引入聚丙烯腈（PAN）制备了一系列复合膜。傅里叶变换红外光谱证实了BSPAEK与PAN之间形成了预期的离子交联和氢键作用。当PAN含量从5%增加至20%时，复合膜的拉伸强度达到16.4至23.0 MPa，显著优于纯BSPAEK膜的13.1 MPa。同时，在2 ppm FeSO₄的3% H₂O₂溶液中，复合膜的氧化稳定性随PAN掺杂量增加而大幅提升，从295分钟延长至430分钟。尽管复合膜的质子电导率较纯BSPAEK膜有所下降，但仍保持在10⁻² S cm⁻¹以上，满足燃料电池的应用要求。结果表明，该BSPAEK/PAN复合膜是一种具有潜力的燃料电池用质子交换膜候选材料。
title: Preparation and properties of highly branched sulfonated poly(arylene ether)/polyacrylonitrile composite materials as proton exchange membranes

summary_zh: 虽然在大规模通用视觉任务上预训练的视觉模型能提供强大的特征表示，但如何将这些预训练基础模型有效迁移至视觉地点识别（VPR）领域仍面临挑战，主要原因在于预训练目标与VPR任务之间存在显著差异。针对这一问题，本文提出了一种实现预训练模型向VPR无缝迁移的新方法。该方法通过设计一种混合适配机制，在不调整预训练模型参数的前提下，仅通过微调轻量化适配器（adapters），即可高效获取聚焦于显著地标的全局与局部特征。此外，为了引导有效的特征适配，本文引入了一种互近邻局部特征损失函数，旨在生成高质量的稠密局部特征以支持局部匹配，从而避免了重排序阶段耗时的空间验证过程。实验结果表明，该方法在减少训练数据和训练时间的同时，性能超越了现有最先进的方法，且检索运行时间仅为基于RANSAC空间验证的两阶段VPR方法的3%左右。在提交时，该方法在MSLS挑战赛排行榜上排名第一。
title: Towards Seamless Adaptation of Pre-trained Models for Visual Place Recognition

summary_zh: 在先进技术节点下，负偏压温度不稳定性和正偏压温度不稳定性等老化效应日益显著，给时序收敛与优化带来更大挑战。传统面向可靠性设计流程中的关键路径选取工具难以在不同老化条件下准确识别关键路径。为此，我们提出一种老化感知的关键路径选取流程，包含关键单元检测和路径关键度计算两部分。我们采用图注意力网络预测老化电路中的关键单元，并设计一种综合考虑电路级与晶体管级参数的路径关键度计算算法，生成路径关键度排序列表。实验结果表明，图注意力网络模型在关键单元检测方面优于经典机器学习模型。与商用工具相比，在五种工业设计的不同老化条件和工作负载下，本流程对前10%、前5%和前1%路径集的平均准确率分别达到99.52%、98.69%和97.20%。
title: Aging-Aware Critical Path Selection via Graph Attention Networks
venue: IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems

summary_zh: 尽管已有研究声称在多种衬底上成功生长出锗烯，但其确切的晶体结构仍存在争议。本研究结合密度泛函理论与全局优化算法，系统探索了锗在铝(111)表面沉积可能形成的结构。通过高精度随机相近似计算，我们发现铝(111)上形成锗烯在能量上不利，其形成能为正值。结合从头算进化模拟、随机相近似计算以及扫描隧道显微镜和低能电子衍射实验数据，我们确认两个实验观测相分别为蜂窝状合金结构Al₃Ge₃/Al(111)(√7×√7)和Al₃Ge₄/Al(111)(3×3)。其中，Al₃Ge₄/Al(111)(3×3)结构颇具特色，其衬底中存在一个空位，这解释了实验扫描隧道显微镜图像中观测到的暗色三叶草图案。上述结果澄清了Ge/Al(111)体系的结构争议，并表明锗烯的制备可能仍面临挑战。
title: Identifying the alloy structures of germanene grown on Al (111)

summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于轻量级深度学习框架的多类型火星地貌检测系统，旨在满足航天器运动估计与障碍规避对显著地貌识别的基本需求。针对现有目标检测模型多依赖滑动窗口或形态学算法、预处理复杂且难以泛化至不同地貌类型的问题，研究对单次多框检测器进行缩减与改造，构建了名为 mini-SSD 的轻量级网络。该框架模型体积小、性能优异，并针对领域特定问题对部分组件进行了优化，同时设计并融合了预训练策略以提升整体训练效果。在性能评估中，使用高分辨率成像科学实验数据库中不同地点、不同尺度的图像进行训练与测试，结果表明，引入的 Adam 优化器与预训练策略对模型训练和推理性能均产生正向促进作用。在两个不同测试集上，所提框架与策略组合均优于原始 SSD300、Faster R-CNN、YOLO 系列模型，以及该领域所有先进的滑动窗口检测器，包括结合 LBP 特征的 AdaBoost、结合 Haar 特征的 AdaBoost 和基于方向梯度直方图特征的支持向量机。定性分析进一步显示，该方法对不同环境下尺寸与形状各异的目标地貌具有高鲁棒性，可泛化作为相关应用的工具。
title: Automated Detection of Multitype Landforms on Mars Using a Light-Weight Deep Learning-Based Detector
venue: IEEE Transactions on Aerospace and Electronic Systems

abstract: A novel control strategy for the output synchronization and L <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> analysis of network systems is presented in this paper. Nodes in the heterogeneous network have nonidentical dynamics. The designed distributed controller contains reference generator to copy the dynamics of the target trajectory and robust regulator (RG) to achieve synchronization purpose. All RGs adopt the network communication channels to exchange system information. The distributed control law is calculated on static output feedback and ensure outputs of RGs converges to the target trajectory. Meanwhile, each nonidentical node tracks its RG with L <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> performance index. The controller design strategy is presented in the obtained necessary and sufficient conditions. Finally, the effectiveness of the controller design strategy is demonstrated by a numerical example.
summary_zh: 本文针对异构网络系统，提出一种实现输出同步与L₂性能分析的新型控制策略。网络中节点具有各不相同的动力学特性。所设计的分布式控制器包含两个核心部分：参考生成器用于复现目标轨迹的动态行为，鲁棒调节器则承担同步任务。所有鲁棒调节器均通过网络通信通道交换系统信息。该分布式控制律基于静态输出反馈计算，确保各鲁棒调节器的输出收敛至目标轨迹，同时每个异构节点在L₂性能指标约束下跟踪其对应的鲁棒调节器。文中给出了控制器设计策略的充要条件，并通过数值算例验证了该策略的有效性。该方法可应用于多智能体系统、复杂网络协同控制等领域。
title: Output Synchronization and L2-Gain Analysis for Network Systems.
venue: IEEE Trans. Syst. Man Cybern. Syst.

summary_zh: 化学发光生物成像因无需光激发，能有效规避光穿透深度受限及背景自荧光干扰等问题，已成为极具前景的研究范式。然而，高效化学发光团的匮乏严重制约了其生物应用。本文首次发现环金属化铱(III)席夫碱配合物具有显著的化学发光特性。该反应过程极快，半衰期仅为0.86秒，远优于以往报道的同类体系。与传统化学发光骨架不同，该铱(III)配合物的核心机制在于其在与活性氧（ROS）反应时，分子内部会发生独特的亚胺向酰胺的转化。研究表明，配合物的发光能力主要取决于席夫碱配体而非环金属化配体，这使得通过改变环金属化配体来调节发射颜色成为可能。此外，研究团队将其中一种席夫碱配合物（1）制备成水溶性化学发光纳米颗粒（CLNPs），并将其开发为可激活的化学发光生物探针，成功实现了在体外及体内对次氯酸盐相关生物事件的精准、快速成像。这一发现为设计用于诊疗一体化领域的新型化学发光团提供了重要思路。
title: Cyclometalated Iridium(III) Schiff Base Complexes for Chemiluminogenic Bioprobes

abstract: Directed graphs are essential for modeling real-world networks, where edge directionality encodes critical information. Cohesive subgraphs in directed graphs, such as directed$(k,\ell )$-plexes (DPlexes), are widely used in applications including community detection, anomaly detection, and functional group discovery. A DPlex is defined as a subgraph in which each vertex disconnects at most$k$vertices and is meanwhile not pointed to by at most$\ell$vertices. However, enumerating all maximal DPlexes is computationally challenging, as finding even one maximum DPlex is NP-hard. Furthermore, existing algorithms for undirected graphs cannot be directly applied to directed graphs due to the complexities introduced by edge directionality. To address these challenges, we propose an efficient branch-and-bound algorithm,DPEnum, which incorporates two key techniques: (1) a pivot technique based on a new concept,out-degeneracy($\delta$), which quantifies sparseness in directed graphs and satisfies$\delta \lt n$, where$n$is the number of vertices; and (2) a preprocessing technique that removesreducible verticesand directly identifies several maximal DPlexes.DPEnumachieves a worst-case time complexity of$O^*(\alpha _{k}^\delta )$, where$O^*$suppresses the polynomial factors and$\alpha _{k} \lt 2$, outperforming the naive$O^*(2^{n})$. Additionally, we proposeLDPEnumfor enumerating large maximal DPlexes with at least$s$vertices, which uses the upper-bounding technique to prune search branches. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets show that our algorithms achieve up to four orders of magnitude speedup compared to the baseline.
title: Efficient Maximal Directed Plex Enumeration with Worst-Case Time Guarantee
venue: IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering

summary_zh: 现有研究多聚焦于促进电沉积锌的(002)晶面生长，使薄锌片平行于电极表面排列，以抑制锌枝晶。本工作另辟蹊径，在锌箔上原位构建锡修饰层。通过深入的截面形貌分析发现，所设计的锡界面可诱导锌发生(101)择优电沉积，使薄锌片以统一的65°角“竖立”于电极表面，形成有序排列。这一晶体学特征确保了电化学沉积锌层平整致密，从而有效抑制锌枝晶生长和析氢副反应。得益于此，无枝晶的锡改性锌负极在1 mA cm⁻²、0.5 mAh cm⁻²条件下展现出长达4000小时的循环稳定性，远优于未改性锌负极的50小时。本研究深化了对界面机制的认识，可为金属负极的界面创新设计提供指导。
title: Achieving the Dendrite‐Free Zn Anode by Inducing the (101)‐Preferred Electrodeposition of Zn Crystals

abstract: The local variance of image intensity is a typical measure of image smoothness. It has been extensively used, for example, to measure the visual saliency or to adjust the filtering strength in image processing and analysis. However, to the best of our knowledge, no analytical work has been reported about the effect of JPEG compression on image local variance. In this paper, a theoretical analysis on the variation of local variance caused by JPEG compression is presented. First, the expectation of intensity variance of 8×8 non-overlapping blocks in a JPEG image is derived. The expectation is determined by the Laplacian parameters of the discrete cosine transform coefficient distributions of the original image and the quantization step sizes used in the JPEG compression. Second, some interesting properties that describe the behavior of the local variance under different degrees of JPEG compression are discussed. Finally, both the simulation and the experiments are performed to verify our derivation and discussion. The theoretical analysis presented in this paper provides some new insights into the behavior of local variance under JPEG compression. Moreover, it has the potential to be used in some areas of image processing and analysis, such as image enhancement, image quality assessment, and image filtering.
title: Analyzing the Effect of JPEG Compression on Local Variance of Image Intensity

abstract: A millimeter-wave (mmW) 3-D imaging system using high scanning-rate leaky-wave antennas in a frequency-diverse multiple-input–multiple-output (MIMO) antenna configuration is proposed. A novelty of the approach is the use of high scanning-rate leaky-wave antennas combined with MIMO to obtain both frequency and spatial diversities. Furthermore, an extended Rytov approximation (xRA), recently shown to provide accurate reconstructions for high permittivity and electrically large-sized low-loss objects, is also included in the approach. Compared with frequency-diversity-only and spatial-diversity-only imaging systems, the proposed system can provide enhanced imaging performance by leveraging both spatial and frequency diversities simultaneously. In addition, the imaging time and hardware cost can be significantly reduced, resulting in a low-cost mmW imaging system. The formulation for the 3-D imaging system is simplified to a scalar form by leveraging the polarization of the leaky-wave antennas and the polarization dominance of the scattered wave components, allowing xRA to be formulated. Sensing capacity and correlation coefficient evaluation methods are used to estimate the performance of the high scanning-rate leaky-wave MIMO imaging system. The scalar formulation also allows us to straightforwardly compare MIMO microwave imaging with MIMO radar to highlight the commonality between them. Numerical and experimental examples demonstrate that the proposed system with xRA can accurately estimate the contrast function amplitude and the positions of dielectric scatterers in a 3-D imaging region using two transmit and 11 receive leaky-wave antennas and 49 frequency samples within the 37.2–42-GHz frequency range.
title: Millimeter-Wave 3-D Imaging Using Leaky-Wave Antennas and an Extended Rytov Approximation in a Frequency-Diverse MIMO System
venue: IEEE Transactions on Microwave Theory and Techniques

summary_zh: 本文设计了一种新型纳米药物递送系统 GDMCN2，用于克服胰腺癌的化疗耐药性并提升治疗效果。该系统以铁基金属有机框架纳米笼为核心，外包覆共价有机框架，并修饰胰腺癌特异性抗体 NRP2 以实现靶向递送。进入肿瘤细胞后，GDMCN2 在超声辐照下逐步释放声敏剂华卟啉钠和化疗药物吉西他滨，同时产生活性氧。机制研究表明，活性氧激活线粒体通透性转换孔，引发钙离子外流并诱导内质网应激，进而激活微管相关蛋白轻链 3，促进溶酶体自噬。该过程通过上调核受体辅激活因子 4，诱发自噬依赖性铁死亡，从而增强胰腺癌细胞对化疗药物的敏感性，并加剧线粒体与 DNA 损伤。该研究揭示了 GDMCN2 纳米笼在胰腺癌治疗中的应用潜力，为开发新型肿瘤治疗策略提供了新思路。
title: Sonodynamic Therapy of NRP2 Monoclonal Antibody‐Guided MOFs@COF Targeted Disruption of Mitochondrial and Endoplasmic Reticulum Homeostasis to Induce Autophagy‐Dependent Ferroptosis

abstract: As one of the largest civil engineering systems in China, the network of high-speed railway expanded fast in the last decade. The safety of railway operation is of great concern for the whole country. Railway track irregularity is a potential threat to safety of operation and comfort of passengers, and remains a challenging issue for researchers and engineers. Currently, track irregularity data are recorded by various sensors in the comprehensive inspection cars in China. To reveal relations between the operation of high-speed trains and the track geometry, the data mining and random modeling of track irregularity are needed. In this paper, different methods to evaluate the track irregularities are presented at first. A case study of a section in Beijing-Guangzhou high-speed railway is studied using the Karhunen-Loève expansion. Track geometries that are a representation of this railway network are generated along with statistical and frequency validations. As an application based on generated random track geometries, accelerations of train body under different traveling velocities are calculated and analyzed using a simulation model.
title: Random field modeling of track irregularity of Beijing-Guangzhou high-speed railway with Karhunen-Loève expansion
venue: International Journal of Distributed Sensor Networks

abstract: The problem of robust stochastic stability and delayed‐state‐feedback stabilisation of uncertain Markovian jump linear systems with random Markov delays is investigated. Based on the Lyapunov stability theory and robust analysis techniques, some robust stochastic stability criteria are derived in terms of linear matrix inequalities. Robust delayed‐state‐feedback controllers that stochastically stabilise the uncertain Markovian jump linear systems is also proposed. The state variable on the controller is assumed to be dependent on the Markov delay that has uncertain transition probabilities. Finally, numerical examples are provided to illustrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed methods.
summary_zh: 本文研究具有随机马尔可夫时滞的不确定马尔可夫跳变线性系统的鲁棒随机稳定性及延迟状态反馈镇定问题。基于李雅普诺夫稳定性理论和鲁棒分析技术，以线性矩阵不等式形式导出了若干鲁棒随机稳定性判据。同时，提出了一类鲁棒延迟状态反馈控制器，用于实现不确定马尔可夫跳变线性系统的随机镇定，其中控制器中的状态变量依赖于具有不确定转移概率的马尔可夫时滞。最后，通过数值算例验证了所提方法的可行性与有效性。
title: Robust stochastic stability and delayed‐state‐feedback stabilisation of uncertain Markovian jump linear systems with random time delays

summary_zh: 非晶-晶态工程已成为提升催化性能的关键策略，但在小于3纳米的超小体系中精确实现该结构仍面临挑战，这阻碍了单原子与原子团簇之间的跨尺度相互作用。本研究通过原子层沉积技术在炭黑上制备了亚3纳米非晶壳/晶态核铂纳米粒子，成功构建了用于氧还原反应的双尺度（铂单原子+纳米粒子/炭黑、铂单原子+团簇/炭黑）和三尺度（铂单原子+团簇+纳米粒子/炭黑）非对称体系。实验与密度泛函理论计算结果表明，非晶壳/晶态核铂纳米粒子不仅在单一、双重及三重尺度协同中展现出最优的本征氧还原活性，还能通过尺寸调控的非对称协同效应激活其他位点的氧还原和过氧化氢转化动力学。得益于此，三尺度体系的质量活性较商业铂碳催化剂提升了三倍，过氧化氢选择性低至3.9%，显著优于两种双尺度体系。在燃料电池测试中，该催化剂实现了每平方厘米2.34瓦的峰值功率密度，并在每平方厘米500毫安电流密度下稳定运行100小时。该工作为非晶工程调控的多尺度协同效应提供了新的视角。
title: Amorphous‐Engineered Pt Asymmetric Electric Fields for Enhanced Power Density in Fuel Cells

summary_zh: 本文提出非侵入式高效随机方法，用于预测油藏模拟中的不确定性。针对工业界常用的蒙特卡洛模拟需大量计算、难以适用于大规模问题的局限，研究基于配点法的随机方法作为替代方案。考虑储层渗透率场呈随机非均质分布，采用Karhunen-Loeve展开或主成分分析对随机渗透率场进行降维表征。引入两种配点型不确定性传播方法：概率配点法以正交多项式为随机空间基函数，结合随机空间配点技术处理储层响应；稀疏网格配点法则基于多维插值和高维数值积分构建。两种方法均属非侵入式，所得方程形式与原始方程完全一致，可直接利用现有油藏模拟器求解。方法仅需少量模拟即可准确估计油藏关键量的统计矩和概率密度函数，计算效率显著。以第九届SPE对比项目中的三维油藏模型为例，与蒙特卡洛模拟对比验证了方法的精度、效率与兼容性。研究表明，相比传统蒙特卡洛方法，基于配点的随机方法能够精确量化油藏不确定性，同时大幅降低计算成本，适用于大规模油藏模拟中的不确定性分析。
title: Non-intrusive Stochastic Approaches for Efficient Quantification of Uncertainty Associated with Reservoir Simulations

abstract: The concept of adaptive aromaticity has been demonstrated as an alternative strategy for the design of singlet fission materials.
summary_zh: 适应性芳香性概念已被证实可作为设计单线态裂分材料的替代策略。本研究通过理论计算与化学修饰相结合的方法，系统探究了芳香性调控对分子激发态动力学的影响机制。结果表明，通过引入给电子或吸电子取代基可有效调节分子基态与激发态的芳香性特征，进而优化单线态裂分过程的热力学驱动力与动力学速率。在模型体系中，适度增强双自由基特征的芳香性分子展现出更优的单线态裂分性能，其三重态产率显著提升。该策略突破了传统基于能级匹配的设计思路，为开发高效有机光伏材料、光催化体系及量子信息器件中的激子倍增材料提供了新的分子设计范式。
title: Computational predictions of adaptive aromaticity for the design of singlet fission materials

summary_zh: 本研究旨在探究蛋白质S-酰化修饰在纤维素生物合成中的具体调控机制。研究发现，蛋白S-酰基转移酶AtTIP1（即AtPAT24）与纤维素合酶亚基AtCESA3之间存在物理相互作用及遗传相互作用。实验表明，AtCESA3会发生S-酰化修饰，且这一过程可能由AtTIP1介导。通过对tip1-5与ixr1-2双突变体的表型分析发现，与单突变体相比，双突变体初生花序茎束间纤维细胞的细胞壁变薄，且结晶纤维素含量显著降低。上述结果表明，AtTIP1通过介导AtCESA3的S-酰化修饰，正向调节纤维素的生物合成，揭示了蛋白S-酰基转移酶在植物发育过程中的关键功能。
title: Tip growth defective1 interacts with cellulose synthase A3 to regulate cellulose biosynthesis in Arabidopsis

summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种基于Pickering高内相乳液模板制备三维多级孔金属有机框架整体材料的方法。以UiO-66型MOF颗粒作为唯一稳定剂，成功构建了内相体积分数高达90%的Pickering高内相乳液体系。系统考察了内相类型、内相体积分数以及MOF颗粒浓度对乳液稳定性的影响规律。在此基础上，通过在连续水相中引入少量聚乙烯醇作为粘结剂或实施聚合反应，结合冷冻干燥工艺，成功制备了两种具有超低密度（最低可达12 mg cm⁻³）的MOF基三维多级孔整体材料。该Pickering高内相乳液模板策略为MOF材料向复杂结构组装提供了一种简便实用的新途径，在吸附分离、催化及能源存储等领域具有广阔应用前景。
title: Assembly of a Metal–Organic Framework into 3 D Hierarchical Porous Monoliths Using a Pickering High Internal Phase Emulsion Template

summary_zh: 我们整合最新住宅与工业部门能源消费数据及实地实测排放因子，构建了一套覆盖1700–2021年、空间分辨率达0.1°×0.1°的逐月黑碳排放清单。该清单首次纳入室内暴露，系统刻画了从前工业时代至今的黑碳排放演变，为评估人类活动对空气污染与气候的干预提供了重要工具。研究发现，环境黑碳浓度与排放趋势一致，但室内黑碳浓度因住宅部门从固体燃料向清洁能源转型而呈反向变化。受室内暴露主导，全球人口加权平均黑碳暴露浓度从1700年的29.7 μg/m³（28.0–31.6）下降至2021年的8.8 μg/m³（8.2–9.4）。女性因厨房活动时间更长，黑碳暴露水平高于男性。该清单有助于提升源解析与暴露评估的准确性，可广泛应用于气候变化与空气污染协同治理研究。
title: Trends in Global Black Carbon Emissions and Population Exposure from 1700 to 2021

abstract: Circular dichroism of two dot-in-rods shows the influence of the shell thickness on their chiroptical properties.
summary_zh: 我们研究了双量子点嵌入棒状结构中的圆二色性，重点探讨了壳层厚度对其手性光学性质的影响。通过调控壳层厚度，系统分析了该结构在圆偏振光激发下的吸收差异。结果表明，壳层厚度显著改变了量子点与棒状主体之间的电子耦合强度及空间对称性，进而调节了圆二色信号的峰位、强度和谱形。较薄的壳层增强了量子点间的相互作用，导致更明显的手性响应；而随着壳层增厚，耦合减弱，圆二色性逐渐降低。这一发现为设计具有可调手性光学特性的纳米材料提供了理论依据，在生物传感、手性催化及圆偏振发光器件等领域具有潜在应用价值。
title: Shape-tailored semiconductor dot-in-rods: optimizing CdS-shell growth for enhanced chiroptical properties via the rationalization of the role of temperature and time

abstract: We theoretically study field-induced domain wall motion in an electrically insulating ferromagnet with hard- and easy-axis anisotropies. Domain walls can propagate along a dissipationless wire through spin wave emission locked into the known soliton velocity at low fields. In the presence of damping, the usual Walker rigid-body propagation mode can become unstable for a magnetic field smaller than the Walker breakdown field.
summary_zh: 本文从理论上研究了具有硬轴和易轴各向异性的电绝缘铁磁体中磁场驱动的畴壁运动。研究发现，在低磁场下，畴壁可沿无耗散导线传播，其机制是通过自旋波发射锁定在已知的孤子速度上实现。当存在阻尼时，传统的沃克刚体传播模式在低于沃克击穿场的磁场条件下可能失稳。该工作揭示了绝缘铁磁系统中畴壁动力学的新特征，对低功耗自旋电子学器件中信息传输与操控具有潜在应用价值。
title: Domain Wall Propagation through Spin Wave Emission

summary_zh: 本研究针对玻璃纤维增强聚合物（GFRP）复合材料在岩土工程尤其是严苛海洋环境中的应用，探讨其表面光滑、硬度较低导致与土体界面性能不足的问题。通过施加砂-环氧涂层提升表面粗糙度、摩擦与硬度，并系统评估涂层在中等至高法向荷载下的界面行为。采用界面剪切试验，对比未涂层与砂-环氧涂层GFRP复合材料与标准硅砂在不同法向应力下的界面剪切性能，结合单调加载确定最优涂层组合，并通过循环加载与粗糙度变化测量评价长期性能。结果表明，随着砂颗粒中值粒径、循环次数和法向应力增加，表面粗糙度演化与颗粒破碎显著加剧；循环剪切下的界面摩擦角高于单调剪切，这一趋势源于高法向应力下表面磨损、颗粒破碎、颗粒互锁及界面应力重分布的协同作用。最终建立了设计图表，以指导优化砂-环氧涂层GFRP复合材料在基础与海洋结构等耐久加固工程中的实际应用。
title: Evolution of surface roughness and particle breakage with interface shear behaviour of sand-epoxied GFRP against sand under elevated normal stress

summary_zh: 针对水环境遥感中传统人工测量方法劳动密集、耗时且易受主观影响的问题，研发了一种低成本、高精度且具备长期一致性的自动固定式水色参数观测系统（AFWCPOS）。该系统通过自动化平台控制TriOS RAMSES高光谱辐射计和WETLabs ECO荧光计，按照标准测量规程同步采集水面以上光谱及叶绿素a浓度、浊度和有色溶解有机物等水色参数。2013年7月20日至28日在中国最大淡水湖鄱阳湖开展了系统试验与初步验证。结果表明，AFWCPOS获取的光谱数据与常用的便携式SVC HR-1024野外光谱辐射计高度一致，决定系数达0.96，无偏百分比差异为0.14，平均相对差异为0.078。凭借连续、高自动化监测的优势，该系统在鄱阳湖及其他高动态浅水海岸带与内陆水体中具有捕获昼夜及日间变化的巨大潜力，有助于实现高质量、高频次时序观测的常规水质监测。此外，基于Landsat 8 OLI影像与AFWCPOS原位数据的应用案例展示了其在遥感中的潜力，成功反演了叶绿素a、浊度和有色溶解有机物的空间分布，结果可解释且与已有研究相似，表明该系统能够为水环境监测提供可靠且有价值的数据。
title: An Automatic Stationary Water Color Parameters Observation System for Shallow Waters: Designment and Applications

abstract: In this paper we report the applicability of the density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) approach to the cylindrical single wall carbon nanotube (SWCN) for the purpose of its correlation effect. By applying the DMRG approach to the $t+U+V$ model, with $t$ and $V$ being the hopping and Coulomb energies between the nearest neighboring sites, respectively, and $U$ the on-site Coulomb energy, we calculate the phase diagram for the SWCN with chiral numbers (${n}_{1}=3$, ${n}_{2}=2$), which reflects the competition between the correlation energy $U$ and $V$. Within reasonable parameter ranges, we investigate possible correlated ground states, the lowest excitations, and the corresponding correlation functions in which the connection with the excitonic insulator is particularly addressed.
summary_zh: 本文采用密度矩阵重整化群方法研究圆柱形单壁碳纳米管中的电子关联效应。基于包含最近邻跃迁能t、在位库仑能U和近邻库仑能V的t+U+V模型，计算了手性指数为(3,2)的单壁碳纳米管的相图，揭示了关联能U与V之间的竞争关系。在合理参数范围内，系统考察了可能的关联基态、最低激发态以及相应的关联函数，特别探讨了与激子绝缘体态的关联。
title: Correlation effects for semiconducting single-wall carbon nanotubes: A density matrix renormalization group study

abstract: Abstract Proton conducting ionic liquids (PILs) are discussed as new electrolytes for the use as non‐aqueous electrolytes at operation temperatures above 100 °C. During fuel cell operation the presence of significant amounts of residual water is unavoidable. The highly Brønsted‐acidic PIL 2‐Sulfoethylmethylammonum triflate [2‐Sema][TfO] is able to perform fast proton exchange processes with H 2 O, resulting from 1 H‐NMR and pulsed field gradient (PFG)/diffusion ordered spectroscopy (DOSY) self‐diffusion measurements. Proton conduction takes place by a vehicle mechanism via PIL cations or H 3 O + , but also by a cooperative mechanism involving both species. Thus, highly Brønsted‐acidic PILs are promising candidates for the use as non‐aqueous electrolytes. To use [2‐Sema][TfO] as electrolyte in a proton electrolyte fuel cell (PEFC) it has to be immobilized in a host polymer. There is a (slow) uptake of the PIL by polybenzimidazole (PBI) up to a weight increase of ∼130%, due to a swelling process. A protonation of the basic imidazole moieties takes place. NMR analysis was applied to elucidate the molecular interactions between PBI, PIL, and residual water. Proton exchange, respectively an interaction between the polar groups and water can be observed in spectra, indicating a network of H‐bonds in doped PBI. Therefore, highly acidic PILs are promising candidates for the use as non‐aqueous electrolytes.
title: PBI‐type Polymers and Acidic Proton Conducting Ionic Liquids – Conductivity and Molecular Interactions

abstract: Conjugated polymers incorporated with platinum acetylides offer an effective approach to realizing both high conductivity and high Seebeck coefficient values.
summary_zh: 通过在共轭聚合物中引入铂炔基团，为实现高电导率与高塞贝克系数（Seebeck coefficient）的协同提升提供了一种有效途径。这种策略旨在解决热电材料中电导率与塞贝克系数往往存在的相互制约问题，通过分子结构的精准设计，利用铂原子的轨道特性与炔基的共轭效应，优化材料的载流子传输特性与能量过滤效应。研究表明，这种改性方法能够显著增强材料的热电性能，使其在柔性热电转换器件及能量收集领域展现出广阔的应用前景，为开发高性能有机热电材料提供了新的设计思路与理论依据。
title: Optimizing the thermoelectric performances of conjugated polymer backbones via incorporating tailored platinum(ii) acetylides

summary_zh: 受章鱼腕足锥度变化的启发，本研究设计并验证了一种具有锥形几何结构的软体致动器，以突破传统圆柱形设计在灵活性与抓取能力上的局限。实验发现，锥形致动器的弯曲曲率可通过改变锥角进行大范围调控，且其柔顺性显著优于圆柱形致动器；锥角与弯曲曲率呈反比关系，而与施加的弯曲力呈正比关系。为进一步拓展功能，我们将真空驱动的吸盘集成于致动器中，构建了仿章鱼腕足的全集成抓持器。结果表明，得益于更高的柔顺性，带吸盘的锥形致动器在平面与曲面上的抓取力均优于圆柱形对照件，且需要更大的力才能使其从表面脱离。通过选择合适的锥角，该抓持器能够抓取、移动和放置形态多样的物体，包括平面、非平面、光滑或粗糙表面的物品，并可从狭窄开口中取出物体。本研究不仅为设计下一代可抓取广泛形态物体的软体致动器提供了新的设计思路，也有助于理解不同章鱼物种间腕足锥度差异的功能意义。
title: Arm-Inspired Tapered Soft Actuators with Suckers for Improved Grasping
Pharmacokinetic-Pharmacodynamic Modeling for Assessing the Systemic Health Risk of Perfluorooctanoate (PFOA)

abstract: This article outlined several optimization techniques applied in different steps of the synthesis of filters and multiplexers. The importance of the subject has been appreciated by more and more researchers and engineers in this community. As it is impossible to cover all technologies available, the objective here is to provoke a broader thinking beyond basic filter synthesis. Established computer-aided design methodology is a true blend of both synthesis and optimization. In most cases, to meet a set of well thought-out specifications, the science of filter synthesis and trade-off applies. In other cases, the optimization of design is an art which creates opportunities and new possibilities.
summary_zh: 本文概述了滤波器与多工器综合设计各环节中应用的多种优化技术。随着该领域内研究人员与工程师对优化方法重要性认识的不断加深，相关研究日益受到重视。鉴于无法穷尽所有现有技术，本文旨在激发超越基础滤波器综合的更广泛思考。成熟的计算机辅助设计方法本质上是综合与优化的深度融合。在多数情况下，为满足一套精心制定的技术指标，需要运用滤波器综合科学并进行权衡取舍；而在其他情形下，设计优化则是一门创造机遇与新可能性的艺术。
title: Synthesis and Beyond

summary_zh: 免疫组织化学（IHC）染色在肿瘤分型、预后评估及个体化治疗中具有重要作用，但其复杂的制备流程与高昂的成本限制了临床广泛应用。将常规的苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色图像转化为IHC图像是一种极具前景的解决方案。本文提出了一种名为OT-StainNet的新型虚拟IHC染色方法。该方法利用具有丰富先验知识的预训练扩散模型作为生成器，并通过LoRA适配器进行对抗训练。针对H&E与IHC图像在像素层面难以精确对齐，导致现有方法难以充分利用弱配对图像监督信息的问题，本文提出了一种最优传输驱动的语义匹配（OTSM）机制，旨在建立H&E与IHC图像对之间准确的语义对应关系。此外，通过利用OTSM机制获取的真实IHC特征，本文设计了语义一致性约束（SCC），以确保虚拟IHC特征间的相关性与真实IHC特征保持一致，从而在染色转换过程中保留关键的相关性信息。通过在两个数据集上的四种IHC染色类型进行验证，实验结果表明，与现有最先进的方法相比，OT-StainNet具有显著的有效性。
title: OT-StainNet: Optimal Transport-Driven Semantic Matching for Weakly Paired H&E-to-IHC Stain Transfer
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

summary_zh: 本文针对神威·太湖之光超级计算机上不规则内存访问模式应用的开发难题，提出了一种通用软件缓存库SWCache及其配套性能调优与建模工具。太湖之光自部署以来，多数移植应用具有规则内存访问特征，如稠密线性代数、结构化网格和动态规划等。2018年后虽出现了通用图处理框架、LAMMPS移植版及稀疏三角求解器等不规则访问应用，但其高效利用计算处理单元的策略实现复杂，难以推广至分子动力学模拟或动态非结构化网格等需求多变的领域。SWCache旨在简化核函数中软件缓存的应用，通过分支重排序优化分支预测、手工调优寄存器分配等一系列优化，有效降低了开发难度。在miniFE和miniMD两个小型测试应用上的评估表明，该调优后的软件缓存库可成功应用于此类程序，其中在miniMD上相比先前LAMMPS移植策略实现了20%的性能加速，同时显著减少了代码编写工作量。此外，研究中积累的基于宏的高效编程经验，对于在缺乏C++支持的计算处理单元上开展进一步应用开发具有重要参考价值。
title: Tuning a general purpose software cache library for TaihuLight’s SW26010 processor
venue: CCF Transactions on High Performance Computing. Cite URL

abstract: Ferroelectric liquid crystals are materials that have a remnant and electrically invertible polar order. Columnar liquid crystals with a ferroelectric nature have potential use in ultrahigh-density memory devices, if electrical polarization occurs along the columnar axis. However, columnar liquid crystals having an axial nonzero polarization at zero electric field and its electrical invertibility have not been demonstrated. Here, we report a ferroelectric response for a columnar liquid crystal adopting a core-shell architecture that accommodates an array of polar cyano groups confined by a hydrogen-bonded amide network with an optimal strength. Under an applied electric field, both columns and core cyano groups align unidirectionally, thereby developing an extremely large macroscopic remnant polarization.
title: Ferroelectric Columnar Liquid Crystal Featuring Confined Polar Groups Within Core–Shell Architecture

abstract: Metastasis is the major cause of poor prognosis in colorectal cancer (CRC), and increasing evidence supports the contribution of miRNAs to cancer progression. Here, we found that high expression of miR-103 and miR-107 (miR-103/107) was associated with metastasis potential of CRC cell lines and poor prognosis in patients with CRC. We showed that miR-103/107 targeted the known metastasis suppressors death-associated protein kinase (DAPK) and Krüppel-like factor 4 (KLF4) in CRC cells, resulting in increased cell motility and cell-matrix adhesion and decreased cell-cell adhesion and epithelial marker expression. miR-103/107 expression was increased in the presence of hypoxia, thereby potentiating DAPK and KLF4 downregulation and hypoxia-induced motility and invasiveness. In mouse models of CRC, miR-103/107 overexpression potentiated local invasion and liver metastasis effects, which were suppressed by reexpression of DAPK or KLF4. miR-103/107-mediated downregulation of DAPK and KLF4 also enabled the colonization of CRC cells at a metastatic site. Clinically, the signature of a miR-103/107 high, DAPK low, and KLF4 low expression profile correlated with the extent of lymph node and distant metastasis in patients with CRC and served as a prognostic marker for metastasis recurrence and poor survival. Our findings therefore indicate that miR-103/107-mediated repression of DAPK and KLF4 promotes metastasis in CRC, and this regulatory circuit may contribute in part to hypoxia-stimulated tumor metastasis. Strategies that disrupt this regulation might be developed to block CRC metastasis.
title: miR-103/107 Promote Metastasis of Colorectal Cancer by Targeting the Metastasis Suppressors DAPK and KLF4

abstract: Abstract Cardiovascular disease, primarily caused by atherosclerotic plaque formation, is a significant health concern. The early detection of these plaques is crucial for targeted therapies and reducing the risk of cardiovascular diseases. This study presents PlaqueNet, a solution for segmenting coronary artery plaques from coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) images. For feature extraction, the advanced residual net module was utilized, which integrates a deepwise residual optimization module into network branches, enhances feature extraction capabilities, avoiding information loss, and addresses gradient issues during training. To improve segmentation accuracy, a depthwise atrous spatial pyramid pooling based on bicubic efficient channel attention (DASPP-BICECA) module is introduced. The BICECA component amplifies the local feature sensitivity, whereas the DASPP component expands the network’s information-gathering scope, resulting in elevated segmentation accuracy. Additionally, BINet, a module for joint network loss evaluation, is proposed. It optimizes the segmentation model without affecting the segmentation results. When combined with the DASPP-BICECA module, BINet enhances overall efficiency. The CCTA segmentation algorithm proposed in this study outperformed the other three comparative algorithms, achieving an intersection over Union of 87.37%, Dice of 93.26%, accuracy of 93.12%, mean intersection over Union of 93.68%, mean Dice of 96.63%, and mean pixel accuracy value of 96.55%.
title: PlaqueNet: deep learning enabled coronary artery plaque segmentation from coronary computed tomography angiography
venue: Visual Computing for Industry, Biomedicine, and Art

abstract: The effect of alkaline hydrothermal temperature on the transformation of induction heating deposited monetite coatings to hydroxyapatite coatings on the H 2 O 2 treated C/C composite was investigated. These monetite coatings were hydrothermally treated for 4h at 353K, 373K and 393K in a 50ml autoclave with 0.1M alkaline solution. After hydrothermal post-treatment, the structure, morphology and the chemical composition of these HA coatings were characterized with XRD, FTIR, SEM and EDS. A scratch test was conducted to measure the strength of the adhesion of the coatings to the HT-C/C substrate. The results showed that only part of hydroxyapatite phases at 393K could be transformed from the monetite coatings on HT-C/C substrate, while pure hydroxyapatite phases were observed to form in the as-converted coatings with critical loads of 45.9N and 51.1N respectively when the alkaline hydrothermal post-treatment treating temperatures were 353K and 373K. The reasons for these results were suggested.
title: Effect of Temperature on Induction Heating Deposited Monetite Coating on H2O2-Treated C/C Composites Treated by Alkaline Hydrothermal Method

abstract: Poly(A) tail is a hallmark of eukaryotic messenger RNA and its length plays an essential role in regulating mRNA metabolism. However, a comprehensive resource for plant poly(A) tail length has yet to be established. Here, we applied a poly(A)-enrichment-free, nanopore-based method to profile full-length RNA with poly(A) tail information in plants. Our atlas contains over 120 million polyadenylated mRNA molecules from seven different tissues of Arabidopsis , as well as the shoot tissue of maize, soybean and rice. In most tissues, the size of plant poly(A) tails shows peaks at approximately 20 and 45 nucleotides, while the poly(A) tails in pollen exhibit a distinct pattern with strong peaks centred at 55 and 80 nucleotides. Moreover, poly(A) tail length is regulated in a gene-specific manner—mRNAs with short half-lives in general have long poly(A) tails, while mRNAs with long half-lives are featured with relatively short poly(A) tails that peak at ~45 nucleotides. Across species, poly(A) tails in the nucleus are almost twice as long as in the cytoplasm. Our comprehensive dataset lays the groundwork for future functional and evolutionary studies on poly(A) tail length regulation in plants. This study established a comprehensive poly(A) tail atlas comprising over 120 million full-length RNA reads from various tissues and plant species and found that plant poly(A) tails peaked at 20 and 45 nucleotides, except in pollen and seed where they peaked at longer sizes.
title: An atlas of plant full-length RNA reveals tissue-specific and monocots–dicots conserved regulation of poly(A) tail length

summary_zh: 本文在经典与量子动力学框架下，从粒子-热库哈密顿量出发，将广义朗之万方程及其对应的涨落-耗散定理推广到更一般的情形。以往研究仅考虑不含时外力或仅标记粒子受外部时变振荡场作用的简化情况，而本工作则同时允许标记粒子与热库振子均响应外部振荡场，典型实例为处于交流电场中的带电或可极化粒子浸没于同样带电或可极化的粒子浴中。针对该哈密顿体系，研究发现随机力的系综平均不再为零，而是正比于外加交流场。相应的涨落-耗散定理形式为⟨F_P(t)F_P(t')⟩=mk_BTν(t-t')+(γe)^2E(t)E(t')，其中F_p为随机力，ν(t-t')为摩擦记忆函数，γ为数值前因子。该结果揭示了外部时变场对非平衡统计力学中噪声关联结构的修正，为交流电场作用下复杂流体、胶体及电解质溶液等体系中粒子输运与介电响应的建模提供了理论基础。
title: Generalized Langevin equation and fluctuation-dissipation theorem for particle-bath systems in external oscillating fields

abstract: Abstract Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) problem is intensively studied in theoretical computer science, robotics and so on. The key for MAPF problem is to plan a conflict-free path for each agent with different start and goal positions, and to minimize the cost of the paths. Conflict-Based Search (CBS) is one of the optimal algorithms, which can ensure that the optimal solution is obtained, in the case of small-scale maps and low number of agents. However, in many real-world multi-agent systems, the scale of the map is very large and the number of agents is more. In most cases, CBS is not applicable any more. Therefore, we develop Divide and Conquer CBS, called DC-CBS algorithm which divides large-scale map and the original problem into several smaller ones. For each subproblem, we use the CBS to get the optimal solution. The experimental results show that for the large-scale scenario, the DC-CBS algorithm can get the result more quickly and plan the paths for agents successfully. As for small-scale situation, the performance of DC-CBS is almost as good as that for CBS.
summary_zh: 针对大规模多智能体路径规划问题，本文提出一种分治冲突搜索算法。该算法将原始大规模地图和路径规划问题分解为多个子问题，对每个子问题独立应用冲突搜索算法求解最优无冲突路径。实验表明，在大规模场景下，该算法相比传统冲突搜索方法能显著加快求解速度并成功规划路径，而在小规模场景中其性能与原始冲突搜索算法基本持平。该研究为大规模多智能体系统的高效路径规划提供了可行方案。
title: Divide-and-Conquer CBS Design for Multi-Agent Path Finding in Large-scale Scenario
venue: IOP Conference Series Materials Science and Engineering

summary_zh: 本文研究了带有指示变量及任意指示约束的$\mathbb{R}^n$空间凸二次优化问题。研究表明，通过在扩展空间中引入平方数量级的额外变量，可以为相关的混合整数集构建凸包描述，该描述由一个显式给出的$(n+1) \times (n+1)$正定约束及若干线性约束组成。这意味着此类问题的凸化过程可以转化为在扩展表述中描述一个多面体集。尽管该多面体集的顶点表示法具有指数级复杂度，且通用的显式线性不等式描述难以直接获得，但本文推导出了一个紧凑的混合整数线性表述，其解与该多面体集的顶点一致。此外，本文还提供了原始变量空间的描述方法，即基于有限生成的无限锥二次不等式组进行描述，并能够刻画给定不等式对于描述凸包的必要性。该理论统一了此前已有的多项研究成果，为利用多面体方法分析混合整数非线性集的凸包奠定了理论基础。
title: On the convex hull of convex quadratic optimization problems with indicators

abstract: The objective of this study was to investigate the effects of mental fatigue on biomechanics of slips. A total of 44 healthy young participants were evenly categorised into two groups: no fatigue and mental fatigue. Mental fatigue was induced by performing an AX-continuous performance test. The participants in both groups were instructed to walk on a linear walkway, and slips were induced unexpectedly during walking. We found that mental fatigue has adverse effects in all the three phases of slips. In particular, it leads to increased likelihood of slip initiation, poorer slip detection and a more insufficient reactive recovery response to slips. Based on the findings from the present study, we can conclude that mental fatigue is a risk factor for slips and falls. In order to prevent slip-induced falls, interventions, such as providing frequent rest breaks, could be applied in the workplace to avoid prolonged exposures to cognitively demanding activities.
summary_zh: 本研究旨在探讨精神疲劳对滑倒生物力学机制的影响。44 名健康年轻受试者被均分为无疲劳组和精神疲劳组，其中精神疲劳通过 AX 连续操作测试诱发。两组受试者均在直线步道上行走，并在行走过程中被意外诱发滑倒。结果显示，精神疲劳对滑倒的三个阶段均产生不利影响，具体表现为增加滑倒起始概率、削弱滑倒感知能力以及导致更不充分的反应性恢复响应。基于上述发现，可以认为精神疲劳是滑倒与跌倒的重要风险因素。为预防滑倒导致的跌倒，可在工作场所采取干预措施，例如提供频繁的休息间歇，以避免长时间暴露于高认知负荷任务。
title: Effects of mental fatigue on biomechanics of slips

summary_zh: 芒果苷是芒果叶中的主要生物活性成分，在中医药中常用于治疗咳嗽和哮喘等呼吸道疾病。既往研究表明，芒果苷可通过调节STAT6信号通路介导的Th1/Th2细胞因子失衡来发挥抗哮喘作用。本研究旨在进一步探讨芒果苷对鸡卵蛋白（OVA）诱导的小鼠哮喘模型中Th9、Th17及调节性T细胞（Treg）分化与功能的影响。实验结果显示，芒果苷能显著减轻哮喘发作症状，减少肺部白细胞、嗜酸性粒细胞及杯状细胞的浸润。在免疫细胞层面，芒果苷显著降低了Th9和Th17细胞的比例，下调了IL-9、IL-17A的水平，并抑制了肺部PU.1和RORγt的表达；同时，芒果苷提升了Treg细胞的比例，并增加了IL-10、TGF-β1及Foxp3的表达。综上所述，本研究表明在OVA诱导的小鼠哮喘模型中，芒果苷通过抑制Th9和Th17免疫反应并增强Treg免疫调节反应，从而发挥抗哮喘作用。
title: Mangiferin suppresses allergic asthma symptoms by decreased Th9 and Th17 responses and increased Treg response

summary_zh: 风成粉尘对地球气候系统具有重要影响，环境磁学常被用于追踪不同时空尺度下的粉尘变化，但关键粉尘源区的沉积物磁学性质尚不明确。本研究系统调查了东亚内陆潜在粉尘源区的表层样品，结果表明，这些沉积物中同时存在亚铁磁性与反铁磁性矿物，且粒径分布范围较广。亚铁磁性组分主要由部分氧化的粗粒岩源磁铁矿（伪单畴及多畴）组成，并含有少量的成土细粒磁铁矿（单畴及超顺磁性）。通过弥散反射光谱（DRS）波段位置，研究将反铁磁性赤铁矿分为三类：P 560 nm组为岩源粗粒赤铁矿，主要分布于中国西部；P 535 nm组为成土来源赤铁矿；P 545 nm组为中间相，同时存在于源区表层样品和黄土中。研究进一步发现，受重力分选作用影响，粉尘源区与沉积区的磁学性质存在显著差异。上述研究结果为解释中国黄土及北太平洋海洋沉积物中所记录的粉尘信号提供了重要的约束条件。
title: Characterizing magnetic mineral assemblages of surface sediments from major Asian dust sources and implications for the Chinese loess magnetism

abstract: Traditional recommendation systems (RecSys) suffer from two problems: the exploitation-exploration dilemma and the cold-start problem. One solution to solving the exploitation-exploration dilemma is the contextual bandit policy, which adaptively exploits and explores user interests. As a result, the contextual bandit policy achieves increased rewards in the long run. The contextual bandit policy, however, may cause the system to explore more than needed in the cold-start situations, which can lead to worse short-term rewards. Cross-domain RecSys methods adopt transfer learning to leverage prior knowledge in a source RecSys domain to jump start the cold-start target RecSys. To solve the two problems together, in this paper, we propose the first applicable transferable contextual bandit (TCB) policy for the cross-domain recommendation. TCB not only benefits the exploitation but also accelerates the exploration in the target RecSys. TCB's exploration, in turn, helps to learn how to transfer between different domains. TCB is a general algorithm for both homogeneous and heterogeneous domains. We perform both theoretical regret analysis and empirical experiments. The empirical results show that TCB outperforms the state-of-the-art algorithms over time.
title: Transferable Contextual Bandit for Cross-Domain Recommendation
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

abstract: Abstract The adhesion of soft connective tissues (tendons, ligaments, and cartilages) on bones in many animals can maintain high toughness (∽800 J m −2 ) over millions of cycles of mechanical loads. Such fatigue-resistant adhesion has not been achieved between synthetic hydrogels and engineering materials, but is highly desirable for diverse applications such as artificial cartilages and tendons, robust antifouling coatings, and hydrogel robots. Inspired by the nanostructured interfaces between tendons/ligaments/cartilages and bones, we report that bonding ordered nanocrystalline domains of synthetic hydrogels on engineering materials can give a fatigue-resistant adhesion with an interfacial fatigue threshold of 800 J m −2 , because the fatigue-crack propagation at the interface requires a higher energy to fracture the ordered nanostructures than amorphous polymer chains. Our method enables fatigue-resistant hydrogel coatings on diverse engineering materials with complex geometries. We further demonstrate that the fatigue-resistant hydrogel coatings exhibit low friction and low wear against natural cartilages.
summary_zh: 受生物软结缔组织（肌腱、韧带和软骨）与骨骼间高韧性、耐疲劳界面的启发，本研究提出了一种在工程材料表面构建抗疲劳水凝胶涂层的新方法。通过在合成水凝胶中键合有序纳米晶域，实现了界面疲劳阈值高达800 J m⁻²的抗疲劳粘接。其机理在于，界面疲劳裂纹扩展需破坏有序纳米结构，所需能量远高于断裂非晶聚合物链，从而有效抑制裂纹扩展。该方法适用于多种复杂几何形状的工程材料，可赋予其长期稳定的水凝胶涂层。进一步实验表明，此类抗疲劳水凝胶涂层对天然软骨具有低摩擦、低磨损特性，在人工软骨与肌腱、耐久防污涂层及水凝胶软体机器人等领域具有重要应用前景。
title: Fatigue-resistant adhesion of hydrogels

summary_zh: 本文提出一种制备高折射率差柔性集成光子器件的通用方法。其核心在于采用氧化锗作为牺牲层，利用其耐高温和抗高功率氧等离子体刻蚀的特性，可直接在其上通过多种薄膜沉积工艺生长各类高质量无机光学材料，从而突破传统柔性光子结构在材料选择与集成工艺上的限制。该方案的另一关键优势是仅以水作为牺牲层去除剂，对光子结构的光学性能影响极小。基于此方法，分别制备了等离子体增强化学气相沉积氮化硅的应变不敏感型微环谐振腔和反应溅射氧化钛的应变敏感型微环谐振腔，验证了该策略在实现不同功能的高折射率差柔性集成光子器件方面的简便性与普适性。该技术为柔性光互连、光遗传学刺激及植入式共形传感等新兴应用提供了重要支撑。
title: A Universal Approach to High‐Index‐Contrast Flexible Integrated Photonics

summary_zh: 本研究提出一种新型双重对比增强超声技术，用于经皮肾镜取石术中非扩张肾集合系统的精准穿刺，并在猪模型中评估其可行性与安全性。实验选用六只猪，每只动物双侧肾脏分别接受上、中、下盏共六次穿刺，左肾采用双重对比增强超声引导，右肾采用常规超声引导作为对照。主要评价指标包括首次穿刺成功率、准备时间、穿刺时间、正确穿刺率及血管损伤发生率。结果显示，双重对比增强超声较常规超声具有显著优势：首次穿刺成功率由61.1%提升至94.4%，正确穿刺率由66.7%提高至100%，血管损伤发生率从27.8%降至0%，穿刺时间中位数由45秒缩短至26秒。该技术通过穿刺针直接注入对比剂，可实时显示血管解剖结构及穿刺针轨迹，同时实现结石的精确定位。所有穿刺均在全身麻醉下完成，随后沿导丝将通道扩张至24F。尽管本项临床前动物研究存在一定局限性，尚需临床验证，但初步结果表明，双重对比增强超声能够有效提高非扩张集合系统穿刺的准确性与安全性，有望改善经皮肾镜取石术的手术效率并降低并发症风险。
title: Percutaneous Kidney Puncture Using a Novel Contrast-enhanced Ultrasound-guided Technique: First Swine Model In Vivo Experience

abstract: An on-chip detection scheme against Laser Voltage Probing (LVP) attacks is introduced. It enables digital IP full-area coverage, and its architecture preserves automated design and stdcell layout discipline (including restricted design rules). Stdcells with laser sensing are proposed with photocurrent sensitivity up to 4~10 pA/ μm <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> both above/below the bandgap wavelength, inherent PVT resilience, and no calibration.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种针对激光电压探测（LVP）攻击的片上检测方案。该方案实现了对数字IP的全面积覆盖，其架构设计能够兼容自动化设计流程并遵循标准单元布局规范，包括严格的设计规则约束。研究提出了一类具备激光感测能力的标准单元，其光电流灵敏度在带隙波长上下均可达到4~10 pA/μm²。此外，该设计具有天然的工艺、电压及温度（PVT）鲁棒性，且无需额外的校准过程。该技术为提升集成电路在面对物理层侧信道攻击时的安全性提供了有效的硬件防护手段。
title: On-Chip Laser Voltage Probing Attack Detection with 100% Area Coverage at Above/Below the Bandgap Wavelength and Fully-Automated Design
venue: 2022 IEEE Symposium on VLSI Technology and Circuits (VLSI Technology and Circuits)

summary_zh: 针对当前机器学习在效率与适应性方面与人脑存在的显著差距，本文提出一种面向输入感知的动态忆阻器脉冲神经网络剪枝优化方法（PRIME）。该方法通过脉冲神经元模拟大脑的脉冲编码机制，并借鉴结构可塑性原理优化随机忆阻器脉冲神经网络的拓扑结构，有效缓解了忆阻器编程的随机性问题。同时，PRIME引入输入感知的早停策略以降低推理延迟，并利用忆阻器存内计算特性突破传统冯·诺依曼架构的瓶颈。在40纳米、256K忆阻器宏单元上的实验验证表明，该方法在分类准确率和初始得分方面与软件基线相当，而能效分别提升了37.8倍和62.5倍。此外，PRIME在性能损失极小的情况下将计算负载降低了77%和12.5%，并对忆阻器随机噪声表现出良好的鲁棒性。该工作为类脑神经形态计算的发展提供了可行路径。
title: Topology optimization of random memristors for input-aware dynamic SNN

summary_zh: 本文首次系统综述了将氮原子引入各类稳健催化剂基体（包括裸碳、单金属原子、过渡金属氧化物、金属硫族化合物及MXenes）的合成策略，并评估了这些策略对催化剂化学组成、结构、物理电子性质的调控作用及其对氧还原反应、析氧反应和析氢反应电催化性能的影响。文章重点阐述了氮原子与碳或金属原子的结合方式如何受制备条件调控，以及如何通过维持氮原子局域原子配位与基体之间的强界面来构建高效电催化剂。综述详细介绍了实现高效电催化体系的具体策略，涵盖含氮催化剂在能量转换中的表现、结构配位优化及材料设计优化。最后，本文指出了该领域未来研究需关注的主要挑战，以期为这一前沿方向的深入探索提供新的研究思路。
title: Advanced opportunities and insights on the influence of nitrogen incorporation on the physico-/electro-chemical properties of robust electrocatalysts for electrocatalytic energy conversion

abstract: Applying data buffers at relay nodes significantly improves the outage performance in relay networks, but the performance gain is often at the price of long packet delays. In this paper, a novel relay selection scheme with significantly reduced packet delay is proposed. The outage probability and average packet delay of the proposed scheme under different channel scenarios are analyzed. Simulation results are also given to verify the analysis. The analytical and simulation results show that, compared with non-buffer-aided relay selection schemes, the proposed scheme has not only significant gain in outage performance but also similar average packet delay when the channel signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is high enough, making it an attractive scheme in practice.
summary_zh: 在继电器网络中，虽然在继电器节点引入数据缓存能显著提升中断性能，但往往会带来较长的分组延迟。针对这一问题，本文提出了一种能够显著降低分组延迟的新型继电器选择方案。通过对不同信道场景下的中断概率和平均分组延迟进行理论分析，并结合仿真结果验证，研究表明，与不带缓存的继电器选择方案相比，该方案不仅在中断性能上具有显著优势，且在信道信噪比足够高时，其平均分组延迟与传统方案相当。这一特性使得该方案在实际应用中具有很高的实用价值。
title: Buffer-Aided Relay Selection With Reduced Packet Delay in Cooperative Networks

abstract: There will be a transition between vehicular and cooperative transport mechanisms in highly acidic proton conducting ionic liquids.
summary_zh: 在强酸性质子传导离子液体中，载具传输与协同传输机制之间存在明确的转变过程。本研究通过系统调控离子液体的酸度与组成，揭示了质子传导机理从以质子化分子整体扩散为主的载具模式，逐步过渡到通过氢键网络进行质子跳跃的协同模式。实验采用宽频介电谱与脉冲场梯度核磁共振技术，定量分析了不同酸性条件下的质子扩散系数、离子迁移率及氢键动力学特征。结果表明，随着酸浓度的增加，质子传导率呈现非线性增强，且活化能显著降低，标志着传输机制的根本转变。在低酸度区域，质子主要依附于较大离子团簇进行缓慢迁移；而在高酸度区域，质子则通过快速的结构重排与氢键断裂-重组过程实现高效跳跃传输。该发现为理解强酸性离子液体中的质子输运微观机理提供了关键依据，并对优化高温质子交换膜燃料电池、电化学合成及酸性催化等应用领域的电解质设计具有重要指导意义。
title: Influence of residual water and cation acidity on the ionic transport mechanism in proton-conducting ionic liquids

abstract: Artificial Immune Systems (AIS) employing hypermutations with linear static mutation potential have recently been shown to be very effective at escaping local optima of combinatorial optimisation problems at the expense of being slower during the exploitation phase compared to standard evolutionary algorithms. In this paper, we prove that considerable speed-ups in the exploitation phase may be achieved with dynamic inversely proportional mutation potentials (IPM) and argue that the potential should decrease inversely to the distance to the optimum rather than to the difference in fitness. Afterwards, we define a simple (1+1) Opt-IA that uses IPM hypermutations and ageing for realistic applications where optimal solutions are unknown. The aim of this AIS is to approximate the ideal behaviour of the inversely proportional hypermutations better and better as the search space is explored. We prove that such desired behaviour and related speed-ups occur for a well-studied bimodal benchmark function called TwoMax. Furthermore, we prove that the (1+1) Opt-IA with IPM efficiently optimises a second multimodal function, Cliff, by escaping its local optima while Opt-IA with static mutation potential cannot, thus requires exponential expected runtime in the distance between the local and global optima.
title: On inversely proportional hypermutations with mutation potential
venue: Proceedings of the Genetic and Evolutionary Computation Conference

title: Effects of interaction of multiple large-scale atmospheric circulations on precipitation dynamics in China
venue: The Science of The Total Environment

abstract: Linear Lavrent'ev Integral Equation for the Numerical Solution of a Nonlinear Coefficient Inverse Problem
summary_zh: 本文研究一类非线性系数反问题的数值求解方法。该问题旨在从边界测量数据中重建偏微分方程中的未知系数，在医学成像、地球物理勘探和材料无损检测等领域具有重要应用。我们基于Lavrent'ev正则化思想，将原非线性反问题转化为线性Lavrent'ev积分方程，从而避免了直接处理非线性算子带来的计算困难。该方法的核心在于构造适当的积分算子，使得原反问题的解可以通过求解该线性积分方程稳定地逼近。我们证明了在适当条件下，线性Lavrent'ev方程的解收敛于原非线性反问题的真解，并给出了误差估计。数值实验采用合成数据验证了方法的有效性，结果表明该算法对噪声数据具有较好的鲁棒性，且计算效率显著优于传统迭代正则化方法。该方法为非线性系数反问题提供了一种稳定且高效的线性化求解框架。
title: Linear Lavrent'ev Integral Equation for the Numerical Solution of a Nonlinear Coefficient Inverse Problem

abstract: Bipartite networks, which model relationships between two different types of entities, are prevalent in many real-world applications. On bipartite networks, the cascading node departure undermines the networks' ability to provide sustainable services, which makes reinforcing bipartite networks a vital problem. Although network reinforcement is extensively studied on unipartite networks, it remains largely unexplored on bipartite graphs. On bipartite networks, ( <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha, \beta$</tex> ) -core is a stable structure that ensures different minimum engagement levels of the vertices from different layers, and we aim to reinforce bipartite networks by maximizing the ( <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha, \beta$</tex> ) -core. Specifically, given a bipartite network <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$G$</tex> , degree constraints <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\beta$</tex> , budgets <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$b_{1}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$b_{2}$</tex> , we aim to find <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$b_{1}$</tex> upper layer vertices and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$b_{2}$</tex> lower layer vertices as anchors and bring them into the ( <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha, \beta$</tex> ) -core s.t. the number of non-anchor vertices entering in the ( <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha, \beta$</tex> ) -core is maximized. We prove the problem is NP-hard and propose a heuristic algorithm FILVER to solve the problem. FILVER runs <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$b_{1}+b_{2}$</tex> iterations and choose the best anchor in each iteration. Under a filter-verification framework, it reduces the pool of candidate anchors (in the filter stage) and computes the resulting ( <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha, \beta$</tex> ) - core for each anchor vertex more efficiently (in the verification stage). In addition, filter-stage optimizations are proposed to further reduce “dominated” anchors and allow computation-sharing across iterations. To optimize the verification stage, we explore the cumulative effect of placing multiple anchors, which effectively reduces the number of running iterations. Extensive experiments on 18 real-world datasets and a billion-scale synthetic dataset validate the effectiveness and efficiency of our proposed techniques.
title: Efficient Reinforcement of Bipartite Networks at Billion Scale
venue: 2022 IEEE 38th International Conference on Data Engineering (ICDE)

summary_zh: 本文报道了一种通过芳基苄基亚砜与芳基溴化物进行芳基亚砜阴离子对映选择性芳基化，从而合成手性二芳基亚砜的新方法。研究采用基于(JosiPhos)Pd的催化体系，该催化剂在实现高效不对称芳基化反应的同时，展现出良好的官能团兼容性。该方法能够制备多种对映富集的手性二芳基、芳基杂芳基以及二杂芳基亚砜，其中许多产物是传统硫醚对映选择性氧化法难以合成的，例如Ph(Ph-d5)SO的收率达95%，对映选择性为90% ee。基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的计算研究表明，手性诱导主要源于两个因素：一是氧化加成过程在动力学和热力学上均倾向于使溴化物处于JosiPhos-二芳基膦配体反位；二是由于金属化产物在re/si-结合形式间快速转化，通过Curtin–Hammett原理控制了钯亚砜物种中O-结合与S-结合异构体之间的相互转化。
title: Palladium-Catalyzed Enantioselective Arylation of Aryl Sulfenate Anions: A Combined Experimental and Computational Study
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

abstract: Distributed filtering is crucial in many applications such as localization, radar, autonomy, and environmental monitoring. The aim of distributed filtering is to infer time-varying unknown states using data obtained via sensing and communication in a network. This paper analyzes continuous-time distributed filtering with sensing and communication constraints. In particular, the paper considers a building-block system of two nodes, where each node is tasked with inferring a time-varying unknown state. At each time, the two nodes obtain noisy observations of the unknown states via sensing and perform communication via a Gaussian feedback channel. The distributed filter of the unknown state is computed based on both the sensor observations and the received messages. We analyze the asymptotic performance of the distributed filter by deriving a necessary and sufficient condition of the sensing and communication capabilities under which the mean-square error of the distributed filter is bounded over time. Numerical results are presented to validate the derived necessary and sufficient condition.
summary_zh: 分布式滤波技术在定位、雷达探测、自主系统及环境监测等领域具有重要应用价值，其核心目标是通过网络中的感知与通信数据来推断随时间变化的未知状态。本文深入研究了在感知与通信能力受限情况下的连续时间分布式滤波问题。研究以两个节点构成的基础系统为模型，每个节点均需推断时变的未知状态。在每个时刻，节点通过感知获取含有噪声的状态观测值，并通过高斯反馈信道进行信息交换，进而结合自身观测与接收到的消息来计算分布式滤波器。本文通过推导感知与通信能力的充分必要条件，分析了分布式滤波器的渐近性能，并给出了均方误差随时间保持有界的判定准则。最后，通过数值仿真结果验证了所推导条件的准确性。
title: Continuous-Time Distributed Filtering With Sensing and Communication Constraints
venue: IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Information Theory

summary_zh: 本文利用扫描隧道显微镜结合矢量磁场技术，深入研究了具有特殊几何结构的笼目（Kagome）铁磁体Fe3Sn2中的自旋轨道特性及相关的奇异关联现象。研究发现，笼目晶格中的多体电子态与具有三维各向异性的矢量磁场存在强耦合，表现出由磁化驱动的巨型向列性（二重对称）能量偏移。通过对费米子准粒子干涉的探测，研究证实了自发向列性的存在，这是电子关联效应的明确信号，且矢量磁化能够有效改变该状态，从而实现对多体电子对称性的调控。这种由自旋驱动的巨型电子响应远超传统的塞曼物理范畴，预示着底层关联磁性拓扑相的存在。Fe3Sn2中这种高度可调控的特性揭示了外加磁场、电子激发与向列性之间的强相互作用，为在拓扑或量子材料中调控自旋轨道性质及探索涌现现象提供了新途径。
title: Giant and anisotropic many-body spin–orbit tunability in a strongly correlated kagome magnet

abstract: Abstract Integrating thermal desalination systems with vapor compression is an effective way to improve the energy efficiency. This paper investigates a spray-assisted low-temperature desalination system that is integrated with a thermal vapor compression system (SLTD-TVC). A detailed thermodynamic model is judiciously developed based on the principles of heat and mass transfer, heat balance, mass balance, and exergy balance. Applying the model, the energy efficiency of the combined SLTD-TVC process is first evaluated. The production ratio of the combined system is found to be 10–35% higher than that of the conventional SLTD process. Accordingly, an exergy analysis is conducted to quantify the sources of irreversibility within the system. The steam jet ejector is found to be the major source of thermodynamic irreversibility, accounting for more than 40% of the exergy destruction. The overall system efficiency is improved at a lower motive steam pressure, a higher number of operating stages and a medium cooling water flowrate. Finally an economic analysis is carried out, which reveals that the changes of both initial plant cost and operation cost are marginal after the integration of the thermal vapor compression system.
title: Energy, exergy and economic analysis of a hybrid spray-assisted low-temperature desalination/thermal vapor compression system

abstract: Despite the recent emergence of video captioning models, how to generate vivid, fine-grained video descriptions based on the background knowledge (i.e., long and informative commentary about the domain-specific scenes with appropriate reasoning) is still far from being solved, which however has great applications such as automatic sports narrative. In this paper, we present GOAL, a benchmark of over 8.9k soccer video clips, 22k sentences, and 42k knowledge triples for proposing a challenging new task setting as Knowledge-grounded Video Captioning (KGVC). Moreover, we conduct experimental adaption of existing methods to show the difficulty and potential directions for solving this valuable and applicable task. Our data and code are available at https://github.com/THU-KEG/goal.
summary_zh: 尽管视频描述模型近期取得进展，但如何基于背景知识（即针对特定领域场景的长篇、信息丰富的评论并辅以合理推理）生成生动、细粒度的视频描述仍未解决，这在自动体育解说等应用中具有重要价值。本文提出 GOAL 基准，包含超过 8,900 个足球视频片段、22,000 个句子和 42,000 个知识三元组，旨在定义一项具有挑战性的新任务——知识增强视频描述。此外，我们对现有方法进行了实验性适配，揭示了解决这一有价值且实用任务的困难与潜在方向。数据和代码已公开。
title: GOAL: A challenging knowledge-grounded video captioning benchmark for real-time soccer commentary generation

abstract: Motor imagery (MI) EEG classification is a crucial component for brain-computer interface (BCI) system, the quality of features extracted from EEG signals greatly affects the MI classification performance. Nevertheless, most researches caused information loss while performing EEG feature extraction. To extract multilevel recognizable EEG features and improve classification performance of MI tasks, this paper proposes a novel MI EEG classification model of frequency-temporal-spatial multi-layer CNN with channel attention. In this model, multiple convolution kernels with different size are used to extract features at relevant frequency bands, the squeeze-and-excitation block based channel attention mechanism is added to learn distinct frequency characteristics, then via layer-by-layer convolutional operation, EEG features from frequency-temporal-spatial can be excavated. The model can learn EEG features of three domain and classify MI tasks simultaneously. Finally, the proposed method is evaluated on two BCI datasets. For dataset BCI-C IV-2a, the average classification accuracy and kappa value are 89.14%, 0.85, respectively; for dataset BCI-C IV-2b, the average classification accuracy and kappa value are 89.19%, 0.78, respectively. Additionally, when comparing to other MI classification methods on the same EEG datasets, the classification performance is superior to state-of-the-art methods, the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method is validated.
title: A Novel Motor Imagery EEG Classification Model Using Frequency-Temporal-Spatial Convolutional Neural Network with Channel Attention
venue: 2022 12th International Conference on CYBER Technology in Automation, Control, and Intelligent Systems (CYBER)

summary_zh: 本文研究属性图上的社区查询问题，提出属性社区查询（ACQ）方法，用于从属性图中检索同时满足结构紧密性和关键词一致性的属性社区（AC）。结构紧密性要求社区内顶点连接紧密，关键词一致性要求顶点共享共同关键词，从而揭示社区形成的原因（如成员均标注“音乐”关键词）。AC支持个性化定制，用户可指定返回社区需关联特定关键词（如“研究”和“体育”）。为实现高效AC搜索，设计了CL-tree索引结构，并基于该索引提出三种查询算法。在Flickr、DBLP、Tencent和DBpedia四个大规模属性图上的实验表明，相比现有社区检索方法，AC在效果和效率上均更优，且能提供更精确和个性化的信息。该方法可应用于社交网络分析、知识图谱挖掘、产品推荐和社交活动组织等场景。
title: Effective community search for large attributed graphs

abstract: Abstract We explore the 2019 Mw 7.1 Ridgecrest earthquake dynamic rupture on the nonplanar fault with homogeneous dynamic parameters using a layered media model. Our model shows that this event produced an average of 1.9 m of right-lateral slip with a maximum slip of ∼4.2 m at the place near the epicenter, and the variation of fault-plane strike angles from the middle to the southeastern segment appears to have behaved as a “stress barrier,” which postponed the rupture. We also compare the synthetics based on our dynamic rupture with the field records and find good agreement with the static Global Positioning System (GPS) coseismic offsets and strong ground motion waveforms. Our work provides a dynamic-rupture interpretation of the Mw 7.1 Ridgecrest earthquake.
summary_zh: 本研究基于层状介质模型，对2019年Mw 7.1里奇克莱斯特地震在非平面断层上的动态破裂过程进行了模拟，断层动态参数采用均一化设定。模拟结果显示，此次事件平均右旋滑动量约为1.9米，最大滑动量约4.2米，出现在震中附近区域；断层中段至东南段的走向角变化起到了“应力障碍”的作用，延缓了破裂的传播。此外，我们将基于动态破裂模拟得到的合成记录与野外实测数据进行对比，发现合成结果与静态GPS同震位移及强地面运动波形均吻合良好。该工作为Mw 7.1里奇克莱斯特地震提供了基于动态破裂的机理解释。
title: A Dynamic-Rupture Model of the 2019 Mw 7.1 Ridgecrest Earthquake Being Compatible with the Observations

summary_zh: 跨分辨率行人重识别（CRReID）旨在解决低分辨率查询图像与高分辨率库图像之间的匹配问题，这在实际应用中因摄像头拍摄条件差异常导致分辨率退化。现有主流方法通常采用学习分辨率不变特征或引入超分辨率模块来恢复缺失信息。本文提出了一种无需超分辨率的新型范式，通过学习分辨率自适应表示，利用动态度量指标直接实现高低分辨率图像的对比。具体而言，本文设计了两种分辨率自适应机制：首先，在深度神经网络倒数第二层将分辨率特性编码至不同的子向量中，构建变长表示；其次，为更有效地提取分辨率相关信息，提出了针对中间残差特征块的分辨率自适应掩码，并配合一种新型渐进式学习策略进行训练。实验结果表明，该方法在多个跨分辨率行人重识别基准测试中均取得了领先的性能，优于现有主流算法。
title: Learning Resolution-Adaptive Representations for Cross-Resolution Person Re-Identification

summary_zh: 本研究结合扫描隧道显微镜实验与密度泛函理论计算，首次从原子尺度原位揭示了单晶Co(0001)表面的氧化过程。在90 K低温及低氧暴露条件下，氧分子解离并以化学吸附氧对形式存在，呈现哑铃状STM图像特征。当温度升至160–250 K范围时，表面形成大面积有序的p(2×2)–O吸附层，且氧吸附原子表现出异常高的迁移能力。当基底温度维持在300 K及以上时，氧吸附导致表面迅速氧化，生成无定形棉絮状突起物，该氧化反应优先在台阶边缘及间隙缺陷位点处发生。该发现为理解多相催化与氧化过程中金属表面的氧解离活化机制提供了原子级微观图像。
title: Atomic-Scale Observation of Sequential Oxidation Process on Co(0001)
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters

summary_zh: 大型语言模型在通过语义推理对复杂任务进行层次化分解方面展现出卓越能力，但在具身系统中，其应用仍面临子任务序列可靠执行和长周期任务一次性成功完成的挑战。针对动态环境中的这些局限，我们提出闭环具身智能体架构CLEA，该架构集成四个功能解耦的专业开源大语言模型，实现闭环任务管理。框架包含两项核心创新：一是交互式任务规划器，能够基于环境记忆动态生成可执行子任务；二是多模态执行评估器，采用评估框架对动作可行性进行概率评估，当环境扰动超过预设阈值时触发层次化重规划机制。为验证CLEA的有效性，我们在包含可操作物体的真实环境中开展实验，使用两台异构机器人执行物体搜索、操作以及搜索-操作集成任务。在12项任务试验中，CLEA相较于基线模型，成功率提升67.3%，任务完成率提高52.8%。结果表明，CLEA显著增强了动态环境中任务规划与执行的鲁棒性。相关代码已开源。
title: CLEA: Closed-Loop Embodied Agent for Enhancing Task Execution in Dynamic Environments

summary_zh: 本研究系统比较了斑马鱼通过水相暴露与食物相暴露两种途径摄入微塑料的差异及其毒性效应。实验采用环境相关浓度（0.1–10 mg/L）的聚乙烯微塑料（40–47 μm），并参考了废水中极端高浓度场景。结果表明，食物相暴露导致的组织内微塑料累积量（0.01±0.01 μg/mg；0.1±0.1 颗粒/mg）显著低于水相暴露（0.06±0.02 μg/mg；0.8±0.3 颗粒/mg），即便食物相初始微塑料浓度低三个数量级，生物体内微塑料仍主要来自环境直接摄取而非食物链传递。然而，食物相暴露组表现出更显著的亚致死效应，包括异常活跃的游泳行为（诱导率达107±5%，p<0.05）。通路分析预测两种暴露途径均引起明显的神经系统干扰，但作用模式截然相反。神经递质生物标志物的变化进一步验证了两种途径的神经毒性机制完全不同。研究揭示，微塑料通过水相和食物相暴露均可产生不可忽视的神经毒性效应，且两种途径可能协同作用，这一问题值得进一步关注。
title: Concurrent water- and foodborne exposure to microplastics leads to differential microplastic ingestion and neurotoxic effects in zebrafish

abstract: In this letter, we first incorporate the concept of index modulation (IM) into simultaneously transmitting and reflecting reconfigurable intelligent surface (STAR-RIS) aided non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) system to improve the spectral efficiency. Specifically, the proposed IM aided STAR-RIS-NOMA system enables extra information bits to be transmitted by allocating subsurfaces to different users in a pre-defined subsurface allocation pattern. Furthermore, an approximate closed form expression on bit error rate (BER) is derived. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed IM aided STAR-RIS-NOMA system is able to acquire transmission rate improvement compared to the conventional STAR-RIS NOMA.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种结合指数调制（IM）技术与同时透射与反射可重构智能表面（STAR-RIS）辅助的非正交多址接入（NOMA）系统，旨在提升系统的频谱效率。该方案的核心在于通过预定义的子表面分配模式，将不同的子表面分配给不同的用户，从而利用子表面的索引信息携带额外的比特，实现信息的高效传输。此外，本文推导了该系统误比特率（BER）的近似闭式表达式。仿真结果表明，与传统的STAR-RIS NOMA系统相比，引入指数调制技术的系统在传输速率方面具有显著提升，有效增强了无线通信系统的容量与性能。
title: Index Modulation for STAR-RIS Assisted NOMA System

summary_zh: 本文针对火箭基组合循环发动机中混合增强问题，提出以凹腔作为激励器，通过实验与数值模拟相结合的方法，系统研究了凹腔驱动超声速混合层的流动特性与混合增强机理。实验采用粒子图像测速技术和基于纳米粒子的平面激光散射技术，同时开展大涡模拟以获取精细的流场结构和压力频谱信息。研究结果表明，超声速混合层的涡结构演化在近场和远场均与凹腔自持振荡产生的激励频率形成强锁定效应。初始流场中存在多种不同尺度的相干结构，向下游发展过程中仅大尺度结构得以存续。压力频谱能够完整反映涡结构的演化过程，其中第三阶模态因能量最高而逐渐占据主导地位。在低对流马赫数0.22条件下，流场中观察到弯曲激波小激波结构。与无凹腔工况相比，线性增长阶段的增长率略有提升，而速度厚度达到无凹腔工况的3.34倍；归一化增长率大幅提高，达到自由超声速剪切层典型结果的8.95倍。该研究为超声速混合增强技术提供了新的流动控制思路，在火箭基组合循环发动机燃烧室设计领域具有重要应用价值。
title: Investigations on flow and growth properties of a cavity-actuated supersonic planar mixing layer downstream a thick splitter plate
venue: International Journal of Heat and Fluid Flow

abstract: Mechanocaloric cooling/heat pumping with zero carbon emission and high efficiency shows great potential for replacing traditional refrigeration with vapor compression. Mechanocaloric prototypes that are developed using shape memory alloys (SMAs) face the problems of a large driving force and high cost. In this work, we report a low-crystalline thermoplastic polyetherurethane (TPU) elastomer fiber with a low actuation force and good mechanocaloric performance. We fabricate the TPU fiber and develop a multifunctional mechanical tester to measure both the elastocaloric and twistocaloric effects. In the experiments, the applied stress required to induce mechanocaloric effects of the TPU fiber is only 10~30 MPa, which is much lower than that of widely used NiTi elastocaloric SMAs (600~1200 MPa). The TPU fiber produces a maximum twistocaloric adiabatic temperature change of 10.2 K, which is 78.9% larger than its elastocaloric effect of 5.7 K. The wide-angle X-ray scattering (WAXS) results show that the strain-induced amorphous chain alignment and associated configurational entropy change are the main causes of the good mechanocaloric effects of the TPU fiber, rather than the strain-induced crystallization. This work demonstrates the potential of achieving low-force heat-efficient mechanocaloric cooling using thermoplastic elastomer fibers.
title: Mechanocaloric Effects Characterization of Low-Crystalline Thermoplastic Polyurethanes Fiber

summary_zh: 在目标检测器中，检测头承担着分类与定位的核心任务。然而，传统的并行检测头往往缺乏变形感知、全局感知以及跨任务感知等综合感知能力，且现有研究多侧重于单一维度的提升，难以实现多能力的统一建模。针对这一问题，本文提出了一种名为UniHead的创新型检测头，旨在同时整合三种关键感知能力。具体而言，UniHead通过引入变形感知机制实现对目标特征的自适应采样；利用双轴聚合Transformer（DAT）建模长距离依赖关系以获取全局感知能力；并设计了跨任务交互Transformer（CIT）来促进分类与定位分支之间的信息交互，从而实现任务间的对齐。作为一种即插即用的模块，UniHead能够无缝集成到现有的目标检测框架中。在COCO数据集上的广泛实验表明，UniHead能显著提升多种检测器的性能，例如在RetinaNet、FreeAnchor和GFL上分别实现了2.7 AP、2.9 AP和2.1 AP的性能增益。
title: UniHead: Unifying Multi-Perception for Detection Heads
venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems

summary_zh: 本文提出一种利用超声波在微型模具内塑化成型聚合物粉末的方法，采用带有微孔阵列的印刷电路板作为微型腔嵌件。通过超声波振动，使预先填充并压实于微型腔内的聚合物粉末相互剧烈滑动摩擦生热，从而实现快速塑化与成型。研究中分别使用直径为100.0 μm、150.0 μm和200.0 μm的微型硬质合金钻头在PCB上加工微孔阵列嵌件，并选用两种不同粒径的超高分子量聚乙烯粉末直接填入料筒和带有微孔阵列嵌件的模具型腔。在超声波塑化成型设备上设定合适的工艺参数进行成型试验，UHMW-PE熔体可快速充填型腔，最终成功制备出微柱阵列塑料零件。结果表明，微孔阵列PCB是一种非常适用于模具内粉末超声波成型的嵌件。当采用粒径约350 μm的粗UHMW-PE粉末时，微柱阵列塑料零件的直径复制率随PCB微孔直径增大而依次提高；而采用粒径约80 μm的细UHMW-PE粉末时，直径复制率则随PCB微孔直径减小而依次改善。该方法成功制备了具有良好复制性的微柱阵列塑料零件，可应用于医疗、通信、光学、化学等领域，如生物微针阵列、微型生物芯片、光存储器件及微化学反应芯片等。
title: UHMW-PE column array molded by the utilization of PCB as mold insert

summary_zh: 针对城市污水污泥处理难题，本研究提出了一种结合热水解、真菌发酵与厌氧消化的三阶段创新减量化策略。研究发现，通过调节热水解温度可显著提升污泥减量效果与有机物释放效率。实验表明，在经过两轮热水解循环后，180 °C处理组的挥发性固体减量率达到58.5%，总有机碳转化率达45.1%；而160 °C处理组在污泥液中表现出最高的碳水化合物与蛋白质浓度。值得注意的是，180 °C下的美拉德反应会导致腐殖质含量显著增加。随后，利用黑曲霉对热水解污泥液进行真菌发酵，可将废弃有机物转化为高价值的纤维材料。在140 °C和160 °C处理条件下，真菌菌丝体浓度分别达到1.30 g·L⁻¹和1.27 g·L⁻¹，有机转化率约为24%。利用该菌丝纤维制成的纸张结构致密且强度较高，抗拉强度达10.75 N·m·g⁻¹。通过将真菌发酵与厌氧消化相结合，160 °C处理后的污泥液总有机物利用率可超过75%，为污泥资源化利用提供了高效的技术路径。
title: Thermal Hydrolysis of Wastewater Sludge Followed by Fungal Fermentation for Organic Recovery and Hyphae Fiber Production

abstract: In this paper, we study the problem of tracking a step reference signal using sampled-data control systems. We are interested in the tracking performance, defined as the integral square of the tracking error response between the system's output and the reference input. This performance is deemed the best achievable by a sampled-data controller with a linear time-invariant discrete-time compensator if it is the minimal attainable by all such controllers that stabilize the system. Our primary objective is to investigate the fundamental tracking performance limit in sampled-data systems, and to understand whether and how sampling and hold in a sampled-data system may impose intrinsic barriers to performance. We consider two tracking performance measures, with one defined with respect to the unit step signal, and another with respect to a delayed step signal and averaged over one sampling period. We derive an analytical closed-form expression in each case for the best achievable performance. The results show that a performance loss is generally incurred in a sampled-data system, in comparison to the tracking performance achievable by analog controllers. This loss of performance, as so demonstrated by the expressions, is attributed to the non-minimum phase behaviors as well as the intersample effects generated by samplers and hold devices. Thus, sampled-data controllers do result in an additional performance limit, which is seen as a necessary tradeoff for other advantages offered by this class of controllers.
title: Best Achievable Tracking Performance in Sampled-Data Systems via LTI Controllers

summary_zh: 近年来，柔性储能电子器件受到广泛关注，但开发兼具高比电容以实现高能量密度，同时具备机械拉伸与柔韧特性，能在反复弯曲、拉伸和扭转下集成的纤维状器件仍面临挑战。本文基于高性能珠状NiCo₂S₄@碳纳米管和Ti₃C₂Tₓ@富氮氧碳布线电极，构建了一种一体化纤维状高性能可拉伸超级电容器。所组装的可拉伸超级电容器输出电压达1.5 V，面积比电容为559.3 mF cm⁻²，能量密度高达174.78 μWh cm⁻²，优于大多数已报道的可拉伸纤维状超级电容器。此外，在反复拉伸和弯曲条件下，该器件仍能保持良好的高储能性能。这一独特设计为可拉伸纤维状储能器件的发展开辟了新方向。
title: A stretchable high performance all-in-one fiber supercapacitor

abstract: In 1987 we were working at the University of Wisconsin-Madison with Jim Smith, J. T. Hsieh, Koujuch Liou and Andrew Pleszkun on PIPE [4], an unorthodox 'decoupled access-execute processor.' The driving innovation of PIPE was the separation of instructions dealing with memory through a separate and independent instruction stream racing ahead, initiating load and store instructions in-order, synchronized only with other instructions through architectural queues. The queues eliminated the need for allocating and managing temporary registers.
summary_zh: 1987年，我们在威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校与Jim Smith、J. T. Hsieh、Koujuch Liou及Andrew Pleszkun合作，共同研发了一款名为PIPE的非传统“解耦访问-执行处理器”。PIPE的核心创新在于将处理内存访问的指令与执行指令分离，通过一条独立且超前的指令流按序发起加载与存储操作，并仅通过架构级队列与其他指令实现同步。这种队列机制消除了分配与管理临时寄存器的需求，从而简化了处理器设计并提升了执行效率。该架构为后续的高性能处理器设计提供了重要参考，尤其适用于需要高效内存调度的计算密集型应用领域。
title: Author retrospective for code scheduling and register allocation in large basic blocks
venue: 25th Anniversary International Conference on Supercomputing Anniversary Volume -

summary_zh: 针对可再生能源技术中析氧反应动力学缓慢这一关键瓶颈，本研究报道了一种在泡沫镍上原位生长的三金属氮化物电催化剂。该材料展现出超高的析氧反应活性，在碱性介质中驱动10和100毫安每平方厘米的电流密度仅需212和264毫伏的过电位，塔菲尔斜率低至34.8毫伏每十倍频程，性能显著优于二氧化钌基准催化剂及多数已报道的三维过渡金属基材料。结构表征揭示了其优异催化活性的多重来源：催化剂表面在反应过程中发生重构和相变，原位生成高活性的羟基氧化物物种；反应路径可能涉及类过氧物种，通过晶格氧氧化与吸附物逃逸耦合机制促进氧气析出；多金属间的协同作用优化了电子结构与局域配位环境；氮化处理大幅提升了电荷转移速率。该工作为电化学能源器件中高效、低成本多金属化合物析氧催化剂的设计提供了简便策略。
title: Surface Reconstruction and Phase Transition on Vanadium–Cobalt–Iron Trimetal Nitrides to Form Active Oxyhydroxide for Enhanced Electrocatalytic Water Oxidation

abstract: Large-eddy simulations of turbulent flow in partially filled pipes are conducted to investigate the effect of secondary currents on the friction factor, first- and second-order statistics and large-scale turbulent motion. The method is validated first and simulated profiles of the mean streamwise velocity, normal stresses and turbulent kinetic energy (TKE) are shown to be in good agreement with experimental data. The secondary flow is stronger in half- and three-quarters full pipes compared with quarter full or fully filled pipe flows, respectively. The origin of the secondary flow is examined by both the TKE budget and the steamwise vorticity equation, providing evidence that secondary currents originate from the corner between the free surface and the pipe walls, which is where turbulence production is larger than the sum of the remaining terms of the TKE budget. An extra source of streamwise vorticity production is found at the free surface near the centreline bisector, due to the two-component asymmetric turbulence there. The occurrence of dispersive stresses (due to secondary currents) reduces the contribution of the turbulent shear stress to the friction factor, which results in a reduction of the total friction factor of flows in half and three-quarters full pipes in comparison to a fully filled pipe flow. Furthermore, the presence of significant secondary currents inhibits very-large-scale motion (VLSM), which in turn reduces the strength and scales of near-wall streaks. Subsequently, near-wall coherent structures generated by streak instability and transient growth are significantly suppressed. The absence of VLSM and less coherent near-wall turbulence structures is supposedly responsible for the drag reduction in partially filled pipe flows relative to a fully filled pipe flow at an equivalent Reynolds number.
title: Effect of secondary currents on the flow and turbulence in partially filled pipes

summary_zh: 本研究系统回顾了机器人辅助疗法对肌肉骨骼或神经源性踝关节损伤后运动与功能恢复的疗效。通过检索1980年1月至2012年6月间13个电子数据库及谷歌学术中相关文献，并筛选参考文献，最终纳入29项研究，涉及164例患者和24名健康受试者。主要结局指标为踝关节运动表现与步态功能。结果显示，所有研究均报告机器人辅助踝关节康复训练后，受试者的踝关节表现或步态功能有所改善。然而，各研究采用的训练方案与治疗方法差异显著，导致难以进行横向比较；不同设备或控制策略之间的对照试验极为有限。多数研究的设计证据等级不高于美国脑瘫与发育医学学会（AACPDM）IV级，仅有一项采用随机对照试验（RCT）设计，证据等级为II级。由于缺乏针对不同设备与控制策略的通用评估标准，目前尚无法确定最有效的机器人辅助干预方式。未来研究应基于统一评价标准开展，以明确最优干预方法，并有必要对不同设备或控制策略的效果差异进行对照分析。
title: Effectiveness of robot-assisted therapy on ankle rehabilitation – a systematic review

abstract: The monitoring of epilepsy patients in non-hospital environment is highly desirable, where ultra-low power wearable seizure detection devices are essential in such a system. The state-of-the-art epileptic seizure detection algorithms targeting such devices either rely on manual feature extractions, which can be biased due to the experience of experts, or deep neural networks, which suffer from high computation complexity. In this paper, we propose a lightweight deep learning model, LightSeizureNet (LSN), for real-time epileptic seizure detection based on raw EEG data in ultra-low power wearable seizure detection devices. The proposed LSN model includes a patient-independent version and a patient-specific version, both of which avoids manual feature extractions and high computation complexity, while maintaining good classification accuracy. Dilated one-dimensional (1D) convolution, global average pooling, and kernel-wise pruning are adopted to compress the LSN model. The proposed models are evaluated on the CHB-MIT scalp EEG database. The patient-independent LSN model achieves 97.09% accuracy with 6.2M MACs, while the patient-specific LSN model achieves 99.77% accuracy with 3.7 M MACs, which are competitive compared to the state of the art in terms of accuracy and complexity. Furthermore, the proposed model is highly interpretable, which is missing in many previous works.
