By using a uniform approach to explore the interpretability of the proposed model, fine-grained information such as the activated brain region and the frequency of brainwave during seizures is obtained for clinical diagnosis.
title: LightSeizureNet: A Lightweight Deep Learning Model for Real-Time Epileptic Seizure Detection
venue: IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics

summary_zh: 针对固态锌金属电池中离子迁移动力学迟缓和电极-电解质界面不稳定的核心问题，本文提出了一种多功能MXene键合传输网络嵌入的聚偏氟乙烯-六氟丙烯共聚物/三氟甲磺酸锌固态聚合物电解质（PH/MXene SPE）的“一体化”设计策略。通过密度泛函理论计算、分子动力学模拟及多种表征手段，系统揭示了该电解质在调控离子输运、界面化学和锌沉积行为方面的作用机制。研究表明，MXene纳米填料与PH聚合物基体之间形成的氢键网络有助于实现快速且均匀的离子传输；同时，原位构建的稳定有机-无机杂化界面相能够确保高效的界面迁移动力学并诱导均匀的锌沉积。基于该PH/MXene SPE的固态锌金属电池展现出超稳定的锌沉积/剥离行为，极化电压极低。此外，所组装的固态Zn/VO₂电池在倍率性能和循环稳定性方面均获得显著提升。该策略为固态聚合物电解质的设计及高性能固态锌金属电池的开发提供了新的思路。
title: MXene‐Bonded Transport Network Embedded in Polymer Electrolyte Enables High‐Rate and Stable Solid‐State Zinc Metal Batteries

summary_zh: 本研究提出一种基于手性钙钛矿纳米晶的高亮度、高效率绿光自旋发光二极管。传统自旋发光二极管多采用低维手性钙钛矿作为自旋过滤层，但其电荷传输性能较差，导致器件效率低、亮度受限。为解决这一问题，我们以CsPbBr₃纳米晶为发光体，通过原位手性配体修饰策略，使用R-/S-1-(4-溴苯基)乙基溴化铵将手性印迹到纳米晶上。所得手性CsPbBr₃纳米晶兼具89%的高光致发光量子产率和延长的自旋弛豫寿命，其薄膜表现出高达88%的自旋极化率。基于此，我们在不采用常规自旋过滤层的情况下，实现了室温下最大亮度12,800 cd m⁻²、峰值外量子效率15.4%以及圆偏振电致发光不对称因子2.16×10⁻³的自旋发光二极管，在亮度、效率与自旋极化性能方面均创下钙钛矿自旋发光二极管的新纪录。该工作为光通信、生物成像及量子信息处理等领域的自旋光电器件提供了高性能材料与器件设计新思路。
title: Green Spin Light-Emitting Diodes Enabled by Perovskite Nanocrystals in Situ Modified with Chiral Ligands

summary_zh: 在下一代移动通信网络中，毫米波通信结合大规模多输入多输出（MIMO）技术是提升系统容量的关键。然而，大规模MIMO系统的稳定性高度依赖于高效的信道估计方案。本文在结构化压缩感知框架下，研究了一种兼顾高精度与高频谱效率的训练序列（TS）设计与优化方案。研究创新性地提出了块自相关与块互相关两个关键性能指标，旨在从新视角优化感知矩阵的块相干性。通过对频域二进制训练序列进行逆离散傅里叶变换，设计出特定的训练序列，并进一步利用遗传算法对上述性能指标进行全局优化。仿真结果表明，该方法能显著降低感知矩阵的块相干性。与传统的暴力搜索设计相比，本文提出的优化训练序列在正确恢复概率、均方误差及误码率等方面均表现出更优的性能，且信道估计结果能够逼近克拉美-罗下界（CRLB）。
title: Design and Optimization on Training Sequence for mmWave Communications: A New Approach for Sparse Channel Estimation in Massive MIMO
venue: IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications

abstract: An innovative strategy is proposed to investigate the problem of synchronization control for the unreliable network systems in this article. It is shown that the dynamics for nodes in the heterogeneous network are nonidentical, which can describe more complicated processes. The proposed distributed controller consists of the reference generator (RG) and regulator. First, any two RGs can exchange effective information by the communication channels. Time-varying delay may occur in the communication channels due to the resource constraints and the limited to network bandwidth. By designing the distributed control law, the closed-loop of the leader and all RGs can be equivalently rewritten as the feedback interconnection of a linear time-invariant system and an integral operator. In the light of the small gain theorem, the stability criteria for the feedback interconnection is obtained. Second, one leader and all RGs are considered as the exosystem of each nonidentical network node. The designed regulator can copy the dynamics of the exosystem and enforce that each nonidentical node tracks the corresponding exosystem. Finally, the control effectiveness of this novel strategy is substantiated through a numerical simulation.
title: Synchronization Control for Unreliable Network Systems in Intelligent Robots

abstract: Cooperative spectrum sensing has been studied to combat the hidden terminal problem by exploiting the spatial diversity in cognitive radio (CR) networks. This paper concerns blind cooperative spectrum sensing with soft fusion, where the a priori knowledge of channels and primary signals is unavailable, and soft information is transmitted from each secondary user (SU) to a fusion center for detection. We first introduce the Quade test to design a blind detector. Then, a new detector with both lower computational complexity and lower overhead is derived, where only the estimated power and the variance of the instantaneous power at each SU are required at the fusion center. The analytical expressions for the detection performance, in terms of false-alarm probability and detection probability, are derived for the proposed detector. Simulation results are provided to validate the theoretical analyses and demonstrate the superior performance of proposed detector compared to the state-of-the-art detectors. It is also shown that, with the increase of the number of hidden terminals in the CR, the proposed detector can maintain high detection performance while the conventional detectors exhibit rapid performance degradation.
title: Cooperative Spectrum Sensing: A Blind and Soft Fusion Detector

abstract: Cleavage of C(sp2)–O bonds in anisoles typically requires transition metal catalysis or harsh reaction conditions. Herein, we report a mild and metal-free photocatalytic strategy for the direct conversion of anisole derivatives into epoxyquinols and para-quinols. This method uses in situ generated singlet oxygen and water as nucleophiles to control divergent pathways. The transformation exhibits a broad substrate scope and excellent functional group tolerance and can be applied to the late-stage functionalization of complex natural products. This work provides a sustainable alternative to traditional transition-metal-catalyzed C(sp2)–O functionalization and expands photoredox catalysis in dearomative synthesis.
summary_zh: 本文报道了一种温和且无需金属参与的光催化策略，用于直接断裂苯甲醚类化合物中的碳(sp²)–氧键，并将其转化为环氧醌醇和对醌醇。该方法利用原位生成的单线态氧和水作为亲核试剂，通过调控反应路径实现发散性转化。该反应具有广泛的底物适用范围和优异的官能团耐受性，并可应用于复杂天然产物的后期官能团化修饰。这一工作为传统过渡金属催化的碳(sp²)–氧键官能团化提供了一种可持续的替代方案，并拓展了光氧化还原催化在去芳构化合成中的应用。
title: Photocatalytic C(sp 2)–O Bond Cleavage and Dearomatization of Anisoles toward Epoxyquinols/para -Quinols

abstract: The target of rapamycin (TOR) complex 1 (TORC1) is a central cell growth regulator in response to a wide array of signals. The Rag GTPases play an essential role in relaying amino acid signals to TORC1 activation through direct interaction with raptor and recruitment of the TORC1 complex to lysosomes. Here we present the crystal structure of the Gtr1p-Gtr2p complex, the Rag homologs from Saccharomyces cerevisiae, at 2.8 Å resolution. The heterodimeric GTPases reveal a pseudo-twofold symmetric organization. Structure-guided functional analyses of RagA-RagC, the human homologs of Gtr1p-Gtr2p, show that both G domains (N-terminal GTPase domains) and dimerization are important for raptor binding. In particular, the switch regions of the G domain in RagA are indispensible for interaction with raptor, and hence TORC1 activation. The dimerized C-terminal domains of RagA-RagC display a remarkable structural similarity to MP1/p14, which is in a complex with lysosome membrane protein p18, and directly interact with p18, therefore recruiting mTORC1 to the lysosome for activation by Rheb. Our results reveal a structural model for the mechanism of the Rag GTPases in TORC1 activation and amino acid signaling.
title: Crystal structure of the Gtr1p-Gtr2p complex reveals new insights into the amino acid-induced TORC1 activation

summary_zh: 近期研究表明，DNA甲基化在果实成熟过程中发挥着关键作用，但其在调节风味等特定性状中的具体机制尚不明确。本研究揭示了DNA甲基化对草莓呋喃酮生物合成的影响机制。研究发现，草莓醌氧化还原酶（FaQR）是呋喃酮生物合成的关键酶，在‘悦新’品种中存在四个同源基因，其中FaQR3贡献了约50%的转录本，是呋喃酮合成的主要贡献者。通过监测果实成熟过程及施用DNA甲基化抑制剂后的变化发现，FaQR3启动子区域的DNA甲基化水平与FaQR3的表达量及呋喃酮积累量呈负相关，表明DNA甲基化通过调节FaQR3的表达来影响呋喃酮的生物合成，并能对不同温度做出响应。进一步研究表明，通过瞬时表达RdDM途径基因FaAGO4以及对24-nt siRNA的富集分析证实，FaQR3启动子的DNA甲基化是由RdDM途径介导的；同时，对FaDML进行瞬时RNA干扰实验表明，去甲基化途径也参与了呋喃酮积累的调控。本研究为理解DNA甲基化与去甲基化在草莓成熟过程中影响风味品质的机制提供了新见解。
title: DNA methylation mediated by RdDM pathway and demethylation affects furanone accumulation through regulation of QUINONE OXIDOREDUCTASE in strawberry

summary_zh: ATP合酶作为一种能够实现旋转能与化学能相互转换的分子动力装置，其多亚基膜结合复合物的完整结构解析长期以来受限于其固有的多构象特性。通过蛋白质工程技术，研究人员成功将酵母线粒体ATP合酶固定在单一构象中，并获得了抑制剂寡霉素结合在膜内旋转c环上的结构。此外，研究进一步发现叶绿体ATP合酶包含一种内置抑制机制，该机制在黑暗条件下由氧化环境触发。研究表明，这类机器的驱动机制具有高度相似性：质子通过通道被输送到嵌入膜内的c环，驱动转子完成近乎全周的旋转，随后从膜另一侧的通道排出。这些研究成果为深入理解生物膜能量转换的分子机制提供了关键的结构基础。
title: High-resolution cryo-EM analysis of the yeast ATP synthase in a lipid membrane

abstract: Conventional cryopreservation of mammalian cells requires the use of toxic organic solvents (e.g., dimethyl sulfoxide) as cryoprotectants. Consequently, the cryopreserved cells must undergo a tedious washing procedure to remove the organic solvents for their further applications in cell-based medicine, and many of the precious cells may be lost or killed during the procedure. Trehalose has been explored as a nontoxic alternative to traditional cryoprotectants. However, mammalian cells do not synthesize trehalose or express trehalose transporters in their membranes, and the lack of an approach for the efficient intracellular delivery of trehalose has been a major hurdle for its use in cell cryopreservation. In this study, a cold-responsive polymer (poly(N-isopropylacrylamide-co-butyl acrylate)) is utilized to synthesize nanoparticles for the encapsulation and intracellular delivery of trehalose. The trehalose-laden nanoparticles can be efficiently taken up by mammalian cells. The nanoparticles quickly and irreversibly disassemble upon cold treatment, enabling the controlled and rapid release of trehalose from the nanoparticles inside cells. The latter is confirmed by an evident increase in cell volume upon cold treatment. This rapid cold-triggered intracellular release of trehalose is crucial to developing a fast protocol to cryopreserve cells using trehalose. Cells with intracellular trehalose delivered using the nanoparticles show comparable postcryopreservation viability compared to that of cells treated with DMSO, eliminating the need for the tedious and cell-damaging washing procedure required for using the DMSO-cryopreserved cells in vivo. This cold-responsive nanoparticle may greatly facilitate the use of trehalose as a nontoxic cryoprotectant for banking cells and tissues to meet their high demand by modern cell-based medicine.
title: Cold-responsive nanoparticle enables intracellular delivery and rapid release of trehalose for organic solvent-free cryopreservation

abstract: A theory of vibrational excitations based on power-law spatial correlations in the elastic constants (or equivalently in the internal stress) is derived, in order to determine the vibrational density of states D([Formula: see text]) of disordered solids. The results provide the first prediction of a boson peak in amorphous materials where spatial correlations in the internal stresses (or elastic constants) are of power-law form, as is often the case in experimental systems, leading to a logarithmic enhancement of (Rayleigh) phonon attenuation. A logarithmic correction of the form [Formula: see text] is predicted to occur in the plot of the reduced excess DOS for frequencies around the boson peak in 3D. Moreover, the theory provides scaling laws of the density of states in the low-frequency region, including a [Formula: see text] regime in 3D, and provides information about how the boson peak intensity depends on the strength of power-law decay of fluctuations in elastic constants or internal stress. Analytical expressions are also derived for the dynamic structure factor for longitudinal excitations, which include a logarithmic correction factor, and numerical calculations are presented supporting the assumptions used in the theory.
title: Vibrational density of states of amorphous solids with long-ranged power-law-correlated disorder in elasticity

summary_zh: 本文采用改进的相场-格子玻尔兹曼方法，结合并行计算与自适应网格细化技术，在二维代表性单元体尺度上系统研究了半固态浆料凝固过程中微观组织形态的演变机制。研究将实际工艺参数与数值模型相耦合，通过对模拟域内介观结果进行空间平均实现尺度提升，重点考察了生长空间、初始过冷度、冷却速率、自然对流和强制对流五个局部变量对微观组织形成的影响。结果表明，球形晶粒的形成需要特定的初始过冷度、冷却速率和形核密度条件。在快速各向同性生长情形下，熔体对流对晶粒形态演变影响甚微，这一发现通过SEED工艺实验得到了验证。而在溶质扩散控制的晶粒生长过程中，强制对流对形态演变具有显著影响，这为拓宽半固态浆料制备的浇注温度工艺窗口以及扩展至窄凝固区间合金的应用提供了可能。该研究为制备具有均匀球形微观组织的高品质半固态浆料奠定了理论基础。
title: Microstructural evolution mechanism of semi-solid slurry: a study using Phase-Field-Lattice-Boltzmann scheme

summary_zh: 本研究旨在探讨环状RNA circSMARCA5在肺腺癌中的功能及分子机制。通过qRT-PCR检测发现，circSMARCA5在肺腺癌患者肿瘤组织及细胞系中表达显著下调。然而，功能实验表明，沉默circSMARCA5可抑制肺腺癌细胞的增殖、集落形成、迁移和侵袭能力，提示其可能发挥促癌作用。机制研究揭示，敲低circSMARCA5导致EGFR、c-MYC和p21蛋白表达下降；进一步分析发现，miR-17-3p能够通过直接结合EGFR mRNA的3'非翻译区，有效下调EGFR表达水平。综合结果表明，circSMARCA5可能通过调控miR-17-3p-EGFR信号轴发挥癌基因功能，促进肺腺癌恶性进展。该发现为肺腺癌的靶向治疗提供了新的潜在分子靶点，具有重要的临床转化意义。
title: CircSMARCA5 silencing impairs cell proliferation and invasion via the miR-17-3p-EGFR signaling in lung adenocarcinoma

summary_zh: 失血性休克通过尚未完全阐明的机制激活并致敏先天免疫系统，促使机体产生过度的炎症反应，进而引发全身炎症反应综合征及器官损伤。IL-1β在失血性休克后全身炎症反应综合征的发生中起关键作用，其活性形式的生成受到炎症小体的严格调控。Pyrin蛋白含781个氨基酸，其N端具有pyrin结构域，能够通过与核苷酸结合寡聚化结构域样受体蛋白相互作用，负向调控炎症小体的活化。Pyrin的表达可由脂多糖和细胞因子诱导，其中IL-10是巨噬细胞中pyrin表达的强效诱导剂。本研究验证了如下假说：失血性休克下调IL-10水平，从而降低pyrin表达，进而促进炎症小体活化及后续肺内IL-1β的加工与分泌。结果表明，脂多糖在激活肺内Nlrp3炎症小体的同时，也能诱导pyrin表达，后者反过来抑制炎症小体活化。更为重要的是，脂多糖介导的IL-10上调增强了pyrin的表达，尤其在后期阶段，构成一种强有力的负反馈机制来调控炎症小体活性。然而，失血性休克抑制肺泡巨噬细胞中IL-10的表达，减弱了肺泡巨噬细胞和肺内皮细胞中pyrin的上调，从而显著增强炎症小体活化及肺内IL-1β分泌。本研究揭示了一种新机制，即失血性休克通过抑制Nlrp3炎症小体的负反馈调控，增强后续脂多糖刺激下的IL-1β分泌，从而为炎症反应奠定基础。
title: Hemorrhagic Shock Augments Nlrp3 Inflammasome Activation in the Lung through Impaired Pyrin Induction

abstract: Defective catabolite export from lysosomes results in lysosomal storage diseases in humans. Mutations in the cystine transporter gene CTNS cause cystinosis, but other lysosomal amino acid transporters are poorly characterized at the molecular level. Here, we identified the Caenorhabditis elegans lysosomal lysine/arginine transporter LAAT-1. Loss of laat-1 caused accumulation of lysine and arginine in enlarged, degradation-defective lysosomes. In mutants of ctns-1 (C. elegans homolog of CTNS), LAAT-1 was required to reduce lysosomal cystine levels and suppress lysosome enlargement by cysteamine, a drug that alleviates cystinosis by converting cystine to a lysine analog. LAAT-1 also maintained availability of cytosolic lysine/arginine during embryogenesis. Thus, LAAT-1 is the lysosomal lysine/arginine transporter, which suggests a molecular explanation for how cysteamine alleviates a lysosomal storage disease.
summary_zh: 溶酶体中代谢产物转运缺陷会导致人类溶酶体贮积症。虽然CTNS基因突变会导致胱氨酸病，但其他溶酶体氨基酸转运蛋白的分子机制尚不明确。本研究在秀丽隐杆线虫中鉴定出溶酶体赖氨酸/精氨酸转运蛋白LAAT-1。研究发现，缺失laat-1会导致赖氨酸和精氨酸在肿大且降解功能缺陷的溶酶体中积累。在ctns-1突变体（CTNS的线虫同源基因）中，LAAT-1对于降低溶酶体胱氨酸水平以及抑制半胱胺诱导的溶酶体肿大至关重要；半胱胺是一种通过将胱氨酸转化为赖氨酸类似物来缓解胱氨酸病的药物。此外，LAAT-1在胚胎发育过程中还负责维持细胞质中赖氨酸和精氨酸的可用性。综上所述，LAAT-1作为溶酶体赖氨酸/精氨酸转运蛋白，为半胱胺缓解溶酶体贮积症的分子机制提供了新的解释。
title: LAAT-1 Is the Lysosomal Lysine/Arginine Transporter That Maintains Amino Acid Homeostasis

summary_zh: 针对有机电化学晶体管（OECT）生物检测领域基础传感原理受限的问题，本文提出了一种不同于传统方案的新型传感机制，即通过生物事件对光敏栅极电极进行生物依赖性调节，从而实现信号转导。研究以三维二氧化钛/碳纤维基底栅极电极为例，通过酶促催化反应使金纳米团簇生长为金纳米颗粒，驱动混合栅极光阳极的光电化学特性从II型异质结向等离激元型转变，进而降低光子-电子转换效率，导致栅极光阳极电流响应下降。通过构建针对代表性分析物C反应蛋白的碱性磷酸酶夹心免疫分析模型，该系统在零栅极偏压下展现出良好的靶向调节能力与分析性能。该研究揭示了一种全新的OECT生物检测原理，为利用光与物质相互作用开发先进的OECT生物传感器件提供了新思路。
title: Regulating Light‐Sensitive Gate of Organic Photoelectrochemical Transistor toward Sensitive Biodetection at Zero Gate Bias

abstract: It is evident based on historical data that groundwater contaminant plumes persist at many sites, requiring costly long-term management. High-resolution site-characterization methods are needed to support accurate risk assessments and to select, design, and operate effective remediation operations. Most subsurface characterization methods are generally limited in their ability to provide unambiguous, real-time delineation of specific processes affecting mass-transfer, transformation, and mass removal, and accurate estimation of associated rates. An integrated contaminant elution and tracer test toolkit, comprising a set of local-scale groundwater extraction-and injection tests, was developed to ameliorate the primary limitations associated with standard characterization methods. The test employs extended groundwater extraction to stress the system and induce hydraulic and concentration gradients. Clean water can be injected, which removes the resident aqueous contaminant mass present in the higher-permeability zones and isolates the test zone from the surrounding plume. This ensures that the concentrations and fluxes measured within the isolated area are directly and predominantly influenced by the local mass-transfer and transformation processes controlling mass removal. A suite of standard and novel tracers can be used to delineate specific mass-transfer and attenuation processes that are active at a given site, and to quantify the associated mass-transfer and transformation rates. The conceptual basis for the test is first presented, followed by an illustrative application based on simulations produced with a 3-D mathematical model and a brief case study application.
title: The integrated contaminant elution and tracer test toolkit, ICET3, for improved characterization of mass transfer, attenuation, and mass removal

summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于社区获得性耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（CA-MRSA）的关键毒力因子——酚可溶性调节蛋白（PSMs）与葡萄球菌蛋白A（SpA）。通过化学与遗传学手段，研究发现抑制细胞壁磷壁酸（WTA）生物合成途径中的首个酶 TarO，能够显著降低典型 CA-MRSA 株系 USA300 LAC 中编码 PSMs 和 SpA 的基因表达。机制研究表明，该效应通过激活 VraRS 二元调节系统实现，进而直接抑制辅助调节因子（agr）位点及 spa 基因的表达。其中，VraRS 的激活部分归因于青霉素结合蛋白 2（PBP2）功能完整性的丧失，且这一过程具有 PBP2a 依赖性；此外，TarO 抑制也能以不依赖 PBP2a 的方式激活 VraRS。多项证据表明，脂质连接的肽聚糖前体积累是触发 VraRS 激活的关键诱因。综上所述，本研究揭示了 WTA 生物合成在 CA-MRSA 毒力基因表达调控中的重要作用，证明 TarO 是极具潜力的抗毒力治疗靶点，并提示 mecA 基因的获得为金黄色葡萄球菌关键信号通路的调节提供了额外的调控层级。
title: Modulation of MRSA virulence gene expression by the wall teichoic acid enzyme TarO

summary_zh: 本文提出 CrossViewDiff，一种面向卫星图像到街景图像跨视角生成的扩散模型。针对卫星与街景视角差异大的挑战，方法设计了卫星场景结构估计模块与跨视角纹理映射模块，分别提取结构控制与纹理控制，用于指导街景图像合成。在此基础上，构建跨视角控制引导的去噪过程，通过增强的跨视角注意力机制将上述控制信息融入生成流程。为更全面评估合成质量，还引入基于 GPT 的评分方法，作为标准指标的补充。此外，探讨了文本、地图、建筑高度及多时相卫星影像等不同数据源对该任务的影响。在三个公开跨视角数据集上的实验表明，CrossViewDiff 在标准指标和 GPT 评分上均优于现有最优方法，能够在乡村、郊区和城市场景中生成结构更真实、纹理更清晰的高质量街景全景图。相关代码与模型将公开发布。
title: arXiv Crossviewdiff: A cross-view diffusion model for satellite-to-street view synthesis Weijia Li#
venue: Jun He#, Junyan Ye#, Huaping Zhong#, Zhimeng Zheng, Zilong Huang, Dahua Lin, and Conghui He* arXiv 2024 Paper project

abstract: This work presents a facile and controllable hydrothermal synthesis of ultrathin Bi 2 O 2 Se nanosheets. The Bi 2 O 2 Se nanosheets show good photoelectrochemical performance.
summary_zh: 本文报道了一种简便且可控的水热合成方法，用于制备超薄Bi₂O₂Se纳米片。通过调控水热反应条件，成功获得了厚度极小的二维层状材料。所制备的Bi₂O₂Se纳米片展现出优异的光电化学性能，表明其在光电转换与能源相关领域具有潜在的应用前景。
title: Lithium nitrate-assisted hydrothermal synthesis of ultrathin Bi2O2Se nanosheets and their photoelectrochemical performance

summary_zh: 通过拟南芥FLC基因位点的研究，本文揭示了新生非编码转录本如何通过调控R环结构来介导染色质沉默的分子机制。研究发现，在FLC基因3′端由反义转录本诱导形成的R环被稳定后，RNA结合蛋白FCA能够与其直接互作伙伴FY/WDR33及其他3′端加工因子协同作用，对新生反义转录本进行多聚腺苷酸化。这一过程不仅清除了R环结构，还招募了能够去除H3K4me1修饰的染色质修饰因子。进一步实验表明，FCA可与m6A甲基转移酶复合物组分发生免疫共沉淀，而m6A修饰则影响FCA核凝聚体的动态变化，从而促进FLC位点的染色质沉默。该调控机制同样作用于拟南芥基因组中的其他基因位点，与此一致的是，fca和fy突变体对DNA损伤诱导药物表现出超敏反应。上述结果阐明了共转录RNA加工过程通过调节R环稳定性来触发染色质沉默的分子机制，为理解非编码RNA在基因组调控中的作用提供了新见解。
title: R-loop resolution promotes co-transcriptional chromatin silencing

summary_zh: 在细胞医学领域，利用微流控技术将细胞或组织封装在水凝胶微胶囊中具有重要应用前景。然而，在封装胰岛或卵泡等稀有细胞时，常面临空胶囊比例过高以及封装后的细胞需从油相转移至水相进行后续培养的问题。现有的提取方法往往依赖细胞标记物或昂贵的检测系统，且提取纯度较低。本文提出了一种基于深度学习的无标记检测与选择性提取方案，实现了在芯片上将含细胞的水凝胶微胶囊从油相实时、动态地转移至水相。实验结果表明，该方法具备极高的检测效率（约100%）与提取效率（约97%），提取纯度高达约90%，且细胞存活率保持在95%以上。这种结合深度学习实时图像分析的无标记检测与芯片集成提取技术，为细胞医学中高效率、高纯度的细胞封装与处理提供了全新的解决方案。
title: Deep learning-enabled label-free on-chip detection and selective extraction of cell aggregate-laden hydrogel microcapsules

summary_zh: 通过对526份多队列粪便样本的宏基因组测序发现，嗜热链球菌在结直肠癌患者肠道中显著减少。本研究旨在探讨嗜热链球菌作为结直肠癌预防药物的可能性。研究通过培养结肠上皮细胞及两种小鼠肠道肿瘤模型，评估了嗜热链球菌的抗肿瘤效应。质谱分析与β-半乳糖苷酶活性检测表明，嗜热链球菌分泌的β-半乳糖苷酶是发挥抑癌作用的关键蛋白。实验结果显示，口服嗜热链球菌能显著减少Apcmin/+及AOM诱导的小鼠肿瘤形成；在体外实验中，嗜热链球菌及其条件培养基可抑制结直肠癌细胞增殖、降低克隆形成能力、诱导细胞周期阻滞并促进细胞凋亡，同时能延缓结直肠癌异种移植瘤的生长。通过同源重组构建的缺失β-半乳糖苷酶功能的突变株失去了抑癌作用。此外，嗜热链球菌通过β-半乳糖苷酶作用增加了肠道内双歧杆菌和乳杆菌等益生菌的丰度。机制研究发现，β-半乳糖苷酶依赖性产生的半乳糖会干扰能量稳态，进而激活氧化磷酸化并下调Hippo通路激酶，从而介导了嗜热链球菌的部分抗癌效应。综上所述，嗜热链球菌是一种具有潜在应用前景的结直肠癌预防性益生菌。
title: Streptococcus thermophilus Inhibits Colorectal Tumorigenesis Through Secreting β-Galactosidase

summary_zh: 本文提出一种紧凑型光谱剪切干涉超快电场重构装置，具备高信噪比与高稳定性。与传统基于迈克尔逊干涉仪的光谱剪切干涉电场重构方案相比，该设计在25 dB带宽范围内将信噪比提升约3.7倍。以6 mm厚BK7玻璃板的材料色散作为测量目标，实测相位与理论值之间的误差小于2.6 mrad，较迈克尔逊干涉仪方案的10.3 mrad误差改善约4倍；即使对1 mm厚熔融石英板，实测相位误差也低于2.1 mrad。利用该装置对超短脉冲激光系统进行连续三天测试，输出脉宽从第一天到第三天的变化仅为1.5%。这一优异性能主要归因于测试脉冲对的共光路全透射式设计，使其具备出色的抗外界干扰能力。此外，该设计可与两步相移法结合，进一步提升对具有复杂时间或光谱结构脉冲的测量能力。该装置在超快激光脉冲表征与精密色散测量领域具有重要应用前景。
title: A compact, highly stable spectral shearing interferometer to accurately reconstruct ultrafast laser fields

abstract: We use an electro-thermal coupled Monte Carlo simulation framework to investigate the self-heating effect (SHE) in 14 nm bulk nFinFETs with ambient temperature (TA) from 220 to 400 K. Based on this method, non-local heat generation can be achieved. Contact thermal resistances of Si/Metal and Si/SiO2 are selected to ensure that the source and drain heat dissipation paths are the first two heat dissipation paths. The results are listed below: (i) not all input power (Qinput) turns into heat generation in the device region and some is taken out by the thermal non-equilibrium carriers, owing to the serious non-equilibrium transport; (ii) a higher TA leads to a larger ratio of input power turning into heat generation in the device region at the same operating voltages; (iii) SHE can lead to serious degradation in the carrier transport, which will increase when TA increases; (iv) the current degradation can be 8.9% when Vds = 0.7 V, Vgs = 1 V and TA = 400 K; (v) device thermal resistance (Rth) increases with increasing of TA, which is seriously impacted by the non-equilibrium transport. Hence, the impact of TA should be carefully considered when investigating SHE in nanoscale devices.
title: Impact of ambient temperature on the self-heating effects in FinFETs

abstract: Calibration of the tool frame is essential to ensure the accuracy of the measurement system. To enhance the detection range of R-test and make it more suitable for robot calibration, we designed a low-cost and high-precision three-dimensional measurement system with R-test. Then, a two-stage method is proposed to reduce the uncertainty caused by the orthogo- nalization procedure in the identification of the R-test frame, which consists of an orthogonalization solution that gives an initial value and an intelligent algorithm that improves the identification accuracy. The measurement structure of the R-test and the proposed identification method are easily applicable to articulated arm measuring machines (AMMs). Additionally, we provide an extension method for AMMs. In the experiment, a prototype of the three-dimensional measurement system based on R-test is developed. And, the comparative experiment proves the effectiveness of the proposed method. Keywords Three-dimensional measurement system · Tool frame calibration · Orthogonalization
summary_zh: 为提升测量系统精度，工具坐标系标定至关重要。本文针对R-test三维检测系统，设计了一种低成本高精度方案以扩大其检测范围，使其更适用于机器人标定。提出一种两阶段标定方法，以降低R-test坐标系辨识过程中因正交化处理引入的不确定性：第一阶段通过正交化求解提供初始值，第二阶段采用智能算法进一步提高辨识精度。该R-test测量结构及所提辨识方法可便捷地应用于关节臂测量机，并给出了相应的扩展方法。实验中研制了基于R-test的三维测量系统样机，对比实验验证了所提方法的有效性。
title: A calibration method for tool frame in the three-dimensional measurement system based on R-test
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

abstract: This study presents the development and catalytic applications of the tetrafluororesorcin[4]arene hexameric capsule (capsule II) as a novel supramolecular catalyst. It demonstrates unprecedented catalytic activity, enabling the β-selective glycosylation of glycals to 2-deoxy glycosides─a transformation that has not been achieved before in molecular and supramolecular catalysis. Mechanistic investigations, including experimental and computational studies, revealed that the high β-selectivity arises from a proton wire mechanism along the capsule's surface, coupling glycal protonation with nucleophile deprotonation. Control experiments confirmed the unique reactivity of capsule II compared to its nonfluorinated predecessor, capsule I, showcasing its potential to expand the boundaries of supramolecular catalysis.
summary_zh: 本研究开发了一种新型超分子催化剂——四氟间苯二酚[4]芳烃六聚体胶囊（胶囊II），并探索了其催化应用。该催化剂展现出前所未有的催化活性，能够实现糖烯向2-脱氧糖苷的β-选择性糖基化反应，这一转化在分子催化和超分子催化领域此前均未实现。机理研究结合实验与计算手段，揭示其高β-选择性源于胶囊表面形成的质子线机制，该机制将糖烯质子化与亲核试剂去质子化过程相耦合。对照实验证实，与未氟化的前体胶囊I相比，胶囊II具有独特的反应活性，展示了其拓展超分子催化边界的潜力。
title: Tetrafluororesorcin[4]arene Hexameric Capsule Enables the Expansion of the Reactivity Space in Supramolecular Catalysis
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

abstract: The global context is crucial to the semantic segmentation task of remote sensing (RS) urban scene imagery since objects have large size variations, high similarity, and mutual occlusion. However, the existing methods for extracting global context information have limitations when directly applied to very high-resolution RS images, mainly in high complexity of computation and memory consumption. To alleviate this limitation, we propose a novel Efficient Global Understanding semantic segmentation Network (EGUNet) to extract global context information efficiently for applicability to RS images. Specifically, EGUNet is a hybrid U-shaped architecture of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and Transformer in which the encoder uses the CSWin Transformer to capture global semantic information, and the decoder uses the CNNs structure to recover local detail information. Thus, the proposed EGUNet has a powerful global extraction capability and local position information recovery capability. In addition, three effective modules are proposed to improve the segmentation accuracy to make EGUNet more applicable for urban scene image segmentation tasks. First, a feature adaptive fusion module is introduced in the decoder to improve the fusion of the deep semantics and the location detail features. Second, an adaptive atrous-spatial pyramid pooling is designed at the skip connections to enhance the multiscale understanding of high-level semantic context. Finally, we introduce a lightweight enhanced segmentation head to utilize the information from each decoder stage for segmentation. Extensive experimental results on ISPRS Vaihingen and Potsdam datasets demonstrate the exceptional segmentation accuracy of EGUNet, outperforming the state-of-the-art methods.
title: Enhancing Efficient Global Understanding Network With CSWin Transformer for Urban Scene Images Segmentation
venue: IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Applied Earth Observations and Remote Sensing

summary_zh: 本文提出一种“固定化分子扰动”策略，通过调控单原子催化剂第二配位层微环境来提升质子交换膜燃料电池（PEMFC）中氧还原反应（ORR）性能。以Fe─N─C催化剂为模型，在活性中心邻近引入含P─O基团的扰动单元，利用其空间位阻和氢键作用选择性削弱关键中间体*OH的水合层，从而促进*OH脱附这一速率决定步骤。光谱表征与理论计算共同证实了该微环境调控机制。优化后的催化剂在0.5 M H₂SO₄中半波电位达0.861 V，在H₂/O₂ PEMFC中峰值功率密度达1024 mW cm⁻²，并在0.65 V恒压运行253小时后仍保持72%电流，稳定性优异，位居已报道非贵金属催化剂前列。该工作将研究范式从单纯优化活性中心拓展到主动设计局域微环境，为器件相关工况下的高效电催化提供了新途径。
title: Breaking the Intermediate Solvation Shell on Single-Atom Catalysts With a Proximal Group Perturber for Enhanced Oxygen Reduction

summary_zh: 本文构建了一套基于高带宽微型器件的全双工高速光无线通信系统，其中下行链路采用单像素量子点微型发光二极管，上行链路则分别采用垂直腔面发射激光器阵列。下行链路利用自适应正交频分复用技术，单像素量子点微型发光二极管实现了2.74 Gbps的数据速率。针对2.2米通信距离，设计了基于垂直腔面发射激光器的视距和非视距上行链路，并采用无透镜接收方案。实验结果表明，上下行链路均能为多吉比特光无线通信提供充足带宽。此外，无透镜上行接收器降低了对准要求，提升了发射端的移动性。在考虑人眼安全的前提下，两种链路中垂直腔面发射激光器的工作驱动电流分别仅为140毫安和190毫安。在非归零开关键控调制下，两条上行链路均能实现2.125 Gbps的速率，且误码率低于以太网接入前向纠错门限3.8×10⁻³。该方案为高速室内光无线接入提供了小型化、低功耗的可行途径。
title: Full-duplex high-speed indoor optical wireless communication system based on a micro-LED and VCSEL array

abstract: We study the Hankel determinants associated with the weight urn:x-wiley:00222526:media:sapm12090:sapm12090-math-0001 where , , , is analytic in a domain containing [ − 1, 1] and for . In this paper, based on the Deift–Zhou nonlinear steepest descent analysis, we study the double scaling limit of the Hankel determinants as and . We obtain the asymptotic approximations of the Hankel determinants, evaluated in terms of the Jimbo–Miwa–Okamoto σ‐function for the Painlevé III equation. The asymptotics of the leading coefficients and the recurrence coefficients for the perturbed Jacobi polynomials are also obtained.
summary_zh: 本文研究了一类与特定权函数相关的汉克尔行列式，该权函数形式为 urn:x-wiley:00222526:media:sapm12090:sapm12090-math-0001，其中参数满足特定条件，且函数在包含区间 [−1, 1] 的区域内解析并保持正值。基于 Deift–Zhou 非线性最速下降法，我们分析了当矩阵阶数趋于无穷大且另一参数趋于零时的双尺度极限行为。研究得到了汉克尔行列式在此极限下的渐近近似表达式，该结果通过 Painlevé III 方程的 Jimbo–Miwa–Okamoto σ 函数给出。此外，还导出了扰动雅可比多项式的首项系数与递推系数的渐近性质。该工作为相关正交多项式及随机矩阵理论中的渐近分析提供了新的理论工具。
title: Painlevé III Asymptotics of Hankel Determinants for a Perturbed Jacobi Weight

summary_zh: 本研究利用二维二硫化钼纳米片去除水中六价铬，重点揭示了其去除机理以及材料组成与结构独特性对去除效率的内在影响。通过分散纳米片的批次实验发现，二硫化钼纳米片对六价铬的去除容量高达约 1100 mg/g，且去除机制依赖于晶相类型。其中，1T 相二硫化钼通过氧化还原反应去除六价铬，这与以往报道的吸附去除机制不同，凸显了材料组成对去除机理和性能的调控作用。更为重要的是，还原产物三价铬可同步通过沉淀和吸附作用被固定在纳米片上，从而省去了传统处理工艺中通常所需的额外调高 pH 步骤。二硫化钼纳米片独特的二维片状结构能够形成定向且离子可及的纳米通道，六价铬在其中被容纳、还原并封存。干燥条件下纳米通道的不可逆收缩将层状堆叠结构内部转变为封闭隔室，有效阻止了已固定三价铬的释放和再氧化。综合结果表明，二硫化钼的组成和结构显著影响铬的去除效率与机理，这对未来针对不同修复场景定制二维纳米材料独特性能的研究具有重要指导意义。该技术在水处理领域展现出良好的应用前景。
title: Highly efficient removal and sequestration of Cr(VI) in confined MoS2 interlayer Nanochannels: Performance and mechanism

abstract: Origin-Destination (OD) matrices estimation is one of the key components in traffic planning and traffic control. Based on the maximum-entropy model, a solution by Genetic Algorithm (GA) is proposed. As an example the Guangzhou Neihuan Road traffic survey data is used to show the importance of current traffic counting points selecting principles. Two new principles are presented. Results show that this solution is able to solve the OD matrices estimation problem. The principles of setting traffic counting points tested in this paper play a very important role in the OD matrices estimation problem.
summary_zh: 基于最大熵模型，本文提出一种利用遗传算法求解起讫点矩阵估计的方法。起讫点矩阵估计是交通规划与交通控制的关键环节之一。以广州内环路交通调查数据为例，研究分析了现有交通检测点布设原则的重要性，并进一步提出两项新的布设原则。结果表明，所提遗传算法能够有效解决起讫点矩阵估计问题，同时验证了交通检测点布设原则在起讫点矩阵估计中具有重要作用。
title: Origin-Destination Matrices Estimation for Highway

summary_zh: 本研究探讨了清零政策在控制新冠疫情中的作用，并评估了通过全市检测-追踪-隔离策略消除奥密克戎传播的可能性。我们构建了一个包含该策略的仓室模型，以模拟中国福建省2021年9月10日至10月9日的德尔塔疫情，以及吉林省2022年3月1日至4月1日的奥密克戎疫情。模型校准结果显示，福建德尔塔疫情在开展10轮全市检测后，可在30天内实现清零；而吉林奥密克戎疫情在公共卫生资源充足和民众配合度高的条件下，预计可在50天内达到零病例目标，表明该策略对两种变异株疫情均具有遏制效果。敏感性分析进一步揭示了策略有效性的关键因素。然而，彻底实施全市检测-追踪-隔离策略面临诸多挑战，包括需要常态化监测以实现早期发现、充足的检测能力、高效的接触者追踪以及高度的隔离依从性，这些条件在资源有限地区难以满足。尤其当面对传染性更强且无症状比例高的变异株时，实施难度更为突出。因此，在无法推行该策略的地区，个人防护、公共卫生管控措施和疫苗接种仍是缓解并最终走出疫情不可或缺的手段。
title: Assessing the mechanism of citywide test-trace-isolate Zero-COVID policy and exit strategy of COVID-19 pandemic

abstract: The asymmetric synthesis of chiral-at-cage o-carboranes, whose chirality is associated with the substitution patterns on the polyhedron, is of great interest as the icosahedral carboranes have wide applications in medicinal and materials chemistry. Herein we report an intermolecular Ir-catalyzed enantioselective B-H alkenylation for efficient and facile synthesis of chiral-at-cage o-carboranes with new skeletons under mild reaction conditions. Generally very good to excellent yields with up to 99% ee can be achieved in this Ir-catalyzed B-H alkenylation. The enantiocontrol model is proposed based on Density Functional Theory calculations in which the use of chiral phosphoramidite ligand is essential for such asymmetric o-carborane B-H alkenylation.
summary_zh: 手性笼状邻碳硼烷的非对称合成具有重要的研究价值，其手性源于多面体上的取代模式，且此类二十面体碳硼烷在药物化学和材料化学领域有着广泛的应用。本文报道了一种通过铱催化的分子间对映选择性B-H烯基化反应，实现了新型骨架手性笼状邻碳硼烷的高效、简便合成。该反应在温和的反应条件下进行，通常能够获得极佳的产率，且对映选择性高达99% ee。此外，研究团队结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算提出了对映控制模型，结果表明使用手性磷酰胺配体对于实现此类不对称邻碳硼烷B-H烯基化反应至关重要。
title: Ir-catalyzed enantioselective B−H alkenylation for asymmetric synthesis of chiral-at-cage o‑carboranes

abstract: For linear discrete‐time multiple‐input–multiple‐output (MIMO) systems with high relative degree, this study presents three average operator‐based iterative learning control (ILC) algorithms to investigate the effect of initial state vibration on ILC tracking error. The proposed ILC laws include an initial rectifying action against initial state vibration at certain time points, and pursue the reference trajectory tracking beyond the initial time points. It is proved that, when the proposed ILC laws are applied to linear discrete‐time MIMO systems with high relative degree, the effect of the initial state vibration on ILC tracking error beyond the initial time points can be exactly decided. Moreover, the ILC tracking error beyond the initial time points can be driven to zero against a progressive fixed initial state error. Numerical examples are used to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed ILC laws.
summary_zh: 针对具有高相对阶数的线性离散时间多输入多输出（MIMO）系统，本文研究了初始状态振动对迭代学习控制（ILC）跟踪误差的影响，并提出了三种基于平均算子的迭代学习控制算法。所设计的控制律通过在特定时刻引入初始校正动作来抵消初始状态振动的影响，并在初始时刻之后实现对参考轨迹的精确跟踪。理论证明表明，当该算法应用于高相对阶的线性离散时间MIMO系统时，能够精确确定初始时刻之后初始状态振动对跟踪误差的作用。此外，针对渐进式固定的初始状态误差，该算法能够驱动初始时刻之后的跟踪误差收敛至零。通过数值仿真结果验证了所提控制算法在处理此类系统问题时的有效性。
title: Iterative learning control for linear discrete‐time systems with high relative degree under initial state vibration

summary_zh: 造血作用是产生所有血细胞谱系的发生学过程。在脊椎动物中，造血作用呈现出多波次的特征，在不同的解剖位置和发育阶段产生不同的血细胞谱系。尽管过去十年中，大量的谱系追踪研究已对造血系统的层级结构进行了深入探讨，但现有的大多数研究仍难以将时空信息与造血细胞的发育潜能有效整合。本文重点讨论了近期开发的红外激光诱导基因操纵（IR-LEGO）显微加热系统的技术进展及其在体内造血谱系追踪中的应用。该系统实现了在单细胞分辨率下对时空信息的精准控制，为深入理解造血作用的复杂机制提供了新的研究手段。
title: Lightening the way of hematopoiesis: Infrared laser-mediated lineage tracing with high spatial-temporal resolution

summary_zh: 血管内手术机器人（ESR）因能显著降低外科医生的辐射暴露而备受关注，但其在操控软导管和细导丝时的灵活性仍难以达到人手的水平。虽然引入软体夹持器可提升机器人的灵活性，但软材料的非线性变形给力感知与力控制带来了挑战。针对这一问题，本研究提出了一种基于深度学习的力感知方法，使柔性血管内手术机器人能够实时测量手术过程中的力和力矩。该方法构建了由多层长短期记忆网络（LSTM）组成的深度学习模型，并通过机器人运动数据与软体夹持器变形数据集进行训练。对比实验表明，该LSTM模型在力测量精度上优于其他模型。此外，研究还针对该机器人提出了一种力控制策略，旨在模拟外科医生手指的灵活性，并将操作力维持在安全范围内。血管仿生模型实验结果证实，该策略能有效提升血管内手术操作的安全性和效率。
title: Deep Learning-based Force Sensing Method for a Flexible Endovascular Surgery Robot
venue: IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement

summary_zh: 全球内陆河流域正面临水资源与生态危机，量化水文循环是实现可持续发展的基础，但气候变化与人类活动如何影响内陆河流域水文循环仍存在认知不足。本研究以中国干旱区典型内陆河——黑河流域为对象，采用集成生态水文模型并结合系统观测数据，分析了2001至2012年间流域内不同景观单元、河道断面及灌区的水量收支闭合特征。结果表明，气候变暖导致降水、融雪、冰川融水和径流增加，在一定程度上缓解了水资源短缺。人类活动如生态输水、耕地扩张和地下水超采则兼具正负效应：天然绿洲生态系统得到显著恢复，但中游水资源过度消耗以及下游将生态流量用于农业灌溉，加剧了水资源压力，导致地表水与地下水相互作用发生不利变化，并引发对水资源公平分配的关切。研究建议，该区域水资源管理需适应正在变化的水文循环，压缩耕地面积并控制地下水开采；同时应从更广泛的社会经济视角处理用水冲突，以获取长期效益。上述发现可为全球内陆河流域的政策制定者与利益相关方提供有益参考。
title: Hydrological Cycle in the Heihe River Basin and Its Implication for Water Resource Management in Endorheic Basins

summary_zh: 针对红外搜索与跟踪（IRST）系统中复杂背景下的微小目标检测难题，本文提出了一种结合方向导数相关滤波（DDCF）与局部相对强度对比度度量（LRICM）的新型检测框架，旨在有效应对云边及结构角点等多样化背景干扰。该方法首先利用分面模型将原始红外图像转换为红外梯度向量场（IGVF），并基于二阶导数计算中微小目标的显著特征，设计了四种方向滤波器，以在抑制边缘杂波的同时增强目标特征，进而通过融合四个方向的二阶导数滤波结果构建DDCF图。随后，通过分析目标与其邻域间的灰度对比度来确定LRICM，从而最大限度地减少背景角点等元素的干扰。最后，通过融合DDCF与LRICM图生成综合显著性表示，并利用自适应阈值技术实现目标的精确提取。多数据集实验结果表明，该方法显著提升了信杂比（SCR）。与现有先进技术相比，该方法在地面、云层、森林及城市建筑等复杂环境下表现出更高的检测可靠性，且计算复杂度较低，在检测精度与效率之间取得了良好的平衡，在实际IRST应用场景中具有广阔的应用前景。
title: Infrared Small Target Detection Using Directional Derivative Correlation Filtering and a Relative Intensity Contrast Measure

abstract: Defect mediated nonradiative recombination limits the photoluminescence (PL) quantum yield of transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers (MLs). In this work, the enhancement of the PL intensity of ML WS2 is reported in a van der Waals heterostructure of WS2 ML and InGaN quantum dots (QDs) under excitation with photon energy larger than the bandgaps of both WS2 and QDs. The mechanism of this PL enhancement is due to the aggregation of excitons in WS2 ML toward the QD sites to form an interfacial bound state, which effectively mitigates the influence of defects. This exciton aggregation induced enhancement of PL intensity is more pronounced at low temperatures and under low power excitations. The lifetime and diffusion coefficient of the excitons in WS2 ML are also measured to validate the aggregation scenario.
title: Exciton aggregation induced photoluminescence enhancement of monolayer WS2

abstract: In the paper we first establish the local well-posedness for a family of nonlinear dispersive equations, the so called b-equation. Then we describe the precise blow-up scenario. Moreover, we prove that for the b-equation we do have the coexistence of global in time solutions and blow-up phenomena: Depending on the initial data solutions may exist for ever, while other data force the solution to produce a singularity in finite time. Finally, we prove the uniqueness and existence of global weak solution to the equation provided the initial data satisfy certain sign conditions.
summary_zh: 本文首先针对一类称为b方程的非线性色散方程族，建立了局部适定性理论。随后，我们精确刻画了解的爆破情景，明确了导致解在有限时间内产生奇异性的具体条件。进一步的研究表明，b方程同时存在全局解与爆破现象：根据初始数据的不同，解可以永久存在，也可能在有限时间内发生奇异性。最后，在初始数据满足特定符号条件的前提下，我们证明了该方程全局弱解的存在性与唯一性。该工作为理解非线性色散方程的长时行为与奇异性形成机制提供了理论依据，在流体力学与数学物理相关领域具有应用价值。
title: Well-posedness, blow-up phenomena, and global solutions for the b-equation
venue: Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik (Crelles Journal)

summary_zh: 电化学氮还原反应合成氨因相比传统哈伯-博斯法更环保、能耗更低而备受关注，但目前报道的各类电催化剂在常温常压下的活性普遍偏低。本研究合成了部分氧化的氮化铬（氮氧化铬）纳米颗粒，并在常温常压下的质子交换膜电解器中评价其氮还原催化性能。在2.0 V槽电压下，最高氨生成速率达到8.9×10⁻¹¹ mol s⁻¹ cm⁻²，质量活性为15.56 µg h⁻¹ mg⁻¹催化剂；在1.8 V槽电压下，最高法拉第效率为6.7%。结果表明，金属氮化物基材料有望成为高效的氮还原电催化剂，并为设计更先进的多类反应催化剂提供理性指导。
title: Chromium Oxynitride Electrocatalysts for Electrochemical Synthesis of Ammonia Under Ambient Conditions

abstract: Novel array-level MXene-electrode flexible synaptic transistors (MEFST) have been realized with a long-term synaptic plasticity of over 1000 s without requiring a floating gate structure, electrolyte dielectrics, or ferroelectric materials.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种新型阵列级MXene电极柔性突触晶体管（MEFST），该器件无需浮栅结构、电解质介质或铁电材料，即可实现超过1000秒的长时程突触可塑性。MEFST利用MXene材料优异的导电性与机械柔性，在阵列集成层面构建了稳定的人工突触单元，其突触权重可在长时间尺度上保持非易失性调节。实验结果表明，该器件在弯曲和重复操作条件下仍能维持可靠的突触响应，展现出良好的柔性电子兼容性。这一成果为构建低功耗、高集成度的柔性神经形态计算系统提供了新的硬件基础，在可穿戴智能感知、自适应人机交互以及边缘神经推理等领域具有广阔的应用前景。
title: Array-level MXene electrode flexible long-term-plasticity synaptic transistors

abstract: Hybrid microgels represent advanced soft colloidal materials. This review systematically outlines key fabrication strategies, structure–property relationships, and emerging applications of hybrid microgels.
summary_zh: 杂化微凝胶是一类先进的软胶体材料，本综述系统梳理了其核心制备策略、结构-性能关系及新兴应用。在制备方面，重点介绍了原位合成、物理共混和化学交联等主要方法，这些策略可在微凝胶网络中原位生成或引入无机纳米粒子、有机功能分子或生物活性组分，从而赋予材料多重响应性和定制化功能。结构-性能关系部分揭示了杂化组分在微凝胶基质中的空间分布、界面相互作用及含量对材料力学性能、刺激响应行为和胶体稳定性的调控规律。在新兴应用领域，杂化微凝胶在生物医学工程中展现出巨大潜力，包括智能药物递送系统、组织工程支架和生物传感平台；在催化领域，其可作为可回收纳米反应器；在环境修复中，这类材料可用于重金属离子吸附和有机污染物去除。此外，杂化微凝胶在光子晶体、防伪油墨和自适应涂层等智能光学材料方面也显示出独特优势。本综述旨在为杂化微凝胶的理性设计和实际应用提供系统性指导。
title: Engineering hybrid microgels: from rational design to next-generation smart materials

summary_zh: 网络搜索引擎Shodan和Censys通过主动扫描与指纹识别技术大规模索引物联网设备，建立IP与设备间的映射关系。由于互联网地址空间巨大且该映射动态变化，在有限扫描预算下高效追踪映射演变成为构建实时网络搜索引擎的关键。一种直观思路是借助强化学习，将扫描资源更多地分配给IP-设备映射变动率高的网络，但该方法此前缺乏系统性研究。本文基于长期维护全球物联网扫描平台的实践经验，首次对该问题进行深入解析。受大规模真实物联网扫描记录测量研究的启发，我们设计了一种将强化学习原则化落地的系统，能够以智能调度方式执行设备扫描。研究揭示了影响不同扫描策略有效性的关键参数，并发现随着物联网设备数量的激增，所提系统将获得持续增长的性能优势。该工作为构建高效、及时的物联网网络搜索引擎提供了可行的方法支撑。
title: Landing Reinforcement Learning onto Smart Scanning of The Internet of Things
venue: IEEE INFOCOM 2022 - IEEE Conference on Computer Communications

summary_zh: 本文报道了在狄拉克拓扑半金属 Cd₃As₂ 微米带中观测到的显著负磁阻效应。在平行磁场与电场配置下，该材料在 50 K 时负磁阻高达 66%，且在室温下仍可分辨。研究发现，负磁阻对磁场与电场间的夹角高度敏感，具有温度鲁棒性，并与载流子浓度密切相关。载流子浓度遵循阿伦尼乌斯定律，从 300 K 时的 3.0×10¹⁷ cm⁻³ 降至 50 K 以下的 2.2×10¹⁶ cm⁻³，低载流子浓度是产生大负磁阻的关键因素。据此，我们将观测到的负磁阻归因于手征反常效应。此外，在垂直场配置下，于 14 T 和 2 K 条件下还获得了高达 1670% 的非饱和线性正磁阻。该工作揭示了拓扑半金属在磁性器件中的应用潜力。
title: Negative Magnetoresistance in Dirac Semimetal Cd3As2

abstract: A new miniature spectrometer with two entrance slits is proposed to expand the spectral band. The proposed spectrometer is designed such that the two entrance slits share the same concave grating and detector array. The two slits are located at different positions such that the spectral range of the same light source incident on the detector array varies greatly between the two slits. Only one of the two slits is illuminated at a given time; as such, the two spectral ranges are sequentially measured. Theoretical calculation and experimentation are conducted to verify the proposed design.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种通过双入射狭缝设计来扩展光谱范围的新型微型光谱仪。该设计巧妙地使两个入射狭缝共用同一个凹面光栅和探测器阵列，通过将两个狭缝布置在不同的空间位置，使得同一光源入射到探测器阵列时，两个狭缝所对应的光谱范围呈现显著差异。在实际测量过程中，系统通过交替照明两个狭缝的方式，实现对不同光谱波段的顺序测量。通过理论计算与实验验证，证明了该设计在扩展光谱带宽方面的有效性，为微型光谱仪的性能提升提供了一种紧凑且高效的设计方案。
title: A concave grating miniature spectrometer with an expanded spectral band by using two entrance

abstract: Spectral efficient frequency division multiplexing (SEFDM) can improve the spectral efficiency for next-generation optical and wireless communications. In this work, we apply SEFDM in beyond 100-Gb/s optical intensity modulation and direct detection transmissions and propose a low-complexity logarithmic-maximum-a-posteriori (log-MAP) Viterbi decoding algorithm to achieve the maximum likelihood (ML) detection. We evaluate the likelihood of detections using a posteriori probability instead of Euclidean distance by taking both noise and inter-carrier interference into consideration. In order to balance the performance and complexity, we then employ Viterbi decoding principle to retain only certain paths with ML detections (a.k.a., the surviving paths) while discarding the others during the decoding procedure. Results show that the proposed log-MAP Viterbi decoding scheme achieves optimal performance due to the precise likelihood evaluation, which guarantees the retention of the global ML detection. By using the proposed decoding scheme, the data rate of SEFDM signals can reach 150-Gb/s in a 2-km standard single mode fiber transmission, using only 28-GHz bandwidth and 16-QAM modulation. Experimental results show that the 16-QAM modulated SEFDM signal with a bandwidth compression factor of 0.8 outperforms 32-QAM modulated OFDM, while both signals have the same bandwidth (28-GHz) and data rate (140-Gb/s), which demonstrate the superiority of SEFDM in optical short reach applications.
title: 150-Gb/s SEFDM IM/DD transmission using log-MAP Viterbi decoding for short reach optical links

abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) encode images and videos into abundant tokens, which contain substantial redundancy and computation cost. While visual token pruning mitigates the issue, most existing methods lack insight into the intrinsic property of the vision encoder itself. In this work, we dive into the vision encoder and prove that the middle layers pay more attention to the main objects of the image qualitatively and quantitatively, while the deep layers to tokens with rich global information. Utilizing this Hierarchical attention pattern, we propose HiPrune, a training-free and model-agnostic token Pruning method. HiPrune identifies three types of visual tokens according to their attention in different phases of the vision encoder, which preserves different levels of information. By coupling with the similarity of text tokens, we propose a prompt-aware variance, HiPrune++, which further improves instruction following performance under a very low token budget. Extensive experiments across four representative VLMs show that HiPrune achieves up to 99.3% of task accuracy with only 1/3 of the tokens, while reducing inference FLOPs by 58.7%. HiPrune++ maintains up to 99.7% accuracy with 2/9 tokens, highlighting robustness under high-resolution. Our code is available at https://github.com/Danielement321/HiPrune.
title: HiPrune: Hierarchical Attention for Efficient Token Pruning in Vision-Language Models

abstract: Single image super-resolution (SISR) is essential in many remote sensing applications. Most of the existing SISR methods on remote sensing images assume that the low resolution (LR) images are synthesized from high-resolution (HR) images by bicubic downscaling. However, the performance of those methods is limited in the real-world remote sensing scenario as the actual degradation is sometimes different from the assumption. Therefore, we introduce the blind super-resolution (SR) concept and propose a super-resolution method with blur kernel prediction (BKPSR). BKPSR first predicts the blur kernel code for an image and then utilizes the blur kernel code to assist the image super-resolution. Experimental results indicate that our method outperforms existing SISR methods on real-world remote sensing images.
summary_zh: 针对遥感图像在实际应用中面临退化过程复杂、传统单图超分辨率方法依赖理想双三次下采样假设而性能受限的问题，本文引入盲超分辨率概念，提出一种基于模糊核预测的超分辨率方法。该方法首先对输入的低分辨率遥感图像进行模糊核编码预测，获取表征实际退化类型的核信息，随后将该模糊核编码作为先验条件融入图像重建网络，以指导高分辨率图像的恢复过程。通过在真实遥感图像上的实验验证，所提方法在重建质量和视觉效果上均优于现有单图超分辨率方法，有效提升了复杂退化条件下的超分辨率性能，适用于遥感监测、地物识别等实际应用场景。
title: Super-Resolution on Remote Sensing Images with Blur Kernel Prediction
venue: 2021 IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium IGARSS. Cite URL

summary_zh: 本文系统综述了可见光-热红外（RGBT）目标跟踪领域的最新研究进展。RGBT跟踪通过融合可见光与热红外图像的优势，有效弥补了单一传感器在复杂环境下全天候跟踪能力的不足。然而，该技术仍面临热交叉、目标遮挡、光照变化、快速运动及背景杂乱等挑战，制约了跟踪性能的进一步提升。为此，研究者已提出多种改进方法。本文首先依据跟踪框架对现有方法进行分类梳理，随后介绍了用于性能评估的主流数据集与测试基准，并展示了代表性跟踪方法在多个基准上的量化结果，直观呈现了当前领域的研究水平。最后，文章探讨了未来可能的研究方向，旨在推动RGBT跟踪技术的持续发展。
title: A Comprehensive Review of RGBT Tracking
venue: IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement

summary_zh: 外日球层中拾取离子的稳定性是解释IBEX观测到的近环状能量中性原子（ENA）发射带的关键。既往研究表明，当拾取离子环的平行热展宽与背景粒子群相当时，其在平行于背景磁场传播时可抑制阿尔芬/离子回旋（AC）不稳定性。本研究旨在探讨在AC不稳定性被抑制的情况下，镜像不稳定性或离子伯恩斯坦（IB）不稳定性对拾取离子稳定性的潜在影响。基于线性Vlasov理论的预测，即使AC不稳定性受到抑制，镜像与IB不稳定性仍表现出较快的增长率。通过二维混合模拟与宏观准线性模拟，研究发现镜像模在初期占据主导地位，并导致拾取离子的平行加热程度超过背景质子的平行温度。随后，受热的拾取离子会触发AC模的发生，并在镜像模衰减后，使AC模成为主要的俯仰角散射媒介。研究结果表明，若将镜像与IB不稳定性纳入考量，维持ENA机制所需的拾取离子稳定性可能无法得到保障。
title: Contributions of Mirror and Ion Bernstein Instabilities to the Scattering of Pickup Ions in the Outer Heliosheath

summary_zh: 随着点对点（P2P）能源交易的日益普及，若缺乏必要的安全保障措施，将对电网运行安全构成威胁。现有研究难以在同一网络中同时协调常规负荷供应与P2P交易，无法针对引发网络违规的交易提供针对性信号，且缺乏分布式且直观的交易机制。针对上述问题，本文提出了一种基于负荷优先级规则的两阶段框架。第一阶段对常规负荷进行经济调度；第二阶段采用双层网络使用费（NUC）算法实现受限的产消者交易。为了实现目标明确、公平且稳定的NUC更新，本文在配电网运营商（DSO）层设计了一种新型加权更新规则，并在产消者层设计了直观的协商过程，以促进分布式P2P交易。仿真结果表明，该方法将电压波动范围从0.8-1.2 p.u.显著缩小至0.95-1.05 p.u.，并将最大绝对功率偏差从0.8 p.u.降低至0.6 p.u.。与基准策略相比，该方法在保障电网安全的同时，实现了更高的社会福利。
title: Network Usage Charge Design for Peer-to-Peer Transactions Considering Network Constraints
venue: 2025 IEEE PES Innovative Smart Grid Technologies - Asia (ISGT Asia)

abstract: Constrained optimization problems are pervasive in various fields, and while conventional techniques offer solutions, they often struggle with scalability. Leveraging the power of deep neural networks (DNNs) in optimization, we present a novel learning-based approach, the Constraint Boundary Wandering Framework (CBWF), to address these challenges. Our contributions include introducing a boundary wandering strategy inspired by the active-set method, enhancing equality constraint feasibility, and treating the Lipschitz constant as a learnable parameter. Additionally, we evaluate the regularization term, illustrating that the nonsmooth L2 norm yields superior results. Extensive testing on synthetic datasets and the ACOPT dataset demonstrates CBWF's superiority, outperforming existing deep learning-based solvers in terms of both objective and constraint loss.
title: Constraint Boundary Wandering Framework: Enhancing Constrained Optimization With Deep Neural Networks
venue: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence

abstract: The concentrations of N (CN) and interstitial metal defects (CMi) and the film thickness (d) dependent microstructure and optical and electrical properties of InGaZnON thin films deposited by RF sputtering are studied. The thin films have a C-axis aligned crystalline structure with increased grain size and CMi and CN with rising substrate temperature and power during sputtering. The average visible optical transmittance (Tr) of 80% decreases with the increased d. The lowered Tr in the infrared region with the increment of free carrier absorption is observed. The refractive index and extinction coefficient and dielectric constants increase, and band gap decreases from 2.8 to 2.2 eV, due to the increased CN and d. The electrical resistivity decreases from 0.1 to 5.0 E-3 Ω.cm and the work function increases from 2.8 to 3.7 eV with the increased free carrier concentration (Ne). The electrical properties are air-stable stored for 1000 hrs due to the N passiviated surface. The thermoelectric properties, including the Seebeck coefficient (S) and power factor and electric thermal conductivity from 300 to 673 K, are evaluated. The S and extracted electron effective mass are temperature and Ne depended. The electron mean path and scattering time and plasma energy at room temperature are calculated.
title: Optical and electrical properties of transparent conductive air-stable C-axis aligned crystalline InGaZnON thin films

abstract: We report on the fabrication of well-defined polymer-protein bioconjugates with varying chain architectures, including star polymers, star block copolymers, and heteroarm star copolymers through the specific noncovalent interaction between avidin and biotinylated synthetic polymer precursors. Homopolymer and diblock precursors site-specifically labeled with a single biotin moiety at the chain terminal, chain middle, or diblock junction point were synthesized by a combination of atom-transfer radical polymerization (ATRP) and click reactions. By taking advantage of molecular recognition between avidin and biotin moieties, supramolecular star polymers, star block copolymers, and heteroarm star copolymers were successfully fabricated. This specific binding process was also assessed by using the diffraction optic technology (DOT) technique. We further investigated the effects of polymer molecular weights, location of biotin functionality within the polymer chain, and polymer chain conformations, that is, steric hindrance effects, on the binding numbers of biotinylated polymer chains per avidin within the polymer-protein bioconjugates, which were determined by the standard avidin/2-(4-hydroxyazobenzene)benzoic acid (HABA) assay. The binding numbers vary in the range of 1.9-3.3, depending on the molecular weights, locations of biotin functionality within synthetic polymer precursors, and polymer chain conformations.
title: Construction of Polymer–Protein Bioconjugates with Varying Chain Topologies: Polymer Molecular Weight and Steric Hindrance Effects

abstract: Antibiotics continuously discharged into the aquatic environment pose threats to phototrophs via high-affinity binding to photosynthetic apparatuses and interfering with their energy metabolism and growth. However, studies attributed the sublethal effects of antibiotics on phototrophs to damaging photosystem (PS) II (PSII) proteins while neglecting PSI proteins as potential targets. Herein, we report that frequently detected ciprofloxacin (CIP) with concentrations of 3-8 μg/L was lethal to Microcystis aeruginosa, the widely distributed phytoplankton in freshwater, via damaging DNA. Besides, CIP damages on different photosynthetic proteins at different exposure levels were evidenced to influence the cyanobacterial death phenotypes. In detail, CIP at 3 μg/L bound to PSII D1 protein exclusively, activating the tricarboxylic acid cycle for energy and proline catabolism. This favored the execution of apoptosis-like regulated cell death (RCD). However, CIP at 8 μg/L exhibited additional binding to the PSI iron-sulfur reaction center, apart from PSII, inducing carbon and arginine starvation. This shifted the RCD from apoptosis-like RCD to mazEF-mediated RCD. Furthermore, microcystin-LR risks were elevated after CIP exposure with enhanced microcystin-LR release and biosynthesis for apoptosis-like and mazEF-mediated RCD, respectively. Thus, the present study underscores the intricate interactions between antibiotics and different photosynthetic apparatuses, which alter antibiotic lethal effects at different exposure levels. This could provide new perspectives on the risk assessment and prediction of antibiotics from the standpoint of chemical-photosynthesis interactions.
title: Variable cyanobacterial death modes caused by ciprofloxacin in the aquatic environment: Prioritizing antibiotic-photosynthetic protein interactions for risk assessment

abstract: A dual-state-emission fluorescent probe undergoes H 2 O 2 -triggered structural transformation, producing a distinct color change from yellow to red in both aqueous media and living cells.
summary_zh: 该研究设计了一种具有双态发射特性的荧光探针，其核心机制在于过氧化氢触发探针分子发生特异性结构转化。在初始状态下，探针呈现黄色荧光发射；当与过氧化氢响应后，分子结构重排导致发射波长红移，产生显著的红色荧光信号。这种从黄到红的明显颜色转变可在水相介质及活细胞环境中同步实现，为可视化检测提供了直观判据。实验结果表明，该探针对过氧化氢具有高选择性和灵敏度，能够有效区分其他活性氧物种，并在生理条件下保持稳定响应。在活细胞成像应用中，探针成功实现了内源性及外源性过氧化氢的实时原位监测，荧光颜色切换清晰可辨，空间分辨率良好。该双态发射策略有效克服了传统单波长探针易受环境干扰的局限，通过比率型颜色变化提高了检测准确性和可靠性。此荧光探针在氧化应激相关疾病机制研究、药物筛选以及生物医学诊断等领域具有广阔的应用前景。
title: A chalcone molecular switch with dual-state-emission for ratiometric tracking of hydrogen peroxide

abstract: PURPOSE: A subset of patients with chronic myelogenous leukemia (CML) do not respond to the tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) imatinib mesylate. Such primary imatinib resistance is distinguished from secondary resistance which reemerges after attainment of cytogenetic remission. PATIENTS AND METHODS: We studied gene expression patterns in total WBCs using a panel of 21 genes previously implicated in TKI handling, resistance, or progression comparing patients who had newly diagnosed TKI-naive CML that had optimal (n = 41), or suboptimal (n = 7) responses to imatinib, or primary resistance (n = 20). Expression patterns were compared to those in secondary TKI-resistant chronic phase CML without ABL1 kinase domain mutations (n = 29), and to lymphoid (n = 15) or myeloid blast phase disease (n = 12). RESULTS: Fifteen genes in the panel distinguished blast phase from chronic phase disease, and 12 genes distinguished newly diagnosed CML from TKI-resistant CML without ABL1 kinase domain mutations, but only a single gene, prostaglandin-endoperoxide synthase 1/cyclooxgenase 1 (PTGS1/COX1; P = .005), differentiated imatinib-responsive from primary imatinib-resistant CML. The association of primary imatinib resistance with higher transcript levels of the drug metabolism gene PTGS1 was confirmed in a separate data set of 68 newly diagnosed, imatinib-treated CML (P = .008). In contrast, up to 11 different genes were identified in a multivariate model that optimally discriminated secondary imatinib resistance lacking ABL1 kinase domain mutation from imatinib-responsive cases, likely related to the more complex pathogenesis of secondary resistance. CONCLUSION: Gene expression profiling of CML at diagnosis for PTGS1 may be useful in predicting imatinib response and in selecting alternate therapy.
title: Predictors of Primary Imatinib Resistance in Chronic Myelogenous Leukemia Are Distinct From Those in Secondary Imatinib Resistance

abstract: Microbial-Induced Carbonate Precipitation (MICP) is a naturally occurring process whereby bacteria produce enzymes that accelerate the precipitation of calcium carbonate. This process is facilitated through various bacterial activities, including ureolysis, sulfate reduction, iron reduction, and denitrification. The application of MICP has been widespread in a range of engineering fields, such as geotechnical, concrete, environmental, and oil and gas engineering for soil stabilization, concrete remediation, heavy metal solidification, and permeability control. Numerous review papers have been published that summarize the mechanisms and properties associated with different MICP applications. The purpose of this review paper is to provide a comprehensive summary of the various engineering applications of MICP, along with the mechanisms, materials, and engineering properties associated with each application. By comparing the similarities and differences in MICP research progress across different engineering fields, this review aims to increase understanding of MICP, stimulate new research ideas, and accelerate the development of MICP techniques.
summary_zh: 微生物诱导碳酸钙沉淀（MICP）是一种利用细菌代谢产生的酶加速碳酸钙沉淀的自然过程，其机制涵盖尿素水解、硫酸盐还原、铁还原及反硝化等多种途径。该技术已广泛应用于岩土、混凝土、环境及油气工程等领域，用于土壤加固、混凝土修复、重金属固化和渗透性控制。已有大量综述总结了不同MICP应用的机理与特性。本文旨在系统梳理MICP在各类工程中的应用现状，归纳各应用所涉及的机制、材料及工程性能，并通过对比不同工程领域间MICP研究进展的异同，深化对该技术的整体认知，激发新的研究思路，推动MICP技术的加速发展。
title: Applications of microbial-induced carbonate precipitation: A state-of-the-art review

summary_zh: 干旱是植物面临的最严重的非生物胁迫之一，而植物微生物组在增强植物抗旱性方面发挥着重要作用。然而，目前关于植物如何通过遗传机制调控干旱诱导的微生物组动态组装仍缺乏证据。本研究利用根毛密度增强或降低的突变体，发现根毛发育调节因子能够影响干旱诱导的根系微生物组变化，其中Rhizobiaceae（根瘤菌科）是受根毛相关突变体影响的关键生物标志物分类单元。通过对1479个根系相关微生物进行分离与测序，研究证实多种根瘤菌菌株具有缓解干旱胁迫的能力。结合宏基因组学、根系转录组学和代谢组学的多组学分析，研究进一步揭示了干旱胁迫下的多维组学变化。通过敲除根瘤菌sp. 4F10中的鸟氨酸环化脱氨酶（ocd）基因，发现其缓解胁迫的能力显著下降。本研究通过整合植物遗传学、微生物遗传学及多组学手段，证实了宿主遗传效应参与了干旱期间缓解胁迫型根系微生物组的重塑过程，并从机制上阐明了根瘤菌科介导植物抗旱保护的作用，揭示了根毛发育调节因子在构建抗旱微生物组中的关键作用。
title: Root hair developmental regulators orchestrate drought triggered microbiome changes and the interaction with beneficial Rhizobiaceae

abstract: Viability, fluorescence (particle volume), photometric, viral RNA, and particle number penetration of MS2 bacteriophage through filter media used in three different models of respirators were compared to better understand the correlation between viability and physical penetration. Although viability and viral RNA penetration were better represented by particle volume penetration than particle number penetration, they were several-fold lower than photometric penetration, which was partially due to the difference in virus survival between upstream and downstream aerosol samples. Results suggest that the current NIOSH photometer-based test method can be used as a quick means to roughly differentiate respirators with different performance against virus aerosols.
summary_zh: 本研究比较了MS2噬菌体在三种不同型号呼吸器过滤介质中的穿透情况，涵盖活性、荧光（颗粒体积）、光度、病毒RNA及颗粒数量等多种穿透指标，旨在深入理解活性穿透与物理穿透之间的相关性。结果表明，活性穿透和病毒RNA穿透更接近颗粒体积穿透而非颗粒数量穿透，但其数值仍比光度穿透低数倍，部分原因在于上下游气溶胶样本中病毒存活率的差异。研究提示，当前NIOSH基于光度计的检测方法可作为快速手段，用于初步区分不同呼吸器对病毒气溶胶的防护性能。
title: Respirator Testing Using Virus Aerosol: Comparison between Viability Penetration and Physical Penetration

summary_zh: 弱监督目标定位（WSOL）旨在仅利用图像级标签实现目标定位，具有较低的标注成本。尽管近期研究利用视觉Transformer的长程依赖建模能力来激活语义区域，以缓解传统类激活映射（CAM）中的局部激活问题，但Transformer的长程建模往往忽略了目标的固有空间相干性，导致语义激活区域扩散至目标边界之外，从而产生定位范围过大或过小的问题。针对这一挑战，本文提出了一种简单且有效的空间校准模块（SCM），通过将Patch Token的语义相似性与其空间关系整合进统一的扩散模型中，以实现精确的WSOL。具体而言，SCM引入了可学习参数，通过动态调整语义相关性和空间上下文强度来实现有效的信息传播。在实际应用中，SCM被设计为Transformer的外部模块，在推理阶段可以将其移除以降低计算开销。通过训练阶段的优化，目标敏感的定位能力被隐式嵌入到Transformer编码器中，使生成的注意力图能够捕捉更清晰的目标边界并过滤无关的背景区域。在CUB-200和ImageNet-1K基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法显著优于现有的TS-CAM方法。
title: Weakly Supervised Object Localization via Transformer with Implicit Spatial Calibration

summary_zh: 近年来，陶瓷膜在水体污染物去除领域受到广泛关注，其中氧化铝膜作为最重要的陶瓷膜之一，不仅在微滤、超滤和纳滤等分离过程中发挥关键作用，还在催化与吸附增强分离等水净化与废水处理应用中展现出重要价值。然而，目前尚缺乏针对氧化铝膜用于水净化的系统性评述。本文综述了氧化铝膜的最新研究进展，重点评述了降低制备成本、提升膜性能和缓解膜污染的前沿策略。在提升膜性能方面，总结了若干新兴方法，包括膜结构调控、柔性膜开发、纳米孔设计以实现精准分离以及多功能性增强。此外，简要介绍了氧化铝膜在水净化中的工程应用实例。最后，展望了未来研究方向，如经济型制备与应用、挑战性精准分离、多功能性拓展以及分离机理的深入阐明。
title: Progress in alumina ceramic membranes for water purification: Status and prospects

abstract: Alveolar bone loss is a main manifestation of periodontitis. Human periodontal ligament stem cells (PDLSCs) are considered as optimal seed cells for alveolar bone regeneration due to its mesenchymal stem cell like properties. Osteogenic potential is the premise for PDLSCs to repair alveolar bone loss. However, the mechanism regulating osteogenic differentiation of PDLSCs remain elusive. In this study, we identified Neuron-derived orphan receptor 1 (NOR1), was particularly expressed in PDL tissue in vivo and gradually increased during osteogenic differentiation of PDLSCs in vitro. Knockdown of NOR1 in hPDLSCs inhibited their osteogenic potential while NOR1 overexpression reversed this effect. In order to elucidate the downstream regulatory network of NOR1, RNA-sequencing was used. We found that downregulated genes were mainly enriched in TGF-β, Hippo, Wnt signaling pathway. Further, by western blot analysis, we verified that the expression level of phosphorylated-SMAD2/3 and phosphorylated-SMAD4 were all decreased after NOR1 knockdown. Additionally, ChIP-qPCR and dual luciferase reporter assay indicated that NOR1 could bind to the promoter of TGFBR1 and regulate its activity. Moreover, overexpression of TGFBR1 in PDLSCs could rescue the damaged osteogenic potential after NOR1 knockdown. Taken together, our results demonstrated that NOR1 could activate TGF-β/SMAD signaling pathway and positively regulates the commitment of osteoblast lineages of PDLSCs by targeting TGFBR1 directly.
title: NOR1 promotes the osteoblastic differentiation of human periodontal ligament stem cells via TGF-β signaling pathway

summary_zh: 本文提出一种新颖的张量补全模型，同时利用原始张量的全局低秩结构与因子张量的局部平滑特性，以解决低秩张量补全方法常忽略图像和视频内在局部平滑结构的问题。模型将目标张量分解为两个因子张量，并要求每个因子张量具备充分的局部平滑性，从而在潜在因子空间而非仅原始数据空间中挖掘平滑先验。为高效求解该模型，设计了基于交替方向乘子法的优化算法。理论上，本文针对不同分解框架下基于平滑因子的张量补全方法建立了泛化误差界，所得界显著紧于现有结果，为局部平滑性在提升恢复性能方面的作用提供了理论支撑。在彩色图像、多光谱图像和视频上的广泛修复实验表明，该方法在恢复质量上具有明显优势，且对超参数设置不敏感，增强了实际应用中的便捷性与可靠性。
title: Smooth Tensor Product for Tensor Completion

summary_zh: 本文提出一种单层超表面结构，可在可见光至近红外波段实现宽带近完美吸收。该结构在单个单元内引入两种不同尺寸的纳米柱，激发米氏共振，使入射光高效耦合至有损耗的衬底，从而显著增强吸收。超表面与支撑衬底均由同质材料锗构成，利用不同阶次米氏共振的耦合与重叠实现宽带吸收。在400至1300纳米波长范围内，平均吸收率达96%。得益于C4对称性，该结构具备偏振不敏感特性。当入射角增大至50°时，平均吸收效率仍可达92%。本工作为设计高性能单层完美吸收体提供了范例，在先进光捕获、集成光子系统及光电子器件等领域具有潜在应用价值。
title: Ultra-broadband near-perfect absorber based on a single-layer Ge-assisted metasurface
venue: Journal of the Optical Society of America B

abstract: Recently, advances in neural network approaches have achieved many successes in both sentiment classification and probabilistic topic modeling. On the one hand, latent topics derived from the global context of documents could be helpful in capturing more accurate word semantics and hence could potentially improve the sentiment classification accuracy. On the other hand, the word-level attention vectors obtained during the learning of sentiment classifiers could carry word-level polarity information and can be used to guide the discovery of topics in topic modeling. This paper proposes a multi-task learning framework which jointly learns a sentiment classifier and a topic model by making the word-level latent topic distributions in the topic model to be similar to the word-level attention vectors in sentiment classifiers through mutual learning. Experimental results on the Yelp and IMDB datasets verify the superior performance of the proposed framework over strong baselines on both sentiment classification and topic modeling. The proposed framework also extracts more interpretable topics compared to other conventional topic models and neural topic models.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种多任务学习框架，通过互学习机制联合训练情感分类器与主题模型，使主题模型中的词级潜在主题分布与情感分类器中的词级注意力向量相互趋近。该框架利用文档全局上下文提取的潜在主题来捕获更精确的词义，从而提升情感分类准确率；同时，情感分类器学习过程中获得的词级注意力向量携带词级极性信息，可反过来引导主题模型发现更具情感区分度的主题。在Yelp和IMDB数据集上的实验结果表明，所提框架在情感分类和主题建模两项任务上均显著优于强基线方法。此外，与传统主题模型及神经主题模型相比，该框架能够提取出更具可解释性的主题。
title: Multi Task Mutual Learning for Joint Sentiment Classification and Topic Detection
venue: IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering

summary_zh: 本研究利用临床实践研究数据链，探讨他汀类药物使用与卒中后痴呆风险之间的关系。纳入既往无痴呆、首次发生卒中且前一年未使用他汀的患者，随访最长10年。采用逆概率加权边际结构模型，分别估计意向治疗分析（他汀启动 vs. 未启动）和符合方案分析（持续使用 vs. 未使用）对痴呆风险的影响。同时以冠心病作为阳性对照结局，以骨折和消化性溃疡作为阴性对照结局，评估未测量混杂的潜在影响。共纳入18,577例他汀启动者和14,613例未启动者，平均随访4.2年。意向治疗分析显示，他汀启动与痴呆风险降低相关，调整后风险比为0.70（95%置信区间0.64–0.75）；符合方案分析中，持续使用他汀的调整后风险比为0.55（95%置信区间0.50–0.62）。冠心病结局的相应调整后风险比分别为0.87（0.79–0.95）和0.70（0.62–0.80），消化性溃疡为1.03（0.82–1.29）和1.09（0.77–1.54），骨折为0.88（0.80–0.96）和0.86（0.75–0.98）。结果表明，卒中后启动他汀治疗与较低的痴呆风险相关，且持续用药者获益可能更大。然而，他汀使用与骨折风险之间的关联提示存在未测量混杂，可能导致他汀对卒中后痴呆的保护作用被部分高估。该发现为卒中人群的他汀治疗与认知结局提供了真实世界证据，对临床用药决策具有参考价值。
title: Statin use is associated with lower risk of dementia in stroke patients: a community-based cohort study with inverse probability weighted marginal structural model analysis

summary_zh: 瞬态执行攻击已成为现代高性能处理器面临的主要安全威胁之一，其利用推测执行漏洞非法窃取私密数据，并通过基于时序的隐蔽信道进行传输。随着新型漏洞不断被发现，隐蔽信道可归纳为两类：一是持久型，基于缓存或TLB等缓冲布局变化构建信道；二是易失型，通过执行单元或发射端口等共享资源的竞争来传递信息。针对持久型隐蔽信道的防御已较为成熟，而面向易失型的防护方案仍显不足。现有的易失型缓解机制，如推测压缩和时分复用，由于需要暂停流水线或禁止资源共享，会引入显著的性能开销。本文从新的视角审视此类攻击与防御，提出一种基于调度的缓解方案SpecWands。该方案包含三种基于优先级的调度策略，能够在不同竞争场景下阻止攻击者传输秘密信息。SpecWands不仅能防御线程间和线程内的瞬态执行攻击，还能保留推测执行和资源共享带来的大部分性能收益。在SPEC 2017基准测试集和实际程序上的评估表明，SpecWands的运行时开销显著优于其他两种代表性方案。
title: SpecWands: An Efficient Priority-Based Scheduler Against Speculation Contention Attacks
venue: IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems

abstract: We revisit the concepts of spin relaxation and spin decoherence of two-level (spin-$1∕2$) systems. From two toy models, we clarify two issues related to the spin relaxation and decoherence: (1) For an ensemble of two-level particles each subjected to a different environmental field, there exists an ensemble relaxation time ${T}_{1}^{*}$, which is fundamentally different from ${T}_{1}$. When the off-diagonal coupling of each particle is in a single mode with the same frequency but a random coupling strength, we show that ${T}_{1}^{*}$ is finite while the spin-relaxation time of a single-spin ${T}_{1}$ and the usual ensemble decoherence time ${T}_{2}^{*}$ are infinite. (2) For a two-level particle under only a random diagonal coupling, its relaxation time ${T}_{1}$ shall be infinite, but its decoherence time ${T}_{2}$ is finite.
summary_zh: 本文重新审视了二能级（自旋-1/2）系统的自旋弛豫与退相干概念。通过两个简化模型，我们澄清了两个关键问题。第一，针对每个粒子处于不同环境场中的系综，存在一种系综弛豫时间 T₁*，其物理本质与单粒子自旋弛豫时间 T₁ 截然不同。具体而言，当系综中每个粒子的非对角耦合具有相同频率但耦合强度随机分布的单模形式时，我们证明系综弛豫时间 T₁* 是有限的，而单粒子的自旋弛豫时间 T₁ 和常规的系综退相干时间 T₂* 均为无穷大。第二，对于仅受随机对角耦合作用的二能级粒子，其自旋弛豫时间 T₁ 为无穷大，但其退相干时间 T₂ 却是有限的。这些发现有助于在量子信息处理与自旋电子学等领域中，更精确地区分和解释不同噪声机制下的自旋动力学行为。
title: Spin relaxation and decoherence of two-level systems

abstract: In this letter, a multi-beam reflectarray antenna operating at 16 GHz is proposed. The feed antenna contains 10 PIN diodes and 5 ports. By changing the states of the PIN diodes and exciting the corresponding port, 15 beams can be obtained. To reduce the sidelobe levels (SLLs) of the beams and achieve the broader beam coverage range (BCR), the multi-objective particle swarm optimization (MOPSO) method is introduced to optimize the reflection phase of the reflectarray. Then, the proposed reflectarray is simulated, fabricated and measured. The simulated SLL is below -9.95 dB, and the beam range is from -38.6°to 37.3°. The measured SLL is below -8.74 dB, and the beam range is from 31.5°to 30.6°.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种工作于16 GHz的多波束反射阵列天线。该天线馈源集成了10个PIN二极管和5个端口，通过切换PIN二极管状态并激励对应端口，可实现15个波束的灵活生成。为降低波束副瓣电平并扩展波束覆盖范围，引入多目标粒子群优化算法对反射阵列的反射相位进行优化设计。在此基础上，对所设计的天线进行了全波仿真、实物加工与实验测试。仿真结果表明，天线副瓣电平低于-9.95 dB，波束覆盖范围达到-38.6°至37.3°；实测结果显示，副瓣电平低于-8.74 dB，波束覆盖范围为31.5°至30.6°。该天线在卫星通信、雷达探测及点对多点无线通信等需要多波束覆盖与波束捷变能力的场景中具有应用潜力。
title: A Ku-Band Multibeam Reflectarray With 15 Beams Based on the Phase Center Reconfigurable Feed Antenna
venue: IEEE Antennas and Wireless Propagation Letters

summary_zh: 本研究首次提出一种基于液晶分子与10聚腺嘌呤寡核苷酸探针的无标记、快速检测锑离子（Sb³⁺）的新方法。锑作为高毒性水体污染物，现有分析方法多存在操作复杂、成本高、难以实时监测等局限。该方法利用寡核苷酸与Sb³⁺的特异性结合，削弱其与阳离子表面活性剂的相互作用，从而引发液晶分子从平面取向转变为垂直取向，在正交偏振片下呈现由亮到暗的光学变化，实现信号转导。该液晶光学传感器对Sb³⁺响应迅速，仅需10秒即可完成检测，检测范围为20 nM至5 μM，10分钟检测时间下的检出限低至6.7 nM。传感器对Ag⁺、Cd²⁺、Cu²⁺、Fe³⁺、K⁺、Mg²⁺、Mn²⁺、Na⁺、Pb²⁺和Zn²⁺等常见金属离子表现出良好的选择性，并可在不同pH和离子强度的水溶液中稳定工作。该方法兼具操作简便、响应快速、成本低廉、灵敏度高和选择性好等优势，在自然水体和工业废水中Sb³⁺的现场实时监测方面具有广阔的应用前景。
title: Liquid crystal based sensor for antimony ions detection using poly-adenine oligonucleotides

abstract: Abstract Research shows that deep neural networks are vulnerable to adversarial examples due to the highly linear nature of deep neural networks (DNNs). Therefore, adversarial examples involve security of deep learning. However, there is a lack of research on the impact of adversarial examples on the biomedical segmentation model. Since a large part of medical image problems are segmentation problems, this paper analyzes the impact of adversarial examples on image segmentation models based on deep learning. We propose to fool the biomedical segmentation model and generate target segmentation masks with feature space perturbations and cross-entropy loss function. Different from the traditional gradient-based attack methods, which usually use the gradient of the final loss function, this paper adopts a Multi-scale Attack (MSA) method based on multi-scale gradients. Extensive experiments to attack U-Net on the ISIC skin lesion segmentation challenge dataset and the glaucoma optic disc segmentation dataset have proved that the predicted mask generated by this method has a high intersection over union(IoU) and pixel accuracy with the target mask. Besides, the L 2 and L ∞ distances between the adversarial and clean examples are reduced compared with the state-of-the-art method.
title: Target attack on biomedical image segmentation model based on multi-scale gradients

abstract: Mix of metabolites tunes root microbiota Uncharacterized biosynthetic genes in plant genomes suggest that plants make a plethora of specialized metabolites. Huang et al. reconstructed three biosynthetic networks from the small mustard plant Arabidopsis thaliana . Promiscuous acyltransferases and dehydrogenases contributed to metabolite diversification. The plant may use these specialized metabolites to modulate the microbiota surrounding its roots. Disruption of the pathways and intervention with purified compounds caused changes in the root microbiota. Science , this issue p. eaau6389
summary_zh: 植物通过尚未被充分解析的生物合成基因，能够产生大量结构多样的特异性代谢物。黄等人以小芥菜拟南芥为模型，重建了三条特异性代谢物的生物合成网络，发现其中广泛底物选择性的酰基转移酶和脱氢酶是驱动代谢物结构多样化的关键因素。研究表明，植物利用这些特异性代谢物来调控其根系周围的微生物群落组成。通过基因手段阻断相关合成途径，或外源施加纯化的小分子化合物进行干预，均能显著改变根系微生物群的结构。该工作揭示了植物通过自身代谢物主动塑造根际微生物组的化学机制，为理解植物-微生物互作及农业微生物组调控提供了新视角。
title: A specialized metabolic network selectively modulates Arabidopsis root microbiota

abstract: In this paper, we study the Moderate Deviation Principle for a perturbed stochastic heat equation in the whole space [Formula: see text]. This equation is driven by a Gaussian noise, white in time and correlated in space, and the differential operator is a fractional derivative operator. The weak convergence method plays an important role.
summary_zh: 本文研究在全空间上受扰动的随机热方程的中偏差原理。该方程由时间白噪声、空间相关的Gauss噪声驱动，其微分算子为分数阶导数算子。我们采用弱收敛方法作为核心分析工具，通过建立变分表示与指数逼近策略，克服了全空间非紧性及分数阶算子带来的技术困难。主要结果给出了方程解过程在适度偏离尺度下的渐近概率估计，精确刻画了偏离概率的指数衰减速率，并得到了相应的速率函数。这一结果适用于具有长程相关性和异常扩散现象的随机偏微分方程模型，可为统计物理、随机流体力学及金融数学中相关随机系统的稀有事件分析提供理论依据。
title: Moderate deviations for a fractional stochastic heat equation with spatially correlated noise

summary_zh: 中国拥有全球最大的人工林面积（2008年约6200万公顷），这些森林构成重要碳汇，但其气候效应取决于地表辐射与湍流能量通量的变化如何影响地表温度。例如，反照率降低可能引起增温，从而抵消固碳的气候收益。本研究利用卫星遥感获取中国人工林及邻近草地或农田的地表温度数据，分析造林对地表温度的影响。结果表明，造林平均使白天地表温度降低约1.1±0.5°C，夜间地表温度升高约0.2±0.5°C。白天降温主要由蒸散发增强所致，而夜间增温幅度随纬度升高而增大、随年均降水量增加而减弱。在干旱地区，白天降温被夜间增温抵消，造林呈现净增温效应。因此，未来造林项目需审慎选择造林区位，以实现预期的气候效益。
title: Afforestation in China cools local land surface temperature
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

abstract: We studied the influence of digital metasurfaces with different phase quantization levels on the purity of OAM modes, and proposed the concept of phase sampling frequency. It is verified by simulation, and the results are in good agreement with the theory.
summary_zh: 本文研究了具有不同相位量化阶数的数字超表面对轨道角动量模式纯度的影响，并提出了相位采样频率的概念。通过理论分析与仿真验证，系统考察了相位离散化程度与轨道角动量模式纯度之间的关系。结果表明，相位采样频率越高，即相位量化阶数越多，所产生的轨道角动量模式纯度越高，杂散模式分量越少；反之，低相位采样频率会导致模式间串扰加剧，纯度显著下降。仿真结果与理论预测高度吻合，证实了相位采样频率作为评价数字超表面模式生成质量的关键参数的有效性。该研究为数字超表面在轨道角动量通信、模式复用及高容量光通信等领域的优化设计提供了理论依据。
title: Restriction on the Purity of OAM Modes Generated by Digital and Coding Metasurfaces
venue: 2021 IEEE 4th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)

abstract: Reed-Solomon (RS) codes are widely used to correct errors in storage systems. Finding the error locator polynomial is one of the key steps in the error correction procedure of RS codes. Modular Approach (MA) is an effective algorithm for solving the Welch-Berlekamp (WB) key-equation problem to find the error locator polynomial that needs $2t$ steps, where $t$ is the error correction capability. In this paper, we first present a new MA algorithm that only requires $2e$ steps and then propose two fast decoding algorithms for RS codes based on our MA algorithm, where $e$ is the number of errors and $e\leq t$. We propose Improved-Frequency Domain Modular Approach (I-FDMA) algorithm that needs $2e$ steps to solve the error locator polynomial and present our first decoding algorithm based on the I-FDMA algorithm. We show that, compared with the existing methods based on MA algorithms, our I-FDMA algorithm can effectively reduce the decoding complexity of RS codes when $e
title: Error Correction Decoding Algorithms of RS Codes Based on An Earlier Termination Algorithm to Find The Error Locator Polynomial

abstract: This paper investigates the kinematics of spin-rolling motion of rigid objects. This paper does not consider slipping but applies a Darboux frame to develop kinematics of spin-rolling motion, which occurs in a nonholonomic system. A new formulation of spin-rolling motion of the moving object is derived in terms of contravariant vectors, rolling velocity, and geometric invariants, including normal curvature, geodesic curvature, and geodesic torsion of the respective contact curve. The equation is represented with geometric invariants. It can be readily generalized to suit both arbitrary parametric surface and contact trajectory and can be differentiated to any order. Effect of the relative curvatures and torsion on spin-rolling kinematics is explicitly presented. The translation velocity of an arbitrary point on the moving object is also derived based on the Darboux frame.
summary_zh: 本文研究刚体自旋滚动运动的运动学特性，不考虑滑移情况，采用达布标架建立非完整系统中的自旋滚动运动学模型。基于逆变矢量、滚动速度以及接触曲线的几何不变量（包括法曲率、测地曲率和测地挠率），推导出运动物体自旋滚动的新表述形式。该方程以几何不变量表示，可方便地推广至任意参数曲面和接触轨迹，并支持任意阶微分运算。研究明确揭示了相对曲率与挠率对自旋滚动运动学的影响规律，同时基于达布标架推导了运动物体上任意点的平移速度。该理论框架为机器人操作、多体动力学仿真及接触力学等领域中涉及复杂滚动接触的运动分析提供了通用建模方法。
title: A Darboux-Frame-Based Formulation of Spin-Rolling Motion of Rigid Objects With Point Contact

summary_zh: 深入了解金星内部结构对于探索其演化历史至关重要。针对现有研究缺乏反演方法的现状，本研究利用质量、平均半径、平均转动惯量矩以及二阶潮汐勒夫数k2等观测或假设的测地学数据，通过反演方法对金星内部结构进行了定量研究。研究构建了两种假设金星内部呈球对称且处于流体静力平衡状态的模型：一种是具有全液态核的各向同性三层模型，另一种是具有液态外核和固态内核的各向同性四层模型。通过对内部结构参数进行敏感性分析，研究发现并非所有参数都能被测地学数据有效约束。随后，利用马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗（MCMC）算法确定了内部结构参数的后验概率分布及最优值。结果表明，基于现有测地学数据，三层模型比四层模型更具可信度。在三层模型假设下，金星拥有一个半径约为3294 km的富铁液态核，这一结果表明其内核规模大于此前的研究结论；同时，金星地幔与液态核的平均密度分别为4101 kg/m³和11885 kg/m³。该研究为金星内部构造研究提供了新的方法论支持。
title: Inversion of Venus internal structure based on geodetic data

abstract: Cross-layer optimization is a key step in wireless network design that coordinates the resources allocated to different layers in order to achieve globally optimal network performance. Existing work on cross-layer optimization for wireless networks often adopts simplistic physical-layer models for wireless channels, such as treating interference as noise or interference avoidance. This crude modeling of physical layer often leads to inefficient utilization of resources. In this paper, we adopt a deterministic channel model proposed in <citerefgrp xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><citeref refid="ref1"/></citerefgrp> , <citerefgrp xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"> <citeref refid="ref2"/></citerefgrp> , a simple abstraction of the physical layer that effectively captures the effect of channel strength, broadcast and superposition in wireless channels. This model allows us to go beyond “treating interference as noise” and as a consequence are able to achieve higher throughput and utility. Within the network utility maximization (NUM) framework, we study the cross-layer optimization for wireless networks based on this deterministic channel model. First, we extend the well-studied conflict graph model to capture the flow interactions over the deterministic channels and characterize the feasible rate region. Then we study distributed algorithms for general wireless multi-hop networks with both link-centric formulation and node-centric formulation. The convergence of algorithms is proved by applying Lyapunov stability theorem and stochastic approximation method. Further, we show the convergence to the bounded neighborhood of optimal solutions with probability one under constant step sizes and constant update intervals. Our numerical evaluations validate the analytical results and show the advantage of deterministic channel model over simple physical layer models such as treating interference as noise.
title: Cross-Layer Optimization for Wireless Networks With Deterministic Channel Models

abstract: Abstract Drivers aged 16–24 are overrepresented in fatal crashes compared to middle-aged, more experienced drivers. This age-related difference in crash rates partly arises from younger drivers’ poorer performance on three cognitive skills known to be related to crash involvement: hazard anticipation, hazard mitigation and attention maintenance. Training programs have been shown effective at improving these skills within a short period of time. However, young drivers are not homogenous and they have different driving styles. The driving styles can interact with driving skills by influencing both their acquisition and, once acquired, their execution. A study was undertaken on a driving simulator to determine whether the effectiveness of an already existing training program aimed at improving the three above mentioned skills is moderated by driving style. In particular, drivers were classified as either careful or careless drivers based both on their scores on measures designed to evaluate two general traits relevant to discriminating between careful and careless drivers (sensation seeking and aggressiveness) as well as on their scores designed to evaluate driving specific behaviors that discriminate between careful and careless drivers (aggressive driving behaviors and driving violations and errors). It was found that training improved the hazard anticipation and attention maintenance performance of only the careful drivers, not the careless drivers.
title: Training interventions are only effective on careful drivers, not careless drivers
venue: Transportation Research Part F: Traffic Psychology and Behaviour

summary_zh: 本文首次提出一种高效制备螺旋长周期光纤光栅的方法，通过在氢氧焰加热标准单模光纤的同时施加扭转，将形成的螺旋光纤切割成多个串联段，从而以少量操作批量获得螺旋长周期光纤光栅。每段螺旋光纤即为所需的长周期光栅，其谐振波长（即光栅周期）可通过调节螺旋光纤的扭转速率灵活改变。在标准单模光纤中刻写的螺旋长周期光纤光栅可用于产生轨道角动量模式，即OAM+1模式，在超过单模光纤截止波长的宽波长范围内，模式纯度达91%，转换效率达87%。该方法对基于轨道角动量模分复用技术的全光纤光通信系统具有显著优势。
title: Orbital Angular Momentum Mode Converter Based on Helical Long Period Fiber Grating Inscribed by Hydrogen–Oxygen Flame

summary_zh: 针对金黄色葡萄球菌引起的角膜炎，传统的抗生素负载水凝胶在应对耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）时面临挑战。本研究受哺乳动物铁死亡机制启发，通过在水凝胶中负载硫酸亚铁（FeSO4），开发了一种新型抗菌治疗材料。研究发现，FeSO4能够诱导金黄色葡萄球菌发生类铁死亡过程，其核心特征表现为活性氧（ROS）的大量产生和脂质过氧化，并能有效杀灭持久性细菌、MRSA及金黄色葡萄球菌生物膜。转录组分析证实，Fe2+暴露后铁死亡相关基因显著上调，而细胞壁与细胞膜生物合成相关基因下调，从而导致细胞裂解。研究进一步利用透明质酸和抗坏血酸制备了FeSO4负载水凝胶，该水凝胶具有良好的可注射性、自修复能力、Fe2+分布均匀性、高保水性以及优异的生物相容性。小鼠角膜炎模型实验表明，FeSO4水凝胶能显著促进角膜炎症的快速恢复，有效防止MRSA向肺部扩散，并减轻全身性炎症反应。综上所述，FeSO4水凝胶为治疗MRSA感染提供了一种极具前景的非抗生素依赖型替代方案。
title: Ferrous sulfate-loaded hydrogel cures Staphylococcus aureus infection via facilitating a ferroptosis-like bacterial cell death in a mouse keratitis model

abstract: Controlling excitation power is the most convenient approach to dynamically tuning upconversion that is essential for a variety of studies. However, this approach suffers from a significant constraint due to insensitive response of most upconversion systems to excitation power. Here we present a study of amplifying excitation power-sensitivity of upconversion in Ho3+ ions through the use of a NaYbF4 host. Mechanistic investigation reveals that the sensitive response of Ho3+ upconversion to excitation power stems from maximal use of the incident energy enabled by concentrated Yb3+ sensitizers. This allows us to sensitively tune the red-to-green emission intensity ratio from 0.37 to 5.19 by increasing the excitation power from 1.25 to 46.25 W cm–2, which represents a 5.6-fold amplification of the tunability (from 0.19 to 0.49) offered by Yb/Ho (19/1 mol %) codoped NaYF4.
