Our results highlight that the excitation-power sensitive upconversion emission can be exploited to experimentally visualize electromagnetic hotspots.
summary_zh: 通过采用NaYbF4基质，可显著增强Ho³⁺离子上转换发光的激发功率敏感性。机理研究表明，高浓度Yb³⁺敏化剂能够最大化利用入射能量，从而使Ho³⁺上转换发光对激发功率产生灵敏响应。当激发功率从1.25 W cm⁻²提升至46.25 W cm⁻²时，红绿发射强度比可从0.37动态调控至5.19，相较于Yb/Ho（19/1 mol%）共掺杂NaYF4体系仅从0.19到0.49的调控范围，实现了5.6倍的调谐能力放大。该激发功率敏感的上转换发射特性可用于实验可视化电磁热点，在光学传感与检测领域具有应用潜力。
title: Excitation-Power Sensitivity of Photon Upconversion in a NaYbF4:Ho Nanostructure for Direct Visualization of Electromagnetic Hotspots
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters

abstract: In this paper, we study the contact angle hysteresis on a slowly moving rough boundary using a phase-field model with a relaxed boundary condition. In particular, we want to model the recent experimental observation in [D. Guan et al., Phys. Rev. Lett., 116 (2016), 066102]. The speed of the moving boundary is slow enough so that the fluid flow effect is negligible. From asymptotic analysis, we derive an ordinary differential system for the dynamics of the apparent contact angle and the contact point. The system enables us to understand the contact angle hysteresis in the experiment, including the asymmetric dependence of the advancing and receding contact angles on the boundary velocity.
summary_zh: 本文采用带有松弛边界条件的相场模型，研究粗糙边界缓慢移动时的接触角滞后现象，旨在复现近期实验观测结果。由于边界移动速度足够缓慢，流体流动效应可忽略不计。通过渐近分析，我们推导出一个描述表观接触角与接触点动力学的常微分方程组。该方程组能够解释实验中的接触角滞后行为，包括前进角和后退角对边界速度的非对称依赖关系。
title: Analysis for Contact Angle Hysteresis on Rough Surfaces by a Phase-Field Model with a Relaxed Boundary Condition

summary_zh: 本文针对中国在“十三五”期间大规模推广电动汽车所面临的障碍展开研究。研究以中国主要城市中电动汽车市场占有率最高的深圳为例，通过问卷调查法收集了406份有效样本，旨在深入分析阻碍电动汽车普及的核心因素。研究基于现有文献构建了五个假设，从消费者偏好与态度、公共政策与财政激励、技术创新认知以及电动汽车技术担忧四个维度进行考察。通过运用交叉频率表、主成分分析及因子分析等统计学方法进行实证检验，研究结果显示，部分假设得到了支持，但也发现部分结论与既有学术研究存在差异。研究表明，电动汽车普及面临的障碍并非静态不变，未来应引入更多变量以更精准地评估中国电动汽车的市场渗透情况。
title: Analysis of Barriers to Wide Spread Adoption of Electric Vehicles in Shenzhen China

abstract: ABSTRACT We have carried out a field trial of a time-lapse continuous electromagnetic profile (CEMP) method for monitoring gas reservoir development. Several data acquisition methods were tested to establish a field-worthy practical procedure that maintained the consistency of time-lapse CEMP acquisition and ensured the reliability of collected data. An effective denoising and static correction algorithm has also been developed to sufficiently suppress noise and disturbance for data processing purposes. The resistivity variation with time was recovered using a time-lapse inversion method. Three continuous acquisition tests on a gas reservoir in western China produced results that clearly indicated the relationship between resistivity change and the change in gas and water ratio as well as pressure decreases. The field trial was a successful experiment in monitoring gas reservoir development with high-precision time-lapse CEMP surveys. The established data acquisition procedure, data processing algorithm, and the inversion-based interpretation have general applicability, and these may open new avenues for time-lapse monitoring in oil and gas production.
title: Field test of monitoring gas reservoir development using time-lapse continuous electromagnetic profile method

summary_zh: 生物膜的断裂过程依赖于多种能够结合并操纵脂质双层的蛋白质复合物。其中，ESCRT-III（内体分选复合物必需转运 III）纤维在多囊泡内体生物发生、胞质分裂以及逆转录病毒出芽等看似不同的生物学过程中，均发挥着介导膜断裂的关键作用。然而，ESCRT-III亚基如何组装成聚合物的分子机制此前尚不明确。本研究利用冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-EM）发现，全长ESCRT-III亚基Vps32/CHMP4B能够自发形成单链螺旋纤维。结合二维冷冻电镜与分子动力学模拟的研究结果表明，纤维内的单个Vps32/CHMP4B单体具有高度柔性，能够适应多种弯曲角度；与之相对，单体间的界面则表现出高度稳定性，不易发生构象变化。此外，研究还发现Vps32/CHMP4B的羧基末端在限制纤维侧向结合方面起着关键作用。这些发现揭示了ESCRT-III纤维组装的新机制，阐明了该聚合物如何在多种细胞语境下实现独特的膜重塑功能。
title: Structural analysis and modeling reveals new mechanisms governing ESCRT-III spiral filament assembly

summary_zh: 本文研究了一种在硅衬底上生长纯纤锌矿相InGaAs微结构的亚稳态生长机制。传统III-V族半导体外延中，闪锌矿相在热力学上更稳定，而纯纤锌矿相仅能在直径小于临界值的纳米线中稳定存在，但细纳米线易受表面复合影响，限制器件性能。本工作提出一种核壳式生长模式：InGaAs以尖锐纳米针形式成核，并同时沿轴向和径向扩展。其基底直径可从数十纳米扩展至微米级以上，而尖端在整个生长过程中始终保持尖锐形态。这种尖锐形貌维持了局部高表面积体积比，有利于六方晶格沿轴向生长，从而在硅上形成微米尺度的纯纤锌矿相InGaAs结构。为验证该纤锌矿微结构确属亚稳态，研究首次在透射电子显微镜内原位演示了从纤锌矿相到能量更优的闪锌矿相的转变过程。这一非常规核壳生长机制有望拓展至其他III-V族材料体系，为有效利用亚稳态纤锌矿晶体的优异特性提供新途径。
title: Metastable Growth of Pure Wurtzite InGaAs Microstructures

abstract: In the analysis of an acoustic radiation mode of a baffled plate, Rayleigh integral with free space Green's function is involved. The boundary element method (BEM) is one of the approaches to compute its modes and radiation efficiencies. In this paper a fast multipole BEM in conjunction with an iterative solver based on the implicit restart Arnold method is proposed to efficiently and accurately evaluate acoustic radiation modes and efficiencies. Even though a 3D free space Green's function is used here, a quad tree is used for the hierarchical tree structure of the boundary mesh instead of an oct tree, which can speed up the fast multipole BEM. Similar to the analytical integration of moment evaluations, the analytical integration is also employed to compute the local expansion coefficients which further improves the efficiency of the fast multipole BEM for the analysis of an acoustic radiation mode of baffled plates. Comparison between numerical and theoretical radiation efficiencies of a baffled circular plate vibrating as a piston shows that the fast multipole BEM proposed here can give results with very good accuracy. The computation of the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a baffled rectangular plate further reveals the efficiency in CPU time, smaller memory size, and accuracy of the fast multipole BEM in the analysis of an acoustic radiation mode.
title: Analyzing Acoustic Radiation Modes of Baffled Plates With a Fast Multipole Boundary Element Method

abstract: We present a novel sparsity-based space-time adaptive processing (STAP) technique based on the alternating direction method to overcome the severe performance degradation caused by array gain/phase (GP) errors. The proposed algorithm reformulates the STAP problem as a joint optimization problem of the spatio-Doppler profile and GP errors in both single and multiple snapshots, and introduces a target detector using the reconstructed spatio-Doppler profiles. Simulations are conducted to illustrate the benefits of the proposed algorithm.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于稀疏表示和交替方向法的空时自适应处理新方法，旨在解决阵列增益相位误差导致的性能严重下降问题。该方法将空时自适应处理重新表述为空间多普勒剖面与阵列增益相位误差的联合优化问题，并分别针对单快拍和多快拍场景建立了相应的优化模型。通过交替方向迭代策略，算法能够在重构空间多普勒剖面的同时有效估计并补偿阵列误差，从而提升目标检测的鲁棒性。在此基础上，进一步引入基于重构空间多普勒剖面的目标检测器，实现对杂波背景下运动目标的可靠检测。仿真实验验证了所提算法在存在阵列增益相位误差条件下的性能优势，表明该方法在机载雷达、地面动目标指示等领域的空时自适应处理中具有良好的应用前景。
title: Sparsity-Based STAP Using Alternating Direction Method With Gain/Phase Errors
venue: IEEE Transactions on Aerospace and Electronic Systems

summary_zh: 表面粗糙度及其内部的纳米级空隙对薄膜复合聚酰胺反渗透（RO）膜的分离性能具有显著影响。受界面聚合过程中二氧化碳纳米气泡脱气导致空隙形成的启发，本研究首次系统探讨了水相间苯二胺（MPD）溶液中碳酸盐化学性质（特别是二氧化碳溶解度）的作用机制。研究发现，当MPD溶液的pH值处于碳酸盐体系两个酸度常数之间（6.3 ≤ pH ≤ 10.3）时，溶液中以碳酸氢根（HCO3–）为主，此时膜表面呈现出“脊谷状”粗糙结构。在此pH范围内，随着pH值的升高，聚酰胺层的有效过滤面积与交联度同步提升，从而实现了水渗透率与溶质截留率的双重增强。然而，当pH值进一步升高至12.5时，由于膜层的水解作用，不同溶质的截留表现出现分化：中性溶质（如硼和三价砷）的截留率下降，而带电溶质（如氯化钠和五价砷）的截留率仍能保持稳定。本研究通过揭示碳酸盐化学对膜结构的影响机制，强调了基于第一性原理针对最终应用场景设计反渗透膜的重要性。
title: Tailoring Polyamide Rejection Layer with Aqueous Carbonate Chemistry for Enhanced Membrane Separation: Mechanistic Insights, Chemistry-Structure-Property Relationship, and Environmental Implications

summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于混合拓扑的电动自行车无线充电策略，利用单个高频逆变器即可为大量电动自行车充电，且同一充电桩可兼容不同规格的电池。通过控制两个交流开关的通断，无需复杂控制方案或无线通信链路，即可实现可配置的恒流与恒压输出。同时，该方法能实现高频逆变器的零相位角开关，从而提升系统效率。实验在多种充电条件下验证了所提方案，结果表明，整个充电过程中充电电流与充电电压的波动幅度均低于2.5%，最高效率达到91.90%。该方案降低了建设成本与控制复杂度，有望成为中国等地区大规模电动自行车充电的理想解决方案之一。
title: Hybrid Topology With Configurable Charge Current and Charge Voltage Output-Based WPT Charger for Massive Electric Bicycles
venue: IEEE Journal of Emerging and Selected Topics in Power Electronics

summary_zh: 针对安全关键型应用中神经网络对随机参数初始化鲁棒性的需求，本文提出一种基于高斯过程期望方差的神经主动学习准则（EV-GP）。该准则在理论上保证所选标注数据能同时提升网络的预测性能与初始化鲁棒性。EV-GP的核心优势在于其免训练特性，即在数据选择阶段无需对神经网络进行任何训练，从而显著降低计算开销。实验表明，EV-GP准则与初始化鲁棒性及泛化性能均高度相关，在初始数据有限或大批量采样的场景下，其在预测精度和鲁棒性两个目标上均一致优于现有基线方法。
title: Training-Free Neural Active Learning with Initialization-Robustness Guarantees

summary_zh: 本文报道了在室温有机亚铁磁体钒四氰乙烯（V(TCNE)ₓ，x≈2）薄膜及器件中实现相干磁振子产生、传输与探测的研究成果。研究采用三种互补技术：宽带铁磁共振用于激发自旋波，布里渊光散射用于探测热磁振子与非共振自旋波，以及向相邻铂层的自旋泵浦实现电学检测。V(TCNE)ₓ薄膜可在多种衬底上直接生长，其吉尔伯特阻尼极低，与钇铁石榴石相当。这些发现证实了有机基磁体在磁振子自旋电子学中的新用途，其合成灵活性有望显著丰富该领域的研究与应用。
title: Organic-based magnon spintronics

summary_zh: 本文提出一种数字极性Doherty开关电容功率放大器，采用基于存储电容阵列的片上自校准技术，可自动补偿高数据率信号产生的幅度-相位失真。该自校准方法通过检测输出端的AM-PM失真，在相位调制信号中生成相应的相位补偿量。所提出的存储电容阵列用于存储不同幅度码对应的移相器控制电压，从而缩短高数据率下的建立时间，实现校准环路的快速锁定。基于该自校准技术，采用40纳米CMOS工艺设计并流片了一款极性Doherty开关电容功率放大器。测试结果表明，该芯片在1.8 GHz频段实现了28.9 dBm的峰值输出功率和43.9%的峰值漏极效率。在无数字预失真条件下，可支持100 MHz带宽的64-QAM信号和10 MHz带宽的1024-QAM信号，平均输出功率分别为22.6 dBm和21.3 dBm，平均漏极效率分别达到33.9%和32.1%。该技术适用于宽带、高阶调制的无线发射机系统。
title: A Self-Calibration SCPA With Storage Capacitor Array Supporting 64-/256-/1024-QAM

abstract: We experimentally investigate the quantum criticality and Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid (TLL) behavior within one-dimensional (1D) ultracold atomic gases. Based on the measured density profiles at different temperatures, the universal scaling laws of thermodynamic quantities are observed. The quantum critical regime and the relevant crossover temperatures are determined through the double-peak structure of the specific heat. In the TLL regime, we obtain the Luttinger parameter by probing sound propagation. Furthermore, a characteristic power-law behavior emerges in the measured momentum distributions of the 1D ultracold gas, confirming the existence of the TLL.
summary_zh: 本研究通过实验手段深入探究了一维超冷原子气中的量子临界性与Tomonaga-Luttinger液体（TLL）行为。研究团队通过测量不同温度下的密度分布，成功观测到了热力学物理量的普适标度律。利用比热随温度变化的双峰结构，研究者精确确定了量子临界区域及其相关的交叉温度。在TLL机制的研究中，通过探测声速传播特性，成功获取了Luttinger参数。此外，实验观测到的动量分布呈现出特征性的幂律行为，从实验层面证实了TLL态的存在。该研究为理解一维量子多体系统的动力学特性与相变行为提供了重要的实验依据。
title: Quantum criticality and the Tomonaga-Luttinger liquid in one-dimensional Bose gases

summary_zh: 本文针对锂金属电池的研究，设计并开发了一种三维网络凝胶聚合物电解质（3D-GPE）。该电解质采用无需引发剂的一步法开环聚合技术制备，实现了机械强度与离子电导率的协同提升。实验结果表明，该3D-GPE能够有效抑制锂枝晶的生长，从而显著改善锂金属电池的循环寿命、倍率性能及安全性。该研究为开发高安全性、高能量密度的下一代锂金属电池提供了一种高效的电解质解决方案。
title: Dendrite‐Free, High‐Rate, Long‐Life Lithium Metal Batteries with a 3D Cross‐Linked Network Polymer Electrolyte

abstract: The generalization capability of machine learning systems degenerates notably when the test distribution drifts from the training distribution. Recently, Domain Generalization (DG) has been gaining momentum in enabling machine learning models to generalize to unseen domains. However, most DG methods assume that training and test data share an identical label space, ignoring the potential unseen categories in many real-world applications. In this paper, we delve into a more general but difficult problem termed Open Test-Time DG (OTDG), where both domain shift and open class may occur on the unseen test data. We propose Compaction and Disambiguation (CODA), a novel two-stage framework for learning compact representations and adapting to open classes in the wild. To meaningfully regularize the model’s decision boundary, CODA introduces virtual unknown classes and optimizes a new training objective to insert unknowns into the latent space by compacting the embedding space of source known classes. To adapt target samples to the source model, we then disambiguate the decision boundaries between known and unknown classes with a test-time training objective, mitigating the adaptivity gap and catastrophic forgetting challenges. Experiments reveal that CODA can significantly outperform the previous best method on standard DG datasets and harmonize the classification accuracy between known and unknown classes.
title: CODA: Generalizing to Open and Unseen Domains with Compaction and Disambiguation
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 36

summary_zh: 车联网（IoV）显著提升了智能交通系统（ITS）的安全性和服务质量，但现有的专用短程通信（DSRC）协议消息广播间隔仅为100至300毫秒，这给短时间内的消息验证带来了巨大挑战。由于传统认证方案往往伴随着高昂的计算与通信开销，难以适应此类高实时性环境。本文提出了一种基于轻量级密码学原语的高效认证方案，利用抗碰撞单向哈希函数和异或（XOR）运算来降低资源消耗。该协议通过物理不可克隆函数（PUF）生成的身份、随机数以及密码实现了双因子认证。通过RoR模型的形式化安全验证，证明了该方案的安全性。语义安全分析表明，该方案具备匿名性、不可追踪性和密钥机密性，并能有效抵御多种车联网攻击向量。性能评估结果显示，与现有方案相比，该方案在计算和能量消耗方面降低了42.31%，同时将支持的安全特性提升了26.67%。
title: Two-Factor Privacy-Preserving Protocol for Efficient Authentication in Internet of Vehicles Networks

abstract: Given a text query, partially relevant video retrieval (PRVR) seeks to find untrimmed videos containing pertinent moments in a database. For PRVR, clip modeling is essential to capture the partial relationship between texts and videos. Current PRVR methods adopt scanning-based clip construction to achieve explicit clip modeling, which is information-redundant and requires a large storage overhead. To solve the efficiency problem of PRVR methods, this paper proposes GMMFormer, a Gaussian-Mixture-Model based Transformer which models clip representations implicitly. During frame interactions, we incorporate Gaussian-Mixture-Model constraints to focus each frame on its adjacent frames instead of the whole video. Then generated representations will contain multi-scale clip information, achieving implicit clip modeling. In addition, PRVR methods ignore semantic differences between text queries relevant to the same video, leading to a sparse embedding space. We propose a query diverse loss to distinguish these text queries, making the embedding space more intensive and contain more semantic information. Extensive experiments on three large-scale video datasets (i.e., TVR, ActivityNet Captions, and Charades-STA) demonstrate the superiority and efficiency of GMMFormer.
title: GMMFormer: Gaussian-Mixture-Model Based Transformer for Efficient Partially Relevant Video Retrieval
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

abstract: Rolling contact joints are attracting increasing interest in applications to robotic fingers and manipulators, due to the potential of the absence of abrasion wear, the simplification of the controller, and the enlargement of reachable configurations. This article first proposes a novel two-degree-of-freedom (DOF) spherical rolling contact (SRC) joint, with the joint model elements being formulated, including rotation matrix , position vector , and free modes , as with those of classic joints. As an application, a new kind of serial manipulator formed by the SRC joints is presented, and its forward and inverse kinematics are modeled. The motions of the two-DOF SRC joint and manipulator are implemented using the FreeBOT, and the control method is proposed for the FreeBOT, such that the SRC joint and manipulator realize the motion control. The kinematics and control of the two-DOF SRC joint and manipulator are validated using physics simulations and on a real manipulator formed by FreeBOTs.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种新型二自由度球面滚滑接触关节，并构建其运动学模型，包括旋转矩阵、位置向量和自由模式等关节要素。基于该关节，设计了一类由多个球面滚滑接触关节串联构成的机械臂，并建立了正逆运动学模型。为实现运动控制，采用 FreeBOT 模块作为关节驱动单元，提出相应的控制方法，使关节与机械臂能够完成预定运动。通过物理仿真和基于 FreeBOT 搭建的实物机械臂实验，验证了所提关节及机械臂的运动学模型与控制策略的有效性。该关节具有无磨粒磨损、简化控制器设计及扩展可达构型空间等优势，在机器人手指与操作臂领域具有应用前景。
title: Kinematics Modeling and Control of Spherical Rolling Contact Joint and Manipulator

abstract: The loss of complexity in ageing hypothesis (LOCH) has found support from EEG studies, most of which adopted signal-domain complexity measures. The present study adopted the largest Lyapunov exponent (LLE) to measure complexity from a nonlinear dynamical systems perspective. A total of 144 participants were included and divided into young, young-old and old-old groups. Both sensor-space and source-space results showed significantly lower LLE for older than younger adults. The age-related differences were region-dependent, being most prominent in the frontal region, followed by bilateral temporal regions. The occipital region showed non-significant differences. Significant reduction of LLE in the posterior cingulate was also observed by virtue of the source-space analysis. We also evaluated the relationships between LLE and other complexity measures. The most intriguing result was the negative correlation between LLE and Lempel-Ziv complexity (LZC). The age-related decrease in LLE indicated a higher regularity in dynamics, while the higher LZC indicated a higher randomness in the signal domain. The new findings support the LOCH by demonstrating the simultaneous increase in regularity and randomness.
title: Regularity and randomness in ageing: Differences in resting-state EEG complexity measured by largest Lyapunov exponent

summary_zh: 随着智能穿戴设备、增强现实（AR）、虚拟现实（VR）及裸眼3D显示等新兴技术的兴起，市场对超高分辨率、柔性及透明显示技术的需求日益迫切，传统显示技术已难以满足相关应用场景。微发光二极管（micro-LED）凭借高对比度、响应速度快、色域宽、低功耗及长寿命等显著优势，被视为有望取代传统LCD和OLED的下一代显示技术核心。然而，micro-LED从实验室走向大规模商业化应用仍面临两大核心挑战：一是如何提升微米级芯片转移的良率并降低成本，二是实现全彩显示的技术路径问题。本文综述了当前实现micro-LED全彩显示的三种主流技术方案，包括RGB三色芯片转移技术、色彩转换技术以及单芯片多色生长技术，旨在总结现有技术进展并为后续研究方向提供指导。
title: Full-Color Realization of Micro-LED Displays

abstract: A Variable Gain and Attenuation control Amplifier (VGA) operating with low power, wide bandwidth and large Gain range for interfacing 60GHz RF front-end to Digital Baseband processor has been designed in 180nm SiGe BiCMOS technology from Jazz Semiconductor. The VGA is implemented using two stage amplifier followed by a Buffer stage with additional Diode linearizer for improving the input referred 1dB compression point. The performance parameters of the proposed VGA is been simulated and achieves a Gain range of -10dB to +10dB with 3-dB Bandwidth of greater than 4GHz. This VGA topology has good input and output matching. The complete circuit consumes about 9mW power from a DC 1.8V supply and the Core circuit (excluding I/O Pads) occupies a chip area of 170μm x 60μm.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种可变增益衰减控制放大器，采用 Jazz Semiconductor 180nm SiGe BiCMOS 工艺设计，用于 60GHz 射频前端与数字基带处理器之间的接口。该放大器由两级放大级联缓冲级构成，并引入二极管线性化器以改善输入参考 1dB 压缩点。仿真结果表明，所设计的可变增益放大器可实现 -10dB 至 +10dB 的增益范围，3dB 带宽超过 4GHz，同时具备良好的输入输出匹配特性。整体电路在 1.8V 直流供电下功耗约为 9mW，核心电路（不含 I/O 焊盘）芯片面积为 170μm×60μm。该设计以低功耗、宽带宽和大增益范围满足毫米波通信系统中高频前端与基带处理之间的信号调理需求。
title: A DC to 4 GHz fully differential wideband digitally controlled Variable Gain Amplifier

abstract: We have developed a hybrid intravascular imaging system for the early detection of vulnerable plaque by combining three complementary imaging techniques: ultrasound imaging (USI), photoacoustic imaging (PAI), and photoacoustic elasticity imaging (PEI). As a loading-free elasticity detection method, PEI can quantitatively obtain the tissue elasticity through the photoacoustic phase. By sharing the same ultrasound detection system, USI and PAI could be organically combined. Meanwhile, the optical absorption and elasticity images of plaque are simultaneously reconstructed by the same photoacoustic pulses. To prove the imaging capabilities and complementarity of the system, mimicking phantom experiments were conducted. Furthermore, ex-vivo experiments were performed on the rabbit abdominal aorta to achieve an early assessment of atherosclerosis by detecting the presence and the development extent of lipid plaques. The results illustrate that the system can simultaneously detect the structural composition and the mechanical properties of plaque, thereby showing great potential for accurately diagnosing the atherosclerosis.
title: Intravascular tri-modality system: Combined ultrasound, photoacoustic, and elasticity imaging

summary_zh: 基数估计是数据库系统中的一项基础功能。现有基数估计器大多聚焦于处理数值型或类别型数据的谓词，普遍忽略了集合值数据这一重要数据类型，而这类数据在信息检索和推荐系统等当代应用中频繁出现。针对集合值数据的少数现有估计器要么偏向高频元素，要么依赖部分独立性假设，限制了其实际适用性。我们提出ACE，一种基于注意力机制的基数估计器，用于估计集合值数据上的查询基数。首先设计了一个基于蒸馏的数据编码器，将数据集压缩为紧凑矩阵；然后设计了一个基于注意力的查询分析器，以捕获查询元素之间的相关性。为处理可变大小的查询，引入了一个池化模块，随后通过回归模型（多层感知机）生成最终的基数估计值。我们在三个具有不同查询元素分布的数据集上评估了ACE，结果表明其在准确性和效率方面均优于现有最先进的方法。
title: ACE: A Cardinality Estimator for Set-Valued Queries

abstract: The human striatum can be subdivided into the caudate, putamen, and nucleus accumbens (NAc). Each of these structures have some overlapping and some distinct functions related to motor control, cognitive processing, motivation, and reward. Previously, we used a "time-of-death" approach to identify diurnal rhythms in RNA transcripts in human cortical regions. Here, we identify molecular rhythms across the three striatal subregions collected from postmortem human brain tissue in subjects without psychiatric or neurological disorders. Core circadian clock genes are rhythmic across all three regions and show strong phase concordance across regions. However, the putamen contains a much larger number of significantly rhythmic transcripts than the other two regions. Moreover, there are many differences in pathways that are rhythmic across regions. Strikingly, the top rhythmic transcripts in NAc (but not the other regions) are predominantly small nucleolar RNAs and long noncoding RNAs, suggesting that a completely different mechanism might be used for the regulation of diurnal rhythms in translation and/or RNA processing in the NAc versus the other regions. Further, although the NAc and putamen are generally in phase with regard to timing of expression rhythms, the NAc and caudate, and caudate and putamen, have several clusters of discordant rhythmic transcripts, suggesting a temporal wave of specific cellular processes across the striatum. Taken together, these studies reveal distinct transcriptome rhythms across the human striatum and are an important step in helping to understand the normal function of diurnal rhythms in these regions and how disruption could lead to pathology.
title: Diurnal rhythms across the human dorsal and ventral striatum
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

summary_zh: 本研究构建了肺上皮类器官与外周血单个核细胞共培养模型，分别暴露于强毒力结核分枝杆菌H37Rv株与减毒卡介苗BCG株，以探究结核病在肺泡上皮微环境中的致病机制。转录组分析显示，H37Rv感染显著改变类器官的细胞死亡模式，并调控外周血单个核细胞的信号转导通路。免疫印迹结果表明，H37Rv株同时诱导类器官发生铁死亡、自噬和凋亡，但抑制程序性坏死；而BCG株主要增强自噬。外周血单个核细胞呈现菌株特异性应答，BCG强烈激活Hippo与Notch信号通路，H37Rv则主要启动肿瘤坏死因子信号通路。此外，结核分枝杆菌显著重塑了类器官与外周血单个核细胞之间的旁分泌和自分泌信号动态。NicheNet网络分析鉴定出H37Rv诱导的TNFSF15和脑源性神经营养因子BDNF为关键介质。过表达实验提示，类器官来源的TNFSF15通过旁分泌信号促进外周血单个核细胞中BDNF的表达，而外周血单个核细胞产生的BDNF反过来抑制类器官的铁死亡，从而限制结核分枝杆菌的生长。该研究为理解结核分枝杆菌在肺泡上皮细胞内的致病机制提供了概念框架，并为人类结核病传播的预防与控制提供了重要启示。
title: Modeling Mycobacterium tuberculosis Pathogenesis in Lung Epithelial Organoids Reveals Strain-Specific Host Responses and Intercellular Crosstalk

summary_zh: 环鸟苷酸-腺苷酸合成酶（cGAS）是先天免疫系统中的关键酶，负责识别细胞质中异常定位的双链DNA。cGAS通过与DNA结合被激活，进而催化产生第二信使2'-5'/3'-5'环GMP-AMP（2'3' cGAMP）。尽管cGAS在细胞免疫反应中发挥着重要作用，但由于缺乏能够快速筛选cGAS活性的遗传学工具、体外环境下人源cGAS与DNA相互作用的不稳定性，以及此前缺乏人源cGAS-DNA复合物的结构信息，对其生物学机制的全面理解一直受到限制。本文详细阐述了用于绘制cGAS激活分子决定因素的实验流程，并开发了制备人源cGAS-DNA晶体以进行结构分析的方法。结合此前建立的哺乳动物cGAS同源物研究体系，这些创新技术为深入理解人源cGAS生物学特性及其在药物治疗中的靶点开发奠定了坚实基础。
title: Analysis of human cGAS activity and structure
venue: Methods in enzymology on CD-ROM/Methods in enzymology

abstract: High-power tunable femtosecond mid-infrared (MIR) pulses are of great interest for many scientific and industrial applications. Here we demonstrate a compact fluoride-fiber-based system that generates single solitons tunable from 3 to 3.8 μm. The system is composed of an Er:ZBLAN fiber oscillator and amplifier followed by a fusion-spliced Dy:ZBLAN fiber amplifier. The Er:ZBLAN fiber amplifier acts as a power booster as well as a frequency shifter to generate Raman solitons up to 3 μm. The Dy:ZBLAN fiber amplifier transfers the energy from the residual 2.8 μm radiation into the Raman solitons using an in-band pumping scheme, and further extends the wavelength up to 3.8 μm. Common residual pump radiation and secondary solitons accompanying the soliton self-frequency shift (SSFS) are recycled to amplify Raman solitons, consequently displaying a higher output power and pulse energy, a wider shifting range, and an excellent spectral purity. Stable 252 fs pulses at 3.8 μm with a record average power of 1.6 W and a pulse energy of 23 nJ are generated. This work provides an effective way to develop high-power widely tunable ultrafast single-soliton MIR laser sources, and this method can facilitate the design of other SSFS-based laser systems for single-soliton generation.
title: Generation of single solitons tunable from 3 to 3.8 μm in cascaded Er3+-doped and Dy3+-doped fluoride fiber amplifiers

abstract: The reception performance of a Multiple-Input-Multiple-Output (MIMO) system suffers from not only the channel fading but also the phase noise. Accurate and efficient estimation algorithms of channel responses and phase noises that enable high-speed wireless communications in MIMO systems are of broad interest. The prior joint estimation schemes of channel responses and phase noises are designed for synchronous MIMO systems, where symbols transmitted from different transmit antennas are strictly synchronized. However, the estimation performance of the prior schemes suffers from the Inter Antenna Interference (IAI), which further limits the reception performance of a MIMO system. In this paper, we propose an asynchronous MIMO system with intentional timing offset. Based on the proposed asynchronous MIMO system, we further design the Joint Estimation of Channel responses and Phase noises using Intentional Timing Offset (JECP-ITO) scheme. We derive the Cramér-Rao Lower Bound (CRLB) of the JECP-ITO scheme in closed form. We provide rigorous theoretical comparisons between the JECP-ITO and the prior scheme in terms of IAI and CRLB. Moreover, we implement the proposed scheme and conduct extensive performance comparisons through simulations.
title: Joint Estimation of Channel Responses and Phase Noises in Asynchronous MIMO Systems With Intentional Timing Offset

summary_zh: 精确调控接触力对于抓取和操作易碎或可变形物体至关重要。本研究旨在利用人手的灵巧性来调节机器人手的接触力，并以可穿戴、非侵入的方式利用人类的感觉运动协同机制。我们通过表面肌电信号从骨骼肌自主收缩的电活动中提取力信息，构建了基于神经网络的回归模型，从预处理后的表面肌电信号中预测抓取力，取得了高精度预测结果（决定系数达0.982）。基于从人体肌肉预测的力指令，我们开发了力引导控制框架，通过导纳控制器实现力控制，该控制器跟踪预测的抓取力参考值，以抓取精细和可变形物体。我们在日常生活中具有代表性的易碎和可变形物体上验证了所提方法的有效性，所有物体均被成功抓取，未造成任何损坏或变形。
title: Force-Guided High-Precision Grasping Control of Fragile and Deformable Objects Using sEMG-Based Force Prediction

summary_zh: 本文报道了铁磁体与半导体界面间出现的非典型交换偏置（EB）效应及增强的自旋泵浦（SP）现象。研究发现，在生长于ZnO单晶上的Co薄膜中，由于界面处形成的Zn1−xCoxO层具有反铁磁性，从而诱导产生了显著的交换偏置效应。自旋泵浦测量结果显示，在Co/ZnO界面处存在巨大的自旋泵浦效率，并在阻塞温度（TB ≈ 75 K）附近出现峰值，其有效自旋混合电导率（Geff↑↓）达到28 nm⁻²。通过反向自旋霍尔效应测量进一步证实了这一增强的自旋泵浦效应，并估算出Zn1−xCoxO的自旋霍尔角为0.011。研究表明，Zn1−xCoxO中施主电子与磁性阳离子离子之间通过s–d交换相互作用形成的束缚磁极化子，是产生反铁磁性及巨大自旋混合电导率的关键因素。该工作为理解铁磁/半导体界面的自旋物理机制提供了新的视角。
title: Unconventional exchange bias and enhanced spin pumping efficiency due to diluted magnetic oxide at the Co/ZnO interface

abstract: It is possible to explore higher dimensional topological properties in lower dimensional structures by introducing additional synthetic dimensions. In this Letter, we construct a four-dimensional (4D) second-order topological insulator using gradient nanoparticle arrays arranged in a periodic lattice. The nanoparticle array has spatially varying inter-particle distance along x and y directions, which can be regarded as two synthetic dimensions. Different from higher-order topological insulators in classical wave systems, the higher-order topological states in this 4D system are protected by a pair of first Chern numbers in two-dimensional (2D) subspaces instead of by the quantized 2D Zak phases. It is shown that there exist (4-1)- and (4-2)-dimensional boundary states for both transverse and longitudinal collective resonant modes, which provides new, to the best of our knowledge, mechanisms for light confinement and control in such a plasmonic superlattice.
summary_zh: 本文通过在梯度纳米颗粒阵列中引入合成维度，构建了一种四维二阶拓扑绝缘体。该阵列沿x和y方向的颗粒间距呈空间渐变分布，可视为两个合成维度，从而在低维结构中实现高维拓扑性质的探索。与传统经典波系统中的高阶拓扑绝缘体不同，该四维体系的高阶拓扑态由二维子空间中的一对第一陈数保护，而非量子化的二维Zak相位。研究表明，对于横向和纵向集体共振模式，体系中均存在(4-1)维和(4-2)维边界态，这为等离激元超晶格中的光场局域与调控提供了新的机制。
title: Four dimensional second-order topological insulator based on a synthetic plasmonic metasurface

abstract:
In this paper, we consider the Cauchy problem to the three dimensional heat conducting compressible nematic liquid crystal system in the presence of vacuum and with vacuum far fields. Global well-posedness of strong solutions is established under the condition that the scaling invariant quantity $ (\|ho_0\|_\infty+1) ig[\|ho_0\|_3+(\|ho_0\|_\infty+1)^2(\|\sqrt{ho_0}u_0\|_2^2+ \|

summary_zh: 本文研究三维热传导可压缩向列型液晶系统在含真空且远场为真空条件下的柯西问题。在仅依赖于系统参数的尺度不变量充分小的条件下，我们建立了强解的整体适定性。该尺度不变量由初始密度、速度、液晶指向矢方向及其梯度、以及能量密度的特定范数组合构成，具体形式为：初始密度无穷范数与1之和，乘以密度L3范数及包含密度无穷范数、速度加权L2范数和指向矢梯度L2范数的组合项，再乘以速度梯度L2范数及包含密度无穷范数、能量密度加权L2范数和指向矢二阶梯度L2范数的组合项。这一结果揭示了在真空区域可能由初始状态产生并维持的复杂物理背景下，液晶流体动力学方程组的全局解存在唯一性，为理解液晶材料在极端条件下的流动与传热行为提供了理论依据。
title: Global small solutions to heat conductive compressible nematic liquid crystal system: smallness on a scaling invariant quantity

summary_zh: 设计兼具高效率与机械鲁棒性的本征可拉伸有机太阳能电池（IS-OSCs）的关键在于开发新型受体材料。针对目前可拉伸聚合物受体效率较低，而高性能小分子受体脆性较大的挑战，本研究采用噻吩烯烷基噻吩（TAT）作为共轭断裂连接桥，通过调节连接位点和卤素取代基，成功合成了四种二聚化受体。研究发现，连接位点与卤素取代对分子的电子结构、聚集行为及电荷传输特性具有显著影响。通过优化分子结构，二聚化受体在混合薄膜中实现了合理的相分离，这在有效抑制电荷复合过程的同时，显著促进了激子的解离。实验结果表明，基于FDY-m-TAT的刚性有机太阳能电池实现了18.07%的最高光电转换效率（PCE），为目前报道的含共轭断裂连接桥的受体中最高水平。更重要的是，基于FDY-m-TAT的本征可拉伸有机太阳能电池实现了14.29%的高效率和18.23%的优异裂纹起始应变（COS），性能大幅超越了基于Y6的同类器件。本研究证明了含有共轭断裂连接桥的二聚化受体在开发高效且机械性能稳健的有机太阳能电池方面具有巨大的应用潜力。
title: Dimerized Acceptors with Conjugate‐Break Linker Enable Highly Efficient and Mechanically Robust Organic Solar Cells

abstract: This paper presents a concept-based learning framework for sign language recognition. The recognition is based on the concept learning framework which transforms learning about high-level concepts into learning for low-level concepts, the structure of which is simpler and can be learned with fewer samples. The sign language samples were first segmented by a modified Time Varying Parameter (TVP) algorithm which segments the motion time series according to pause points, and the segments are used to build a primitive library with a selforganizing feature map (SOFM) network. Then the SL samples represented by the primitive library were recognized using template matching and model generation methods. Experimental results show that under the framework of concept learning, we achieve 3% to 4% accuracy improvement for the recognition of 95 classes Australian Sign Language (AUSL) using Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) and Hidden Markov Model (HMM) classifiers.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于概念学习的手语识别框架。该框架将高层概念的学习转化为低层概念的学习，低层概念结构更简单，所需训练样本更少。首先，采用改进的时变参数算法对手语样本进行分割，依据停顿点将运动时间序列切分为若干片段，并利用自组织特征映射网络构建基元库。随后，基于基元库表示的手语样本，通过模板匹配和模型生成方法完成识别。实验结果表明，在概念学习框架下，采用动态时间规整和隐马尔可夫模型分类器对95类澳大利亚手语进行识别，准确率提升了3%至4%。
title: Sign language recognition based on concept learning
venue: 2020 IEEE International Instrumentation and Measurement Technology Conference (I2MTC)

abstract: Elucidating the characteristics and molecular composition of dissolved organic matter (DOM) is critical to understanding carbon cycling in increasingly saline lakes in arid and hyperarid areas; however, the molecular signatures of DOM in these widely distributed saline lakes remain poorly understood. Here, variations in DOM characteristics and ages with salinity were investigated across 10 small saline lakes within the Badain Jaran Desert based on absorption and fluorescence spectroscopy, Fourier transform ion cyclotron resonance mass spectrometry, and 14C-isotopic analysis. The results showed that dissolved organic carbon (DOC) significantly increased with salinity, and the 14C age of solid-phase extracted DOM ranging 385–3935 years before present did not correlate with salinity across lakes. With increasing salinity, the DOM aromaticity, DOC-specific abundances of fluorescent components, and relative abundance of lignin-like components all decreased, whereas the relative abundance of lipid-like components increased. Regarding halogen-containing DOM, the brine lakes showed higher relative abundances of chlorine-containing lignin- and lipid-like components but comparable relative abundances of bromine-containing components, supporting preferential chlorination over bromination. This study demonstrates the strong impacts of salinization on DOM accumulation and chlorination in inland saline lakes and highlights the critical role of brine lakes as a persistent carbon pool.
title: Dissolved Organic Matter Characteristics and Composition of Saline Lakes in the Badain Jaran Desert, China

summary_zh: 本文针对基于LCL滤波器的三相并网逆变器，研究了一种电容电流内环与并网电流外环构成的双闭环控制策略。首先分析了无源阻尼方法对LCL滤波器谐振峰的抑制效果，在此基础上引入双闭环控制结构，以提升系统稳定性与谐波抑制能力。为充分发挥碳化硅金属氧化物半导体场效应晶体管（SiC MOSFET）在高开关频率下的优势，搭建了基于SiC MOSFET的逆变器实验平台。实验结果表明，所提双闭环控制策略能够显著降低系统谐波含量，验证了控制参数设计方案的可行性与有效性。该研究为高功率密度并网逆变器的设计提供了参考，适用于对谐波性能和系统稳定性要求较高的新能源并网发电应用场景。
title: SiC MOSFET Based LCL Grid-Connected Inverter with Double Closed-Loop Control
venue: 2018 IEEE Energy Conversion Congress and Exposition (ECCE)

abstract: Compared with traditional broadside array, end-fire array has the advantages of low profile and strong directional radiation thereby is well-suited for airborne platform to detect moving target. Similar to the airborne radar with broadside array, the end-fire array airborne radar (EFAAR) also face the challenge of suppressing strong ground/sea clutter in practical application. However, the existing researches on clutter suppression for EFAAR primarily focus on the column-Doppler domain, while neglecting the clutter three-dimensional (3D) coupling characteristic. In this paper, a space-time 3D clutter signal model for EFAAR that incorporates the row spatial frequency, column spatial frequency and Doppler frequency is firstly constructed. Then, the clutter coupling characteristics in the row-column-Doppler 3D domain are analyzed in detail. Finally, a novel clutter suppression scheme for three typical scenarios is proposed according to the clutter distribution. Simulation results validate the superiority of the proposed scheme in both clutter suppression performance and training sample requirements.
summary_zh: 本文针对端射阵机载雷达的杂波抑制问题，首先构建了融合行空间频率、列空间频率与多普勒频率的空时三维杂波信号模型，系统揭示了杂波在行-列-多普勒三维域中的耦合特性。基于该分布规律，提出了一种适用于三种典型场景的杂波抑制新方案。仿真结果表明，与传统仅关注列-多普勒域的方法相比，所提方案在杂波抑制性能和训练样本需求方面均表现出显著优势，为端射阵机载雷达在强地/海杂波背景下的运动目标检测提供了有效解决途径。
title: A Reduced-Dimensional STAP Scheme for End-Fire Array Airborne Radar

abstract: In both structural and environmental wind engineering, the vertical variation of wind direction is important as it impacts both the torsional response of the high-rise building and the pedestrian level wind environment. In order to systematically investigate the vertical variation of wind directions (i.e., the so-called 'twist effect') induced by hills with idealized geometries, a series of wind-tunnel tests was conducted. The length-to-width aspect ratios of the hill models were 1/3, 1/2, 1, 2 and 3, and the measurements of both wind speeds and directions were taken on a three-dimensional grid system. From the wind-tunnel tests, it has been found that the direction changes and most prominent at the half height of the hill. On the other hand, the characteristic length of the direction change, has been found to increase when moving from the windward zone into the wake. Based on the wind-tunnel measurements, a descriptive model is proposed to calculate both the horizontal and vertical variations of wind directions. Preliminarily validated against the wind-tunnel measurements, the proposed model has been found to be acceptable to describe the direction changes induced by an idealized hill with an aspect ratio close to 1. For the hills with aspect ratios less than 1, while the description of the vertical variation is still valid, the horizontal description proposed by the model has been found unfit.
title: Wind direction field under the influence of topography, part I: A descriptive model

summary_zh: 本研究系统解析了大肠杆菌中cAMP受体蛋白（CRP）介导的前馈环（FFL）调控网络。通过整合EcoCyc与RegulonDB数据库，共鉴定出393个CRP-FFL，涵盖全部八种结构类型。利用剂量响应基因组芯片技术，检测了不同cAMP浓度下CRP-FFL靶基因的动态表达谱，发现各类FFL呈现多样化的表达模式，并可归为五种功能组别。结合芯片数据与已知调控关系，确认其中202个CRP-FFL受CRP直接调控。值得注意的是，34%（432个基因中的147个）同时受CRP及其调控的转录因子双重控制，表明这些基因通过CRP-FFL结构响应环境信号，形成级联调控。进一步通过基因本体注释揭示了CRP-FFL的生物学功能。该研究首次基于体内实验数据全面阐明了CRP-FFL的结构类型、表达特征与功能分类，为理解细菌如何通过前馈环网络灵活适应营养环境波动提供了系统性见解。
title: Large-Scale Functional Analysis of CRP-Mediated Feed-Forward Loops

abstract: We show that the intrinsic and surface defects can be simultaneously suppressed by inserting polymeric interlayer beneath the perovskite films, through facilitating the crystallization process and filling up the vacancies on the crystal surface.
summary_zh: 本研究通过在钙钛矿薄膜下方引入聚合物中间层，实现了对材料本征缺陷与表面缺陷的同步抑制。该聚合物层在钙钛矿结晶过程中起到调控作用，促进更有序的晶体生长，从而减少薄膜内部的结构缺陷；同时，聚合物分子可有效填充晶体表面的空位，钝化表面悬挂键。这一协同策略显著降低了缺陷态密度，抑制了非辐射复合损失，最终提升了钙钛矿光电器件的性能与稳定性。该方法为制备高质量钙钛矿薄膜提供了一种简便有效的途径，在太阳能电池、发光二极管及光电探测器等领域具有广泛的应用前景。
title: Suppressing the defects in cesium-based perovskites via polymeric interlayer assisted crystallization control

abstract: Freight forwarding companies commonly encounter difficulties in handling uncertainties, especially demand uncertainty under the circumstances of no sufficient historical data or accurate forecasting approach. A two-stage robust optimization method is proposed for service network design under demand uncertainty. We employ probability-free uncertainty sets to illuminate the potential scenarios and develop a column-and-constraint generation approach as the solution method to solve the introduced robust models exactly. As indicated by the numerical results, the algorithm we proposed herein performs better than the Benders decomposition approach in terms of computing speed and quality of the solution. Comparative results demonstrate the robustness of the proposed models. We also analyze the structural properties of robust solutions, which provide operational flexibility against uncertainty.
summary_zh: 针对货运代理公司在缺乏充足历史数据或准确预测手段时难以应对需求不确定性的问题，本文提出了一种用于服务网络设计的两阶段鲁棒优化方法。研究采用无概率不确定集合来刻画潜在的需求场景，并开发了列约束生成算法（C&CG）以实现对所构建鲁棒模型的精确求解。数值仿真结果表明，该算法在计算速度与解的质量方面均优于传统的Benders分解法。对比实验进一步验证了所提模型的鲁棒性。此外，本文还对鲁棒解的结构特性进行了深入分析，为应对不确定性提供了更具灵活性的运营决策支持。
title: Robust service network design under demand uncertainty

summary_zh: 解析实体肿瘤的复杂组成对于理解肿瘤的发生、进展及转移至关重要。尽管患者来源的样本能提供重要信息，但其在分子水平上具有高度异质性，且往往源自晚期肿瘤阶段。本研究利用小鼠唾液腺鳞状细胞癌模型，结合单细胞转录组学与表位谱分析，并通过通路及谱系分析，从发育的角度对肿瘤发生过程进行了深入研究。研究构建了全面的细胞图谱并成功鉴定出肿瘤特异性细胞。研究发现，这些细胞遵循一条可重复的发育轨迹：肿瘤发生始于表现出上皮-间质转化特征的基底细胞，随后通过具有Wnt信号差异的类癌干细胞亚群，最终分化为管腔样细胞。本研究在完整的组织环境中为肿瘤特异性细胞身份提供了无偏见的见解，并强调了使用明确遗传模型系统在肿瘤研究中的强大效能。
title: Tracing tumorigenesis in a solid tumor model at single-cell resolution

summary_zh: 本文研究有界Lipschitz区域Ω上具有给定障碍ψ的非局部障碍问题，其中允许函数集为非空分数阶Sobolev空间子集。非局部算子由可测、有界且严格正定的奇异核a(x,y)通过Dirichlet形式定义，该形式未必对称。我们证明了由分布型Riesz分数阶导数与可测有界矩阵A(x)构成的分数阶算子可表示为具有明确奇异积分核的非局部积分算子。相应的分数阶障碍问题在s趋近于1时收敛到经典梯度算子对应的H₀¹(Ω)障碍问题。 本文重点研究涉及该双线性形式的单障碍、双障碍及N-膜问题，推导出弱极大值原理、比较性质、有界惩罚逼近以及Lewy–Stampacchia不等式等一系列结果。这些结果进一步揭示了正则性：包括解的L^∞全局估计；当核对称时解的局部Hölder正则性；以及当算子为分数阶s-Laplacian时，解在局部分数阶Sobolev空间和C¹中的正则性。此外，我们将Lewy–Stampacchia不等式推广到H₀ˢ(Ω)的序对偶空间，并对相关s-容量和一般非局部障碍问题进行了讨论。
title: On a class of nonlocal obstacle type problems related to the distributional Riesz fractional derivative

summary_zh: 本研究提出一种基于双路易斯酸的无金属催化体系，用于在温和条件下实现氮气活化与加氢转化。通过密度泛函理论计算，我们验证了该策略的概念可行性，其中氮气加氢反应的活化能低至15.3千卡每摩尔。双路易斯酸通过协同作用有效削弱氮氮三键的稳定性，从而促进氮气的催化氢化。此外，该双路易斯酸体系还可拓展应用于多种小分子的活化，包括二氧化碳、甲醛、N-亚乙基甲胺和乙腈等。研究发现，芳香性在稳定反应中间体和产物方面发挥着关键作用，有助于降低反应能垒并提高热力学可行性。这一发现为氮气活化与功能化提供了一条非过渡金属依赖的新途径，并凸显了双路易斯酸在小分子活化领域的广阔应用前景。
title: Predicting Small Molecule Activation including Catalytic Hydrogenation of Dinitrogen Promoted by a Dual Lewis Acid

summary_zh: 单细胞转录组学虽在鼻咽癌（NPC）肿瘤微环境的研究中取得了显著进展，但由于难以有效捕获上皮或肿瘤细胞，限制了对肿瘤异质性及免疫逃逸机制的深入探索。本研究通过结合单细胞转录组测序（scRNA/snRNA-seq）与成像质谱流式技术（IMC），在单细胞分辨率下对鼻咽癌肿瘤细胞的转录组特征及空间分布进行了系统分析。研究揭示了鼻咽癌中多种免疫逃逸模式，包括恶性细胞中主要组织相容性复合体（MHC）分子的缺失、类成纤维细胞样恶性细胞诱导的上皮-间质转化（EMT），以及肿瘤巢内增生细胞通过物理屏障保护肿瘤细胞免受免疫浸润。此外，研究首次鉴定出鼻咽癌肿瘤微环境中特有的CD8+自然杀伤（NK）细胞亚群。这些发现深化了对鼻咽癌免疫景观复杂性的理解，为开发针对性的新型治疗策略提供了重要依据。
title: Single‐cell analysis reveals the multiple patterns of immune escape in the nasopharyngeal carcinoma microenvironment

summary_zh: 本文提出了一种利用界面限域反应实现高效稳定催化的新策略。研究表明，富含1T'相的锂化二硫化钼是一种强效还原剂，可在其层间原位还原金属离子，形成零价金属插层的二硫化钼复合材料。通过将铂纳米颗粒限域在二硫化钼层状结构内部，所制备的催化剂在析氢反应中展现出比传统碳载催化剂更优异的活性和稳定性。关键在于，层间铂表面可选择性地允许质子及金属离子等带电物种进入并接触活性位点，同时有效阻隔大尺寸污染物或中性分子的毒化作用。这种基于体相插层化合物的设计思路为能源相关领域的催化应用开辟了新方向。
title: Interface confined hydrogen evolution reaction in zero valent metal nanoparticles-intercalated molybdenum disulfide

abstract: Formal [2+2+2] addition reactions of the NBD ligand in [Cp*Ru(H2O)(NBD)]BF4 (NBD = norbornadiene) with H2, Ph3SiH, ArCHCCH2, and RC⋮CPh were observed. In contrast, olefins such as styrene and NBD do not undergo similar [2+2+2] addition reactions with [Cp*Ru(H2O)(NBD)]BF4. [Cp*Ru(H2O)(NBD)]BF4 reacts with H2 in benzene to give [Cp*Ru(η6-C6H6)]BF4 and nortricyclene. Similarly, [Cp*Ru(H2O)(NBD)]BF4 reacts with Ph3SiH to give [Cp*Ru(η6-C6H5SiPh2OH)]BF4 and nortricyclene. Treatment of [Cp*Ru(H2O)(NBD)]BF4 with styrene produces [Cp*Ru(η6-C6H5-CHCH-C7H9)]BF4, [Cp*Ru(η6-C6H5-CHCH2)]BF4, C6H5-CHCH−C7H9, and Cp*Ru(η5-C5H4-C9H11). The latter complex is also produced from the reaction of [Cp*Ru(H2O)(NBD)]BF4 with NBD. Treatment of [Cp*Ru(H2O)(NBD)]BF4 with ArCHCCH2 produces [Cp*Ru(η6-Ar-C10H11)]BF4. Reactions of [Cp*Ru(H2O)(NBD)]BF4 with RC⋮CC6H5 (R = Ph, Me) give [Cp*Ru(η6-C6H5-C10H8R)]BF4. The reaction pathways of the coupling reactions have been studied by computational chemistry.
title: Reactions of [Cp*Ru(H2O)(NBD)]+ with Dihydrogen, Silanes, Olefins, Alkynes, and Allenes

abstract: Abstract Recent researches show that material microstructural designs mimicking biomaterials offer an effective way to produce tougher composites. To reveal the underlying microstructure-toughness relationship, five bioinspired material microstructures are investigated experimentally, including the brick-and-mortar, cross-lamellar, concentric hexagonal, and rotating plywood microstructures. The feature sizes of these microstructures are controlled to be one order smaller than the specimen size, providing better pictures of how crack resistance interacts with heterogeneity. Fracture theories are further used to analyze the toughening mechanisms and find the design criteria. Results show that the rotating plywood structure presents a “J” shaped R-curve, while other structures show “Γ” shaped R-curves. The “J” shaped R-curve gives a larger critical energy release rate and tolerates a longer crack, thus preferable for crack arresting. By contrast, the “Γ” shaped R-curve provides a larger critical failure stress and is beneficial for preventing crack initiation. Moreover, combined experimental results and theoretical analysis suggest that heterogeneity improves toughness by 1) creating stiffness variations to slow down crack propagation and prevent crack penetration and 2) guiding cracks along weak interfaces to promote progressive damage. Our results shed new light on the structure-property relationship that will facilitate the design of tougher and better crack resistant composites.
title: 3D printing of biomimetic composites with improved fracture toughness

abstract: Traditional learning methods for training Markov random fields require doing inference over all variables to compute the likelihood gradient. The iteration complexity for those methods therefore scales with the size of the graphical models. In this paper, we propose block belief propagation learning (BBPL), which uses block-coordinate updates of approximate marginals to compute approximate gradients, removing the need to compute inference on the entire graphical model. Thus, the iteration complexity of BBPL does not scale with the size of the graphs. We prove that the method converges to the same solution as that obtained by using full inference per iteration, despite these approximations, and we empirically demonstrate its scalability improvements over standard training methods.
summary_zh: 传统马尔可夫随机场训练方法在计算似然梯度时需对所有变量执行推断，导致迭代复杂度随图模型规模增长。本文提出分块置信传播学习方法，通过近似边缘概率的分块坐标更新计算近似梯度，避免了对整个图模型进行全局推断。因此，该方法的迭代复杂度不再随图规模缩放。我们证明，尽管采用了近似策略，该方法仍能收敛至与逐次全推断相同的解，并通过实验验证了其相比标准训练方法在可扩展性上的显著提升。
title: Block Belief Propagation for Parameter Learning in Markov Random Fields
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

abstract: This paper proposes a new two-phase hybrid metaheuristic for vehicle routing problems with time windows (VRPTW). The first phase is to minimize the number of routes by means of variable neighborhood search algorithm, while the second phase is mainly aimed at minimizing the total travel distance using tabu search algorithm. Three neighborhood search operators (All-exchange, All-2-opt, All-) and two local search operators (All-relocate and ejection chain) are designed. To further lower the number of vehicles, the sum-of-squares route size is maximized in the first phase. A comparative test is implemented by our algorithm on the basis of 56 benchmark problems proposed by Solomon (1987), the mean number of vehicles and running time of this algorithm is very competitive compared to previous metaheuristics, showing that the new two-phase hybrid metaheuristic is effective and fast.
summary_zh: 本文针对带时间窗的车辆路径问题（VRPTW）提出了一种新型两阶段混合元启发式算法。该算法首先通过变邻域搜索算法（VNS）最小化路径数量，在此阶段通过最大化路径规模平方和来进一步降低车辆使用量；随后进入第二阶段，利用禁忌搜索算法（TS）优化总行驶距离。研究设计了包括全交换、全2-opt及全k-opt在内的三种邻域搜索算子，并结合全重定位与弹出链两种局部搜索算子以提升搜索效率。基于Solomon（1987）提供的56个基准测试问题的对比实验结果表明，该算法在车辆使用数量和运行时间方面均优于现有的元启发式算法，证明了该两阶段混合策略在解决复杂路径规划问题时具有高效性与快速收敛的优势。
title: A new two-phase hybrid metaheuristic for vehicle routing problem with time windows
venue: Journal of the Eastern Asia Society for transportation studies/Journal of the Eastern Asia Society for Transportation Studies

summary_zh: 本文针对多标签学习中标签缺失问题，提出基于混合依赖图的传导式学习方法。核心思路是将每个实例的每个标签视为节点，通过多种标签依赖关系构建图结构以传播标签信息。基础混合依赖图包含两类边：基于实例相似性的无向边连接不同实例的标签节点，基于语义标签层次的有向边连接不同类别节点。在此基础上，进一步引入两种跨类标签依赖：一是类别共现关系，编码为无向边，与基础图结合形成共现混合图（MG-CO）；二是对整个标签矩阵进行稀疏与低秩分解，以嵌入标签间的高阶依赖，与基础图结合形成稀疏低秩混合图（MG-SL）。基于这两种图结构，分别提出两个凸传导式优化模型MLMG-CO和MLMG-SL。两模型均通过二次平滑项嵌入实例相似性，并将语义标签层次作为线性约束。MLMG-CO额外将类别共现建模为二次平滑项，而MLMG-SL则通过引入稀疏矩阵和低秩矩阵，并约束两者之和等于原始标签矩阵，来融入稀疏低秩分解。该方法可同时应用于图像标注和基于标签的图像检索。在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，所提方法在性能和对标签缺失的鲁棒性上均显著优于现有方法。
title: Multi-label Learning with Missing Labels Using Mixed Dependency Graphs

summary_zh: 本研究针对南黄海最长钻孔（NHH01，深度125.64米）开展了高分辨率磁性地层学研究，旨在通过沉积物记录揭示海平面、气候变化及构造历史。研究发现，在含有灰铁矿的层位（44.90–51.80米）中，利用交替场退磁法观测到了以负倾角为主的异常区间；然而，通过加热至约360°C后，多数样本的倾角由负转正，这表明该异常并非真实的负磁极亚期，而是受灰铁矿影响的假象。在排除灰铁矿干扰后，磁性地层学解释成功界定了马图亚-布伦斯界线（781 ka）和雅拉米洛顶界（990 ka），并经线性外推得出该钻孔底部年龄约为1.10 Ma。此外，研究识别出若干短期的倾角异常，初步判定为磁偏转事件，这证明了在这些快速地磁事件发生时，深部沉积过程仍保持千禧年尺度的连续性。同时，钻孔中粘土含量变化与海洋氧同位素记录具有高度一致性，表明粘土含量可作为该区域过去约100万年间的古气候指标。本研究不仅为南黄海提供了可靠的地层年龄模型，也为大陆架地区的古地磁研究提供了方法论指导。
title: Magnetostratigraphy of a greigite‐bearing core from the South Yellow Sea: Implications for remagnetization and sedimentation
venue: Journal of Geophysical Research Solid Earth

abstract: A central question in edge intelligence is “how can an edge device learn its local model with limited data and constrained computing capacity?” In this study, we explore the approach where a global model initialization is first obtained by running federated learning (FL) across multiple edge devices, based on which a semi-supervised algorithm is devised for a single edge device to carry out quick adaptation with its local data. Specifically, to account for device heterogeneity and resource constraints, a global model is first trained via FL, where each device conducts multiple local updates only for its customized subnet. A subset of devices can be selected to upload updates for aggregation during each training round. Further, device scheduling is optimized to minimize the training loss of FL, subject to resource constraints, based on the carefully crafted reward function defined as the one-round progress of FL each device can provide. We examine the convergence behavior of FL for the general non-convex case. For semi-supervised model personalization, we use the FL-based model initialization as a teacher network to impute soft labels on unlabeled data, thereby addressing the insufficiency of labeled data. Experiments are conducted to evaluate the performance of the proposed algorithms.
title: Resource-Efficient Edge AI: From Federated Learning to Semi-Supervised Model Personalization

summary_zh: 在大数据时代，人工智能物联网场景下，大量智能设备采集的数据需在云端进行智能语义分析，如图像识别。基于深度学习的图像压缩技术推动了面向机器的语义压缩发展，但物联网设备计算与存储资源有限，难以部署参数过多的编码器。为此，本文提出一种基于压缩感知的非对称语义图像压缩方法，专为资源受限的人工智能物联网系统设计。该非对称语义压缩方案旨在突破物联网设备的限制，实现高效的机器视觉任务语义压缩。方法核心包括一个基于深度图像压缩感知的轻量级前端编码器，利用丰富图像先验学习测量矩阵进行采样；同时，在服务器端部署一个与线性编码器协同设计的深度迭代解码器，以提升图像重建质量和多种语义分析任务的性能。此外，本文还提出一种新颖的有损压缩感知语义率失真理论框架，为在扩展语义失真下降低码率提供了理论依据。大量实验结果表明，在人工智能物联网仿真环境中，所提方法在信号-语义率失真权衡方面具有显著优势，且编码复杂度低于现有编解码器。
title: Image Compression for Resource-Constrained AIoT System With Compressed Sensing
venue: IEEE Transactions on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics: Systems

summary_zh: 我们提出 P-Dedupe，一种流水线化并行数据去重系统，旨在加速大规模存储系统中基于内容分块与安全哈希指纹的去重过程。该系统将去重流程划分为分块、指纹计算、索引和写入四个阶段，并以数据块和文件为处理单元进行流水线调度，同时对计算密集的内容定义分块和哈希指纹阶段实施并行化，以缓解计算瓶颈。为在满足最大与最小块长约束下高效并行化内容定义分块，受 MapReduce 模型启发，先将数据流切分为多个段（Map），各段由独立线程并行执行分块，再对段边界进行重新分块与拼接（Reduce），从而保证并行分块的有效性。在四核 Intel i7 处理器上对八个数据集的实验表明，P-Dedupe 能够以仅约 0.02% 的去重率下降为代价，实现去重吞吐量近线性的加速。该工作为大数据科学提供了支撑，确保所有文件快速且完整地经历去重处理，使得同一文件仅需被处理和分析一次，而非多次。
title: Accelerating content-defined-chunking based data deduplication by exploiting parallelism

summary_zh: 我们提出了一种基于能量约束扩散（ECD）的新型癌症驱动基因识别模型，命名为ECD-CDGI。该模型首次将ECD技术与注意力机制相结合，设计了ECD-Attention编码器，能够在抑制数据噪声的同时生成鲁棒的基因表征，有效揭示基因间复杂的相互依赖关系。在此基础上，通过图Transformer从基因相互作用网络中提取拓扑嵌入，并与基因表征进行拼接，以增强模型对网络结构信息的利用。在三种测试场景下开展的大量实验表明，ECD-CDGI不仅能准确识别已知的癌症驱动基因，还能高效发现未知的潜在驱动基因。与基于图神经网络的方法相比，该模型受现有基因网络的约束更小，从而提升了识别驱动基因的能力。此外，ECD-CDGI已开源并免费提供，同时作为一款在线工具发布，旨在加速癌症驱动基因识别相关研究。
title: ECD-CDGI: An efficient energy-constrained diffusion model for cancer driver gene identification

abstract: 4D printing technology combines 3D printing and stimulus-responsive materials, enabling construction of complex 3D objects efficiently. However, unlike smart soft materials, 4D printing of ceramics is a great challenge due to the extremely weak deformability of ceramics. Here, we report a feasible and efficient manufacturing and design approach to realize direct 4D printing of ceramics. Photocurable ceramic elastomer slurry and hydrogel precursor are developed for the fabrication of hydrogel-ceramic laminates via multimaterial digital light processing 3D printing. Flat patterned laminates evolve into complex 3D structures driven by hydrogel dehydration, and then turn into pure ceramics after sintering. Considering the dehydration-induced deformation and sintering-induced shape retraction, we develop a theoretical model to calculate the curvatures of bent laminate and sintered ceramic part. Then, we build a design flow for direct 4D printing of various complex ceramic objects. This approach opens a new avenue for the development of ceramic 4D printing technology.
title: Direct 4D printing of ceramics driven by hydrogel dehydration

abstract: Bus service is of great significance to urban residents. With the convergence of bus lines and the formation of bus hubs, a multi-line operation mode which can realize the centralized management of vehicles is applied to the daily bus service planning. To solve the bus service planning problem systematically in the multi-line operation mode, we propose an integrated framework for bus timetabling (TT) and vehicle scheduling (VS), which are the two fundamental processes of bus service planning. Firstly, the determination processes of TT and VS are correlated by constructing the multiple vehicles’ trip-link chains with departure time information to facilitate simultaneous optimization. Secondly, a multi-objective optimization model is constructed, which considers higher service quality and lower operating costs as objectives. Logic and operational rules are also considered as constraints to ensure the implementation of the solutions. Thirdly, we propose and implement a heuristic solution algorithm based on neighborhood search to achieve high-performance solutions. Finally, we validate the efficiency and effectiveness of our framework under the actual bus operation scenario in Chongqing, China. The Pareto frontier solutions are provided to bus operators as alternative operation schemes.
title: Integrated Framework for Bus Timetabling and Scheduling in Multi-Line Operation Mode
venue: Applied Sciences 12, no. 9: 4210. https://doi.org/10.3390/app1209421023.Ji, Shiqian, Jiaming Zhong, and Zhaocheng He. 2022. "A Bus Subsidy Scheme Design Model Considering Competition between Bus Companies" Sustainability 14, no. 7: 4201

summary_zh: 受激发射损耗（STED）显微术作为超分辨成像的重要分支，通过纯光学调控荧光行为突破衍射极限，在生命科学领域实现了对亚200纳米结构的观测。本研究系统探究了共聚焦与STED成像模式下激光照射对荧光寿命的影响规律。实验结果表明，相较于共聚焦模式，两种荧光微球在STED模式下的荧光寿命随光照时间延长均发生显著变化。进一步分析发现，荧光寿命延长可降低饱和光强，从而在相同损耗功率条件下提升STED成像分辨率。该现象在固定HeLa细胞中Star635P标记的人源Nup153蛋白体系中也得到验证，可为开发环境敏感型荧光标记物、优化STED纳米显微术的分辨率提供设计参考。
title: Increasing fluorescence lifetime for resolution improvement in stimulated emission depletion nanoscopy

summary_zh: 本研究提出一种用于下肢辅助外骨骼的曲柄滑块串联弹性执行器，通过独特的曲柄滑块机构与内置线性弹簧组实现非线性物理阻抗特性，以提升力矩输出效果并实现高透明度。为精确控制输出力矩，设计了基于径向基函数的滑模控制器，并引入自适应神经模糊滑模控制律，通过理论分析验证了其稳定性。实验结果表明，该执行器具备精确的力控性能。将其集成至膝关节外骨骼样机并开展人体穿戴实验，结果证实系统在与穿戴者交互过程中能够实现柔顺透明与力矩辅助的精准控制，适用于需要紧凑关节模块与高质量物理交互的下肢辅助场景。
title: Novel Design and Control of a Crank-Slider Series Elastic Actuated Knee Exoskeleton for Compliant Human–Robot Interaction

summary_zh: 本文系统回顾了中国近岸海底地下水排泄（SGD）研究进展，聚焦不同生态系统（海湾、河口、陆架和潟湖）中地下水镭同位素与营养盐特征、SGD速率及其营养盐输入通量。结果表明，河口区域地下水中溶解无机氮、溶解无机磷和溶解无机硅含量、SGD速率以及SGD输入的溶解无机氮与溶解无机磷中位数均显著高于其他三类生态系统，这主要归因于河口水动力条件复杂且受人类活动影响强烈；而大尺度陆架系统的SGD速率及三种无机营养盐输入通量均为最低。在海岸带整体尺度上，SGD及其营养盐输送量不亚于河流输入，对近岸海域营养盐收支平衡、营养盐结构及初级生产力具有显著调控作用。最后，文章从SGD精准评估、环境效应和调控策略三方面提出未来研究方向，为近岸生态环境管理与保护提供科学依据。
title: 中国近岸海底地下水排泄 (SGD) 研究进展

summary_zh: GN2是一种基于Transformer架构的喷注味标记算法，由ATLAS合作组部署，用于在大型强子对撞机的质子-质子碰撞中识别源自重味夸克的喷注。该算法采用端到端架构直接处理低层级径迹信息，并引入物理启发的辅助训练目标，以增强可解释性和性能。在仿真与碰撞数据中均验证了其有效性：在70%的b喷注标记效率下，数据中测得的c喷注排斥因子提升至3.5倍，轻喷注排斥因子提升至1.8倍，较先前算法显著改善。GN2为涉及重味喷注的物理分析带来实质性增益，例如希格斯玻色子对产生测量以及底夸克和粲夸克与希格斯玻色子耦合的研究，展示了先进机器学习方法在实验粒子物理中的影响力。
title: Transforming jet flavour tagging at ATLAS

summary_zh: 3D目标检测是自动驾驶领域的一项基础且关键的任务。本文提出了一种名为自蒸馏内省数据（SID）的新型自蒸馏范式，旨在提升基于激光雷达（LiDAR）以及激光雷达-摄像头融合场景下的3D目标检测精度。该方法通过内省式数据增强技术，利用几何或语义注入来丰富稀疏点云中的目标感知信息，并以此训练出一个具有极高判别能力的教师模型。与依赖大型模型来增强小模型表示能力的传统蒸馏方法不同，SID中的教师模型与学生模型采用相同的架构，从而能够更有效地将丰富的特征表示迁移至学生模型。在基于激光雷达的检测任务中，SID显著增强了稀疏点云的语义表示能力；在激光雷达-摄像头融合任务中，该方法能有效监督特征层面的模态融合，确保更合理的跨模态学习。在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上的广泛实验表明，SID能显著提升多种检测器的性能。在基于激光雷达的检测器上，SID在KITTI困难目标上的mAP提升了2.31%，在nuScenes上的NDS提升了1.76%；在融合检测器上，其在KITTI上的mAP提升了1.5%，在nuScenes上的NDS提升了2.15%。
title: Boosting 3D Object Detection via Self-distilling Introspective Data
venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems

summary_zh: 本研究采用有限差分数值模拟方法，探讨了勒夫波在黏弹性垂直横向各向同性层状介质中的传播特性。通过与各向同性弹性及黏弹性介质的理论地震图对比，验证了模拟方案的精度；利用各向同性或各向异性弹性及黏弹性介质中勒夫波的理论相速度频散曲线，进一步确认了模拟结果的正确性。在双层半空间模型中，通过对比各向异性弹性、各向同性黏弹性及各向异性黏弹性介质与各向同性弹性介质的模拟结果，系统分析了速度各向异性、黏弹性及衰减各向异性对勒夫波的影响。随后，模拟了三种典型四层半空间模型中的勒夫波，以深入剖析各向异性黏弹性层状介质中勒夫波的特征。结果表明，在各向异性黏弹性介质中传播的勒夫波同时受介质各向异性和黏弹性的共同作用。介质的速度各向异性导致勒夫波相速度的数值和分布范围发生显著变化；介质的黏弹性引起勒夫波振幅衰减和相速度频散，且这些效应随品质因子的降低而增强；介质的衰减各向异性则表明其黏弹性程度具有方向依赖性。相速度比值对比显示，黏弹性引起的勒夫波相速度变化程度远小于速度各向异性所导致的变化。
title: Finite-Difference Modeling and Characteristics Analysis of Love Waves in Anisotropic-Viscoelastic Media
venue: Bulletin of the Seismological Society of America

summary_zh: 智能手机即时检验技术使患者无需依赖实验室即可由医生或自行完成诊断，其核心工具为生物传感器。传统生物传感器体积庞大、操作复杂，仅能在特定条件下使用。当前发展的智能手机生物传感器通过便携式连接，使操作者可随时随地进行多种检测并整合数据。这类设备贴近患者，有助于长期疾病监测并促进患者主动参与健康管理。可穿戴生物传感器因其精准性、低成本和高可及性被视为医疗健康领域的未来方向。最新进展包括集成智能手机摄像头的光学生物传感器，以及用于识别体液中生物标志物的手机附件，这些技术有望降低医学诊断服务成本并扩大全球医疗覆盖范围。
title: Smartphone-based analytical biosensors

summary_zh: 信号-车辆协同控制在提升城市交通效率方面具有巨大潜力，但现有研究往往基于理想通信条件的假设，忽略了车路协同（V2I）通信质量对控制性能的影响，且缺乏对路侧单元（RSU）部署方案的有效评估。针对上述问题，本文研究了非理想通信环境下的信号-车辆协同控制建模及RSU部署评估方法。首先，本文构建了能够表征RSU与联网车辆（CV）间通信缺陷的通信模型；其次，提出了一种集成信号控制优化与联网车队速度优化策略的协同控制模型；最后，引入了一套系统的评估方法，以车辆延误减少量作为控制性能指标，并结合通信覆盖范围内的车辆数、连接概率、速度优化车辆数、速度调整次数、绿灯延长时长及RSU通信域重叠率等多个观测指标，定量分析RSU部署参数对控制效果的影响。仿真实验结果表明，该模型在低、中、高不同交通流量场景下均能实现有效的信号-车辆协同控制，并揭示了通信距离、指令传输周期、安装位置及RSU数量等部署参数对控制性能的具体影响规律。
title: Signal-Vehicle Coordination Control Modeling and Roadside Unit Deployment Evaluation under V2I Communication Environment

summary_zh: 本文通过一锅法无金属多组分聚合，以二乙炔酯、苯甲醛和苯胺衍生物为单体，成功合成了一系列聚(1,4-二氢吡啶)（PDHPs）。该类聚合物不含传统发光单元，却借助不同尺寸簇结构的空间共轭效应，获得了可调的三重态能级。大而致密的簇能有效延长磷光波长，三重态激子可在二苯甲酮刚性基质中稳定存在，从而实现室温磷光。该非共轭聚合物簇的磷光发射波长可达645 nm。结合静态与动态激光光散射技术，揭示了基质熔体中簇结构的形成信息。此外，通过改变激发波长、浓度及客体聚合物分子量，可便捷调控其荧光与磷光发射。该工作为设计聚合物主客体体系提供了独特视角，并为长波长磷光材料的开发开辟了新策略。
title: Clusterization-Triggered Color-Tunable Room-Temperature Phosphorescence from 1,4-Dihydropyridine-Based Polymers

abstract: Learning an expressive representation from multi-view data is a key step in various real-world applications. In this paper, we propose a semi-supervised multi-view deep discriminant representation learning (SMDDRL) approach. Unlike existing joint or alignment multi-view representation learning methods that cannot simultaneously utilize the consensus and complementary properties of multi-view data to learn inter-view shared and intra-view specific representations, SMDDRL comprehensively exploits the consensus and complementary properties as well as learns both shared and specific representations by employing the shared and specific representation learning network. Unlike existing shared and specific multi-view representation learning methods that ignore the redundancy problem in representation learning, SMDDRL incorporates the orthogonality and adversarial similarity constraints to reduce the redundancy of learned representations. Moreover, to exploit the information contained in unlabeled data, we design a semi-supervised learning framework by combining deep metric learning and density clustering. Experimental results on three typical multi-view learning tasks, i.e., webpage classification, image classification, and document classification demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
title: Semi-supervised Multi-view Deep Discriminant Representation Learning
venue: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence

abstract: Spin echo is a powerful technique to extend atomic or nuclear coherence times by overcoming the dephasing due to inhomogeneous broadenings. However, there are disputes about the feasibility of applying this technique to an ensemble-based quantum memory at the single-quanta level. In this experimental study, we find that noise due to imperfections of the rephasing pulses has both intense superradiant and weak isotropic parts. By properly arranging the beam directions and optimizing the pulse fidelities, we successfully manage to operate the spin echo technique in the quantum regime by observing nonclassical photon-photon correlations as well as the quantum behavior of retrieved photons. Our work for the first time demonstrates the feasibility of harnessing the spin echo method to extend the lifetime of ensemble-based quantum memories at the single-quanta level.
summary_zh: 自旋回波技术是克服非均匀展宽导致的退相干、延长原子或核相干时间的有效手段，但其在单量子水平下应用于系综量子存储器的可行性此前仍存在争议。本研究通过实验发现，重聚焦脉冲缺陷所产生的噪声包含强超辐射部分和弱各向同性部分。通过精确调整光束方向并优化脉冲保真度，研究团队成功在量子态领域实现了自旋回波技术的运行，并观测到了非经典的光子-光子相关性以及检索光子的量子行为。该工作首次证明了利用自旋回波方法在单量子水平上延长系综量子存储器寿命的可行性，为量子存储技术的进一步发展提供了重要实验依据。
title: Operating Spin Echo in the Quantum Regime for an Atomic-Ensemble Quantum Memory

summary_zh: 我们提出一种基于多体量子干涉与周期性多脉冲序列的纠缠增强锁定放大器方案，用于在强噪声环境中高精度检测时变信号。传统锁定放大器依赖已知载波频率提取交变信号，而本方案在量子干涉的询问阶段引入周期性多π脉冲序列，将多体量子系统构建为量子锁定放大器。理论分析表明，通过选择适当的输入态和读出操作，可利用布居数测量同时提取未知交变场的频率和幅度。特别地，若采用自旋猫态作为输入并结合基于相互作用的读出操作，频率和幅度的测量精度均可逼近海森堡极限。此外，该多体量子放大器对极端随机噪声具有鲁棒性。本研究为利用多体量子系统测量时变信号开辟了新方向，并为实现海森堡极限精度的交变信号检测提供了可行途径。
title: Many-Body Quantum Lock-In Amplifier

summary_zh: 本研究通过对中国鄂尔多斯盆地靖边气田附近三个剖面的土壤磁性测量（磁化率及磁滞参数）与土壤烃类分析，探讨了磁异常（如体积磁化率k）与油气渗漏环境之间的关系。研究结果表明，土壤磁化率与土壤气中的烃类浓度之间存在显著的正相关性，且磁化率异常与烃类异常的空间分布特征与气田分布高度吻合。矿物学分析进一步发现，高磁化率土壤中的磁性矿物主要为磁铁矿，且与低磁化率样本相比，其钛元素的替代程度极低。上述结果为油气渗漏诱发高磁性矿物形成提供了有力证据。该研究表明，识别此类由渗漏引起的磁异常特征，可为国内外油气勘探提供有效的辅助手段。
title: Relationship between magnetic anomalies and hydrocarbon microseepage above the Jingbian gas field, Ordos basin, China

summary_zh: 富含半胱氨酸-组氨酸的新型蛋白（PINCH）是一种仅含LIM结构域的接头蛋白，在细胞骨架组织、细胞外基质粘附、迁移、增殖及存活过程中发挥关键作用。哺乳动物细胞中存在两种具有功能的PINCH蛋白，即PINCH1和PINCH2。研究表明，PINCH不仅能结合Nck2并参与生长因子受体的信号转导，还能与整合素连接激酶（ILK）及parvin形成三元复合物（即IPP复合物）。在正常生理状态下，IPP复合物定位于粘附斑，参与整合素信号传导，并介导细胞骨架与细胞外基质之间的相互作用。现有证据表明，PINCH信号通路的异常与癌症、肾脏疾病、心肌病及艾滋病毒感染等多种重要疾病的发病机制密切相关。因此，深入阐明PINCH的功能及其与关键因子的相互作用机制，对于理解健康状态及疾病过程中的细胞信号转导事件具有重要意义。
title: Signaling via PINCH: Functions, binding partners and implications in human diseases

abstract: This paper proposes an accurate model for yarn-based embroidered coil antenna used in Near Field Communication (NFC) applications. Traditionally, the inductance of a coil-shaped antenna is calculated using the Wheeler's equation, while accurate enough for metallic coil geometries, the results from Wheeler's equation have more than 20% errors when being applied to yarn-based embroidered antennas. We have discovered that this discrepancy is related to the parasitic capacitance, which is caused by the subtle gaps along twisted fibers. Experiments demonstrate that the parasitic capacitance has significant impact on the overall performances of the coil antenna. In this paper, an equivalent model for yarn-based coils is proposed to take into account of the parasitic capacitance and antenna geometrical characteristics. Compared with traditional Wheeler's equation, the inductance calculated from this proposed model is within 5% from the measured value. Additionally, the electromagnetic performance of the embroidered coil is resilient to mechanical deformation. When being used as a coupling antenna, it can harvest energy and power-up the NFC-based platform for body-area-network applications.
title: Characterization and Modeling of Embroidered NFC Coil Antennas for Wearable Applications

abstract: Robot-assisted vascular interventional surgery changes the surgeons’ original operation, which affects their judgment and surgical safety. Therefore, the reliable safety method for robot-assisted surgery is practically valuable. However, the existing active safety methods have two challenges: the difficulty in setting inserting force thresholds suitable for the current vascular environment and the response delay caused by program processing. The paper improved a SEA(series elastic actuator)-based guidewire manipulator with an adjustable grasping force function. A multifunctional finger pulp was designed to measure the guidewire inserting force and perceive the manipulating state between fingers simultaneously. Then, an orthogonal force coupling model based on the mechanical-molecular friction theory was established to demonstrate the friction mechanism of cylindrical surgical instruments grasped by elastic grasping surfaces. Based on the model, a passive safety method was proposed to adjust the grasping force autonomously, which can satisfy the inserting force requirements of the phase delivery task and control the safety threshold suitable for the current environment. The evaluation experimental results demonstrated that the designed robot system could manipulate the guidewire accurately. Then the friction experiments verified the designed orthogonal force coupling model. Finally, the in vitro experiments were performed to demonstrated that the designed passive safety method can automatically adjust the grasping force based on the inserting states of the guidewire, reduce the contact force with the vessels, and ensure surgical safety in real-time.
title: Grasping Force-based Passive Safety Method for a Vascular Interventional Surgery Robot System
venue: IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement

summary_zh: 本研究系统评估了利用GRACE重力卫星数据反演南极与格陵兰冰盖质量平衡的多种算法性能。基于欧洲空间局气候变化倡议项目框架，首次公开征集并对比了不同研究团队生成的冰盖质量平衡产品，评估过程采用实际GRACE月解数据和合成数据集双重验证。针对2003年2月至2013年12月时段，各算法估算的南极冰盖线性质量变化趋势介于每年-990亿至-1080亿吨之间，格陵兰冰盖趋势则介于每年-2520亿至-2740亿吨之间。分析表明，当研究尺度缩小至更小的流域盆地或网格化产品时，不同算法结果间的离散度显著增大。该对比实验的结论为后续气候变化倡议项目中冰盖质量平衡产品的算法遴选提供了科学依据，确保了最终产品的可靠性。
title: Evaluating GRACE Mass Change Time Series for the Antarctic and Greenland Ice Sheet—Methods and Results

abstract: In this paper, a vehicular dual-band reflectarray antenna (RA) designed for sub-terahertz (sub-THz) communication systems is proposed, offering switchable single-beam and asymmetrical dual-beam deflection. The antenna unit cell (UC) adopts a center-edge dual-band configuration, fabricated on a three-layer stacked substrate with varying thicknesses and dielectric constants. This configuration ensures superior reflection amplitude and facilitates a phase shift exceeding 360°. A RA consisting of the proposed 21×21 UCs is developed by integrating a tailored phase compensation equation. Experimental results show that under X-polarized excitation, the RA achieves a single-beam deflection of +20° with a peak gain of 19.1 dBi in the lower frequency band (145-155 GHz, 6.7% bandwidth). Furthermore, an asymmetrical dual-beam deflection at +20° and -10° with a gain of 16.8 dBi is realized in the same band. Under Y-polarized excitation, the RA demonstrates a -10° single-beam deflection with a high gain of 22.5 dBi in the upper frequency band (165-180 GHz, 10% bandwidth). With its dual-band reconfigurable beam-steering capability, the proposed RA is ideal for dynamic, high-performance vehicular sub-THz communication applications.
title: A Dual-Band Sub-Terahertz Reflectarray Antenna With Reconfigurable Beamforming for Vehicular Communication Systems
venue: IEEE Transactions on Antennas and Propagation

abstract: The out-of-time-ordered correlators (OTOC), a fundamental concept for quantifying quantum information scrambling, has recently been suggested to be an order parameter to dynamically detect both equilibrium quantum phase transitions (EQPTs) and dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPTs). Here we report the first experimental observation of EQPTs and DQPTs in a quantum spin chain via quench dynamics of OTOC on a nuclear magnetic resonance quantum simulator. We observe that the quench dynamics of the OTOC can unambiguously detect the DQPTs and the equilibrium critical point, while conventional order parameters such as the longitudinal magnetization can not. Moreover, we investigate the two-body correlations throughout the quench dynamics, and find that OTOC can extract the equilibrium critical point with higher accuracy and is more robust to decoherence than that of two-body correlation. Our experiment paves a way for experimentally investigating DQPTs through OTOCs and for studying the EQPTs through the nonequilibrium quantum quench dynamics with quantum simulators.
title: Experimental Observation of Equilibrium and Dynamical Quantum Phase Transitions via Out-of-Time-Ordered Correlators

abstract: An alternative method is proposed for constructing the coupling matrix of a filter having a transfer function with non-paraconjugate transmission zeros. The conversion formulas from the scattering matrix to the admittance matrix are derived under the only conditions of passiveness, losslessness and reciprocity. The main benefit of this method is that it allows, for the first time, to design all-pass filters using the coupling matrix technique.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种用于构建滤波器耦合矩阵的替代方法，适用于传输函数包含非仿共轭传输零点的情形。在仅满足无源性、无耗性和互易性的条件下，推导了从散射矩阵到导纳矩阵的转换公式。该方法的主要优势在于首次实现了利用耦合矩阵技术设计全通滤波器。
title: Alternative Construction of the Coupling Matrix of Filters With Non-Paraconjugate Transmission Zeros
venue: IEEE Microwave and Wireless Components Letters

abstract: In this paper, we present a synchronization approach to trajectory tracking of multiple mobile robots while maintaining time-varying formations. The main idea is to control each robot to track its desired trajectory while synchronizing its motion with those of other robots to keep relative kinematics relationships, as required by the formation. First, we pose the formation-control problem as a synchronization control problem and identify the synchronization control goal according to the formation requirement. The formation error is measured by the position synchronization error, which is defined based on the established robot network. Second, we develop a synchronous controller for each robot's translation to guarantee that both position and synchronization errors approach zero asymptotically. The rotary controller is also designed to ensure that the robot is always oriented toward its desired position. Both translational and rotary controls are supported by a centralized high-level planer for task monitoring and robot global localization. Finally, we perform simulations and experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed synchronization control approach in the formation control tasks.
title: A Synchronization Approach to Trajectory Tracking of Multiple Mobile Robots While Maintaining Time-Varying Formations

summary_zh: 我们提出了一种名为比较通路整合器（CPI）的元分析整合工具，旨在解决多研究联合分析中的通路富集冗余与跨条件比较难题。CPI 采用自适应加权 Fisher 方法，从多个转录组研究中识别一致性和差异性的通路富集模式；同时引入紧凑聚类算法，对来自多个公共数据库的通路进行去冗余处理，将高度重叠的通路归并为代表性簇，以降低解释负担。此外，CPI 还集成了文本挖掘算法，自动提取通路簇的关键功能主题，辅助生物学解释。为验证工具的有效性，我们将 CPI 应用于六项精神疾病转录组研究的联合分析，成功识别出既有文献支持的已知功能通路，也发现了新的差异富集模式，展示了其在复杂疾病跨研究整合中的发现能力。CPI 以 R 包形式发布，可通过 Github 仓库 metaOmics/MetaPath 获取。该工具适用于需要同时比较多种疾病状态或实验条件下基因表达调控机制的系统生物学与生物医学研究场景。
title: Comparative Pathway Integrator: A Framework of Meta-Analytic Integration of Multiple Transcriptomic Studies for Consensual and Differential Pathway Analysis

summary_zh: 本文针对知识图谱问答中歧义表达下的主题实体识别、自然语言语义表示及答案搜索空间高效构建等挑战，提出一种面向复杂问题的综合方法。在主题实体识别阶段，构建深度转移模型提取主题实体，并设计结合字符匹配与实体消歧模型的高效实体链接策略。在候选路径排序阶段，提出动态候选路径生成算法以高效构建候选答案集，同时设计四种专用相似度计算模型，分别处理长序列与多样化表达等复杂问句的精细条件，并通过融合策略决策最终正确答案。在CCKS2019竞赛的中文知识库问答数据集CKBQA上进行评估，实验结果表明各环节的改进均有效，整体方法性能优于该竞赛最佳团队。
title: Knowledge Graph Question Answering with semantic oriented fusion model

summary_zh: 本文提出Fast-LCM，一种面向大规模土地覆盖制图的可扩展弱监督方法，部署于新一代神威超级计算机，无需人工标注即可完成分类。方法包含两个核心模块：一是距离引导的k均值聚类，融合纹理、光谱与时相特征；二是基于自动投票的合并策略，为每个聚类赋予符合分类体系的真实语义。通过精细的并行化设计，Fast-LCM可扩展至超过3800万核，在中国土地覆盖制图任务中实现持续高性能。仅用3分钟即生成全国10米分辨率土地覆盖图，其中I/O耗时1.2分钟，计算仅需55秒。在25类分类体系下，总体精度达68.85%，较现有最佳产品提升3.64至7.05个百分点。该方法适用于大范围快速土地覆盖遥感制图场景。
title: Achieving 10m China Land Cover Mapping within Three Minutes Using a New Sunway Supercomputer
venue: IGARSS 2023 - 2023 IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium. Cite URL

summary_zh: 本研究探索了利用光电容积脉搏波描记信号结合深度卷积神经网络进行多类别心律失常分类的可行性。研究同步采集了接受射频消融术的心律失常患者的心电图与光电容积脉搏波信号，构建了一个基于10秒光电容积脉搏波波形的深度卷积神经网络模型，用于区分多种心律类型。以两位心内科医师基于心电图结果标注的心律失常节律为金标准，通过计算微平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积、总体准确率、敏感性、特异性及阳性与阴性预测值来评估分类性能。研究共纳入228例患者，使用了118,217对10秒光电容积脉搏波与心电图波形。在包含45例患者、23,384个光电容积脉搏波波形的独立测试集上验证时，该深度卷积神经网络对窦性心律、室性早搏、房性早搏、室性心动过速、室上性心动过速及心房颤动六种心律类型实现了85.0%的总体分类准确率，微平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积达0.978，平均敏感性、特异性、阳性预测值和阴性预测值分别为75.8%、96.9%、75.2%和97.0%。研究结果表明，利用深度学习技术从光电容积脉搏波信号中分类多种心律失常具有可行性，该方法适用于大规模人群筛查，并在心律失常的长期监测与管理方面展现出应用前景。
title: Multiclass Arrhythmia Detection and Classification From Photoplethysmography Signals Using a Deep Convolutional Neural Network
venue: Journal of the American Heart Association

abstract: Deuterium labeling is of great value in organic synthesis and the pharmaceutical industry. However, the state-of-the-art C-H/C-D exchange using noble metal catalysts or strong bases/acids suffers from poor functional group tolerances, poor selectivity and lack of scope for generating molecular complexity. Herein, we demonstrate the deuteration of halides using heavy water as the deuteration reagent and porous CdSe nanosheets as the catalyst. The deuteration mechanism involves the generation of highly active carbon and deuterium radicals via photoinduced electron transfer from CdSe to the substrates, followed by tandem radicals coupling process, which is mechanistically distinct from the traditional methods involving deuterium cations or anions. Our deuteration strategy shows better selectivity and functional group tolerances than current C-H/C-D exchange methods. Extending the synthetic scope, deuterated boronic acids, halides, alkynes, and aldehydes can be used as synthons in Suzuki coupling, Click reaction, C-H bond insertion reaction etc. for the synthesis of complex deuterated molecules.
title: Controllable deuteration of halogenated compounds by photocatalytic D2O splitting

summary_zh: 氢迁移是加氢反应中的关键过程。过去几十年中，表面氧一直被认为是氢迁移的主要途径，但还原反应可能生成水并抑制迁移。因此，通过精准的表面修饰来延长氢迁移路径，有望提升加氢反应活性，但这仍是一个挑战。本研究以萨巴蒂尔反应为模型反应，该反应的催化性能高度依赖氢迁移活性。通过在基准Ni/CeO2催化剂上修饰少量不可还原的烷基硅烷，氢的活化、迁移及整体加氢反应均得到显著增强。借助萨巴蒂尔反应的放热特性，在纯太阳能驱动下，实现了CO2单程转化率99.9%、甲烷选择性接近100%的优异性能，户外实际运行时能量转换效率约25.0%。催化剂表面氢的迁移方式决定了反应生成目标产物的效率，本研究表明，精细的表面调控可大幅促进氢流动，从而实现高效太阳能驱动的二氧化碳甲烷化转化。
title: Alkylsilane-extended hydrogen migration enhanced photothermal Sabatier reaction

abstract: Eucommia ulmoides Oliver is a native plant and valuable tonic Chinese medicine in China with a long history, great economic value and comprehensive development potential. Traditionally, the comprehensive utilization rate of E. ulmoides Oliv. is still very low, only bark has been used as medicine and other parts of Eucommia ulmoides Oliv. cannot be fully utilized, even the leaves have been well utilized in food products in Japan in the past decades. In order to improve the comprehensive utilization efficiency of E. ulmoides Oliv., in this review, we summarized the varieties and contents of main active compounds, biological functions and pharmacological effects in different parts of E. ulmoides Oliv. The findings suggest that other parts of E. ulmoides Oliv. could replace the bark of E. ulmoides Oliv. to some extent besides of their respective applications. The unique and extensive physiological functions between different parts of E. ulmoides Oliv. indicate that the comprehensive utilization of E. ulmoides Oliv. has a wide space to develop, which is also an effective way to protect E. ulmoides Oliv. resources and improve its the utilization rate. Keywords: Eucommia ulmoides Oliver, Comprehensive utilization, Chemical constituents, Biological functions, Pharmacological effects
title: Biological Functions and Pharmacological Effects for Comprehensive Utilization of Eucommia ulmoides Oliver

abstract: We report the observation of symmetric fission in doubly charged Fe-S cluster anions, $[{\mathrm{F}\mathrm{e}}_{4}{\mathrm{S}}_{4}{X}_{4}{]}^{2\ensuremath{-}}\ensuremath{\rightarrow}2[{\mathrm{F}\mathrm{e}}_{2}{\mathrm{S}}_{2}{X}_{2}{]}^{\ensuremath{-}}$ ($X=\mathrm{C}\mathrm{l},\mathrm{B}\mathrm{r}$), owing to both Coulomb repulsion and antiferromagnetic coupling. Photoelectron spectroscopy shows that both the parent and the fission fragments have similar electronic structures and confirms the inverted energy schemes due to the strong spin polarization of the Fe $3d$ levels. The current observation provides direct confirmation for the unusual spin couplings in the $[{\mathrm{F}\mathrm{e}}_{4}{\mathrm{S}}_{4}{X}_{4}{]}^{2\ensuremath{-}}$ clusters, which contain two valent-delocalized and ferromagnetically coupled ${\mathrm{F}\mathrm{e}}_{2}{\mathrm{S}}_{2}$ subunits.
summary_zh: 本研究报道了双电荷铁硫簇阴离子[Fe₄S₄X₄]²⁻（X=Cl, Br）的对称裂变现象，其裂变路径为[Fe₄S₄X₄]²⁻→2[Fe₂S₂X₂]⁻。该过程由库仑排斥与反铁磁耦合共同驱动。通过光电子能谱分析发现，母体簇与裂变碎片具有相似的电子结构，并证实了因铁3d能级强自旋极化导致的能级反转现象。这一观测结果为[Fe₄S₄X₄]²⁻簇中独特的自旋耦合机制提供了直接证据，即该类簇合物包含两个价电子离域且铁磁耦合的Fe₂S₂亚单元。该发现深化了对铁硫簇电子结构与磁相互作用的理解，在仿生催化、分子磁体及自旋电子学等领域具有潜在应用价值。
title: Coulomb- and Antiferromagnetic-Induced Fission in Doubly Charged Cubelike Fe-S Clusters

summary_zh: 本文利用高频电力消费数据，量化并比较了新冠疫情对中国东部地区不同行业的经济冲击。研究采用双重差分估计模型，对多阶段公共卫生措施的影响进行因果分析，数据涵盖2019至2020年东部96个区县，涉及三大经济部门及其53个子行业。结果表明，除信息传输行业外，所有行业的电力需求在经历初期冲击后均出现反弹，并在2020年5月底管控措施放松后恢复至疫情前趋势。应急响应作为特定时期内各项防疫措施的综合体，对所有行业均产生影响，且响应级别越高、人员流动管控越严，电力消费和生产下降幅度越大。疫情暴发对行业存在负向滞后效应，而对人员流动依赖较低的经济生产与活动，其行业韧性更强。该研究为评估突发公共卫生事件下不同产业的经济恢复能力提供了量化依据。
title: Electricity-consumption data reveals the economic impact and industry recovery during the pandemic X Wang

summary_zh: 本文提出了一种硫掺杂氧化铋与碳纳米管复合的电催化剂（S-Bi₂O₃-CNT），用于高效电化学二氧化碳还原制甲酸盐。通过调控硫掺杂量，最优样品S2-Bi₂O₃-CNT（硫掺杂量0.7 at.%）在宽电流密度范围（2.77–48.6 mA cm⁻²）内均表现出超过90%的甲酸盐法拉第效率，并在−0.9 V电位下达到最高97.06%的法拉第效率。性能提升主要归因于硫掺杂引入的快速电子转移、增强的CO₂吸附能力以及更多低配位铋活性位点。密度泛函理论计算进一步揭示，硫掺杂导致铋的电子离域，有利于关键中间体*CO₂和*HCOO的结合，同时削弱*H的吸附从而显著抑制析氢副反应，这是实现高电流密度和高选择性的根本原因。该研究为在原子尺度调控电催化CO₂还原性能提供了有效策略。
title: Electronic Delocalization of Bismuth Oxide Induced by Sulfur Doping for Efficient CO2 Electroreduction to Formate

abstract: Aggregate is one of the most extensive existing modes of matters in the world. Besides the research objectives of inanimate systems in physical science, the entities in life science can be regarded as living aggregates, which are far from being thoroughly understood despite the great advances in molecular biology. Molecular biology follows the research philosophy of reductionism, which generally reduces the whole into parts to study. Although reductionism benefits the understanding of molecular behaviors, it encounters limitations when extending to the aggregate level. Holism is another epistemology comparable to reductionism, which studies objectives at the aggregate level, emphasizing the interactions and synergetic/antagonistic effects of a group of composed single entities in determining the characteristics of a whole. As a representative of holism, aggregation-induced emission (AIE) materials have made great achievements in the past two decades in both physical and life science. In particular, the unique properties of AIE materials endow them with in situ and real-time visual methods to investigate the inconsistency between microscopic molecules and macroscopic substances, offering researchers excellent toolkits to study living aggregates. The applications of AIE materials in life science are still in their infancy and worth expanding. In this Perspective, we summarize the research progress of AIE materials in unveiling some phenomena and processes of living systems, aiming to provide a general research approach from the viewpoint of holism. At last, insights into what we can do in the near future are also raised and discussed.
title: A Holistic Perspective on Living Aggregate
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

summary_zh: 针对心肌梗死体内干细胞治疗中难以兼顾微创注射、高细胞留存率及动物存活率的挑战，本研究提出了一种新型细胞递送策略。研究人员将预分化为早期心肌谱系的诱导多能干细胞聚集成团，并将其封装在一种具有生物相容性且可生物降解的微基质中，从而实现了高效的注射递送。实验结果表明，与传统的单细胞注射方式相比，该微基质封装技术将注射细胞的存活率提升了六倍以上，并能有效防止畸胎瘤的形成。此外，得益于微基质产生的局部免疫抑制效应以及注射细胞诱导的原位心肌再生能力，该方法显著改善了心肌梗死动物的心功能并提高了其生存率，为心肌修复提供了有效的临床转化思路。
title: Bioengineering of injectable encapsulated aggregates of pluripotent stem cells for therapy of myocardial infarction

summary_zh: 常微分方程（ODEs）被广泛应用于模拟生物网络的动态特性。然而，受限于生物网络的复杂性以及定量实验数据的匮乏，如何准确估算这些模型的动力学参数仍是一项极具挑战性的任务。本文提出了一种名为微分模拟退火（DSA）的新型全局优化算法，旨在实现生物网络模型动力学参数的高效、稳健估算。研究人员利用BioModels数据库中规模从少量参数到数百个参数不等的95个模型对DSA进行了测试，并将其与包括确定性和随机优化算法在内的五种主流算法进行了对比。实验结果表明，DSA在整个数据集中的成功率最高，尤其在处理大规模模型时表现优异。进一步的分析证实，DSA在参数估算的准确性与计算效率方面均优于所对比的其他五种算法。
title: Differential simulated annealing: a robust and efficient global optimization algorithm for parameter estimation of biological networks

abstract: Lexically constrained neural machine translation (NMT), which leverages pre-specified translation to constrain NMT, has practical significance in interactive translation and NMT domain adaption. Previous work either modify the decoding algorithm or train the model on augmented dataset. These methods suffer from either high computational overheads or low copying success rates. In this paper, we investigate Att-Input and Att-Output, two alignment-based constrained decoding methods. These two methods revise the target tokens during decoding based on word alignments derived from encoder-decoder attention weights. Our study shows that Att-Input translates better while Att-Output is more computationally efficient. Capitalizing on both strengths, we further propose EAM-Output by introducing an explicit alignment module (EAM) to a pretrained Transformer. It decodes similarly as EAM-Output, except using alignments derived from the EAM. We leverage the word alignments induced from Att-Input as labels and train the EAM while keeping the parameters of the Transformer frozen. Experiments on WMT16 De-En and WMT16 Ro-En show the effectiveness of our approaches on constrained NMT. In particular, the proposed EAM-Output method consistently outperforms previous approaches in translation quality, with light computational overheads over unconstrained baseline.
title: Lexically Constrained Neural Machine Translation with Explicit Alignment Guidance
