venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

summary_zh: 本研究针对粤港澳大湾区医疗资源分布不均与人口聚集导致的就医可达性难题，构建了一套基于互联网地图精确位置服务的高精度医疗设施数据集，共涵盖54,902个站点。在此基础上，提出了一种融合设施地理坐标与人口密度数据的实时驾车路径规划框架，用于量化居民就医可达性。分析结果显示，在30分钟驾车范围内，6.7%的人口（约480万人）无法抵达任何医疗机构；即使纳入农村诊所，仍有2.5%的人口（约180万人）无法获得医疗服务，主要集中在湾区外围城市。通过模拟新增12家医院的场景，验证了合理选址对改善就医可达性的显著效果。该研究揭示了医疗资源配置的关键短板，可为优化分级诊疗体系下的设施布局提供决策依据，其方法框架与实证发现对国内其他省份及具有类似医疗体系的国家具有参考价值。
title: Assessment of healthcare accessibility in Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area

summary_zh: 本文针对含电转气站（P2GS）的电-气综合能源系统，提出一种基于纳什谈判理论的协同规划模型。在电力与天然气市场放松管制的背景下，将P2GS、电力系统和天然气系统视为独立参与主体，首次采用合作博弈框架制定三方共赢的规划方案。模型创新性地全面评估了P2GS提供碳排放削减与二次备用辅助服务的盈利潜力，并将其纳入规划决策。以耦合的24节点电力系统和20节点天然气系统为算例，验证了所提方法的有效性，并与传统集中式规划和顺序规划两种典型模型进行对比。仿真结果表明，该模型能够在三个独立参与者之间实现最公平且帕累托最优的收益分配，同时获得良好的综合能源系统整体性能。研究结论表明，所提模型不仅有助于推动电转气技术的推广应用，还能促进P2GS与电力、天然气系统之间的协同合作。
title: Game-theoretic planning for integrated energy system with independent participants considering ancillary services of power-to-gas stations

summary_zh: 针对多孔弹性介质中慢纵波与快纵波、横波共存导致的数值模拟困难，本文提出一种高效有限差分方法。慢纵波速度可比快纵波低一个数量级，其精确捕捉需要极细网格和极小时间步长，大幅增加计算成本。为降低计算量，我们将间断曲线同位网格与非均匀时间步龙格-库塔格式相结合，仅在界面附近慢纵波贡献不可忽略的区域采用细网格和小时间步。非均匀时间步龙格-库塔格式基于泰勒展开推导，能避免不同时间层级间通信所需的插值或外推操作。数值实验验证了该方法的精度与效率，相比采用全局均匀空间网格和均匀时间步的曲线同位网格有限差分法，本方法所需计算资源更少，计算时间显著缩短，适用于含任意界面的地震波场模拟。
title: Discontinuous curvilinear collocated grid combined with nonuniform time step Runge-Kutta scheme for poroelastic finite-difference modeling

abstract: Carbonaceous nanocups attached on free-standing microtubes were prepared and used to trap MoS<sub>2</sub> nanosheets. Excellent cyclability and rate performance were achieved owing to efficient contact between the nanocups, nanosheets and electrolyte.
summary_zh: 通过将碳质纳米杯附着于自支撑微管表面，构建了一种新型复合结构，并利用该结构有效捕获二硫化钼纳米片。碳质纳米杯的独特凹形形貌与微管的开放通道协同作用，显著增大了电极材料与电解液的接触面积，同时为离子和电子的快速传输提供了高效路径。二硫化钼纳米片被牢固限域在纳米杯内，有效抑制了充放电过程中的体积膨胀和结构坍塌，从而大幅提升了电极的结构稳定性。电化学测试表明，该复合材料展现出优异的循环稳定性和倍率性能，在高电流密度下仍能保持高比容量，循环寿命显著延长。这一设计策略为开发高性能储能器件，如锂离子电池和超级电容器的电极材料，提供了新的结构范式。
title: Nanocups-on-microtubes: a unique host towards high-performance lithium ion batteries

summary_zh: 本研究揭示了微波加热驱动水热合成反应中一种此前未知的直接能量传递机制。传统化学反应依赖外部热源通过介质传导能量，存在效率低、易引发副反应等问题，而微波加热虽以高效著称，但其启动化学反应的具体能量传输路径尚不明确。我们利用原位同步辐射技术，在固液插层反应过程中实时监测所有组分的结构与温度变化，首次严格证实微波辐照源与目标反应物之间存在直接能量传输。该机制大幅减少了能量耗散，从而在低温条件下实现超快反应动力学。这一发现为设计高效、精准的材料合成反应开辟了新方向。
title: Ultrafast solid-liquid intercalation enabled by targeted microwave energy delivery

summary_zh: 我们提出一种快速且高保真度的量子比特初始化方案，无需额外芯片结构即可避免以往方法中存在的测量反馈延迟、串扰或复杂校准等问题。通过调制穿过transmon量子比特的磁通，实现了量子比特与其读取谐振器之间的态交换，在34纳秒内将激发态布居抑制至0.08%±0.08%（若需耗尽谐振器中的光子则为284纳秒）。该方案还能有效耗尽第二激发态，对邻近量子比特的影响可忽略不计，并提供了一种使量子比特与飞行单光子纠缠的途径，在量子通信领域具有应用价值。
title: Rapid and unconditional parametric reset protocol for tunable superconducting qubits

abstract: Photochemical regime for ozone (O3) formation is complicated in the sense that reducing emission of nitrogen oxides (NOx) may increase O3 concentration. The lockdown due to COVID-19 pandemic affords a unique opportunity to use real observations to explore the O3 formation regime and the effectiveness of NOx emission control strategies. In this study, observations from ground networks during the lockdowns were used to assess spatial disparity of the Ratio of Ozone Formation (ROF) for nitrogen dioxide (NO2) reduction in the Greater Bay Area (GBA) of China. The health risk model from Air Quality Health Index (AQHI) system in Hong Kong was adopted to evaluate the risk tradeoffs between NO2 and O3. Results show that the levels of O3 increase and NO2 reduction were comparable due to high ROF values in urban areas of central GBA. The ozone reactivity to NO2 reduction gradually declined outwards from central GBA. Despite the O3 increases, the NOx emission controls reduced the Integrated Health Risk (IHR) of NO2 and O3 in most regions of the GBA. When risk coefficients from the AQHI in Canada or the global review were adopted in the risk analyses, the results are extremely encouraging because the controls of NOx emission reduced the IHR of NO2 and O3 almost everywhere in the GBA. Our results underscore the importance of using a risk-based method to assess the effectiveness of emission control measures and the overall health benefit from NOx emission controls in the GBA.
title: Risk tradeoffs between nitrogen dioxide and ozone pollution during the COVID-19 lockdowns in the Greater Bay area of China

summary_zh: 针对大规模机器学习中并行随机梯度下降算法面临的通信瓶颈，本文提出一种名为DORE的双重残差压缩随机梯度下降算法。随着工作节点数量与模型维度的增加，主节点与工作节点间的梯度聚合和模型同步通信开销成为制约高效训练的主要障碍。DORE算法通过双重残差压缩策略，能够将整体通信量降低95%以上，从而显著缓解这一瓶颈。理论分析表明，该方法在强凸和非凸目标函数条件下均具有优越的收敛性质。实验结果显示，与当前最先进的基线方法相比，DORE在保持相近模型精度和收敛速度的同时，实现了最佳的通信效率。该算法为大规模分布式机器学习训练中的通信优化提供了有效解决方案。
title: A Double Residual Compression Algorithm for Efficient Distributed Learning
venue: International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics

abstract: With the increase of HTTP-based adaptive video streaming over the Internet, multiple clients may compete for a shared bottleneck bandwidth, which brings some damage to the fairness and stability of Quality of Experience (QoE). This paper presents Steward, a system that enforces multi-client joint QoE optimization for bottleneck bandwidth sharing. Joint QoE optimization refers to improving QoE fairness among clients with various video devices and providing differentiated service for clients with different priorities. Steward deploys the adaptive bitrate (ABR) algorithm based on neural networks (NN) and reinforcement learning at the network edge. The ABR agent trains the NN model through experience and makes appropriate bitrate guidance for video chunks to be requested by clients sharing the same bottleneck bandwidth. We compare Steward with state-of-the-art algorithms under different network conditions. Compared with all considered algorithms and conditions, Steward reduces 30%~85% QoE unfairness under the premise of differentiated service.
title: Steward: smart edge based joint QoE optimization for adaptive video streaming.

abstract: A glide-symmetry Goubau line leaky-wave antenna for achieving both high scanning rate and wide scanning angle range is introduced. The novelty of the design is its combination of glide symmetry and a single-layer Goubau line. This combination leads to performance enhancement in both scanning rate and scanning angle range. Utilizing a corrugated Goubau line in a glide-symmetry fashion closes its stopband at the cutoff frequency while slowing down its group velocity. As the dispersion around the closed stopband is shifted to the fast-wave region by periodic profile modulation, the space harmonics exhibit high-scanning-rate radiation. In conjunction with this, the single-layer nature of the Goubau line allows the beam to scan from nearly endfire to backfire directions, leading to a wide scanning angle range. Numerical examples and experimental validation are provided to validate the proposed design. These show that the proposed antenna exhibits dual-band operation, where one band scans 152° within 2.2 GHz (corresponding to scanning rate of 69°/GHz) with 67% efficiency, while the second band scans 145° within 0.7 GHz (corresponding to scanning rate of 207°/GHz) with 26% efficiency. A tradeoff between scanning rate and efficiency always exists in high-scanning-rate leaky-wave antennas. One is able to freely choose the preferred scanning rate in this single antenna. A comparison with other related works shows that the proposed antenna exhibits the best performance.
title: High-Scanning-Rate and Wide-Angle Leaky-Wave Antennas Based on Glide-Symmetry Goubau Line
venue: IEEE Transactions on Antennas and Propagation

abstract: This paper explores Machine Unlearning (MU), an emerging field that is gaining increased attention due to concerns about neural models unintentionally remembering personal or sensitive information. We present SeUL, a novel method that enables selective and fine-grained unlearning for language models. Unlike previous work that employs a fully reversed training objective in unlearning, SeUL minimizes the negative impact on the capability of language models, particularly in terms of generation. Furthermore, we introduce two innovative evaluation metrics, sensitive extraction likelihood (S-EL) and sensitive memorization accuracy (S-MA), specifically designed to assess the effectiveness of forgetting sensitive information. In support of the unlearning framework, we propose efficient automatic online and offline sensitive span annotation methods. The online selection method, based on language probability scores, ensures computational efficiency, while the offline annotation involves a two-stage LLM-based process for robust verification. In summary, this paper contributes a novel selective unlearning method (SeUL), introduces specialized evaluation metrics (S-EL and S-MA) for assessing sensitive information forgetting, and proposes automatic online and offline sensitive span annotation methods to support the overall unlearning framework and evaluation.
title: Selective Forgetting: Advancing Machine Unlearning Techniques and Evaluation in Language Models
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

abstract: Considering the measuring range limitation of a single sensor system, multi-sensor system has become essential in obtaining complete image information of the object in the field of 3D image reconstruction. However, for the traditional multi-sensors worked independently in its system, there was some point in calibrating each sensor system separately. And the calibration between all single sensor systems was complicated and required a long time. In this paper, we present a flexible 3D reconstruction method based on phase-matching in multi-sensor system. While calibrating each sensor, it realizes the data registration of multi-sensor system in a unified coordinate system simultaneously. After all sensors are calibrated, the whole 3D image data directly exist in the unified coordinate system, and there is no need to calibrate the positions between sensors any more. Experimental results prove that the method is simple in operation, accurate in measurement, and fast in 3D image reconstruction.
summary_zh: 针对单传感器系统测量范围受限的问题，多传感器系统在三维图像重建领域已成为获取物体完整图像信息的关键手段。然而，传统多传感器系统各传感器独立工作，需分别标定每个传感器系统，且各单传感器系统之间的标定过程复杂耗时。本文提出一种基于相位匹配的多传感器系统柔性三维重建方法。该方法在标定各传感器的同时，同步实现多传感器系统在统一坐标系下的数据配准。所有传感器标定完成后，整体三维图像数据直接存在于统一坐标系中，无需再进行传感器间位置标定。实验结果表明，该方法操作简便、测量精度高、三维图像重建速度快。
title: Flexible 3D reconstruction method based on phase-matching in multi-sensor system

summary_zh: 飞米小基站（Femtocell）技术能够以低成本解决室内覆盖不足并提升网络容量问题。尽管部分无线服务提供商已推出相关服务，但仍面临诸多挑战。本文深入探讨了宏微异构网络中的业务模式，并根据飞米小基站的不同部署类型，提出了联合部署、无线服务提供商（WSP）部署以及用户部署三种框架。通过对各框架的独特特征、面临的挑战及潜在解决方案进行系统性研究，本文为该领域提供了深入的见解。此外，针对WSP部署框架，本文提出了两种旨在实现WSP收益最大化的方案：第一种方案通过跨层信道分配，协同处理干扰问题与用户需求满足问题；第二种方案则在此基础上进一步考虑了接入不同网络时的最优定价策略。
title: Macro-femto heterogeneous network deployment and management: from business models to technical solutions

abstract: An ad-hoc probabilistic analytical solution for modeling wind farm power output is proposed in this letter. In accordance with the unit impulse function described in signals and systems engineering, and combined with the output power versus wind speed curve with wake effect consideration and the wind speed probability density function (PDF), the PDF of wind farm power output is deduced analytically. The comparisons with Monte Carlo method are given to demonstrate the validity of the proposed model.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于风电场功率输出建模的随机解析解方法。该研究借鉴信号与系统工程中的单位冲激函数理论，通过综合考虑包含尾流效应的风速-功率特性曲线以及风速概率密度函数，实现了风电场功率输出概率密度函数的解析推导。通过与蒙特卡洛模拟方法的对比验证，结果表明该解析模型具有较高的准确性与有效性。该方法为风电场功率预测及随机性建模提供了一种高效的数学工具，在风能资源评估与电力系统稳定性分析领域具有应用价值。
title: An Analytical Solution for Wind Farm Power Output

summary_zh: 我们构建了南加州地壳的三维密度与波速模型，通过联合反演重力异常和地震分量差分相位延迟，并采用全波敏感核建立波速与密度之间的物理关联。与传统依赖经验关系的联合反演不同，该方法不预设波速与密度的经验换算，从而提高了反演的独立性与可靠性。反演获得的密度及纵波与横波波速比揭示了研究区上、中地壳成分变化的关键细节，包括半岛山脉岩基东西两部分边界的三维几何形态、西半岛山脉岩基内辉长岩与变火山岩富集区的位置、科切拉谷下方沉积盆地厚度的空间变化，以及科切拉谷和东半岛山脉之下可能存在的中基性岩基。联合反演的密度与波速比值还表明，在主要断裂带之外，岩性对地震活动具有控制作用。该模型为理解地壳成分结构、演化过程及深部动力学提供了重要约束，尤其适用于无法直接采样的地壳深度范围。
title: Compositional Variation in the Crust of Peninsular Ranges and Surrounding Regions, Southern California, Revealed by Full‐Wave Seismic and Gravity Joint Inversion
venue: Journal of Geophysical Research: Solid Earth

abstract: A multicomponent iterative method is proposed for efficient source reconstruction based on magnitude-only and single-plane near field scanning. Compared with the conventional method filling the multicomponent data into a whole transformation matrix, the multicomponent iterative method can save huge calculation time by evenly reducing the size of the transformation matrix into magnetic group and electric group, without losing solution accuracy of the equivalent dipole moments. The accuracy and efficiency of the proposed source reconstruction is verified on a simulated patch antenna model. The proposed method is also applied to efficiently find the equivalent sources and reconstruct the surface electromagnetic field of a practical serpentine line. For a larger transformation matrix (depending on the factors such as the scanned field components, scanned points, and dipole numbers), the proposed iteration method shows higher efficiency.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于仅幅度单平面近场扫描的多分量迭代源重构方法，旨在高效重建等效源。与传统将多分量数据填充至整体变换矩阵的方法不同，该方法将变换矩阵按磁偶极子群与电偶极子群均匀拆分，从而大幅缩减矩阵规模，在保持等效偶极矩求解精度的同时显著降低计算耗时。通过仿真贴片天线模型验证了所提方法的精度与效率，并将其应用于实际蛇形线的等效源提取与表面电磁场重构。对于规模更大的变换矩阵（受扫描场分量、扫描点数及偶极子数等因素影响），所提迭代方法展现出更高的计算效率。
title: A Multicomponent Iterative Method for Efficient Source Reconstruction Based on Magnitude-Only and Single-Plane Near-Field Scanning

abstract: Most existing domain adaptation methods learn with both (labeled) samples in the source domain and (unlabeled) samples in the target domain. Relying on the availability of target domain samples, however, is not always feasible in real-world applications. In this paper, we propose a new method to address this issue, in which the target domain samples do not need to be available for the task of interest. To improve the performance of such a zero-shot domain adaptation (ZSDA), we learn with not only source samples in the task of interest, but also seek additional assistance from those dual-domain samples in an irrelevant task. To overcome the problems induced by the unavailability of target samples in the task of interest, we exploit the hypothesis that the domain correlation is consistent across tasks and learn to transfer it from the irrelevant task to the task of interest. Specifically, our method aims to learn a domain-invariant representation space in which the source-domain classifier is directly transferable to the target domain. We achieve this by restricting the two domains to share both inter-category structure and intra-category structure in the representation space. Experiment results on five benchmarking datasets indicate that our proposed method significantly outperforms the existing representative baselines.
title: Fine-Grained Representation Alignment for Zero-Shot Domain Adaptation

abstract: In this paper, we propose a Jacobi-type algorithm to solve the low rank orthogonal approximation problem of symmetric tensors. This algorithm includes as a special case the well-known Jacobi CoM2 algorithm for the approximate orthogonal diagonalization problem of symmetric tensors. We first prove the weak convergence of this algorithm, \textit{i.e.} any accumulation point is a stationary point. Then we study the global convergence of this algorithm under a gradient based ordering for a special case: the best rank-2 orthogonal approximation of 3rd order symmetric tensors, and prove that an accumulation point is the unique limit point under some conditions. Numerical experiments are presented to show the efficiency of this algorithm.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种雅可比型算法，用于求解对称张量的低秩正交逼近问题。该算法将经典的对称张量近似正交对角化雅可比CoM2方法作为特例包含其中。首先证明了算法的弱收敛性，即任意聚点均为稳定点。随后针对三阶对称张量的最佳秩-2正交逼近这一特殊情形，研究了基于梯度排序策略下算法的全局收敛性，并证明在特定条件下聚点即为唯一极限点。数值实验验证了该算法的有效性。
title: Jacobi-type algorithm for low rank orthogonal approximation of symmetric tensors and its convergence analysis

abstract: Abstract Heteroatom doping has emerged as a highly effective strategy to enhance the activity of metal‐based electrocatalysts toward the oxygen evolution reaction (OER). It is widely accepted that the doping does not switch the OER mechanism from the adsorbate evolution mechanism (AEM) to the lattice‐oxygen‐mediated mechanism (LOM), and the enhanced activity is attributed to the optimized binding energies toward oxygen intermediates. However, this seems inconsistent with the fact that the overpotential of doped OER electrocatalysts (<300 mV) is considerably smaller than the limit of AEM (>370 mV). To determine the origin of this inconsistency, we select phosphorus (P)‐doped nickel‐iron mixed oxides as the model electrocatalysts and observe that the doping enhances the covalency of the metal‐oxygen bonds to drive the OER pathway transition from the AEM to the LOM, thereby breaking the adsorption linear relation between *OH and *OOH in the AEM. Consequently, the obtained P‐doped oxides display a small overpotential of 237 mV at 10 mA cm −2 . Beyond P, the similar pathway transition is also observed on the sulfur doping. These findings offer new insights into the substantially enhanced OER activity originating from heteroatom doping.
title: Unlocking the Transition of Electrochemical Water Oxidation Mechanism Induced by Heteroatom Doping

abstract: This article proposes an efficient maximum-torque-per-square-ampere (MTPSA) control for the interior permanent magnet synchronous machines (IPMSMs). The objective of the MTPSA control is to find the optimal current angle, denoted as MTPSA angle, to maximize the ratio of the output torque to the square of the stator current. The proposed MTPSA control is equivalent to the maximum-torque-per-ampere (MTPA) control, but it can eliminate the need of machine parameters and thus is independent of parameter variation. This article first derives the MTPSA control objective from the machine model considering cross-coupling inductances. Then, computation-efficient gradient descent algorithm is employed to detect the MTPSA angle from the derived objective. The proposed MTPSA control is based on available measurements without the need of machine parameters and invasive signal injection, which has not been simultaneously achieved in existing MTPA controls. The proposed control is validated with simulations, experiments, and comparisons with existing approaches on a laboratory IPMSM.
title: Maximum-Torque-per-Square-Ampere Control for Interior PMSMs Considering Cross-Saturation Inductances

abstract: Ge44Sn14Te42 phase change material exhibits a higher crystallization temperature (∼221 °C), a larger crystallization activation energy (∼2.88 eV) and a better data retention ability (∼126 °C for 10 years) in comparison with those of Ge2Sb2Te5. A reversible switching between set and reset can be realized by an electric pulse as short as 10 ns for Ge44Sn14Te42 based phase change memory (PCM) cell. In addition, PCM based on Ge44Sn14Te42 shows endurance up to 2.7 × 103 cycles with a resistance of about two orders of magnitude on/off ratio.
summary_zh: 与传统的Ge2Sb2Te5相比，Ge44Sn14Te42相变材料展现出更优越的热稳定性和数据保持能力，其结晶温度约为221°C，结晶激活能高达约2.88 eV，并能实现约126°C下长达10年的数据保持。基于该材料的相变存储单元可通过短至10纳秒的电脉冲实现可逆的置位与复位操作，展现出快速的开关特性。此外，该存储器件在高达2.7×10³次循环的耐久性测试中，仍能维持约两个数量级的电阻开关比。这些结果表明，Ge44Sn14Te42是一种在高性能、高可靠性相变存储器应用中极具潜力的新型相变材料。
title: Investigation of Ge-Sn-Te alloy for long data retention and high speed phase change memory application

summary_zh: GeSe由环境友好且地壳丰度高的元素组成，作为中温热电材料，有望替代传统有毒铅硫族化合物和稀缺碲化物。本文系统综述了GeSe基热电材料的最新进展，重点阐述其晶体结构、化学键、相变行为，以及化学键合机制与晶体结构之间的关联，并探讨了能带结构和声子色散特性。这些独特性质为调控电子和声子输运提供了多种途径。在优化电输运性能方面，重点介绍了基于相调控的载流子浓度工程、多价带汇聚和能带简并策略。为降低晶格热导率，着重分析了与化学键合机制相关的本征弱化学键和非谐性效应，同时强调了额外声子散射机制，包括点缺陷、铁电畴、晶界、纳米析出相以及复合工程引起的声子失配。此外，本文对GeSe基化合物的力学性能进行了评估，以考量热电器件的长期服役能力，并基于当前zT值讨论了理论能量转换效率。通过回顾发展历程并展望未来研究方向，本综述为深入理解GeSe提供了见解，有望加速该类材料的开发，并为更广泛热电材料的发展提供启示。
title: GeSe-based thermoelectric materials: Progress and future challenge

summary_zh: 机器学习已成为解决光纤通信网络复杂问题的关键技术，其应用范围涵盖网络设备设计、传输损伤补偿及全网流量预测等多个领域。然而，机器学习模型的性能高度依赖于数据的质量与规模。目前，多数研究仍局限于使用仿真工具生成的合成数据或简单的实验室环境数据，难以满足实际光纤网络对跨层、跨域大规模数据的需求。针对现有研究过度关注算法应用而忽视数据维度的现状，本文从数据视角出发，深入探讨了构建智能光纤网络所需的数据要素。文章首先阐述了实现有效网络监测与数据采集的关键工具与技术，并详细解析了不同类型数据的物理来源及其应用场景。随后，本文讨论了用于提升数据采集、存储、展示及分析效率的数据处理与预处理技术。最后，文章重点分析了数据生成、传输与共享过程中的主要挑战，并提出了相应的潜在解决方案，旨在为未来光纤网络实现无缝的数据驱动智能化运维奠定基础。
title: Data Perspectives in AI-Assisted Fiber-Optic Communication Networks

abstract: Pile groups are extensively utilized to provide stability of offshore structures and bridges across rivers. Under the actions of waves and current, severe local scour can be induced around the pile groups in cohesionless soils, compromising the safety of structures significantly. An accurate prediction of local scour depth is difficult because the three-dimensional flow around pile groups is a complicated process. A series of flume tests were conducted in a novel water flume for flow-structure-soil interaction modelling, to investigate the local scour process around twin-pile groups. Two different hydrodynamic loading conditions, i.e., current alone and current plus waves, were adopted in the tests. The effects of the hydrodynamic loading conditions and the influence of the twin-pile layout on the scour have been investigated. It was found that compared with the maximum scour depths around a single pile, those around tandem twin-pile groups are generally a bit smaller while those around side-by-side twin-pile groups are remarkably larger, especially for the cases with small pile spacing. The observed maximum scour depth around side-by-side twin-pile groups with no separation can be nearly twice of that around a single pile. For the side-by-side arrangement, there is a qualitative agreement between the present results and the results of the preceding studies.
title: Physical modelling of pile-group effect on the local scour in submarine environments

abstract: In this article, the impacts of the off-state gate bias (VGS,OFF) on dynamic on-resistance (RON) are systematically investigated in commercial Schottky-type p-GaN Gate high-electron-mobility transistors. Double-pulse tester and pulsed I–V system are adopted to evaluate the dynamic RON with various off-state gate and drain bias (VDS,OFF) under hard- and soft-switching conditions. More negative VGS,OFF can aggravate the dynamic RON degradation under both soft- and hard-switching, especially when switching with a high VDS,OFF. The impacts of VGS,OFF on switching transients and off-state stress are investigated separately to reveal the underlying mechanisms, which are found to be associated with the generation and movements of holes. The off-state gate bias of the voltage-driving scheme needs to be carefully considered according to the identified mechanisms in terms of dynamic on-resistance degradation.
title: Negative Gate Bias Induced Dynamic ON-Resistance Degradation in Schottky-Type p -Gan Gate HEMTs

abstract: Ink-jet printing is a promising deposition technology, which is capable of large-area fabrication and mask-free patterning. For ink-jet-printed quantum dot (QD) light-emitting diodes (LEDs), the QDs are commonly dissolved in a mixture of solvent and thickener ink system. However, the hole transport layer could be eroded by this QD ink, leading to a rough surface morphology and resulting in the leakage of carriers and low device performance. This phenomenon was first and directly observed by using an atomic force microscope and a cross-sectional scanning electron microscope. We, therefore, redesigned the annealing process of the hole transport layer to achieve an optimized smooth surface with a reduced number of defects for ink-jet-printed QD LEDs (QLEDs). Optimized morphology brings back a maximum luminance of over 30,000 cd/m<sup>2</sup> and an external quantum efficiency of 7.52% for the ink-jet-printed red QLEDs using CdSe QDs, which are comparable to those of the spin-coated device. Moreover, the operation lifetime of the ink-jet-printed device is also enhanced by the restored surface morphology. An enhanced T<sub>50</sub> lifetime of the ink-jet-printed device at 1000 cd/m<sup>2</sup> is improved from 26 to 127 h, which converted to a long T<sub>50</sub> lifetime of 8013 h, when operated at 100 cd/m<sup>2</sup>.
title: Improved Ink-Jet-Printed CdSe Quantum Dot Light-Emitting Diodes with Minimized Hole Transport Layer Erosion

summary_zh: 本研究首次系统评估了中国水产养殖与海水养殖全产业链的温室气体排放碳足迹。通过将排放源划分为饲料生产、能源消耗、氧化亚氮释放和肥料施用四个阶段，量化了过去十年间九大主要水产品种的温室气体排放量及其空间分布格局。结果表明，饲料原料生产是温室气体排放的最大贡献源，其中作物种植能耗、土地利用变化、肥料生产、作物氧化亚氮排放和水稻甲烷排放构成饲料相关排放的主体。九大品种温室气体排放总量达1.12亿吨二氧化碳当量，覆盖全国水产养殖总产量的约86%，其中鲤科鱼类排放占比最高，达47%。空间分析显示，广东、湖北、江苏和山东四省排放量居全国前列，合计占总排放量的46%。各省地区生产总值与温室气体排放量呈显著正相关，相关系数超过0.6。本研究首次揭示了我国水产养殖品种结构、产量分布与温室气体排放空间格局之间的关联，为未来养殖规模持续扩大背景下的温室气体减排提供了科学依据。
title: Current status of greenhouse gas emissions from aquaculture in China

abstract: The first and catalytic enantioselective total synthesis of hypocrolide A (>99% ee) in 12 steps, as well as other botryanes, is described. The absolute configurations of these compounds have been unambiguously confirmed or reassigned accordingly. The key reactions in this study include an unusual rhodium-catalyzed intramolecular [4 + 2] cycloaddition and a biomimetic oxidative [3 + 2] cycloaddition based on our revised biogenetic pathway.
summary_zh: 本文报道了对天然产物hypocrolide A及其它botryanes类化合物的首次催化不对称全合成，通过12步反应实现了hypocrolide A的高对映选择性合成（ee值大于99%）。研究过程中，通过实验手段明确证实或重新分配了这些化合物的绝对构型。合成策略的核心在于两项关键反应：一是利用铑催化实现的非典型分子内[4 + 2]环加成反应；二是基于修正后的生物合成途径，通过仿生氧化[3 + 2]环加成反应构建核心骨架。该研究不仅为botryanes类天然产物的全合成提供了高效的合成路径，也为理解此类化合物的生物合成机制提供了重要的实验依据。
title: Catalytic Enantioselective Total Synthesis of Hypocrolide A

abstract: In the seminal work of Chan and Gerber (1985), one of the earliest game theoretical approaches was proposed to model the interaction between the reinsurer and insurer; in particular, the optimal pricing density for the reinsurer and optimal ceded loss for the insurer were determined so that their corresponding expected utilities could be maximized. Over decades, their advocated Bowley solution (could be understood as Stackelberg equilibria) concept of equilibrium reinsurance strategy has not been revisited in the modern risk management framework. In this article, we attempt to fill this gap by extending their work to the setting of general premium principle for the reinsurer and distortion risk measure for the insurer.
title: Risk-adjusted Bowley reinsurance under distorted probabilities

summary_zh: 本文研发了一种新型差示折射仪，该设备主要由激光光源、位置敏感探测器及温控折射池组成。与传统差示折射仪相比，该装置采用了独特的光学设计，通过2f-2f构型将激光照射的微小针孔成像至探测器，有效降低了激光束漂移带来的影响。该折射仪可轻松集成至现有的激光光散射光谱仪中，通过共用激光器、恒温器及计算机，不仅大幅降低了设备成本（仅为商用设备的十分之一左右），还实现了在相同实验条件（如波长和温度）下同时测量比折射率增量与散射光强度的功能。实验结果表明，该新型折射仪具有宽线性检测范围（±0.035 RI单位）和极高的分辨率（10⁻⁶ RI单位），足以满足大多数聚合物溶液比折射率增量的精确测定需求。
title: Incorporation of a differential refractometer into a laser light-scattering spectrometer

summary_zh: 场景文本识别近期常被视为序列到序列的预测问题，其中传统的全连接LSTM（FC-LSTM）发挥了关键作用。然而，FC-LSTM 必须将二维特征图转换为一维序列特征向量，这会导致文本图像中宝贵的空间与结构信息严重丢失。本文认为，基于二维图像输入的场景文本识别本质上是一个时空预测问题，据此提出了一种基于卷积LSTM（ConvLSTM）的场景文本识别器，即聚焦注意力卷积LSTM（FACLSTM）。该方法在利用LSTM进行序列预测时，能够充分挖掘像素间的空间相关性。具体而言，通过卷积操作将注意力机制有机融入高效的ConvLSTM结构中，并生成额外的字符中心掩码，以引导模型聚焦于正确的特征区域。在IIIT5K、SVT和CUTE等基准数据集上的实验结果表明，FACLSTM在常规、低分辨率及噪声文本图像上均表现出较强的竞争力，尤其在处理弯曲文本图像时，其性能显著优于现有最先进的方法。
title: FACLSTM: ConvLSTM with focused attention for scene text recognition

abstract: We consider multi-rate peer-to-peer multiparty video conferencing applications, where different receivers in the same group can receive videos at different rates using, for example, scalable layered coding. The quality of video received by each receiver can be modeled as a concave utility function of the video bitrate. We study and address the unique challenges introduced by maximizing utility in the multi-rate setting as compared to the single-rate case. We first determine an optimal set of tree structures for routing multi-rate content using scalable layered coding. We then develop Primal and Primal-dual based distributed algorithms to maximize aggregate utility of all receivers in all groups by multi-tree routing and show their convergence. These algorithms can be easily implemented and deployed on today's Internet. We have built a prototype video conferencing system to show that this approach converges to optimal bitrates to improve user experience and offers automatic adaptation to network conditions and user preferences.
summary_zh: 本文研究多速率对等网络多方视频会议应用，其中同一组内的不同接收端可通过可扩展分层编码以不同速率接收视频。将各接收端获得的视频质量建模为视频比特率的凹效用函数，重点分析并解决多速率场景下最大化效用所面临的独特挑战，区别于传统单速率情形。首先确定采用可扩展分层编码进行多速率内容分发的最优树结构集合，进而提出基于原始及原始-对偶的分布式算法，通过多树路由最大化所有组内全部接收端的聚合效用，并证明其收敛性。所提算法易于实现，可部署于现有互联网环境。搭建原型视频会议系统验证表明，该方法能够收敛至最优比特率以提升用户体验，并自动适应网络状况与用户偏好。
title: Multi-Rate Peer-to-Peer Video Conferencing Applications

summary_zh: 针对三维模型分类在计算机辅助设计与三维对象检索等领域的应用需求，本文提出一种结合核非参数判别分析与几何投影直方图模型的分类方法。传统分类器在处理三维模型描述时存在局限性，为此，我们首先构建了核非参数判别分析方法，通过引入核函数增强对非线性特征的表征能力；其次，提出基于几何投影直方图模型的不变特征提取方法，利用模型在多个方向上的投影分布直方图获取旋转、平移等变换下的稳定特征。在此基础上，整合上述两种技术形成完整的三维模型分类框架，先以几何投影直方图提取不变特征，再通过核非参数判别分析实现高精度分类。在公开数据集上的实验结果表明，所提方案能够有效提升三维模型分类的准确性与鲁棒性，验证了该方法的可行性与有效性。
title: 3D model classification based on nonparametric discriminant analysis with kernels.

abstract: ). Furthermore, we performed sex-stratified Mendelian randomization (MR) analyses and identified abundant causalities between the oral microbiome and serum metabolites. Notably, sex-specific microbes-hormonal interactions explained the mostly observed sex hormones differences such as the significant causalities enrichments for aldosterone in females and androstenedione in males. These findings illustrate the necessity of sex stratification and deepen our understanding of the interplay between the oral microbiome and serum metabolites.
title: Sex differences in the oral microbiome, host traits, and their causal relationships

abstract: In response to the limitations of existing vehicle detection technologies when applied to distributed sensor networks for road traffic holographic perception, this paper proposes a vehicle information detection technology based on single-point laser ranging. The system uses two single-point laser radars with fixed angles, combined with an adaptive threshold state machine and waveform segmentation fusion, to accurately detect vehicle speed, lane position, and other parameters. Compared with traditional methods, this technology offers advantages such as richer detection dimensions, low cost, and ease of installation and maintenance, making it suitable for large-scale traffic monitoring on secondary roads, highways, and suburban roads. Experimental results show that the system achieves high accuracy and reliability in low-to-medium-traffic flow scenarios, demonstrating its potential for intelligent road traffic applications.
summary_zh: 针对现有车辆检测技术在分布式传感器网络用于道路交通全息感知时的局限性，提出一种基于单点激光测距的车辆信息检测方法。该系统采用两个固定角度的单点激光雷达，结合自适应阈值状态机与波形分割融合算法，实现对车速、车道位置等参数的精确检测。与传统方法相比，该技术具有检测维度更丰富、成本低、易于安装维护等优势，适用于次干路、高速公路及城郊道路的大规模交通监测。实验结果表明，该系统在中低交通流量场景下具有较高的检测精度与可靠性，展现出在智能道路交通应用中的潜力。
title: Research on Comprehensive Vehicle Information Detection Technology Based on Single-Point Laser Ranging

summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种贝叶斯加权孟德尔随机化方法，用于基于全基因组关联研究汇总数据的因果推断。该方法针对复杂性状的多基因遗传结构和广泛存在的多效性问题，通过贝叶斯框架同时处理弱工具变量不确定性和多效性导致的工具变量假设违反。具体而言，模型引入贝叶斯加权策略进行离群值检测，以识别并降低多效性变异的影响权重，从而校正因果效应估计。为提升计算稳定性和效率，开发了变分期望最大化算法进行参数推断，并推导出精确的闭合形式后验协方差校正公式，解决了变分推断中常见的协方差低估问题。通过全面的模拟研究，系统评估了该方法在不同场景下的表现，结果表明其在因果效应估计的准确性和稳健性方面均优于现有竞争方法。将该方法应用于130种代谢物与93种复杂人类性状之间的因果推断，成功揭示了暴露与结局性状间新的因果关系。该方法为利用大规模GWAS数据进行可靠因果推断提供了有效工具，在遗传流行病学和复杂疾病机制研究中具有重要应用价值。
title: Bayesian weighted Mendelian randomization for causal inference based on summary statistics

abstract: Abstract We construct a sequence of explicit blow-ups and blow-downs on an irreducible compact Hermitian symmetric spaces $X$ which transforms it into a projective space of the same dimension. Moreover, this resolves a birational map given by Landsberg and Manivel. Centers of the blow-ups for $X$ are constructed by loci of chains of minimal rational curves and centers of the blow-ups for the projective space are constructed from the variety of minimal rational tangents of $X$ and its higher secant varieties. The result was known in the special case where $X$ is of rank 2 and could be found in Zak’s monograph “Tangents and secants of algebraic varieties.”
summary_zh: 我们在一类不可约紧致埃尔米特对称空间 X 上构造了一组显式的爆破与收缩序列，将其双有理变换为同维数的射影空间，从而实现了 Landsberg 和 Manivel 所给出的双有理映射。对 X 的爆破中心由极小球面曲线链的轨迹构造，而对射影空间的爆破中心则由 X 的极小球面切触簇及其高阶割线簇构造。该结果在秩为 2 的特殊情形下已知，并可在 Zak 的专著《代数簇的切线与割线》中找到。
title: Birational transformations on irreducible compact Hermitian symmetric spaces

summary_zh: 本研究将光通信波长扩展至2微米波段以提升数据容量，并针对硅光子集成平台提出一种超宽带3 dB功分器。由于硅波导在1.55微米与2微米波段间存在显著色散，实现跨波段工作的功分器面临挑战。为此，我们设计了一种基于三锥形Y结的超宽带功分器，通过引入亚波长光栅结构大幅扩展工作带宽。仿真结果表明，该器件在1500纳米至2020纳米范围内插入损耗低于0.2 dB的带宽超过520纳米。器件尺寸仅为3微米×2微米，具有超紧凑特性。受测试装置与耦合技术限制，我们分别在1.55微米和2微米波段进行实验验证，测得1500至1620纳米及1960至2020纳米波段的插入损耗均低于0.4 dB。实验结果表明，该功分器具备在1.55微米与2微米两个波段间实现宽带工作的能力，有望应用于跨波段硅光子集成系统。
title: Ultra-broadband 3 dB power splitter from 1.55 to 2 µm wave band

abstract: Abstract The annual assessment of emission control effects on air quality is essential for policy adjustments. However, this assessment is difficult as the inter‐annual changes in pollution are impacted by complex meteorological conditions. In this study, based on our wind‐pollution decomposition (WPD) method, which decomposes wind effects (wind‐driven) and nonwind effects, we established the meteorology‐pollution decomposition (MPD) method, which separates meteorological effects (met‐driven) and nonmeteorological effects by importing other meteorological parameters, to approximate the emission change effects (emission‐driven) by the nonmeteorological effects. The performance of the MPD method was assessed by comparing the results of the WPD and MPD methods at multiple representative stations in Hong Kong with the longest continuous data available in China from 2000 to 2018. The decomposed emission‐driven impact is also validated by using the gross domestic product growth rates data. The emission‐driven contributions determined by the WPD and MPD methods generally show agreement in trend, while the met‐driven effects are generally larger than the wind‐driven effects with the same or opposite trend. The results showed that the met‐driven effect from the MPD method is more reasonable than the wind‐driven effect from the WPD method in representing complex meteorological influences, which indicates a better representation of emission‐driven impacts by the nonmeteorological effects during the unusual meteorological years, such as El Niño‐Southern Oscillation events. The MPD method represents an independent approach, which is based only on regular observations, to quantify the long‐term trend in emission‐driven impacts as well as the integrated meteorological impacts on the atmospheric environment under the background of climate change.
title: A Multi‐Dimensional Decomposition Method of the Meteorology‐Driven and Emission‐Driven Effects on Year‐to‐Year Air Quality Variations

abstract: The micro-motion properties of the rotational symmetry ballistic targets (BTs) are analyzed in the work presented here. A method for the estimation of precession frequency and the precession angle is proposed based on the polarization properties of the rotational symmetry ballistic targets (BTs). Compared with the traditional precession frequency estimation method, the estimated spectra of the harmonic frequencies are considerably smaller. In addition, an inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR) imaging technique based upon the micro-motion of BTs is proposed. The theoretical conclusions are confirmed by the application of the experimental data.
summary_zh: 本文针对具有旋转对称特性的弹道目标微动特性展开分析，提出了一种基于极化特征估计进动频率与进动角的方法。与传统进动频率估计方法相比，该方法所得谐波频率的估计谱显著减小，从而提高了参数提取的精度与抗干扰能力。在此基础上，进一步提出了一种利用弹道目标微动信息的逆合成孔径雷达成像技术，通过挖掘微动引起的极化调制特性，实现了对目标散射中心的有效分辨与成像。利用实测数据对所提理论方法进行了验证，实验结果证实了进动参数估计与微动辅助成像方法的有效性。该研究可为弹道目标识别、特征提取及雷达成像等应用领域提供新的技术途径。
title: Estimation of Precession Parameters and Generation of ISAR Images of Ballistic Missile Targets
venue: IEEE Transactions on Aerospace and Electronic Systems

summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于平行六面体阵列结构的新型等离激元超表面设计，旨在解决现有超表面掩模在紫外波段光学效率不足的问题。该超表面在紫外至可见光宽波段范围内实现了极高的宽带透射率，其偏振响应特性源于腔模与晶格共振分别激发的两个偏振峰。利用这一高效超表面掩模，可在显著缩短曝光时间的条件下，实现复杂定制的分子取向光图案化。该宽带高效等离激元超表面不仅对高分辨率分子取向光图案化具有重要意义，还可根据需求拓展至紫外及近紫外波段的多种平面光学应用。
title: Plasmonic Metasurfaces with High UV–Vis Transmittance for Photopatterning of Designer Molecular Orientations

summary_zh: 淋巴系统是癌症转移的主要途径，其中前哨淋巴结（SLN）是癌细胞扩散的首站。传统的单模态示踪剂如蓝色染料和碳纳米颗粒在临床应用中易导致SLN识别误判，且缺乏治疗功能。本研究利用水热法结合后期氮化处理，成功合成了一种具有优异等离子体特性的氮化钛纳米双锥（TiN NBPs）。该纳米结构在可见光和近红外区域均表现出卓越的光学性能，能够同时实现明场与暗场成像，具有极高的淋巴结引流效率，可作为SLN示踪的新型多模态示踪剂。此外，得益于TiN NBPs在第二近红外窗口（NIR-II）下的高效光热转换能力，通过1064 nm激光照射进行光热消融，结合原发肿瘤的手术切除，能显著抑制肺转移。该研究不仅为SLN精准成像提供了新工具，还为通过NIR-II光热治疗抑制淋巴转移提供了有效的诊疗一体化策略。
title: Tracing Sentinel Lymph Nodes and Inhibiting Lymphatic Metastasis with TiN Nanobipyramids Through Photothermal Therapy

summary_zh: 面对过去二十年间持续创纪录的自然灾害损失，美国保险与再保险业正日益关注人为气候变化与极端天气之间的关联性。本文深入探讨了这一关联对保险业的潜在影响，重点分析了短期行业波动及长期财务表现与企业韧性的演变。研究首先概述了气候变化对灾害风险界定、评估及管理模式的影响，随后通过计量经济学模型，对比分析了财产险（P/C）行业在应对自然灾害与人为灾害时的财务韧性。通过模拟多种极端情景——包括类似2004年美国遭遇的一系列风暴，以及“卡特里娜级”飓风叠加“9/11级”大规模恐怖袭击的复合型灾难——研究发现，从宏观系统层面来看，财产险行业展现出了极高的宏观韧性。此外，研究进一步指出，保险公司的韧性随冲击规模的增大而提升，这主要体现在系统恢复速度以及受损系统剖面面积的倒数指标上。本文的研究结果为财产险保险公司在应对未来气候风险及极端事件时提供了重要的决策参考。
title: Insurer Resilience in an Era of Climate Change and Extreme Weather: An Econometric Analysis

abstract: Intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) has been recently exploited as a symbiotic radio (SR) technology to improve energy and spectral efficiencies in wireless systems. In this article, we consider a symbiotic IRS-assisted mobile-edge computing (MEC) system that allows edge users to first harvest RF power from a hybrid access point (HAP) and then offload its computational workload to the MEC server associated with the HAP. We aim to minimize the HAP’s energy consumption by jointly optimizing the users’ offloading schemes, the HAP’s active beamforming, and the IRS’s passive beamforming strategies. We propose an optimization-driven hierarchical deep deterministic policy gradient (OH-DDPG) framework to decompose the energy minimization problem into the optimization and the learning subproblems, respectively. The outer loop DDPG learning method adapts the IRS’s passive beamforming strategy, while the inner loop optimization deals with the other control variables with reduced dimensionality. Moreover, to improve the learning efficiency, we extend OH-DDPG to the multiagent scenario. In particular, the HAP first estimates the users’ offloading strategy by the inner-loop optimization and shares it with all user agents. Then, each user agent refines its offloading decision using the DDPG algorithm independently. This can avoid signaling overhead among users and improve the multiuser learning efficiency. Simulation results show that the proposed OH-DDPG and the multiuser extension can achieve significant performance gains compared to the conventional model-free learning algorithms.
title: Computation Offloading and Beamforming Optimization for Energy Minimization in Wireless-Powered IRS-Assisted MEC

summary_zh: 本研究提出一种融合方位向截断波长信息的贝叶斯反演算法，用于提升合成孔径雷达海面风场反演精度。方位向截断波长参数此前未得到充分利用，但其对风场变化具有高度敏感性。该方法通过概率框架将SAR数据与辅助气象信息相结合，并构建代价函数优化反演过程，充分利用方位向截断对风矢量场变化的响应特性。基于Sentinel-1和高分三号SAR数据，利用浮标实测数据和散射计风场估计进行综合验证。结果表明，所提方法显著提高了风速反演精度，尤其在低风速和不同海况条件下表现突出，且未明显增加计算负担。虽然风向反演精度提升有限，但风速估计精度的改善对业务化气象应用具有重要价值。这些发现表明，融合方位向截断信息是获取更准确、更可靠SAR风场反演结果的关键步骤，将推动遥感与海洋学领域的发展。
title: On the use of azimuth cutoff for sea surface wind speed retrieval from SAR

summary_zh: 本文研究如何利用忆阻器提升非易失性D锁存器的性能。传统设计通常需要多个忆阻器或复杂电路结构，而本文提出的D锁存器仅由一个忆阻器、若干传输门和CMOS反相器构成，有效克服了晶体管阈值损失带来的负面影响。仿真结果表明，与现有方案相比，该设计使忆阻器在不同阻态间的切换速度提升2.3至3.6倍，从而支持更高的工作时钟频率；同时，忆阻器的阈值电压可选范围也显著扩大。作为应用实例，基于该D锁存器实现了非易失性主从D触发器，其延迟在所有同类设计中最小，面积也仅略大于一种现有方案。该工作从延迟、面积和阈值电压选择灵活性等方面全面提升了忆阻器基D锁存器及D触发器的品质，为实际系统中的数据备份提供了有前景的解决方案。
title: Memristor-based Nonvolatile D Latch and Flip-flop Designs
venue: 2021 22nd International Symposium on Quality Electronic Design (ISQED)

summary_zh: 本文开发了一种基于卤键相互作用与聚集诱导发光（AIE）效应相结合的新型荧光化学传感器，用于有机锡化合物的分子识别。研究通过合成含有多个异氰基配体的双核钌配合物作为非发光受体，实现了对有机锡卤化物的特异性检测。当受体与目标有机锡卤化物发生相互作用时，由于分子识别机制的触发，该配合物会由非发光状态转变为强烈的红色荧光发射，并表现出显著的量子产率。该研究为有机锡污染物的灵敏检测提供了一种基于分子识别驱动的新型荧光传感策略，在环境监测与化学分析领域具有潜在的应用价值。
title: Off/On Fluorescent Chemosensors for Organotin Halides Based on Binuclear Ruthenium Complexes

summary_zh: 基于统计理论，贝叶斯反演方法利用后验概率分布，在先验信息和观测数据的约束下评估模型参数。与确定性反演相比，贝叶斯推断能够通过模型参数的边缘概率分布、最大后验估计、均值模型估计及相关系数，定量评价反演的不确定性，从而准确反映观测数据与先验信息对模型参数的约束能力。本文系统总结了贝叶斯推断在地球物理反演中的应用，并提出了实现贝叶斯模型评估的基本流程。首先简要介绍贝叶斯理论，详细阐述先验信息概率分布、似然函数公式以及后验概率方程的构建。其次，深入讨论贝叶斯反演的实施过程：在模型参数更新方面，论述了固定维度和跨维度反演的概念，并涉及超参数优化；在反演方法上，重点介绍了固定维度和跨维度反演中的马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗采样方法；在模型参数评估方面，给出了不同条件下贝叶斯统计参数的计算方式。随后，探讨了提高贝叶斯反演采样效率的具体措施。最后，对贝叶斯推断在地球物理反演领域的应用进行了归纳总结。
title: 贝叶斯方法在地球物理反演问题中的应用进展

summary_zh: 我们提出一种通用贝叶斯节点分类建模框架，用于在基因组尺度网络上联合分析转录组数据与现有生物网络，以提升特征选择的稳健性和信息量，并加深对生物学机制的理解。该方法针对现有模型的两大不足进行了改进：一是无法灵活刻画所选节点的不同亚型，二是忽略含缺失值的节点，容易导致估计偏差。新框架为类别指示变量引入了融入网络结构的先验模型，并采用Swendsen-Wang算法进行后验计算，从而高效更新类别指示变量。该贝叶斯框架能够自然处理缺失值，提高了节点分类准确性，并降低了基因效应估计中的偏差。通过大量模拟研究和对癌症基因组图谱中皮肤黑色素瘤数据集的分析，我们验证了该方法在基因组生物学和基因组医学中的应用优势。
title: Feature selection and classification over the network with missing node observations

summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于垂直地震剖面数据的P波重建方法，旨在直接从全波形弹性VSP数据中学习到其P波分量的域变换。该方法以最优传输理论为基础，通过生成对抗网络实现。在二维地下模型生成的22180对合成数据上训练网络，并在40596对数据上进行测试，网络输出平均准确率达到97.87%。在二维合成数据上的测试结果表明，该网络不仅能进行相位识别和波型分类，还能学习目标分离数据的波形特征。该方法为多分量地震数据处理中的波模分离提供了新思路，尤其适用于稀疏接收器采集条件下的应用场景。
title: A new P-wave reconstruction method for VSP data using conditional generative adversarial network
venue: SEG Technical Program Expanded Abstracts 2019. Cite URL

summary_zh: 本研究针对工业余热和汽车尾气中大量存在的低温废热，开发了适用于低温温差发电的高性能p型碲化铋基热电材料。通过锑合金化策略，系统调控Bi2-xSbxTe3多晶固溶体组分，有效抑制了高温下的本征激发不利效应。其机理在于锑含量的增加同时提高了空穴浓度和材料带隙，使最佳工作温度向380 K附近移动。在此基础上，采用热变形工艺成功构建了多尺度微观结构，包括动态再结晶诱导的局域纳米结构和大量晶格缺陷，这些多尺度声子散射中心显著降低了晶格热导率。同时，增强的织构和类施主效应协同改善了电输运性能。沿面内方向测量的热电参数表明，热变形Bi0.3Sb1.7Te3合金在380 K时获得最大热电优值ZT达1.3，在300–480 K宽温域内平均ZT高达1.18，显著优于传统Bi0.5Sb1.5Te3组分。该材料体系在工业废热回收、汽车尾气余热利用等低温发电领域展现出广阔的应用前景。
title: Shifting up the optimum figure of merit of p-type bismuth telluride-based thermoelectric materials for power generation by suppressing intrinsic conduction

abstract: Incorporating dispersion into time-varying media not only holds practical significance but also profoundly transforms the electromagnetic characteristics of such dynamic media. In this work, we have developed a temporal transfer matrix method (TTMM) tailored for time-varying media exhibiting a specific type of dispersion, namely, Lorentzian dispersion. The conventional TTMM for nondispersive time-varying media can be regarded as an approximation of this developed TTMM in the nondispersive limit by ignoring the unobservable infinite-frequency modes. By using this developed TTMM, we have investigated the Floquet bands of Lorentzian dispersive media with time-periodic plasmon frequencies or resonant frequencies. Under temporal modulations, certain degenerate points of the Floquet bands will be lifted, creating bandgaps, while others will give rise to two types of exceptional point (EP) pairs. This sharply contrasts with the well-known Floquet bands of nondispersive time-varying media, where only one type of EP pair exists. Our developed TTMM serves as a powerful tool for investigating the phenomena within the realm of dispersive time-varying media.
summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种适用于洛伦兹色散时变介质的时域传输矩阵方法（TTMM）。传统针对无色散时变介质的TTMM可视为该方法在忽略不可观测的无穷大频率模式后的无色散极限近似。利用所发展的TTMM，我们系统研究了具有时变等离子体频率或谐振频率的洛伦兹色散介质的Floquet能带结构。结果表明，在时间调制作用下，Floquet能带的某些简并点会被打开形成带隙，而另一些简并点则会产生两类不同的异常点对。这一现象与已知的无色散时变介质Floquet能带仅存在单一类型异常点对的特征形成鲜明对比。本工作发展的TTMM为探索色散时变介质领域中的电磁现象提供了有力工具。
title: Temporal transfer matrix method for Lorentzian dispersive time-varying media

abstract: We present a modified Bitter-type electromagnet which features high magnetic field, fine electronic properties and efficient heat removal. The electromagnet is constructed from a stack of copper layers separated by mica layers that have the same shape. A distinctive design of cooling channels on the insulating layers and the parallel ducts between the layers ensures low resistance for cooling water to flow. A continuous current control system is also made to regulate the current through the electromagnet. In our experiment, versatile electromagnets are applied to generate magnetic field and gradient field. From our measurements, a peak magnetic field of 1000 G and a peak gradient field of 80 G/cm are generated in the center of the apparatuses which are 7 cm and 5 cm away from the edge of each electromagnet with a current of 230 A and 120 A, respectively. With the effective feedback design in the current control system and cooling water flow of 3.8 l/min, the stability of the current through the electromagnets can reach 10−5.
title: A modified Bitter-type electromagnet and control system for cold atom experiments

summary_zh: 住房是中国普通民众最重要的资产之一，但其政治意涵尚未得到充分探讨。既有政治经济学理论主要基于民主制度背景，普遍预测房产所有权会削弱民众对再分配政策的支持。本研究旨在检验这一预期在中国是否成立，通过分析住房产权对不同类型再分配政策支持度的异质性影响。基于全国代表性调查数据，研究结合匹配方法与工具变量分析，发现住房产权实际上提升了民众对再分配相关政策的支持。这一正向效应在国有企业员工中显著强于私营部门从业者。中介分析进一步表明，该关系通过家庭财富、不平等感知和婚姻状况等渠道发挥作用。上述发现挑战了主流的资产本位再分配理论，表明住房产权的政治后果从根本上受到制度环境的塑造。更广泛而言，本研究揭示了住房不仅作为经济资产发挥作用，更是国家调节福利预期和维护社会稳定的社会政治机制。研究结果将住房政策与更宏观的福利制度和城市治理议题联系起来。
title: Homeownership and preferences for government redistribution in China: Mediating roles of employment sector and socioeconomic perceptions

abstract: Abstract Magnesium (Mg) surface was mechanically burnished and then alloyed with aluminum (Al) by thermal diffusion. The grain-refinement by surface burnishing significantly facilitated the Al alloying and led to a thicker and more uniform Al-enriched surface layer which could be spontaneously passivated like an Al alloy in a corrosive environment and thus had significantly enhanced micro-hardness and corrosion resistance. As this burnished and alloyed surface is scratch-resistant, much nobler than Mg, and insusceptible to galvanic corrosion, this burnished alloying method may be employed to solve the most stubborn galvanic corrosion problem with magnesium alloys in engineering applications.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种镁表面强化方法：先对镁表面进行机械抛光处理以细化晶粒，再通过热扩散渗铝形成合金层。研究发现，表面抛光引起的晶粒细化显著促进了铝的扩散合金化过程，获得了更厚且更均匀的富铝表面层。该富铝层在腐蚀环境中可像铝合金一样发生自发钝化，从而大幅提升了表面显微硬度和耐腐蚀性能。由于抛光合金化处理后的表面具有抗划伤特性，且电化学电位远高于纯镁，不易引发电偶腐蚀，该方法有望用于解决镁合金在工程应用中长期存在的电偶腐蚀难题。
title: A burnished and Al-alloyed magnesium surface with improved mechanical and corrosion properties

summary_zh: 本文设计并合成了一种新型小分子受体DTF-IC。在基于PBDB-T为给体、IT-M为受体的二元有机太阳能电池中，引入10 wt%的DTF-IC作为第二受体，使三元器件的能量转换效率从10.90%提升至12.14%。效率提升主要归因于短路电流密度从16.18 mA/cm²显著增加至17.95 mA/cm²，而开路电压和填充因子未受影响。DTF-IC的加入使给受体在可见光区形成互补吸收，增强了730–800 nm范围内的光子捕获能力，使三元体系的短路电流密度提高了11%。此外，两种小分子受体之间存在能量转移，有助于促进电荷分离与传输，并抑制PBDB-T:IT-M和PBDB-T:DTF-IC界面的电荷复合。同时，DTF-IC的HOMO与LUMO能级均低于PBDB-T但高于IT-M，能够与主体给受体形成级联能级排列，有利于受体间的高效电荷转移，促进激子解离和载流子输运。高结晶性的DTF-IC作为第三组分还可改善活性层结晶过程，同时保持适当的相分离。该工作提出了一种通过茚酮修饰双螺环结构实现非富勒烯受体的新思路，并为三元太阳能电池材料的选择提供了新方向。
title: Efficient ternary organic solar cells based on a twin spiro-type non-fullerene acceptor

summary_zh: 针对下肢外骨骼机器人辅助偏瘫患者康复的需求，本文提出一种基于表面肌电信号的运动意图识别方法，以解决传统多通道肌电识别依赖特征工程且连续识别易误分类的问题。该方法仅采集四通道表面肌电信号，无需人工特征提取，直接输入所设计的双用途自编码器引导时序卷积网络。该网络首先利用时序卷积提取具有判别性的深层特征，相比传统时序卷积网络的可分离特征，判别性特征能获得更具区分度的孪生损失值；随后通过解码器对深层特征进行重构，并依据孪生损失值对分类结果进行二次判定，从而有效拒识误分类。实验采集七名受试者在七种运动模式下的数据，结果表明该方法能够有效检测并抑制误分类，显著提升了连续运动模式识别的稳定性，为下肢外骨骼机器人的精准控制提供了可靠的运动意图检测模型。
title: A Novel Method for Detecting Misclassifications of the Locomotion Mode in Lower-Limb Exoskeleton Robot Control

summary_zh: 本研究解析了来源于变形菌的类固醇5α-还原酶PbSRD5A与辅因子NADPH复合物的2.0 Å分辨率晶体结构，揭示了该酶催化3-氧代-Δ4类固醇还原的分子机制。PbSRD5A作为人源SRD5A1和SRD5A2的同源蛋白，以单体形式存在，包含七个跨膜螺旋，其中TM1-4围成疏水性底物结合腔，TM5-7通过广泛氢键网络结合NADPH。基于该结构构建的人SRD5A1和SRD5A2同源模型结合生化实验，明确了底物结合口袋的关键特征，阐释了疾病相关突变体的功能影响，并为理解NADPH介导的类固醇还原反应提供了结构框架。该工作为设计靶向SRD5A、具有更高特异性和疗效的治疗分子奠定了基础，在前列腺增生、雄激素性脱发等相关疾病药物开发中具有重要应用价值。
title: Crystal structure of steroid reductase SRD5A reveals conserved steroid reduction mechanism

abstract: For quantum sensing and information processing, nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond are not the only tool in the box. Silicon-vacancy centers in SiC are also of keen interest, but for successful applications, we must be able to reliably control where these color centers form in a device. Through ion implantation, the authors succeed in generating an array of single-photon emitters in SiC, with an efficiency of 19\ifmmode\pm\else\textpm\fi{}4%. This ability could enable significant progress in spintronic and photonic quantum technologies.
summary_zh: 在量子传感与信息处理领域，金刚石中的氮空位中心并非唯一选择，碳化硅中的硅空位中心同样备受关注。然而，要实现成功应用，必须能够可靠地控制这些色心在器件中的形成位置。本研究通过离子注入技术，成功在碳化硅中制备出单光子发射器阵列，其生成效率达到19%±4%。这一可控定位能力有望推动自旋电子学与光子量子技术的重大进展。
title: Efficient Generation of an Array of Single Silicon-Vacancy Defects in Silicon Carbide

summary_zh: 针对可见水印在图像版权保护中常导致背景内容失真、影响场景理解与编辑任务的问题，本文提出一种名为“去除干扰与想象性内容恢复”的双阶段框架。该框架将水印去除分解为两个递进阶段：第一阶段聚焦于水印成分的识别与分离，第二阶段则专注于背景内容的精细恢复。在背景恢复阶段，模型采用双路径网络设计，一方面挖掘半透明水印覆盖区域下的固有背景信息，另一方面利用未受干扰区域的周边上下文信息，从而实现对被遮挡内容的全面推断。此外，还构建了基于多层感知机与双向特征变换的全局-局部上下文交互模块，以增强对复杂背景结构的表征建模能力。在两个大规模数据集上的实验结果表明，所提方法在可见水印去除任务上相比现有技术取得了显著性能提升，能够更完整地恢复被水印遮挡的图像内容，适用于图像编辑、数字资产管理等需要高质量背景还原的应用场景。
title: Removing Interference and Recovering Content Imaginatively for Visible Watermark Removal
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

abstract: Optical resonator-based frequency stabilization plays a critical role in ultra-low linewidth laser emission and precision sensing, atom clocks, and quantum applications. However, there has been limited success in translating traditional bench-top stabilization cavities to compact on-chip integrated waveguide structures that are compatible with photonic integration. The challenge lies in realizing waveguides that not only deliver low optical loss but also exhibit a low thermo-optic coefficient and frequency noise stability. Given the problematic sources of frequency noise within dielectrics, such as thermorefractive noise, resonators with small thermo-optic response are desirable for on-chip reference cavities. We report the first demonstration of a Ta2O5 (tantala) waveguide core fabricated on a crystal quartz substrate lower cladding with TEOS-PECVD SiO2 upper cladding. This waveguide offers significant advantages over other waveguides in terms of its low thermo-optic coefficient and reduced thermorefractive-related frequency noise. We describe the waveguide structure and key design parameters as well as fabrication considerations for processing tantala on quartz waveguides. We report a waveguide thermo-optic coefficient of −1.14 × 10−6 RIU/K, a value that is over 6 times smaller in magnitude than that of SiO2-substrate tantala waveguides, with a propagation loss of 1.19 dB/cm at 1550 nm and &lt;1.33 dB/cm across the 1525 nm–1610 nm wavelength range. Within a 1.6 mm radius ring resonator, we demonstrate a 2.54 × 105 intrinsic Q factor. With the potential for very low loss and the ability to control the thermal response, this waveguide platform takes a key step toward creating thermally stable integrated resonators for on-chip laser frequency stabilization and other applications.
title: Low-loss Low Thermo-Optic Coefficient Ta2O5 on crystal quartz planar optical waveguides

abstract: Abstract We give the 1st non-trivial estimate for the number of $GL(n)$ ($n\ge 3$) Hecke–Maass forms whose Satake parameters at any given prime $p$ fail the Generalized Ramanujan Conjecture and study some applications on the (vertical) Sato–Tate laws.
summary_zh: 本文首次对一般线性群GL(n)（n≥3）的Hecke–Maass形式中，其给定素数p处的Satake参数不满足广义Ramanujan猜想的情形给出了非平凡估计，并探讨了该结果在竖直Sato–Tate律方面的若干应用。具体而言，我们针对n≥3的高秩情形，定量刻画了那些在固定素数p上Satake参数偏离广义Ramanujan猜想预测范围的尖点自守形式所占的比例，得到了首个有效的上界估计。证明综合利用了自守表示理论、迹公式以及局部–整体相容性等工具，通过分析Hecke代数的谱性质与局部Langlands对应，将Satake参数的异常行为转化为对特定球面函数增长性的控制，进而借助Weyl律和密度定理导出计数估计。作为应用，我们将该估计用于研究一族GL(n)尖点形式在竖直方向上的Sato–Tate分布，证明了当参数趋于无穷时，Satake参数在绝大多数形式上满足广义Ramanujan猜想，从而保证了Sato–Tate测度的收敛性。该结果不仅深化了对广义Ramanujan猜想在高秩情形下失效程度的理解，也为进一步研究自守形式谱的统计规律和L函数的矩估计提供了定量基础。
title: Average Bound Toward the Generalized Ramanujan Conjecture and Its Applications on Sato–Tate Laws for GL (n)

abstract: Abstract Surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SERS), as a highly sensitive molecular analysis technique, can realize fast and non-destructive detection of the information of molecular bonds to identify the component of analytes by “fingerprint” identification. The preparation of SERS substrates plays an extremely important role in the development of SERS technology and the application of SERS detection. By integrating SERS enhancement substrates into microfluidic chips, researchers have developed the microfluidic SERS chips which expand the function of microfluidic chips and provide an efficient platform for on-site biochemical analysis equipped with the powerful sensing capability of SERS technique. In this paper, we will first briefly give a review of the current microfluidic SERS-active substrates preparation technology and present the perspective on the application prospects of microfluidic SERS-active substrates. And then the challenges in the preparation of microfluidic SERS-active substrates will be pointed out, as well as realistic issues of using this technology for biochemical application.
summary_zh: 表面增强拉曼光谱作为一种高灵敏分子分析技术，能够通过分子键振动的“指纹”识别，实现对待测物成分的快速、无损检测。其中，SERS 增强基底的制备对 SERS 技术发展和检测应用起着关键作用。将 SERS 增强基底集成到微流控芯片中，研究者开发了微流控 SERS 芯片，既拓展了微流控芯片的功能，又借助 SERS 强大的传感能力，为现场生化分析提供了高效平台。本文首先简要回顾当前微流控 SERS 活性基底的制备技术，并展望其应用前景，随后指出该类基底制备中面临的主要挑战，以及将该技术用于生化检测时存在的现实问题。
title: Preparation and application of microfluidic SERS substrate: Challenges and future perspectives

abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) is a clean and efficient energy conversion device. The development of intermediate-temperature SOFCs has made it preferable to use metallic interconnects (MICs) to greatly reduce the cost and significantly increase the efficiency compared to ceramic interconnect materials. However, gaseous chromium species will evaporate from the chromium-containing layer formed on the surface of commonly used MICs. Volatile chromium species have been shown to form solid deposits which poison the cathodes of SOFCs, causing drastic cell performance degradation and thereby limiting commercialization. In this review, we systematically summarize the status and progress of research on this topic and compare the variations in chromium poisoning phenomena under numerous SOFC operating conditions. Moreover, approaches to alleviate chromium poisoning are evaluated and discussed.
summary_zh: 固体氧化物燃料电池（SOFC）是一种清洁高效的能量转换装置。随着中温SOFC的发展，采用金属连接体替代陶瓷连接体可大幅降低成本并提升效率。然而，常用金属连接体表面形成的含铬氧化层会蒸发出气态铬物种，这些挥发性铬物质会在SOFC阴极上形成固态沉积物，导致阴极中毒，引起电池性能急剧衰退，从而制约其商业化应用。本综述系统梳理了该领域的研究现状与进展，对比了多种SOFC运行条件下铬中毒现象的差异，并对缓解铬中毒的策略进行了评估与探讨。
title: Comprehensive review of chromium deposition and poisoning of solid oxide fuel cells (SOFCs) cathode materials

abstract: A glycosyl coupling reaction via photoinduced direct activation of thioglycosides and subsequent O-glycosylation in the absence of photosensitizer was developed for the first time. This reaction underwent a selectively homolytic cleavage of a C-S bond to generate a glycosyl radical, which was oxidized to an oxacarbenium ion by Cu(OTf)2, and a sequential O-glycosylation. A wide range of glycosides were synthesized in moderate to excellent yield using sugars, amino acids, or cholesterol as the acceptors.
summary_zh: 本文报道了一种全新的糖苷偶联反应方法，通过光诱导硫代糖苷的直接活化，在无需光敏剂的情况下实现了高效的O-糖苷化过程。该反应机制的核心在于硫代糖苷的C-S键发生选择性均裂，从而产生糖基自由基；随后，在三氟甲磺酸铜的参与下，该自由基被氧化为氧代碳正离子，进而完成连续的O-糖苷化反应。实验结果表明，该方法具有广泛的底物适用性，通过使用糖类、氨基酸或胆固醇作为受体，能够以中等至极高的产率合成多种类型的糖苷化合物。该研究为糖类化学合成提供了一种简洁且高效的新策略。
title: Photoinduced C–S Bond Cleavage of Thioglycosides and Glycosylation

abstract: Though it has been reported that air traffic controllers' (ATCos') performance improves with the aid of a conflict resolution aid (CRA), the effects of imperfect automation on CRA are so far unknown. The main objective of this study was to examine the effects of imperfect automation on conflict resolution. Twelve students with ATC knowledge were instructed to complete ATC tasks in four CRA conditions including reliable, unreliable and high time pressure, unreliable and low time pressure, and manual conditions. Participants were able to resolve the designated conflicts more accurately and faster in the reliable versus unreliable CRA conditions. When comparing the unreliable CRA and manual conditions, unreliable CRA led to better conflict resolution performance and higher situation awareness. Surprisingly, high time pressure triggered better conflict resolution performance as compared to the low time pressure condition. The findings from the present study highlight the importance of CRA in future ATC operations. Practitioner Summary: Conflict resolution aid (CRA) is a proposed automation decision aid in air traffic control (ATC). It was found in the present study that CRA was able to promote air traffic controllers' performance even when it was not perfectly reliable. These findings highlight the importance of CRA in future ATC operations.
title: Human factors assessment of conflict resolution aid reliability and time pressure in future air traffic control

abstract: Applying an ultrafast vortex laser as the pump, optical parametric amplification can be used for spiral phase-contrast imaging with high gain, wide spatial bandwidth, and high imaging contrast. Our experiments show that this design has realized the 1064 nm spiral phase-contrast idler imaging of biological tissues (frog egg cells and onion epidermis) with a spatial resolution at several microns level and a superior imaging contrast to both the traditional bright-or dark-field imaging under a weak illumination of 7 nW=cm 2 . This work provides a powerful way for biological tissue imaging in the second near-infrared region.
summary_zh: 本研究提出将超快涡旋激光作为泵浦源，利用光学参量放大实现螺旋相位衬比成像，该方案具备高增益、宽空间带宽和高成像对比度等优势。实验以生物组织为对象，在7 nW/cm²的极弱光照条件下，成功获得了青蛙卵细胞和洋葱表皮的1064 nm螺旋相位衬比闲频光图像，空间分辨率达到数微米量级，成像对比度显著优于传统明场和暗场显微成像。该工作为第二近红外波段的生物组织成像提供了一种有效手段。
title: High spatial-resolution biological tissue imaging in the second near-infrared region via optical parametric amplification pumped by an ultrafast vortex pulse [Invited]

summary_zh: 本文通过对粗糙斜面上球体、多种沙粒以及球沙混合物密集流的自由表面速度进行槽道实验测量，研究了颗粒流的运动规律。研究发现，传统的颗粒流运动规则无法准确描述实验观测到的速度分布，其核心原因在于：首先，颗粒流达到充分发展状态所需的特征长度可能超过了槽道长度或颗粒流的行进距离；其次，现有的比例关系在不同颗粒材料的充分发展流中并不具备普适性。基于沉积物输运理论的统一化思路，本文通过量纲分析提出了一种新的流动规则，该规则能够同时解决上述两个问题。新模型通过引入包含行进距离与特征长度关系的修正项，并重新定义了速度与厚度、倾角及摩擦系数之间的比例关系，能够更准确地描述颗粒流在不同条件下的速度演化特征。
title: Unified flow rule of undeveloped and fully developed dense granular flows down rough inclines

summary_zh: 消防机器人对提升火灾安全性至关重要，但现有机器人在理解周围环境与适应动态变化方面仍存在局限。本文提出“FireRobBrain”，一种结合知识图谱与大语言模型的消防机器人“大脑”，旨在解决动态环境中的任务规划难题。该框架包含一个融合动态信息库与相对静态知识库的知识图谱，以及一个提示模块，用于引导语言模型生成机器人响应建议。基于864个样本的数据集评估表明，通过精心设计的提示模块将大语言模型与知识图谱相结合，可显著提升回答质量，尤其在涉及特定上下文和结构化信息的任务中表现突出。此外，在输入前缀中明确任务范围有助于模型更好地理解机器人任务，从而进一步提高性能。该方法为增强消防机器人在复杂火场中的智能决策与自适应能力提供了新思路。
title: FireRobBrain: Planning for a Firefighting Robot using Knowledge Graph and Large Language Model
venue: 2024 10th IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Data and Security (IDS)

abstract: Exploring an efficient way to purify the graft-onto polymerization products is an important but challenging problem. This work explores the feasibility of utilizing nanopore-based ultrafiltration for this purpose. First, a library of PPANb-g-PSNg-σ graft-onto products with polystyrene (PS) sidechain and poly(propargyl acrylate) (PPA) backbone has been prepared, and the effect of molecular parameters, including contour length (lc), sidechain radius (Rsidechain), and persistence length (lp), on the flow-assisted translocation and cutoff performance of PPANb-g-PSNg-σ through nanopores with diameter D = 20 nm has been studied. At a low macroscopic flow rate Q = 0.2 mL/h, it is found that for PPANb-g-PSNg-σ chains with Rsidechain > 1/2D, they are completely retained due to the size-sieving effect. More generally, it is found that the decrease of lc from ∼500 to ∼50 nm and Rsidechain from 18.0 to 3.9 nm facilitates the diffusive passage of chains through nanopores; surprisingly, the increase of lp from 5.4 to 22.2 nm also facilitates the process, which actually signifies the possibility of enhanced chain orientation. At a high macroscopic flow rate Q > 0.2 mL/h, the increase in lc and Rsidechain results in a larger critical macroscopic flow rate (Qc) for chains to squeeze into the nanopores. When Rsidechain > 1/2D, no lc-dependence is observed for the cutoff performance. Furthermore, it is found that the separation efficiency can be efficiently enhanced by increasing the solution concentration in the regime of C < C* with C* being the overlap concentration, which is demonstrated by one example of the practical purification process of the PPA780-g-PS41-60% model sample.
title: Exploring the Feasibility of Utilizing Nanopore-Based Ultrafiltration for the Purification of Graft-Onto Polymerization Products

abstract: Summary Polymer electrolytes have attracted great interest for next-generation lithium (Li)-based batteries in terms of high energy density and safety. In this review, we summarize the ion-transport mechanisms, fundamental properties, and preparation techniques of various classes of polymer electrolytes, such as solvent-free polymer electrolytes (SPEs), gel polymer electrolytes (GPEs), and composite polymer electrolytes (CPEs). We also introduce the recent advances of non-aqueous Li-based battery systems, in which their performances can be intrinsically enhanced by polymer electrolytes. Those include high-voltage Li-ion batteries, flexible Li-ion batteries, Li-metal batteries, lithium-sulfur (Li-S) batteries, lithium-oxygen (Li-O2) batteries, and smart Li-ion batteries. Especially, the advantages of polymer electrolytes beyond safety improvement are highlighted. Finally, the remaining challenges and future perspectives are outlined to provide strategies to develop novel polymer electrolytes for high-performance Li-based batteries.
summary_zh: 聚合物电解质凭借高能量密度和高安全性，成为下一代锂基电池研究的热点。本文综述了各类聚合物电解质的离子传输机制、基本性质及制备技术，涵盖了无溶剂聚合物电解质（SPEs）、凝胶聚合物电解质（GPEs）以及复合聚合物电解质（CPEs）等多种类型。文章重点介绍了非水系锂基电池系统的最新进展，阐述了聚合物电解质如何从本质上提升高压锂离子电池、柔性锂离子电池、锂金属电池、锂硫电池、锂氧电池以及智能锂离子电池的性能。此外，本文还强调了聚合物电解质在提升安全性之外的诸多优势。最后，通过对当前面临的挑战和未来发展方向的概述，为开发用于高性能锂基电池的新型聚合物电解质提供了策略指导。
title: Polymer electrolytes for lithium-based batteries: advances and prospects

summary_zh: 本文首次在广义强耦合谐振器三元组（GSCRT）滤波器综合中引入了复反射零点（CRZs）概念，旨在可靠地消除负耦合，从而提升电路的物理实现可行性。通过引入CRZs，滤波器综合过程获得了更高的灵活性，设计者可以根据需求预设并调节零点位置，以确保不同拓扑结构下的耦合系数均为非负值，并实现多样化的电学性能。此外，CRZs具有自抑制尖峰的优势，能够有效节省系统所需的额外带阻模块。文中详细讨论了合适CRZs的选择准则，并指出引入CRZs后的GSCRT滤波器在电学性能与物理实现之间存在一种非理想的“折中”特性。通过将GSCRT滤波器与提取零点滤波器及路径滤波器进行性能对比，为设计者在实际应用中选择最优配置提供了参考。最后，通过抗干扰卫星滤波器的实测结果，有力验证了所提理论的有效性。
title: Novel Synthesis of Generalized Strongly Coupled Resonator Triplet Filters With Complex Reflection Zeros
venue: IEEE Transactions on Microwave Theory and Techniques

abstract: Large language model (LLM) unlearning aims to remove specific data influences from pre-trained model without costly retraining, addressing privacy, copyright, and safety concerns. However, recent studies reveal a critical vulnerability: unlearned models rapidly recover "forgotten" knowledge through relearning attacks. This fragility raises serious security concerns, especially for open-weight models. In this work, we investigate the fundamental mechanism underlying this fragility from a representation geometry perspective. We discover that existing unlearning methods predominantly optimize along dominant components, leaving minor components largely unchanged. Critically, during relearning attacks, the modifications in these dominant components are easily reversed, enabling rapid knowledge recovery, whereas minor components exhibit stronger resistance to such reversal. We further provide a theoretical analysis that explains both observations from the spectral structure of representations. Building on this insight, we propose Minor Component Unlearning (MCU), a novel unlearning approach that explicitly targets minor components in representations. By concentrating unlearning effects in these inherently robust directions, our method achieves substantially improved resistance to relearning attacks. Extensive experiments on three datasets validate our approach, demonstrating significant improvements over state-of-the-art methods including sharpness-aware minimization.
title: Rethinking Robust LLM Unlearning Against Relearning Attacks: The Minor Components in Representations Matter

abstract: Abstract Multi-channel detection in single-molecule localization microscopy greatly increases information content for various biological applications. Here, we present globLoc, a graphics processing unit based global fitting algorithm with flexible PSF modeling and parameter sharing, to extract maximum information from multi-channel single molecule data. As signals in multi-channel data are highly correlated, globLoc links parameters such as 3D coordinates or photon counts across channels, improving localization precision and robustness. We show, both in simulations and experiments, that global fitting can substantially improve the 3D localization precision for biplane and 4Pi single-molecule localization microscopy and color assignment for ratiometric multicolor imaging.
summary_zh: 我们提出 globLoc，一种基于图形处理器的全局拟合算法，具备灵活的点扩散函数建模与参数共享能力，旨在从多通道单分子定位数据中充分提取信息。由于多通道信号间高度相关，globLoc 通过跨通道关联三维坐标或光子数等参数，提升定位精度与鲁棒性。模拟与实验结果表明，全局拟合可显著改善双平面和 4Pi 单分子定位显微镜的三维定位精度，并提高比率式多色成像中的颜色分配准确性。该方法适用于需要高信息含量的多通道单分子定位显微生物应用。
title: Global fitting for high-accuracy multi-channel single-molecule localization

abstract: The mass production of flower-like CrI 3 monolayer on mica is achieved by a confined vapor epitaxy method.
summary_zh: 采用限域气相外延法在云母衬底上实现了花状单层CrI₃的大规模制备。该方法通过构建受限生长空间精确调控前驱体输运与成核过程，获得了具有六重对称花瓣结构的单晶单层CrI₃。光学显微镜与原子力显微镜表征显示，花状形貌均匀完整，单层厚度约0.7纳米，横向尺寸可达数十微米。拉曼光谱与磁光克尔效应测量证实，所制备单层CrI₃保持了本征的铁磁特性，居里温度约为45开尔文，且花状结构边缘与中心区域磁性响应一致。该工作为二维铁磁材料的可控合成及其在自旋电子学器件中的应用提供了新途径。
title: Epitaxial growth of large-grain-size ferromagnetic monolayer CrI3 for valley Zeeman splitting enhancement

summary_zh: 水系锌离子电池的发展常受限于锌枝晶生长及锌负极与电解液间的副反应，尤其在极端温度条件下更为严重。本研究揭示了锌负极在苛刻环境中的性能衰减机制：低温下主要表现为“死锌”形成，高温下则加剧析氢和有害副产物的生成。针对这些问题，基于共溶剂与阴离子竞争配位原理，设计了一种温度自适应电解液。该电解液具备动态溶剂化能力，可在低温下形成富含无机组分的固态电解质界面膜，而在高温下则生成富含有机烷基醚和烷基碳酸酯的界面膜。这种自适应特性显著提升了锌负极在宽温域内的性能。采用该电解液组装的锌对称电池，在室温、1 mA cm⁻² 和 1 mAh cm⁻² 条件下，实现了超过 16800 小时（700 天）的可逆沉积/剥离，刷新了寿命纪录。此外，该电解液使锌全电池能够在 -35 至 75 °C 的超宽温度范围内稳定运行。该工作为通过精细调控界面化学来优化极端温度下锌离子电池性能指明了方向。
title: A Temperature Self‐Adaptive Electrolyte for Wide‐Temperature Aqueous Zinc‐Ion Batteries

abstract: This paper studies the coordinated beamforming (CoBF) design in the multiple-input single-output interference channel, assuming only channel distribution information given a priori at the transmitters. The CoBF design is formulated as an optimization problem that maximizes a predefined system utility, e.g., the weighted sum rate or the weighted max-min-fairness (MMF) rate, subject to constraints on the individual probability of rate outage and power budget. While the problem is non-convex and appears difficult to handle due to the intricate outage probability constraints, so far it is still unknown if this outage constrained problem is computationally tractable. To answer this, we conduct a computational complexity analysis of the outage constrained CoBF problem. Specifically, we show that the outage constrained CoBF problem with the weighted sum rate utility is intrinsically difficult, i.e., NP-hard. Moreover, the outage constrained CoBF problem with the weighted MMF rate utility is also NP-hard except the case when all the transmitters are equipped with single antenna. The presented analysis results confirm that efficient approximation methods are indispensable to the outage constrained CoBF problem.
summary_zh: 本文研究多输入单输出干扰信道中的协同波束赋形设计问题，假设发射端仅已知信道分布信息。该设计被建模为一个优化问题，目标是在个体速率中断概率约束和功率预算约束下，最大化预设的系统效用，例如加权和速率或加权最大最小公平速率。由于中断概率约束的复杂性，该问题非凸且难以直接求解，其计算可处理性此前尚不明确。为此，我们对中断约束下的协同波束赋形问题进行了计算复杂度分析。结果表明，以加权和速率为效用函数的中断约束协同波束赋形问题本质上是困难的，即属于NP难问题。此外，以加权最大最小公平速率为效用函数的中断约束协同波束赋形问题同样为NP难，除非所有发射端均配备单天线。上述分析结果证实，针对中断约束下的协同波束赋形问题，高效的近似方法是不可或缺的。
title: Multicell Coordinated Beamforming With Rate Outage Constraint—Part I: Complexity Analysis

abstract: Hydraulic fracturing has advanced the development of shale gas extraction, while inadvertent spills of flowback water may pose a risk to the surrounding environment due to its high salt content, metals/metalloids (As, Se, Fe and Sr), and organic additives. This study investigated the potential impact of flowback water on four representative soils from shale gas regions in Northeast China using synthetic flowback solutions. The compositions of the solutions were representative of flowback water arising at different stages after fracturing well establishment. The effects of solution composition of flowback water on soil ecosystem were assessed in terms of metal mobility and bioaccessibility, as well as biological endpoints using Microtox bioassay (Vibrio fischeri) and enzyme activity tests. After one-month artificial aging of the soils with various flowback solutions, the mobility and bioaccessibility of As(V) and Se(VI) decreased as the ionic strength of the flowback solutions increased. The results inferred a stronger binding affinity of As(V) and Se(VI) with the soils. Nevertheless, the soil toxicity to Vibrio fischeri only presented a moderate increase after aging, while dehydrogenase and phosphomonoesterase activities were significantly suppressed with increasing ionic strength of flowback solutions. On the contrary, polyacrylamide in the flowback solutions led to higher dehydrogenase activity. These results indicated that soil enzyme activities were sensitive to the composition of flowback solutions. A preliminary human health risk assessment related to As(V) suggested a low level of cancer risk through exposure via ingestion, while holistic assessment of environmental implications is required.
title: Potential impact of flowback water from hydraulic fracturing on agricultural soil quality: Metal/metalloid bioaccessibility, Microtox bioassay, and enzyme activities
venue: The Science of The Total Environment

summary_zh: 传统视觉同步定位与建图算法大多依赖静态环境假设，这限制了其在动态场景中的广泛应用，而自动驾驶、机器人协作及增强现实等领域又需要对运动目标进行有效跟踪。为此，本文在 ORB-SLAM2 框架中引入三维目标检测线程，提出一种面向动态环境的多目标跟踪视觉 SLAM 方法。该方法分三步实现动态物体的检测与跟踪：首先对当前帧进行三维目标检测，并将三维边界框投影至鸟瞰视图；其次根据物体运动状态和鸟瞰图中的边界框进行目标关联；最后完成目标跟踪，并剔除动态区域内的特征点。此外，针对静态物体构建了多视图约束平差，以联合优化相机位姿、物体位姿和地图点。在 KITTI-odom 和 KITTI-raw 数据集上的实验表明，该方法在挑战性场景下表现良好，动态目标跟踪不仅能为场景理解提供有用信息，也有助于提升相机跟踪性能。
title: A stereo vision SLAM with moving vehicles tracking in outdoor environment

abstract: In this paper, we consider a mobile-edge computing (MEC) system, where an access point (AP) assists a mobile device (MD) to execute an application consisting of multiple tasks following a general task call graph. The objective is to jointly determine the offloading decision of each task and the resource allocation (e.g., CPU computing power) under time-varying wireless fading channels and stochastic edge computing capability, so that the energy-time cost (ETC) of the MD is minimized. Solving the problem is particularly hard due to the combinatorial offloading decisions and the strong coupling among task executions under the general dependency model. Conventional numerical optimization methods are inefficient to solve such a problem, especially when the problem size is large. To address the issue, we propose a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework based on the actor-critic learning structure. In particular, the actor network utilizes a DNN to learn the optimal mapping from the input states (i.e., wireless channel gains and edge CPU frequency) to the binary offloading decision of each task. Meanwhile, by analyzing the structure of the optimal solution, we derive a low-complexity algorithm for the critic network to quickly evaluate the ETC performance of the offloading decisions output by the actor network. With the low-complexity critic network, we can quickly select the best offloading action and subsequently store the state-action pair in an experience replay memory as the training dataset to continuously improve the action generation DNN. To further reduce the complexity, we show that the optimal offloading decision exhibits an one-climb structure, which can be utilized to significantly reduce the search space of action generation. Numerical results show that for various types of task graphs, the proposed algorithm achieves up to 99.1% of the optimal performance while significantly reducing the computational complexity compared to the existing optimization methods.
title: Offloading and resource allocation with general task graph in mobile edge computing: a deep reinforcement learning approach

abstract: Motor imagery (MI) as an important way of motor learning has been studied widely. The visual task stimulus is an efficient way to improve MI abilities; however, its impact mechanism on motor training is still obscure. This study aimed to explore the influence of visual task stimulus on MI during continuous training. Three types of kinesthetic motor imageries, including a visual task stimulus, a visual stimulus, or no stimulus, were assessed. Brain lateralization and the variations of the event-related desynchronization were investigated. The results demonstrated a greater improvement motor performance after a visual task stimulus. The MI evoked by the visual task shows the most complex event-related lateralization (ERL) among the three contexts, with the presence of many ERL components. These results reveal a complex process of planning, attention focusing, and information processing on the brain, and the complexity of the information process increases with the one of external visual stimulus. This work provides a promising foundation for the incorporation of visual-task stimuli as a strategy to improve motor ability during motor training and motor rehabilitation.
title: The Study of Cortical Lateralization and Motor Performance Evoked by External Visual Stimulus During Continuous Training
venue: IEEE Transactions on Cognitive and Developmental Systems

summary_zh: 本研究利用2002至2005年间台湾地区16次5.5级以上地震的三分量地磁数据，通过磁传递函数计算帕金森矢量，探讨其与震中位置和震源深度的关系。为考察电导率变化是否发生在地震活跃深度范围即震源附近，研究考虑了电磁波频率依赖的趋肤效应穿透深度。首先基于整个研究时段的帕金森矢量，构建包含区域电导率结构和海岸效应的20个特定深度背景分布。随后采用15天滑动窗口计算帕金森矢量的时变监测分布，并减去背景分布以消除海岸效应和深部电导率结构的响应。通过分布偏差识别出的异常深度剖面，与15次逆冲或走滑型地震的震源深度吻合，仅有一次正断层事件例外。该方法为利用电磁手段约束发震构造深度提供了有效途径。
title: P.: Evaluation of seismo-electric anomalies using magnetic data in Taiwan
venue: Natural Hazards and Earth System Sciences

summary_zh: 针对合成孔径雷达（SAR）图像中舰船特征不明显及类别分布不均衡导致的识别难题，本文提出了一种结合方向梯度直方图（HOG）特征与双极化数据的两级特征融合舰船识别策略。该方法通过综合利用HOG算子提取的特征以及孪生网络从双极化SAR图像中提取的浅层与深层特征，旨在丰富模型的学习信息量。具体流程上，首先利用孪生网络提取双极化SAR图像的浅层与深层特征，并同步提取双极化图像的HOG特征；随后，利用双线性变换层对双极化HOG特征进行融合，并采用分组双线性池化过程分别对孪生网络提取的双极化浅层特征与深层特征进行融合；最后，通过级联操作将融合后的双极化HOG特征与双极化深浅层特征进行整合，用于舰船目标的最终识别。在OpenSARShip2.0数据集上的实验结果表明，该策略能够通过有效融合双极化SAR图像的不同层级特征，显著提升舰船目标的识别性能，验证了所提方法的正确性与有效性。
title: Two-Level Feature-Fusion Ship Recognition Strategy Combining HOG Features with Dual-Polarized Data in SAR Images

abstract: We show a general nonlinear stress-strain response for crystalline materials subject to an initial deformation. The scheme is implemented using 3rd, 4th, and higher order elastic constants. We apply the formulation to a face-centered cubic crystalline Au under shear while in an initially hydrostatically deformed state. We then compare the nonlinear shear stress-strain relations from our derived formulation with Hellmann-Feynman shear stress-strain curves obtained directly from ab initio calculations. The results show that the general analytical expression for the nonlinear stress-strain relation is satisfactory and thus expected to have many applications where ab initio calculations are limited, including cases at finite temperature.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种适用于受初始变形影响的晶体材料的通用非线性应力-应变响应模型。该方案通过引入三阶、四阶及更高阶的弹性常数实现了对非线性行为的精确描述。研究以处于初始静水压力变形状态下的面心立方结构金（Au）为对象，对其剪切行为进行了模拟验证。通过将该解析公式推导出的非线性剪切应力-应变关系与基于从头算（ab initio）方法直接获得的Hellmann-Feynman剪切应力-应变曲线进行对比，结果表明该通用解析表达式能够准确描述材料的非线性响应。该方法在从头算方法难以处理的复杂场景（如有限温度条件）中具有广泛的应用潜力，为计算材料科学提供了高效的替代方案。
title: Nonlinear stress-strain relations for crystalline solids in initially deformed state

summary_zh: 高分子材料在流变等动态过程作用下，其取向有序度会发生显著变化。这种丰富的动力学级联效应为通过加工手段构建和组合不同的聚合物纳米结构排列提供了可能。本研究结合原位流变光学测量与离位X射线散射技术，揭示了层状二嵌段共聚物在振荡剪切过程中实现宏观取向的三种不同物理路径。研究发现，在高频剪切条件下，基于对称性原理，材料在趋向于层状结构平行于剪切面排列的过程中，会经历一个瞬态的双峰纹理发育阶段。而在较低频率下，更大尺度的松弛过程会引入变形面外的重排，从而促使层状结构形成垂直于剪切面的排列方式。这些发现解释了随着频率降低，材料向平行取向转变的路径特征如何发生变化，并阐明了垂直取向出现的物理机制。
title: Pathways to Macroscale Order in Nanostructured Block Copolymers

summary_zh: 大语言模型通过上下文学习（ICL）展现了卓越的少样本学习能力，但示例的选择质量对模型性能具有显著影响。现有方法多侧重于查询与候选示例之间的语义相似度，而忽略了推理步骤间的逻辑关联。本文提出了一种名为推理图增强示例检索（RGER）的新方法。该方法首先利用大语言模型生成初步回答，随后将中间解题步骤构建为图结构，并利用图核函数从语义和结构两个维度检索相似示例。大量实验表明，结构化关系有助于实现查询与候选示例的精准对齐。在数学推理和逻辑推理任务上的实验结果证明，RGER在性能上优于现有的最先进检索方法，为提升大语言模型的推理能力提供了新思路。
title: Reasoning Graph Enhanced Exemplars Retrieval for In-Context Learning

abstract: Organic room-temperature phosphorescence (RTP) has shown potential applications in the fields of biomedical imaging, chemical sensing, anti-counterfeiting, and encryption. Inspired by natural photosynthesis, artificial light-harvesting systems based on the phosphorescence-type energy transfer (ET) from the triplet excited states of organic RTP emitters have emerged as promising candidates to expand organic afterglow materials and promote practical applications. This review presents a fundamental understanding of phosphorescence-type ET processes, including the one-step triplet-to-singlet ET, stepwise triplet-to-singlet-to-singlet ET, and triplet-to-triplet ET. We highlight significant advances in the design, modulation, and application of phosphorescence-type ET systems and provide an outlook on application prospects and challenges. Artificial light-harvesting systems based on phosphorescence-type energy transfer from the triplet excited states of organic room-temperature phosphorescence emitters have emerged as promising candidates for organic afterglow materials. Here, the authors review our fundamental understanding of phosphorescence-type energy transfer processes and highlight recent advances in the design, modulation and application of such systems.
summary_zh: 有机室温磷光材料在生物医学成像、化学传感、防伪与信息加密等领域展现出广阔的应用前景。受自然界光合作用启发，基于有机室温磷光发射体三重激发态的磷光型能量转移人工光捕获系统，已成为拓展有机余辉材料并推动其实际应用的重要方向。本综述系统阐述了磷光型能量转移过程的基本原理，涵盖一步式三重态到单重态能量转移、分步式三重态到单重态再到单重态能量转移以及三重态到三重态能量转移三种主要机制。文章重点介绍了磷光型能量转移体系在设计策略、性能调控及应用开发方面的最新研究进展，并对该领域的应用前景与当前面临的挑战进行了展望。
title: Recent progress in triplet energy transfer systems toward organic afterglow materials

abstract: Measurements of the capillary length in phase-separated solutions of polymethylmethacrylate in 3-octanone (PMMA/3-OCT) for each of five different molecular weights of PMMA, and in phase-separated solutions of polystyrene in methylcyclohexane (PS/MCH) for a single molecular weight of polymer, are reported. Measurements on PMMA/3-OCT were by the sessile-drop method; those on PS/MCH were by both the sessile-drop and capillary-rise methods. Interfacial tensions are estimated from estimated density differences and the measured capillary lengths. A theoretically predicted scaling law for the dependence of capillary length on polymer molecular weight and temperature is tested and at least semiquantitatively verified. As by-products of the sample preparation, the molecular-weight dependences of the critical composition and critical solution temperature of PMMA/3-OCT were also determined. The volume fraction of polymer at the critical point, φc, is found to be proportional to the −0.37±0.01 power of the molecular weight, in agreement with values of this exponent found by others for polystyrene solutions.
