summary_zh: 本文研究了聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯/3-辛酮（PMMA/3-OCT）及聚苯乙烯/甲基环己烷（PS/MCH）相分离溶液中的毛细长度。研究通过对五种不同分子量的PMMA以及单一分子量的PS进行实验，分别采用 sessile-drop 法和毛细上升法进行了测量。通过测得的毛细长度与估算的密度差，进一步推算了界面张力。实验结果对毛细长度随聚合物分子量及温度变化的理论标度律进行了验证，并实现了半定量的证实。此外，研究还测定了PMMA/3-OCT体系中临界组成与临界溶液温度随分子量的变化规律。结果表明，临界点处的聚合物体积分数φc与分子量的-0.37±0.01次方成正比，这一指数结果与此前关于聚苯乙烯溶液的研究结论保持一致。
title: Interfacial tensions of phase-separated polymer solutions

abstract: The concept of synergy has drawn attention and been applied to lower limb assistive devices such as exoskeletons and prostheses for improving human–machine interaction. A better understanding of the influence of gait kinematics on synergies and a better synergy-modeling method are important for device design and improvement. To this end, gait data from healthy, amputee, and stroke subjects were collected. First, continuous relative phase (CRP) was used to quantify their synergies and explore the influence of kinematics. Second, long short-term memory (LSTM) and principal component analysis (PCA) were adopted to model interlimb synergy and intralimb synergy, respectively. The results indicate that the limited hip and knee range of motions (RoMs) in stroke patients and amputees significantly influence their synergies in different ways. In interlimb synergy modeling, LSTM (RMSE: 0.798° (hip) and 1.963° (knee)) has lower errors than PCA (RMSE: 5.050° (hip) and 10.353° (knee)), which is frequently used in the literature. Further, in intralimb synergy modeling, LSTM (RMSE: 3.894°) enables better synergy modeling than PCA (RMSE: 10.312°). In conclusion, stroke patients and amputees perform different compensatory mechanisms to adapt to new interlimb and intralimb synergies different from healthy people. LSTM has better synergy modeling and shows a promise for generating trajectories in line with the wearer’s motion for lower limb assistive devices.
title: Gait Synergy Analysis and Modeling on Amputees and Stroke Patients for Lower Limb Assistive Devices

abstract: In this paper the potential of the modulated model predictive control (MMPC) to control a matrix converter (MC) in the linear- and over-modulation zone is investigated. Input and output current references of MC are usually used to define the control objective in MMPC. By considering the predicted input and output currents of MC, a conventional space current vector modulation equation can be formed. As a result, control of the load and supply currents, good steady state performance and fixed switching frequency are achieved in the linear zone. Moreover, the transition time between the linear- and over-modulation modes is minimized by considering a new reference vector through a simple calculation. The feasibility of proposed method is demonstrated by simulation results and proved that the resulted controller includes the advantages of model predictive control (MPC) and space vector modulation (SVM) and effectively working in the different modes of operation.
title: Over-modulation Method of Modulated Model Predictive Control for Matrix Converters
venue: IECON 2020 The 46th Annual Conference of the IEEE Industrial Electronics Society

summary_zh: 社交网络分析用于提取人类社群特征，在诸多科学领域发挥着重要作用。社交网络数据集通常规模庞大，对于不熟悉并行编程的研究人员而言，将计算部署在云端并行平台上的数据分析服务成为一种理想选择。在云环境中，高效数据分析面临的主要挑战是由人类群体行为（如从众效应）引发的计算与通信倾斜，即计算机节点间的负载不均衡。传统负载均衡技术要么需要大量额外工作来重新平衡节点负载，要么难以有效应对滞后节点。本文提出一种通用的滞后感知执行方法 SAE，用于支持云端社交网络分析服务。该方法采用新颖的计算分解策略，将滞后的特征提取过程细分为更细粒度的子过程，并将其分布到计算机集群上并行执行。实验结果表明，与现有先进方案相比，SAE 可将分析速度提升最高 1.77 倍。
title: SAE: Toward Efficient Cloud Data Analysis Service for Large-Scale Social Networks

abstract: We consider a production-inventory system in which production relies on a self-renewable natural resource. The resource regenerates at a rate that depends on its current stock as well as random environmental factors. In each period, the firm decides on the production quantity, facing stochastic demand and limited resource. This type of system is common in industries such as fishing and logging. We model the resource’s self-renewal using a generating function and formulate the production optimization problem as a dynamic program. We find that because of the renewable nature of the resource, the optimal stock level does not necessarily increase with the available resource quantity, and could become higher than the optimal stock level for a benchmark system where resource is unlimited. In a special case with deterministic demand and environment, we show that it could be optimal to halt production even with zero inventory left, in order to preserve the growth of resource. On the other hand, it could also be optimal to raise the inventory level to be higher than demand, when overpopulation becomes an issue. Moreover, a higher market price, which stems from adverse environmental conditions and signals lower future yields, can incentivize the firm to reduce production and conserve resources for future growth. In a deterministic environment where the inventory is fully perishable, we analytically characterize the long-run dynamics of the resource quantity. In particular, sustainable production is more achievable for low-margin products, and a myopic production firm does not necessarily deplete the resource. We conduct numerical experiments using real-world salmon population data to test the robustness of our findings in general systems with stochastic environment and non-perishable products. The results show that ignoring either the resource constraint or the self-renewal dynamics, could lead to high operational costs and undermine resource sustainability.
title: Dynamic Management of Self-Renewable Resources in Production-Inventory Systems

summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种基于细菌纤维素这一低成本生物质原料，通过规模化工艺制备碳纳米纤维气凝胶的方法。细菌纤维素可通过工业微生物发酵过程大量获取，为气凝胶的宏量制备提供了可行路径。所制得的碳纳米纤维气凝胶呈现黑色块状宏观形貌，具备高度多孔的网络结构。实验表明，该材料对有机溶剂表现出优异的吸收能力，能够快速吸附并容纳大量红色有机液体，显示出在有机溶剂泄漏处理、环境修复等领域的应用潜力。此外，该气凝胶还展现出良好的压敏特性，有望作为压力传感器件使用，在可穿戴电子、柔性传感等方面具有广阔前景。该研究实现了从廉价生物质原料出发，通过绿色发酵与碳化工艺，构建兼具高吸收性能与压敏响应功能的多孔碳纳米纤维气凝胶材料，为生物质基功能材料的大规模生产和多功能应用提供了新思路。
title: Ultralight, Flexible, and Fire‐Resistant Carbon Nanofiber Aerogels from Bacterial Cellulose

summary_zh: 本文提出一种通过电荷反转诊疗一体化策略全面优化肿瘤内芬顿反应因素的方法，以实现可示踪的多级增强化学动力学治疗。研究以定制化的pH响应性聚乙二醇-聚β-氨基酯胶束为载体，共载葡萄糖氧化酶、亚铁离子及pH响应性近红外二区荧光探针，构建诊疗一体化纳米系统。其中，亚铁离子通过与聚合物不饱和配位保持其亚稳态活性。在肿瘤微酸性环境中，载体发生电荷反转阳离子化，促进纳米系统在肿瘤部位蓄积并暴露亚铁离子；同时葡萄糖氧化酶催化生成大量过氧化氢并进一步降低局部pH，从而协同增强电荷反转效果。该策略同步优化了芬顿反应的关键限速因素——亚铁离子供给、过氧化氢浓度及酸性条件，在体外与体内实验中均实现了显著增强的化学动力学治疗效果。该研究为解决当前化学动力学治疗的内在缺陷提供了一种全面优化肿瘤内芬顿反应条件的新思路。
title: Comprehensively Optimizing Fenton Reaction Factors for Antitumor Chemodynamic Therapy by Charge-Reversal Theranostics

summary_zh: 人类21号染色体三体综合征（唐氏综合征）是一种复杂的发育及神经退行性疾病，但由于该染色体非整倍体区域包含大量功能未知的基因，其分子机制的研究面临巨大挑战。本研究旨在通过探究21号染色体蛋白的亚细胞定位，深入理解相关基因的功能与调控机制。研究人员采用转染细胞阵列技术，针对覆盖21q大部分区域的89个基因（范围从RBM11至MCM3AP）进行了快速且低成本的胞内分布分析。研究过程中，将这些基因的开放阅读框克隆至带有N端His6标签的哺乳动物表达载体中，通过玻璃载玻片阵列化并反向转染至HEK293T细胞，随后利用细胞器标记物检测蛋白的共定位情况。研究结果成功解析了52种蛋白的亚细胞定位特性，其中34种蛋白的定位信息系首次被报道；此外，研究还表征了claudin-8和claudin-14基因过表达导致的细胞形态与生长改变。该基于细胞阵列的蛋白表达与检测方法为大规模功能分析（包括蛋白定位和细胞表型筛选）提供了一个高效平台，其发现的21号染色体蛋白新功能特征有助于进一步揭示唐氏综合征的分子病理机制。
title: Cell array-based intracellular localization screening reveals novel functional features of human chromosome 21 proteins

abstract: Abstract Several mechanisms have been proposed to interpret the widely reported phenomenon of Mg corrosion that the hydrogen evolution rate increases with increasing anodic potential or anodic current density. This paper critically analyzed the two main mechanisms, (1) “the incomplete film univalent Mg+ ion mechanism” and (2) “the enhanced catalytic activity mechanism”, aiming to clarify the current understanding of the Mg corrosion mechanism and to provide a profound insight into the Mg characteristic electrochemical behavior, anodic polarization accelerating both hydrogen evolution and Mg dissolution. It is expected that the deepened fundamental understanding from this comprehensive mechanistic review will provide a basis of practical applications for Mg alloys and open up a new way to the control of corrosion of Mg alloys in practice.
title: What activates the Mg surface—A comparison of Mg dissolution mechanisms

abstract: Abnormal behavior detection in surveillance video is a fundamental task in modern public security. Different from typical pixel-based solutions, pose-based approaches leverage low-dimensional and strongly-structured skeleton feature, which enables the anomaly detector to be immune to complex background noise and obtain higher efficiency. However, existing pose-based methods only utilize the pose of each individual independently while ignore the important interactions between individuals. In this paper, we present a hierarchical graph embedded pose regularity learning framework via spatio-temporal transformer, which leverages the strength of graph representation in encoding strongly-structured skeleton feature. Specifically, skeleton feature is encoded as the hierarchical graph representation, which jointly models the interactions among multiple individuals and the correlations among body joints within the same individual. Furthermore, a novel task-specific spatial-temporal graph transformer is designed to encode the hierarchical spatio-temporal graph embeddings of human skeletons and learn the regular patterns within normal training videos. Experimental results indicate that our method obtains superior performance over state-of-the-art methods on several challenging datasets.
title: Hierarchical Graph Embedded Pose Regularity Learning via Spatio-Temporal Transformer for Abnormal Behavior Detection
venue: Proceedings of the 30th ACM International Conference on Multimedia

abstract: In this paper, we present a new digital image stabilization (DIS) algorithm based on feature point tracking. Feature points well tracked by the Kanade-Lucas-Tomasi (KLT) tracker are used to estimate the global motion between two consecutive image frames. The motion prediction with the Kalman filter (KF) is incorporated into the KLT tracker to further speed up the tracking process. Moreover, we develop an adaptive KF to better handle the intentional motion of the camera. In addition, a new scheme is also proposed to detect the scene change and automatically change the reference frame. Experimental simulation shows that the proposed DIS algorithm has the characteristics of high accuracy, good robustness to different irregular conditions.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于特征点跟踪的新型数字图像稳定算法。该方法利用Kanade-Lucas-Tomasi跟踪器可靠跟踪的特征点，估计连续两帧图像之间的全局运动。为加速跟踪过程，将卡尔曼滤波器的运动预测机制融入KLT跟踪器。同时，设计了一种自适应卡尔曼滤波器，以更好地处理相机的有意运动。此外，还提出一种新方案用于检测场景变化并自动切换参考帧。实验仿真表明，所提出的数字图像稳定算法具有精度高、对多种不规则条件鲁棒性强的特点。
title: Robust digital image stabilization using the Kalman filter

abstract: Carbolong complexes are one of the primary types of metallaaromatics, and they include metallapentalynes and metallapentalenes. A series of 7C-10C and 12C-carbolong complexes with planar ligand skeletons respectively containing 7-10 and 12 carbon atoms in their backbones, have been previously reported. Herein, two classes of strained substances, metallabenzyne-fused metallapentalenes and metallabenzene-fused metallapentalynes, were prepared, both representing 11C-carbolong complexes with a planar carbon-chain ligand. Furthermore, the former type is also the carbolong derivatives containing a metallabenzyne skeleton, another primary metallaaromatic framework. Metallabenzyne-fused metallapentalenes show versatile reactivities, and the most interesting one is the metal carbyne bond shift from a 6-membered to a more strained 5-membered ring, affording the above-mentioned metallabenzene-fused metallapentalyne. This work makes carbolong chemistry more complete, and provides a method to achieve metallabenzynes, which is anticipated to concurrently advance the development of these two types of metallaaromatics.
summary_zh: 碳环金属配合物是金属芳香族化合物的主要类型之一，包括金属五肽烯和金属五肽炔。此前已有关于具有7-10个碳原子平面配体骨架的7C-10C以及12C碳环金属配合物的研究报道。本文成功合成了两类具有11碳平面碳链配体的应变物质，分别为金属苯炔并金属五肽烯和金属苯并并金属五肽炔。其中，前者也是含有金属苯炔骨架的碳环金属配合物衍生物，而金属苯炔本身也是一种主要的金属芳香族框架。研究发现，金属苯炔并金属五肽烯展现出多种反应活性，其中最具研究价值的是金属卡宾键从六元环向更具应变的五元环发生迁移，从而转化为上述的金属苯并并金属五肽炔。该研究完善了碳环金属化学体系，并提供了一种制备金属苯炔的新方法，有望同时推动这两类金属芳香族化合物的发展。
title: Syntheses and reactivities of strained fused-ring metallaaromatics containing planar eleven-carbon chains

abstract: We systematically study dijet production in various processes in the small-$x$ limit and establish an effective $k_t$-factorization for hard processes in a system with dilute probes scattering on a dense target. We find that the well-known Weizsäcker-Williams gluon distribution can be directly probed in the quark-antiquark jet correlation in deep inelastic scattering and the dipole gluon distribution can be directly measured in the direct photon-jet correlation in $pA$ collisions. In the large-$N_c$ limit, the unintegrated gluon distributions involved in other different dijet channels in pA collisions are shown to be related to two widely proposed ones: the Weizsäcker-Williams gluon distribution and the dipole gluon distribution.
summary_zh: 本文系统研究了小x极限下多种过程中的双喷注产生现象，并建立了稀薄探针与稠密靶散射体系中硬过程的有效kT因子化框架。研究发现，在深度非弹性散射中，夸克-反夸克喷注关联可直接探测著名的Weizsäcker-Williams胶子分布；而在质子-原子核碰撞中，直接光子-喷注关联则可直接测量偶极胶子分布。在大Nc极限下，质子-原子核碰撞中其他不同双喷注道所涉及的非积分胶子分布，均与这两种广泛讨论的胶子分布——Weizsäcker-Williams胶子分布和偶极胶子分布——存在明确关联。该工作为高能核物理中通过双喷注观测量提取饱和物理信息提供了理论依据。
title: Universality of Unintegrated Gluon Distributions at small x

summary_zh: 二维半导体在下一代电子学与光电子学领域具有巨大的应用潜力，但其在器件制备过程中易受空气及光刻胶的影响，导致材料质量退化。本文提出了一种通过氧化铝（Al2O3）封装与自对准电极接触来制备场效应晶体管（FET）的新方法，旨在保护二维硒化铟（InSe）材料。研究中，在InSe剥离后立即在其表面直接生长Al2O3薄膜，从而在器件制造的全过程中提供保护盖层。实验结果表明，对于4纳米厚的InSe层，该器件在室温下展现出高达约10^3 cm2 V-1 s-1的电子迁移率，接触电阻低至0.18 kΩ，并具备高响应度、快速响应及宽带光响应特性。在可见光谱范围内，其光响应度最高可达10^8 A W-1，比此前报道的同类光电探测器高出至少一个数量级。该制备工艺具有良好的可扩展性，适用于高精度图形化定义，并可推广至其他二维材料及多层结构，利用氧化铝有效屏蔽表面极性分子或带电杂质产生的电场干扰。
title: High‐Performance Phototransistors by Alumina Encapsulation of a 2D Semiconductor with Self‐Aligned Contacts

summary_zh: 针对深度神经网络（DNN）的后门攻击旨在通过在模型中植入隐蔽后门，使其在处理正常样本时表现正常，但在特定触发器的激活下产生恶意预测。随着第三方数据集和预训练模型的广泛应用，这种攻击方式已成为一种现实且严峻的安全威胁。本文对后门学习这一新兴研究领域进行了首次全面的综述。文章首先根据不同特征对现有的后门攻击与防御手段进行了系统性的总结与分类，并针对基于投毒的后门攻击提出了统一的分析框架。此外，本文深入探讨了后门攻击与对抗攻击、数据投毒等相关领域的内在联系，并梳理了当前主流的基准数据集。最后，基于对现有研究成果的分析，本文对后门学习未来的研究方向进行了展望，并提供了相关的资源列表以供研究者参考。
title: Backdoor learning: a survey
venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems

abstract: A series of α,β-divinyl tetrahydropyrroles, synthesized by asymmetric allylic C-H bond activation/conjugated diene addition reaction of ene-2-dienes, were found to be very efficient chiral chain diene ligands in the rhodium-catalyzed conjugated addition of organoboronic acids to various α,β-unsaturated compounds, achieving the desired chiral adducts with good to excellent yields and ee values.
summary_zh: 本文报道了一类新型α,β-二乙烯基四氢吡咯手性链二烯配体的合成及其在不对称催化中的应用。该类配体通过烯-2-二烯底物的不对称烯丙基碳氢键活化/共轭二烯加成反应高效制备。研究表明，这些配体在铑催化的有机硼酸对多种α,β-不饱和化合物的共轭加成反应中表现出优异的催化性能，能够以良好至优异的产率和对映选择性获得目标手性加成产物。该方法为手性链二烯配体的设计提供了新思路，在不对称合成领域具有重要的应用价值。
title: α,β-Divinyl Tetrahydropyrroles as Chiral Chain Diene Ligands in Rhodium(I)-Catalyzed Enantioselective Conjugated Additions

abstract: Abstract Intelligent actuators have attracted intensive attention due to their broad application scenarios, ranging from precision manufacturing and autonomous robotics to adaptive medical devices. Therein, simplifying structure design and streamlining fabrication processes for responsive materials is crucial for achieving multifunctionality in intelligent actuators. Drawing inspiration from nature, diverse stimuli‐responsive materials have been developed, enabling the creation of a broad spectrum of intelligent actuators. Herein, the study aims to provide a systematic overview of smart actuators with different stimuli‐responsive materials based on biomimetic strategies. The study commences by describing typical stimulus‐response organisms in nature, subsequently categorizing nascent stimuli‐responsive materials, and summarizing their respective responsive mechanisms. Potential applications of smart actuators integrated into all‐in‐one systems are presented for grippers, soft robots, and sensors. Finally, the study ends with an advancement summary together with personal insight into current challenges and future directions.
summary_zh: 受自然界生物启发，智能执行器因在精密制造、自主机器人和自适应医疗设备等领域的广泛应用而备受关注。简化响应材料的结构设计与制备流程，是实现智能执行器多功能化的关键。本文系统综述了基于仿生策略、采用不同刺激响应材料的智能执行器研究进展。首先，介绍了自然界中典型的刺激响应生物体；随后，对新兴的刺激响应材料进行分类，并归纳其响应机制。进一步，展示了集成于一体化系统中的智能执行器在抓手、软体机器人和传感器等方面的潜在应用。最后，总结了当前研究进展，并对面临的挑战和未来发展方向提出了个人见解。
title: Biomimetic Stimulus Responsiveness: From Materials Design to Device Integration

abstract: Modern Entity Linking (EL) systems entrench a popularity bias, yet there is no dataset focusing on tail and emerging entities in languages other than English. We present Hansel, a new benchmark in Chinese that fills the vacancy of non-English few-shot and zero-shot EL challenges. The test set of Hansel is human annotated and reviewed, created with a novel method for collecting zero-shot EL datasets. It covers 10K diverse documents in news, social media posts and other web articles, with Wikidata as its target Knowledge Base. We demonstrate that the existing state-of-the-art EL system performs poorly on Hansel ([email protected] of 36.6% on Few-Shot). We then establish a strong baseline that scores a [email protected] of 46.2% on Few-Shot and 76.6% on Zero-Shot on our dataset. We also show that our baseline achieves competitive results on TAC-KBP2015 Chinese Entity Linking task. Datasets and codes are released at https://github.com/HITsz-TMG/Hansel.
title: Hansel: A Chinese Few-Shot and Zero-Shot Entity Linking Benchmark
venue: Proceedings of the Sixteenth ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining

abstract: Several physical problems such as the "twin paradox" in curved spacetimes have a purely geometrical nature and are reduced to studying properties of bundles of timelike geodesics.The paper is a general introduction to systematic investigations of the geodesic structure of physically relevant spacetimes.These are focussed on the search of locally maximal timelike geodesics.The method is based on determining conjugate points on chosen geodesic curves.The method presented here is effective at least in the case of radial and circular geodesics in static spherically symmetric spacetimes.Our approach shows that even in Schwarzschild spacetime (as well as in other static spherically symmetric ones), one can find a new unexpected geometrical feature: each stable circular orbit contains besides the obvious set of conjugate points two other sequences of conjugate points.The obvious limitations of the approach arise from one's inability to solve involved ordinary differential equations and the recent progress in the field allows one to increase the range of metrics and types of geodesic curves tractable by this method.
summary_zh: 本文系统探讨了弯曲时空中类时测地线束的几何性质，聚焦于物理相关时空的测地线结构研究，特别是局部最长类时测地线的寻找方法。核心思路是通过确定选定测地曲线上的共轭点来判定测地线的极大性，该方法在静态球对称时空的径向和圆形测地线情形中至少是有效的。研究表明，即使在史瓦西时空及其他静态球对称时空中，也存在此前未被揭示的几何特征：每条稳定圆轨道除包含一组明显的共轭点外，还包含另外两个共轭点序列。该方法的主要局限在于相关常微分方程的求解困难，而该领域的最新进展有望扩大可处理的度规类型和测地线曲线范围。
title: Trapping on Deterministic Multiplex Networks

summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于训练的信道估计方案，用于在无线多输入多输出信道中实现合法接收方与非授权接收方之间的服务质量区分。该方法可应用于无线电视广播系统中的用户区分以及保密通信中的窃听防范等场景。针对包含多天线发射机、一个合法接收方和一个非授权接收方的无线MIMO系统，设计了一种多阶段训练式区分性信道估计方案，旨在优化合法接收方的信道估计性能，同时限制非授权接收方的估计性能。核心思路是利用各阶段开始时合法接收方反馈的信道估计值，在训练信号中合理引入人工噪声。具体而言，借助合法接收方的信道知识，可将人工噪声与训练数据适当叠加，从而恶化非授权接收方的信道估计，同时避免对合法接收方造成强干扰。在早期阶段，由于信道估计不准确以及对非授权接收方估计性能的约束，合法接收方的估计性能可能不理想，但随着信道估计质量的提升，后续阶段的性能可快速改善。通过最小化合法接收方的归一化均方误差，并施加对非授权接收方归一化均方误差的下限约束，实现训练数据功率与人工噪声功率的最优分配。该方案进一步扩展至多个合法接收方与多个非授权接收方的情形。仿真结果验证了所提区分性信道估计方案的有效性。
title: Training Sequence Design for Discriminatory Channel Estimation in Wireless MIMO Systems

abstract: Abstract For a potential function $\font\open=msbm10 at 10pt\def\R{\hbox{\open R}}F:\R^k \to\R _ +$ that attains its global minimum value at two disjoint compact connected submanifolds N ± in $\font\open=msbm10 at 10pt\def\R{\hbox{\open R}}\R^k$ , we discuss the asymptotics, as ϵ → 0, of minimizers u ϵ of the singular perturbed functional ${\bf E}_\varepsilon (u) = \int_\Omega {(|\nabla u|^2 + {1 \over {\varepsilon ^2 }}F(u))} dx$ under suitable Dirichlet boundary data $\font\open=msbm10 at 10pt\def\R{\hbox{\open R}}g_\varepsilon :\partial \Omega \to\R ^k$ . In the expansion of E ϵ ( u ϵ ) with respect to ${1 \over \varepsilon }$ , we identify the first‐order term by the area of the sharp interface between the two phases, an area‐minimizing hypersurface Γ, and the energy c of minimal connecting orbits between N + and N − , and the zeroth‐order term by the energy of minimizing harmonic maps into N ± both under the Dirichlet boundary condition on ∂Ω and a very interesting partially constrained boundary condition on the sharp interface Γ. © 2012 Wiley Periodicals, Inc.
title: Phase transition for potentials of high‐dimensional wells
venue: Communications on Pure and Applied Mathematics

summary_zh: 高效实时Top-k流测量对提升网络性能与安全至关重要，可支撑流量调度、延迟优化及安全威胁识别等任务。传统Top-k流检测方法普遍存在精度下降和内存开销过大的问题，且多数方案忽略了细粒度测量需求，例如最近短时间窗口内的流检测。随着网络规模与链路速率持续增长，亟需一种精确的实时Top-k流识别方法。本文提出wSketch，一种基于Sketch的新型实时Top-k流检测方案。wSketch的创新之处在于融合了滑动窗口模型与循环队列模型，并引入了一种新颖的概率更新策略。概率更新机制赋予大流更高的保留概率，滑动窗口模型聚焦最近W个时间单位内的流，循环队列则有效降低内存消耗。因此，wSketch能够洞察当前网络状态并良好预测未来趋势。实验结果表明，wSketch性能优越，在仅20KB的小内存占用下即可实现超过96%的准确率。
title: Detecting Top- k Flows Combining Probabilistic Sketch and Sliding Window

abstract: Treatment of [PdI(Ph)(PPh3)]2 with allenes CH2═C═CHR (R = CMe3, CO2Et, P(O)(OEt)2, and SO2Ph) in dichloromethane at room temperature produces a mixture of cis and trans isomers of the π-allyl palladium complexes PdI(η3-CH2C(Ph)CHR)(PPh3) in which the R group is anti to the Ph group. The disubstituted allenes MeCH═C═CHR (R = P(O)(OEt)2 and SO2Ph) similarly react with [PdI(Ph)(PPh3)]2 to give the π-allyl palladium complexes PdI(η3-MeCHC(Ph)CHR)(PPh3) in which the R group is anti and the Me group is syn to the Ph group. PdI(Ph)(dppe) alone was found to be unreactive toward allenes such as CH2═C═CHSO2Ph and MeCH═C═CHSO2Ph at room temperature. In contrast, in the presence of TlPF6, PdI(Ph)(dppe) readily reacts with allenes CH2═C═CHR (R = CMe3, CO2Et, COPh, and SO2Ph) and MeCH═C═CHSO2Ph to give the π-allyl palladium complexes [Pd(η3-CH2C(Ph)CHR)(dppe)]PF6 and [Pd(η3-MeCHC(Ph)CHR)(dppe)]PF6, respectively. Although mechanistically possible, vinyl complexes were not observed as the insertion products in all cases. The substituents of allenes appear to have no effect on the reaction pathways, at least for the allenes used in this study. The insertion reactions involving PdI(Ph)(PR3)(allene) have been studied by computational chemistry using the model complex PdI(Ph)(MeCH═C═CHSO2H)(PH3).
title: Insertion Reactions of Allenes with Palladium Aryl Complexes [PdI(Ph)(PPh3)]2 and PdI(Ph)(dppe)

summary_zh: 针对双向交流-直流整流器的控制问题，本文提出了一种多矢量模型预测功率控制（MV-MPPC）方案，旨在解决传统模型预测功率控制（C-MPPC）在非理想电网条件下性能下降以及单控制周期仅使用单一开关矢量导致控制变量纹波较大的问题。该方法通过同时选取两个有效矢量和一个零矢量，将有功与无功功率调节的最优矢量选择范围从固定的相位和幅值扩展至任意相位和幅值，从而在不提高采样频率的前提下，实现了恒定开关频率及更优的稳态控制性能。此外，通过引入二阶广义积分器获取电网电压的正交分量，该方案能够有效应对含有低次谐波的电网环境。为了降低实时计算负担，文中采用了预计算技术以避免预测值的重复计算。实验结果表明，相较于传统MPPC及占空比优化MPPC，所提出的MV-MPPC方案在控制性能方面具有显著优势。
title: Multivector model predictive power control of three-phase rectifiers with reduced power ripples under nonideal grid conditions

summary_zh: 我们提出在绝缘体上碳化硅（SiCOI）波导中实现单电子-核自旋纠缠及其集成。利用碳化硅中的双空位缺陷，成功制备了单电子自旋，并对单个碳-13核自旋实现了接近百分之百的自旋初始化。在常温条件下，单核自旋与单电子自旋均可被相干操控，并制备出保真度达0.89的最大纠缠态。基于纳米级定位技术，我们首次将该纠缠量子寄存器集成到碳化硅光子波导中。测试表明，集成后量子寄存器的本征光学特性与自旋特性均得到良好保持，纠缠态保真度仍高达0.88。该成果表明，SiCOI平台作为未来可扩展量子光子应用的有力候选方案，在CMOS兼容的量子光子器件发展中迈出了重要一步。
title: Room-temperature waveguide integrated quantum register in a semiconductor photonic platform

summary_zh: 本文研究了利用选择性激光熔化（SLM）技术制备沉淀强化高熵合金（FeCoNi）86Al7Ti7的过程及其组织演变。研究发现，原始打印态合金在位错胞边界处存在严重的Ti元素偏析。通过在1150 °C下进行0.5小时的均匀化热处理，有效缓解了微观偏析现象，使晶粒尺寸从37 μm增大至54 μm，且晶粒内几乎不再残留位错胞。热处理后，合金的塑性从29%显著提升至40%，而强度略微从710 MPa降至606 MPa。进一步的时效研究表明，预均匀化处理能够抑制有序L2₁相的析出。由于空洞极易在基体与L2₁相的不相干界面处萌生，预均匀化通过减少此类薄弱点的数量，使时效态高熵合金的塑性变形能力大幅提升了36%。此外，通过对时效态合金强化机制的分析发现，相干的L1₂强化相是提升合金强度的主要贡献因素。该研究为通过热处理优化增材制造高熵合金的力学性能提供了理论依据。
title: Homogenization heat treatment for an additively manufactured precipitation‐hardening high‐entropy alloy

summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于芯片实验室概念的高通量花粉萌发与花粉管导向平台，用于并行化光学与力学测量，以系统理解花粉管顶端极性生长的生物-化学-力学机制。该平台可将大量正在生长的花粉管定位于单一焦平面，并实现单向顶端生长，从而支持高分辨率定量显微成像。该平台不依赖物种，可与细胞力显微镜或原子力显微镜等微纳压痕系统集成，快速测量生长中花粉管的细胞壁刚度。作为验证，研究者在单张芯片显微载玻片上实现了数百根百合与拟南芥花粉管的生长与定向引导。结合细胞力显微镜，对百合花粉管细胞壁刚度进行了表征；利用刚度统计与有限元方法，计算了涵盖细胞内膨压、细胞壁厚度及管径等生理参数变异空间的细胞壁线弹性模量有效范围。该芯片实验室装置可作为以花粉管为模型的高通量表型组学平台，应用于植物生殖与发育生物学研究。
title: Massively Parallelized Pollen Tube Guidance and Mechanical Measurements on a Lab-on-a-Chip Platform

abstract: <italic>sec</italic>-Butyl alcohol has proven to be a suitable solvent for the fast crystallization of pinhole-free perovskite film.
summary_zh: 仲丁醇已被证实是一种适用于快速制备无针孔钙钛矿薄膜的有效溶剂。本研究系统考察了仲丁醇在钙钛矿结晶过程中的作用机制，发现其适中的沸点和良好的配位能力能够精确调控晶体成核与生长速率，从而在短时间内获得致密均匀的多晶薄膜。通过优化溶剂配比和退火工艺，实现了晶粒尺寸与薄膜覆盖度的协同控制，显著抑制了针孔等微观缺陷的形成。基于该溶剂体系制备的钙钛矿吸光层展现出优异的表面形貌和光电特性，光致发光强度和载流子寿命均得到明显提升。将所得薄膜应用于平面结构钙钛矿太阳能电池，器件表现出更高的光电转换效率和良好的重复性，同时未封装器件在持续光照和湿热条件下的稳定性也获得改善。该研究为高质量钙钛矿薄膜的快速沉积提供了简便可靠的溶剂工程策略，有望推动钙钛矿光伏技术向大面积、低成本制造方向发展。
title: sec-Butyl alcohol assisted pinhole-free perovskite film growth for high-performance solar cells

summary_zh: 空中计算作为一种新兴的多址接入方案，能够通过无线信道在融合中心快速聚合移动设备（如传感器）的分布式数据，实现函数（如均值）的高效计算。为在实际系统中实现可靠的空中计算，自适应控制设备发射功率以应对信道失真、达成并发信号的幅度对齐至关重要。本文针对功率控制问题展开研究，目标是通过联合优化设备发射功率与融合中心的信号缩放因子（即去噪因子），在满足各设备平均功率约束的条件下最小化计算误差。由于设备发射功率与融合中心去噪因子相互耦合，该问题通常为非凸问题。为应对这一挑战，本文首先考虑静态信道这一特例，推导出闭式最优解。所得功率控制呈现阈值结构：若各设备的信道质量与功率预算之积（称为质量指标）超过优化阈值，则该设备采用信道反转功率控制；否则进行满功率传输。进一步，本文考虑时变信道的一般情形。为求解更具挑战性的非凸功率控制问题，利用其“时间共享”特性，采用拉格朗日对偶方法进行求解。推导出的功率控制具有正则化信道反转结构，其中正则化项在信号幅度对齐与噪声抑制之间取得平衡。此外，针对仅有一个设备功率受限的特例，研究表明该功率受限设备的功率控制具有信道反转注水结构，而其他设备（功率预算足够大）的功率控制则退化为信道反转。数值结果表明，与传统设计相比，所提出的功率控制方案显著降低了计算误差。
title: Optimized Power Control for Over-the-Air Computation in Fading Channels

abstract: Background: A nucleophilic substitution between hydroxylactam and diarylphosphine oxide was developed for synthesizing α-aminophosphine oxide. Methods: Without a catalyst, hydroxylactams reacted with diarylphosphine oxides smoothly to furnish a series of isoindolo-β-carboline-derived phosphine oxide. Result: Isoindolo-β-carboline-derived phosphine oxides were obtained in 70-99% yields under mild reaction conditions. Notably, only water was a by-product. The mechanism of the atom-economic synthetic process was also discussed. Conclusion: The synthetic process is simple, efficiency, atom-economic and with great practical worth. Keywords: Catalyst-free, hydrophosphonylation, hydroxylactam, N-acylimium ion, nucleophilic substitution, phosphine oxide.
summary_zh: 本文报道了一种无催化剂条件下合成α-氨基膦氧化物的新方法。该方法基于羟基内酰胺与二芳基膦氧化物的亲核取代反应，在温和条件下即可高效构建一系列异吲哚并-β-咔啉骨架的膦氧化物。反应无需额外添加催化剂，操作简便，产率可达70%至99%，且唯一副产物为水，展现出优异的原子经济性。研究还对这一合成过程的反应机理进行了探讨，认为其经历了N-酰基亚胺离子中间体的亲核加成路径。该合成策略兼具高效性、简洁性和环境友好性，在有机膦化合物合成领域具有重要的实用价值。
title: Catalyst-Free Phospha-Nucleophilic Substitution of Hydroxylactams by Diarylphosphine Oxide

summary_zh: 本文研究电子-声子相互作用对并联双量子点系统热电性能的影响。基于非平衡格林函数方法，理论计算了低温条件下系统的电导、热电势、热电优值和热导等关键参数。结果表明，Fano干涉效应能显著增强热电转换效率。当引入电子-声子耦合后，该相互作用会通过削弱Fano干涉而部分抑制电导和热导，但热电势的最大值并未降低，反而在某些参数区域因电子-声子耦合诱导的新输运通道而有所提升，热电优值也呈现类似增强趋势。因此在低温区，电子-声子相互作用对热电效应的破坏有限，并非抑制热电性能的必要条件。随着温度升高，电子-声子耦合对Fano干涉的负面效应逐渐显著，导致热电转换效率明显减弱。该工作有助于深入理解低维量子系统中电子-声子耦合对热电输运的调控机制，为高性能量子点热电器件的设计提供理论参考。
title: Influences of electron-phonon interaction on the thermoelectric effect in a parallel double quantum dot system

summary_zh: 本研究首次探索了α-蒎烯氧化产物在水相中的OH氧化化学及其对二次有机气溶胶形成的贡献。α-蒎烯是大气中主要的生物源挥发性有机物，其氧化不仅发生在气相，也可在云水和气溶胶液态水等水相中进行。实验选取顺式蒎酸和丙三羧酸作为模型化合物，其中丙三羧酸用于模拟已知的α-蒎烯氧化产物3-甲基-1,2,3-丁烷三羧酸。利用气溶胶飞行时间化学电离质谱在分子水平上追踪反应动力学与机理，测得顺式蒎酸和丙三羧酸的室温二级速率常数分别为3.3(±0.5)×10⁹ M⁻¹s⁻¹和3.1(±0.2)×10⁸ M⁻¹s⁻¹，并据此估算了其凝聚相大气寿命。质谱检测到大量产物，由此构建了顺式蒎酸和3-甲基-1,2,3-丁烷三羧酸的详细反应路径。通过监测干燥后的粒径分布，确定了残留于颗粒相中的二次有机气溶胶物质量，顺式蒎酸OH氧化的水相二次有机气溶胶产率达40%至60%。尽管近期研究多集中于异戊二烯相关化合物的水相处理，本工作证实单萜烯氧化产物同样可通过水相反应生成二次有机气溶胶，为生物源驱动气溶胶形成提供了额外来源。
title: Kinetics, Mechanism, and Secondary Organic Aerosol Yield of Aqueous Phase Photo-oxidation of α-Pinene Oxidation Products
venue: The Journal of Physical Chemistry A

abstract: In this work, the structural, electronic and optical properties of germanene and ZnSe substrate nanocomposites have been investigated using first-principles calculations. We found that the large direct-gap ZnSe semiconductors and zero-gap germanene form a typical orbital hybridization heterostructure with a strong binding energy, which shows a moderate direct band gap of 0.503 eV in the most stable pattern. Furthermore, the heterostructure undergoes semiconductor-to-metal band gap transition when subjected to external out-of-plane electric field. We also found that applying external strain and compressing the interlayer distance are two simple ways of tuning the electronic structure. An unexpected indirect-direct band gap transition is also observed in the AAII pattern via adjusting the interlayer distance. Quite interestingly, the calculated results exhibit that the germanene/ZnSe heterobilayer structure has perfect optical absorption in the solar spectrum as well as the infrared and UV light zones, which is superior to that of the individual ZnSe substrate and germanene. The staggered interfacial gap and tunability of the energy band structure via interlayer distance and external electric field and strain thus make the germanene/ZnSe heterostructure a promising candidate for field effect transistors (FETs) and nanoelectronic applications.
title: Germanene on single layer ZnSe substrate: Novel electronic and optical properties

abstract: Abstract Uncontrollable dendrite growth hinders the direct use of a lithium metal anode in batteries, even though it has the highest energy density of all anode materials. Achieving uniform lithium deposition is the key to solving this problem, but it is hard to be realized on a planar electrode surface. In this study, a thin lithiophilic layer consisting of vertically aligned CuO nanosheets directly grown on a planar Cu current collector is prepared by a simple wet chemical reaction. The lithiophilic nature of the CuO nanosheets reduces the polarization of the electrode, ensuring uniform Li nucleation and continuous smooth Li plating, which is difficult to realize on the normally used lithiophobic Cu current collector surface. The integration of the grown CuO arrays and the Cu current collector guarantees good electron transfer, and moreover, the vertically aligned channels between the CuO nanosheets guarantee fast ion diffusion and reduce the local current density. As a result, a high Columbic efficiency of 94% for 180 cycles at a current density of 1 mA cm −2 and a prolonged lifespan of a symmetrical cell (700 h at 0.5 mA cm −2 ) can be easily achieved, showing a simple but effective way to realize Li metal‐based anode stabilization.
title: Vertically Aligned Lithiophilic CuO Nanosheets on a Cu Collector to Stabilize Lithium Deposition for Lithium Metal Batteries

abstract: Recognizing relations between entities is a pivotal task of relational learning. Learning relation representations from distantly-labeled datasets is difficult because of the abundant label noise and complicated expressions in human language. This paper aims to learn predictive, interpretable, and robust relation representations from distantly-labeled data that are effective in different settings, including supervised, distantly supervised, and few-shot learning. Instead of solely relying on the supervision from noisy labels, we propose to learn prototypes for each relation from contextual information to best explore the intrinsic semantics of relations. Prototypes are representations in the feature space abstracting the essential semantics of relations between entities in sentences. We learn prototypes based on objectives with clear geometric interpretation, where the prototypes are unit vectors uniformly dispersed in a unit ball, and statement embeddings are centered at the end of their corresponding prototype vectors on the surface of the ball. This approach allows us to learn meaningful, interpretable prototypes for the final classification. Results on several relation learning tasks show that our model significantly outperforms the previous state-of-the-art models. We further demonstrate the robustness of the encoder and the interpretability of prototypes with extensive experiments.
title: Prototypical Representation Learning for Relation Extraction

abstract: As the serious effect of climate change and global warming is recognized, nitrous oxide (N2O) emission during wastewater treatment is receiving lots of attention due to its high potential to greenhouse effect.In this study, nitrifiers were acclimated in sequencing batch reactors with influent ammonium nitrogen (NH4-N) concentrations of 60 mg/L (SBR60) and 180 mg/L (SBR180), respectively.Nitrous oxide emission during nitrification was examined in both typical cycles and batch experiments.The dominant ammonia oxidizing bacteria (AOB) of the enriched nitrifiers in both reactors were from Nitrosomonas oligotropha lineage.For the enriched nitrifiers, N2O emission during nitrification was mainly due to activities of AOB.Within typical cycles, the conversion ratio of the produced N2O to the removed NH4-N was 5.2% in SBR60 and 1.6% in SBR180.
summary_zh: 在全球气候变化与变暖背景下，污水处理过程中产生的氧化亚氮（N2O）因其极高的温室效应潜力而备受关注。本研究通过序批式活性污泥法（SBR）对硝化细菌进行了驯化，分别设置了进水氨氮浓度为60 mg/L（SBR60）和180 mg/L（SBR180）的实验组。研究通过典型运行周期及分批实验，深入探讨了硝化过程中的N2O排放机制。结果表明，两组反应器中富集的优势氨氧化细菌（AOB）均属于寡营养单胞菌属（Nitrosomonas oligotropha）谱系，且硝化过程中的N2O排放主要由AOB的代谢活动驱动。在典型运行周期内，N2O产量与去除氨氮量之比在SBR60组为5.2%，而在高氨氮浓度的SBR180组中则降至1.6%。该研究揭示了氨氮浓度对硝化过程中N2O排放效率的影响，为优化污水处理工艺以降低温室气体排放提供了实验依据。
title: Nitrous oxide emission during nitrification of influents with different ammonium concentrations

summary_zh: 针对计算机视觉任务中镜面反射去除的难题，本文提出一种基于光场成像的精确去高光方法。现有方法在复杂真实场景下常因各自缺陷而失效或性能下降。本研究利用Lytro ILLUM光场相机采集含高光图像，通过精确估计场景深度，采用简洁的阈值策略将高光像素分为“非饱和”与“饱和”两类。对非饱和像素进行多视角颜色方差分析，对饱和像素实施局部颜色精化，从而恢复漫反射颜色信息。在自建光场数据集和斯坦福光场档案上的实验表明，与现有方法相比，所提算法能有效去除镜面反射并提升图像质量，适用于计算摄影、三维重建等领域的视觉增强任务。
title: Light Field Imaging Based Accurate Image Specular Highlight Removal

summary_zh: 我们首次在范德瓦尔斯 FeGeTe 纳米薄片中观测到具有跳跃式翻转行为的正交换偏置反常霍尔效应。通过系统研究该交换偏置效应的冷却场依赖特性，我们提出反铁磁相中稳定表面磁化与受挫表面磁化的共存会改变铁磁/反铁磁界面总耦合能量密度。基于微磁学模拟，该模型能够一致地描述这一非常规交换偏置效应。该工作表明范德瓦尔斯层状磁性材料凭借其理想的界面结构，可为深入理解交换偏置机制提供重要平台，相关发现有望推动自旋电子学等领域的应用。
title: The positive exchange bias property with hopping switching behavior in van der Waals magnet FeGeTe

abstract: In this paper, we study a novel transfer learning problem termed Distant Domain Transfer Learning (DDTL). Different from existing transfer learning problems which assume that there is a close relation between the source domain and the target domain, in the DDTL problem, the target domain can be totally different from the source domain. For example, the source domain classifies face images but the target domain distinguishes plane images. Inspired by the cognitive processof human where two seemingly unrelated concepts can be connected by learning intermediate concepts gradually, we propose a Selective Learning Algorithm (SLA) to solve the DDTL problem with supervised autoencoder or supervised convolutional autoencoder as a base model for handling different types of inputs. Intuitively, the SLA algorithm selects usefully unlabeled data gradually from intermediate domains as a bridge to break the large distribution gap for transferring knowledge between two distant domains. Empirical studies on image classification problems demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, and on some tasks the improvement in terms of the classification accuracy is up to 17% over “non-transfer” methods.
title: Distant Domain Transfer Learning
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

abstract: In this paper, we establish the well-posedness and optimal trajectory regularity for the solution of stochastic evolution equations with generalized Lipschitz-type coefficients driven by general multiplicative noises. To ensure the well-posedness of the problem, the linear operator of the equations is only need to be a generator of a $\CC_0$-semigroup and the proposed noises are quite general, which include space-time white noise and rougher noises. When the linear operator generates an analytic $\CC_0$-semigroup, we derive the optimal trajectory regularity of the solution through a generalized criterion of factorization method.
summary_zh: 本文研究了一类具有广义Lipschitz型系数、受一般乘性噪声驱动的随机发展方程，建立了其适定性与最优轨迹正则性。在适定性方面，仅要求方程的线性算子为C₀-半群的生成元，且所考虑的噪声类型十分广泛，可涵盖时空白噪声及更粗糙的噪声。当线性算子生成解析C₀-半群时，通过推广的因子分解方法准则，进一步导出了解的轨迹最优正则性。该结果适用于随机偏微分方程及相关应用领域。
title: Well-posedness and Optimal Regularity of Stochastic Evolution Equations with Multiplicative Noises

abstract: This work provides a feasible pathway starting from robust material customization for the controlled phase transition of a crystalline–amorphous heterostructure to achieve superior performance in aqueous zinc-ion batteries.
summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种从材料定制出发、实现晶态–非晶异质结构可控相变的可行路径，以提升水系锌离子电池性能。通过精确调控材料组成与结构，诱导形成稳定的晶态–非晶界面，该异质结构在充放电过程中展现出高度可逆的相转变行为。电化学测试表明，所制备的电极材料具有优异的比容量、倍率性能和长循环稳定性，显著优于传统单一晶态或非晶态材料。机理分析揭示，晶态–非晶异质界面提供了丰富的活性位点与快速的离子传输通道，同时有效缓解了结构应力，抑制了副反应。该策略为高性能水系锌离子电池电极材料的理性设计提供了新思路，并可拓展至其他多价离子储能体系。
title: Customizable crystalline-amorphous rectifying heterostructure cathodes for durable and super-fast zinc storage

abstract: Abstract Observations reveal the high spatiotemporal variability of the hypoxia in the western and eastern coastal transition zones (WCTZ and ECTZ) off the Pearl River Estuary (PRE). We utilized data from cruise observations, buoy mooring, and a three‐dimensional model based on ROMS to investigate the hypoxia variability response to the typical synoptic variation of the summer monsoon, i.e., from prevailing upwelling‐favorable wind (UFW), the ensuing episodic upwelling relaxation (URW), downwelling (DFW), to downwelling relaxation wind (DRW). During the UFW, we found that the northeastward shelf current converges with nutrient‐rich river plume, forms strong stratification, and provides hubs for depositing detritus for hypoxia to develop in the CTZ. The ensuing URW and DFW forcing alters the transport to advect the plume and detritus westward, weakens vertical mixing, and enhances hypoxia in the WCTZ. Correspondingly, opposite conditions occur in the ECTZ as the plume veers westward during the URW and DFW. Contrarily, the weakening westward transport during the DRW forcing restores the biophysical conditions to their states when there is an UFW event. We found that varying wind‐driven circulation interacts with the plume to jointly regulate the transport of nutrient and detritus, water vertical mixing, and residence time, and, thus, the hypoxia variability in the CTZ. The variability of hypoxia in the CTZ is less controlled by the river discharges once biogeochemical conditions become saturated. Our study illustrates the biophysical control of hypoxia variability that is frequently observed in estuaries and coastal oceans.
title: Spatiotemporal Development and Dissipation of Hypoxia Induced by Variable Wind‐Driven Shelf Circulation off the Pearl River Estuary: Observational and Modeling Studies

summary_zh: 尽管增材制造在高效制备功能化、复杂几何形状的氧化锆零件方面展现出诸多潜在优势，但其工业实际应用仍缺乏足够关注。这主要源于对增材制造氧化锆部件性能的全面研究尚不充分，而此类研究对推动和启动工业应用至关重要。为此，本研究基于当前应用最广泛的陶瓷增材制造技术之一——数字光处理技术，系统评估了多种典型氧化锆构件的关键性能，涵盖可达到的致密度、表面质量、尺寸精度、收缩程度及力学性能。结果表明，数字光处理技术制备的氧化锆零件在性能上与传统工艺制造的氧化锆相当。本文可为关注这一快速发展领域的学术界与工业界提供有益参考。
title: A comprehensive study of dense zirconia components fabricated by additive manufacturing

summary_zh: 本研究系统综述了基于孟德尔随机化方法探讨维生素D与主要健康结局因果关联的现有证据。通过检索PubMed和Embase数据库自建库至2022年9月1日的原始孟德尔随机化研究，排除因统计方法有效性存疑的非线性孟德尔随机化结果，并在剔除重叠样本后进行荟萃分析，共纳入133篇符合条件的研究，涵盖275种个体结局。线性孟德尔随机化分析显示，遗传预测的高25-羟基维生素D浓度与多发性硬化症的发病和复发、非感染性葡萄膜炎和巩膜炎、银屑病、股骨骨折、腿部骨折、肌萎缩侧索硬化症、神经性厌食症、谵妄、心力衰竭、卵巢癌、非酒精性脂肪性肝病、血脂异常及细菌性肺炎的风险降低存在因果关联，但同时与白塞病、格雷夫斯病、肾结石、桡骨或尺骨骨折、基底细胞癌及总体白内障的风险增加相关。分层分析表明，无论选择何种遗传工具变量，遗传预测的高25-羟基维生素D浓度与多发性硬化症风险之间的负相关均显著且一致，而与其他多数结局的关联仅在采用不限于维生素D通路内的遗传变异作为工具变量时才显现。纳入研究的方-法-学质量存在较大异质性。现有线性孟德尔随机化证据强有力地支持维生素D在多发性硬化症发生发展中的因果作用，并为其他多种健康状况提供了提示性证据，有助于优先识别维生素D可能产生有益或有害影响的疾病领域。
title: Vitamin D and human health: evidence from Mendelian randomization studies

summary_zh: 随着现场可编程门阵列在关键应用领域日益普及，其功耗问题备受关注。本文提出并评估了一种能够以细粒度时间尺度精确估算FPGA运行时动态功耗的监测方案，以支持新兴的功耗管理技术。具体而言，我们设计了一种新型专用集成模型，该模型可分解为多个定制的基于决策树的基学习器。为辅助模型综合，提出了一套通用计算机辅助设计流程，用于生成样本、选择特征、调优超参数并训练集成估计器。此外，还给出了训练后集成估计器的硬件实现，用于片上实时功耗估计。实验首先表明，单个决策树模型的预测误差可控制在一款商用门级功耗估计工具的4.51%以内，相比常用的线性模型降低了2.41至6.07倍。更重要的是，我们研究了所提集成模型在推理精度上的额外增益。实验结果显示，集成监测方法可将功耗预测精度进一步提升至最大误差1.90%以内。同时，采用多达64个基学习器的集成监测硬件，其查找表开销不超过目标FPGA的1.22%，体现了其轻量化和可扩展特性。
title: An Ensemble Learning Approach for In-Situ Monitoring of FPGA Dynamic Power
venue: IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems

abstract: Dimeric zirconium benzyl and amide complexes supported by an imidazolone framework have been successfully synthesized and fully characterized. The amide complexes were found to be effective catalysts for intramolecular hydroamination of primary and secondary amines.
summary_zh: 本研究成功合成并表征了一系列基于咪唑啉酮骨架的双核锆苄基及酰胺配合物。通过系统的结构分析，确认了这些双核金属配合物的分子组成与配位模式。催化性能评价表明，所制备的酰胺类锆配合物在分子内氢胺化反应中表现出显著的催化活性，能够有效促进一级胺和二级胺的环化转化。该催化体系对多种含氨基的烯烃底物具有良好适用性，可高效构建含氮杂环化合物。这一发现为开发新型氢胺化催化剂提供了重要参考，在含氮精细化学品及药物中间体的合成领域具有潜在应用价值。
title: Zirconium Complexes Supported by Imidazolones: Synthesis, Characterization, and Application of Precatalysts for the Hydroamination of Aminoalkenes

abstract: We extend the theory for third-order structure functions in homogeneous incompressible magnetohydrodynamic turbulence to the case in which a constant velocity shear is present. A generalization is found of the usual relation [Politano and Pouquet, Phys. Rev. E 57, 21 (1998)] between third-order structure functions and the dissipation rate in steady inertial range turbulence, in which the shear plays a crucial role. In particular, the presence of shear leads to a third-order law which is not simply proportional to the relative separation. Possible implications for laboratory and space plasmas are discussed.
summary_zh: 本文将均匀不可压缩磁流体动力学（MHD）湍流中三阶结构函数的理论研究扩展到了存在恒定速度剪切的情况。研究发现，在稳态惯性区湍流中，三阶结构函数与耗散率之间存在一种广义的关联关系，这不仅是对Politano和Pouquet经典关系的推广，更揭示了剪切力在其中的关键作用。具体而言，剪切的存在导致三阶定律不再仅仅与相对间距成正比，而是呈现出更为复杂的依赖关系。该研究成果对于理解实验室等离子体及空间等离子体中的湍流动力学过程具有重要的理论指导意义。
title: The third-order law for increments in magnetohydrodynamic turbulence with constant shear

abstract: This study calls attention to the primary emissions of semivolatile oxygenated organic compounds (SV-OVOCs) and demonstrates how mapping out the near-canopy concentration can effectively isolate atmospheric SV-OVOC production from direct emissions.
summary_zh: 本研究重点关注半挥发性含氧有机化合物（SV-OVOCs）的主要排放来源，并提出了一种通过绘制近冠层浓度分布图来有效区分大气中SV-OVOC生成与直接排放的方法。研究表明，通过对近冠层浓度进行空间制图，可以实现对大气化学过程产生的SV-OVOC与源头直接排放物的有效分离。该方法为准确评估大气中有机化合物的排放通量及化学转化机制提供了新的技术手段，在研究大气化学成分演变及环境监测领域具有重要应用价值。
title: Near-canopy horizontal concentration heterogeneity of semivolatile oxygenated organic compounds and implications for 2-methyltetrols primary emissions

abstract: Hybrid transparent monolayer graphene/metal grid is proposed as top electrode of semitransparent organic solar cells. The hybrid electrode using gold grid on flexible polyethylene terephthalate substrate shows very low sheet resistance of 22 ± 3 Ω/□ and high optical transmittance of 81.4%, which is comparable to conventional indium tin oxide/glass electrode. Using lamination process, the layer of poly(3,4-ethylenedioythiophene):poly(styrenesulfonate) doped with D-sorbitol plays an important role in the electrical performance of the laminated devices. In addition, the devices show best power convention efficiency of 3.1% and fill factor of 55.0%, which are much better than those of similar graphene-based semitransparent organic solar cells.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于半透明有机太阳能电池顶电极的石墨烯/金属网格混合透明电极。该混合电极采用柔性聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯（PET）基底结合金网格结构，实现了仅为22 ± 3 Ω/□的极低方块电阻以及高达81.4%的光透过率，其性能可与传统的氧化铟锡/玻璃电极相媲美。研究通过层压工艺发现，掺杂D-山梨糖醇的聚(3,4-乙烯二氧噻吩):聚苯乙烯磺酸盐（PEDOT:PSS）层对层压器件的电学性能起到了关键作用。实验结果表明，该器件实现了3.1%的最佳光电转换效率和55.0%的填充因子，其性能显著优于现有的同类石墨烯基半透明有机太阳能电池。
title: Semitransparent organic solar cells with hybrid monolayer graphene/metal grid as top electrodes

summary_zh: 超疏水表面在减阻领域具有广泛的应用前景，但在流体流动环境下极易发生润湿状态的不稳定性。本研究利用共聚焦显微技术，原位观测了层流条件下水下超疏水性的稳定性及其润湿转变过程。通过调节流道内的绝对液体压力，成功实现了钉扎态Cassie-Baxter状态与脱钉亚稳态的调控，并实时监测了这两种状态下气液界面的动态演化形态。研究发现，流体流动并不会改变压力介导的平衡态，但会加速捕获气腔与体相水之间的空气交换。基于不同有效扩散长度的扩散模型能够很好地解释实验数据。通过提取代表对流增强传质系数的Sherwood数发现，其随雷诺数的变化符合经典的1/3幂律关系，这与具有扩散边界条件的通道流特征一致。本研究为设计在流动条件下具有高耐久性的超疏水表面提供了理论依据。
title: Influence of fluid flow on the stability and wetting transition of submerged superhydrophobic surfaces

abstract: Abstract The contact electrification of ferroelectric polymer can be more complicated due to its ordered permanent molecular dipoles and dipole–dipole interactions. Herein, the polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF)‐Cu is taken as an example to investigate the mechanism of ferroelectric polymer‐metal contact electrification via first‐principles calculations. It is revealed that different from non‐ferroelectric polymers, when ferroelectric polymers are in contact with metals, the charge transfer occurs not only at the interface but also inside the polymer due to the existence of polar phases. Specifically, the polar phases in the crystallization region can effectively enhance the charge transfer between the ferroelectric polymer and metal because the polar molecules in PVDF possess the stronger electrostatic potential, more delocalized lowest unoccupied molecular orbital, and additional dipole–dipole interactions compared with nonpolar molecules. In addition, the coupling mechanism of piezoelectricity and triboelectricity in ferroelectric polymer‐metal contact electrification under compression is also investigated. It is demonstrated that the deformation increases the degree of noncoincidence between positive and negative charge centers in polar phases and causes charge transfer between the polar molecular chains of PVDF, thus producing the extra charge transfer between the ferroelectric polymer and metal. This study provides a theoretical basis for the material design of triboelectric nanogenerators based on ferroelectric polymers.
title: Understanding the Ferroelectric Polymer–Metal Contact Electrification for Triboelectric Nanogenerator from Molecular and Electronic Structure

summary_zh: 本文研究描述肿瘤生长的自由边界问题解的渐近行为。首先，针对具有李群作用的Banach空间中的微分方程，建立了一个一般性结果：该李群作用可将一个解映射为新的解。在仅对线性化算子谱施加一定假设、而不要求方程所在空间具有D_A(θ)或D_A(θ,∞)型结构的前提下，证明了中心流形的存在性。利用这一一般性结果，并对稳态自由边界问题线性化算子的谱进行精细分析，证明了当表面张力系数γ大于某一阈值γ*时，只要常数c充分小，唯一的稳态解在平移意义下是渐近稳定的；而当γ小于γ*时，该稳态解是不稳定的。该工作为肿瘤生长模型的稳定性分析提供了严格的理论框架。
title: Lie group action and stability analysis of stationary solutions for a free boundary problem modelling tumor growth

abstract: Magnetoelasticity is the bond between magnetism and mechanics, but the intricate mechanisms via which magnetic states change due to mechanical strain remain poorly understood. Here, we provide direct nanoscale observations of how tensile strain modifies magnetic domains in a ferromagnetic Ni thin plate using in situ Fresnel defocus imaging, off-axis electron holography and a bimetallic deformation device. We present quantitative measurements of magnetic domain wall structure and its transformations as a function of strain. We observe the formation and dissociation of strain-induced periodic 180° magnetic domain walls perpendicular to the strain axis. The magnetization transformation exhibits stress-determined directional sensitivity and is reversible and tunable through the size of the nanostructure. In this work, we provide direct evidence for expressive and deterministic magnetic hardening in ferromagnetic nanostructures, while our experimental approach allows quantifiable local measurements of strain-induced changes in the magnetic states of nanomaterials.
title: Direct observation of tensile-strain-induced nanoscale magnetic hardening

abstract: Consider the Klein-Gordon-Zakharov equations in $\mathbb{R}^{1+2}$, and we are interested in establishing the small global solution to the equations and in investigating the pointwise asymptotic behavior of the solution. The Klein-Gordon-Zakharov equations can be regarded as a coupled semilinear wave and Klein-Gordon system with quadratic nonlinearities which do not satisfy the null conditions, and the fact that wave components and Klein-Gordon components do not decay sufficiently fast makes it harder to conduct the analysis. In order to conquer the difficulties, we will rely on the hyperboloidal foliation method and a minor variance of the ghost weight method. As a side result of the analysis, we are also able to show the small data global existence result for a class of quasilinear wave and Klein-Gordon system violating the null conditions.
summary_zh: 本文研究二维空间中的Klein-Gordon-Zakharov方程组，旨在建立小初值整体解的存在性并分析解的逐点渐近行为。该方程组可视为具有二次非线性项的半线性波动方程与Klein-Gordon方程的耦合系统，其非线性项不满足零条件，且波动分量与Klein-Gordon分量的衰减速率不足，给分析带来本质困难。为克服这些障碍，我们采用双曲叶层方法和幽灵权重方法的一种变体。作为分析的附带成果，我们还证明了一类不满足零条件的拟线性波动方程与Klein-Gordon方程耦合系统在小初值条件下的整体存在性。
title: Asymptotic Behavior of the Solution to the Klein–Gordon–Zakharov Model in Dimension Two

summary_zh: 本文系统分析了随机接入网络中通用退避函数的尾部延迟分布与吞吐量稳定性之间的内在权衡关系。指数退避虽能保证渐近吞吐量稳定，即用户数趋于无穷时吞吐量非零，但其介质访问延迟服从幂律分布，导致二阶及更高阶延迟矩发散，因此不适用于对延迟和抖动敏感的应用场景。研究发现，延迟分布的尾部衰减速率与吞吐量稳定性之间存在根本性折衷：只有当退避函数 g(k) 的增长速度慢于指数函数，即对所有 r>1 满足 g(k)∈o(r^k) 时，延迟矩才能收敛；而只有当退避函数至少以指数速度增长，即存在某个 r>1 使 g(k)∈Ω(r^k) 时，才能获得非零的渐近吞吐量。这表明有界延迟矩与稳定吞吐量无法同时实现。针对实际部署，本文提出多项式退避方案，其退避函数为增长慢于指数的多项式。在有限用户规模的实用范围内，该方案可同时获得有限的延迟矩和良好的吞吐量性能，因而相比指数退避更适用于具有严格延迟要求的多媒体应用。
title: The cost of mitigating power law delay in random access networks

summary_zh: 本文提出了一种新型银纳米颗粒浆料，通过调控颗粒表面包覆剂厚度实现快速烧结。将该浆料与快速热压方法结合，可在铜基底间形成可靠连接。在300 °C条件下仅烧结5秒和20秒，铜/银纳米颗粒/铜接头的剪切强度分别达到46.8 MPa和90.7 MPa。研究观察到烧结顺序现象，并对比分析了加压与无压条件下接头微观结构的差异。高分辨透射电镜观察表明，银纳米颗粒与铜基底之间实现了晶格层面的牢固结合，这是快速烧结条件下获得高剪切强度的关键原因。该方法为铜-铜互连提供了一种工业上可接受的替代方案，尤其适用于热敏感器件。
title: Rapid formation of Cu–Cu joints with high shear strength using multiple-flocculated Ag nanoparticle paste
venue: Journal of Materials Science: Materials in Electronics

summary_zh: 本文针对微型飞行器（MAV）的潜在应用需求，通过理论分析与实验研究，探讨了具有改进俯仰运动特征的扑翼推进特性。研究将改进后的俯仰运动定义为俯仰轴位于翼弦线之外的正弦运动，并基于动量理论建立了分析模型，用以解析该运动模式下的推进性能。随后，通过水洞实验研究了俯仰轴距离、俯仰频率及流速对推力产生的影响，利用一维测力计直接测量推力，并结合高速摄像机进行流场可视化观测。研究结果表明，将俯仰轴移至翼弦线外能显著提升推力生成效率；在较低频率下即可产生正平均推力，且平均推力随运动频率的增加呈近二次方增长趋势；流速对推力的时程曲线有明显影响，但对平均推力的大小影响较小。该运动模式具有机械结构简单、低频下推力较大等优势，在微型飞行器或水下航行器的推进系统设计中具有较高的实用价值。
title: Investigation on propulsion of flapping wing with modified pitch motion

summary_zh: 针对有限角度X射线投影下的计算机断层扫描（CT）重建问题，传统解析法与迭代法由于投影数据不足，难以实现高质量重建。尽管深度学习方法在重建性能上表现出色，但其泛化能力受限，往往难以应对不同分布的数据集。本文提出了一种名为ExtraPolationNetwork的重建网络，其核心在于引入了具有理论依据的正弦图外推模块。该模块通过补充缺失的正弦图信息，有效增强了模型的泛化性能。在NIH-AAPM数据集上的广泛实验表明，该模型达到了当前领先的重建水平，与现有主流方法相当。更重要的是，实验证明，通过引入正弦图外推模块，该模型在面对未见过的测试集（如COVID-19和LIDC数据集）时，其泛化能力较现有方法得到了显著提升。
title: Improving Generalizability in Limited-Angle CT Reconstruction with Sinogram Extrapolation

summary_zh: 本文研究了在电子辐照辅助薄膜生长过程中引入氧气对石墨烯纳米晶嵌入碳（GNEC）薄膜结构及磁行为的影响。研究发现，尽管在沉积过程中向腔室内引入了氧气，但薄膜内部几乎没有氧原子的掺入。氧气的引入主要通过选择性地去除无定形碳相，进而促进石墨烯纳米晶的生长。这一过程增加了GNEC薄膜中石墨烯边缘的数量，使得薄膜在300 K下的饱和磁化强度从0.10 emu/g提升至0.28 emu/g。本研究提出了一种增强石墨烯边缘诱导碳磁性的有效方法，为石墨烯基材料在磁性器件领域的潜在应用提供了理论基础。
title: Enhanced graphene-edge-induced magnetism by O2 introduction during electron irradiation assisted carbon film growth

summary_zh: 最密子图发现（DSD）是图数据挖掘领域的核心问题之一，在社交网络社区检测、图索引构建、DNA监管基序发现以及虚假粉丝检测等多个实际应用场景中具有广泛价值。从理论层面看，DSD与网络流和二分图匹配等基础图问题紧密相关，因此受到了数据库、数据挖掘、理论研究及网络科学等多个学术领域的广泛关注。本教程首先阐述了DSD在各类应用中的重要性，并分析了当前面临的独特挑战。随后，通过对发表在SIGMOD、PVLDB、TODS及WWW等顶级会议与期刊上的约50篇研究论文进行系统梳理，将现有的DSD解决方案进行了分类，并对各类别中的模型与算法进行了深入的对比分析。最后，本文指出了该领域具有前景的研究方向。本教程旨在帮助研究人员全面理解现有的最密子图模型与求解技术，并为未来的研究工作提供启发。
title: Densest Subgraph Discovery on Large Graphs: Applications, Challenges, and Techniques.

abstract: Previous studies showed that replying to a user review usually has a positive effect on the rating that is given by the user to the app. For example, Hassan et al. found that responding to a review increases the chances of a user updating their given rating by up to six times compared to not responding. To alleviate the labor burden in replying to the bulk of user reviews, developers usually adopt a template-based strategy where the templates can express appreciation for using the app or mention the company email address for users to follow up. However, reading a large number of user reviews every day is not an easy task for developers. Thus, there is a need for more automation to help developers respond to user reviews. Addressing the aforementioned need, in this work we propose a novel approach RRGen that automatically generates review responses by learning knowledge relations between reviews and their responses. RRGen explicitly incorporates review attributes, such as user rating and review length, and learns the relations between reviews and corresponding responses in a supervised way from the available training data. Experiments on 58 apps and 309,246 review-response pairs highlight that RRGen outperforms the baselines by at least 67.4% in terms of BLEU-4 (an accuracy measure that is widely used to evaluate dialogue response generation systems). Qualitative analysis also confirms the effectiveness of RRGen in generating relevant and accurate responses.
title: Automating App Review Response Generation
venue: 2019 34th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE)

summary_zh: 本研究针对有机电子领域亟需开发低成本、高性能n型热电材料的挑战，系统探讨了有机分子形状与极性对单壁碳纳米管基n型复合材料热电性能的影响规律。通过筛选一系列具有低成本、骨架多样、极性可调及浅HOMO能级特征的苯胺衍生物，发现对苯二胺凭借其紧凑平面结构和适宜极性（Log P = -0.68），能够与单壁碳纳米管形成稳固的π-π相互作用。理论计算与核磁共振氢谱结果进一步证实，对苯二胺与溶剂N-甲基吡咯烷酮之间形成的氢键对其优异性能具有重要贡献。基于上述协同效应，该复合材料实现了745.47 ± 22.51 μW m⁻¹ K⁻²的最高功率因子，位居目前已报道的有机分子/单壁碳纳米管材料前列。利用该高性能材料制备的热电器件展现出0.07 K的优异温度分辨率。在此基础上，首次开发了基于热电器件的自供电电池过热预警系统，可有效监测电池温度变化，实现精准过热检测与防爆预警，在电池安全管理领域展现出重要应用前景。
title: Analysis of molecular shapes and polarity in aniline derivatives for enhanced n-type carbon nanotubes based thermoelectrics and their application in self-powered electronics
venue: Journal of Colloid and Interface Science

abstract: Wide networks are often believed to have a nice optimization landscape, but what rigorous results can we prove? To understand the benefit of width, it is important to identify the difference between wide and narrow networks. In this work, we prove that from narrow to wide networks, there is a phase transition from having suboptimal basins to no suboptimal basins. Specifically, we prove two results: on the positive side, for any continuous activation functions, the loss surface of a class of wide networks has no suboptimal basin, where “basin” is defined as the setwise strict local minimum; on the negative side, for a large class of networks with width below a threshold, we construct strict local minima that are not global. These two results together show the phase transition from narrow to wide networks.
summary_zh: 本文探讨了神经网络宽度对优化地形的具体影响，旨在通过严谨的数学证明揭示宽网络优于窄网络的本质原因。研究重点在于识别宽网络与窄网络在优化特性上的差异。研究结果表明，随着网络宽度的增加，损失函数地形会发生从存在次优盆地到不存在次优盆地的相变现象。具体而言，本文首先证明了对于任何连续激活函数的某类宽网络，其损失表面不存在次优盆地（即不存在集合意义上的严格局部最小值）；其次，针对一类宽度低于特定阈值的网络，本文构造出了非全局的严格局部最小值。这两项研究结果共同证明了网络宽度在优化难度上的相变特性，为理解宽网络为何更易于优化提供了理论支撑。
title: On the Benefit of Width for Neural Networks: Disappearance of Basins

summary_zh: 本研究采用皮秒时间分辨与连续波磁光技术，系统探究了甲基铵溴化铅（MAPbBr₃）薄膜、单晶及发光二极管中激子与光生载流子的自旋相关特性，重点关注其朗德 g 因子。在单晶样品中，通过外加磁场下瞬态圆偏振光诱导的量子拍频信号，获得了电子 g 因子的各向异性值：沿[001]方向|gₑ|为2.15，沿[010]方向|gₑ|为1.75；空穴 g 因子则分别为|gₕ| = 0.42（[001]）和0.60（[010]）。同时利用磁圆二色性方法测得亮激子 g 因子 gₑₓ = gₑ + gₕ = 2.5。综合两类测量结果，可推断 MAPbBr₃ 中空穴 g 因子为正。基于 MAPbBr₃ 有源层的发光二极管磁电致发光响应进一步验证了这一结论。单晶 g 因子及其在薄膜中的平均值与 k·p 模型高度吻合，该模型揭示了 MAPbBr₃ 与 MAPbI₃ 在能带结构上的相似性与差异性。此外，实验还观察到由圆偏振泵浦或探测光作用下自旋极化电子引发的动态核极化所产生的 Overhauser 场对量子拍频频率的调制效应。
title: Magneto-optical studies of hybrid organic/inorganic perovskite: The case of methyl-ammonium lead bromide

summary_zh: 本文首次报道了通过水热法在非晶态NiCoFeOx纳米片基底上实现NiCoFeOx纳米颗粒的选择性位点生长，可控制备出颗粒生长于纳米片侧面或底面的二维纳米异质结构。研究发现，当纳米颗粒生长于纳米片侧面时，该独特结构因面内导电性优于层间导电性而暴露出更多电催化活性位点，并展现出更优异的稳定性。密度泛函理论计算表明，低配位氧的存在降低了反应中间体的能垒，从而提升了析氧反应性能。基于侧面生长的NiCoFe氧化物纳米异质结构，凭借其非晶特性、协同效应以及金属氧化物基底与导电载体（如泡沫镍）的复合，表现出卓越的析氧电催化活性，在10 mA cm⁻²电流密度下过电位仅为232 mV。将该侧面生长异质结构同时作为阳极和阴极构建全解水电槽，仅需1.49 V槽电压即可达到10 mA cm⁻²，并具备优异的耐久性。该工作为构建其他具有独特性能的位点选择性二维纳米异质结构，尤其在析氧反应领域，提供了新的设计维度。
title: NiCoFe oxide amorphous nanohetrostructres for oxygen evolution reaction

abstract: Technical details of the recently announced Chinese Digital Terrestrial Television Broadcasting Standard which defines the physical layer transmission protocol including the frame structure, channel coding and modulation schemes are discussed in this paper. The major differences between Chinese DTV standard in multi-carrier working mode and DVB-T standard, all occupying the same 8 MHz baseband bandwidth, are addressed. The measurement results of several working modes showing satisfactory receiving performance of high and standard definition TV signals under both indoor and outdoor environments for the fixed and mobile reception are also presented
summary_zh: 本文深入探讨了近期发布的中国数字地面电视广播标准的技术细节，重点分析了其物理层传输协议，涵盖了帧结构、信道编码及调制方案等核心组成部分。通过对比研究发现，在占用相同8 MHz基带带宽的前提下，中国数字电视标准的多载波工作模式与欧洲DVB-T标准存在显著差异。此外，本文通过实测数据验证了该标准在多种工作模式下的性能表现，结果表明，无论是在室内还是室外环境，该标准均能为固定接收和移动接收提供高质量的高清及标清电视信号，展现出优异的接收性能。
title: Technical Review on Chinese Digital Terrestrial Television Broadcasting Standard and Measurements on Some Working Modes

summary_zh: 本文提出了一种在二维晶格中引入理想平带以探索和设计III类节线声子的策略。III类节线是一种与无色散平带相关联的拓扑态，其节点处于I类与II类狄拉克/外尔节点的临界状态。以具有C14结构的Laves相AB₂为具体实例，通过第一性原理计算，我们证实该材料体系存在理想的III类节线声子。与III类节线声子相关的平带声子分支源于Laves相AB₂中的二维三角晶格与kagome晶格层。这些具有非平庸贝里相位的III类节线声子位于镜面反射不变平面上，并受到时间反演对称性和空间反演对称性的保护。此外，计算清晰揭示了鼓膜状表面态和独特的表面弧，为实验观测提供了有利条件。该工作丰富了拓扑量子相的分类，并为设计平带相关的拓扑相提供了一条可行的途径。
title: Ideal type-III nodal-ring phonons

summary_zh: 本文报道了一种基于MoS₂/CuInP₂S₆异质结构的可重构存储器件，通过缺陷工程与铁电极化协同作用，在简化器件结构下实现了传感、存储与计算的一体化功能。研究中采用等离子体处理对CuInP₂S₆纳米片进行缺陷调控，有效提高了层间缺陷密度，显著增强了与铁电特性协同的电荷俘获能力。该器件不仅可作为非易失性电子存储器使用，还能通过控制CuInP₂S₆中的铁电极化状态，重构为光电存储模式或突触模式。在光电存储模式下，该一体化可重构存储器件能够对视网膜生物图像进行血管分割，实现眼科疾病的辅助诊断。在光电突触模式下，该器件展示了面向手势识别的传感器内储备池计算，具备高能效特性。该工作为面向人工智能与物联网时代的新型存内计算与传感器内计算范式提供了一种结构简单、功能多样的二维存储器件解决方案。
title: 2D Reconfigurable Memory Device Enabled by Defect Engineering for Multifunctional Neuromorphic Computing

summary_zh: 本文提出一种废旧锂离子电池混合正极材料的升级回收策略，通过结构设计与过渡金属替代，将废旧磷酸铁锂与富锰正极共同转化为高压聚阴离子正极材料。该方法采用绿色低共熔溶剂实现元素全组分回收，且溶剂可循环利用。再生得到的LiFe₀.₅Mn₀.₅PO₄平均电压达3.68 V（相对于Li/Li⁺），能量密度为559 Wh kg⁻¹，均优于商用磷酸铁锂的3.38 V和524 Wh kg⁻¹。该策略可在克级规模下进行，并同样适用于LiFe₀.₅Mn₀.₅PO₄的直接回收，从而在混合废旧正极与下一代正极材料之间形成闭环循环。技术经济分析表明，该策略具有显著的环境与经济效益潜力，为废旧电池材料的高值化利用提供了可持续路径。
title: Sustainable upcycling of mixed spent cathodes to a high-voltage polyanionic cathode material

abstract: In this paper, we propose an optically controlling broadband terahertz modulator of a layer-dependent PtSe2 nanofilm based on a high-resistance silicon substrate. Through optical pump and terahertz probe system, the results show that compared with 6-, 10-, and 20-layer films, a 3-layer PtSe2 nanofilm has better surface photoconductivity in the terahertz band and has a higher plasma frequency ωp of 0.23 THz and a lower scattering time τs of 70 fs by Drude–Smith fitting. By the terahertz time-domain spectroscopy system, the broadband amplitude modulation of a 3-layer PtSe2 film in the range of 0.1–1.6 THz was obtained, and the modulation depth reached 50.9% at a pump density of 2.5 W/cm2. This work proves that PtSe2 nanofilm devices are suitable for terahertz modulators.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于高阻硅衬底的层数依赖PtSe2纳米薄膜光控宽带太赫兹调制器。利用光泵浦-太赫兹探测系统，研究发现，与6层、10层和20层薄膜相比，3层PtSe2纳米薄膜在太赫兹波段展现出更优的表面光电导特性，通过Drude-Smith模型拟合得到其等离子体频率ωp为0.23 THz，散射时间τs为70 fs。借助太赫兹时域光谱系统，实现了3层PtSe2薄膜在0.1–1.6 THz范围内的宽带振幅调制，在2.5 W/cm²泵浦功率密度下调制深度达到50.9%。该工作证实PtSe2纳米薄膜器件适用于太赫兹调制器。
title: Optically Controlling Broadband Terahertz Modulator Based on Layer-Dependent PtSe2 Nanofilms

abstract: When a block of an elastomer is bent, the compressed surface may form a crease. The critical strain for creasing measured experimentally is known to disagree with that predicted by linear perturbation analysis. This paper calculates the critical strain by comparing the elastic energy in a creased body and that in a smooth body. This difference in energy is expressed by a scaling relation. Critical conditions for creasing are determined for elastomers subject to general loads and gels swelling under constraint. The theoretical results are compared with existing experimental observations.
summary_zh: 当弹性体块发生弯曲时，其受压表面可能会产生褶皱。实验测得的褶皱临界应变往往与线性扰动分析的预测结果不一致。本文通过比较褶皱体与光滑体之间的弹性应变能，计算了褶皱产生的临界应变，并将这种能量差异表示为一种标度关系。研究进一步确定了在一般载荷作用下的弹性体以及在约束条件下发生溶胀的凝胶产生褶皱的临界条件。通过将理论计算结果与现有的实验观测数据进行对比，验证了该理论模型的准确性。
title: Formation of creases on the surfaces of elastomers and gels

abstract: In this paper, cutting force and its power spectrum analysis at different tool wear levels are explored. A dynamic model is established to simulate the measured cutting force compositions, and a series of cutting experiments have been conducted to investigate the cutting force evolution with the tool wear progress. Research results reveal that in the time domain, the cutting force in UPRM is characterized as a force pulse follows by a damped vibration signals, the vibration can be modeled by a second order impulse response of the measurement system. While in the frequency domain, it is found that the power spectrum density at the natural frequency of dynamometer increases with the progress of tool wear, which therefore can be utilized to monitor diamond tool wear in UPRM.
summary_zh: 本文探究了超精密加工中不同刀具磨损状态下的切削力及其功率谱特性。通过建立动力学模型模拟实测切削力成分，并结合系列切削实验，分析了刀具磨损过程中切削力的演变规律。时域分析表明，超精密加工中的切削力呈现为一个力脉冲后跟随阻尼振动信号的特征，该振动可建模为测量系统的二阶脉冲响应。频域分析发现，随着刀具磨损加剧，测力仪固有频率处的功率谱密度逐渐增大，这一特征可用于超精密加工中金刚石刀具磨损状态的监测。
title: Cutting Force Evolution and its Power Spectrum Analysis with Tool Wear Progress in Ultra-Precision Raster Milling

abstract: In this paper, we define, a priori, a natural two-dimensional model for a time-dependent flexural shell. As expected, this model takes the form of a set of hyperbolic variational equations posed over the space of admissible linearized inextensional displacements, and a set of initial conditions. Using a classical argument, we prove that the model under consideration admits a unique strong solution. However, the latter strategy makes use of function spaces, which are not amenable for numerically approximating the solution. We thus provide an alternate formulation of the studied problem using a suitable penalty scheme, which is more suitable in the context of numerical approximations. For the sake of completeness, in the final part of the paper, we also provide an existence and uniqueness theorem for the case where the linearly elastic shell under consideration is an elliptic membrane shell.
summary_zh: 本文针对时变弯曲壳体，先验地定义了一个自然的二维模型。该模型由一组定义在容许线性化不可伸长位移空间上的双曲变分方程及初始条件构成。通过经典论证，我们证明了该模型存在唯一强解。然而，该策略所依赖的函数空间不利于数值逼近求解。为此，我们采用适当的罚方法给出了问题的另一种表述，该形式更适用于数值近似计算。作为补充，本文最后部分还针对线弹性壳体为椭圆薄膜壳的情形，给出了解的存在唯一性定理。
title: An existence and uniqueness theorem for the dynamics of flexural shells

abstract: OBJECTIVE: Cohort selection for clinical trials is a key step for clinical research. We proposed a hierarchical neural network to determine whether a patient satisfied selection criteria or not. MATERIALS AND METHODS: We designed a hierarchical neural network (denoted as CNN-Highway-LSTM or LSTM-Highway-LSTM) for the track 1 of the national natural language processing (NLP) clinical challenge (n2c2) on cohort selection for clinical trials in 2018. The neural network is composed of 5 components: (1) sentence representation using convolutional neural network (CNN) or long short-term memory (LSTM) network; (2) a highway network to adjust information flow; (3) a self-attention neural network to reweight sentences; (4) document representation using LSTM, which takes sentence representations in chronological order as input; (5) a fully connected neural network to determine whether each criterion is met or not. We compared the proposed method with its variants, including the methods only using the first component to represent documents directly and the fully connected neural network for classification (denoted as CNN-only or LSTM-only) and the methods without using the highway network (denoted as CNN-LSTM or LSTM-LSTM). The performance of all methods was measured by micro-averaged precision, recall, and F1 score. RESULTS: The micro-averaged F1 scores of CNN-only, LSTM-only, CNN-LSTM, LSTM-LSTM, CNN-Highway-LSTM, and LSTM-Highway-LSTM were 85.24%, 84.25%, 87.27%, 88.68%, 88.48%, and 90.21%, respectively. The highest micro-averaged F1 score is higher than our submitted 1 of 88.55%, which is 1 of the top-ranked results in the challenge. The results indicate that the proposed method is effective for cohort selection for clinical trials. DISCUSSION: Although the proposed method achieved promising results, some mistakes were caused by word ambiguity, negation, number analysis and incomplete dictionary. Moreover, imbalanced data was another challenge that needs to be tackled in the future. CONCLUSION: In this article, we proposed a hierarchical neural network for cohort selection. Experimental results show that this method is good at selecting cohort.
title: Cohort selection for clinical trials using hierarchical neural network
venue: Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association

abstract: Arabidopsis thaliana high-affinity potassium transporter 1 (AtHKT1) limits the root-to-shoot sodium transportation and is believed to be essential for salt tolerance in A. thaliana. Nevertheless, natural accessions with 'weak allele' of AtHKT1, e.g. Tsu-1, are mainly distributed in saline areas and are more tolerant to salinity. These findings challenge the role of AtHKT1 in salt tolerance and call into question the involvement of AtHKT1 in salinity adaptation in A. thaliana. Here, we report that AtHKT1 indeed drives natural variation in the salt tolerance of A. thaliana and the coastal AtHKT1, so-called weak allele, is actually hyper-functional in reducing flowers sodium content upon salt stress. Our data showed that AtHKT1 positively contributes to saline adaptation in a linear manner. Forward and reverse genetics analysis established that the single AtHKT1 locus is responsible for the variation in the salinity adaptation between Col-0 and Tsu-1. Reciprocal grafting experiments revealed that shoot AtHKT1 determines the salt tolerance of Tsu-1, whereas root AtHKT1 primarily drives the salt tolerance of Col-0. Furthermore, evidence indicated that Tsu-1 AtHKT1 is highly expressed in stems and is more effective compared to Col-0 AtHKT1 at limiting sodium flow to the flowers. Such efficient retrieval of sodium to the reproductive organ endows Tsu-1 with stronger fertility compared to Col-0 upon salt stress, thus improving Tsu-1 adaptation to a coastal environment. To conclude, our data not only confirm the role of AtHKT1 in saline adaptation, but also sheds light on our understanding of the salt tolerance mechanisms in plants.
title: AtHKT1 drives adaptation of Arabidopsis thaliana to salinity by reducing floral sodium content

abstract: With the leap-forward development of intelligent driving, traffic light detection with high accuracy and high speed is important for intelligent transportation systems to ensure safety. However, existing methods encounter difficulties in balancing the detection speed and accuracy. This paper aims to present a flexible and robust lightweight model TL (Traffic Light)-Detector for real-time detection of traffic light. The model is composed of three parts. An enhanced backbone network combined with G-module is proposed to generate abundant information and reduce computational load, and the coordinate attention mechanism is introduced to focus on location features thereby strengthening the feature extract ability. The lightweight neck promotes multi-scale feature information aggregation for feature fusion to build a lightweight feature fusion network. The lightweight detection head adopts anchor-free mechanism to eliminate the hyperparameters related to the anchor. The dataset TL2022 of traffic light is built based on real traffic sceneries. Experimental results show that TL-Detector has the best comprehensive performance. TL-Detector achieves a detection speed of 277 FPS and a precision of 73.24% with only 0.72 GFLOPs. The experiments on LaRA (La Route Automatisee) public traffic light dataset show the excellent generalization ability. It indicates that TL-Detector can effectively achieve accurate and real-time detection for traffic lights.
title: TL-Detector: Lightweight Based Real-Time Traffic Light Detection Model for Intelligent Vehicles
venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems

abstract: In reverberant conditions with a single speaker, each far-field microphone records a reverberant version of the same speaker signal at a different location. In over-determined conditions, where there are multiple microphones but only one speaker, each recorded mixture signal can be leveraged as a constraint to narrow down the solutions to target anechoic speech and thereby reduce reverberation. Equipped with this insight, we propose USDnet, a novel deep neural network (DNN) approach for unsupervised speech dereverberation (USD). At each training step, we first feed an input mixture to USDnet to produce an estimate for target speech, and then linearly filter the DNN estimate to approximate the multi-microphone mixture so that the constraint can be satisfied at each microphone, thereby regularizing the DNN estimate to approximate target anechoic speech. The linear filter can be estimated based on the mixture and DNN estimate via neural forward filtering algorithms such as forward convolutive prediction. We show that this novel methodology can promote unsupervised dereverberation of single-source reverberant speech.
summary_zh: 我们提出 USDnet，一种基于深度神经网络的无监督语音去混响方法，适用于单说话人多麦克风的过定混响场景。核心思路是：在只有单一说话人的条件下，每个远场麦克风记录的是同一语音信号在不同位置产生的混响版本，因此各通道的混合信号可作为约束，帮助网络逼近无混响的干净语音。训练时，每一轮先将输入混合信号送入 USDnet 得到目标语音估计，再通过线性滤波对该估计进行处理，使其逼近多麦克风混合信号，从而在每个麦克风处满足约束，以此正则化网络输出，使其更接近无混响语音。线性滤波器通过神经前向滤波算法（如前向卷积预测）从混合信号和网络估计中学习得到。实验表明，该方法能够有效推动单声源混响语音的无监督去混响。
title: USDnet: Unsupervised Speech Dereverberation via Neural Forward Filtering
venue: IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing

abstract: We propose an efficient iterative convolution thresholding method for the formulation of flow networks where the fluid is modeled by the Darcy–Stokes flow with the presence of volume sources. The method is based on the minimization of the dissipation power in the fluid region with a Darcy term. The flow network is represented by its characteristic function and the energy is approximated under this representation. The minimization problem can then be approximately solved by alternating: 1) solving a Brinkman equation to model the Darcy–Stokes flow and 2) updating the characteristic function by a simple convolution and thresholding step. The proposed method is simple and easy to implement. We prove mathematically that the iterative method has the total energy decaying property. Numerical experiments demonstrate the performance and robustness of the proposed method and interesting structures are observed.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种高效的迭代卷积阈值方法，用于求解含体积源项的 Darcy–Stokes 流动网络构型问题。该方法以流体区域内包含 Darcy 项的耗散功率最小化为目标，将流动网络表示为其特征函数，并在此表示下近似能量泛函。通过交替执行两个步骤实现近似求解：第一步求解 Brinkman 方程以模拟 Darcy–Stokes 流动，第二步通过简单的卷积与阈值操作更新特征函数。所提方法结构简洁、易于实现，并从数学上证明了迭代过程具有总能量递减性质。数值实验验证了该方法的性能与鲁棒性，同时观察到具有显著特征的流动网络结构。该方法可应用于多孔介质流、微流控及拓扑优化等相关领域。
title: An Efficient Iterative Method for the Formulation of Flow Networks

abstract: Theoretical calculations reveal the origin of the stereoselectivity and enantioselectivity of cobalt-catalyzed [2 + 2] cyclization of ethylene and enynes.
summary_zh: 理论计算揭示了钴催化乙烯与烯炔[2+2]环化反应立体选择性和对映选择性的起源。通过密度泛函理论系统研究了反应机理，发现该转化经历氧化环化、乙烯插入和还原消除等关键基元步骤。计算结果表明，氧化环化步骤是立体化学的决定性步骤，其中底物与手性钴催化剂之间的空间排斥和色散相互作用共同控制着环化过程的立体选择性。对映选择性的产生源于手性配体营造的不对称配位环境，使得两个前手性面在氧化加成时具有显著的能量差异。该研究阐明了钴催化环加成反应中立体化学控制的内在规律，为设计新型手性催化剂和发展高选择性环化反应提供了理论指导，在不对称合成和手性药物中间体制备领域具有重要应用价值。
title: Probing the origin of the stereoselectivity and enantioselectivity of cobalt-catalyzed [2 + 2] cyclization of ethylene and enynes

summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于光纤环形标准具参考的色散测量方法，用于回音壁模式微腔的非线性光子应用。该方法首先通过边带调制精确测定标准具的自由光谱范围，随后在色散测量过程中利用二元函数拟合推断标准具自身的色散特性。该技术具有结构简单、成本低廉的优势，能够满足微腔光频梳器件设计对色散表征的需求。实验在氟化镁盘式微腔上进行了验证，测量结果与有限元法数值仿真高度吻合。此外，还通过数值模拟研究了此类微腔的色散工程优化。该工作为片上集成克尔微腔光频梳的色散调控提供了实用测量方案。
title: Dispersion engineering and measurement in crystalline microresonators using a fiber ring etalon

abstract: Abstract Background Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is one of the most lethal malignant tumors. Cell division cycle associated 8 (CDCA8) is an important multifactorial regulator in cancers. However, its up and downstream targets and effects in HCC are still unclear. Methods A comprehensive bioinformatics analysis was performed using The Cancer Genome Atlas dataset (TCGA) to explore novel core oncogenes. We quantified CDCA8 levels in HCC tumors using qRT-PCR. HCC cell’s proliferative, migratory, and invasive abilities were detected using a Cell Counting Kit-8 (CCK-8) assay, 5-ethynyl-2′-deoxyuridine (EdU) assay, clone formation, and a Transwell assay. An orthotopic tumor model and tail vein model were constructed to determine the effects of CDCA8 inhibition in vivo. The mechanism underlying CDCA8 was investigated using RNA sequencing. The prognostic value of CDCA8 was assessed with immunohistochemical staining of the tissue microarrays. Results CDCA8 was identified as a novel oncogene during HCC development. The high expression of CDCA8 was an independent predictor for worse HCC outcomes both in publicly available datasets and in our cohort. We found that CDCA8 knockdown inhibited HCC cell proliferation, colony formation, and migration by suppressing the MEK/ERK pathway in vitro. Moreover, CDCA8 deficiency significantly inhibited tumorigenesis and metastasis. Next-generation sequencing and laboratory validation showed that CDCA8 silencing inhibited the expression of TPM3, NECAP2, and USP13. Furthermore, NA-YA overexpression upregulated the expression of CDCA8. CDCA8 knockdown could attenuate NF-YA-mediated cell invasion in vitro. The expression of NF-YA alone or in combined with CDCA8 were validated as significant independent risk factors for patient survival. Conclusion Our findings revealed that the expression of CDCA8 alone or in combined with NF-YA contributed to cancer progression, and could serve as novel potential therapeutic targets for HCC patients.
title: CDCA8 induced by NF-YA promotes hepatocellular carcinoma progression by regulating the MEK/ERK pathway

abstract: Abstract Many new techniques and materials have been applied to microfluidic systems in the past decade, and integrated microfluidic chips have become powerful platforms for realizing highly sensitive, high throughput, and low‐cost analysis. This article reviews the latest advancements of microfluidic platforms for biological and biomedical analysis in the fields of fundamental biology research, clinical application, food safety, and environmental monitoring, with a focus on nucleic acid‐based molecular diagnosis and protein‐based immunodiagnosis. The combination of microfluidics with advanced techniques (e.g., nanotechnology, 3D printing, deep learning) would offer innovative new tools for bioanalyses. The current challenges and the future developments of microfluidic technologies for clinical applications are also discussed. It is anticipated that this review will be beneficial to promoting microfluidics toward a broad range of applications in the future.
summary_zh: 在过去的十年中，微流控技术与多种新材料的结合，使得集成化微流控芯片已成为实现高灵敏度、高通量及低成本分析的强大平台。本文综述了微流控平台在基础生物学研究、临床应用、食品安全及环境监测等领域的最新进展，并重点探讨了基于核酸的分子诊断与基于蛋白质的免疫诊断技术。研究指出，微流控技术与纳米技术、3D打印及深度学习等前沿技术的融合，正为生物分析领域提供创新的工具。此外，本文还讨论了微流控技术在临床应用中面临的现有挑战及未来发展趋势，旨在为推动微流控技术向更广泛的应用领域迈进提供参考。
title: Microfluidics for Biomedical Analysis

abstract: This article studies controllability and observability problems for a class of mixed-valued probabilistic logical control networks (PLCNs). First, PLCN is transformed into the algebraic state-space representation (ASSR)-form by resorting to the semitensor product method. Then, the formulas are presented to calculate the lower and upper bounds of the transition probability matrix, which further derive the controllability and observability criteria. Furthermore, the ASSR-form of a PLCN can be regarded as a Markov decision process. Using the latter framework, we prove the equivalence between the controllability probability and the optimal state-value function, which is an iteration equation. Besides, the parallel extension technique transforms the observability of PLCNs into the set stabilization of an augmented system. The correspondence between observability probability and optimal state-value function is also derived. Afterward, based on the state-value function, the algorithms via the Q-learning technique are exploited to estimate the controllability and observability probabilities along with obtaining the corresponding optimal control sequences. Finally, all the theoretical results are elaborated via a genetic regulatory p53-Mdm2 network.
title: Learning Probabilistic Logical Control Networks: From Data to Controllability and Observability

summary_zh: 本研究探讨了基于虚拟智能体的认知行为疗法对自动负性思维的干预效果。在传统认知行为疗法中，认知重构等技术用于将自动负性思维转变为更现实的认知，本研究在此基础上进一步考察虚拟智能体对话系统在修正负性思维、缓解痛苦与焦虑方面的作用，并重点关注用户动机及先前知识的影响。实验采用单组两阶段被试内设计，招募35名18至50岁参与者，在奈良先端科学技术大学院大学完成数据采集。参与者在虚拟智能体引导下完成围绕自动负性思维的认知行为疗法对话，两次实验间隔一周，通过多份问卷评估抑郁症状及相关认知变量。采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验和配对样本t检验分析痛苦与状态焦虑的变化，通过相关分析考察动机与认知改变及情绪改善的关系，并利用多元线性回归检验先前认知行为疗法知识对干预效果的预测作用。结果显示，两次实验阶段中参与者的痛苦程度和状态焦虑均显著下降，虚拟智能体干预提升了对负性思维的识别能力及改变意愿，即增强了改变动机。然而，动机与痛苦或焦虑减轻之间未发现明确相关性；参与者报告的主观认知变化与动机部分呈正相关。此外，先前对认知行为疗法的了解未能预测首次干预中痛苦的减轻程度。研究表明，基于虚拟智能体的认知行为疗法对话系统能有效缓解个体在谈论自动负性思维时的痛苦与焦虑，但在设计此类干预方案时需审慎考量如何激发来访者动机，未来还需进一步通过实验探究动机与干预效果之间的因果机制。
title: Examining the Effects of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy With a Virtual Agent on User Motivation and Improvement in Psychological Distress and Anxiety: Two-Session Experimental Study

abstract: A rapid, environment-friendly, and cost-effective finishing method has been developed for cotton textiles by using zwitterionic NCO-sulfopropylbetaine as the antibacterial finishing agent through covalent bond. The sulfopropylbetaine-finished cotton textile exhibits durable broad-spectrum antibacterial and nonfouling activity, improved mechanical properties, and enhanced comfort. As a service to our authors and readers, this journal provides supporting information supplied by the authors. Such materials are peer reviewed and may be re-organized for online delivery, but are not copy-edited or typeset. Technical support issues arising from supporting information (other than missing files) should be addressed to the authors. Please note: The publisher is not responsible for the content or functionality of any supporting information supplied by the authors. Any queries (other than missing content) should be directed to the corresponding author for the article.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种快速、环保且成本低廉的棉织物整理方法，采用两性离子型NCO-磺丙基甜菜碱作为抗菌整理剂，通过共价键合方式实现功能化。经磺丙基甜菜碱整理的棉织物展现出持久的广谱抗菌与抗污活性，同时力学性能和穿着舒适性得到改善。该技术为功能性棉纺织品开发提供了新途径，在医用防护、卫生用品及日常服装等领域具有应用前景。
title: Durable Antibacterial and Nonfouling Cotton Textiles with Enhanced Comfort via Zwitterionic Sulfopropylbetaine Coating

abstract: Flex-route transit is regarded as the feasible solution to provide flexible service for various demands. To improve the service of flex-route transit, this paper proposes a design framework with the input of multi-type demands. Firstly, according to the multi-feature-based classification method, static stations and dynamic stations are divided by hierarchical clustering algorithm based on historical demands. Secondly, in the two-stage planning method, an offline plan is generated by multi-route design model and route-design-oriented genetic algorithm based on the classified stations and the flexible combination of reserved demands and regular travel patterns.
