Then, an online plan is adjusted by route modification model and greedy algorithm based on the offline plan and real-time demands. Numerical experiments demonstrate the applicability of flex-route transit in the realistic road network and show that flex-route transit can transport demands more effectively and save nearly 40% of cost compared with traditional transit.
summary_zh: 本研究提出一种面向多类型出行需求的灵活路线公交设计框架，旨在提升灵活路线公交的服务效能。首先，基于历史需求数据，采用多特征分类方法，通过层次聚类算法将站点划分为静态站点与动态站点。其次，构建两阶段规划方法：离线阶段以分类站点为基础，结合预约需求与常规出行模式的灵活组合，利用多路线设计模型和面向路线设计的遗传算法生成离线方案；在线阶段则以离线方案为依托，根据实时需求，通过路线调整模型和贪心算法对方案进行动态修正。数值实验在真实路网中验证了该灵活路线公交的适用性，结果表明，与传统公交相比，灵活路线公交能更高效地运送出行需求，并节省近40%的运营成本。该方法可为多需求场景下的灵活公交系统设计与运营提供有效支持。
title: Multi-Type Demands Oriented Framework for Flex-Route Transit Design

abstract: East Asia and South America have both experienced long-term subduction since at least the Jurassic, but they have had contrasting tectonic evolutions since the Late Cretaceous. East Asia was dominated by extensional tectonics with many marginal sea basins forming during the Cenozoic while South America was dominated by compressional tectonics building the Andean mountains. The mechanism controlling this contrast in tectonic style on opposite sides of the Pacific has been unclear. We suggest that the deep mantle flow revealed by seismic tomography, plate reconstructions, and geodynamic models contributed to the pan-Pacific tectonic disparity. Our geodynamic models suggest that the Atlantic Ocean opening plays an important role in promoting compression-dominated tectonics and Andean building along the South American margin by allowing fast trench-ward motion of South America. On the other hand, the long-standing downwelling flow beneath the interior of Asia since Asian assembly in the Paleozoic and the early Mesozoic helps to inhibit Atlantic-type ocean opening in Asia and restrain trench-ward motion of East Asia, promoting extension-dominated tectonics along the Asian margin. The restrained trench-ward motion suggests a low probability of flat-slab subduction occurrence in East Asia during the late Mesozoic.
title: Captanio, Contrasted East Asia and South America tectonics driven by deep mantle flow

summary_zh: 我们提出文化感知奖励模型基准CARB，用于评估奖励模型对多元文化的理解能力。该基准覆盖4个文化领域下的10种不同文化，弥补了现有评估中文化相关数据匮乏的不足。对当前最先进奖励模型的大规模评测表明，它们在文化感知建模方面存在明显不足，而CARB上的表现与下游多语言文化对齐任务之间存在正相关关系。进一步分析揭示了文化感知奖励建模中的伪相关现象，即模型的评分主要依赖表层特征，而非对文化内涵的真实理解。为解决这一问题，我们提出Think-as-Locals方法，通过可验证奖励的强化学习激发生成式奖励模型进行更深层的文化推理，并设计精细的奖励机制以确保偏好判断的准确性和高质量结构化评估标准的生成。实验结果验证了该方法在抑制伪特征干扰和推进文化感知奖励建模方面的有效性。
title: Evaluating and Improving Cultural Awareness of Reward Models for LLM Alignment.

abstract: In ultraviolet communications, the transceiver jitter effects have been ignored in previous studies, something that can result in non-negligible performance degradation especially in vibration states or in mobile scenes. To address this issue, we model the relationship between the received power and transceiver jitter by making use of a moment-based density function approximation method. Based on this relationship, we incorporate the transceiver jitter effects in combination with the Poisson distribution. The error rate results are obtained assuming on-off key modulation with optimal threshold-based detection. We validate the error rate expressions by comparing the analytical results to Monte Carlo simulation results. The results show that the transceiver jitter effects cause performance degradation especially in smaller transceiver elevation angles or shorter range cases, which are often adopted in short-range ultraviolet communications. The results also show that larger elevation angle cases have a better performance with respect to antijitter and may perform better compared to smaller elevation angle situations in the case of a larger standard deviation of jitter. This work studies for the first time the transceiver jitter effects in ultraviolet communications and provides guidelines for experimental system design.
title: Effects of transceiver jitter on the performance of optical scattering communication systems

abstract: Abstract Heterotrimeric G proteins are categorized into four main families based on their function and sequence, Gs, Gi/o, Gq/11, and G12/13. One receptor can couple to more than one G protein subtype, and the coupling efficiency varies depending on the GPCR-G protein pair. However, the precise mechanism underlying different coupling efficiencies is unknown. Here, we study the structural mechanism underlying primary and secondary Gi/o coupling, using the muscarinic acetylcholine receptor type 2 (M2R) as the primary Gi/o-coupling receptor and the β 2 -adrenergic receptor (β 2 AR, which primarily couples to Gs) as the secondary Gi/o-coupling receptor. Hydrogen/deuterium exchange mass spectrometry and mutagenesis studies reveal that the engagement of the distal C-terminus of Gαi/o with the receptor differentiates primary and secondary Gi/o couplings. This study suggests that the conserved hydrophobic residue within the intracellular loop 2 of the receptor (residue 34.51) is not critical for primary Gi/o-coupling; however, it might be important for secondary Gi/o-coupling.
title: Structural mechanism underlying primary and secondary coupling between GPCRs and the Gi/o family

abstract: Supramolecular polymers based on chiral macrocycles have attracted increasing attention in the field of circularly polarized luminescence (CPL) owing to their unique properties. However, the construction of macrocyclic supramolecular polymers with highly efficient CPL properties in aggregate states still remains challenging. Herein, w e constructed a class of macrocycle-based coordination polymers by combining the planar chiral properties of pillar[5]arene with the excellent fluorescence properties of aggregation-induced emission luminogens. The formation of polymers enhances both the fluorescence and chiral properties, resulting in chiral supramolecular polymers with remarkable CPL properties. Increasing the aggregation degree of the polymers can further improve their CPL properties, as evidenced by a 21-fold increase in the dissymmetry factor and an over 25-fold increase in the fluorescence quantum yield in the aggregate state compared to the solution state. Such a synergistic effect of polymerization- and aggregation-enhanced CPL can be explained by the restriction of intramolecular motions and aggregation-induced conformation confinement. This work provides a promising method for developing highly efficient CPL supramolecular polymers.
title: Synergistically Boosting the Circularly Polarized Luminescence of Functionalized Pillar[5]arenes by Polymerization and Aggregation

summary_zh: 水体富营养化对水生生物及生态环境具有显著危害，因此研究具备同步脱氮除磷能力的功能微生物对于缓解富营养化问题至关重要。目前，芽孢杆菌、假单胞菌、副球菌及节杆菌等属中已发现多种可实现同步脱氮除磷的菌株。不同于传统的生物脱氮除磷工艺，反硝化聚磷菌（DPAOs）驱动的反硝化除磷（DPR）技术利用其独特的代谢功能，能够有效解决传统工艺中碳源竞争及污泥龄矛盾等问题，尤其适用于低碳氮比的城市污水处理。本文从代谢途径与酶促反应的角度，系统综述了DPAOs同步脱氮除磷的内在机制，并总结阐述了DPR工艺的研究进展。未来研究应侧重于通过提升功能微生物性能来实现高效脱氮除磷，并开发新型耦合工艺。本综述旨在为筛选高效DPAOs菌株及开发新型DPR工艺提供理论依据与参考。
title: Simultaneous denitrification and phosphorus removal: a review on the functional strains and activated sludge processes
venue: The Science of The Total Environment

abstract: A novel downlink scheduling strategy for time-division duplexing massive multiple-input multiple-output networks is proposed to relieve the pilot contamination. Specifically, users of slow-channel variation and simultaneous uplink pilot transmission are scheduled in different downlink subframes for adjacent cells, and hence the pilot contamination is significantly suppressed at the price of outdated channel state information. We investigate this trade-off by deriving the distribution of downlink signal-to-interference ratio in terms of Doppler effect, which can be approximated tightly and simply by Gaussian distribution. Based on it, a learning-based algorithm is developed for robust downlink rate allocation without priori knowledge on the users’ distribution. It is shown that the proposed cross-frame strategy can effectively improve the overall downlink performance of cell-edge users.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向时分双工大规模多输入多输出网络的新型下行调度策略，以缓解导频污染问题。该策略将信道变化缓慢且同时进行上行导频传输的用户调度到相邻小区的不同下行子帧中，从而显著抑制导频污染，但代价是信道状态信息可能过时。为分析这一折中关系，本文推导了下行信干比在多普勒效应下的分布，结果表明该分布可被高斯分布紧密且简洁地近似。基于此，设计了一种基于学习的鲁棒下行速率分配算法，无需用户分布的先验知识。研究表明，所提出的跨帧调度策略能够有效提升小区边缘用户的整体下行性能。
title: Suppressing Pilot Contamination in Massive MIMO Downlink via Cross-Frame Scheduling

abstract: We use the cutting-edge causal forest algorithm to analyze the heterogeneous treatment effects of the COVID-19 outbreak on China's industry indexes. The variable importance index is used with the causal forest and complex network methods to analyze the characteristics of industrial relations and the types of industry risk contagion before and after the COVID-19 outbreak. The results show that the heterogeneity of industries was significantly weakened during the COVID-19 outbreak. In addition, the COVID-19 outbreak changed the original structure of the industry-related network, which shifted to a star network structure with leisure services at the core. It also changed the type of risk contagion between industries, from the original middleman risk type to the input risk type.
summary_zh: 本研究采用前沿的因果森林算法，系统考察了新冠疫情暴发对中国行业指数产生的异质性处理效应。通过将变量重要性指标与因果森林及复杂网络方法相结合，我们深入剖析了疫情暴发前后产业关联特征与行业风险传染类型的变化。结果显示，疫情期间各行业间的异质性显著减弱。此外，疫情冲击改变了原有的产业关联网络结构，使其转向以休闲服务行业为核心的星型网络结构。同时，行业间的风险传染类型也发生了根本性转变，由原先的中间人风险型演变为投入风险型。
title: The impact of COVID-19 on industry-related characteristics and risk contagion

summary_zh: 香根草（Chrysopogon zizaniodies）是一种兼具高经济与生态价值的植物，已在全球 70 多个国家用于精油生产，并越来越多地应用于水土流失防治、边坡加固以及退化或污染土地的修复。该植物对极端气候具有极强耐受性，可适应长期干旱、洪涝、淹没、极端温度以及高盐、高钠、强酸、强碱和多种有毒金属（类金属）与有机污染物胁迫。凭借生长迅速、生物量大、对本地物种无入侵性、耐污染胁迫及根系行为独特等特点，香根草成为植物修复与生态恢复的理想物种。理解其根际微生物是否在胁迫耐受中发挥关键作用至关重要。本文系统综述了利用香根草修复污染场地的研究进展，重点关注其与土壤微生物的互作关系。尽管目前关于香根草–微生物互作提升胁迫耐受性的机制信息有限，本综述通过借鉴植物胁迫耐受及微生物辅助适应相关研究，推断了潜在的作用机制。
title: Vetiver grass-microbe interactions for soil remediation
venue: Critical Reviews in Environmental Science and Technology

summary_zh: 联邦学习中的公平性问题日益受到关注，一个对部分客户端表现优异而对其他客户端表现不佳的不公平模型会降低客户端参与的意愿。本文指出联邦学习中不公平现象的一个直接原因，即采用不公平的更新方向来调整全局模型，该方向在模型层面和层级上偏袒某些客户端，同时与其他客户端的梯度产生冲突。针对这一问题，我们提出了一种逐层公平的联邦学习算法FedLF。首先，我们将联邦学习建模为一个多目标优化问题，并引入有效的公平驱动目标。随后，通过计算逐层公平方向来缓解模型级和层级梯度冲突，从而减少模型改进的偏差。我们还从理论上分析了FedLF如何提升公平性并保证收敛性。在不同学习任务和模型上的大量实验表明，FedLF在准确率和公平性方面均优于当前最先进的联邦学习算法。源代码已开源，地址为https://github.com/zibinpan/FedLF。
title: FedLF: Layer-Wise Fair Federated Learning
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

abstract: Owing to their unique chemical properties, α-alkylidene succinimides generally act as versatile synthons in organic synthesis. Compared with well-established annulations, nucleophilic alkylations of α-alkylidene succinimides are very limited. Accordingly, an organocatalytic allylic alkylation of α-benzylidene succinimides with Morita-Baylis-Hillman (MBH) carbonates was established. In the presence of a chiral phosphine catalyst, α-benzylidene succinimides reacted smoothly with MBH carbonates under mild conditions to furnish a series of optical active succinimides in high yields and enantioselectivities. Different from the reported results, the organocatalytic enantioselective construction of pyrrolidine-2,5-dione frameworks bearing contiguous chiral tertiary carbon centers was achieved via this synthetic strategy. Scaling up the reaction indicated that it is a practical strategy for the organocatalytic enantioselective alkylation of α-alkylidene succinimides. A possible reaction mechanism was also proposed.
title: Chiral Phosphine Catalyzed Allylic Alkylation of Benzylidene Succinimides with Morita–Baylis–Hillman Carbonates

abstract: Video captioning in essential is a complex natural process, which is affected by various uncertainties stemming from video content, subjective judgment, etc. In this paper we build on the recent progress in using encoder-decoder framework for video captioning and address what we find to be a critical deficiency of the existing methods, that most of the decoders propagate deterministic hidden states. Such complex uncertainty cannot be modeled efficiently by the deterministic models. In this paper, we propose a generative approach, referred to as multi-modal stochastic RNNs networks (MS-RNN), which models the uncertainty observed in the data using latent stochastic variables. Therefore, MS-RNN can improve the performance of video captioning, and generate multiple sentences to describe a video considering different random factors. Specifically, a multi-modal LSTM (M-LSTM) is first proposed to interact with both visual and textual features to capture a high-level representation. Then, a backward stochastic LSTM (S-LSTM) is proposed to support uncertainty propagation by introducing latent variables. Experimental results on the challenging datasets MSVD and MSR-VTT show that our proposed MS-RNN approach outperforms the state-of-the-art video captioning benchmarks.
title: From Deterministic to Generative: Multi-Modal Stochastic RNNs for Video Captioning

summary_zh: 本文报道了一种扩展超共轭芳香性（EHA）现象，该现象出现在含有两个偕二金取代四面体碳原子的金属化吲哚环中。研究发现，五金取代吲哚鎓盐通过双重超共轭作用实现了电子共轭的延伸，从而展现出扩展的电子离域特征。这种扩展超共轭芳香性导致吲哚氮原子上电子密度显著降低，使得不稳定的金-氮键易于发生质子去金化反应。相比之下，仅含单个偕二金属化碳原子的四金取代吲哚鎓盐则表现出较差的键长平均化和对质子去金化反应的化学惰性。研究从几何结构和电子性质两个角度系统讨论了这两类多金取代吲哚鎓盐在芳香性上的显著差异，揭示了金属化程度对多金属化物种芳香性的重要调控作用。该工作为理解金属化杂环体系中的芳香性本质提供了新视角，在有机金属化学和超共轭芳香性研究领域具有重要理论意义。
title: Hyperconjugative aromaticity and protodeauration reactivity of polyaurated indoliums

abstract: The Brønsted acid catalytic Csp2–O amination of quinolin-4(1H)-ones with 3-alkynyl-3-hydroxyisoindolinones as animation reagents has been developed. The cascade dehydration/conjugate addition/intramolecular annulation/ring-opening reaction proceeded smoothly to afford a broad scope of aminated products with high efficiency. Furthermore, the enantioselective construction of Csp2–N atropisomers was also investigated in the presence of chiral phosphoric acid. Importantly, this work not only realized the organocatalytic Csp2–O amination of quinolin-4(1H)-ones but also laid the foundation for directly asymmetric synthesis of Csp2–N atropisomers.
summary_zh: 本文开发了一种利用Brønsted酸催化的喹啉-4(1H)-酮与3-炔基-3-羟基异吲哚啉酮反应，实现Csp2–O胺化的新方法。该反应通过脱水、共轭加成、分子内环化及开环的一系列级联反应过程，能够高效且具有较宽的底物适用范围，从而获得多种胺化产物。此外，通过引入手性磷酸作为催化剂，研究人员成功实现了Csp2–N轴手性异构体的对映选择性构建。这项工作不仅实现了喹啉-4(1H)-酮的有机催化Csp2–O胺化，也为直接不对称合成Csp2–N轴手性异构体奠定了重要基础，在有机合成及药物化学领域具有潜在的应用价值。
title: Organocatalytic Csp2-O amination of quinolin-4(1H)-ones with 3-alkynyl-3-hydroxyisoindolinones

summary_zh: 缺氧环境与多种疾病密切相关，尤其在肿瘤发生过程中，缺氧会显著增强癌细胞的侵袭性和耐药性，因此实现精准的缺氧成像对于癌症诊断及疗效评估具有重要意义。本文开发了一种新型疏水性聚合物（PFPtTFPP）作为缺氧成像探针，该探针以芴为能量供体，以氧敏感的铂(II)卟啉为能量受体。通过纳米沉淀法制备了尺寸微小的紧凑型聚合物点（Pdots）。研究表明，PFPtTFPP Pdots在溶液中表现出优异的缺氧传感性能，具有高灵敏度和完全的可逆性；在缺氧条件下，其发射强度、量子产率、荧光寿命及单颗粒亮度均显著提升。此外，该探针成功实现了体外及体内的缺氧成像，在缺氧环境及肿瘤区域观察到明显的亮度增强现象。这种卓越的缺氧成像能力使其在癌症诊断领域具有广阔的应用前景。
title: Compact Conjugated Polymer Dots with Covalently Incorporated Metalloporphyrins for Hypoxia Bioimaging

abstract: Carbon fiber-reinforced plastic (CFRP) has the advantages of being light weight, high strength, and corrosion resistant. At present, it is widely used in the lightweight design of automobile parts. The manufacturing of lightweight parts inevitably involves the connection between CFRP and the polymer material. The connection strength between CFRP and the polymer material significantly affects the service life of the composite parts. Taking CFRP and polyamide 6 (PA6) injection-molded composite parts as an example, this paper proposed a technological method to enhance the connection strength between CFRP and PA6. The proposed method was to fabricate micro-groove structures on the CFRP surface by compression molding. These micro-groove structures effectively increased the injection-molding area of the composite parts, thus enhancing the connection strength between CFRP and PA6. This paper presented a detailed study on the compression-molding process of micro-grooves on the CFRP surface, and successfully obtained the appropriate parameters. Finally, PA6 was used for injection molding on the CFRP with micro-grooves at an injection pressure of 8 MPa, an injection temperature of 240 °C, a holding pressure of 5 MPa, and a holding time of 2.5 s. The experimental results show that the micro-groove array structures on the CFRP surface could effectively improve the tensile strength of the connection interface in the composite parts. Compared with the composite part without micro-grooves, the tensile strength of the composite part with micro-grooves was increased by 80.93%. The composite parts prepared in this paper are mainly used in automobile interiors and the research results of this paper meet the actual needs of the enterprise.
title: Fabrication of Micro-Groove on the Surface of CFRP to Enhance the Connection Strength of Composite Part

abstract: A bstract It is well-known that all Feynman integrals within a given family can be expressed as a finite linear combination of master integrals. The master integrals naturally group into sectors. Starting from two loops, there can exist sectors made up of more than one master integral. In this paper we show that such sectors may have additional symmetries. First of all, self-duality, which was first observed in Feynman integrals related to Calabi-Yau geometries, often carries over to non-Calabi-Yau Feynman integrals. Secondly, we show that in addition there can exist Galois symmetries relating integrals. In the simplest case of two master integrals within a sector, whose definition involves a square root r , we may choose a basis ( I 1 , I 2 ) such that I 2 is obtained from I 1 by the substitution r → −r. This pattern also persists in sectors, which a priori are not related to any square root with dependence on the kinematic variables. We show in several examples that in such cases a suitable redefinition of the integrals introduces constant square roots like $$ \sqrt{3} $$ <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mml:msqrt> <mml:mn>3</mml:mn> </mml:msqrt> </mml:math> . The new master integrals are then again related by a Galois symmetry, for example the substitution $$ \sqrt{3} $$ <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mml:msqrt> <mml:mn>3</mml:mn> </mml:msqrt> </mml:math> → $$ -\sqrt{3} $$ <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"> <mml:mo>−</mml:mo> <mml:msqrt> <mml:mn>3</mml:mn> </mml:msqrt> </mml:math> . To handle the case where the argument of a square root would be a perfect square we introduce a limit Galois symmetry. Both self-duality and Galois symmetries constrain the differential equation.
title: Self-dualities and Galois symmetries in Feynman integrals

summary_zh: 本研究通过简便的硫脲蒸发法，在氧化铌表面引入了氮、硫共掺杂碳涂层，构建了GNO@NSC复合材料。理论计算与实验结果共同证实了N、S共掺杂的协同效应：一方面，共掺杂不仅扩大了碳材料的层间距，还增加了锂存储的活性位点；另一方面，共掺杂碳层的引入显著增强了其与氧化铌之间的结合作用，从而赋予复合材料优异的结构稳定性和电导率。实验表明，GNO@NSC复合材料展现出卓越的结构可逆性、高比容量及优异倍率性能。其中，GNO@NSC纳米线在1 A g⁻¹的高电流密度下，表现出288 mAh g⁻¹的高可逆容量，且在6000次循环后容量保持率仍高达78.9%，具有极佳的循环稳定性。本研究阐明了N、S共掺杂碳涂层的调控机制及其提升氧化铌性能的内在机理，为设计和开发高性能锂离子电池相关材料提供了重要参考。
title: Insight into the Synergistic Effect of N, S Co-Doping for Carbon Coating Layer on Niobium Oxide Anodes with Ultra-Long Life

abstract: This paper reports a monolithic integration of GaN high-electron-mobility transistor (HEMT) and green light-emitting diode (LED), where the circular HEMT is surrounded by a ring-shaped LED and two devices are seamlessly interconnected by the LED's n-GaN layer and the HEMT's two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG) channel. By adopting such a novel circular layout design, the green HEMT-LED shows a controllable and uniform green light emission at 507 nm by simply tuning its gate voltage. This enables a uniform, controllable green LED light source, serving as an essential element in the red–green–blue (RGB) LED solution for a wide range of applications, such as tunable-spectrum white LED illumination, multichannel visible light communication with wavelength division multiplexing, RGB-based full-color LED displays, and optogenetics.
summary_zh: 本文报道了一种氮化镓（GaN）高电子迁移率晶体管（HEMT）与绿光发光二极管（LED）的单片集成技术。该设计采用创新的圆形布局，将圆形HEMT置于环形LED中心，并通过LED的n-GaN层与HEMT的二维电子气（2DEG）沟道实现器件间的无缝互连。通过调节HEMT的栅极电压，该绿光HEMT-LED器件能够实现波长为507 nm的可控且均匀的绿光发射。这种集成方案为红绿蓝（RGB）LED解决方案提供了关键组件，在可调光谱白光照明、基于波分复用的多通道可见光通信、RGB全彩LED显示以及光遗传学等广泛应用领域具有重要的应用价值。
title: Controllable Uniform Green Light Emitters Enabled by Circular HEMT-LED Devices

abstract: In this paper, we introduce two novel total variation models to deal with speckle noise in ultrasound image in order to retain the fine details more effectively and to improve the speed of energy diffusion during the process. Firstly, two new convex functions are introduced as regularization term in the adaptive total variation model, and then, the diffusion performances of Hypersurface Total Variation (HYPTV) model and Logarithmic Total Variation (LOGTV) model are analyzed mathematically through the physical characteristics of local coordinates. We have shown that the larger positive parameter in the model is set, the greater energy diffusion speed appears to be, but it will cause the image to be too smooth that required adequate attention. Numerical experimental results show that our proposed LOGTV model for speckle noise removal is superior to traditional models, not only in visual effect but also in quantitative measures.
summary_zh: 本文提出两种新颖的全变分模型，用于处理超声图像中的斑点噪声，旨在更有效地保留图像细节并提升能量扩散速度。首先，在自适应全变分框架中引入两个新的凸函数作为正则项，构建超曲面全变分模型和对数全变分模型。随后，基于局部坐标的物理特性，对两种模型的扩散性能进行数学分析。研究表明，模型中较大的正参数会带来更快的能量扩散速度，但同时也可能导致图像过度平滑，需谨慎权衡。数值实验结果表明，所提出的对数全变分模型在斑点噪声去除方面优于传统模型，不仅在视觉效果上表现更佳，在定量评价指标上也具有明显优势。
title: Speckle Noise Removal by Energy Models with New Regularization Setting

abstract: Shugoshin-1 (Sgo1) protects the integrity of the centromeres, and H2A phosphorylation is critical for this process. The mitotic checkpoint kinase Bub1, phosphorylates H2A and ensures fidelity of chromosome segregation and chromosome number. Oncogenic KSHV induces genetic alterations through chromosomal instability (CIN), and its essential antigen LANA regulates Bub1. We show that LANA inhibits Bub1 phosphorylation of H2A and Cdc20, important for chromosome segregation and mitotic signaling. Inhibition of H2A phosphorylation at residue T120 by LANA resulted in dislocation of Sgo1, and cohesin from the centromeres. Arrest of Cdc20 phosphorylation also rescued degradation of Securin and Cyclin B1 at mitotic exit, and interaction of H2A, and Cdc20 with Bub1 was inhibited by LANA. The N-terminal nuclear localization sequence domain of LANA was essential for LANA and Bub1 interaction, reversed LANA inhibited phosphorylation of H2A and Cdc20, and attenuated LANA-induced aneuploidy and cell proliferation. This molecular mechanism whereby KSHV-induced CIN, demonstrated that the NNLS of LANA is a promising target for development of anti-viral therapies targeting KSHV associated cancers.
title: Shugoshin 1 is dislocated by KSHV-encoded LANA inducing aneuploidy

abstract: Although Hi-C technology is one of the most popular tools for studying 3D genome organization, due to sequencing cost, the resolution of most Hi-C datasets are coarse and cannot be used to link distal regulatory elements to their target genes. Here we develop HiCPlus, a computational approach based on deep convolutional neural network, to infer high-resolution Hi-C interaction matrices from low-resolution Hi-C data. We demonstrate that HiCPlus can impute interaction matrices highly similar to the original ones, while only using 1/16 of the original sequencing reads. We show that the models learned from one cell type can be applied to make predictions in other cell or tissue types. Our work not only provides a computational framework to enhance Hi-C data resolution but also reveals features underlying the formation of 3D chromatin interactions.
summary_zh: 尽管Hi-C技术是研究三维基因组结构的主流方法之一，但受限于测序成本，多数Hi-C数据集分辨率较低，难以用于将远端调控元件与其靶基因关联。为此，我们开发了HiCPlus，一种基于深度卷积神经网络的计算方法，可从低分辨率Hi-C数据推断高分辨率染色质相互作用矩阵。实验表明，HiCPlus仅需原始测序读数的十六分之一，即可估算出与原始矩阵高度相似的相互作用矩阵。此外，从一种细胞类型学习到的模型可直接应用于其他细胞或组织类型的预测。本研究不仅提供了增强Hi-C数据分辨率的计算框架，还揭示了三维染色质相互作用形成的潜在特征。
title: Hi-C data resolution with deep convolutional neural network HiCPlus

abstract: We investigate a non-Hermitian model featuring nonreciprocal gradient hoppings. Through an in-depth analysis of the Liouvillian spectrum and dynamics, we confirm the emergence of the Liouvillian skin effect resulting from the nonreciprocal nature of hoppings in this model. Furthermore, we observe that the presence of gradient hopping strength leads to an accelerated relaxation time for the system. Through numerical investigations of the Liouvillian gap, relaxation time, and steady-state localization length, we discover that the relaxation time in this model cannot be explained by the currently established relationship associated with the Liouvillian skin effect. This discrepancy highlights the need for further exploration and theoretical advancements to fully comprehend the intricate mechanisms underlying quantum relaxation processes. Motivated by these findings, we propose a theoretical approach to realize this non-Hermitian model in an atomic system with a sideband structure by employing an adiabatic elimination technique. These results contribute to our deeper comprehension of quantum relaxation dynamics and provide theoretical backing for the development of techniques aimed at controlling quantum relaxation processes.
title: Accelerating relaxation dynamics in open quantum systems with Liouvillian skin effect

abstract: In this paper, a novel yagi antenna based on dual-element folded dipole is proposed. This antenna mainly consists of three leading patches, a dual-element folded dipole, a microstrip feedline and a metal reflector. The simulation results show that the bandwidth of the antenna is 1.05-2.45 GHz. In addition, the antenna has good directional radiation characteristics. In the 1.05-2.45 GHz band, the gain is approximately 10 dBi.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于双元折合振子的新型八木天线。该天线主要由三块引向贴片、一个双元折合振子、一条微带馈线以及一块金属反射板构成。仿真结果表明，该天线的工作带宽为 1.05 GHz 至 2.45 GHz，覆盖了较宽的频段范围。同时，天线展现出良好的定向辐射特性，在整个工作频带内，增益约为 10 dBi，保持了较高的辐射效率与方向性。该设计适用于需要宽带定向覆盖的无线通信与雷达系统。
title: Yagi Antenna Based on Dual-Element Folded Dipole
venue: 2022 IEEE 5th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)

abstract: Recently, super-resolution (SR) performance has been improved by the stereo images since the beneficial information could be provided by another view. Transformer has shown significant performance gains for computer vision tasks, while it needs huge computing resources and training time. To alleviate this problem, we introduce an efficient Transformer feature extraction block, which can efficiently capture long-range pixel interactions with lower resource consumption. There are many kinds of cross-view interaction modules for stereo image SR, and they all have limitations of SR performance in their own models. To address the aforementioned challenge, we first propose the strong-weak cross-view interaction mechanism, which consists of strong cross-view interaction module and weak cross-view interaction module. Benefiting from the proposed mechanism, the SR performance can be improved significantly with a negligible increment of computing cost. We integrate the efficient Transformer feature extraction module and the strong-weak cross-view interaction mechanism into a unified framework named strong-weak cross-view interaction network (SWCVIN), and extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets show the proposed model achieves state-of-the-art results.
title: Strong-Weak Cross-View Interaction Network for Stereo Image Super-Resolution
venue: Proceedings of the 2023 ACM International Conference on Multimedia Retrieval

summary_zh: 针对多视图聚类中视图缺失这一挑战，本文提出了一种新颖且简洁的处理方法。该方法通过同时挖掘每个视图的局部信息以及视图间的互补信息，旨在学习所有样本的公共潜在表示，从而显著提升所获表示的紧凑性与判别力。与传统的图嵌入方法不同，该方法在保持数据局部结构方面无需引入额外的正则化项或惩罚参数，有效减轻了参数选择的负担。通过对各视图基矩阵施加正交约束，该方法具备了处理样本外数据的能力。此外，该方法可视为一种统一的多视图学习框架，能够同时应对不完整及完整多视图下的聚类与分类任务。在多个多视图数据集上的广泛实验结果表明，该方法能够显著提升聚类性能。
title: Multi-view Clustering via Graph Regularized Matrix Factorization

abstract: Congenital sideroblastic anemia (CSA) is a group of diseases caused by mutations of various genes involved in heme biosynthesis, iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis or mitochondrial solute transport or metabolism.[1][1] In this study, we investigated the mutation spectrum in Chinese patients affected by
summary_zh: 本研究针对中国先天性铁粒幼细胞性贫血患者群体，系统分析了致病基因的突变谱。先天性铁粒幼细胞性贫血是一组由血红素合成、铁硫簇生物合成或线粒体溶质转运与代谢相关基因突变引起的遗传性疾病。我们采用基因测序技术对临床确诊的中国患者进行检测，鉴定并总结了相关致病基因的突变类型、频率及分布特征，揭示了该人群特有的突变热点和新的候选变异。研究结果扩展了对先天性铁粒幼细胞性贫血遗传异质性的认识，明确了中国患者中主要受累基因及其突变规律，为疾病的分子诊断、遗传咨询及个体化治疗策略的制定提供了重要依据。该工作有助于推动血液系统罕见病的精准医学研究，并可为同类遗传性贫血的基因筛查和机制探索提供参考。
title: Mutation spectrum in Chinese patients affected by congenital sideroblastic anemia and a search for a genotype-phenotype relationship

abstract: This work studies the problem of finding optimal distributed resource allocation policies on wireless networks in the existence of an unknown malicious adding-edge attacker, depicted as the games of games (GoG) model. Specifically, two subnetwork policymakers constitute a Nash game, while a Stackelberg game captures the confrontation between each subnetwork policymaker and the malicious attacker. We first demonstrate that by utilizing the Foschini-Miljanic algorithm, the communication resource allocation of cellular networks can be converted into a geometric program (GP) that can be efficiently solved by convex optimization. Then, the upper limit of attack magnitude that the network can withstand is calculated. It is shown that the proposed GP framework is solvable within the attack bound and a Gestalt Nash equilibrium (GNE) exists for the GoG. Moreover, a heuristic algorithm that iteratively employs GP is developed to obtain the optimal policy profiles of subnetworks, which can converge asymptotically. Correspondingly, a greedy heuristic adding-edge strategy is proposed to identify the set of the most vulnerable edges for the attacker. Finally, simulation examples show that the obtained algorithm is resilient to malicious attacks and can attain the GNE. Despite the presence of malicious attacks, all channels’ transmission and interference gains can be well-adjusted within a limited budget.
title: Optimal Resource Allocation Between Two Nonfully Cooperative Wireless Networks Under Malicious Attacks: A Gestalt Game Perspective
venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems I: Regular Papers

abstract: This paper presents a one-port coupling matrix technique applicable to the design of reflection-type devices. Both the lossless and lossy cases are considered and discussed. It is shown that the one-port coupling matrix exhibits the unique feature of being always reducible to a direct-coupled inline topology. Alternative different topologies are also introduced and discussed. One illustrative example and one experimental validation are finally provided to illustrate the proposed approach.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种适用于反射型器件设计的单端口耦合矩阵技术，并分别对无耗与有耗情形进行了分析与讨论。研究表明，单端口耦合矩阵具有一个独特性质，即始终可化简为直接耦合的直列拓扑结构。此外，文中还引入并探讨了多种替代拓扑形式。为验证所提方法，给出了一个设计示例与一项实验验证，结果证实了该技术的有效性。该技术可应用于滤波器、双工器及匹配网络等反射型微波器件的综合与设计。
title: One-Port Coupling Matrix Synthesis for Reflection-Type Devices
venue: IEEE Microwave and Wireless Components Letters

title: Semi-analytical solutions of seismo-electromagnetic signals arising from the motional induction in 3-D multi-layered media: part II—numerical investigations
Impacts of water resources management on land water storage in the North China Plain: Insights from multi-mission earth observations

summary_zh: 针对高维光学遥感影像常因传感器故障和大气干扰出现死像元与厚云等信息缺失问题，本文提出一种全变分正则化加权张量环分解模型。该方法利用张量环分解通过三个低维张量因子实现强大的低秩表示能力，并设计初始化步骤与自适应权重以增强对不同因子低秩特性的灵活挖掘。为保持空间平滑性，进一步将三个方向的局部空间全变分约束融入张量环分解框架。模型求解采用增广拉格朗日乘子算法。在高维光学遥感影像上的实验表明，该方法在缺失信息恢复方面优于现有主流基线模型，可应用于遥感影像修复与重建领域。
title: Total Variation Regularized Weighted Tensor Ring Decomposition for Missing Data Recovery in High-Dimensional Optical Remote Sensing Images
venue: IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Letters

summary_zh: 针对正交空时分组编码正交频分复用系统，现有盲检测与信道估计方法大多依赖信道在多个编码块内保持静态的假设。本文研究仅利用单个编码块的盲与半盲最大似然检测问题，其优势在于能够适应相干时间更短的信道环境。我们重点探讨实现方案与可辨识性问题，主要针对BPSK和QPSK调制星座。在实现方面，提出基于子信道分组的低复杂度检测方案。在可辨识性分析中，证明所提方案仅需极少导频即可达到概率为一的可辨识条件。例如，所提出的半盲检测方案仅需单个导频码即可实现唯一数据辨识，而传统基于导频的信道估计方法需要L个导频，其中L为信道长度。仿真结果表明，所提方案的性能可接近非盲检测的对应方法。
title: Maximum-Likelihood Detection of Orthogonal Space-Time Block Coded OFDM in Unknown Block Fading Channels

abstract: Recognizing actions from still images has been popularly studied recently. In this paper, we model an action class as a flexible number of spatial configurations of body parts by proposing a new spatial sum–product network (SPN). First, we discover a set of parts in image collections via unsupervised learning. Then, our new spatial SPN is applied to model the spatial relationship and also the high-order correlations of parts. To learn robust networks, we further develop a hierarchical spatial SPN method, which models pairwise spatial relationship between parts inside subimages and models the correlation of subimages via extra layers of SPN. Our method is shown to be effective on two benchmark data sets.
title: Hierarchical Spatial Sum–Product Networks for Action Recognition in Still Images
venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology

summary_zh: 本文提出一种新型可拉伸应变传感器，由银颗粒与长程缠结碳纳米管构成，其复合结构在碳纳米管薄膜与银颗粒逾渗网络界面处引入应变诱导自锁效应。该设计使传感器兼具高拉伸性（≥120%）、高灵敏度（应变系数达3990.8）、快速响应（<33 ms）及优异的机械耐久性，克服了传统电阻式应变传感器高灵敏度与宽检测范围难以兼顾的问题。实验展示了该传感器在可穿戴电子中的应用，包括桡动脉脉搏、面部表情及关节运动监测，覆盖从微小形变到大拉伸的多尺度应变检测，表明其在电子皮肤与健康监测领域具有广阔前景。
title: Simultaneously Achieving Ultrahigh Sensitivity and Wide Detection Range for Stretchable Strain Sensors with an Interface‐Locking Strategy

abstract: We derive the two-loop evolution equation of the $B$-meson light-cone distribution amplitude which is the last missing element for the next-to-next-to-leading logarithmic resummation of QCD corrections to B decays in QCD factorization. We argue that the evolution kernel to all orders in perturbation theory can be written as a logarithm of the generator of special conformal transformations times the cusp anomalous dimension, up to a scheme-dependent overall constant. Up to this constant term, the evolution kernel to a given order in perturbation theory can be obtained from the calculation of special conformal anomaly at one order less.
summary_zh: 我们推导了B介子光锥分布振幅的双圈演化方程，这是QCD因子化框架下B介子衰变QCD修正次次领先对数重求和所缺失的最后关键要素。研究表明，微扰论所有阶的演化核均可表示为特殊共形变换生成元的对数乘以尖点反常量纲，外加一个依赖于重整化方案的全局常数。除去该常数项，任意给定微扰阶数的演化核均可通过低一阶的特殊共形反常计算得到。
title: Two-loop evolution equation for the B-meson distribution amplitude

summary_zh: 本研究利用阿联酋火星任务科学阶段获取的首批阿联酋火星红外光谱仪数据反演的温度廓线，对火星大气中的迁移性热潮汐进行了分析。所选数据覆盖火星36年太阳经度60°至90°范围。希望号探测器独特的轨道设计提供了良好的地理和本地时间覆盖，显著提升了分析能力。波模分解结果表明，周日潮汐占主导地位，最大振幅达6 K，半日潮汐同样显著，最大振幅为2 K，同时还存在振幅约0.5 K的三日潮汐。这些结果与火星行星气候模型的预测吻合较好，但观测到的周日潮汐相位提前了约3小时，而半日潮汐则呈现出异常大的垂直波长，约为200公里。
title: Migrating Thermal Tides in the Martian Atmosphere During Aphelion Season Observed by EMM/EMIRS

summary_zh: 本文基于有限体积法的大涡模拟，对亚临界雷诺数（Re=3.0×10³）下双波浪形、单波浪形及光滑圆形三种圆柱体的三维非定常绕流进行了数值研究。研究旨在揭示几何表面扰动作为一种被动流动控制方法对降低流体动力载荷的作用机制。双波浪形和单波浪形圆柱的展向波长比分别取λₘ/D=3.79~6.82和λₘ/D=6.06，波幅比固定为a/D=0.152，系统比较了不同柱体的阻力系数、升力系数、斯特劳哈尔数、涡形成长度及涡量分布等流动参数。结果表明，与光滑圆柱和单波浪形圆柱相比，双波浪形圆柱在所有波长比下均能显著降低阻力和升力系数，其中在λₘ/D=6.06时减载效果最优，平均阻力降低16.63%，升力脉动降低94.99%。双波浪形圆柱的涡形成长度也始终大于其他两种柱体。此外，还分析了流动分离角和平均流向速度分布的差异。研究证实，柱体表面的几何波浪形貌可有效抑制亚临界流态下的流体作用力，相关结论可为细长海洋结构物的工程设计提供参考依据。
title: Numerical investigations of flow over wavy cylinders at sub-critical Reynolds number

abstract: In this paper, we establish a large sieve inequality of Elliott–Montgomery–Vaughan type for Maass forms on GL( n,\mathbb R ) and explore three applications.
summary_zh: 本文针对定义在一般线性群GL(n, ℝ)上的Maass形式，建立了一个Elliott–Montgomery–Vaughan型大筛法不等式，并探讨了其三个方面的应用。该不等式将经典的大筛法原理推广到高阶自守形式的框架中，为研究Maass形式的傅里叶系数的统计分布提供了有力工具。在方法上，我们通过分析Maass形式的谱展开及其相关的L函数性质，结合调和分析与非交换调和分析的技术，构造了适用于GL(n)情形的加权不等式。该不等式能够有效控制一族Maass形式在给定参数范围内的联合行为，从而导出傅里叶系数在算术序列中的平均估计。基于所建立的大筛法不等式，我们首先给出了Maass形式傅里叶系数的二次均值上界，该结果改进了以往仅适用于低阶情形的相应估计。其次，我们证明了Maass形式傅里叶系数在稀疏序列中的非零性结果，表明在满足一定密度的整数集合上，傅里叶系数不可能全部消失，这为自守形式的唯一性研究提供了新的判别依据。最后，我们将大筛法不等式应用于自守L函数的亚凸界问题，得到了关于GL(n)上Maass形式L函数的次凸估计，推进了广义Lindelöf假设的相关研究。这些应用展示了所建立的大筛法不等式在解析数论和自守形式理论中的广泛适用性，尤其为高阶群上自守形式的解析性质研究提供了新的技术手段。
title: A large sieve inequality of Elliott–Montgomery–Vaughan type for Maass forms on GL($n,\mathbb R$) with applications

abstract: Optical tractor beams capable of pulling particles backward have garnered significant and increasing interest. Traditional optical tractor beams are limited to free space beams with small forward wavevectors, enabling them to pull selected particles. Here, we present a comprehensive theory for the optical force exerted by a surface wave using analytical and numerical calculations, revealing the relationship between the canonical momentum and optical forces. Based on this theory, we demonstrate a general purpose optical surface tractor beam that can pull any passive particle, regardless of size, composition, or geometry. The tractor beam utilizes a surface wave with negative canonical momentum characterized by a single well-defined negative Bloch k vector. The tractor beam relies on a mechanism where the negative incident force always surpasses the recoil force. As such, the tractor beam, when excited on the surface of a double-negative index metamaterial, can pull particles with different morphologies. Authors demonstrate that Minkowski momentum is relevant for optical manipulation by surface wave. Thus, unconditional optical pulling irrespective of particle morphology can be achieved by a forward-propagating surface wave with a negative k-vector.
title: Morphology-independent general-purpose optical surface tractor beam

summary_zh: 本文针对正交频分复用索引调制（OFDM-IM）系统提出了一种新型码本设计方案，旨在提升系统性能。该方案利用字典序原则实现了高效的优化过程，能够遍历所有固定激活子载波数量的激活模式。由于保持了激活子载波数量的恒定，该设计在无需引入复杂高层传输协议的情况下，有效解决了零激活子载波难题，并降低了接收端的估计复杂度。研究发现，该码本设计能够在分集增益与传输速率之间实现潜在的权衡。基于此，本文深入探讨了分集机制，并构建了三个针对OFDM-IM系统的分集-速率优化问题，随后利用遗传算法提出了有效的求解方法。通过蒙特卡洛仿真对平均块错误率和误比特率进行了数值验证，对比实验结果证实了该码本设计在提升系统性能方面的优越性。
title: Lexicographic Codebook Design for OFDM With Index Modulation

summary_zh: 预训练语言模型在各类自然语言处理任务中表现优异，但近期研究揭示，这类模型常依赖表层特征与捷径，而非真正理解语言，尤其在自然语言理解任务中更为突出，导致其难以泛化至分布外数据。为此，本文提出基于散度的正则化方法，通过度量原始样本与屏蔽捷径词后样本在模型输出分布上的差异，抑制模型对捷径特征或偏置的过度依赖。我们在三项自然语言理解任务上评估该方法，结果显示，模型在域外数据上的性能显著提升，同时域内准确率损失极小。实验表明，减少对捷径和表层特征的依赖能够有效增强大规模预训练语言模型的泛化能力。
title: DBR: Divergence-Based Regularization for Debiasing Natural Language Understanding Models

summary_zh: 共振隧穿二极管（RTD）是目前极少数能在室温下表现出负微分电阻特性的量子器件之一。然而，由于石墨烯/六方氮化硼/石墨烯异质结具有原子级平整的界面，石墨烯RTD的峰谷电流比（PVR）此前仅能达到3.9，这一现象一直难以解释。本研究通过改变石墨烯异质结RTD的有源面积与周长，发现边缘掺杂在决定共振隧穿过程中起到了主导作用，并证实了获得高PVR必须具备较大的面积周长比。基于这一发现，研究团队提出了一种全新的设计准则，成功将PVR提升至14.9，较此前报道的石墨烯RTD提高了至少3.8倍。此外，研究还建立了一套理论模型，首次实现了对边缘掺杂深度的定量提取。该成果为高性能二维材料量子器件的设计提供了重要指导。
title: Toward High-Peak-to-Valley-Ratio Graphene Resonant Tunneling Diodes

abstract: Abstract Concrete-encased concrete-filled steel tube members (concrete-encased CFST) are innovative composite structural elements which are having gradually increasing utilization in high-rise buildings and bridge structures. In practice, the inner CFST component is generally erected first and thus subjected to constructional load before the outer reinforced concrete (RC) component is formed. Afterward, the whole composite cross-section is under long-term sustained load in the service stage. This paper studies the structural behaviour of such composite columns under combined preload and long-term sustained load through a series of experimental tests. Concrete-encased CFST columns under different loading conditions, together with their CFST counterparts, are tested and compared. The main parameters include preload ratio, loading age and sectional configuration. Influence of these parameters on the structural behaviour in terms of failure mode, bearing capacity, stiffness and ductility are evaluated. Finally, a simplified design method is recommended to account for the influences of combined preload and long-term sustained load on the ultimate strength of the concrete-encased CFST columns, where the combined effects can be reflected by a corresponding set of coefficients.
title: Long-term experimental behavior of concrete-encased CFST with preload on the inner CFST

summary_zh: 在湍流分析与计算领域，精确测量流体产生的应力对于传感器性能至关重要。本研究基于标准180nm CMOS工艺开发了一种用于实时应力测量的机械应力传感器。该研究的核心贡献在于设计了一种具有温度补偿功能的RC振荡器电路，能够将机械应力引起的芯片形变有效转化为频率输出。实验结果表明，该电路具有极佳的热稳定性，在-40°C至120°C的温度范围内，振荡频率的变化率仅为0.303Hz/°C。此外，该传感器具有高度集成的优势，芯片面积小于0.569 mm²，功耗低于22.9 µW，且无需复杂的校准流程或昂贵的测量设备。测试数据显示，该芯片的平均灵敏度为14.39ppm/kPa，线性拟合优度（R²）高达0.9983。该研究为流体动力学监测提供了一种低功耗、高精度且易于集成的微型化传感解决方案。
title: A 14.39ppm/kPa Stress Sensor with Low Temperature-drift and High Linearity for turbulence Stress
venue: 2022 IEEE International Conference on Integrated Circuits, Technologies and Applications (ICTA)

abstract: In this paper an technology of two-axis synchronization control based on Fuzzy PID is presented. With a hardware platform constructed by Linux EMC2 and MESA 5i20 motion controller, a two-axis synchronization control system is built up to study the synchronize precision and dynamic feature by adapting Fuzzy PID controller. The result of the experiment shows that the Fuzzy PID controller works well in the two-axis synchronization control system, and will become a reliable reference to the technology of two-axis synchronization control.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于模糊PID的双轴同步控制技术。在由Linux EMC2数控软件与MESA 5i20运动控制器构建的硬件平台上，搭建了双轴同步控制系统，通过引入模糊PID控制器研究其同步精度与动态特性。实验结果表明，模糊PID控制器在双轴同步控制系统中表现良好，能够有效提升同步性能，为双轴同步控制技术提供了可靠参考。
title: Research on the Technology of Two-Axis Synchronization Control Based on Fuzzy PID

abstract: Abstract Developing acid‐stable electrocatalysts with high activity for the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) is of paramount importance for many energy‐related technologies. This work reports that ultrathin nitrogen‐doped carbon coated oxygen‐vacancy (Vo·) rich RuO 2 nanoparticles on carbon nanotubes (CNTs) (NC@Vo·‐RuO 2 /CNTs‐350), synthesized through the controlled calcination in air, is an efficient acid‐stable electrocatalyst for the OER. It only needs an overpotential of 170.0 mV to drive 10.0 mA cm −2 and shows excellent stability with no distinguishable activity loss observed for >900 h. Its mass activity is >110 times higher than the commercial RuO 2 . In particular, an electrolyzer assembled with this catalyst shows a record‐low cell voltage of 1.45 V to deliver 10.0 mA cm −2 and exhibits a low performance drop for >1000 h. The NC@Vo·‐RuO 2 /CNTs‐350 also shows super‐high catalytic activities and excellent stabilities for OER in neutral and alkaline media. DFT calculations indicate that its high catalytic activity mainly arises from the strong electronic coupling between RuO 2 and NC/CNTs, which increases the oxidation state and catalytic activity of Ru at the active site and improves the stabilities of lattice oxygen and surface Ru during the OER processes. The presence of Vo· can strengthen the electronic coupling between RuO 2 and NC/CNTs.
title: Ultrathin Carbon Coating and Defect Engineering Promote RuO2 as an Efficient Catalyst for Acidic Oxygen Evolution Reaction with Super‐High Durability

abstract: The algorithm used for reconstruction or resolution enhancement is one of the factors affecting the quality of super-resolution images obtained by fluorescence microscopy. Deep-learning-based algorithms have achieved state-of-the-art performance in super-resolution fluorescence microscopy and are becoming increasingly attractive. We firstly introduce commonly-used deep learning models, and then review the latest applications in terms of the network architectures, the training data and the loss functions. Additionally, we discuss the challenges and limits when using deep learning to analyze the fluorescence microscopic data, and suggest ways to improve the reliability and robustness of deep learning applications.
summary_zh: 深度学习算法已成为荧光显微超分辨成像中影响重建质量与分辨率提升效果的关键因素，其性能在近年取得领先水平并受到广泛关注。本文首先介绍荧光显微超分辨领域常用的深度学习模型，继而从网络架构、训练数据与损失函数三个维度系统评述最新应用进展。针对使用深度学习分析荧光显微数据所面临的挑战与局限性，文章进一步展开讨论，并提出提升方法可靠性与鲁棒性的可行途径，为该技术在生物医学成像中的实际部署提供参考。
title: Deep-learning-based methods for super-resolution fluorescence microscopy
venue: Journal of Innovative Optical Health Sciences

abstract: Abstract We describe an undocumented change in how calm periods in near-surface wind speed (and direction) observations have been encoded in a subset of global datasets of sub-daily data after 2013. This has resulted in the under-estimation of the number of calm periods for meteorological stations across much of Asia and Europe. Hence average wind speeds after 2013 have been over-estimated, affecting the assessment of changes in global stilling and reversal phenomena after this date. By addressing this encoding change we show that globally, since 2010, wind speeds have recovered by around 30% less than previously thought.
summary_zh: 本文揭示2013年后全球部分次日风速观测数据集中，静风时段编码方式发生了一项未被记录的变更，导致亚洲和欧洲大量气象站点的静风频次被系统性低估，进而造成2013年后平均风速被高估。这一编码变化直接影响了对全球风速减弱与恢复趋势的评估。通过修正该编码偏差，研究发现自2010年以来全球风速的实际恢复幅度比此前认知低约30%。该发现对气候变化研究、风能资源评估及大气环流分析等领域具有重要参考价值。
title: Reduction in reversal of global stilling arising from correction to encoding of calm periods*

summary_zh: 我们提出了一种名为 DFL-Dual 的拜占庭鲁棒去中心化联邦学习方法，通过双域客户端聚类与信任引导机制，解决去中心化联邦学习易受拜占庭攻击且良性客户端可能被恶意邻居主导的问题。该方法首先利用数据域和模型域的双重距离度量来识别客户端之间的差异，在此基础上设计以良性客户端为中心的信任评估机制，使其能够有效评估邻居节点的可信度。结合双域距离度量与信任评估，进一步开发了两阶段聚类与信任引导技术，在本地模型聚合过程中排除拜占庭客户端。大量实验验证表明，DFL-Dual 在鲁棒性上显著优于现有的中心化和去中心化联邦学习方案，适用于无中心协调服务器的协作模型训练场景。
title: Byzantine-robust Decentralized Federated Learning via Dual-domain Clustering and Trust Bootstrapping
venue: 2024 IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)

summary_zh: 无人机作为飞行无线接入节点，为传统固定地面部署提供了有力补充。在无线网络领域，无人机还被设想用于射频感知与定位。其核心优势在于能自主在三维空间中灵活移动，及时抵达网络吞吐量或感知性能最优的位置。然而，无人机位置或轨迹的合理选择高度依赖局部地形特征，尤其是周围无线障碍物的分布。因此，无人机在执行数据通信或感知服务时，必须能够绘制其无线环境特征图。本文围绕这一称为“无线地图构建”的任务展开讨论，重点阐述了其在自主无线感知无人机高效轨迹设计中的应用前景及相关算法方案。文章还展示了无线地图构建在提升连接性能、感知能力与定位精度方面的具体优势。
title: UAV-aided RF Mapping for Sensing and Connectivity in Wireless Networks

summary_zh: 针对机载雷达系统中空时自适应处理（STAP）方法在实际应用中受限于训练样本支持的问题，本文提出了一种基于深度学习的STAP框架。该方法首先通过仿真同时构建了杂波空时数据及其精确杂波协方差矩阵（CCM），并综合考虑了飞机侧滑、阵列误差及内部杂波运动等多种实际非理想因素。随后，设计了一种多层二维卷积神经网络（CNN），利用少量训练样本估计的低分辨率角-多普勒谱作为输入，并以精确CCM获得的高分辨率谱作为标签进行训练。训练完成后，该网络能够利用极少量的实测数据近乎实时地预测高分辨率角-多普勒谱，进而结合空时导向字典计算高分辨率杂波谱，并据此构建实测数据的CCM及空时权重向量。仿真结果表明，与现有的基于稀疏性的STAP方法相比，该方法在杂波抑制性能和计算效率方面均具有显著优势，更适用于实际工程环境下的实时处理。
title: Deep learning for high‐resolution estimation of clutter angle‐Doppler spectrum in STAP

abstract: Light-scattering experiments have been carried out on an entanglement gel with a binary-liquid mixture as solvent. The onset temperature for critical opalescence has a composition dependence which is similar to the coexistence curve of the free-liquid mixture. This system resembles previously reported work on the cross-linked gel polyacrylamide in two ways: (1) As temperature is lowered toward the critical temperature of the free-liquid mixture, the binary-fluid gel exhibits a strong and increasing light scattering over a broad temperature region of several kelvins, and (2) no appreciable temporal fluctuations are observed throughout this temperature region. Two added features are observed in the present, entanglement-gel measurements: (a) Gel samples with solvent composition both near and off the critical composition of the free-liquid mixture exhibit similar light-scattering behavior, and (b) a Lorentzian-squared fit to the light-scattering angular distributions yields a characteristic wave number which does not change with temperature and an amplitude which shows a very strong dependence on the temperature.
title: Light scattering from a binary-liquid entanglement gel

abstract: Graphene-sulfur (G-S) hybrid materials with sulfur nanocrystals anchored on interconnected fibrous graphene are obtained by a facile one-pot strategy using a sulfur/carbon disulfide/alcohol mixed solution. The reduction of graphene oxide and the formation/binding of sulfur nanocrystals were integrated. The G-S hybrids exhibit a highly porous network structure constructed by fibrous graphene, many electrically conducting pathways, and easily tunable sulfur content, which can be cut and pressed into pellets to be directly used as lithium-sulfur battery cathodes without using a metal current-collector, binder, and conductive additive. The porous network and sulfur nanocrystals enable rapid ion transport and short Li(+) diffusion distance, the interconnected fibrous graphene provides highly conductive electron transport pathways, and the oxygen-containing (mainly hydroxyl/epoxide) groups show strong binding with polysulfides, preventing their dissolution into the electrolyte based on first-principles calculations. As a result, the G-S hybrids show a high capacity, an excellent high-rate performance, and a long life over 100 cycles. These results demonstrate the great potential of this unique hybrid structure as cathodes for high-performance lithium-sulfur batteries.
title: Fibrous Hybrid of Graphene and Sulfur Nanocrystals for High Performance Lithium-Sulfur Batteries

abstract: Prior studies have challenged the practical usefulness of Markowitz portfolio optimization in improving the return–risk trade-off in portfolio management. The authors approach this question from a unique angle by examining whether one can improve the performance of a large sample of actual mutual fund portfolios by reoptimizing the holdings using simple mean–variance optimization methods. The analyses produce compelling evidence of the benefits of Markowitz optimization. Simple portfolio optimization improves mutual fund portfolios’ risk-adjusted performance despite noisy expected return estimates inferred from mutual fund portfolio weights. Several alternative optimization strategies, including the risk-parity portfolio, minimum variance portfolio, mean–variance portfolio, and Sharpe ratio maximization portfolio, all outperform actual mutual fund portfolios in terms of the Sharpe ratio and other risk-adjusted performance measures. Moreover, the results are robust to subsamples partitioned on various dimensions. In contrast to the findings of DeMiguel et al. (2009), the authors find that the 1/N portfolio performs the worst.
title: Gains from Markowitz Optimization: Evidence from Re-Optimization of Mutual Fund Holdings

abstract: Novel Si2Sb2Te6 phase change material for low-power chalcogenide random access memory is prepared by sputtering of Si2Sb2Te6 alloy target. The motion of Te atom was confirmed from the X-ray diffraction patterns. Phase change random access memory device based on the Si2Sb2Te6 alloy was successfully fabricated. Threshold current (Ith) of the device is only 1 µA. SET and RESET voltage pulse values are 1.2 and 2.4 V, respectively, with voltage pulse width of 150 ns. Up to 5×105 cycles of endurance had been achieved with a resistance ratio of 100.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种用于低功耗硫系化合物随机存取存储器的新型Si₂Sb₂Te₆相变材料，通过溅射Si₂Sb₂Te₆合金靶材制备而成。X射线衍射图谱证实了Te原子在相变过程中的迁移行为。基于该合金成功制造了相变存储器器件，其阈值电流仅为1微安，展现出优异的低功耗特性。在150纳秒电压脉冲宽度下，SET和RESET操作电压分别为1.2伏和2.4伏。器件实现了高达5×10⁵次循环的耐久性能，且电阻比值保持在100倍以上，表明该材料在下一代高密度、低能耗非易失性存储领域具有重要应用潜力。
title: Si2Sb2Te6Phase Change Material for Low-Power Phase Change Memory Application

summary_zh: 本文综述了作者课题组近期在可压缩湍流领域的研究进展，涵盖可压缩各向同性湍流的基础研究与壁面约束大涡模拟的应用研究。在第一部分中，我们提出了一种新型混合紧致-加权基本无振荡格式，用于可压缩各向同性湍流的数值模拟，并据此构建了系统的数据库。基于该数据库，我们系统考察了可压缩湍流的多种基本特性，包括可压缩模态的统计规律与标度律、激波片与湍流的相互作用、局部可压缩性对小尺度结构的影响、动能级串过程，以及基于拉格朗日视角的初步分析结果。第二部分回顾了约束大涡模拟的基本思想与数学公式，随后展示了该方法的验证结果及其在可压缩工程问题中的若干应用。
title: Recent progress in compressible turbulence

summary_zh: 针对深度神经网络中正则化技术的研究，现有方法多侧重于权重参数正则化，或通过软化标签进行标签正则化。虽然知识蒸馏技术能够利用软标签捕捉类别间的关联信息，但其依赖预训练大型教师模型的模式带来了显著的计算开销。本文提出了一种名为知识精炼（Knowledge Refinery, KR）的新型方法，旨在无需教师-学生训练策略的情况下，使神经网络能够在线实时学习类别间的内在关系。该方法通过引入解耦标签的概念，将标签拆分为原始硬标签与残差标签两部分。通过在计算机视觉和自然语言处理领域的广泛实验验证，结果表明KR方法在多种实验设置下均能实现稳定的性能提升，展现出良好的泛化能力。
title: Knowledge refinery: learning from decoupled label
venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence

summary_zh: 本研究通过自组装辅助法简便合成了二硫化钼基杂化管状纳米结构，并评估其作为析氢反应和氧还原反应双功能电催化剂的应用潜力。在常温条件下简单混合反应物，即可形成四硫代钼酸铵与聚多巴胺杂化纳米球。质子化的多巴胺通过弱N–H···S和O–H···S相互作用与四面体[MoS4]2–连接，在搅拌诱导的剪切力作用下，聚多巴胺纳米球相互融合并形成纳米棒。随后，多巴胺的氧化聚合在纳米棒表面进行，而内部因缺氧受到抑制，导致多巴胺向外扩散并形成空腔。经退火处理后，管状形貌得以完好保留，同时在骨架限域效应下生成超细二硫化钼单层。得益于这些独特的结构特征，二硫化钼/碳杂化纳米管具有丰富的活性位点、高比表面积以及增强的电子和离子传输能力，显著提升了电催化活性。在氧还原反应中，起始电位和半波电位分别达到0.91 V和0.82 V，接近铂碳催化剂的水平；在析氢反应中也表现出低起始电位和较小的塔菲尔斜率，展现了该杂化纳米管作为非贵金属双功能电催化剂的应用前景。
title: Self-Assembly-Assisted Facile Synthesis of MoS2-Based Hybrid Tubular Nanostructures for Efficient Bifunctional Electrocatalysis

summary_zh: 我们提出了一种专为远距离调频连续波激光测距系统设计的集成多功能硅光引擎。该引擎在单一芯片上集成了并行四通道双偏振相干探测模块、片上光分路系统、利用大规模光延迟线的激光非线性校准模块以及片上本振光分光单元。关键器件如锗硅光电探测器经过优化，实现了1.09 A/W的高响应度和3.6 nA的低暗电流。片上延迟线设计在改善损耗的同时实现了5.74 ns的光延时，从而支持非线性校准，有效提升了信噪比和光谱线宽性能。封装后的硅光引擎芯片尺寸为2.8 mm × 2.7 mm，在四个通道上均实现了最远200米的测距能力，且信噪比超过10 dB。该研究为调频连续波激光测距系统提供了一种新的集成方案，为汽车及其他高精度测距应用构建了稳健的平台。
title: Integrated multi-functional silicon photonic engine for long-range FMCW laser ranging

abstract: Distributed resource allocation is a central task in network systems such as smart grids, water distribution networks, and urban transportation systems. When solving such problems in practice it is often important to have non-asymptotic feasibility guarantees for the iterates, since overall-location of resources easily causes systems to break down. In this paper, we develop a distributed resource reallocation algorithm where every iteration produces a feasible allocation. The algorithm is fully distributed in the sense that nodes communicate only with neighbors over a given communication network. We prove that under mild conditions the algorithm converges to a point arbitrarily close to the optimal resource allocation. Numerical experiments demonstrate the competitive practical performance of the algorithm.
summary_zh: 针对智能电网、供水管网及城市交通系统等网络环境中的分布式资源分配问题，本文提出一种确保每次迭代均满足可行性的分布式资源再分配算法。该算法完全去中心化，节点仅通过给定通信网络与邻居交换信息。在温和条件下，我们证明了算法可收敛至任意接近最优资源分配的配置点。数值实验验证了该算法在实际应用中具有竞争力的性能。
title: A New Family of Feasible Methods for Distributed Resource Allocation
venue: 2021 60th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC)

abstract: Abstract With the energy density of intercalation electrodes approaching the ceiling, there are tremendous interests in developing metal oxide conversion type electrodes for lithium ion batteries, which involve more lithium ions in electrochemical reactions. Nevertheless, the cyclic and rate performances of conversion electrodes are rather poor, due to their large volume changes during charging and discharging, poor contact with current collector, and accumulated internal passivation over cycling. Here by carefully designing epitaxial array of Fe3O4 nanodots as a binder-free conversion electrode, we accomplish excellent rate performance under current density as high as 60C with long cycling life and good capacity, and the detailed scanning transmission electron microscopy in combination with comprehensive electrochemical analysis suggest that the success can be attributed to the synergic effects of released internal stress, slowed internal passivation, and good structure integrity all rendered by the nanodot array architecture of Fe3O4. Our study thus overcome materials breakdown, contact failure, and internal passivation of conventional conversion electrodes, providing new insight into optimizing conversion electrodes for practical applications.
title: Epitaxial array of Fe3O4 nanodots for high rate high capacity conversion type lithium ion batteries electrode with long cycling life

abstract: Stochastic video generation methods predict diverse videos based on observed frames, where the main challenge lies in modeling the complex future uncertainty and generating realistic frames. Numerous of Recurrent-VAE-based methods have achieved state-of-the-art results. However, on the one hand, the independence assumption of the variables of approximate posterior limits the inference performance. On the other hand, although these methods adopt skip connections between encoder and decoder to utilize multi-level features, they still produce blurry generation due to the spatial misalignment between encoder and decoder features at different time steps. In this paper, we propose a hierarchical recurrent VAE with a feature aligner, which can not only relax the independence assumption in typical VAE but also use a feature aligner to enable the decoder to obtain the aligned spatial information from the last observed frames. The proposed model is named Hierarchical Stochastic Video Generation network with Aligned Features, referred to as HAF-SVG. Experiments on Moving-MNIST, BAIR, and KTH datasets demonstrate that hierarchical structure is helpful for modeling more accurate future uncertainty, and the feature aligner is beneficial to generate realistic frames. Besides, the HAF-SVG exceeds SVG on both prediction accuracy and the quality of generated frames.
title: HAF-SVG: Hierarchical Stochastic Video Generation with Aligned Features
venue: Proceedings of the Twenty-Ninth International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence

abstract: A bstract We study chiral-odd quark-antiquark correlation functions suitable for lattice calculations of twist-three nucleon parton distribution functions h L ( x ) and e ( x ), and also the twist-two transversity distribution δq ( x ). The corresponding factorized expressions are derived in terms of the twist-two and twist-three collinear distributions to one-loop accuracy. The results are presented both in position space, as the factorization theorem for Ioffe-time distributions, and in momentum space, for quasi- and pseudo-distributions. We demonstrate that the twist-two part of the h L quasi(pseudo)-distribution can be separated from the twist-three part by virtue of an exact Jaffe-Ji-like relation.
summary_zh: 我们研究了可用于格点量子色动力学计算的手征奇异的夸克-反夸克关联函数，这些函数与扭度为三的核子部分子分布函数 h_L(x) 和 e(x) 以及扭度为二的横向性分布 δq(x) 密切相关。在单圈精度下，我们推导出了这些关联函数用扭度二和扭度三共线分布表示的因子化表达式。研究结果同时在坐标空间和动量空间中给出：在坐标空间中表现为 Ioffe 时间分布的因子化定理，在动量空间中则对应于准分布和赝分布。我们证明，借助一个精确的类 Jaffe-Ji 关系式，可以将 h_L 准分布或赝分布中的扭度二部分与扭度三部分有效分离。这项工作为从格点 QCD 第一性原理出发计算核子内部横向自旋结构提供了理论框架，对深入理解强子结构及高能散射过程中的自旋效应具有重要应用价值。
title: QCD factorization for chiral-odd parton quasi- and pseudo-distributions

summary_zh: 肿瘤抑制基因在进化过程中形成了特定的遗传与基因组特征以利于其抑癌功能。我们前期研究发现，肿瘤抑制基因的启动子区在进化中获得了较高的CpG二核苷酸频率，从而维持其在正常组织中的高表达并抵抗癌症特异性下调。本研究进一步探讨了肿瘤抑制基因的3'非翻译区是否也演化出类似功能的特异性特征。结果显示，与非癌症基因相比，肿瘤抑制基因的3'非翻译区更长，尤其是那些涉及多种组织学类型和儿童癌症的基因。同时，这些3'非翻译区具有更高密度的RNA结合蛋白结合位点，且这些蛋白对富含胞嘧啶的基序具有高亲和力。更长的3'非翻译区长度和RNA结合蛋白结合位点的富集均与基因在多种正常组织中的高表达水平相关。此外，这两个特征连同与之相关的N6-甲基腺苷修饰和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用程度，均与肿瘤抑制基因抵抗癌症特异性下调的能力呈正相关。上述结果已在独立数据集中得到成功验证。综合而言，本研究表明肿瘤抑制基因在进化中形成了更长的3'非翻译区，并增强了RNA结合蛋白结合、N6-甲基腺苷修饰和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的倾向，从而优化其抑癌功能。
title: 3′untranslated regions of tumor suppressor genes evolved specific features to favor cancer resistance

summary_zh: 本研究提出一种基于纳米界面敏化的光纤生物传感器，用于超灵敏检测耳聋基因互补DNA。传感器采用单模光纤-锥形无芯光纤-多模光纤-单模光纤的横向偏移结构，并在表面修饰黑磷纳米界面以增强光与物质相互作用，从而提升传感性能。利用该纳米界面敏化传感器，成功实现了1 pM至1 μM浓度范围内互补DNA的原位检测，灵敏度达到0.719 nm/lgM，检测限低至0.24 pM，较现有方法降低至少两个数量级。该传感器具有操作简便、响应快速、免标记测量、重复性优异和选择性高等特点。本工作为耳聋基因DNA检测提供了一种便捷方案，并可拓展应用于通用超低浓度DNA检测领域。
title: Ultrasensitive deafness gene DNA hybridization detection employing a fiber optic Mach-Zehnder interferometer: Enabled by a black phosphorus nanointerface

summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种名为TIReconNet的深度学习框架，用于从稀疏视角重建断层图像，旨在减少CT连续扫描中大量X射线辐射对人体的伤害。该框架将图像重建定义为数据驱动的监督学习任务，通过学习二维投影视图与三维体积之间的映射关系来实现重建。TIReconNet由特征提取模块、形状映射模块、体积生成模块和超分辨率模块四个部分组成，融合了二维与三维操作，能够在相对较低的计算资源下生成高分辨率断层图像，同时有效保留空间信息。在胸部数字重建放射影像数据集上的验证结果显示，与真实图像相比，重建图像的峰值信噪比达到18.621±1.228 dB，结构相似性指数为0.872±0.041。本研究创新性地设计并验证了一种卷积神经网络架构，证明了利用深度学习从单张二维图像生成三维高分辨率断层图像的可行性。该方法有望推动低辐射重建技术在临床中的应用，并为创伤与骨科手术中的术中导航提供进一步探索的可能。
title: Prior information-based high-resolution tomography image reconstruction from a single digitally reconstructed radiograph

abstract: We introduce an auxiliary quantum master equation dual fermion method and argue that it presents a convenient way to describe steady states of correlated impurity models. The scheme yields an expansion around a reference that is much closer to the true nonequilibrium state than that in the original dual fermion formulation. In steady-state situations, the scheme is numerically inexpensive and avoids time propagation. The Anderson impurity model is used to test the approach against numerically exact benchmarks.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种辅助量子主方程对偶费米子方法，用于描述关联杂质模型的稳态性质。该方法在原有对偶费米子框架基础上引入辅助量子主方程作为参考系统，使展开起点更接近真实非平衡态，从而有效提升描述精度。在稳态情形下，该方案无需进行时间演化，计算成本显著降低，具备良好的数值可行性。以安德森杂质模型为测试平台，将所得结果与数值精确基准进行对比，验证了方法的准确性和可靠性。这一方法为强关联量子杂质系统的稳态研究提供了高效且精确的理论工具，可广泛应用于量子输运、分子电子学及强关联材料等领域的非平衡稳态计算。
title: Auxiliary Master Equation for Nonequilibrium Dual-Fermion Approach

abstract: Commit messages record code changes (e.g., feature modifications and bug repairs) in natural language, and are useful for program comprehension. Due to the frequent updates of software and time cost, developers are generally unmotivated to write commit messages for code changes. Therefore, automating the message writing process is necessitated. Previous studies on commit message generation have been benefited from generation models or retrieval models, but the code structure of changed code, i.e., AST, which can be important for capturing code semantics, has not been explicitly involved. Moreover, although generation models have the advantages of synthesizing commit messages for new code changes, they are not easy to bridge the semantic gap between code and natural languages which could be mitigated by retrieval models. In this paper, we propose a novel commit message generation model, named ATOM, which explicitly incorporates the abstract syntax tree for representing code changes and integrates both retrieved and generated messages through hybrid ranking. Specifically, the hybrid ranking module can prioritize the most accurate message from both retrieved and generated messages regarding one code change. We evaluate the proposed model ATOM on our dataset crawled from 56 popular Java repositories. Experimental results demonstrate that ATOM increases the state-of-the-art models by 30.72 percent in terms of BLEU-4 (an accuracy measure that is widely used to evaluate text generation systems). Qualitative analysis also demonstrates the effectiveness of ATOM in generating accurate code commit messages.
title: ATOM: Commit Message Generation Based on Abstract Syntax Tree and Hybrid Ranking

summary_zh: 针对无人机网络面临的安全威胁，本文提出一种两阶段方案，在增强安全性的同时优化网络资源分配。第一阶段设计了一种基于分布式射频指纹认证与共识投票的鉴别模型，以提升无人机网络的安全性。第二阶段在考虑认证精度的前提下，构建了以最大化数据速率为目标的性能优化问题。经证明，该问题可转化为势博弈，即整体网络效用的优化等价于各节点自身效用的优化；同时证明了该博弈纳什均衡的存在性，并采用迭代算法实现均衡求解。仿真结果表明，在典型参数设置下，所提出的共识认证模型相比传统Adaboost方法识别精度提升40%，所提算法能显著提高网络效用，并通过数值实验验证了不同参数对效用的影响。
title: Secure IoU in Adversarial Environments: User Authentication and Performance Optimization

summary_zh: 在移动应用市场竞争日益激烈的背景下，及时发现并解决用户反馈的关键问题是提升用户体验和应用成功率的核心。现有的新兴问题检测研究多依赖主题模型或聚类技术，但往往忽略了用户评论的短文本特征及其蕴含的情感信息。本文提出了一种名为MERIT的新型新兴问题检测方法，旨在综合考虑评论长度与情感维度。具体而言，研究设计了一种自适应在线双词主题情感模型（AOBST），通过结合应用版本信息，实现对主题与对应情感的联合建模。基于该模型，系统能够推断出特定版本应用评论中负面反馈集中的主题，并通过提取最相关的短语和句子实现主题含义的自动解释。在Google Play和Apple App Store热门应用上的实验结果表明，MERIT在识别新兴应用问题方面表现出色，其F1分数较现有最先进方法提升了22.3%，同时在处理效率方面也能在可接受的时间内返回结果。
title: Emerging App Issue Identification via Online Joint Sentiment-Topic Tracing

summary_zh: 图像复原旨在从退化图像中恢复清晰图像，在众多领域具有重要应用。近期，Transformer 模型在各类图像复原任务中展现出优异性能，但其平方级计算复杂度限制了实际部署。本研究致力于构建高效且高性能的图像复原框架。受退化图像中不同区域受损程度存在差异这一现象启发，我们提出在重建过程中重点关注关键区域。为此，设计了一种双域选择机制，用于强化边缘信号和困难区域等对复原至关重要的信息。同时，通过对高分辨率特征进行拆分以引入多尺度感受野，在提升效率的同时增强了网络性能。最终，将这些设计融入 U 形骨干网络，构建了名为 FocalNet 的模型。在单图像散焦去模糊、图像去雾和图像去雪三项任务的十个数据集上进行的大量实验表明，本模型达到了当前最优性能。代码已开源。
title: Focal Network for Image Restoration
venue: 2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)

abstract: Vertical federated learning (VFL) has recently emerged as an appealing distributed paradigm empowering multi-party collaboration for training high-quality models over vertically partitioned datasets. Gradient boosting has been popularly adopted in VFL, which builds an ensemble of weak learners (typically decision trees) to achieve promising prediction performance. Recently there have been growing interests in using decision table as an intriguing alternative weak learner in gradient boosting, due to its simpler structure, good interpretability, and promising performance. In the literature, there have been works on privacy-preserving VFL for gradient boosted decision trees, but no prior work has been devoted to the emerging case of decision tables. Training and inference on decision tables are different from that in the case of generic decision trees, not to mention gradient boosting with decision tables in VFL. In light of this, we design, implement, and evaluate Privet, the first system framework enabling privacy-preserving VFL service for gradient boosted decision tables. Privet delicately builds on lightweight cryptography and allows an arbitrary number of participants holding vertically partitioned datasets to securely train gradient boosted decision tables. Extensive experiments over several real-world datasets and synthetic datasets demonstrate that Privet achieves promising performance, with utility comparable to plaintext centralized learning.
title: Privet: A Privacy-Preserving Vertical Federated Learning Service for Gradient Boosted Decision Tables

summary_zh: 本文提出一种非侵入式方法，用于识别集成电路中有限状态机（FSM）的状态寄存器。该方法利用FSM的强连通特性及其状态编码在时序上的相关性，从芯片扫描转储数据中挖掘状态寄存器。首先，通过字符串匹配算法将每个扫描寄存器输出的数据序列分割为高权重频率的非重叠字符串片段；在此基础上定义并计算寄存器对之间的相干性。随后，采用回归分析剔除低影响力寄存器以降低相干矩阵维度，再基于相干性值对寄存器进行聚类，以最小化簇内方差。该方案在OpenCores的多个IP核上进行了验证，实验结果表明，在大多数设计中能够以高命中率准确识别FSM状态寄存器，为硬件安全领域的复杂问题提供了有效的大数据分析手段。
title: Identification of FSM State Registers by Analytics of Scan-Dump Data
venue: IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security

summary_zh: 本研究揭示了一种稀释屏蔽效应，为复合聚合物电解质界面钝化与均匀锂离子输运提供了通用策略。聚偏氟乙烯-共-六氟丙烯与石榴石型陶瓷填料集成的复合固态电解质虽兼具机械柔韧性和离子电导率，但石榴石填料表面的镧位点会与极性溶剂配位，引发聚合物脱氟化氢反应，形成碱性微环境，加速材料降解，损害界面化学与电化学稳定性。针对这一问题，引入具有超高介电常数的氟代碳酸乙烯酯，可有效减弱强碱性配位溶剂的活性，并通过静电屏蔽镧位点，阻止碱性微环境生成，从而抑制脱氟化氢过程。该简便策略同时驱动原位形成富含氟化锂的保护性界面相。综合原位表征证实，经氟代碳酸乙烯酯改性的复合聚合物电解质实现了增强的界面钝化与稳定的锂离子输运。基于此，锂对称电池在0.1 mA cm⁻²条件下稳定循环超过700小时，磷酸铁锂全电池在1C倍率下循环超过1200次，容量保持率达90.2%。该工作确立了稀释屏蔽效应作为一种可迁移的界面调控策略，为化学与电化学稳定的固态锂金属电池设计提供了新思路。
title: Unveiling the Dilution‐Shielding Effect as a Universal Strategy for Interfacial Regulation in Composite Polymer Electrolytes

summary_zh: 本研究提出一种从临床语料库自动构建语义词典的方法，用于解决现有知识库（如统一医学语言系统 UMLS）中术语覆盖不足的问题。方法分两步：首先利用条件随机场分类器从文本中提取候选语义术语，再通过 C-Value 算法筛选高质量术语。基于范德堡大学医院十年出院小结语料，我们为“问题”“治疗”“检查”三个语义组提取了 44,957 个新术语。对 200 个未见于 UMLS 的随机抽样术语进行人工评估，结果显示 59% 为有意义的全新临床概念，25% 为 UMLS 已有概念的词汇变体。在 2010 年 i2b2 临床自然语言处理挑战的概念抽取任务中，使用语料库衍生语义词典作为特征的分类器取得 F 值 82.52%，优于使用 UMLS 衍生词典的 82.04%。实验表明，基于语料库的方法能有效生成语义词典，有助于提升命名实体识别性能，并可辅助扩充现有术语系统的同义关系。
title: Extracting semantic lexicons from discharge summaries using machine learning and the C-Value method.

abstract: Abstract Regional scale transport models are needed to support the long‐term evaluation of groundwater quality and to develop management strategies aiming to prevent serious groundwater degradation. The purpose of this study is to evaluate the capacity of a previously developed upscaling approach to adequately describe the main solute transport processes, including the capture of late‐time tails under changing boundary conditions. Potential factors that impact the performance of upscaling methods, including temporal variations in mass transfer rates and mass distributions, were investigated. Advective‐dispersive contaminant transport in a 3‐D heterogeneous domain was simulated and used as a reference solution. The equivalent transport under homogeneous flow conditions was then evaluated by applying the multirate mass transfer (MRMT) model. The random walk particle tracking method was used to solve the solute transport for heterogeneous and homogeneous MRMT scenarios under steady state and transient conditions. The results indicate that the MRMT model can capture the tails satisfactorily for plumes transported with ambient steady state flow fields at all studied scales using the same parameters. However, when the boundary conditions change in either local, plume, or regional scale, the mass transfer model calibrated for transport under steady state conditions cannot accurately reproduce the tailings observed for the heterogeneous scenario. The deteriorating impacts of transient boundary conditions on the upscaled model are more significant for regions where the flow fields are dramatically affected, which highlights the poor applicability of the MRMT approach for complex field settings. This finding also has implications for the suitability of other potential upscaling approaches.
title: Upscaling of Regional Scale Transport Under Transient Conditions: Evaluation of the Multirate Mass Transfer Model

summary_zh: 螺环骨架因其卓越的构型刚性，在不对称催化和功能材料等多个研究领域被视为重要的手性载体。然而，现有螺环结构的类型多样性不足，限制了其应用范围的进一步拓展。本文报道了一类新型轴手性螺环双吲哚骨架，并首次通过手性磷酸催化的分子内脱水环化反应实现了其对映选择性构建。与传统的SPINOL骨架不同，该方法通过引入吲哚基团取代酚基，增强了酮类底物的亲核性，从而避免了繁琐的预活化过程。利用吲哚保留的活性位点，所得高对映选择性的螺环双吲哚可快速转化为其他高价值结构。更重要的是，该方法能够简便地合成具有良好不对称因子和荧光量子效率的轴手性荧光分子，为开发手性荧光材料开辟了新途径。对照实验证实，吲哚上未掩蔽的N-H键对于实现高效反应和高对映选择性控制起到了关键作用。
title: Organocatalytic Asymmetric Construction and Application of Axially Chiral Spiro‐bisindoles

summary_zh: 酶参数对于定量理解、建模及工程化改造细胞具有至关重要的作用。然而，受限于实验成本，目前已知的酶-底物对参数仅占模型生物中已知组合的极小部分，在非模型生物中更是匮乏。随着人工智能技术的兴起，通过高通量预测手段探索酶属性已成为可能。本文推出了名为GotEnzymes的大规模酶参数预测数据库，用户可通过交互式网页或编程方式进行访问。该数据库的首个版本涵盖了跨越8099个物种的超过2570万个酶-底物对的周转数（turnover numbers）预测数据。GotEnzymes通过提供便捷的预测参数，将显著提升涉及候选酶研究的实验生物学与计算生物学领域的科研效率。
title: GotEnzymes: an extensive database of enzyme parameter predictions

summary_zh: 本文提出一种可在活体内时空可控地形成并旋转磁性纳米链的新方法，用于实现肿瘤的精准力学治疗。该纳米链由脱镁叶绿酸A修饰的氧化铁纳米颗粒与稀土掺杂的下转换纳米颗粒复合而成。在恒定磁场作用下，复合纳米颗粒定向排列形成纳米链；随后通过预先在肿瘤部位蓄积的二氧化锰纳米颗粒释放的锰离子与脱镁叶绿酸A配位，将纳米链锚定于肿瘤区域。在旋转磁场驱动下，纳米链快速旋转，对肿瘤细胞产生机械力刺激，诱导细胞凋亡与坏死。该纳米链同时具备高T2磁共振成像与近红外二区荧光成像信号，可实现影像引导下的精准治疗。该策略在肿瘤精准治疗领域具有良好的实际应用前景。
title: Spatiotemporally Controlled Formation and Rotation of Magnetic Nanochains In Vivo for Precise Mechanotherapy of Tumors

summary_zh: 双离子钠金属||石墨电池凭借其高工作电压（相对于Na/Na+超过4.4 V）及电极材料低成本的优势，被视为大规模固定式储能领域极具前景的技术方案。然而，传统液体电解液在高电压环境下极易发生严重分解，从而限制了电池的循环寿命。本文报道了一种采用多功能凝胶聚合物电解质的稳定双离子钠金属电池。该准固态电解质通过原位聚合工艺制备，以乙氧基化季戊四醇四丙烯酸酯单体为主要成分，并在含有氟代碳酸乙烯酯共溶剂及1,3-丙烷磺内酯添加剂的优化液体电解液中完成聚合。研究表明，该准固态电解质不仅展现出优异的抗氧化性能，能在电极表面构建稳定的保护层，还能有效促进阴阳离子的均匀通量并抑制钠枝晶的生长。实验结果显示，所开发的准固态双离子电池具备高容量与长循环寿命，为实现低成本储能应用提供了有效的技术路径。
title: Quasi-solid-state dual-ion sodium metal batteries for low-cost energy storage

summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于连续多波长光电容积脉搏波（MWPPG）监测的新型噪声整形（NS）逐次逼近寄存器（SAR）型光数字转换器（LDC）。该设计采用单通道电流积分（CI）SAR量化器，结合三通道无源噪声整形回路滤波器，通过时分复用技术实现低功耗的多波长信号读取。其核心架构采用了级联积分前馈噪声整形技术，并引入无源嵌套反馈路径以提升噪声整形阶数。为了应对运动伪影和环境光干扰引起的基线漂移及大直流电流问题，该转换器利用CI NS-SAR固有的交流增益控制特性，并结合预测阈值滤波器，实现了极高的动态范围（DR）。实验结果表明，该LDC采用180nm标准CMOS工艺制造，功耗低于26.5 $\mu$W，信噪失真比（SNDR）达95 dB，总动态范围高达161.5 dB。通过商用PPG传感器进行的指尖多波长PPG测量验证了该方案在生理信号监测领域的有效性。
title: A Noise-Shaping-SAR Multiplexed Light-to-Digital Converter With Passive Nested Feedback and Predictive Baseline Current Compensation Achieving 95-dB SNDR and 161.5-dB DR
venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems I Regular Papers

abstract: With the development of biometric verification, we proposed a new algorithm and personal mobile sensor card system for ECG verification. The proposed new mean-interval approach can identify the user quickly with high accuracy and consumes a small amount of flash memory in the microprocessor. The new framework of the mobile card system makes ECG verification become a feasible application to overcome the issues of a centralized database. For a fair and comprehensive evaluation, the experimental results have been tested on public MIT-BIH ECG databases and our circuit system; they confirm that the proposed scheme is able to provide excellent accuracy and low complexity. Moreover, we also proposed a multiple-state solution to handle the heat rate changes of sports problem. It should be the first to address the issue of sports in ECG verification.
summary_zh: 针对生物特征验证技术的发展，本文提出了一种面向心电信号验证的新型算法及个人移动传感卡系统。所提出的均值间期算法能够快速识别用户身份，在保持高准确率的同时仅占用微处理器极少的闪存空间。新设计的移动卡系统框架使心电验证得以实际部署，有效规避了集中式数据库带来的安全隐患。为进行公平全面的评估，实验在公开的MIT-BIH心电数据库和自研电路系统上同步开展，结果证实该方案兼具优异的识别精度与较低的计算复杂度。此外，本文还首次提出了一种多状态解决方案，用于应对运动过程中心率变化对验证性能的影响，这在心电验证领域尚属首次探索。
title: ECG Sensor Verification System with Mean-Interval Algorithm for Handling Sport Issue

abstract: In this paper, an experimental process was proposed to directly characterize the deformation of the on-chip PDMS membrane at large deformation based on the image processing method. High precision pressures were applied on the surface of the PDMS membrane with fixed edges and a series deformation of the PDMS membrane were captured by the imaging system. The Chan and Vese (CV) level set method was applied to segment the images of the deformed membrane. The volumes wrapped by the deformed membranes were obtained, and pressure-volumes relationships of the PDMS membranes with different geometry parameters were also calculated. Then the membrane capacitance can be derived by differentiating the curve of pressure-volumes. In addition, the theoretical estimation of the capacitance of the PDMS membrane at large deformation was also obtained through finite element simulation (FEM), which was in good agreement with the experimental results. These results are expected to be significant for designing and on-chip measuring of such PDMS membrane based microfluidic components in our future work.
title: Characterizing the Deformation of the Polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) Membrane for Microfluidic System through Image Processing

summary_zh: 针对现有抗体数据库类型单一、覆盖不足，难以满足纳米抗体研究快速增长需求的现状，本文整合多源数据，构建了一个全新的综合性纳米抗体数据库——Nanobody Library and Archive System。该数据库汇集了最新的纳米抗体序列与注释信息，并配备了高效的数据检索与展示界面，显著提升了纳米抗体的查询效率与应用潜力。作为一类源自骆驼科动物、仅由单重链可变区构成的特殊抗体，纳米抗体凭借其分子量小等优势在疾病治疗中展现出广阔前景，而本数据库的建立有望为纳米抗体的筛选、开发及其在生物医学领域的转化应用提供便捷、稳健且高效的数据支撑平台，从而推动相关研究的深入发展。数据库访问地址为 https://www.nanolas.cloud。
title: NanoLAS: a comprehensive nanobody database with data integration, consolidation and application

summary_zh: 我们提出结构化知识与统一检索-生成方法 SKURG，用于解决多模态多跳问答任务。该方法首先通过以实体为中心的融合编码器，利用共享实体对齐不同模态的输入源，从而在检索阶段有效建模候选证据之间的相互依赖关系。随后，采用统一的检索-生成解码器，将中间检索结果直接融入答案生成过程，并能够自适应地决定检索步数，避免了传统流水线方法中检索与生成分离所导致的错误累积问题。在 MultimodalQA 和 WebQA 两个代表性多模态多跳问答数据集上的实验表明，SKURG 在证据检索和答案生成两项指标上均优于现有最优模型，且参数量更少。该工作可应用于需要跨模态复杂推理的智能问答系统。
title: Multi-modal and Multi-hop Question Answering via Structured Knowledge and Unified Retrieval-Generation

authors.name: Luc J. W. van der Laan

summary_zh: 干扰素调节因子1（IRF1）是细胞抗病毒免疫中关键的干扰素刺激基因（ISG）。针对戊型肝炎病毒（HEV）感染过程中ISG如何发挥作用这一科学问题，本研究通过多种携带HEV的细胞模型，深入探讨了IRF1对HEV复制的影响。研究结果表明，在不同的HEV细胞培养系统中，IRF1均能有效抑制HEV的复制。机制研究发现，IRF1并不直接诱导干扰素（IFN）的产生，而是通过结合STAT1的启动子区域，驱动STAT1的转录，进而提升总STAT1及磷酸化STAT1蛋白水平，并进一步激活一系列下游抗病毒ISG的转录。通过药理学抑制剂和RNA干扰技术验证，IRF1的抗病毒功能依赖于JAK-STAT信号通路。此外，IRF1诱导ISG表达及抗HEV的效果与IFNα相似，并能受到利巴韦林的增强作用。综上所述，IRF1通过激活JAK-STAT通路并促进下游抗病毒ISG的转录来限制HEV的复制，且这一过程独立于干扰素的产生。
title: IFN regulatory factor 1 restricts hepatitis E virus replication by activating STAT1 to induce antiviral IFN‐stimulated genes

summary_zh: 本研究通过对2020年至2022年间发表的28项随机对照试验进行系统评价与荟萃分析，旨在评估SARS-CoV-2疫苗在预防不同严重程度感染中的有效性，并探讨抗体浓度与保护效力之间的剂量效应关系。研究结果显示，完成全程疫苗接种后，疫苗预防无症状感染、有症状感染、住院、重症感染及死亡的综合有效率分别为44.5%、76.5%、95.4%、90.8%和85.8%。研究发现，疫苗对有症状感染的保护效力随时间推移而下降，平均每月下降13.6%，但可通过加强针接种得到提升。此外，中和抗体、刺突蛋白特异性IgG及受体结合域特异性IgG滴度与预防有症状及重症感染之间存在显著的非线性关系，但由于存在较大的异质性，仅凭抗体浓度难以实现精确的效力预测。综上所述，SARS-CoV-2疫苗在预防重症及死亡方面的效果显著优于预防轻症感染，该研究为评估疫苗保护效力及制定后续免疫策略提供了重要的科学依据。
title: Efficacy of SARS-CoV-2 vaccines and the dose–response relationship with three major antibodies: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials

abstract: In this Technical Note, we describe a method to fabricate nanopore-supported Pt nanoparticle electrodes and their use in bipolar electrochemistry. A Pt nanoparticle is deposited on the orifice of a solid-state nanopore inside a focused-ion beam (FIB) system. Complete blockage of the nanopore with Pt metal forms a closed bipolar nanoparticle electrode whose size and shape can be tunable in one simple step. Nanoparticle electrodes and their arrays can be prepared on different substrates such as the tip of a glass pipet, a double-barrel pipet, and a freestanding silicon nitride membrane. Steady-state voltammetry can be performed on such nanoparticle electrodes via bipolar electrochemistry. Moreover, an array of Pt nanoparticles can be used for fluorescence-enabled electrochemical microscopy. Future use of highly advanced FIB systems may allow nanoparticles of <10 nm to be fabricated which may enable coupled electrochemical reactions of single redox molecules. Pipette-supported single particle electrodes may also find useful applications in high resolution imaging with nanoscale scanning electrochemical microscopy (SECM) and neurochemical analysis inside single cells.
title: Bipolar Electrochemistry on a Nanopore-Supported Platinum Nanoparticle Electrode

abstract: SUMMARY This paper presents a control algorithm for biped walking by extension of previous work in the fields of central pattern generator (CPG) and passive walking. The algorithm takes advantage of the passive dynamics of walking, assisting only when necessary with an intermittent sinusoidal oscillator. The parameterized oscillator is used to drive the hip joint; the triggering and ceasing of the oscillator during a walking cycle can be modulated by the sensory feedback. The results from simulation indicate a stable, efficient gait, and robustness against model inaccuracy and environmental variation. We also examine the effects of oscillator parameters and link parameters on the gait, and design a controller to suppress the bifurcation phenomenon based on the error of prior step periods.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种双足行走控制算法，该算法融合并拓展了中枢模式发生器与被动行走领域的前期研究。方法利用行走的被动动力学特性，仅在必要时通过间歇性正弦振荡器提供辅助驱动。参数化振荡器用于驱动髋关节，其在一个行走周期内的触发与停止可由感觉反馈进行调节。仿真结果表明，该方法能够实现稳定高效的步态，并对模型误差和环境变化具有良好的鲁棒性。此外，本文还分析了振荡器参数和连杆参数对步态的影响，并基于前一步周期的误差设计控制器以抑制分岔现象。
title: A simple walking strategy for biped walking based on an intermittent sinusoidal oscillator

summary_zh: 图像和谐化旨在通过调整前景图像使其与背景相匹配，从而实现合成图像的视觉一致性。针对现有方法仅利用真实图像作为正样本、且负样本单一导致失真知识学习不足、解空间过大进而引发图像失真的问题，本文提出了一种自一致风格对比学习方案（SCS-Co）。该方案通过动态生成多个负样本，从前景自身风格以及前景与背景风格一致性两个维度，在风格表示空间内对生成的和谐化图像进行有效正则化，从而学习更丰富的失真知识并提升视觉逼真度。此外，针对现有区域感知自适应实例归一化方法仅考虑全局背景特征分布、导致前景特征分布偏差的问题，本文进一步提出了背景注意力自适应实例归一化（BAIN）机制，通过前景与背景特征的相似度实现注意力加权的背景特征分布。实验结果表明，该方法在定量评估与视觉分析方面均优于现有的先进方法。
title: SCS-Co: Self-Consistent Style Contrastive Learning for Image Harmonization
venue: 2022 IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)

summary_zh: 本文提出一种实现高性能圆偏振有机发光二极管（CP-OLED）的简便策略，旨在同时满足窄带发射、高效率和圆偏振发光的需求。研究首先设计了一种由手性给体与非手性受体分子构成的手性激基复合物共主体材料。该手性主体能够有效敏化一种非手性的绿色多重共振热激活延迟荧光（MR-TADF）发光体，从而在不直接修饰发光体手性的情况下，实现高效的圆偏振电致发光。实验结果表明，基于该体系的器件展现出优异的综合性能：外量子效率高达33.2%，电致发光不对称因子达到2.8×10⁻³，同时半峰全宽仅为42纳米，实现了窄带发射。该工作为利用易得的非手性发光材料实现圆偏振电致发光提供了一种通用方法，显著拓展了圆偏振OLED的材料选择范围和实际应用潜力。
title: High‐Performance Circularly Polarized Electroluminescence with Simultaneous Narrowband Emission, High Efficiency, and Large Dissymmetry Factor

abstract: Spectral induced polarization (SIP) has been used in east China for nearly 20 years to evaluate hydrocarbon charge. In assessing 65 wells in six oil fields in east China, SIP made 47 successful positive (producer) and negative (dry hole) predictions for a success rate of 72.3%.
summary_zh: 光谱激发极化法在中国东部油气充注评价中已应用近二十年。通过对六个油田六十五口井的评估，该方法成功预测了四十七口产油井和干井，预测成功率达百分之七十二点三。该技术基于岩石在交变电场下的复电阻率响应，利用低频极化效应识别含油气层段，有效区分含水层与含烃层，为钻前评价和井位部署提供重要依据。实践表明，光谱激发极化法在复杂断块和岩性圈闭条件下具有较好的适应性，能够降低勘探风险，提高钻探成功率。
title: Two case studies from China of hydrocarbon detection with SIP

summary_zh: 针对动力学失配（dynamics mismatch）环境下策略迁移的离策略强化学习（off-dynamics RL）研究，目前由于缺乏统一的标准基准测试，算法评估面临巨大挑战。为此，本文提出了首个专门用于评估离策略强化学习方法的基准测试平台 ODRL。该平台涵盖了源域与目标域分别为在线或离线数据的四种实验设置，并通过提供多样化的任务场景与广泛的动力学偏移范围，为全面衡量智能体对目标域的适应能力提供了可靠平台。此外，ODRL 采用单文件实现方式，将现有的离策略强化学习算法集成在统一框架内，并针对不同设置引入了额外的基准算法。通过开展广泛的基准测试实验，研究发现现有方法在面对不同的动力学偏移时，并不具备普遍的性能优势。该基准测试旨在为未来相关领域的研究提供坚实的基础。
