title: ODRL: A Benchmark for Off-Dynamics Reinforcement Learning

abstract: Transition density delocalization allows stable control of CPL by twisting chromophore segments. However, when transition density is localized, CPL cannot be controlled by such twisting and can be weakened by molecular vibrations.
summary_zh: 本文探讨了圆偏振发光性质与分子内跃迁密度分布之间的关系。研究发现，当跃迁密度在发色团片段间呈现离域化分布时，通过扭转这些片段可以稳定地调控圆偏振发光信号，实现对其强度和旋向的有效控制。相反，若跃迁密度局域在分子内某一特定区域，则片段间的扭转操作将无法有效调节圆偏振发光，且分子振动会进一步削弱该发光信号。这一发现揭示了跃迁密度离域化对于实现圆偏振发光动态调控的关键作用，为设计具有可调手性光学性质的功能材料提供了理论依据，在圆偏振有机发光二极管、手性传感及信息加密等领域具有潜在应用价值。
title: Pivotal role of transition density in circularly polarized luminescence

abstract: The comparison of long-term ceramic membrane bioreactors (MBRs) without and with in-situ ozonation was investigated in this study in terms of membrane fouling, activated sludge, effluent quality and microbial community in wastewater treatment. The optimal dosage of in-situ ozonation for long-term MBR operation was firstly determined as 5 mg/L (0.66 mg-ozone/g-mixed liquor suspended solid (MLSS)) with the optimal filterability of mixed liquor. During the long-term filtration experiment, MBR-ozone with in-situ ozonation demonstrated its significantly alleviated ceramic membrane fouling performance compared with MBR-control without in-situ ozonation as a result of the enhanced filterability of mixed liquor and organic foulants removal from membrane surface by in-situ ozonation oxidation. Furthermore, ozonation was beneficial to phosphorus removal and the total phosphorus (TP) concentration in effluent of MBR-control (0.82 ± 0.63 mg/L) was >2-fold higher than that of MBR-ozone (0.29 ± 0.41 mg/L). The improved phosphorus removal performance by ozonation was due to the increased abundance of phosphate accumulating bacteria of Candidatus Accumulibacter in activated sludge. However, ozonation was detrimental to nitrogen removal mainly as a result of the inhibition of denitrification with the decreased relative abundance of denitrification genus of Dechloromonas in activated sludge. Overall, ceramic MBR with in-situ ozonation had not only significantly alleviated membrane fouling but also remarkably improved phosphorus removal performance.
title: Comparison of long-term ceramic membrane bioreactors without and with in-situ ozonation in wastewater treatment: Membrane fouling, effluent quality and microbial community
venue: The Science of The Total Environment

summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于深度学习的感兴趣区域注意力网络，用于自动识别制造场景中的表面缺陷。该网络由三个核心模块构成：多级特征保持模块通过特征保留块区分缺陷特征与纹理信息；区域提议注意力模块通过捕获全局与局部上下文信息实现缺陷定位；跳跃密集连接检测模块则将低层特征图中的细粒度细节传播至高层，以提升缺陷类别预测能力。在NEU-DET、DAGM和Magnetic-Tile三个公开数据集上的实验结果表明，所提方法显著优于现有先进方法，平均缺陷检测准确率达到99.49%，可广泛应用于工业制造领域的表面质量检测。
title: RoIA: Region of Interest Attention Network for Surface Defect Detection

abstract: The metabolism of both cancer and immune cells in the tumor microenvironment (TME) is poorly understood since most studies have focused on analysis in bulk samples and ex vivo cell culture models. Our recent analyses of single-cell RNA sequencing data suggest that the metabolic features of single cells within TME differ greatly from those of the bulk measurements. Here, we discuss some key findings about metabolism in cancer and immune cells and discuss possible relevance to immunotherapy.
summary_zh: 由于以往的研究多侧重于对大体样本（bulk samples）及体外细胞培养模型的分析，肿瘤微环境（TME）中癌细胞与免疫细胞的代谢机制仍缺乏深入理解。本研究通过对单细胞RNA测序数据的分析发现，肿瘤微环境内单个细胞的代谢特征与大体测量结果存在显著差异。基于此，本文探讨了癌症与免疫细胞代谢的关键研究发现，并进一步讨论了这些代谢特征在免疫治疗中的潜在临床意义。
title: Metabolism in the tumor microenvironment: insights from single-cell analysis

summary_zh: 我们提出 SegSAM-3D，一种面向三维医学图像分割的增强框架，通过引入语义点提示与多层特征采样来提升分割精度与计算效率。该方法将 SAM 的二维组件扩展为三维对应结构，并利用语义点提示在视觉采样过程中同时编码位置与语义信息，从而克服传统二维提示模型对空间位置的依赖及其难以捕捉复杂三维空间关系的局限。多层特征采样则融合浅层与深层网络特征，增强对精细解剖结构的轮廓刻画能力。在 AbdomenCT-1K、BTCV-Abdomen、BTCV-Cervix、FLARE22 和 KiPA22 五个数据集上的评估表明，SegSAM-3D 相比原始 SAM 及其他基线模型（MedSAM、SAMMed3D）性能显著提升，Dice 分数达到 85.08%，较 SAM 提高 59.27%，同时保持较低的计算开销。尤其在腹部器官等边界模糊区域，该方法展现出优异的分割能力。上述结果证实，在 SAM 框架中融合语义引导与层次化特征可有效推动三维医学图像分割技术的发展，为临床诊断与治疗规划提供有力支持。
title: SegSAM-3D: Integrating Semantic Point Prompts and Multi-Layer Feature Sampling in SAM for Medical Imaging Segmentation
venue: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Bioinformatics and Biomedicine (BIBM)

abstract: In this paper, we propose an autonomous tree climbing strategy for a novel tree climbing robot that is named Treebot. The proposed algorithm aims to guide Treebot in climbing along an optimal path by the use of minimal sensing resources. Inspired by inchworms, the algorithm reconstructs the shape of a tree simply by the use of tactile sensors. It reveals how the realization of an environment can be achieved with limited tactile information. An efficient nonholonomic motion planning strategy is also proposed to make Treebot climb on an optimal path. This is accomplished by the prediction of the future shape of the tree. The study that is presented in this paper also includes the formulation of Treebot kinematics and an analysis of the workspace of Treebot on different shapes of a tree. Numerous experiments have been conducted to evaluate the proposed autonomous climbing algorithm and to unveil the ability of Treebot.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向新型爬树机器人 Treebot 的自主攀爬策略，旨在以最少传感资源引导机器人沿最优路径攀爬。受尺蠖运动启发，该算法仅利用触觉传感器重建树干形状，揭示了如何通过有限触觉信息实现对环境的认知。同时，提出一种高效的非完整运动规划方法，通过预测树干未来形状使 Treebot 沿最优路径攀爬。研究还建立了 Treebot 的运动学模型，并分析了其在不同树干形状下的工作空间。大量实验验证了所提自主攀爬算法的有效性，并展示了 Treebot 的攀爬能力。
title: Climbing Strategy for a Flexible Tree Climbing Robot—Treebot

abstract: This letter presents an angular noncritical phase-matching (PM) design in a non-collinear optical parametric amplifier to improve the spatial resolution of idler imaging. The design can not only promote the spatial gain bandwidth, but also eliminate the spatial walk-off between the Poynting vectors of the signal and the idler. By using an 800-nm pulse train as signal and its second-harmonic as pump, we have experimentally realized idler imaging with a two-dimensional space-bandwidth-product more than 72,900, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the highest value of the reported idler images to date.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种用于非共线光参量放大器的角度非临界相位匹配设计，旨在提升闲频光成像的空间分辨率。该设计既能扩展空间增益带宽，又能消除信号光与闲频光坡印廷矢量之间的空间走离效应。实验中以800纳米脉冲序列作为信号光，以其二次谐波作为泵浦光，成功实现了闲频光成像，其二维空间带宽积超过72900。据我们所知，这是迄今已报道的闲频光图像中空间带宽积的最高值。
title: High Resolved Non-Collinear Idler Imaging via Type-II Angular Noncritical Phase-Matching

abstract: In this paper we establish the convergence of a numerical scheme based, on the Finite Element Method, for a time-independent problem modelling the deformation of a linearly elastic elliptic membrane shell subjected to remaining confined in a half space. Instead of approximating the original variational inequalities governing this obstacle problem, we approximate the penalized version of the problem under consideration. A suitable coupling between the penalty parameter and the mesh size will then lead us to establish the convergence of the solution of the discrete penalized problem to the solution of the original variational inequalities. We also establish the convergence of the Brezis–Sibony scheme for the problem under consideration. Thanks to this iterative method, we can approximate the solution of the discrete penalized problem without having to resort to nonlinear optimization tools. Finally, we present numerical simulations validating our new theoretical results.
summary_zh: 本文针对线弹性椭圆膜壳在半空间约束下的静态障碍问题，建立了基于有限元方法的数值格式收敛性分析。该问题描述膜壳在变形过程中被限制于半空间内的力学行为。为避免直接逼近控制该障碍问题的原始变分不等式，我们转而对其惩罚形式进行离散近似。通过合理匹配惩罚参数与网格尺寸，证明了离散惩罚问题的解收敛于原始变分不等式的解。此外，本文还证明了Brezis–Sibony迭代格式在该问题中的收敛性。借助这一迭代方法，可在无需使用非线性优化工具的情况下有效求解离散惩罚问题。最后，数值模拟验证了所获理论结果的正确性。该工作为受单侧约束的薄壳结构力学分析提供了可靠的数值计算框架。
title: Numerical Approximation of the Solution of an Obstacle Problem Modelling the Displacement of Elliptic Membrane Shells via the Penalty Method

abstract: Multisegmented (MS) Co/CoPt3 nanowires (NWs) have been successfully fabricated by a template-assisted pulsed electrodeposition process and the length of each Co and CoPt3 segment is controlled by the pulse durations. The MS NWs show both the characteristic surface plasmon absorption and catalytic properties of CoPt3 and the strong ferromagnetic properties of Co that are affected by the interactions between Co and CoPt3. Furthermore, the ferromagnetic, optical, and catalytic properties can be well modulated by mainly changing the length of the Co and CoPt3 segments, respectively. Such multifunction of MS nanowires can be exploited for recyclable catalysts and bioassays based on their magnetic-catalytic and magnetic-optical properties, respectively.
summary_zh: 本文成功采用模板辅助脉冲电沉积工艺制备了多段式 Co/CoPt₃ 纳米线，并通过调节脉冲持续时间精确控制各段 Co 与 CoPt₃ 的长度。所制备的多段纳米线兼具 CoPt₃ 的特征表面等离激元吸收与催化性能，以及 Co 的强铁磁特性，且这些性能受到 Co 与 CoPt₃ 之间相互作用的显著影响。进一步研究表明，通过分别改变 Co 段和 CoPt₃ 段的长度，可以有效调控纳米线的铁磁、光学及催化性能。这种集多重功能于一体的多段纳米线，可基于其磁-催化特性应用于可回收催化剂，并基于其磁-光学特性应用于生物检测领域。
title: Multifunctional multisegmented Co/CoPt3 heterostructure nanowires

abstract: In this letter, we study efficient channel estimation and passive beamforming designs for a double-intelligent reflecting surface (IRS) aided single-user communication system, where a user communicates with an access point (AP) via the cascaded user-IRS 1-IRS 2-AP double-reflection link. First, a general channel estimation scheme is proposed for the system under any arbitrary inter-IRS channel, where all coefficients of the cascaded channel are estimated. Next, for the typical scenario with a line-of-sight (LoS)-dominant inter-IRS channel, we propose another customized scheme to estimate two signature vectors of the rank-one cascaded channel with significantly less channel training time than the first scheme. For the two proposed channel estimation schemes, we further optimize their corresponding cooperative passive beamforming for data transmission to maximize the achievable rate with the training overhead and channel estimation error taken into account. Numerical results show that deploying two cooperative IRSs with the proposed channel estimation and passive beamforming designs achieves significant rate enhancement as compared to the conventional case of single IRS deployment.
summary_zh: 本文研究了双智能反射面（IRS）辅助的单用户通信系统中的高效信道估计与被动波束赋形设计。在该系统中，用户通过用户-IRS 1-IRS 2-AP的级联反射链路与接入点进行通信。首先，针对具有任意级联信道特性的通用场景，本文提出了一种能够估计级联信道所有系数的通用信道估计方案。其次，针对存在视距（LoS）主导特征的典型级联信道场景，本文提出了一种定制化方案，通过估计秩为1的级联信道的两个特征向量，显著缩短了信道训练时间。在此基础上，本文综合考虑训练开销与信道估计误差，优化了两种方案对应的协作被动波束赋形设计，旨在最大化系统可达速率。数值仿真结果表明，相较于传统的单IRS部署方案，采用本文所提信道估计与被动波束赋形设计的双IRS协作方案能够显著提升系统的传输速率。
title: Wireless Communication via Double IRS: Channel Estimation and Passive Beamforming Designs

summary_zh: 踝关节运动的本体感觉信号对于维持身体平衡和步态控制至关重要，但目前临床上尚缺乏客观且准确的踝关节运动感知测试方法。本研究提出了一种快速且精确评估人体踝关节运动感知敏锐度的方法。研究采用单自由度机器人装置在受控条件下被动旋转受试者的踝关节，并结合心理物理学强制选择范式进行实验。通过招募20名健康受试者，在不同的参考速度（10°/s、15°/s和20°/s）下提供较小的比较速度，要求受试者通过口头判断两种运动中哪一种更快。研究利用心理测量学刺激-反应差异函数，推导出每个受试者的最小可觉差（JND）阈值和不确定性区间（IU）作为衡量指标。结果显示，JND阈值随参考速度的增加呈近线性增长，从10°/s时的0.53°/s增加到20°/s时的1.6°/s；感知不确定性也呈现类似的增长趋势。此外，JND与IU之间存在强相关性，表明人体踝关节运动感知的偏差约为所经历运动速度的5%至8%。该机器人辅助测试能够提供人体踝关节运动感知敏锐度的定量数据，为现有的踝关节本体感觉功能评估手段提供了有效的补充。
title: A Robotic Device for Measuring Human Ankle Motion Sense
venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Systems and Rehabilitation Engineering

summary_zh: 针对大语言模型在Text-to-SQL任务中的表现，现有研究多侧重于提升GPT-4等大规模闭源模型的性能，而对小规模开源模型的研究相对不足。本文提出了一种名为SPS-SQL的轻量化方法，旨在提升小规模开源模型在Text-to-SQL任务中的准确率。该方法的核心在于利用语义信息从训练数据中提取模板，并仅基于数据库模式（Schema）信息预合成查询语句，将其作为少样本示例（few-shot examples）来引导后续的SQL生成过程。实验结果表明，在Spider数据集的开发集和测试集上，基于7B参数量的Qwen 2.5 Coder模型通过SPS-SQL实现了81.7%和82.1%的执行准确率。此外，该方法在多种其他小规模模型上也展现出了极强的灵活性与适应性，性能显著优于同类方法，为提升开源小模型的逻辑推理与代码生成能力提供了有效路径。
title: SPS-SQL: Enhancing Text-to-SQL generation on small-scale LLMs with pre-synthesized queries

abstract: We determine accurate asymptotics for the low-lying eigenvalues of the Robin Laplacian when the Robin parameter goes to <inline-formula content-type="math/mathml"> <mml:math xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" alttext="negative normal infinity"> <mml:semantics> <mml:mrow> <mml:mo> − </mml:mo> <mml:mi mathvariant="normal"> ∞ </mml:mi> </mml:mrow> <mml:annotation encoding="application/x-tex">-\infty</mml:annotation> </mml:semantics> </mml:math> </inline-formula> . The two first terms in the expansion have been obtained by K. Pankrashkin in the 2D-case and by K. Pankrashkin and N. Popoff in higher dimensions. The asymptotics display the influence of the curvature and the splitting between every two consecutive eigenvalues. The analysis is based on the approach developed by Fournais-Helffer for the semi-classical magnetic Laplacian. We also propose a WKB construction as candidate for the ground state energy.
summary_zh: 本文研究了Robin拉普拉斯算子低阶特征值在Robin参数趋于负无穷时的精确渐近行为。针对二维情形，K. Pankrashkin已获得展开式的前两项，而高维情形则由K. Pankrashkin与N. Popoff共同给出。这些渐近结果揭示了边界曲率对特征值的影响，并刻画了相邻特征值之间的分裂规律。我们的分析基于Fournais和Helffer为半经典磁拉普拉斯算子发展的方法框架。此外，我们提出了一种WKB构造，作为基态能量的候选近似方案。
title: Eigenvalues for the Robin Laplacian in domains with variable curvature
venue: Transactions of the American Mathematical Society

abstract: Abstract In this paper, we are concerned with the inverse problem of determining anomalies in the state space associated with the stationary mean field game (MFG) system. We establish novel unique identifiability results for the intrinsic structure of these anomalies in MFGs systems, including their topological structure and parameter configurations, in several general scenarios of practical interest, including traffic flow, market economics and epidemics. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work that considers anomalies in the state space for the nonlinear coupled MFG system.
summary_zh: 本文研究稳态平均场博弈系统中状态空间异常的反问题，重点关注如何确定这些异常的内在结构。针对交通流、市场经济和流行病等多个具有实际应用价值的场景，我们建立了关于异常拓扑结构与参数配置的唯一可辨识性新结果。据我们所知，这是首次在非线性耦合平均场博弈系统中考虑状态空间异常问题的工作。
title: Determining state space anomalies in mean field games

summary_zh: 针对卷积神经网络硬件加速器在能效与吞吐量方面超越GPU的迫切需求，现有方案普遍存在并行度受限及功耗（含漏电功耗）过高的问题。本文提出一种基于阻变随机存取存储器加速的卷积神经网络，通过对权重和激活值施加二值约束训练网络，并将其映射到数字ReRAM交叉开关上，实现了吞吐量与能效的显著提升。我们设计了一种面向按位卷积的优化加速器架构，具备大规模并行处理能力且能效极高。数值实验结果表明，在数字ReRAM交叉开关上实现的二值CNN加速器峰值吞吐量达792 GOPS，功耗仅为4.5 mW，相较于高端GPU速度提升1.61倍，能效提升296倍。
title: An Energy-Efficient Digital ReRAM-Crossbar-Based CNN With Bitwise Parallelism
venue: IEEE Journal on Exploratory Solid-State Computational Devices and Circuits

abstract: Context representations have been widely used to profit semantic image segmentation. The emergence of depth data provides additional information to construct more discriminating context representations. Depth data preserves the geometric relationship of objects in a scene, which is generally hard to be inferred from RGB images. While deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have been successful in solving semantic segmentation, we encounter the problem of optimizing CNN training for the informative context using depth data to enhance the segmentation accuracy. In this paper, we present a novel switchable context network (SCN) to facilitate semantic segmentation of RGB-D images. Depth data is used to identify objects existing in multiple image regions. The network analyzes the information in the image regions to identify different characteristics, which are then used selectively through switching network branches. With the content extracted from the inherent image structure, we are able to generate effective context representations that are aware of both image structures and object relationships, leading to a more coherent learning of semantic segmentation network. We demonstrate that our SCN outperforms state-of-the-art methods on two public datasets.
title: SCN: Switchable Context Network for Semantic Segmentation of RGB-D Images

summary_zh: 可扩展且相干的多体系统能够实现此前未被探索的量子相，并具有指数级提升信息处理速度的潜力。在极低温度下，此类系统的行为受量子效应主导，热涨落可忽略不计。本文报道了一种包含一万个原子的量子模拟器的冷却技术，并实现了高保真度纠缠对的大规模制备。研究人员通过将莫特绝缘体样本浸入可移除的超流体储库中，在二维平面内实现了样本冷却，使每个粒子的熵降至极低水平。随后，原子被重新排列成无缺陷的二维晶格。研究进一步展示了针对1250对原子实现的双比特门操作，其保真度达到0.993 ± 0.001。该研究成果为探索低能多体相提供了理想环境，并为构建大规模量子纠缠奠定了基础。
title: Cooling and entangling ultracold atoms in optical lattices

abstract: The asymptotic behavior of nonoscillatory solutions of the superlinear dynamic equation on time scales , γ > 1, is discussed under the condition that exists and P ( t ) ≥ 0 for large t .
summary_zh: 本文研究时间尺度上一类超线性动态方程非振动解的渐近行为，其中非线性项指数 γ > 1，且假设在充分大的 t 上存在并满足 P(t) ≥ 0。通过分析解的渐近性质，给出了非振动解趋于零或趋于非零常数的充分条件，并刻画了其渐近衰减速率。所得结果统一并推广了连续与离散情形下的已有结论，可应用于种群动力学、控制理论等涉及时间尺度建模的领域。
title: Nonoscillatory Solutions of Second‐Order Superlinear Dynamic Equations with Integrable Coefficients

summary_zh: 针对密西西比河上游流域各州制定减少河流营养负荷策略的需求，本研究评估了11条爱荷华州河流中硝酸盐氮负荷估算常用插值与外推模型的变异性。结果显示，不同模型估算的年均日负荷整体一致性较低，尤其在硝酸盐氮负荷最高的五月，方法间差异最为显著。这种负荷估算方法间的显著差异令人担忧，因为只有当各州、联邦机构或利益团体对硝酸盐氮负荷估算程序具有充分信心时，公众才会相信负荷削减策略正在产生实效。
title: Variability of nitrate-nitrogen load estimation results will make quantifying load reduction strategies difficult in Iowa
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation

summary_zh: 本文针对铁磁材料磁化动力学模拟中Landau-Lifshitz方程的非线性和非凸约束难题，提出了两种新型二阶精度Gauss-Seidel投影方法。该方法将双调和方程与二阶后向微分公式相结合，在保持与隐式求解标量双调和方程相当的计算复杂度前提下，突破了现有GSPM仅有一阶精度的局限。第一种方法通过Gauss-Seidel更新实现无条件稳定性；第二种方法具有条件稳定性，其Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy常数为0.25。一致性分析和数值实验验证了方法的有效性与可靠性。值得注意的是，在微磁学模拟中，即使每个时间步仅更新一次杂散场，第一种方法仍表现出无条件稳定性。该工作为微磁学高效高精度数值模拟提供了新途径。
title: Second-Order Gauss-Seidel Projection Methods for the Landau-Lifshitz Equation

summary_zh: 本研究报道了两种近红外发光的有机铂(II)配合物Pt-2TPE和Pt-2TPA，它们通过Pt-Pt和π-π堆积相互作用自组装形成J-聚集体。理论计算表明，与单体相比，J-聚集体具有更低的LUMO能级和减小的单线态-三线态能隙，这意味着其电子接受能力增强，系间窜越效率提高。瞬态吸收光谱证实，Pt-2TPA J-聚集体的三线态激发态寿命显著延长至5.8微秒，而单体仅为123纳秒。该长寿命三线态的高效氧猝灭行为验证了J-聚集体中三线态布居和敏化作用的增强。基于此，J-聚集体在红光照射下可高效产生I型和II型活性氧，并催化NADH氧化，从而在常氧和乏氧条件下均能有效杀伤B16-F10肿瘤细胞。进一步构建的生物素修饰纳米制剂Biotin@Pt-2TPA在体内展现出优异的肿瘤蓄积能力和肿瘤生长抑制效果。该工作为提升铂(II)配合物光动力与光催化治疗效能提供了一种新策略。
title: Organoplatinum(II) J‐Aggregates with Prolonged Triplet Lifetimes for Enhanced Photodynamic and Photocatalytic Therapy

summary_zh: 黑炭（BC）源于生物质和化石燃料的不完全燃烧，对全球气候变化和碳循环具有重要影响。尽管红树林是蓝碳系统的关键组成部分，但对其黑炭的研究仍较为有限。本研究通过对香港、广西和孟加拉国三个地区的红树林沉积物进行采样，结合化学热氧化法（CTO-375）、苯多羧酸（BPCA）分析、元素分析、稳定碳同位素（δ13C）以及MixSIAR模型源解析，系统探究了红树林沉积物中黑炭的含量、来源及组成特征。研究结果表明，黑炭含量以香港最高，其次是孟加拉国和广西；而黑炭与总有机碳（TOC）的比值则以孟加拉国最高。在化石燃料燃烧的贡献方面，香港、孟加拉国和广西依次递减。这种空间差异性主要受周边地区发展水平和能源结构的驱动。此外，香港红树林沉积物中的黑炭可能受长距离输送影响更大，且在埋藏前经历了更显著的光降解作用，表现为较低的芳香度。本研究证明了黑炭是红树林沉积物碳库中一个重要且具有高度异质性的组成部分。
title: Heterogeneous distributions of black carbon in sediments from three Asian mangrove wetlands

summary_zh: 基于36° Y-X LiTaO3压电基片的水平剪切型声表面波器件，本研究实现了液滴的垂直喷射功能。传统上，水平剪切声表面波因流体与声波间耦合微弱，被认为不适于流体操控，但本工作发现其可激发近乎垂直方向的液柱喷射，且液柱在断裂前的长径比与施加功率呈正比关系，该特性与常规瑞利型声表面波产生的喷射行为显著不同。通过系统的理论仿真与实验研究，我们揭示了这一垂直喷射现象源于声波能量以压力形式耗散至固着液滴内部，从而在器件表面形成定向驱动力。该发现拓展了水平剪切声表面波在微流控、液体传感及生物医学液滴操控等领域的应用潜力。
title: Vertical jetting induced by shear horizontal leaky surface acoustic wave on 36° Y-X LiTaO3

abstract: Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) is overexpressed in >20% of breast cancers. Dimerization of HER2 receptors leads to the activation of downstream signals enabling the proliferation and survival of malignant phenotypes. Owing to the high expression levels of HER2, combination therapies are currently required for the treatment of HER2 + breast cancer. Here, we designed non-toxic transformable peptides that self-assemble into micelles under aqueous conditions but, on binding to HER2 on cancer cells, transform into nanofibrils that disrupt HER2 dimerization and subsequent downstream signalling events leading to apoptosis of cancer cells. The phase transformation of peptides enables specific HER2 targeting, and inhibition of HER2 dimerization blocks the expression of proliferation and survival genes in the nucleus. We demonstrate, in mouse xenofraft models, that these transformable peptides can be used as a monotherapy in the treatment of HER2 + breast cancer. HER2-targeting peptide-based micelles transform into nanofibrils on binding to HER2 on cancer cells, triggering cancer cell apoptosis and tumour death in vivo.
title: Transformable peptide nanoparticles arrest HER2 signalling and cause cancer cell death in vivo

abstract: Multiobjective evolutionary algorithms (MOEAs) have been widely used in real-world applications. However, most MOEAs based on Pareto-dominance handle many-objective problems (MaOPs) poorly due to a high proportion of incomparable and thus mutually nondominated solutions. Recently, a number of many-objective evolutionary algorithms (MaOEAs) have been proposed to deal with this scalability issue. In this article, a survey of MaOEAs is reported. According to the key ideas used, MaOEAs are categorized into seven classes: relaxed dominance based, diversity-based, aggregation-based, indicator-based, reference set based, preference-based, and dimensionality reduction approaches. Several future research directions in this field are also discussed.
summary_zh: 多目标进化算法在现实应用中已得到广泛采用，但多数基于帕累托支配的方法在处理高维多目标优化问题时表现不佳，主要原因是随着目标数量增加，解之间不可比较且互不支配的比例急剧上升。本文对高维多目标进化算法进行了系统综述。依据核心设计思想，将现有方法划分为七类：基于松弛支配关系的方法、基于多样性维护的方法、基于聚合函数的方法、基于性能指标的方法、基于参考集的方法、基于决策者偏好的方法以及基于降维的方法。文章还探讨了该领域若干值得关注的未来研究方向。
title: Many-Objective Evolutionary Algorithms: A Survey.

abstract: Small RNAs (sRNAs) are essential regulatory molecules, and there are three major sRNA classes in plants: microRNAs (miRNAs), phased small interfering RNAs (phased siRNAs or phasiRNAs), and heterochromatic siRNAs (hc-siRNAs). Excluding miRNAs, the other two classes are not well annotated or available in public databases for most sequenced plant genomes. We performed a comprehensive sRNA annotation of 143 plant species that have fully sequenced genomes and next-generation sequencing sRNA data publicly available. The results are available via an online repository called sRNAanno ( www.plantsRNAs.org ). Compared with other public plant sRNA databases, we obtained was much more miRNA annotations, which are more complete and reliable because of the consistent and highly stringent criteria used in our miRNA annotations. sRNAanno also provides free access to genomic information for >22,721 PHAS loci and >22 million hc-siRNA loci annotated from these 143 plant species. Both miRNA and PHAS loci can be easily browsed to view their main features, and a collection of archetypal trans-acting siRNA 3 (TAS3) genes were annotated separately for quick access. To facilitate the ease of sRNA annotation, sRNAanno provides free service for sRNA annotations to the community. In summary, the sRNAanno database is a great resource to facilitate genomic and genetic research on plant small RNAs.
title: sRNAanno—a database repository of uniformly annotated small RNAs in plants

summary_zh: 在现代航空制造领域，在机检测（OMI）系统凭借其高效、便捷及低成本的优势发挥着重要作用。然而，如何在确保无碰撞的前提下，寻找一条遍历所有检测点且耗时最短的最优路径，是制约检测效率提升的核心瓶颈。针对航空航天结构具有几何特征复杂、尺寸规模大以及加工精度要求高等特殊属性，本文提出了一种易于实现且鲁棒性强的航空航天结构在机检测路径规划新方法。为显著提升检测效率，该方法从三个维度进行了改进：首先，利用聚类技术对检测特征进行重组；其次，基于Voronoi图构建相邻特征图以进行路径规划；最后，设计了一种专门的搜索算法在相邻特征图中确定检测特征序列，并结合凸包算法实现避障。通过多个案例的实验验证，结果表明该方法能够有效应对航空航天结构的路径规划挑战，为在机检测任务提供了适用的优化路径。
title: Path planning method for on-machine inspection of aerospace structures based on adjacent feature graph

abstract: Abstract A framework to describe transport and deposition of ultrafine particles (UFP) within forests using large eddy simulation (LES) is presented. Comparison with measurements collected within and above a Scots pine stand in Southern Finland are used to explore the plausibility of the simulations. The numerical model is then employed to quantify the effects of canopy morphology (leaf area index and leaf area density), turbulence intensity, and particle size on the partitioning between upper canopy and subcanopy deposition and the overall deposition velocities. Results show a complex interplay between canopy morphology and turbulence, which is reflected on the particle flux profiles within the canopy. However, mean particle concentration profiles, total deposition, and deposition velocities at the canopy top are insensitive to the leaf area density profile but show dependence mostly on leaf area index, turbulence levels, and particle size. Finally, with the goal of understanding the sensitivity of the deposition velocity to all these parameters, an analytical model is developed that shows good agreement with LES results (within ± 20 % ) for all conditions simulated here.
title: Effects of leaf area index and density on ultrafine particle deposition onto forest canopies: A LES study

abstract: Research suggests that speech-based interventions can mitigate driving anger and enhance road safety. The present study found that both positive and negative comments can reduce anger state and perceived workload, and improve driving performance. In addition, positive comment including description of the driving environment and comment on drivers is more effective than negative comment intervention, which is indicated by larger effect size and higher user satisfaction and acceptance. The research findings could provide practical implications on the design of in-vehicle intelligent agents for driving behavior intervention.
summary_zh: 本研究表明，基于语音的干预措施能够有效缓解驾驶愤怒情绪并提升道路安全。实验发现，无论是正面还是负面的语音评论，均能降低驾驶者的愤怒状态与主观工作负荷，同时改善驾驶表现。其中，包含驾驶环境描述及对驾驶者评价的正面评论干预效果更优，表现为更大的效应量以及更高的用户满意度和接受度。这些发现为面向驾驶行为干预的车载智能代理设计提供了实践参考。
title: Effects of speech-based intervention with positive comments on reduction of driver's anger state and perceived workload, and improvement of driving performance

summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为EM-SA-DS的新型外部存储后缀数组构建算法，旨在处理长度达数十GB、字符集为常数或整数的大规模字符串。该算法的核心思想借鉴了经典的内部存储SA-DS算法框架，通过对固定大小的d-critical子串进行采样来实现。为了适应外部存储环境，EM-SA-DS引入了创新的缓存数据结构，实现了具有良好空间局部性的顺序扫描构建模式，从而确保数据在磁盘上的读写均为顺序操作。在外部存储模型下，假设RAM容量为Ω((n/B)^0.5)，磁盘容量为O(n)，且I/O块大小为B，该算法的I/O复杂度达到了O(n/B)。这项研究为基于缓存的算法设计提供了一种通用的解决方案，不仅能高效处理大规模后缀数组构建问题，还可进一步扩展至计算最长公共前缀（LCP）数组等相关问题，能够充分利用现代个人电脑中典型的内存与磁盘配置进行高效计算。
title: Suffix Array Construction in External Memory Using D-Critical Substrings

abstract: A concept of model-robustness is defined in terms of the performance of the design in the presence of model violations. The robustness problem is discussed for several randomization procedures commonly used in experimental design situations. Among them, the balanced completely randomized design, the randomized complete block design and the randomized Latin square design are shown to be model-robust in their own settings. To compare different randomization procedures, we define a concept of efficiency which depends on the particular "pattern" of model violations. This concept, when applied to different designs, gives results which are consistent with the intuitive grounds on which the designs are suggested.
summary_zh: 本文定义了模型稳健性概念，用以衡量试验设计在模型假设被违反时的表现性能。针对试验设计中常用的几种随机化方法，系统探讨了其稳健性问题。研究表明，完全随机化平衡设计、随机化完全区组设计以及随机化拉丁方设计在各自适用场景下均具有模型稳健性。为比较不同随机化过程的优劣，进一步提出了一种依赖于模型违反具体模式的效率概念。将该效率概念应用于不同设计方案时，所得比较结果与设计选择背后的直观依据高度一致，从而为试验设计方法的合理选用提供了理论支撑。
title: On the Robustness and Efficiency of Some Randomized Designs

abstract: A Mo–S–Ti–C nanocomposite film with both high-crystalline MoS2 in (002) basal planes and high hardness was successfully synthesized in the condition of pure MoS2 films growing with edge-terminated surface. The evolution of their structure and the transformation of crystal orientation during film growth were investigated by X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns and focused ion beam combining with the transmission electron microscopy (FIB/TEM). TEM revealed that the MoS2 edge sites usually considered as catalytic materials in catalysis field can provide active sites for titanium and carbon atoms aggregating in deposition. This aggregation of dopants not only largely passivates the activated MoS2 edge sites and induces the initial (100) textured MoS2 lamellar gradually transforming into (002) orientation but also effectively reduces the damage the dopants do to the highly ordered MoS2 crystallites. As a result, a Mo–S–Ti–C composite film with well-crystallized MoS2 in (002) basal planes was formed. The nanoindented experiments reveal that the hardness of this nanocomposite film reaches up to 6.81 GPa. Benefiting from the enhanced hardness and well-crystallized MoS2 in (002) basal planes, the corresponding pin-on-disk tribotests indicate that this nanocomposite film exhibits low friction coefficient (about 0.02) and high-wear resistance whether in vacuum or ambient air.
title: Mo–S–Ti–C Nanocomposite Films for Solid-State Lubrication

summary_zh: 金属卤化物钙钛矿材料因其高量子效率、易于调节的发光颜色、窄发射线宽以及低成本等优势，已成为高性能光电器件尤其是发光二极管中极具前景的半导体材料。尽管绿光和红光钙钛矿发光二极管已取得显著进展，蓝光器件的外量子效率仍明显落后。本研究实现了波长可调的高外量子效率纯蓝和深蓝钙钛矿发光二极管，在472纳米和461纳米发射波长下分别获得17.5%和10.8%的外量子效率。该波长可调性与高效率源于钙钛矿薄膜中独特的垂直梯度带隙结构和晶界有机壳层。这一结果标志着蓝光钙钛矿发光二极管性能的重大提升，为制备可与绿光和红光器件性能相匹配的高性能纯蓝和深蓝钙钛矿发光二极管提供了新途径，有望应用于未来照明与显示领域。
title: Highly Efficient Blue Light‐Emitting Diodes Based on Perovskite Film with Vertically Graded Bandgap and Organic Grain Boundary Passivation Shells

summary_zh: 本研究探讨了以荔枝壳为原料制备的生物炭（BC）及其改性产物——钙改性生物炭（Ca-BC）和铁锰改性生物炭（Fe–Mn-BC）——对雌酮（E1）在水体和土壤中迁移行为的影响。实验结果表明，在不同水体环境条件（如腐殖酸浓度、pH值和离子强度）下，Fe–Mn-BC均表现出优于其他两种生物炭的吸附能力。在298 K温度下，其最大吸附容量从原始生物炭的1.12 mg g⁻¹显著提升至4.18 mg g⁻¹。研究发现，相较于pH和离子强度，腐殖酸对生物炭吸附水中雌酮的性能影响更为显著。在土壤迁移控制方面，Fe–Mn-BC作为土壤改良剂效果突出，柱实验中未检测到雌酮的淋出液。与原始土壤（阻滞因子Rf = 7.1）相比，添加Ca-BC的土壤对雌酮迁移表现出更强的阻滞作用（Rf = 11.2）。上述结果证实，铁锰改性生物炭能够更有效地控制雌酮在环境中的迁移，可作为一种经济高效的替代吸附材料，用于治理水体和土壤中的雌酮污染。
title: The characteristics of oestrone mobility in water and soil by the addition of Ca-biochar and Fe–Mn-biochar derived from Litchi chinensis Sonn.

summary_zh: 近年来电子商务日益普及，大量消费者通过线上完成交易。部分商家为获取更多利润，雇佣虚假评价者发布高分好评以推广特定商品，或恶意给出负面评价以诋毁竞争对手产品，此类误导性评论严重破坏电商环境的公平性，因此识别持续发布欺骗性评价的虚假评价者至关重要。现有方法对虚假评论的识别率较低。本文首先提出利用SCTD对整体数据集进行缩减，从而聚焦于虚假评价者更可能活跃的时间段；随后构建相似度图，描述在同一商品下发表评论的评价者之间的关系；最后提出一种迭代算法，利用图中相邻评价者的边权重和关键特征计算每位评价者的虚假评分。实验结果表明，所提方法在虚假评价者检测方面具有显著更高的有效性。
title: Detecting spammers using review graph
venue: International Journal of High Performance Computing and Networking

abstract: Petal-like δ-MnO<sub>2</sub> microspheres were successfully synthesized by a very simple hydrothermal method with potassium permanganate (KMnO<sub>4</sub>) as the only raw material.
summary_zh: 本文通过以高锰酸钾为单一原料的简易水热法，成功制备了花瓣状δ-MnO₂微球。采用X射线衍射、扫描电子显微镜、透射电子显微镜和氮气吸附-脱附等表征手段，系统分析了产物的物相、形貌及孔结构特征。结果表明，所合成的δ-MnO₂呈现由纳米片组装而成的微球形貌，具有较高的比表面积，且其层间距约为0.7纳米。将制备的δ-MnO₂微球作为超级电容器电极材料，在三电极体系中以1摩尔每升硫酸钠为电解液进行电化学性能测试。循环伏安测试显示材料呈现近似矩形的曲线，表现出理想的电容行为；恒流充放电测试表明，在0.5安每克电流密度下，其比电容高达251.3法每克，且经2000次循环后电容保持率仍可达85.1%。该研究为高性能锰氧化物超级电容器电极材料的可控制备提供了一种简便有效的策略。
title: Synthesis of petal-like σ-MnO2 and its catalytic ozonation performance, New J. Chem

summary_zh: 本研究系统探讨了三种纳米级巯基功能化UiO-66型锆基金属有机框架材料——UiO-66-(SH)₂、UiO-66-MSA和UiO-66-DMSA——在钙钛矿太阳能电池中的作用。其中，具有刚性有机配体的UiO-66-(SH)₂与钙钛矿材料展现出最强的相互作用，能够更有效地抑制钙钛矿中的空位缺陷。通过原位掠入射广角X射线散射技术，深入揭示了UiO-66-(SH)₂辅助钙钛矿薄膜在退火过程中的形成机制：该添加剂的引入显著促进了碘化铅向钙钛矿相的转化，延长了阶段I的持续时间，并诱导了延迟的相变路径。基于UiO-66-(SH)₂的器件表现出更低的缺陷密度和优异的光电性能，实现了24.09%的优化光电转换效率，并在大气环境和持续光照条件下展现出增强的长期稳定性。该研究为设计理想的金属有机框架/钙钛矿复合结构提供了有益的指导，有助于推动金属有机框架/钙钛矿光电器件的进一步发展。
title: Thiol‐Functionalized Conjugated Metal–Organic Frameworks for Stable and Efficient Perovskite Photovoltaics

abstract: Abstract Revealing the hardening mechanisms is crucial for facilitating the design of superhard high‐entropy borides. Taking high‐entropy diborides (HEB 2 ) as the prototype, the hardening mechanisms of high‐entropy borides are thoroughly investigated. Specifically, the equiatomic 4—9‐cation single‐phase HEB 2 ceramics (4—9HEB 2 ) are fabricated by an ultra‐fast high‐temperature sintering method. The experimental results show that the hardness of the as‐fabricated 4—9HEB 2 samples has an increasing tendency with the increase of metal components. With a combination of first‐principles calculations, machine‐learning‐potential‐based molecular dynamics simulations, and scanning transmission electron microscopy characterizations, lattice distortion is explicitly identified to be essential in hardening HEB 2 by increasing strain field fluctuation, enlarging atomic strain energy, and strengthening B─B bonds. The results unravel the hardening mechanisms of HEB 2 by intensifying lattice distortion, providing fascinating guidance for developing superhard high‐entropy borides.
summary_zh: 揭示高熵硼化物的硬化机制对于设计超硬高熵硼化物至关重要。本研究以高熵二硼化物为原型，系统探究了其硬化机理。通过超快速高温烧结技术制备了等原子比四至九阳离子单相高熵二硼化物陶瓷，实验结果表明，随着金属组元数量增加，所制样品的硬度呈上升趋势。结合第一性原理计算、基于机器学习势的分子动力学模拟以及扫描透射电子显微镜表征，明确证实晶格畸变在硬化过程中起关键作用，其通过增强应变场波动、增大原子应变能并强化硼-硼键来提升硬度。该结果阐明了通过强化晶格畸变实现高熵二硼化物硬化的机制，为开发超硬高熵硼化物材料提供了重要指导。
title: Lattice Distortion Enhanced Hardness in High‐Entropy Borides

abstract: We report on the two-photon excited fluorescence of conjugated polymer dots (CPdots). As a new class of two-photon fluorescent probes, CPdots exhibit two-photon action cross sections as high as 2.0 × 105 GM, to our knowledge, the largest reported thus far for a nanoparticle. The cross section values are 3−4 orders of magnitude higher than those of conventional fluorescent dyes and an order of magnitude higher than those of inorganic quantum dots. Single particle fluorescence imaging was achieved using relatively low laser power.
summary_zh: 本文报道了共轭聚合物点（CPdots）的双光子激发荧光特性。作为一种新型双光子荧光探针，CPdots展现出了极高的双光子吸收截面，其数值高达2.0 × 10⁵ GM。据目前已知研究，这一数值是纳米颗粒中所报道的最大值，比传统荧光染料高出3至4个数量级，并比无机量子点高出一个数量级。得益于这种卓越的光学性能，研究人员能够在较低的激光功率下实现单颗粒荧光成像。该研究为开发高性能生物成像探针提供了新的材料方向。
title: Conjugated Polymer Dots for Multiphoton Fluorescence Imaging
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

summary_zh: 针对高熵合金（HEAs）成分设计空间过于庞大、传统“试错法”效率低下的难题，本文提出了一种“自优化”设计策略，旨在加速高性能合金的研发进程。该策略的核心在于利用现有多相合金中特定相的局部成分，直接提取并构建过饱和单相固溶体的化学成分，从而规避了繁琐的成分筛选过程。研究表明，通过该策略设计的“自优化合金”在力学性能上较母合金有显著提升，其屈服强度达到约1.2 GPa，同时保持了约10%的良好塑性。这种强韧化的机制归因于材料内部形成的独特多尺度层级组织结构，以及由此诱发的阶段性变形行为和综合强化效应。该设计策略及层级组织调控方法具有广泛的普适性，可推广至其他双相或多相合金体系，为新型先进工程材料的快速开发提供了高效途径。
title: A self-optimized alloy with multi-scale hierarchical microstructure and enhanced mechanical properties

abstract: Motivated by modern regression applications, in this paper, we study the convexification of a class of convex optimization problems with indicator variables and combinatorial constraints on the indicators. Unlike most of the previous work on convexification of sparse regression problems, we simultaneously consider the nonlinear non-separable objective, indicator variables, and combinatorial constraints. Specifically, we give the convex hull description of the epigraph of the composition of a one-dimensional convex function and an affine function under arbitrary combinatorial constraints. As special cases of this result, we derive ideal convexifications for problems with hierarchy, multi-collinearity, and sparsity constraints. Moreover, we also give a short proof that for a separable objective function, the perspective reformulation is ideal independent from the constraints of the problem. Our computational experiments with sparse regression problems demonstrate the potential of the proposed approach in improving the relaxation quality without significant computational overhead.
title: Ideal formulations for constrained convex optimization problems with indicator variables

summary_zh: 腺苷脱氨酶作用于RNA（ADAR）蛋白通过介导双链RNA（dsRNA）底物的腺苷到肌苷编辑，在维持先天免疫平衡中发挥关键作用。本研究利用冷冻电子显微镜技术，解析了秀丽隐杆线虫ADR-2-ADBP-1复合物的结构。研究发现，该复合物以2:2的化学计量比存在，呈现出一种不对称的ADR-2二聚体构象，其中一个编辑位点被另一个ADR-2分子所阻挡。出乎意料的是，dsRNA的招募会触发ADR-2二聚体的解离，从而暴露更多具有活性的dsRNA编辑位点。此外，在高浓度的dsRNA和蛋白质环境下，复合物会发生液-液相分离并形成点状结构，这种组织形态的转变显著提升了编辑活性，使ADR-2-ADBP-1复合物能够实现dsRNA的高效超编辑。研究结果表明，ADAR编辑机制能够通过构象重组来适应不同的细胞环境。
title: Conformational Reorganization and Phase Separation Drive Hyper-Editing of ADR-2-ADBP-1 Complex

abstract: Gold nanoparticle-based lateral flow immunoassays (AuNP LFIAs) are widely used point-of-care (POC) sensors for in vitro diagnostics. However, the sensitivity limitation of conventional AuNP LFIAs impedes the detection of trace biomarkers. Several studies have explored the size and shape factors of AuNPs and derivative nanohybrids, showing limited improvements or enhanced sensitivity at the cost of convenience and affordability. Here, we investigated surface chemistry on the sensitivity of AuNP LFIAs. By modifying surface ligands, a surface chemistry strategy involving weakly ionized AuNPs enables ultrasensitive naked-eye LFIAs (~100-fold enhanced sensitivity). We demonstrated how this surface chemistry-amplified immunoassay approach modulates nanointerfacial bindings to promote antibody adsorption and higher activity of adsorbed antibodies. This surface chemistry design eliminates complex nanosynthesis, auxiliary devices, or additional reagents while efficiently improving sensitivity with advantages: simplified fabrication process, excellent reproducibility and reliability, and ultrasensitivity toward various biomarkers. The surface chemistry using weakly ionized AuNPs represents a versatile approach for sensitizing POC sensors.
title: Weakly ionized gold nanoparticles amplify immunoassays for ultrasensitive point-of-care sensors

abstract: In ultra-short pulse laser machining and micro/surface processing, accurate simulation of laser ablation is important for understanding laser-target interaction and improving ablation performance, but it remains challenging. This work aims to develop a numerical model to improve the accuracy of the ablation depth calculation. A grid deformation scheme is proposed based on energy conservation and considering contributions to instant material removal from both the electron and lattice subsystems. By incorporating this scheme with the two-temperature model (TTM), a reasonable prediction of the instant target surface profile during laser ablation has been achieved. In the case of single-pulse femtosecond laser ablation of Ti6Al4V, the calculated ablation depth ranges from 0.06 to 0.56 μm for laser energy from 1.0 to 10.0 μJ. For single-pulse picosecond laser ablation of stainless steel, as laser energy increases from 6.0 to 18.5 μJ, the predicted ablation crater deepens accordingly from 40 to 87 nm. In addition, for multi-pulse picosecond laser ablation of stainless steel, a linear dependence of the ablation depth on the pulse number is observed up to a depth of about 803 nm at 6.0 μJ and 20 pulses. In all the above-mentioned cases, the calculation results are in better agreement with experimental measurements than conventional TTM or other material removal schemes, validating the accuracy of the proposed model.
title: Numerical simulation and investigation of ultra-short pulse laser ablation on Ti6Al4V and stainless steel

abstract: This paper presents a passive-marker-based optical tracking system utilizing dual Kinect sensors and additional custom optical tracking components. To obtain sub-millimeter tracking accuracy, we introduce robust calibration of dual infrared sensors and point correspondence establishment in a stereo configuration. The 3D localization is subsequently accomplished using multiple back projection lines. The proposed system extends existing inexpensive consumer electronic devices, implements tracking algorithms, and shows the feasibility of applying the proposed low-cost system to surgical training for computer assisted surgeries.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于被动标记的光学追踪系统，该系统采用双 Kinect 传感器并辅以定制光学追踪组件。为实现亚毫米级追踪精度，研究中引入了稳健的双红外传感器标定方法，并在立体配置下建立了点对应关系。随后，利用多条反投影线完成三维定位。该系统对现有低成本消费电子设备进行了功能扩展，实现了相应的追踪算法，并验证了将该低成本系统应用于计算机辅助手术外科培训的可行性。
title: Marker-Based Surgical Instrument Tracking Using Dual Kinect Sensors
venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering

summary_zh: 本文提出一种两阶段语义图像传输框架，结合多模态大语言模型实现生成式编辑，以解决深度联合信源信道编码在语义通信中感知质量与失真可靠性之间的矛盾。第一阶段采用基于联合信源信道编码的判别式传输，在有限带宽下优先保留语义重要区域，维持场景布局与物体完整性；第二阶段利用多模态大语言模型驱动的生成式编辑，依据文本描述修复缺失细节，提升语义保真度与感知质量。大量实验表明，该框架在多种信道条件下，尤其在低信噪比场景中，在语义保持、感知质量和视觉保真度方面均达到当前最优性能。
title: GenED-SC: generative editing semantic communication with integrated multi-modal LLMs

summary_zh: 本研究针对双足机器人三维行走中的被动安全问题，提出了一种将安全约束集成到任务空间模仿学习中的新框架。传统方法依赖简化动力学模型的非线性优化，需要人工调整参考轨迹，而本研究通过极值线性化处理三维捕获条件，将原本非线性耦合的捕获动力学转化为线性约束，并无缝嵌入约束型模仿学习过程中。同时，设计了基于启发式规则的控制点定义方法，使机器人能够自适应地学习运动技能。该框架仅需少量示教即可高效习得运动技能，并能将所学技能泛化至未见过的三维场景，同时满足被动安全约束。与深度强化学习相比，本方法无需大量迭代训练或从仿真到实物的迁移过程。得益于任务空间的自适应能力，所提出的模仿学习框架可在新机器人平台上复用已采集的示教数据。通过在Walker2机器人上的硬件实验和COMAN机器人上的仿真实验，验证了该方法的有效性。
title: Safe and Adaptive 3-D Locomotion via Constrained Task-Space Imitation Learning

abstract: Detecting cell-cell communications (CCCs) in single-cell transcriptomics studies is fundamental for understanding the function of multicellular organisms. Here, we introduce FastCCC, a permutation-free framework that enables scalable, robust, and reference-based analysis for identifying critical CCCs and uncovering biological insights. FastCCC relies on fast Fourier transformation-based convolution to compute p-values analytically without permutations, introduces a modular algebraic operation framework to capture a broad spectrum of CCC patterns, and can leverage atlas-scale single cell references to enhance CCC analysis on user-collected datasets. To support routine reference-based CCC analysis, we constructed the first human CCC reference panel, encompassing 19 distinct tissue types, over 450 unique cell types, and approximately 16 million cells. We demonstrate the advantages of FastCCC across multiple datasets, most of which exceed the analytical capabilities of existing CCC methods. In real datasets, FastCCC reliably captures biologically meaningful CCCs, even in highly complex tissue environments, including differential interactions between endothelial and immune cells linked to COVID-19 severity, dynamic communications in thymic tissue during T-cell development, as well as distinct interactions in reference-based CCC analysis. As single-cell datasets scale to millions of cells, analyzing cell-cell communication becomes computationally challenging. Here, authors present FastCCC, a fast, permutation-free framework that enables scalable CCC analysis and provides a comprehensive human CCC reference panel.
title: FastCCC: a permutation-free framework for scalable, robust, and reference-based cell-cell communication analysis in single cell transcriptomics studies
Search for exotic decays of the Higgs boson into long-lived particles in pp collisions at $$ \sqrt{s} $$ = 13 TeV using displaced vertices in the ATLAS inner detector

summary_zh: 随着计算机视觉应用的爆发式增长，大量图像被上传至云端服务器进行深度学习推理。尽管JPEG已成为图像压缩与封装的事实标准，但其标准配置在处理深度学习任务时效率较低，往往需要在保持推理精度的情况下承担过大的数据传输开销。针对云端视觉模型对用户而言通常是“黑盒”且不同用户需求多变的问题，本文提出了一种基于强化学习的JPEG配置框架。该框架通过设计智能体，根据输入图像特征与后端深度学习模型动态调整压缩级别。通过将不同的云端视觉服务作为交互式训练环境，并综合考虑分类精度与数据大小构建奖励机制，实现了智能体的自适应训练。在Amazon Rekognition、Face++及百度视觉等真实场景下的评估结果表明，该方法在仅导致分类精度轻微下降的前提下，能够将图像数据量减少至原有的1/2至1/3，显著提升了在线计算机视觉服务的传输效率。
title: AdaCompress: adaptive compression for online computer vision services

abstract: experiments revealed that PLGA@MT-Ti screws promoted the bone formation and osteointegration in type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM) mice with tibial bone defects. Our findings demonstrate that PLGA@MT-Ti exerted dual effects through activating the BMP-4/WNT pathway and attenuating ROS overproduction to promote osteogenesis and osteointegration at the Ti-B interface, providing a novel strategy to fabricate biomaterial modification and biofunctionalization under diabetic conditions.
summary_zh: 研究表明，PLGA@MT-Ti螺钉能够有效促进1型糖尿病（T1DM）小鼠胫骨缺损部位的骨形成与骨整合。实验结果显示，该材料通过激活BMP-4/WNT信号通路并减轻活性氧（ROS）的过度产生，在钛-骨界面发挥双重调节作用，从而显著增强成骨能力与界面整合效果。本研究为糖尿病病理环境下生物材料的表面改性与生物功能化提供了新的设计策略与技术路径。
title: The dual-effects of PLGA@MT electrospun nanofiber coatings on promoting osteogenesis at the titanium–bone interface under diabetic conditions

summary_zh: 相干光场与原子激发之间的量子接口在量子计量学和量子信息科学领域具有重要意义。本文利用高效的电磁诱导透明（EIT）存储技术，在冷原子系统中直接观测到了单光子水平的Ramsey干涉现象，并实现了高对比度的光谱透明梳状结构，其在共振线附近的可见度高达0.81左右。研究详细探讨了影响干涉条纹的关键因素，包括脉冲重复周期、减速与检索信号脉冲的波形重叠程度，以及EIT存储器的相干寿命。这种高对比度的干涉条纹为精密测量提供了新方法，在原子钟和磁力计等领域具有潜在的应用价值。
title: High-contrast transparency comb of the electromagnetically-induced-transparency memory

summary_zh: 本文提出一种用于分数-N 锁相环的时间模式运算单元，旨在替代传统相位检测器前端的时间偏移消除方案。该单元以频率参考信号与可变振荡器时钟的下降沿之间、以及两个连续振荡器时钟沿之间的时延加权求和作为输出。与基于数字-时间转换器的对齐方法相比，该方案对工艺、电压和温度变化不敏感，输出仅随 RC 时间常数比值变化，可在不增加系统复杂度的前提下保证低分数杂散。与电压域抵消方案相比，该结构无需电流源，有利于相位噪声优化和向更先进工艺节点迁移。此外，时间模式运算单元可隐式提供时间放大增益，进一步抑制后续模块的噪声贡献。该方案为分数-N 锁相环中相位检测器输入范围的最小化提供了一条低杂散、低噪声且工艺可迁移的新途径，适用于高性能频率合成器设计。
title: A 2.6-to-4.1GHz Fractional-N Digital PLL Based on a Time-Mode Arithmetic Unit Achieving -249.4dB FoM and -59dBc Fractional Spurs
venue: 2022 IEEE International Solid-State Circuits Conference (ISSCC), San Francisco, CA, USA, 2022, pp. 380-382

summary_zh: 针对超急性期缺血性脑卒中溶栓治疗中不可逆梗死评估的临床需求，本文提出一种通用异常组织分割方法，用于实现超急性期梗死灶的精准分割。该方法设计多维特征训练随机森林分类器进行体素级分类，并采用基于稀疏编码的词袋模型训练区域分类器以识别梗死区域。在98例发病6小时内连续入组患者的扩散加权成像数据上进行验证，所提方法获得Dice系数0.774±0.117，优于现有两种方法（0.755±0.118和0.597±0.204）。该方法可作为超急性期扩散加权成像梗死灶定量分析的潜在工具，为溶栓治疗决策提供精准辅助支持。
title: Segmentation of hyper-acute cerebral infarct based on random forest and sparse coding from diffusion weighted imaging
venue: 2017 39th Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC)

abstract: We show that all meromorphic solutions of the stationary reduction of the real cubic Swift‐Hohenberg equation are elliptic or degenerate elliptic. We then obtain them all explicitly by the subequation method, and one of them appears to be a new elliptic solution.
summary_zh: 本文研究了实立方Swift-Hohenberg方程稳态约化形式的所有亚纯解，证明了这些解均为椭圆函数或其退化形式。在此基础上，采用子方程方法显式构造了全部解，其中包含一个此前未被报道的新型椭圆函数解。该工作为理解Swift-Hohenberg方程在斑图形成、流体力学不稳定性及非线性光学等领域的稳态结构提供了完整的解析描述。
title: Exact meromorphic solutions of the real cubic Swift-Hohenberg equation

summary_zh: 面向快速增长的组学数据，对高效灵活的生物信息学分析工具的需求日益迫切。本文提出自动化生物信息学分析智能体AutoBA，一种基于大语言模型构建的自主AI代理，专门用于全自动多组学分析。AutoBA仅需极少的用户输入，即可为各类生物信息学任务生成详细的分步分析方案，并具备根据输入数据特征自主设计分析流程的能力，展现出高度的通用性。相较于在线生物信息服务，AutoBA支持多种大语言模型后端，并提供在线与本地部署选项，优先保障数据安全与用户隐私。与ChatGPT及开源大语言模型相比，AutoBA内置的自动代码修复机制显著提升了其在端到端自动化生物信息学分析任务中的稳定性。此外，不同于预定义的固定流程，AutoBA能够同步适应新兴生物信息学工具。总体而言，AutoBA为常规多组学分析提供了一种先进便捷、稳健且具有良好适应性的工具。
title: An AI Agent for Fully Automated Multi‐Omic Analyses

summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于集中式动物饲养作业（CAFOs）中内分泌干扰物（包括邻苯二甲酸酯、双酚A及雌激素类化合物）的排放与来源问题。通过对典型家畜（牛）与特殊家畜（鸽子）的粪便、尿液及饲料样本进行检测，研究发现单头牛每日的总雌激素排泄量显著高于鸽子，且排泄物的雌激素存在形式受物种及排泄类型影响，其中牛尿液中的结合态雌激素占比极高。研究结果显示，所有样本中均检出了双酚A（BPA），且饲料是BPA进入牛与鸽繁殖过程的重要来源。此外，鸽子粪便中高频检出邻苯二甲酸二乙酯（DEP），表明其暴露于此类增塑剂的风险较高。通过估算发现，畜牧业来源的雌二醇当量（EEQt）在水环境中的浓度已超过基准危害值。本研究为评估CAFOs中内分泌干扰物的排放特征及污染路径提供了关键数据，并明确了饲料在双酚A污染过程中的核心作用。
title: Occurrence and emission of phthalates, bisphenol A, and oestrogenic compounds in concentrated animal feeding operations in Southern China

summary_zh: 脂毒性是导致非酒精性脂肪性肝炎（NASH）发生与进展的关键因素。饱和脂肪酸的过度积累会诱发肝细胞线粒体功能障碍、氧化应激及细胞凋亡，进而引发炎症损伤。本研究通过棕榈酸诱导的LO2细胞模型，系统探讨了恩格列净对脂毒性的影响及其分子机制。研究发现，恩格列净能够通过减轻氧化应激、改善线粒体功能以及抑制细胞凋亡和炎症反应，有效保护肝细胞并缓解脂毒性。机制研究表明，恩格列净并非通过LKB1或TAK1，而是通过激活CAMKK2/AMPKα信号通路来增强AMPKα的活性。这种激活作用进一步促进了FoxO3a和Nrf2的核转位，并上调了超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和血红素加氧酶-1（HO-1）等抗氧化酶的表达。值得注意的是，恩格列净并未减少脂质的积累，其缓解脂毒性的作用主要通过增强抗氧化防御机制实现。综上所述，恩格列净通过CAMKK2/AMPKα通路介导的抗氧化作用可减轻饱和脂肪酸诱导的肝细胞脂毒性，CAMKK2/AMPKα通路有望成为治疗NASH脂毒性的潜在药物靶点。
title: Empagliflozin-Enhanced Antioxidant Defense Attenuates Lipotoxicity and Protects Hepatocytes by Promoting FoxO3a-and Nrf2-Mediated Nuclear Translocation via the CAMKK2/AMPK Pathway

summary_zh: 骨质疏松症是一种常见的年龄相关性疾病，以骨密度下降和全身骨微结构紊乱为特征。随着年龄增长，骨组织中衰老细胞不断积累并呈现衰老相关分泌表型，导致骨稳态失衡、骨量减少、骨小梁结构改变及骨脆性增加。骨微环境中的细胞衰老涉及成骨细胞、破骨细胞和骨髓间充质干细胞，其对骨稳态的影响受到表观遗传调控。因此，细胞衰老的表观遗传调控机制作为防治骨质疏松的潜在靶点受到广泛关注。本文系统综述了骨质疏松中衰老相关表观遗传调控机制，重点阐述了表观遗传对细胞衰老的影响，并总结了目前靶向细胞衰老的三种方法，有助于深入理解骨质疏松中细胞衰老的致病机制，并为开发治疗骨质疏松的表观遗传药物提供策略。
title: Epigenetic regulations of cellular senescence in osteoporosis

abstract: Hyperconjugation, a weak interaction in organic chemistry, can have a strong effect on aromaticity, leading to the concept of hyperconjugative aromaticity, which was first proposed by Mulliken in 1939. However, most studies are limited to main group chemistry. Here we report the most aromatic and antiaromatic pyrrolium ring by maximizing the hyperconjugation caused by transition metal fragments and the push-pull effect. Our calculations reveal that the origin of the outperformance of transition metal substituents over main group ones on hyperconjugative aromaticity could be attributed to their higher highest occupied molecular orbitals (HOMOs). Among the group 11 transition metals, a silver substituent results in the best performance. All these findings highlight the magic of the transition metal (silver) and could be particularly helpful for the design of other aromatic and antiaromatic counterparts based on a nonaromatic parent species.
summary_zh: 本研究探讨了超共轭效应对芳香性的显著影响，重点关注过渡金属取代基在增强超共轭芳香性方面的独特优势。超共轭芳香性概念由Mulliken于1939年首次提出，但以往研究多局限于主族元素体系。我们通过最大化过渡金属片段引起的超共轭效应及推拉电子效应，成功构建了迄今最具芳香性和反芳香性的吡咯鎓环。计算结果表明，过渡金属取代基之所以优于主族取代基，根本原因在于其最高占据分子轨道能级更高。在第11族过渡金属中，银取代基表现出最佳性能。这些发现揭示了过渡金属（特别是银）在调控芳香性方面的独特魔力，可为基于非芳香母体设计其他芳香性和反芳香性类似物提供重要指导。
title: Probing the Most Aromatic and Antiaromatic Pyrrolium Rings by Maximizing Hyperconjugation and Push–Pull Effect

abstract: Human atherosclerotic lesions overexpress the lysosomal cysteine protease cathepsin S (Cat S), one of the most potent mammalian elastases known. In contrast, atheromata have low levels of the endogenous Cat S inhibitor cystatin C compared with normal arteries, suggesting involvement of this protease in atherogenesis. The present study tested this hypothesis directly by crossing Cat S-deficient (CatS(-/-)) mice with LDL receptor-deficient (LDLR(-/-)) mice that develop atherosclerosis on a high-cholesterol diet. Compared with LDLR(-/-) mice, double-knockout mice (CatS(-/-)LDLR(-/-)) developed significantly less atherosclerosis, as indicated by plaque size (plaque area and intimal thickening) and stage of development. These mice also had markedly reduced content of intimal macrophages, lipids, smooth muscle cells, collagen, CD4(+) T lymphocytes, and levels of IFN-gamma. CatS(-/-)LDLR(-/-) monocytes showed impaired subendothelial basement membrane transmigration, and aortas from CatS(-/-)LDLR(-/-) mice had preserved elastic laminae. These findings establish a pivotal role for Cat S in atherogenesis.
title: Deficiency of cathepsin S reduces atherosclerosis in LDL receptor-deficient mice

abstract: This article presents a framework for systematic, stable and passive, dynamical balancing and locomotion control of flexible-joint bipedal robots. In order to achieve stability/passivity of the full flexible-joint, floating-base model with contacts, several novel control designs are proposed, whose ability to guarantee regulation and tracking stability is mathematically and practically demonstrated. The proposed designs enable usage of full-state feedback terms, thereby increasing both link tracking and oscillation suppression performance. These constitute the only control schemes reported in the literature, which are capable of asymptotically stabilizing flexible-joint, floating-base systems with contacts, during trajectory-tracking tasks. Moreover, a novel linear quadratic regulator (LQR) tuning approach is proposed, which permits the creation of models characterized by distinct kinetic chain and impedance combinations. Stable switching between these gain sets is guaranteed, as it is demonstrated that the proposed controllers enable unconstrained and stable, variable impedance control (VIC). The proposed control methods are corroborated through practical, balancing and locomotion experiments on the COmpliant huMANoid, as well as via dynamical simulations; these results demonstrate stability maintenance during tracking and VIC tasks. The ability to stably modulate a legged robot's active impedances could enable closer replication of biologically inspired behaviors.
title: Flexible-Joint Floating-Base Robot Balancing and Locomotion via Variable Impedance Control

abstract: The development of asymptotic expansions of Stieltjes transforms of exponentially decaying functions has been well established. In this paper, we are concerned with the more difficult case in which the functions decay only algebraically at infinity. By using a Gevrey–type condition, we obtain an exponentially improved asymptotic expansion, and give three representation theorems to show that the Stieltjes transform of algebraically decaying functions can be written as the difference of two integral transforms with exponentially decaying kernels, thus making the asymptotic theory developed for integral transforms with exponentially decaying kernels relevant to Stieltjes transforms of algebraically decaying functions, including the smoothing of the Stokes phenomenon.
summary_zh: 本文研究代数衰减函数的Stieltjes变换的渐近展开问题。与已有充分研究的指数衰减情形不同，代数衰减函数的渐近分析更为困难。通过引入Gevrey型条件，我们得到了指数改进的渐近展开式，并建立了三个表示定理，证明代数衰减函数的Stieltjes变换可表示为两个具有指数衰减核的积分变换之差。这一表示使得针对指数衰减核积分变换所发展的渐近理论，包括Stokes现象的平滑化处理，能够直接应用于代数衰减函数的Stieltjes变换，从而将经典渐近方法推广到更广泛的函数类。
title: Gevrey asymptotics and Stieltjes transforms of algebraically decaying functions
venue: Proceedings of the Royal Society A Mathematical Physical and Engineering Sciences

summary_zh: 本研究通过密度泛函理论计算，揭示了第8族过渡金属取代基在环戊二烯体系中诱导超共轭芳香性的能力，填补了此前该族元素在此类芳香性研究中的空白。超共轭芳香性作为芳香性与超共轭概念的融合，自1939年提出以来，已从主族元素拓展至第7、9、10、11族有机金属取代基体系。计算结果表明，金属-金属键的形成会显著削弱体系的超共轭芳香性；然而，当金属-金属双键与桥连羰基协同作用时，芳香性可得到明显恢复。这一发现不仅拓展了超共轭芳香性的元素范围，也为金属芳香化学提供了新的理论视角，对理解有机金属化合物中的电子离域与稳定性具有重要价值。
title: Predicting the Hyperconjugative Aromaticity in Cyclopentadiene Containing Group 8 Transition Metal Substituents

summary_zh: cypress 是首个面向细胞类型特异性差异表达基因识别研究的实验设计与统计功效分析工具。该工具能够对纯化的细胞类型特异性表达谱、细胞类型组成比例以及生物学与技术变异进行可靠建模，为 bulk RNA-seq 数据的卷积与反卷积提供高保真模拟。通过模拟并评估多种影响因素的作用，cypress 借助多项统计指标帮助研究人员优化实验设计方案并开展功效分析。该工具以开源 R/Bioconductor 包形式发布，适用于临床研究中基于转录组反卷积的细胞类型水平精细分析场景。
title: cypress: an R/Bioconductor package for cell-type-specific differential expression analysis power assessment

summary_zh: 本文探索可重构平台在革新订单簿架构方面的潜力，提出一种面向最大吞吐量和最低延迟优化的新型订单簿更新算法。主要贡献包括三项：首先，设计了一种固定档位数据结构，使订单簿更易于映射到硬件；其次，构建了缓存订单簿前五档行情的定制化缓存，以进一步降低延迟；最后，基于所提数据结构提出了一种硬件友好的订单簿更新算法。实验表明，基于FPGA的解决方案每秒可处理120万至150万条消息，吞吐量达10Gb/s，延迟为132至288纳秒，相比CPU方案速度提升90至157倍，相比现有FPGA方案提升5.2至6.6倍。该研究为高频交易场景下金融交易所的订单簿重建提供了高效硬件加速方案。
title: Exploring the potential of reconfigurable platforms for order book update
venue: 2017 27th International Conference on Field Programmable Logic and Applications (FPL). Cite URL

summary_zh: 本文提出了一种交流供电的无电感LED驱动器，旨在通过调制光输出，同时实现高效照明与数据传输功能。针对传统基于开关变换器的可见光通信驱动方案存在被动元件速度限制的问题，该设计通过数字化的功率级与控制器实现了多电流路径间的平滑切换，并结合保持与恢复技术及辅助开启开关，有效提升了可见光通信的数据传输速率。此外，该驱动器采用精确的1/x电路与调光补偿方法，成功抑制了有害的低频闪烁。该集成电路采用0.35μm、120V高压CMOS工艺制造。实验结果表明，在110VAC、60Hz输入条件下，该设计的峰值效率超过89%，低频闪烁降低至10%以下。在LED模块与接收端距离为1米的情况下，该驱动器支持高达8Mb/s的非归零码（NRZ）开关键模（OOK）数据传输。
title: An AC Input Inductor-Less LED Driver for Efficient Lighting and Visible Light Communication

summary_zh: 去马赛克技术旨在从图像传感器采集的分离颜色样本中重建RGB图像，其中拜耳（Bayer）彩色滤波阵列应用最为广泛。本文提出了一种针对拜耳模式的抗混叠与抗伪影去马赛克（AAACA）算法，并设计了与之配套的高资源效率超大规模集成电路（VLSI）架构。AAACA算法由抗混叠策略和基于颜色差值的中值滤波器（CDMF）组成。在抗混叠方面，该算法针对边缘像素与非边缘像素采取不同的重建策略，从而显著消除了边缘附近的混叠现象；在伪影抑制方面，利用CDMF通过中值滤波后的颜色差异来消除重建图像中的色彩伪影。在McMaster和Kodak数据集上的定量评估与主观视觉质量测试表明，与现有先进算法相比，AAACA算法能有效减少边缘混叠并大幅降低色彩伪影。此外，基于180nm CMOS工艺实现的VLSI架构在处理1280×720分辨率的HD图像时，工作频率可达200MHz，在相同工艺条件下展现出优于以往实现的视觉质量。
title: Anti-Aliasing and Anti-Color-Artifact Demosaicing for High-Resolution CMOS Image Sensor
venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems I Regular Papers

abstract: from α-(6-indolyl) propargylic alcohols with 1,3-dicarbonyl compounds such as 4-hydroxycoumarins and cyclohexane-1,3-diones was developed, which provided robust access to a wide range of pyranocoumarin and pyran derivatives containing an indole skeleton with high efficiency under mild conditions.
summary_zh: 本文报道了一种以α-(6-吲哚基)炔丙醇与1,3-二羰基化合物为原料，高效构建含吲哚骨架的吡喃香豆素及吡喃衍生物的新方法。该方法以4-羟基香豆素和环己烷-1,3-二酮等典型1,3-二羰基化合物为反应伙伴，在温和条件下实现了结构多样的含吲哚杂环化合物的快速合成。反应展现出优异的官能团兼容性和广泛的底物适用范围，为吡喃并香豆素类及吡喃类衍生物的制备提供了一条便捷可靠的合成路径。所获得的产物分子同时包含吲哚和吡喃香豆素或吡喃酮等重要药效团，在药物化学和天然产物合成领域具有潜在的应用价值。该策略操作简便、效率高，为后续生物活性分子的设计与结构优化奠定了方法学基础。
title: Organocatalytic formal [3 + 3] cyclization of α-(6-indolyl) propargylic alcohols

abstract: We present an experimental study of turbulent Rayleigh-Bénard convection with polymer additives made in two convection cells, one with a smooth top and bottom plates and the other with a rough top and bottom plates. For the cell with smooth plates, a reduction of the measured Nusselt number (Nu) was observed. Furthermore, the amount of Nu reduction increases with increasing polymer concentration (c), reaching ~12% for c = 120 ppm and an apparent leveling off thereafter. For the cell with rough plates, however, an enhancement (~4%) of Nu was observed when the polymer concentration is greater than 120 ppm. This increase in Nu is corroborated by an increased large-scale circulation (LSC) velocity in the same cell when polymers are added. In contrast, the LSC velocity in the smooth cell is found to be essentially the same with and without polymers. It is further found that in the smooth cell the rms values of the global Nu, σ(Nu), and that of the local temperature, σ(T), both exhibit similar dependence on c as Nu itself. In contrast, σ(Nu) and σ(T) in the rough cell are found to be essentially independent of c.
title: Enhanced and reduced heat transport in turbulent thermal convection with polymer additives

abstract: Problem definition: We consider capacity sharing through demand allocation among firms with multiple demand sources and multiple service facilities. Firms decide on the allocation of demand from different sources to different facilities to minimize delay costs and service-fulfillment costs possibly subject to service-level requirements. If firms decide to operate collectively as a coalition, they must also decide on a scheme for sharing the total cost. Academic/practical relevance: We study capacity sharing through demand allocation in service systems in the presence of service-fulfillment costs. Our problem is motivated by service collaboration in healthcare involving public–private partnerships. Methodology: We formulate the problem as a cooperative game and identify a cost allocation that is in the core. Results: The cost-allocation scheme we identify is price-directed, and the cost of each firm consists of three components: (1) the delay cost incurred within the firm; (2) a cost paid for the capacity used by the firm at facilities owned by other firms; and (3) a payment received for fulfilling demand of other firms at facilities owned by the firm. Interestingly, we show that the cost-allocation scheme is equivalent to a market equilibrium—that is, it can be implemented in a decentralized fashion. We extend our analysis to settings where the capacity of each facility is endogenously determined and to settings where a service-priority policy is deployed. Our results are robust to a variety of generalizations: partial sharing, partial transfer, facilities modeled as general queueing systems, and convex delay costs. Managerial implications: Our findings provide guidelines for and insights into how to carry out demand allocation and cost sharing among different firms in the presence of service-fulfillment costs to foster service collaboration. In particular, the equilibrium market prices can be viewed as the prices/subsidies for service collaboration in a public–private partnership.
title: Price-Directed Cost Sharing and Demand Allocation Among Service Providers with Multiple Demand Sources and Multiple Facilities

abstract: An array of simple programmable processors is implemented in 0.18 mum CMOS and contains 36 asynchronously clocked independent processors. Each processor occupies 0.66 and is fully functional at a clock rate of 520-540 MHz at 1.8 V and over 600 MHz at 2.0 V. Processors dissipate an average of 32 mW under typical conditions at 1.8 V and 475 MHz, and 2.4 mW at 0.9 V and 116 MHz while executing applications such as a JPEG encoder core and a fully compliant IEEE 802.11 a/g wireless LAN baseband transmitter.
summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种基于 0.18 微米 CMOS 工艺实现的简单可编程处理器阵列。该阵列集成了 36 个独立处理器，采用异步时钟工作方式。每个处理器核心面积仅为 0.66 平方毫米，在 1.8 V 供电电压下可实现 520 至 540 MHz 的时钟频率，当电压提升至 2.0 V 时，工作频率可超过 600 MHz。功耗方面，在典型工作条件（1.8 V，475 MHz）下，处理器平均功耗为 32 毫瓦；而在低电压模式（0.9 V，116 MHz）下，功耗可降至 2.4 毫瓦。该处理器阵列已成功应用于 JPEG 编码器核心及完全符合 IEEE 802.11 a/g 标准的无线局域网基带发射器等实际场景，验证了其在不同计算负载下的功能完整性与能效特性。
title: AsAP: An Asynchronous Array of Simple Processors

abstract: A simple chemodosimeter array has been successfully achieved for the detection and discrimination of different palladium species by using principal component analysis.
summary_zh: 本研究成功构建了一种简易的化学计量传感器阵列，结合主成分分析技术，实现了对不同形态钯物种的检测与区分。该阵列基于多种化学响应性探针，各探针对不同钯物种（如Pd(0)、Pd(II)及不同配位环境下的钯配合物）表现出差异化的光学信号变化。通过采集阵列与多种钯物种反应后的光谱响应数据，并运用主成分分析进行降维与模式识别，实现了对不同钯物种的高效鉴别。实验结果表明，该方法不仅能够灵敏检测低浓度的钯物种，还能清晰区分氧化态、配位结构各异的钯化合物，展现出良好的选择性与抗干扰能力。该策略无需复杂仪器或繁琐操作，为环境监测、工业催化及药物合成等领域中钯物种的快速现场分析提供了一种简便、低成本且高效的新途径。
title: Utilizing modified flavonoids to construct a chemodosimeter array for discrimination of different palladium species by using principal component analysis

abstract: This paper presents a model predictive voltage control (MPVC) method for the single-inductor multiple-output (SIMO) dc-dc converter. The proposed MPVC method is able to solve the cross-regulation problem, which is a critical issue in SIMO dc-dc converters. The design of the proposed method including augmented state-space model, cost function, enumerated algorithm, and constraints for the SIMO dc-dc converter is discussed. Simulation for the influences of predict horizon N <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">P</sub> , control horizon N <sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">C</sub> , and Lagrange multiplier λ on the voltage ripple is conducted to guide the control parameters' setting for hardware implementation. Steady-state operation and dynamic performance of the proposed MPVC method are conducted in simulation and experiment based on the single-inductor dual-output (SIDO) buck converter to verify the proposed MPVC method. In addition, the comparison between the proposed method and state-of-art methods for the SIMO dc-dc converters is presented. Simulation and experimental results demonstrate that the MPVC method guarantees low cross regulation for the SIMO dc-dc converter in continuous-conduction mode (CCM) and has a fast response speed to variations in load and reference.
title: Model Predictive Voltage Control for Single-Inductor Multiple-Output DC–DC Converter With Reduced Cross Regulation

summary_zh: 本研究从原子尺度探究了钇铁石榴石与坡莫合金双层膜体系中反铁磁耦合的结构与电子起源。针对经表面离子研磨处理的样品，铁磁共振谱探测到独特的混合模式，表明YIG/Py界面存在反铁磁交换耦合。利用原子分辨扫描透射电子显微镜，我们发现反铁磁耦合出现在离子研磨形成的四面体YIG表面与Py的界面处。STEM测量表明，界面反铁磁耦合主要由氧介导的超交换耦合机制驱动，密度泛函理论计算进一步证实该机制在能量上更为有利。综合实验与理论结果揭示了界面原子结构对YIG/铁磁体异质结中磁耦合类型的关键调控作用，并证明可通过表面离子研磨实验手段调控界面结构。
title: Unraveling the origin of antiferromagnetic coupling at YIG/permalloy interface

summary_zh: NuA4/TIP60乙酰转移酶复合物在基因调节、DNA修复及细胞周期进程中发挥关键作用，但此前由于结构信息匮乏，限制了对其组装方式与调控机制的深入理解。本研究利用冷冻电子显微镜技术，分别解析了分辨率为4.7 Å的NuA4/TIP60 TEEAA组装体（包含Tra1、Eaf1、Eaf5、actin和Arp4）以及分辨率为7.6 Å的TEEAA-piccolo组装体（包含Esa1、Epl1、Yng2和Eaf6）的结构。研究发现，Tra1与Eaf1构成了该复合物的组装支架，其中Eaf1的SANT结构域通过离子相互作用与Tra1的LBE及FATC结构域紧密结合，而actin/Arp4则外围结合于Eaf1的HSA结构域。此外，Eaf5/7/3（TINTIN）模块与piccolo模块主要通过与Tra1的FAT及HEAT重复序列结合进行堆叠，且两者的结合分别依赖于Eaf1的N端及HSA区域。这些结构解析详尽阐明了NuA4各亚基之间的空间架构与分子相互作用，为理解Tra1假激酶的支架功能及其调控机制提供了重要的结构生物学依据。
title: Architecture of the Saccharomyces cerevisiae NuA4/TIP60 complex

summary_zh: 后门攻击旨在向深度神经网络中植入隐藏后门，使得受攻击模型在良性样本上表现正常，但当攻击者指定的触发器激活隐藏后门时，其预测结果会被恶意篡改。此类威胁可在训练过程未受完全控制的场景下发生，例如使用第三方数据集训练或直接采用第三方模型，构成一种现实且新型的安全风险。尽管后门学习已成为一个新兴且快速发展的研究方向，但迄今仍缺乏系统性的综述。本文首次对该领域进行了全面调研，依据攻击与防御的特性对现有方法进行归纳与分类，并提出了一个统一框架用于分析基于数据投毒的后门攻击。此外，文章还探讨了后门攻击与相关领域（即对抗攻击和数据投毒）之间的关联，并总结了广泛采用的基准数据集。最后，基于已有工作简要展望了若干未来研究方向。相关后门学习资源的整理列表可通过指定链接获取。
title: Backdoor Learning: A Survey

summary_zh: 尽管多项全基因组关联研究（GWAS）已发现与结核病（TB）易感性相关的单核苷酸多态性（SNPs），但由于遗传异质性的存在，许多位点在不同族群间难以重复验证。本研究旨在通过验证并评估先前GWAS发现的潜在结核病易感位点（包括18q染色体、ASAP1、DUSP14及HLA-DQA1）的机制，探究遗传异质性的成因。研究采用了一个包含1200名结核病患者和1280名健康对照者的中国人群队列进行基因分型。结果表明，结核病的遗传易感性可能具有年龄特异性。虽然在全样本分析中未发现显著关联，但在发病年龄为20至40岁的青年发病亚组中，HLA-DQA1基因座的SNP位点rs9272785显示出提示性的关联性。该研究结果支持了结核病在不同年龄组中具有不同发病机制的假设，并表明遗传因素可能主要在青年发病型结核病中发挥重要作用。
title: Genetic susceptibility to Tuberculosis: Interaction between HLA-DQA1 and age of onset

abstract: Wave motion over a submerged porous plate is studied by the boundary‐element method based on the linear potential wave theory. The boundary condition at the porous plate is formulated under the assumption that the flow within the porous medium is governed by Darcy's law. The characteristics of variation of the reflection, the transmission, the loss of energy and the force versus the plate length, the water depth, the incident wavelength, the depth of submergence, and the porosity of the plate are discussed. It is shown that the reflection and transmission coefficients vary periodically as the relative length of the plate to the incident wavelength increases. Moderately large values of the porosity of the plate are found to produce the maximum dissipation of the incident wave energy. It is also demonstrated that a plate with proper porosity can significantly suppress the reflection and reduce the wave force acting on it while the transmission can be kept at a low level.
summary_zh: 基于线性势波理论，采用边界元方法研究了波浪在淹没多孔板上的传播特性。多孔板边界条件依据达西定律描述介质内部流动。分析了反射系数、透射系数、能量耗散及波浪力随板长、水深、入射波长、淹没深度和孔隙率的变化规律。结果表明，反射与透射系数随板相对入射波长的增大呈周期性变化；中等偏大的孔隙率可实现入射波能的最大耗散。适当孔隙率的多孔板能显著抑制反射并减小其所受波浪力，同时保持较低的透射水平。该研究可为多孔结构在海岸与海洋工程中的消浪设计提供理论参考。
title: Water Waves above Submerged Porous Plate

abstract: Many conventional computer vision object tracking methods are sensitive to partial occlusion and background clutter. This is because the partial occlusion or little background information may exist in the bounding box, which tends to cause the drift. To this end, in this paper, we propose a robust tracker based on key patch sparse representation (KPSR) to reduce the disturbance of partial occlusion or unavoidable background information. Specifically, KPSR first uses patch sparse representations to get the patch score of each patch. Second, KPSR proposes a selection criterion of key patch to judge the patches within the bounding box and select the key patch according to its location and occlusion case. Third, KPSR designs the corresponding contribution factor for the sampled patches to emphasize the contribution of the selected key patches. Comparing the KPSR with eight other contemporary tracking methods on 13 benchmark video data sets, the experimental results show that the KPSR tracker outperforms classical or state-of-the-art tracking methods in the presence of partial occlusion, background clutter, and illumination change.
summary_zh: 针对传统目标跟踪方法在局部遮挡和背景干扰下易发生漂移的问题，本文提出一种基于关键块稀疏表示的鲁棒跟踪算法。该方法首先利用块稀疏表示计算每个图像块的得分，然后设计关键块选择准则，根据块的位置和遮挡情况从边界框中筛选出关键块，最后为采样块分配相应的贡献因子以强化关键块的作用。在13个基准视频数据集上与8种主流跟踪方法进行对比实验，结果表明该算法在局部遮挡、背景杂乱和光照变化等复杂场景下均优于经典及当前最优方法，展现出更强的鲁棒性和准确性。
title: Robust Object Tracking via Key Patch Sparse Representation

abstract: Abstract The sudden loss of energetic protons in the inner radiation belt has been observed during geomagnetic storms. It is hypothesized that this sudden loss occurs because of changes in the geomagnetic field configuration which lead to a breakdown of the first adiabatic invariant, μ , in a process called magnetic field line curvature scattering or μ scattering. Comparison of observations to various analytic model predictions for μ scattering induced loss has, however, yielded discrepancies. To better understand how well the analytic models predict the proton loss, test particle simulations are carried out for various magnetic field configurations. Although our simulation results agree well with the analytic models for single μ ‐scattering events, the results after cumulative μ scattering can show significant disagreement with the theoretical predictions based on analytic models. In particular, we find the assumption that protons with predicted initial δμ / μ > 0.01 or ε > 0.1 are ultimately lost overestimates the proton loss. Based on the test particle simulation results, we develop a new empirical model, called the “ ε ‐onset” model, to predict the minimum value of ε at which all protons of a given pitch angle and energy can be assumed to be lost due to μ scattering. By applying our ε ‐onset model as the variable cutoff condition between trapping and detrapping, we obtain very good agreement between theoretical predictions and the simulation results for a range of Kp , suggesting that the ε ‐onset model can potentially serve as an easy‐to‐use and more reliable predictor of inner belt proton loss due to μ scattering than the previously used fixed‐valued cutoff conditions.
title: Modeling the loss of inner belt protons by magnetic field line curvature scattering
venue: Journal of Geophysical Research: Space Physics

summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于锌有机框架（Zn@MOF）的聚集诱导发光活性纳米酶，用于促进脊髓损伤后的功能恢复。研究通过生物正交反应将聚集诱导发光分子2-(4-叠氮丁基)-6-(苯基(4-(1,2,2-三苯基乙烯基)苯基)氨基)-1H-菲烯-1,3-二酮修饰到多功能Zn@MOF上，制得Zn@MOF-TPD纳米酶。该纳米酶可在脊髓损伤部位逐步释放没食子酸和锌离子。没食子酸作为活性氧清除剂，能够增强抗氧化能力、减轻炎症反应，重建活性氧生成与抗氧化防御系统之间的平衡；锌离子则通过抑制基质金属蛋白酶9的活性，经活性氧介导的NF-κB通路促进继发性损伤后神经元的再生。此外，Zn@MOF-TPD还能保护神经元和髓鞘免受创伤，抑制胶质瘢痕形成，促进神经干细胞的增殖与分化，从而修复受损神经元和脊髓组织，加速挫伤型脊髓损伤大鼠的运动功能恢复。该研究表明，Zn@MOF-TPD纳米酶在缓解氧化应激介导的病理生理损伤及促进脊髓损伤后运动恢复方面具有应用潜力。
title: Engineered Multifunctional Zinc–Organic Framework-Based Aggregation-Induced Emission Nanozyme for Accelerating Spinal Cord Injury Recovery

abstract: While sp2-hybridized carbon atoms in hydrocarbons typically contribute only one electron to their aromaticity, metals have more electrons from d or f orbitals available for participating in conjugation in organometallics, complicating the electron counting as well as analysis of their aromaticity. Here, the author comments on the challenges towards understanding aromaticity in organometallics and outlines several remaining questions that have yet to be answered.
summary_zh: 有机金属化合物中的芳香性研究面临独特挑战。在传统碳氢化合物中，sp²杂化碳原子通常仅贡献一个电子参与芳香共轭体系，而金属中心拥有丰富的d轨道或f轨道电子，这些电子均可参与共轭，使得电子计数和芳香性分析变得极为复杂。本文系统评述了有机金属芳香性研究中的核心难题，重点讨论了金属d轨道和f轨道电子参与共轭对传统芳香性判据的冲击，包括休克尔规则在金属有机体系中的适用性局限、电子离域模式的多样性以及磁性与结构判据之间的不一致性。作者指出，当前领域仍存在若干悬而未决的关键问题：如何建立适用于金属有机体系的统一芳香性量化标准，如何准确界定金属电子对共轭体系的贡献方式，以及如何理解金属-配体协同作用对芳香稳定化的影响机制。这些问题的解决对于深入理解金属有机配合物的电子结构、反应活性及其在催化、材料科学等领域的应用具有重要意义。
title: Open questions on aromaticity in organometallics

abstract: AT-rBAT exists as a dimer of heterodimer consistent with the previous study. A ligand molecule is bound to the substrate binding pocket, near which an occluded pocket is identified, to which we found that it is important for substrate transport.
summary_zh: 本研究揭示了AT-rBAT转运蛋白以异源二聚体的二聚体形式存在，这与先前的研究结果一致。在底物结合口袋附近，我们观察到一个配体分子与之结合，并鉴定出一个此前未被发现的封闭口袋。进一步研究发现，该封闭口袋对底物转运过程具有重要作用。这一发现为理解AT-rBAT介导的氨基酸转运机制提供了新的结构基础，有助于阐明相关转运蛋白的工作机理及其在生理和病理条件下的功能调控。
title: Cryo-EM structure of the human heteromeric amino acid transporter b 0,+ AT-rBAT

summary_zh: 拟南芥中SAID1/2蛋白作为miRNA生物发生负调控因子的作用机制被揭示。SAID1/2属于固有无序蛋白，此前被推测为牙本质涎磷蛋白样蛋白，但其真实功能未知。本研究发现SAID1/2是miRNA加工复合体核心因子SERRATE/ARS2的负调控因子。said1;said2双突变体表现出多效发育缺陷，数千个差异表达基因与se突变体部分重叠，同时伴随微处理器组装增强和miRNA积累升高。机制上，SAID1/2通过促进PRP4KA激酶介导的SE磷酸化，导致SE蛋白在体内降解。此外，SAID1/2对发夹结构pri-miRNA具有强结合亲和力，可将其与SE隔离，并在体外直接抑制微处理器对pri-miRNA的加工。SAID1/2不影响SE的亚细胞区室化分布，但自身能在SE上成核形成液-液相凝聚。综上，本研究提出SAID1/2通过劫持pri-miRNA以阻止微处理器活性，同时促进SE磷酸化并降低其稳定性，从而减少miRNA生成。该发现为理解植物miRNA生物发生的精细调控提供了新机制。
title: Intrinsically disordered proteins SAID1/2 condensate on SERRATE/ARS2 for dual inhibitions of miRNA biogenesis in Arabidopsis

abstract: An ultra-thin molecularly imprinted polymers (MIPs) membrane was synthesized<italic>via</italic>a surface-imprinting technique using layered double hydroxides (LDH) as the template substrate and applied for the selective preconcentration of RhB in wastewater.
summary_zh: 本文采用表面印迹技术，以层状双氢氧化物（LDH）作为模板基底，成功合成了一种超薄分子印迹聚合物（MIPs）薄膜。该研究旨在开发一种高效的选择性分离材料，并将该薄膜应用于废水中罗丹明B（RhB）的选择性预富集。通过利用LDH的层状结构与表面印迹技术的结合，该薄膜能够实现对目标分子的精准识别与高效捕获，为废水处理中的有机染料检测与净化提供了新的技术手段。
title: Template-synthesized ultra-thin molecularly imprinted polymers membrane for the selective preconcentration of dyes

abstract: A circularly polarized (CP) antenna based on metasurface with simple structure is proposed for 5G millimeter-wave (mmw) applications. This antenna mainly consists of three layers. Square patches with periodic rhombus grooves are placed on the top of the first layer. A pair of substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) feeding networks are orthogonally arranged in the second layer and third layer, respectively. Simulated experiments demonstrate that an overlapped frequency bandwidth of 5.4% (27.1-28.6 GHz) as well as a 3-dB axial ratio (AR) bandwidth of 7.9% (26.8-29 GHz) can be achieved in dual circularly polarized directions.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种面向5G毫米波应用的结构简单、基于超表面的圆极化天线。该天线主要由三层结构组成：顶层为带有周期性菱形槽的方形贴片，构成超表面辐射结构；第二层和第三层分别正交布置一对基片集成波导馈电网络，以实现双圆极化工作。仿真实验结果表明，该天线在双圆极化方向上可获得5.4%（27.1–28.6 GHz）的重叠阻抗带宽，以及7.9%（26.8–29 GHz）的3 dB轴比带宽，展现出良好的宽带圆极化性能。该设计适用于5G毫米波通信系统中对极化分集和紧凑结构有需求的场景。
title: A Metasurface Antenna with Dual Circularly Polarization for 5G Millimeter-Wave Applications
venue: 2020 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT)

abstract: Abstract Aqueous copper-based batteries have many favourable properties and have thus attracted considerable attention, but their application is limited by their low operating voltage originating from the high potential of copper negative electrode (0.34 V vs. standard hydrogen electrode). Herein, we propose a coordination strategy for reducing the intrinsic negative electrode redox potential in aqueous copper-based batteries and thus improving their operating voltage. This is achieved by establishing an appropriate coordination environment through the electrolyte tailoring via Cl − ions. When coordinated with chlorine, the intermediate Cu + ions in aqueous electrolytes are successfully stabilized and the electrochemical process is decoupled into two separate redox reactions involving Cu 2+ /Cu + and Cu + /Cu 0 ; Cu + /Cu 0 results in a redox potential approximately 0.3 V lower than that for Cu 2+ /Cu 0 . Compared to the coordination with water, the coordination with chlorine also results in higher copper utilization, more rapid redox kinetics, and superior cycle stability. An aqueous copper-chlorine battery, harnessing Cl − /Cl 0 redox reaction at the positive electrode, is discovered to have a high discharge voltage of 1.3 V, and retains 77.4% of initial capacity after 10,000 cycles. This work may open up an avenue to boosting the voltage and energy of aqueous copper batteries.
title: Manipulating coordination environment for a high-voltage aqueous copper-chlorine battery

summary_zh: 利用卫星观测甲醛（HCHO）柱浓度来定量异戊二烯排放存在显著误差，这些误差主要源于柱浓度反演过程以及HCHO与异戊二烯排放之间假设关系的准确性。本研究利用GOME卫星1996至2001年间的HCHO柱浓度数据集，系统评估了反演误差，并结合原位通量观测及MEGAN过程模型对GOME推算的异戊二烯排放进行了验证，同时探讨了北美异戊二烯排放季节性与年际变化的影响因素。研究发现，GOME的HCHO柱浓度反演误差约为40%。通过主化学机制（MCM）模型定量分析表明，虽然α-蒎烯、β-蒎烯和甲基丁烯醇也会产生HCHO，但仅异戊二烯的排放能被GOME有效探测；此外，MCM计算的异戊二烯氧化产生HCHO的随时间变化的产率比GEOS-CHEM模型高出20%至30%。在验证方面，GOME推算的异戊二烯通量能够追踪密歇根森林观测站的原位季节变化趋势，但存在-30%的偏差。在北美尺度上，GOME推算的2001年异戊二烯排放季节变化与MEGAN模型相似，但在生长季初期和末期分别表现出25%的高估或低估。研究进一步表明，MEGAN模型中异戊二烯排放对地表气温的依赖性，可以解释1996至2001年间5月至9月美国东南部地区GOME推算排放量75%的月度变化。
title: Quantifying the seasonal and interannual variability of North American isoprene emissions using satellite observations of the formaldehyde column

abstract: With the explosive growth of blockchain platforms and applications, security threats of blockchain also occur frequently. As a decentralized application deployed on the blockchain, smart contracts help the blockchain realize safe and efficient information storage, asset management, and value transfer. Therefore, smart contracts play a vital role in the security of the blockchain. In recent years, security threats against smart contracts have increased, not only causing huge economic losses but also impacting the credit system of the blockchain. Therefore, many researchers have carried out corresponding research on the security threats of smart contracts. Common threat detection methods include formal verification, symbolic execution, fuzzing, etc. Most of these methods are only for known threats, while there is not much work on detecting unknown threats. In order to better deal with unknown threats, we present a review of the typical smart contract security events in recent years, analyze the security threats from contract coding, Ethereum virtual machine, and blockchain characteristics. Further, we compare and summarize the latest unknown threat detection methods. Then, to address the problem that very few unknown threat samples are available, a detection method based on a few-shot learning is proposed.
title: Unknown Threats Detection Methods of Smart Contracts

summary_zh: 针对人为污染物对全球水安全及人体健康构成的威胁，本文开发了一种新型氧化还原活性磁性复合材料，旨在实现对水中无机及有机阴离子的定向去除。研究通过四步法合成了Fe3O4@SiO2@PPy@P(VFc-co-HEMA)复合材料，利用聚合物氧化还原活性单元——乙烯基二茂铁（VFc）与吡咯（Py）构建功能层，并通过引入2-羟乙基甲基丙烯酸酯（HEMA）单体优化了材料表面的亲水性。实验结果表明，该材料能够有效分离致癌性的六价铬氧阴离子及其他带电微污染物。通过将二茂铁基团氧化为二茂铁阳离子，材料的吸附容量可提升两倍以上；针对马来酸、萘普生、2,4-D及十二烷基苯磺酸的吸附量分别达到23、49、66和95 mg/g，且对1 ppm浓度的铬表现出超过99%的提取率。这种将氧化还原活性组分集成于磁性颗粒骨架的设计，显著提升了材料的操作灵活性与相接触效率，为水处理及产品纯化领域提供了一种极具潜力的新型水相分离技术框架。
title: Redox-Active Magnetic Composites for Anionic Contaminant Removal from Water

summary_zh: 针对重金属污染水处理领域中寻找廉价且环保的阴离子重金属去除材料这一挑战，本研究开发了一种新型聚烯丙基三甲基铵接枝壳聚糖与生物炭复合材料（PATMAC-CTS-BC），用于高效去除水中的硒酸根离子（SeO42-）。实验结果表明，该复合材料表现出极快的吸附动力学性能，在10分钟内对硒酸根的去除率即可超过97%，且吸附过程符合准二级动力学模型。基于Langmuir模型分析，该材料的硒酸根最大吸附容量达到98.99 mg·g-1，显著优于目前已报道的大多数吸附剂。热力学研究证实，该吸附过程为自发放热反应。得益于季铵基团（=N+）提供的永久正电荷，该复合材料在pH 2至10的宽范围内均能保持高去除效率。其去除机制主要归因于与季铵基团及质子化氨基（-NH3+）之间的静电相互作用，以及与氨基（-NH2）、亚氨基（-NH-）和羟基（-OH）之间的氧化还原络合作用。此外，通过对重铬酸根（Cr2O72-）的去除实验进一步验证了该阳离子水凝胶-生物炭复合材料对阴离子重金属的广泛去除能力。本研究为利用此类新型材料高效处理水体中的阴离子重金属污染提供了新思路。
title: Efficient removal of selenate in water by cationic poly(allyltrimethylammonium) grafted chitosan and biochar composite

abstract: In recent years, machine learning (ML) models, especially deep learning models, have become commodities. In this context, data centers which hold a lot of data often buy ML models from ML model providers, train them on their data locally and use the trained models to provide intelligent services. Existing work has shown that there is a risk of data leakage, which could cause incalculable consequences. Even under the black-box condition, there are still some attacks that can steal the private data held by data centers, and the capacity abuse attack (CAA) is the state-of-the-art attack method. CAA attackers steal the training data by labeling malicious samples with the data to be stolen. However, the label encodings are usually mapped into other output forms, such as categories, and it is impossible for the adversary to know the mapping relationship between the form output by the trained model and the label encodings. Without the mapping relationship, CAA becomes invalid. Aiming at the limitation of CAA, this study proposes a novel practical attack method, i.e., capacity abuse attack II (CAAII), which can find the mapping relationship between the output in the arbitrary form returned by the trained model and the values of the stolen data. Experiments are conducted on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR10 datasets, and experimental results show that no matter what forms are returned by the model, our attack method can always find the mapping relationship and successfully steals the training data.
title: Capacity Abuse Attack of Deep Learning Models Without Need of Label Encodings

abstract: We report a passively mode-locked fiber oscillator based on thulium-doped large-mode-area (LMA) fiber. Reliably mode-locking soliton operation can be readily achieved after the suppression of the higher-order modes by using mode field adapters in combination with coiling fiber method. The laser delivers 600-fs level pulses at 2 μm with an average power of up to 243 mW and a repetition rate of ~53.7 MHz. The output corresponds to a maximum pulse energy of 4.5 nJ, >5 times larger than that of a similar homemade mode-locked Tm laser with the LMA fibers replaced by single mode fibers, coinciding with theoretical prediction. The successful demonstration of our soliton mode-locked LMA fiber laser at 2 μm offers another strategy for high performance ultrafast fiber sources at midinfrared region.
summary_zh: 本文报道了一种基于掺铥大模场面积光纤的被动锁模光纤振荡器。通过采用模场适配器并结合光纤盘绕方法有效抑制高阶模后，可稳定实现孤子锁模运转。该激光器在2 μm波段输出脉宽约600飞秒的脉冲，平均功率最高达243 mW，重复频率约为53.7 MHz，对应的最大单脉冲能量为4.5 nJ，较采用单模光纤的同类自制锁模铥激光器提升逾5倍，与理论预期一致。这一2 μm孤子锁模大模场光纤激光器的成功演示，为中红外波段高性能超快光纤光源提供了新的技术途径。
title: Mode-Locked Large-Mode-Area Tm-Doped Fiber Oscillator
