This model is built upon a foundation of data that incorporates cell-free synthesis, isotope sensitive spectroscopies, and the selective use of synthetic complexes substituting for intermediates in the enzymatic "assembly line". We discuss controversies pertaining to this model and some remaining open issues to be addressed by future work.
summary_zh: 本文围绕一氧化碳脱氢酶/乙酰辅酶A合酶（CODH/ACS）中负责催化乙酰辅酶A合成的A簇活性位点，提出了一种新的结构功能模型。该模型基于无细胞合成、同位素敏感光谱技术以及选择性使用合成配合物替代酶促“装配线”中间体的实验数据构建而成。文章还讨论了与该模型相关的争议，并指出了未来研究需要解决的一些悬而未决的问题。
title: Proposed Mechanism for the Biosynthesis of the [FeFe] Hydrogenase H-Cluster: Central Roles for the Radical SAM Enzymes HydG and HydE

abstract: Although multi-scale feature learning can improve the performances of deep models, its parallel structure quadratically increases the model parameters and causes deep models to become larger and larger when enlarging the receptive fields (RFs). This leads to deep models easily suffering from over-fitting issue in many practical applications where the available training samples are always insufficient or limited. In addition, under this limited situation, although lightweight models (with fewer model parameters) can effectively reduce over-fitting, they may suffer from under-fitting because of insufficient training data for effective feature learning. In this work, a lightweight model called Sequential Multi-scale Feature Learning Network (SMF-Net) is proposed to alleviate these two issues simultaneously using a novel sequential structure of multi-scale feature learning. Compared to both deep and lightweight models, the proposed sequential structure in SMF-Net can easily extract features with larger RFs for multi-scale feature learning only with a few and linearly increased model parameters. The experimental results on both classification and segmentation tasks demonstrate that our SMF-Net only has 1.25M model parameters (5.3% of Res2Net50) with 0.7G FLOPS (14.6% of Res2Net50) for classification and 1.54M parameters (8.9% of UNet) with 3.35G FLOPs (10.9% of UNet) for segmentation but achieves higher accuracy than SOTA deep models and lightweight models, even when the training data is very limited available.
title: A novel sequential structure for lightweight multi-scale feature learning under limited available images

abstract: Intelligent defect detection technology combined with deep learning has gained widespread attention in recent years. However, the small number, and diverse and random nature, of defects on industrial surfaces pose a significant challenge to deep learning-based methods. Generating defect images can effectively solve this problem. This paper investigates and summarises traditional defect generation and deep learning-based methods. It analyses the various advantages and disadvantages of these methods and establishes a benchmark through classical adversarial networks and diffusion models. The performance of these methods in generating defect images is analysed through various indices. This paper discusses the existing methods, highlights the shortcomings and challenges in the field of defect image generation, and proposes future research directions. Finally, the paper concludes with a summary.
summary_zh: 近年来，结合深度学习的智能缺陷检测技术受到广泛关注，但工业表面缺陷样本数量少、形态多样且随机性强，给基于深度学习的方法带来严峻挑战。通过生成缺陷图像可有效缓解这一问题。本文对传统缺陷生成方法与基于深度学习的方法进行了系统调研与总结，分析了各类方法的优缺点，并基于经典对抗网络和扩散模型构建了基准评测框架。通过多项指标分析这些方法在缺陷图像生成中的表现，探讨了现有方法的不足与领域面临的挑战，并提出了未来研究方向。
title: An Overview of Image Generation of Industrial Surface Defects

abstract: Controlling the dimensions in the nanometer scale of olivine-type LiFePO4 has been regarded as one of the most effective strategies to improve its electrochemical performance for Li-ion batteries. In this communication, we demonstrate a novel LiFePO4 nanoarchitecture, which is composed of self-assembled single-crystalline nanowires and exhibits good rate capability with a reversible capacity of ∼110 mA h g(-1) at a current rate of 30 C, and a stable capacity retention of ∼86% after 1000 cycles at a current rate of 10 C.
summary_zh: 通过调控橄榄石型磷酸铁锂（LiFePO₄）的纳米尺度维度，是提升其锂离子电池电化学性能的最有效策略之一。本文提出一种新型LiFePO₄纳米结构，该结构由自组装单晶纳米线构成，展现出优异的倍率性能：在30 C电流倍率下可逆容量约为110 mAh g⁻¹，并在10 C倍率下循环1000次后仍能保持约86%的稳定容量。该纳米结构设计为高功率、长寿命锂离子电池正极材料的开发提供了新思路。
title: Self-assembled LiFePO 4 nanowires with high rate capability for Li-ion batteries

abstract: Summary All living organisms are unavoidably exposed to various endogenous and environmental stresses that trigger potentially fatal DNA damage, including double‐strand breaks (DSBs). Although a growing body of evidence indicates that DNA damage is one of the prime drivers of aging in animals, little is known regarding the importance of DNA damage and its repair on lifespan control in plants. We found that the level of DSBs increases but DNA repair efficiency decreases as Arabidopsis leaves age. Generation of DSBs by inducible expression of I ‐Ppo I leads to premature senescence phenotypes. We examined the senescence phenotypes in the loss‐of‐function mutants for 13 key components of the DNA repair pathway and found that deficiency in ATAXIA TELANGIECTASIA MUTATED (ATM), the chief transducer of the DSB signal, results in premature senescence in Arabidopsis . ATM represses DSB‐induced expression of senescence‐associated genes, including the genes encoding the WRKY and NAC transcription factors, central components of the leaf senescence process, via modulation of histone lysine methylation. Our work highlights the significance of ATM in the control of leaf senescence and has significant implications for the conservation of aging mechanisms in animals and plants.
title: ATM suppresses leaf senescence triggered by DNA double‐strand break through epigenetic control of senescence‐associated genes in Arabidopsis

abstract: The slow and inefficient deep Wyoming earthquake ruptured in the ductile regime of the upper mantle.
summary_zh: 怀俄明州深源地震的破裂过程表现出缓慢且低效的特征，这一现象发生在上地幔的韧性变形域内。本研究通过分析该深部地震的震源参数与破裂动力学，揭示了在高温高压条件下岩石破裂行为的独特性。传统地震学理论认为，地壳浅部的地震破裂通常以较高的速度和效率传播，而怀俄明深源地震的观测数据显示，其破裂速度显著低于预期，能量释放效率也明显偏弱。这种缓慢低效的破裂机制与上地幔物质的韧性流变特性密切相关，在韧性域中，岩石更倾向于发生塑性变形而非脆性断裂，导致断层滑动过程受到抑制。研究结果对于理解板块俯冲带深部地震的成因机制、上地幔的力学性质以及地球深部动力学过程具有重要科学意义，同时也为评估深源地震灾害风险和完善地震物理模型提供了新的约束条件。
title: Earthquake rupture below the brittle-ductile transition in continental lithospheric mantle

summary_zh: 含铜一氧化二氮还原酶（N2OR）是目前已知唯一能催化环境关键温室气体一氧化二氮（N2O）转化为二氮（N2）的酶，该反应是细菌反硝化过程的最后一步。除了其独特的四核活性中心CuZ外，双核电子入口位点CuA也存在于其他酶中，如细胞色素c氧化酶。在施氏假单胞菌N2OR的CuA位点中，一个组氨酸配体被发现会在底物N2O结合于两个铜中心之间时发生构象翻转。本研究基于已建立的大肠杆菌功能性表达体系，对该组氨酸及其周围氢键残基进行了系统诱变及光谱与结构表征。结果显示，在Asp576Ala变体中，仅靠Ser550提供的单一氢键就足以稳定His583的非结合构象；而在Asp576Ala/Ser550Ala双突变体中，进一步移除该氢键迫使His583以结合构象作为CuA的配体。将His583系统突变为Ala、Asp、Asn、Glu、Gln、Lys、Phe、Tyr和Trp后发现，尽管所有变体均保留CuZ和CuA位点，但只有携带可质子化侧链的变体（即His、Asp和Glu）能在生理pH条件下介导电子传递。这一发现与N2OR的CuA位点采取质子耦合电子转移机制的观点相符。
title: Histidine-Gated Proton-Coupled Electron Transfer to the CuA Site of Nitrous Oxide Reductase
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

abstract: In order to overcome the disadvantages of complexity and nonadaptability of the conventional Kalman filter (KF) in servo systems with maneuverability, a novel fuzzy-based adaptive gain filter (FAGF) is proposed in this article. First, based on the principle of KF, a third-order fixed gain filter model is established to realize the state observation of the permanent magnet synchronous motors servo system. Then, the influence of filter gain on the observation performance of a time-varying system is analyzed by deriving the covariance matrices of the observed states. On this basis, an adjustable gain is designed by fuzzy logic to replace the fixed gain of the conventional observer. The algorithm can adaptively balance the fast and smooth performance of the observer according to the maneuvering conditions of the system. Finally, the superiority of the proposed FAGF is verified by both simulations and experiments.
summary_zh: 针对传统卡尔曼滤波器在机动伺服系统中存在的复杂度高、适应性差等不足，本文提出一种基于模糊逻辑的自适应增益滤波器。首先，依据卡尔曼滤波原理，构建三阶固定增益滤波器模型，实现永磁同步电机伺服系统的状态观测。其次，通过推导观测状态的协方差矩阵，分析滤波器增益对时变系统观测性能的影响。在此基础上，采用模糊逻辑设计可调增益，替代传统观测器的固定增益。该算法能够根据系统机动工况，自适应地平衡观测器的快速性与平滑性。最后，仿真与实验结果均验证了所提模糊自适应增益滤波器的优越性。该方法适用于永磁同步电机伺服系统的状态估计与运动控制领域。
title: Design of a Fuzzy-based Adaptive Gain Filter for PMSM Servo Systems with Maneuverability

abstract: In this paper the realized niche of the Snowy Plover (Charadrius alexandrinus), a primarily resident Florida shorebird, is described as a function of the scenopoetic and bionomic variables at the nest-, landscape-, and regional-scale. We identified some pos- sible geomorphological controls that influence nest-site selection and survival using data collected along the Florida Gulf coast. In particular we focused on the effects of beach replenishment interventions on the Snowy Plover (SP), and on the migratory Piping Plover (PP) (Charadrius melodus) and Red Knot (RK) (Calidris canutus). To quantify the relationship between past renourishment projects and shorebird species we used a Monte Carlo procedure to sample from the posterior distribution of the binomial probabilities that a region is not a nesting or a wintering ground conditional on the occurrence of a beach replenishment intervention in the same and the previous year. The results indicate that it was 2.3, 3.1, and 0.8 times more likely that a region was not a wintering ground following a year with a renourishment intervention for the SP, PP and RK respectively. For the SP it was 2.5. times more likely that a region was not a breeding ground after a renourishment event. Through a maximum entropy principle model we observed small differences in the habitat use of the SP during the breeding and the wintering season. However the habitats where RK was observed ap- peared quite different. Maintaining and creating optimal suitable habitats for SP characterized by sparse low vegetation in the foredunes areas, and uneven/low-slope beach surfaces, is the proposed conservation scenario to convert anthropic beach restorations and SP populations into a positive feedback without impacting other threatened shorebird species.
title: Anthropogenic Renourishment Feedback on Shorebirds: a Multispecies Bayesian Perspective

summary_zh: 针对低资源语言在口语理解（SLU）任务中面临的训练数据匮乏问题，现有的数据增强方法虽能合成目标语言数据，但往往会引入噪声，进而限制模型的性能。本文旨在解决增强数据中的噪声问题，提出了一种新型的去噪训练方法。该方法通过利用多种数据增强技术生成数据，并训练多个模型，使这些模型之间能够相互提供监督信号，从而实现协同去噪。实验结果表明，该方法在两个基准数据集上的表现均优于现有最先进技术，性能分别提升了3.05%和4.24%。该研究为扩展低资源语言的口语理解能力提供了有效途径，相关代码也将开源。
title: Learning from Multiple Noisy Augmented Data Sets for Better Cross-Lingual Spoken Language Understanding
venue: Proceedings of the 2021 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing

abstract: Abstract We present normally‐off AlGaN/Gan power tunnel‐junction FETs (TJ‐FETs) with high breakdown voltage, low off‐state leakage current and low specific on‐resistance. The TJ‐FETs exhibit normally‐off operation in an otherwise normally‐on as‐grown sample owing to a current controlling scheme different from the conventional FETs. The high 2DEG density in AlGaN/GaN heterostructure results in a thin tunnel barrier whose effective thickness is controlled by an overlaying gate electrode. This tunnel junction is controlled by an overlapping gate and deliver highly efficient quantum tunnelling, enabling normally‐off operation. A positive gate bias results in a nanometer‐thick barrier with high tunnelling current, while a zero gate bias leads to a thicker barrier that effectively blocks the current flow. High tunnel current (326 mA/mm), low off‐state leakage (10 ‐8 mA/mm) and high off‐state breakdown voltage (557 V) are obtained on a standard GaN‐on‐Si platform featuring a 1.8 μm buffer. (© 2012 WILEY‐VCH Verlag GmbH & Co. KGaA, Weinheim)
summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于隧穿结结构的常关型AlGaN/GaN功率场效应晶体管（TJ-FET），实现了高击穿电压、低关态漏电与低比导通电阻。该器件在常规常开型外延材料上，通过不同于传统FET的电流控制机制实现常关工作。利用AlGaN/GaN异质结的高二维电子气密度形成薄隧穿势垒，其有效厚度由覆盖栅电极调控。栅极与隧穿结重叠，控制高效量子隧穿，从而实现常关特性：正栅压下势垒减薄至纳米级，产生高隧穿电流；零栅压下势垒增厚，有效阻断电流。在标准硅基GaN平台（缓冲层厚度1.8 μm）上，器件获得326 mA/mm的高隧穿电流、10⁻⁸ mA/mm的低关态漏电以及557 V的高关态击穿电压。该技术为功率电子器件提供了一种实现常关操作的新途径。
title: Normally‐off AlGaN/GaN power tunnel‐junction FETs

summary_zh: 随机块模型（SBM）是网络社区检测的经典基准模型，但其标签恢复所对应的理论优化问题具有NP难特性，导致许多现有统计方法难以应用于大规模网络。为此，本文提出一种分裂似然框架，并基于此设计了一种快速收敛的分裂似然算法，该算法在社区检测精度和计算效率方面均具有显著优势。针对含有枢纽节点或社区内节点度差异较大的网络，进一步开发了条件分裂似然算法作为变体。文中给出了所提算法的计算与统计性质，并通过大量数值实验及两项真实网络实证分析，验证了所提方法的优越性。
title: Efficient split likelihood‐based method for community detection of large‐scale networks

summary_zh: 本文提出一种非对称朗缪尔-布洛杰特（LB）成膜技术与无机亲水化处理相结合的方法，在聚萘二甲酸乙二醇酯、聚酰亚胺和聚二甲基硅氧烷等柔性基底上实现了高度取向的碳纳米管阵列。通过沉积50 nm二氧化硅进行亲水改性，不同基底的水接触角均显著降低；同时表征了表面粗糙度与柔性对器件性能的影响。在LB过程中调节表面压力，可将阵列中碳纳米管密度分别控制在每平方微米10–25根、25–35根或35–45根。以取向半导体性碳纳米管阵列为沟道、各向异性金属性碳纳米管网络为栅极和源漏电极，在聚酰亚胺基底上制备了全碳纳米管晶体管作为验证。该器件展现出92.9 mV/dec的亚阈值摆幅、15.32 cm²/V·s的载流子迁移率以及4.51×10²的开关电流比。更重要的是，在50 nm厚栅介质条件下，经3.66 mm曲率半径弯折1000次后，阈值电压和载流子迁移率的变化分别控制在16.62%和28.78%以内，表明该技术对柔性可拉伸电子器件具有良好应用前景。
title: Realizing Controllable Carbon Nanotube Arrays for Soft Devices by Asymmetric Langmuir–Blodgett and Hydrophilization Process

abstract: Abstract We study a disclosure game in which a sender privately knows how much information she possesses and can disclose verifiable information to persuade a receiver to provide a higher reward. The receiver may attribute any imprecise disclosure to the sender concealing unfavorable information. We show that the most unfavorable possibility contained in information possessed by the sender will be fully revealed to the receiver.
summary_zh: 本文研究了一种信息披露博弈模型。在该模型中，发送方私下掌握信息的具体量，并通过披露可验证的信息来试图说服接收方提供更高的奖励。然而，接收方可能会将任何模糊或不精确的信息披露解读为发送方在刻意隐瞒不利信息。研究结果表明，在发送方所掌握的信息范围内，其包含的最不利可能性将会被接收方完全识别并揭示。该研究深入探讨了信息不对称环境下，披露策略与接收方预期之间的互动机制。
title: Disclosure with unknown expertise

summary_zh: 本研究针对登革热这一蚊媒传染病在热带及亚热带地区的持续扩散，提出了一种融合城市内部人口流动空间交互信息的精细化登革热预测框架。当前登革热预测多在国家、区域或城市尺度开展，而街区等精细空间尺度的预测仍面临挑战。由于病毒传播与高度动态的人口流动密切相关，整合区域间人口移动的空间交互特征有望提升预测能力。该方法首先利用图嵌入技术Node2Vec，从城市内部区域间的人口流动网络中学习各区域的嵌入向量，这些向量作为“交互特征”能够反映区域间联系的强弱——交互越强的区域其嵌入向量越相似。随后，将交互特征与温度、降雨、人口等常用特征相结合，输入到支持向量机、LASSO回归和人工神经网络等监督学习模型中，构建精细尺度的登革热预测模型。以中国受登革热威胁最严重的亚热带城市广州为研究区，在街道尺度上对融合与未融合交互特征的预测模型性能进行了对比验证。结果表明，同时使用常用特征和交互特征的模型在预测精度上优于仅使用常用特征的模型。本研究证实，利用图嵌入技术整合人口流动的空间交互信息是有效的，能够显著提升城市内部精细尺度登革热预测的性能，为精准防控提供了新的技术手段。
title: Enhancing fine-grained intra-urban dengue forecasting by integrating spatial interactions of human movements between urban regions

abstract: Abstract Air flows from the atmosphere into an unconfined aquifer when the water table falls during pumping tests. Pumping test results in unconfined aquifers may be significantly affected by low‐permeability zones (LPZs) near the initial water table position, because they restrict the downward movement of air. A transient, three‐dimensional air–water two‐phase flow model is employed to investigate numerically the effects of local heterogeneity on pumping test results in unconfined aquifers. Two cases of local heterogeneities are considered herein: a LPZ around the pumping well and on one side of the pumping well. Results show that the drawdown with the LPZ is significantly greater than that of the homogeneous aquifer. The differences in drawdown are the most significant at intermediate times and gradually diminish at later times. The LPZ significantly reduces air flow from the atmosphere to the aquifer. The pore air velocity in the LPZ is very low. The air pressure at the observation point under the LPZ when air begins to enter is significantly lower than the air pressure of the homogeneous aquifer at the same point. After that, the air pressure increases quickly and then increases slowly. The time for the air pressure to reach the atmospheric pressure is significantly longer. Copyright © 2013 John Wiley & Sons, Ltd.
title: Air and water flows induced by pumping tests in unconfined aquifers with low‐permeability zones

abstract: Abstract Realizing long cycling stability under a high sulfur loading is an essential requirement for the practical use of lithium–sulfur (Li–S) batteries. Here, a lamellar aerogel composed of Ti 3 C 2 T x MXene/carbon nanotube (CNT) sandwiches is prepared by unidirectional freeze‐drying to boost the cycling stability of high sulfur loading batteries. The produced materials are denoted parallel‐aligned MXene/CNT (PA‐MXene/CNT) due to the unique parallel‐aligned structure. The lamellae of MXene/CNT/MXene sandwich form multiple physical barriers, coupled with chemical trapping and catalytic activity of MXenes, effectively suppressing lithium polysulfide (LiPS) shuttling under high sulfur loading, and more importantly, substantially improving the LiPS confinement ability of 3D hosts free of micro‐ and mesopores. The assembled Li–S battery delivers a high capacity of 712 mAh g −1 with a sulfur loading of 7 mg cm −2 , and a superior cycling stability with 0.025% capacity decay per cycle over 800 cycles at 0.5 C. Even with sulfur loading of 10 mg cm −2 , a high areal capacity of above 6 mAh cm −2 is obtained after 300 cycles. This work presents a typical example for the rational design of a high sulfur loading host, which is critical for the practical use of Li–S batteries
title: Lamellar MXene Composite Aerogels with Sandwiched Carbon Nanotubes Enable Stable Lithium-Sulfur Batteries with a High Sulfur Loading

abstract: Testing an adapted psychology of working theory (PWT) model (PWT; Duffy et al., 2016), this study examined how and when contextual constraints affect the ability of Chinese rural migrant workers () to attain decent work. Surveying a sample of 510 employed Chinese rural migrants at two time points, this study revealed that economic constraints and daily discrimination were indirectly related to attaining decent work through the mediating factors of work volition and psychological ownership over work. In addition, proactive personality moderated the relationships between daily discrimination and economic constraints and the two mediators. The results contribute to better understanding Chinese rural migrant workers' work experience, refining the PWT and enriching the literature on the underlying mechanisms and moderating factors associated with decent work attainment. The research results call for policy and social change to lessen economic constraints and discrimination at the macro level and organizational commitment to employee-oriented human resource management and counseling interventions to improve the quality of the work lives of rural migrant workers. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2024 APA, all rights reserved).
title: Attaining decent work among Chinese rural migrants: Exploring the roles of psychological ownership and proactive personality within the psychology of working theory.

summary_zh: 本研究通过系统综述与荟萃分析，量化每日少量吸烟（1至5支）与冠心病及卒中发病风险的关系。检索Medline 1946年至2015年5月的文献并辅以手工检索，纳入至少报告50起事件且提供与从不吸烟者相比的风险比或相对风险的前瞻性队列研究。采用回归模型估计每日吸烟1支、5支和20支的相对风险，并以每日吸烟20支的超额相对风险为参照，计算每日1支烟的超额风险占比。荟萃分析共纳入55篇文献中的141项队列研究。结果显示，男性每日吸1支烟与20支烟的冠心病合并相对风险分别为1.48和2.04，经多因素调整后分别为1.74和2.27；女性则分别为1.57和2.84，多因素调整后为2.19和3.95。男性每日吸1支烟的超额风险达到每日20支烟的46%（多因素调整后为53%），女性为31%（调整后为38%）。卒中方面，男性每日吸1支和20支烟的合并相对风险为1.25和1.64（调整后为1.30和1.56），女性为1.31和2.16（调整后为1.46和2.42）；男性每日1支烟的超额卒中风险占比为41%（调整后为64%），女性为34%（调整后为36%）。女性吸烟的相对风险普遍高于男性。结论表明，即使每日仅吸约1支烟，其冠心病和卒中风险也远高于预期，约为每日吸烟20支者的一半。心血管疾病不存在安全的吸烟水平，吸烟者应彻底戒烟而非减少吸烟量，以显著降低这两种常见重大疾病的风险。
title: Low cigarette consumption and risk of coronary heart disease and stroke: meta-analysis of 141 cohort studies in 55 study reports

abstract: Increasing number of drivers are switching to electric vehicles (EV) for higher efficiency, lower environmental impact and less maintenance cost. To promote the EV revolution, charging issues of EVs needs to be well addressed. Since the traffic flow of the transportation network and the operating conditions of the power systems are time-varying, it is important to implement real-time charging navigation for EV drivers. In this paper, a novel navigation approach is proposed to search the fast charging station with the lowest overall objective, which consists both of the time consumption and the financial cost. The traffic condition and distribution system loading level are reflected by the time consumption on each road section and locational marginal price (LMP) at each fast charging station, respectively. The LMP can act as a signal to divert the EV load and thus relieve the traffic and power line congestions. The proposed navigation approach is based on the multi-agent system framework utilizing the distributed min/max- consensus and the biased min consensus algorithms. Simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed navigation approach in different scales of systems.
title: A Distributed EV Navigation Strategy Considering the Interaction Between Power System and Traffic Network

abstract: Benchmarks in utility functions have various interpretations, including performance guarantees and risk constraints in fund contracts and reference levels in cumulative prospect theory. In most of the existing literature, benchmarks are either a deterministic constant or a fraction of the underlying wealth; thus the utility is still a function of the wealth. In this paper, we propose a general framework of state-dependent utility optimisation with stochastic benchmark variables, which includes stochastic reference levels as typical examples. We provide the solution(s) and investigate the issues of well-definedness, feasibility, finiteness and attainability. The major challenges include: (i) various reasons for the non-existence of Lagrange multipliers and the corresponding results of the solution; (ii) measurability issues related to the concavification of a state-dependent utility function and the selection of solutions. Finally, we apply the framework to solve some constrained utility optimisation problems with state-dependent performance and risk benchmarks serving as non-trivial examples.
title: A framework of state-dependent utility optimisation with general benchmarks

abstract: An image cipher using block-based scrambling and image filtering (IC-BSIF) is introduced;It is the first time that image filtering is used to do encryption;IC-BSIF uses the well-known substitution-permutation network and strictly follows the principles of confusion and diffusion;The block-based scrambling is to fast separate neighboring pixels to different rows and columns, and thus can sufficiently weaken the strong correlation between adjacent pixels;IC-BSIF can encrypt different kinds of images into noise-like ones, and security evaluations demonstrate that it can achieve better performance than some state-of-the-art encryption schemes. The operation of image filtering is widely used to deblur digital images. However, using inappropriate masks, it can also blur images. Motivated by this concept, this paper introduces an image cipher using block-based scrambling and image filtering (IC-BSIF). To the best of our knowledge, this is the first time that image filtering has been used for image encryption. IC-BSIF uses the well-known substitution-permutation network and strictly follows the concepts of confusion and diffusion. The block-based scrambling is able to separate neighboring pixels to different rows and columns, and thus can efficiently weaken the strong correlations between adjacent pixels. Using randomly generated masks by the secret key, the image filtering can spread little change of plain-images to the entire pixels of cipher-images. Simulation results show that IC-BSIF can encrypt different kinds of images into noise-like ones, and security evaluations demonstrate that it can achieve better performance than several state-of-the-art encryption schemes.
summary_zh: 本文提出一种基于分块置乱与图像滤波的图像加密算法（IC-BSIF），首次将图像滤波技术应用于加密领域。该算法采用经典的代换–置换网络结构，严格遵循混淆与扩散原则。分块置乱操作能够快速将相邻像素分散至不同行和列，从而有效削弱相邻像素间的强相关性。利用密钥随机生成的滤波掩模，图像滤波可将明文图像的微小变化扩散至密文图像的全部像素。实验结果表明，IC-BSIF 能将各类图像加密为噪声状密文，且安全性评估显示其性能优于多种现有先进加密方案。
title: Design of image cipher using block-based scrambling and image filtering

abstract: A gene from human chromosome 11p11.2 was isolated and was shown to suppress metastasis when introduced into rat AT6.1 prostate cancer cells. Expression of this gene, designated KAI1 , was reduced in human cell lines derived from metastatic prostate tumors. KAI1 specifies a protein of 267 amino acids, with four hydrophobic and presumably transmembrane domains and one large extracellular hydrophilic domain with three potential N-glycosylation sites. KAI1 is evolutionarily conserved, is expressed in many human tissues, and encodes a member of a structurally distinct family of leukocyte surface glycoproteins. Decreased expression of this gene may be involved in the malignant progression of prostate and other cancers.
summary_zh: 研究人员从人类染色体11p11.2区域分离出一个新基因，将其命名为KAI1。将该基因导入大鼠AT6.1前列腺癌细胞后，可显著抑制肿瘤转移。在源自人类转移性前列腺肿瘤的细胞系中，KAI1的表达水平明显降低。该基因编码一个由267个氨基酸组成的蛋白质，其结构包含四个疏水性跨膜结构域和一个较大的胞外亲水结构域，该胞外区含有三个潜在的N-糖基化位点。KAI1在进化上高度保守，在多种人体组织中均有表达，属于白细胞表面糖蛋白中一个结构独特的家族成员。该基因的表达下调可能在前列腺癌及其他恶性肿瘤的进展过程中发挥关键作用。
title: KAI1, a Metastasis Suppressor Gene for Prostate Cancer on Human Chromosome 11p11.2

abstract: We introduce a particle levitation tensiometry to accurately quantify ultra-low interfacial tensions in liquid–liquid phase separation (LLPS) systems, crucial for understanding the structure and dynamics of membrane-less organelles in biological cells. Our technique uses non-reactive spherical microparticles to balance gravitational and interfacial forces, providing precise, repeatable, and reliable measurements across a wide range of LLPS systems, including aqueous two-phase systems, coacervates, and immiscible oil–oil systems. By adjusting the Bond number through variations in the bead size and density, our method allows for accurate interfacial tension measurements across values as low as 0.37 μN/m with minimal deviation and efficiently detects substantial variations in interfacial tensions with changes in compositions, concentrations, and ionic strengths; for instance, it recorded a change from 7.34 μN/m at a polyelectrolyte concentration of 0.002 M to 8.26 μN/m at 0.003 M. Our findings offer insights into the dynamics of LLPS and open pathways for applications in fields where accurate interfacial tension measurement is crucial, enhancing our understanding of cellular processes and enabling practical applications in drug delivery, adhesives, and coatings.
title: Particle levitation tensiometry (PLT) for probing interfaces of liquid–liquid phase separation systems (LLPSs)

summary_zh: 本文研究了一种双基地天基预警雷达系统，该系统采用发射机部署于地球同步轨道卫星、接收机部署于低地球轨道卫星的创新构型。通过分析双基地几何关系并考虑地球自转效应，建立了精确描述杂波分布的数学模型，进而给出了杂波分布轨迹，揭示了其严重的非平稳特性。仿真分析了系统天线方向图与实际波束照射范围对杂波功率谱的影响。最后，针对不同空间自由度，分析了三维空时自适应处理方法下的信杂噪比损失。本文可为双基地天基预警雷达研究提供参考。
title: Clutter Modeling and Analysis for Bistatic Space-Based Early Warning Radar with GEO Transmitter and LEO Receiver

abstract: Abstract Myo-inositol is originally applied as a cardiovascular medicine in clinic, which can be multi-ton manufactured via extraction from the byproducts in agricultural product processing such as defatted rice bran and corn-soaking water. Herein, the application of myo-inositol (MI) as a novel versatile tridentate O -donor ligand has been first described for promoting Cu-catalyzed amination reaction in aqueous medium.
summary_zh: 肌醇（Myo-inositol）最初作为心血管药物应用于临床，可通过脱脂米糠或玉米浸泡水等农业加工副产物进行大规模提取生产。本文首次报道了肌醇作为一种新型多功能三齿氧供体配体，在水相介质中能够有效促进铜催化的胺化反应。该研究不仅拓展了肌醇在化学合成领域的应用范围，也为开发绿色、可持续的催化体系提供了新思路。
title: “On Water” promoted N-arylation reactions using Cu (0)/myo-inositol catalytic system

abstract: Recent studies in information computation technology (ICT) are focusing on Next-generation networks, SDN (Software-defined networking), 5G, and 6G. Optimal working mode for device-to-device (D2D) communication is aimed at improving the quality of service with the frequency spectrum structure is of research areas in 5G. D2D communication working modes are selected to meet both the predefined system conditions and provide maximum throughput for the network. Due to the complexity of the direct solutions, we formulated the problem as an optimization problem and found the optimal working modes under different parameters of the system through extensive simulations. After determining the links’ optimal modes, we calculated the network throughput; because of selecting the best working modes, we obtained the highest throughput. A major finding from this research is that D2D communication pairs are more inclined to use full-duplex (FD) mode in short distances to meet system requirements, and so most communications take place in FD mode at these distances. According to these results, using FD communication at short distances offers better conditions and Quality of service (QoS) than QoS-D2D method.
title: Improving Quality of Service in 5G Resilient Communication with the Cellular Structure of Smartphones

summary_zh: 本文展示了一种基于三方硒纳米片的电解质栅控突触晶体管，用于构建低能耗、高异质性的人工神经网络硬件。该器件利用硒沟道本征低电导率特性，实现了每次脉冲低于0.1皮焦的超低能耗。三方硒的低对称性赋予其沿c轴与a轴方向的电导显著各向异性，各向异性比高达8.6。多端器件对相同外部刺激表现出各向异性的滤波响应，从而能够模拟人脑中轴突-多突触生物结构的异质信号传递过程。这一概念验证器件为开发面向复杂信号处理的神经形态电子系统迈出了重要一步。
title: Anisotropic Signal Processing with Trigonal Selenium Nanosheet Synaptic Transistors

abstract: With the advent of large language models (LLMs), deep artificial intelligence methods have begun to approach the field of scientific research. Nevertheless, the pre-trained LLMs face problems such as information fabrication and the inability to handle simulations in specific research fields, which restricts the further integration of artificial intelligence with professional scientific research. Here, we present a pioneering framework that harnesses the textual comprehension of LLMs alongside the physical models, thereby advancing the field of battery research. Our coevolution blueprint not only refines the LLMs' ability to conduct domain-specific simulations but also generates data, steering AI toward broader intelligence. The integration of LLMs and physical models provides a powerful tool for researchers, streamlining the transition from data analysis to experimental validation, and inspires more researchers to adopt this paradigm as a prototype to promote the integration between data, models, and information, innovating the research patterns in related fields.
title: Coevolution of large language models with physical models boosts advanced battery research

summary_zh: 在传统摩擦学系统中，摩擦系数通常随正压力增加而增大，呈现正相关关系。然而，本研究在石墨与$\alpha$-Al$_{2}$O$_{3}$表面的摩擦特性研究中发现了一种独特的“钟形”载荷依赖曲线，即摩擦力随正压力的增加呈现先上升后下降的趋势。通过有限元模拟分析发现，这种异常现象的根源在于当正压力接近某一临界值时，石墨与$\alpha$-Al$_{2}$O$_{3}$界面处的边缘发生了脱离。由于超润滑接触中的摩擦力主要源于界面边缘，边缘脱离导致了整体摩擦力的降低。研究人员通过改变针尖曲率半径及石墨薄片厚度，对这一发现进行了实验验证。这一前所未有的观测结果为超润滑领域的摩擦系数调控提供了全新范式，使得摩擦系数在正值与负值之间的转换成为可能。
title: Positive-Negative Tunable Coefficients of Friction in Superlubric Contacts

summary_zh: 糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）是糖尿病最常见的并发症之一，也是导致不可逆失明的主要原因。自动化的DR分级对于早期诊断和干预、降低患者视力丧失风险具有重要意义。尽管近年来已有多种基于深度学习的DR分级方法被提出，但现有模型大多依赖单视野眼底图像进行训练，难以实现视网膜全貌的完整可视化，且面临病灶位置分散及形态差异巨大的挑战。针对眼底特征不完整及病灶信息获取困难的问题，本文提出了一种新型多视图DR分级框架。该框架通过联合学习多个视野下的眼底图像，有效解决了特征缺失的问题；同时，模型结合了眼底图像与病灶局部快照等多种视图输入，并引入异构卷积块（HCB）与可扩展自注意力类（SSAC）模块，显著增强了模型捕捉病灶信息的能力。在大规模数据集上的实验结果表明，该方法在性能上优于现有的基准模型。
title: A Lesion-Fusion Neural Network for Multi-View Diabetic Retinopathy Grading
venue: IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics

summary_zh: 截断奇异值分解（SVD）作为一种最优低秩矩阵近似方法，广泛应用于生物学和医疗保健等高维数据领域。为了从高维数据中提取具有解释性的信息，稀疏截断奇异值分解（SSVD）通过选取原始矩阵中的少量行与列来获取最佳低秩近似。不同于现有研究侧重于单一最大奇异值或以牺牲稀疏性来换取计算效率，本文提出了一种全新的SSVD建模方法，旨在给定规模下精确选取子矩阵，以最大化其截断Ky Fan范数。针对该问题属于NP-hard的问题特性，本文首先将其重新表述为混合整数半正定规划问题，并利用带有闭式割平面（closed-form cuts）的分支定界算法框架，实现了对中小规模实例的精确求解，为评估近似算法的解质量提供了基准。随后，本文基于不同的选择准则开发了三种选择算法，并结合贪心算法与局部搜索算法提出了两种搜索策略。理论证明表明，当所选子矩阵的行数或列数不超过原矩阵的一半时，所有近似算法的近似比均为紧致且不可改进的。数值实验验证了所提算法的高解质量与计算效率。此外，本文的研究分析框架亦可推广至行稀疏主成分分析（row-sparse PCA）领域。
title: Beyond Symmetry: Best Submatrix Selection for the Sparse Truncated SVD

abstract: Scan-based design-for-testability (DfT) structure has been widely adopted in integrated circuit (IC) design. It enables high testability for circuit under test (CUT). However, security concerns are also caused. For a cryptographic chip or module, an adversary can use scan chain as a side channel to collect sensitive information for the retrieval of cipher key. This poses a high threat for the fields where the cryptographic chips are applied. Effective countermeasures should be explored to solve this problem. In this paper, we survey the existing work on secure scan designs and highlight their merits and weaknesses. Our recent work is presented to illustrate how the weaknesses in existing countermeasures can be overcome. All these work are compared in terms of the area overhead, security and impact on testability. Our ongoing work is briefly introduced to indicate the promising future work in this area.
summary_zh: 本文综述集成电路测试中基于扫描的可测试性设计所面临的安全问题及其对策。扫描链结构虽能显著提升待测电路的可测试性，但在密码芯片或模块中，攻击者可将其作为侧信道窃取敏感信息，进而恢复密钥，对密码芯片应用领域构成严重威胁。文章系统梳理了现有安全扫描设计研究，分析各类方案的优缺点，并重点介绍作者近期工作，展示如何克服已有对策中的不足。从面积开销、安全性及对可测试性的影响三个维度，对各类方案进行了对比评估。最后简要介绍正在进行的研究，指出该领域未来有前景的发展方向。
title: How to Secure Scan Design Against Scan-Based Side-Channel Attacks?

abstract: Rope-like bundles of single-walled carbon nanotubes (SWNTs) similar to those obtained by laser vaporization and electric-arc techniques were synthesized on a relatively large scale and at low cost by the catalytic decomposition of hydrocarbons at a temperature of about 1200 °C using an improved floating catalyst method. The SWNTs thus obtained have larger diameters and are self-organized into ropes. The addition of thiophene was found to be effective in promoting the growth of SWNTs and in increasing the yield of either SWNTs or multiwalled carbon nanotubes under different growth conditions.
summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种改进的浮动催化剂法，通过在约1200 °C下催化分解碳氢化合物，实现了单壁碳纳米管绳状束的大规模、低成本合成。所得产物与激光蒸发和电弧法获得的单壁碳纳米管束相似，但管径更大，且能自组装成绳状结构。实验发现，添加噻吩在不同生长条件下可有效促进单壁碳纳米管的生长，并提高单壁或多壁碳纳米管的产率。该方法为碳纳米管的规模化制备及其在复合材料、电子器件等领域的应用提供了新途径。
title: Large-scale and low-cost synthesis of single-walled carbon nanotubes by the catalytic pyrolysis of hydrocarbons

summary_zh: 本文研制了一种结合高速斩波器与温度可调脉冲阀的窄脉冲、速度可控分子束系统。通过在喷嘴下游约193 mm处利用共振增强多光子电离（REMPI）技术进行表征，该系统成功将氢分子束的脉冲宽度缩减至约6.3 μs。为了实现对氢分子速度的精确测量，研究采用了结合受激拉曼泵浦与REMPI技术的泵浦-探测法，并利用纳秒激光在固定距离处进行检测。实验结果表明，通过调节脉冲阀的温度，氢分子束的速度可在1290 m/s至3550 m/s范围内连续调节。该系统在化学反应动力学领域具有广泛的应用潜力，能够与离子阱及表面散射实验等技术进行有效集成。
title: Development and characterization of a narrow-pulsed molecular beam system

abstract: Color centers in diamond are promising solid-state qubits for scalable quantum photonics applications. Amongst many defects, those with inversion symmetry are of an interest due to their promising optical properties. In this work, we demonstrate a maskless implantation of an array of bright, single germanium vacancy (GeV) centers in diamond. Employing the direct focused ion beam technique, single GeV emitters are engineered with the spatial accuracy of tens of nanometers. The single GeV creation ratio reaches as high as 53% with the dose of 200 Ge + ions per spot. The presented fabrication method is promising for future nanofabrication of integrated photonic structures with GeV emitters as a leading platform for spin-spin interactions.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种在金刚石中无掩模制备锗空位色心阵列的方法，用于可扩展量子光子学应用。锗空位中心作为具有反演对称性的缺陷，因其优异的光学特性而备受关注。研究采用直接聚焦离子束技术，实现了单锗空位发光体的定点制造，空间精度达到数十纳米量级。实验表明，在每个注入点 200 个锗离子的剂量条件下，单锗空位的生成率高达 53%。该制备方法无需掩模，工艺简洁可控，为未来集成光子结构中锗空位色心的纳米加工提供了可行路径，有望成为自旋-自旋相互作用研究的重要平台。
title: Direct writing of single germanium vacancy center arrays in diamond

abstract: Accurate model of permanent magnet synchronous machine (PMSM) is significant for high-performance control. The machine model can be affected by various factors such as magnetic saturation and core loss effect, especially in the deep saturation and high-speed regions. This article proposes a data-driven-based machine modeling and compensation approach to improve the model accuracy by considering saturation and core loss effect. In the proposed approach, magnetic saturation is initially modeled using nonlinear polynomials and core loss effect is modeled with various speed data. The model mismatch due to these effects is then derived to generate the training data for the neural network (NN), which can accurately predict the model mismatch under various operating conditions. In comparison to the conventional model, the proposed approach adds compensation terms directly to the machine models, which can achieve better accuracy with efficiency and simple implementation, which can be utilized in motor control and parameter estimation. The proposed approach is validated on a laboratory interior PMSM and compared with existing methods under various operating conditions.
title: Data-Driven Modeling and Compensation Strategy of PMSM Considering Core Loss and Saturation
venue: IEEE Journal of Emerging and Selected Topics in Power Electronics

abstract: Luminescent liquid crystal materials (LLCMs) have been a hot research topic in the field of fluorescent materials. In this study, we successfully designed and synthesized an intense fluorescence thermotropic liquid crystal material with a fluorescence quantum yield (Φ) of 0.26 in the solid state. Moreover, the alkyl chain attached to the terminus of the chromophore was able to promote the stability of electrochemical and thermal properties, which was beneficial to the device fabrication reproducibility and stability of the device performance.
summary_zh: 发光液晶材料作为荧光材料领域的研究热点，近年来受到广泛关注。本研究设计并合成了一种具有强荧光发射性能的热致液晶材料，该材料在固态下的荧光量子产率达到0.26，表现出优异的光致发光特性。通过在发色团末端引入烷基链，有效提升了材料的电化学稳定性和热稳定性，这一结构修饰有利于器件制备过程的重现性以及器件性能的长期稳定性。该材料兼具液晶的有序性和荧光材料的高发光效率，在有机发光二极管、液晶显示、荧光传感器及生物成像等领域具有潜在的应用前景。
title: Preparation of Luminescent Thermotropic Liquid Crystal from Benzodiathiazole Derivatives

abstract: Summary During male gametogenesis in Arabidopsis , the haploid microspore undergoes an asymmetric division to produce a vegetative and a generative cell, the latter of which continues to divide symmetrically to form two sperms. This simple system couples cell cycle with cell fate specification. Here we addressed the role of DNA replication in male gametogenesis using a mutant bicellular pollen 1 ( bice1 ), which produces bicellular, rather than tricellular, pollen grains as in the wild‐type plant at anthesis. The mutation prolonged DNA synthesis of the generative cell, which resulted in c . 40% of pollen grains arrested at the two‐nucleate stage. The extended S phase did not impact the cell fate of the generative cell as shown by cell‐specific markers. BICE 1 encodes a plant homolog of human D123 protein that is required for G1 progression, but the underlying mechanism is unknown. Here we showed that BICE 1 interacts with MCM 4 and MCM 7 of the pre‐replication complex. Consistently, double mutations in BICE 1 and MCM 4, or MCM 7, also led to bicellular pollen and condensed chromosomes. These suggest that BICE 1 plays a role in modulating DNA replication via interaction with MCM 4 and MCM 7.
title: BICELLULAR POLLEN 1 is a modulator of DNA replication and pollen development in Arabidopsis

summary_zh: ADMETlab 2.0 是一个全新设计的网络服务器，用于预测化合物的药代动力学与毒性特征。鉴于候选化合物因药代动力学性质不佳和毒性问题成为药物开发失败的主因，尽早评估其吸收、分布、代谢、排泄及毒性（ADMET）已成为共识。该平台将支持的 ADMET 相关终点数量较前版扩充近一倍，涵盖 17 项理化性质、13 项药物化学性质、23 项 ADME 性质、27 项毒性终点以及 8 类毒性基团规则（含 751 个警示子结构）。为构建稳健且高精度的预测模型，平台采用了多任务图注意力网络框架。应大量用户需求，新增了批量计算模块，并对结果展示方式进行了优化。ADMETlab 2.0 服务器免费开放，无需注册，可通过 https://admetmesh.scbdd.com/ 访问，旨在为药物化学家在先导物设计与优化过程中提供辅助性的计算评价工具。
title: ADMETlab 2.0: an integrated online platform for accurate and comprehensive predictions of ADMET properties

abstract: Symmetrical solid oxide fuel cell reactor with BaZr 0.1 Ce 0.7 Y 0.1 Yb 0.1 O 3−δ as electrolyte and La 0.6 Sr 0.4 Fe 0.8 Nb 0.1 Cu 0.1 O 3−δ as electrodes is applied to cogenerate ethylene and electricity.
summary_zh: 本研究构建了一种对称结构固体氧化物燃料电池反应器，采用BaZr₀.₁Ce₀.₇Y₀.₁Yb₀.₁O₃₋δ作为电解质材料，并以La₀.₆Sr₀.₄Fe₀.₈Nb₀.₁Cu₀.₁O₃₋δ同时作为阳极和阴极。该反应器通过电化学氧化途径，实现了乙烯与电能的联产。在运行过程中，燃料在阳极侧发生选择性氧化反应生成乙烯，同时阴极侧进行氧还原反应，从而在外电路产生电流。实验结果表明，该对称电池设计简化了制备工艺，并展现出良好的催化活性与电化学稳定性，能够在高效生产乙烯的同时输出可观的电功率。这一技术路线为碳氢化合物的增值转化与清洁能源的协同产出提供了新的解决方案，在化工与能源领域具有潜在的应用前景。
title: Cogeneration of ethylene and electricity in symmetrical protonic solid oxide fuel cells based on a La0.6Sr0.4Fe0.8Nb0.1Cu0.1O3−δ electrode

abstract: With Au nanoparticles as the catalyst, the formation of Bi4Te3 nanowires was achieved at an optimized substrate temperature of around 330 °C. We found two growth mechanisms for the nanowires: a self-assembled growth mode through islands as the seed and a vapor-solid-solid growth mode through the assistance of Au catalyst nanoparticles, the decisive factor for which was identified as the density of the Au nanoparticles.
summary_zh: 以金纳米颗粒为催化剂，在约330 °C的优化衬底温度下实现了Bi4Te3纳米线的制备。研究发现纳米线存在两种生长机制：一种是通过岛状结构作为籽晶的自组装生长模式，另一种是借助金催化剂纳米颗粒辅助的气-固-固生长模式，其中金纳米颗粒的密度被确定为决定生长模式的关键因素。
title: Molecular beam epitaxy-grown Bi4Te3 nanowires

summary_zh: 近年来，基于深度学习的隐写分析器通常通过扩展网络结构来提升检测性能，但过度扩展会导致计算开销和存储需求剧增，进而增加训练与部署难度。本文提出 CALPA-NET，一种通道剪枝辅助的深度残差网络架构搜索方法，用于压缩现有庞大且过度参数化的隐写分析模型。我们观察到，现有隐写分析器广泛采用的倒金字塔结构可能与强调模型多样性的设计理念相悖，并不适合隐写分析任务。为此，引入一种结合两种网络剪枝方案的混合准则，以数据驱动方式自适应地压缩每个卷积层，最终得到的网络结构呈现出细长的瓶颈状形态。在 BOSSBase + BOWS2 数据集、更具多样性的 ALASKA 数据集以及从 ImageNet CLS-LOC 中提取的大规模子集上进行了广泛实验。结果表明，与原始隐写分析模型相比，CALPA-NET 生成的结构仅需不到百分之二的参数量和约三分之一的浮点运算量，即可达到相当的性能，并且具备更好的适应性、迁移能力和可扩展性。
title: CALPA-NET: Channel-Pruning-Assisted Deep Residual Network for Steganalysis of Digital Images
venue: IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security

abstract: The polymer/liquid-crystal composite materials have been extensively studied for their potential applications. Various optical devices based on this composite material have been proposed and realised. The device performance is highly dependent on the phase separation of this composite material. Here, we investigate the photopolymerisation-induced phase separation in this composite material. Depending on the mass ratios between the polymer and the liquid crystal, the phase separation can be well controlled and subsequently affect the morphological and electro-optical properties. At a fixed ratio, we can realise either phase-separated composite films or conventional polymer-dispersed liquid crystal films with completely different optical properties. By carefully controlling the exposure conditions, the morphologies and electro-optical properties have been studied and optimised in details. With in-depth studies and optimisation, the photopolymerisation-induced phase separation technique could be utilised to realise many different optical functions based on the polymer/liquid-crystal composite materials.
title: Controlling morphological and electro-optical properties via the phase separation in polymer/liquid-crystal composite materials

summary_zh: 本研究通过实验证明，利用单车智能控制可有效抑制交通流中的时走时停波。在一条包含二十余辆车的环形测试跑道上，即使不存在道路几何变化或车道变换等触发因素，当车流密度超过临界阈值时，交通波仍会稳定出现。实验的核心发现是，仅需对车流中单一车辆的速度进行精准调控，即可显著削弱这种集体振荡现象。研究对比了有无控制干预下的多项指标，包括速度分布、急刹车事件频率以及燃油经济性，结果表明控制策略能带来全面改善。这一发现预示着交通管理范式的重大转变：无需等到多数车辆具备自动驾驶能力，仅靠不到百分之五的移动执行器即可实现有效的车流调控，为缓解交通拥堵提供了全新思路。
title: Dissipation of stop-and-go waves via control of autonomous vehicles: Field experiments
venue: Transportation Research Part C Emerging Technologies

abstract: In this paper, we consider polynomials orthogonal with respect to a varying perturbed Laguerre weight e - n ( z - log z + t / z ) for t < 0 and z on certain contours in the complex plane. When the parameters n , t and the degree k are fixed, the Hankel determinant for the singular complex weight is shown to be the isomonodromy ? -function of the Painleve III equation. When the degree k = n , n is large and t is close to a critical value, inspired by the study of the Wigner time delay in quantum transport, we show that the double scaling asymptotic behaviors of the recurrence coefficients and the Hankel determinant are described in terms of a Boutroux tronquee solution to the Painleve I equation. Our approach is based on the Deift-Zhou nonlinear steepest descent method for Riemann-Hilbert problems.
summary_zh: 本文研究了一类变参数扰动拉盖尔权函数下正交多项式的渐近性质，权函数形式为 e^{-n(z-\log z+t/z)}，其中 t<0，z 取复平面上特定围道。当参数 n、t 及多项式次数 k 固定时，该奇异复权对应的 Hankel 行列式被证明是 Painlevé III 方程的等单导 τ 函数。受量子输运中 Wigner 时间延迟研究的启发，当次数 k=n 且 n 很大、t 趋近某一临界值时，递推系数与 Hankel 行列式的双尺度渐近行为可用 Painlevé I 方程的 Boutroux 截断解来刻画。研究方法基于 Deift-Zhou 非线性最速下降法对 Riemann-Hilbert 问题的分析。
title: Hankel determinants for a singular complex weight and the first and third Painlevé transcendents

abstract: ., prostate cancer, breast cancer, and multiple myeloma), and a cure for bone metastasis remains elusive. To recapitulate the process of bone metastasis and understand how cancer cells metastasize to bone, intracardiac injection and intracaudal arterial animal models were developed. The intratibial injection animal model was established to investigate the communication between cancer cells and the bone microenvironment and to mimic the setting of prostate cancer patients with bone metastasis. Given that detailed protocols of intratibial injection and its quantitative analysis are still insufficient, in this protocol, we provide hands-on procedures for how to prepare cells, perform the tibial injection, monitor tibial tumor growth, and quantitatively evaluate the tibial tumors in pathological samples. This manuscript provides a ready-to-use experimental protocol for investigating cancer cell behaviors in bone and developing novel therapeutic strategies for bone metastatic cancer patients.
summary_zh: 骨转移是前列腺癌、乳腺癌及多发性骨髓瘤等恶性肿瘤的常见并发症，目前仍缺乏根治手段。为重现骨转移过程并解析癌细胞向骨组织迁移的机制，研究者建立了心内注射和尾动脉注射动物模型。胫骨内注射模型则专门用于模拟前列腺癌骨转移患者的病理状态，以探究癌细胞与骨微环境之间的相互作用。鉴于现有文献中关于胫骨内注射的详细操作流程及其定量分析方法仍不完善，本方案系统提供了从细胞制备、胫骨注射实施、肿瘤生长监测到病理样本定量评估的全流程实操指南。本文为研究癌细胞在骨内的生物学行为以及开发针对骨转移患者的新型治疗策略提供了一套可直接应用的实验方案。
title: Measurement of Bone Metastatic Tumor Growth by a Tibial Tumorigenesis Assay

abstract: Communication has emerged as a critical bottleneck in the distributed training of large language models (LLMs). While numerous approaches have been proposed to reduce communication overhead, the potential of lossless compression has remained largely underexplored since compression and decompression typically consume larger overheads than the benefits of reduced communication traffic. We observe that the communication data, including activations, gradients and parameters, during training often follows a near-Gaussian distribution, which is a key feature for data compression. Thus, we introduce ZipCCL, a lossless compressed communication library of collectives for LLM training. ZipCCL is equipped with our novel techniques: (1) theoretically grounded exponent coding that exploits the Gaussian distribution of LLM tensors to accelerate compression without expensive online statistics, (2) GPU-optimized compression and decompression kernels that carefully design memory access patterns and pipeline using communication-aware data layout, and (3) adaptive communication strategies that dynamically switch collective operations based on workload patterns and system characteristics. Evaluated on a 64-GPU cluster using both mixture-of-experts and dense transformer models, ZipCCL reduces communication time by up to 1.35$\times$ and achieves end-to-end training speedups of up to 1.18$\times$ without any impact on model quality.
title: ZipCCL: Efficient Lossless Data Compression of Communication Collectives for Accelerating LLM Training

abstract: We introduce contextual stochastic bilevel optimization (CSBO) -- a stochastic bilevel optimization framework with the lower-level problem minimizing an expectation conditioned on some contextual information and the upper-level decision variable. This framework extends classical stochastic bilevel optimization when the lower-level decision maker responds optimally not only to the decision of the upper-level decision maker but also to some side information and when there are multiple or even infinite many followers. It captures important applications such as meta-learning, personalized federated learning, end-to-end learning, and Wasserstein distributionally robust optimization with side information (WDRO-SI). Due to the presence of contextual information, existing single-loop methods for classical stochastic bilevel optimization are unable to converge. To overcome this challenge, we introduce an efficient double-loop gradient method based on the Multilevel Monte-Carlo (MLMC) technique and establish its sample and computational complexities. When specialized to stochastic nonconvex optimization, our method matches existing lower bounds. For meta-learning, the complexity of our method does not depend on the number of tasks. Numerical experiments further validate our theoretical results.
title: Contextual Stochastic Bilevel Optimization

summary_zh: 本研究基于聚集诱导发光（AIE）特性的光诊疗剂日益受到关注，但AIE分子因扭曲几何构型通常吸收系数较低，且开发可被长波长激发并兼具高效光诊疗性能的AIE材料仍具挑战。为此，以具有聚集猝灭发光（ACQ）性质的稠环电子受体-给体-受体（A–D–A）型分子IDT为基础，通过在其骨架两侧简单修饰四苯乙烯（TPE）基团，成功构建了一种新型AIE分子IDT-TPE。该分子因AIE特性，其纳米颗粒荧光亮度显著增强，在小鼠肿瘤荧光成像中表现远优于IDT纳米颗粒。同时，IDT-TPE纳米颗粒具备近红外光激发能力，吸收系数高达8.9×10⁴ M⁻¹cm⁻¹，较已报道的大多数AIE分子提高约一个数量级。结合其活性氧生成能力与极高的光热转换效率（59.7%），IDT-TPE纳米颗粒在多模态光诊疗中实现了前所未有的性能。该研究为开发多功能光诊疗材料并推动其在肿瘤诊疗中的实际应用提供了有益思路。
title: Add the Finishing Touch: Molecular Engineering of Conjugated Small Molecule for High‐Performance AIE Luminogen in Multimodal Phototheranostics
